We have evolved into a Global Financial Super App, delivering complete solutions and leading innovation. Here, work has purpose: creating real opportunities, transforming people’s lives, and reshaping the financial market.

Become Sangue Laranja.

Sobre a vaga e missão do cargo 

Você fará parte do time de Corporate, Agribusiness DCM Credit Analysis, atuando na análise de operações de crédito, com foco em empresas de médio e grande porte.

No seu dia a dia, você vai:

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Travel
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Engineering at Brex

Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams span Software, Data, Security, and IT, and operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration. We tackle hard technical problems, own our outcomes, and push for excellence at every level — from architecture to deployment. It's an environment where engineering is a craft, and builders become leaders.

What you'll do

We're building a new team within Brex's Travel group to own a defined part of our next-generation travel experience, and we're looking for the Engineering Manager to build and lead it. This is a rare from-scratch opportunity: a large strategic investment, a clean slate on team shape and roadmap, and high autonomy to define how the team works.

Part of your job is deciding what the job is. The broader Travel group covers a lot of ground, and one of your first and most important tasks is to help shape this team's mandate within that bigger picture — what it owns, where its boundaries sit, and where it should focus to have the most impact. You'll start with a small existing group and grow it through hiring into the team that carries this part of travel forward.

You'll set the technical and product direction for the team, ship a competitive customer-facing product, and build the culture from day one. Because the domain is new and the roadmap is yours to shape, product judgment matters as much as technical judgment here — you'll be making real calls about what to build and why, not just executing a handed-down plan.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our New York office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Build and lead a new full-stack team owning a defined part of Brex's next-generation travel experience, growing it through hiring and onboarding new engineers.
• Help define and continually sharpen the team's mandate within the broader Travel group — what it owns, where its boundaries sit, and where it should focus.
• Set the team's technical and product direction, making thoughtful tradeoffs about what to build, in what order, and why.
• Ship a high-quality, reliable, competitive travel product, balancing customer-facing feature velocity with a durable technical foundation.
• Foster a people-centered culture on a brand-new team — one built on enablement, trust, and context-sharing.
• Partner cross-functionally across Travel, Expenses, and Product to align on scope and delivery.
• Provide strong coaching, mentorship, and career development for engineers at all levels.
• Bring an AI-forward mindset to how the team builds and operates.

Requirements
• Track record of engineering leadership building and scaling customer-facing products, including hiring and growing teams.
• Strong product sense — the ability to make and defend product and UX tradeoffs, not just technical ones.
• A staff-engineer-level technical bar; able to operate at all levels and earn the technical respect of a strong engineering team.
• Strong customer empathy and advocacy.
• Excellent written and verbal communication.
• Demonstrated coaching and mentorship of engineers across levels.

Bonus points
• Travel domain experience (e.g., online booking / travel management platforms such as Navan or similar).
• Experience standing up a new team or product area from scratch.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $240,000 CAD - $300,000 USD. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.title: Big Data Development Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 90 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

 

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

 

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Key

Responsibilities:
• Assess the Status Quo — Develop an end-to-end understanding of the campaign lifecycle and available data assets; identify all decision points currently reliant on manual judgment (opportunity identification, audience selection, budget estimation, campaign mechanics design, post-campaign review) and determine where intelligent automation yields the highest return.
• What Campaign to Run — Mine campaign opportunities from user behavior, product and market signals, and historical campaign performance; build an AI Agent that outputs candidate campaign themes with clear supporting evidence, not just a ranked list.
• Who to Target — Build or reuse user segmentation and response/propensity models; apply uplift modeling to direct budget toward truly incremental audiences who would be influenced, rather than users who would convert anyway.
• How Much Budget — Build a cost-benefit model: projected participation, incremental trading volume / revenue, ROI simulation, budget allocation recommendations, and sensitivity and risk analysis (including abuse and reward-farming risks under incentive designs).
• Feasibility Analysis Plan Design — Translate model outputs into a reviewable proposal: objectives, mechanics, target audience, budget, expected KPIs, and risk control boundaries; align with PM, Growth, and business stakeholders.
• MVP Delivery — Implement the end-to-end pipeline (data → model → recommendation → campaign configuration → A/B or holdout evaluation); run it on at least one real campaign or rigorous backtest; quantify improvement relative to the current manual decision-making baseline.

Requirements:
• Undergraduate or graduate student in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, or a related field.
• Solid proficiency in SQL and Python. Experience with real-time / streaming tech stacks (Flink, Kafka) is a plus.
• Data science foundations relevant to this project: A/B experiment design, causal inference and uplift modeling, propensity/response models, and basic predictive modeling. Must be able to distinguish correlation from incremental effect.
• Hands-on experience with LLM application development: prompt engineering, RAG, Agent / tool-calling frameworks; able to use LLMs for reasoning and orchestration on top of quantitative models.
• Business acumen: genuine interest in fintech / crypto and growth marketing; able to translate a business question ("Should we run a trading competition next month?") into a data problem, and translate the conclusion back into an actionable decision for business stakeholders.
• Strong communication skills — this role sits at the intersection of data, PM, and growth/marketing.
• Bonus: experience in growth / CRM / campaign analytics, recommendation systems, or marketing mix modeling background.
• Minimum 3-month internship commitment, 5 days per week on-site.
• Fluent in Mandarin is required.

Why Join Us

 

At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. Our benefits include:
• Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
• Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
• Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
• Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
• Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

jobs.title: Governance Intern / Business Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 90 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

 

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

 

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

About the Role

We are looking for an analytical, organised and proactive Fiat Payments Business Manager to support fiat governance and the management and development of our global and European fiat, card and payments businesses, including business activities within regulated entities. This role combines business management, project coordination, performance analysis, market research and general business risk control, working across teams to turn business priorities into clear plans and measurable outcomes.

You will help keep key initiatives on track, provide actionable insights and support effective governance across the business. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role focused on coordination, analysis and delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Support the day-to-day management and development of the fiat and payments business, with a focus on the following areas:
• Fiat governance and business coordination: Support governance and business management across global and European operations, including regulated entities. Prepare meeting materials, maintain decision and action logs, and follow up on agreed actions. Coordinate with relevant control functions to ensure initiatives follow applicable entity-level requirements and established review and approval processes, respecting local accountability and decision-making authority. Support general business risk control by identifying and tracking operational, financial and delivery risks, coordinating mitigation actions, monitoring adherence to agreed controls and escalating issues promptly. Work alongside Risk, Compliance, Legal and Finance, without replacing their specialist responsibilities or independent oversight.
• Key project management: Coordinate priority initiatives across fiat, cards and payments. Maintain project plans, milestones, owners and dependencies; monitor progress; and escalate risks or blockers with practical recommendations.
• Data analysis and business insights: Analyse business performance, customer behaviour, revenue, costs and product adoption. Translate findings into clear insights that support prioritisation, commercial decisions and performance improvements.
• Market and competitor research: Monitor developments in crypto, fiat payments and card products. Assess competitor propositions, customer needs and emerging opportunities, and summarise their implications for the business.
• Business and product development support: Help assess new initiatives, prepare business cases and coordinate launch readiness and post-launch reviews with Product, Operations, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Legal and other stakeholders.
• Reporting and communication: Produce regular business reports and concise management updates covering performance, project status, key risks and decisions required. Maintain accurate and well-organised supporting documentation.
• Cross-functional delivery: Bring together stakeholders across business lines and departments, clarify responsibilities and follow through on commitments to support timely delivery.

What We Are Looking For

You bring strong analytical and organisational skills, sound judgement and a genuine interest in building your career in fiat, payments and digital assets.
• A bachelor’s degree or higher, with at least one year of relevant professional experience; two years or more is preferred. Basic understanding of crypto, fiat payments, cards or related financial services, with a strong interest in developing expertise in these areas.
• Strong data analysis skills, including the ability to interpret financial and operational metrics and communicate clear, actionable conclusions.
• Project management and organisational capability, with a structured approach to prioritisation, progress tracking and follow-through.
• Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to prepare concise reports and presentations for different audiences.
• Ability to collaborate across departments and business lines, align stakeholders and coordinate projects without relying on direct authority.
• A results-oriented mindset, attention to detail and ownership of the quality and timeliness of deliverables.
• Resilience under pressure and comfort working with ambiguity, changing priorities and a fast-moving business environment.
• Sound risk awareness and judgement, including knowing when to raise concerns or involve the appropriate specialists.
• A fast learner with a proactive, curious approach, able to quickly understand new products, business models and industry developments and adapt to changing priorities.
• Fluent English, both written and spoken, is essential. Availability to work during European business hours is required.

Preferred Qualifications

The following would be an advantage, but are not essential:
• Relevant working experience in crypto, fintech, fiat payments, card businesses or related financial services.
• Relevant academic and/or professional background in economics, treasury, data analytics, finance or a related discipline, with strong numerical skills and confidence working with data.
• Experience with analytical tools such as advanced Excel, SQL or business intelligence platforms.
• Experience working in an international company, with a track record of effective cross-departmental communication and coordination across teams, markets or time zones. Comfortable navigating complex, multi-stakeholder workflows, managing dependencies and working through multiple review and approval stages. Experience supporting cross-functional projects, business reporting or governance processes is an advantage.
• Mandarin or a European language, such as German, French, Spanish, Portuguese or Italian.

• Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.

• This is not a pure strategy-writing or manual operations role. You own business definition, cross-functional problem-solving and growth delivery; regional RMs and CMs own customer relationships, frontline execution and local commercial accountability.

Key Responsibilities
• Find VIP growth opportunities and customer-experience gaps. Work directly with regions and RMs, combining customer insights, competitor intelligence and operating data to identify acquisition, upgrade, product adoption, retention and reactivation opportunities. Investigate blockers proactively rather than waiting for the analytics function to assign work.
• Own VIP proposition, loyalty and programme strategy. Strengthen benefits, tier positioning, loyalty mechanisms and partnerships against customer needs and competitor offerings. Define the role of each programme in the VIP lifecycle, balancing premium experience, market competitiveness, delivery feasibility and sustainable economics.
• Design and rationalise lifecycle programmes. Develop and optimise experience-to-upgrade journeys, Momentum, retention, Recall and other approved use cases. Maintain clear eligibility, triggers, thresholds, reward rules, budget, duration, exit and exception requirements. Use performance evidence to retain, redesign, merge or stop programmes; prevent conflicting benefits and duplicate subsidies.
• Integrate business coordination with growth delivery. Own the coordination of VIP programme blockers involving benefits, task mechanics, reward fulfilment, approvals or cross-team handoffs. Establish accountable PICs, actions, timelines, escalation needs and closure evidence. Resolve recurring patterns through standardisation and productisation, not permanent ad-hoc manual work.
• Drive end-to-end automation and CRM improvements. Translate priorities into business requirements, rules and acceptance criteria with Internal Tooling, CRM and relevant Product teams through the unified intake channel. Cover eligibility, task issuance, progress, rewards, exceptions and result capture; distinguish automated steps from RM actions. Automatic task distribution alone is not completion.
• Develop commercially sound deal and incentive frameworks. Maintain VIP deal templates and guidance, evaluate rewards, costs and net contribution under approved budget rules, and work with Finance and Risk on incentive boundaries. Identify overlaps with global campaigns and other lifecycle tasks; recommend sequencing, exclusions or adjustments for approval.
• Lead regional rollout and VIP GTM. Agree target segments, regional suitability, participation expectations and delivery plans with BUs, CRM, Marketing and regional teams. Coordinate business cases, customer lists, approved communications and launch readiness. Ensure local consent and applicable market restrictions are respected; RMs retain customer-contact ownership.
• Improve RM service standards through programme insight. Use CSAT, response times, recurring customer cases and product feedback to improve programme design and identify service gaps. Collaborate with Analytics Governance on execution monitoring and remediation evidence, and with Training on capability gaps and materials; do not take over RM line management.
• Define benefits and event business requirements. For gifts, partnerships and VIP events, specify customer objectives, eligibility, service expectations and expected commercial outcomes. Work with Marketing/Event owners and Merch or fulfilment teams on delivery; support tooling and process improvements without personally owning routine stocking, shipping or logistics.
• Validate incremental and sustained business impact. Partner with Analytics on pilots, comparable cohorts or phased experiments. Measure formal upgrades after trials, continued trading after rewards end, retention, revenue and net contribution. Separate natural market movement and overlapping campaign effects from programme contribution; scale, adjust or discontinue mechanisms accordingly.

Required Qualifications
• 5+ years of experience in VIP programmes, customer lifecycle growth, loyalty, relationship-management operations or comparable commercial programme roles.
• Demonstrated delivery of initiatives improving activation, upgrades, sustained activity, retention or revenue, not only campaign launches.
• Strong understanding of high-value customer needs, programme incentives and sustainable unit economics.
• Analytical capability in segmentation, cohort behaviour, programme cost-benefit assessment and practical experimentation.
• Experience translating complex programme mechanics into clear business rules, CRM requirements and acceptance criteria.
• Proven ability to resolve cross-functional business blockers, manage dependencies and drive adoption across regions without line authority.
• Excellent written and spoken English; able to communicate clear strategies, programme documentation and stakeholder decisions.
• Customer-oriented, structured and commercially pragmatic, with sound judgement on compliance, budgets and approval boundaries.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in a cryptocurrency exchange, fintech or financial services business.
• Familiarity with VIP benefit structures, tier programmes, loyalty partnerships and premium customer engagement.
• Experience with CRM automation, task/reward engines, retention experiments and lifecycle analytics.
• Exposure to RM service-quality monitoring, product-feedback processes or multi-market VIP programme rollout.

jobs.description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 90 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

 

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

 

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Position Overview

As a Senior PMO, you will act as a strategic partner to the business, driving the company’s project portfolio management and governance at an enterprise level. You will independently coordinate cross-functional resources, steer complex project life cycles, and ensure strict alignment between strategic initiatives and business objectives. This role requires exceptional leadership without authority, advanced organizational agility, and the ability to seamlessly bridge executive-level strategic thinking with rigorous, detail-oriented execution.

 

Key Responsibilities
1. Project Portfolio Management Resource Strategy
• Lead and own end-to-end (full lifecycle) project management for multiple high-impact, company-level strategic initiatives, ensuring high-quality and on-time delivery.
• Directly manage complex project portfolios, define priorities, and independently resolve resource contentions and critical path conflicts.
• Optimize resource utilization globally; formulate strategies for manpower, time, and budget allocation to maximize ROI.
• Drive project initiation reviews, establish priority frameworks, and enforce rigorous schedule tracking methodologies.
2. Stakeholder Management Communication
• Act as the primary bridge across business, product, R D, QA, and other departments, fostering high-performance synergy and aligning diverse teams on shared deliverables.
• Deliver executive-level, structured reports and presentations to senior management regarding project health, strategic risks, and mitigation strategies.
• Proactively navigate and resolve complex project conflicts using advanced stakeholder management skills—balancing consensus-building (soft skills) with firm decision enforcement (hard skills).
3. Process Governance Continuous Improvement
• Establish, standardize, and scale organizational project management processes, methodology frameworks, and deliverable standards.
• Lead periodic audits and health checks to ensure strict project compliance with organizational governance standards.
• Drive continuous closed-loop optimization; track the effectiveness of implemented improvements across ongoing and new projects, shaping a culture of excellence.
4. Data-Driven Governance Tooling
• Design, implement, and maintain comprehensive KPI dashboards and metrics for enterprise project governance.
• Conduct advanced data analysis and visualization to preemptively identify project bottlenecks, financial risks, and schedule variances.
• Leverage, configure, and optimize project management toolchains (e.g., Jira, Lark, BDOT) to streamline task breakdown, automated tracking, and workflow efficiency.
5. Strategic Alignment Business Acumen
• Demonstrate profound understanding of the company’s industry, market dynamics, and business models.
• Proactively identify opportunities where project outcomes can better serve business strategy, influencing product and business roadmaps.

Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree or above, preferably in Computer Science, Business Administration, or related disciplines. (PMP, ACP, or Prince2 certification is highly preferred).
• 3-5+ years of proven experience in PMO, Project/Program Management, preferably within a fast-paced tech or Internet environment.
• Exceptional analytical, risk management, and problem-solving skills, with a proven track record of delivering complex technical or business projects from 0 to 1.
• Advanced proficiency in configuring and utilizing project management toolchains (e.g., Jira, Lark, Confluence, BDOT).
• Demonstrated resilience and adaptability to thrive and lead in a dynamic, highly ambiguous environment with shifting priorities.
• Bilingual proficiency in Chinese and English (both written and spoken) is required, with the ability to influence and negotiate across global, diverse teams.

Nossa área de App Platform

A área de App Platform Engineering é responsável por construir as capacidades, produtos e padrões que impulsionam o desenvolvimento de aplicações em toda a organização. Atuamos de forma transversal junto aos times de Android, iOS, Backend, Arquitetura, Segurança e Produto, fornecendo soluções que aumentam a produtividade dos desenvolvedores, melhoram a qualidade dos produtos e aceleram a entrega de valor ao negócio.Nosso objetivo é criar as fundações que permitam aos times desenvolver software de forma mais eficiente, padronizada e escalável, preparando a engenharia para os desafios atuais e futuros.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? Coinbase is building the future of finance for people, institutions and their agents, with one place to trade crypto, equities, derivatives and prediction markets, use stablecoins, and connect AI agents with clear controls. The bar is high and the pace is intense, and we like it that way. This isn’t a place for complacency. It’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits and do the best work of your career. If you’re ready to build the future of finance with a championship team who refuse to settle for “good enough,” you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for in-person working sessions

This is a 12-week internship during summer
2027. As an intern on the Policy team, you'll get hands-on exposure to how Coinbase shapes crypto policy in Washington and beyond. Depending on where the team needs support, you may spend the summer on more outward-facing, community engagement work, or on more technical, research-driven policy analysis — sometimes a mix of both. The strongest candidates genuinely care about digital assets policy, work well with others, and can flex between hands-on advocacy work and detailed technical analysis depending on what the team needs that week.

What you'll do:
• Support a mix of policy workstreams, from advocacy, community engagement, and stakeholder outreach to technical research, regulatory analysis, and briefing materials
• Draft policy materials such as talking points, white papers, social media posts, presentation decks, and short and long-form articles for external audiences
• Conduct research on legislative, regulatory, and policy developments and synthesize findings into actionable briefs for the Policy team
• Provide operational support on key deliverables including drafting, proofreading, data compilation, and project coordination

Required Skills and

Experience:
• A collaborative team player who can flex between grassroots/community-facing work and more technical, substantive research depending on team needs
• Comfortable operating in ambiguity, able to make progress on undefined or evolving problems without needing every detail spelled out
• Currently pursuing a degree or certificate in public policy, political science, law, international relations, or a related field, with a genuine interest in US policy and government
• Demonstrated research capability, including experience producing written analysis of legislative, regulatory, or policy topics (academic or professional)
• A proactive, self-starter mindset with the ability to manage multiple concurrent deliverables with minimal supervision over a 12-week engagement
• Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

jobs.title: Branch Experience Manager - Kaduna
jobs.description:
About us

Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times, Moniepoint is Africa’s fastest growing fintech, trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of Naira’s in transactions monthly. Our mission is to enable financial happiness for every African, everywhere.

About this role

The Branch Experience Manager (XM) is the daily operational commander of the branch and the person accountable for how every customer experiences it. The role exists to make sure customers are served quickly, treated well, and leave satisfied, while the branch runs smoothly, safely, and in line with policy. This is a service-and-operations leadership role first; growth and commercial targets are owned above the branch at the regional layer.

Responsibilities
• Customer Experience
• Own the end-to-end customer

experience:

first impression on arrival, journey through the service zones, and how the customer feels on exit
• Set and hold the premium service standard expected of a Moniepoint branch, and model it personally on the floor
• Resolve customer complaints and escalations quickly, and use recurring issues to improve how the branch runs
• Queue Flow Management
• Run the queueing system actively: monitor wait times, anticipate build-ups, and intervene before queues form rather than after
• Coordinate staff movement across zones in real time based on traffic and demand, opening and closing service points as needed
• Operations Control
• Enforce service-level agreements, compliance hygiene, and operational standards across all workstreams
• Act as first responder for in-branch escalations, system downtime, and technical disruptions, coordinating a fast return to service
• Oversee opening and closing readiness, branch presentation, and the safe, compliant running of the premises
• At regional branches, hold oversight of cash and vault operations under dual control, while keeping the role independent of cash custody and reconciliation
• People Reporting
• Lead, motivate, and develop the branch team (including Operations Supervisor, front-line and service staff, and security and support functions), and ensure the Operations Supervisor can deputise fully in the XM's absence
• Report daily branch performance, service metrics, and incidents to the Regional Operations Manager

Experience Background
• Degree in a relevant field
• 5+ years in branch operations, service management, or a customer-facing leadership role in banking or financial services
• Sound understanding of CBN regulations, KYC, and branch compliance
• Comfortable with a digital, paperless service model and with reading operational data

Skills Competencies
• Strong customer-service orientation with a genuine instinct for how a branch should feel to a customer
• Proven ability to lead a team and stay calm under pressure during peak traffic or system issues
• Proactive queue and floor management skills to anticipate bottlenecks and reallocate resources in real time
• Strong operational discipline, compliance mindset, and incident-response coordination

What success looks like in this role
• Low average customer wait times and a high percentage of customers served within target
• Strong customer satisfaction and service quality scores
• Fast complaint resolution rates and turnaround times, paired with continuous operational improvements from recurring feedback
• High branch uptime and rapid recovery from technical or operational disruptions
• Strong audit and compliance ratings, with clear daily reporting and a fully capable deputy in the Operations Supervisor

jobs.title: Hardware Engineer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

What We Do

At Moniepoint, we are a customer-focused community dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We leverage artificial intelligence and data to support our businesses with essential services like credit and overdrafts. We’re here to create financial happiness for everyone, everywhere.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

Role Purpose

The Hardware Engineer (Repair Centre) is the technical authority embedded within a repair centre. This role bridges the gap between hands-on repair operations and engineering-level quality governance. It exists to ensure that every repaired terminal leaving the centre is fit for redeployment, that technician capability continuously improves, and that quality failures are understood, root-caused, and eliminated.

Key Responsibilities
• Design electronic hardware circuits and ensure it complies with specifications.
• Design printed circuit board (PCB) layout as specified.
• Create, maintain and update engineering related aspects (e.g. parts, bill of materials) of a design or product.
• Develop processes and procedures that will support training technician competency to repair with the specified standards, guidelines and technical requirements.
• Create, maintain and update repair procedures.
• Conduct testing of products and tools. Recommend modifications and corrections to design deficiencies through evaluation of operational capability of product/equipment.
• Research, plan, analyze and support hardware design and modifications to determine the feasibility of design or application.
• Research and analyze specifications and manuals of hardware products.
• Documentation: Maintaining detailed records of repair process, repair results and issues identified during the process.
• Collaboration: Working closely with repair technicians, hardware engineers and relevant teams..
• Process Improvement: Identifying areas for improvement to enhance overall repair process, quality and efficiency.
• Perform other duties as delegated and assigned by Line Manager.

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Electrical/ Electronics, or a related field is preferred.
• Experience in terminal repair is an advantage.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to reconcile discrepancies and identify areas for improvement.
• Proficiency in using Microsoft Office applications.
• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and record-keeping.
• Strong organizational and time management skills to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.
• Effective written and verbal communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team, with a proactive and solution-oriented approach.

What we can offer you
• Culture: We put our people first. We’ve built a company where all voices are heard and we look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
• Learning: We offer a learning-focused environment with knowledge sharing, training, and regular technical talks.
• Compensation: You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, and an annual bonus.

What to expect in the hiring process
• A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
• An interview with the Hiring Team.
• An interview with a member of our Executive team.

Moniepoint Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

jobs.title: Implementation Officer (Abia)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint is Africa’s all-in-one financial ecosystem, empowering businesses and their customers with seamless payment, banking, credit, and management tools. In 2023, we processed $182 billion and are Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer. We are on a mission to create financial happiness for everyone, everywhere.

What We Do

At Moniepoint, we are a customer-focused community dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We leverage artificial intelligence and data-driven best practices to support our businesses, from providing credit and overdrafts to ensuring every transaction is secure.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out our stories on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

Job Title: Implementation Officer

Reports To: Lead, Onboarding

Location: Abia - Aba North, Aba South, Umuahia North

Work Mode: Hybrid

Employment Type: Outsourcing

Job Purpose

The Implementation Officer ensures new retail customers successfully adopt Moniebook POS into their daily store operations through structured, high-touch onboarding experiences. This role bridges the gap between sales and long-term customer success by transforming newly signed customers into confident, active users who derive maximum value from the platform within their first 30-60 days.

Operating as the customer's primary guide during the critical early adoption phase, you will understand each retailer's unique operational needs, configure Moniebook to fit their workflow, deliver effective training, and drive product adoption that sets the foundation for retention and expansion. Activation rates, time-to-value, feature adoption depth, and seamless handoffs to Account Managers measure success.

Key Responsibilities
• Onboarding Program Design Execution: Create and execute tailored onboarding plans that guide customers from signup to full operational usage. Define clear milestones, timelines, and success metrics for each customer's onboarding journey.
• Product Setup Configuration: Guide customers through initial Moniebook POS setup.
• Training Delivery Enablement: Conduct engaging live training sessions (both one-on-one and group) that educate retail staff on core Moniebook features, best practices, and operational workflows. Create an environment where users feel confident and empowered to use the POS system independently.
• Adoption Monitoring Progress Tracking: Monitor customer usage data, transaction volume, feature adoption, and engagement signals. Proactively identify at-risk customers showing low adoption and intervene with targeted support to get them back on track.
• Relationship Building Trust Establishment: Build strong, trust-based relationships with key stakeholders during the onboarding period. Be responsive, empathetic, and solutions-oriented in addressing concerns and questions.
• Issue Resolution Escalation Management: Provide troubleshooting support for technical issues, user errors, or configuration challenges during onboarding. Escalate complex technical issues to Product/Engineering teams while maintaining customer communication and managing expectations.
• Documentation Knowledge Sharing: Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, onboarding progress, configuration details, and issues in CRM/CS platform. Document common customer questions and best practices to improve onboarding resources and internal knowledge base.
• Account Manager Handoff: Execute smooth, well-documented handoffs to the account manager upon onboarding completion. Provide context on customer goals, usage patterns, relationship notes, and any ongoing concerns to ensure continuity of support.
• Feedback Loop Product Insights: Capture and share customer feedback, feature requests, usability issues, and competitive insights with Product and Account management teams. Act as the voice of the customer to inform improvements to product development and the onboarding process.

Qualifications
• 2-4 years of experience in customer onboarding, customer success, implementation, or account management roles (preferably in SaaS, retail technology, or POS systems)
• Must have completed NYSC or possess a valid exemption/exclusion certificate.
• Proven track record of successfully onboarding customers to software platforms and driving product adoption
• Excellent communication and presentation skills with ability to train diverse audiences
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, able to diagnose customer challenges and recommend effective solutions
• Customer-first mindset with genuine passion for helping people succeed and delivering exceptional experiences
• Highly organised and detail-oriented, capable of managing multiple onboarding projects simultaneously while maintaining quality
• Self-motivated, proactive, and adaptable, comfortable working independently and taking ownership of customer outcomes
• Technical aptitude and comfort with software tools
• Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Communication, or related field (or equivalent work experience) 

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience creating training materials, documentation, or knowledge base content
• Exposure to SaaS onboarding methodologies, customer health scoring, or CS best practices
• The candidate should be based in Abia – Aba North, Aba South, Umuahia North
• Please indicate your preferred location.

About You
• You're deeply customer-obsessed; you measure your success by your customers' success and genuinely care about their outcomes
• You're an exceptional teacher and communicator who can explain complex concepts simply and make technology accessible to non-technical users
• You're naturally empathetic and patient; you understand that change is hard and meet customers where they are with understanding and support
• You're process-driven but flexible; you follow structured onboarding frameworks while adapting to each customer's unique needs and pace
• You thrive on problem-solving and troubleshooting; you're resourceful, persistent, and don't give up until the customer succeeds
• You're a team player who collaborates seamlessly across Sales, Product, Support, and Account managers to deliver great customer experiences

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial ecosystem, helping 10 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, and business management tools since
2019. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, it powers most of the country’s Point of Sale (POS) transactions. Through its subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes $22 billion monthly for its customers while operating profitably.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

About

the role:

We are hiring for a dedicated Google Acquisition function to drive scalable customer growth across both our personal and business banking products. You will own the end-to-end Google performance channel — from campaign architecture and technical infrastructure to economic modelling and channel governance.

This is not an execution role dressed up as a leadership role. We need someone who thinks in systems, works from first principles, and has the depth to make credible judgements on strategy, technology, and economics simultaneously.

Responsibilities
• Campaign Architecture Execution
• Design and own the full Google channel strategy across UAC / App Campaigns, Performance Max, and Search for both personal and business banking acquisition
• Build and maintain campaign structures optimised for Moniepoint's dual-product funnel — separating signals, audiences, and bidding logic appropriately across segments
• Set bidding strategies, budget allocation frameworks, and creative testing cycles that reduce dependence on any single signal or format
• Own campaign performance end-to-end: from brief to launch to optimisation to reporting
• Tracking, Attribution Technical Infrastructure
• Architect and own the full measurement stack: Firebase / GA4 event taxonomy, Google Tag Manager configuration, and server-side event pipelines
• Lead the implementation and ongoing integrity of Conversion APIs and enhanced conversions to maximise signal quality sent back to Google
• Define the attribution model — evaluate last-click, data-driven, and custom models against Moniepoint's funnel reality, and own the decision with clear reasoning
• Partner with engineering and data teams to ensure event data flowing to Google is accurate, complete, and timely — treating signal quality as a competitive asset
• Build audit protocols for tracking coverage and attribution consistency; surface gaps before they distort decisions
• LTV/CAC Economics
• Own the economic model for Google acquisition: define CAC targets by product, segment, and channel variant; set the inputs, assumptions, and review cadence
• Understand the LTV/CAC relationship at a structural level — not just as a ratio to optimise, but as a function of product retention, monetisation curves, and cohort behaviour
• Build and iterate on payback period models that account for Moniepoint's emerging market context: irregular income patterns, higher churn risk, and longer monetisation timelines
• Design bidding and budget logic that reflects true LTV signals rather than proxy metrics, working closely with data science to enrich Google's Smart Bidding with offline conversion data
• Proactively identify when CAC is drifting against LTV thresholds and lead the diagnosis — channel mix, audience quality, creative fatigue, product-market fit — before it becomes a financial problem
• Governance Reporting
• Build a channel reporting system that surfaces reality clearly — not dashboards that flatter performance, but views that drive better decisions
• Establish review cadences with clear owners, metrics, and follow-through mechanisms
• Translate channel performance into business language for senior stakeholders: what is the cost of growth, is it sustainable, and what would change the trajectory
• Emerging Market Fintech Context
• Adapt Google acquisition strategy for the realities of emerging market users: variable device penetration, low-bandwidth environments, trust barriers to financial services, and diverse
• language/literacy contexts
• Navigate platform constraints specific to fintech advertising on Google: financial services policies, verification requirements, and creative compliance
• Bring genuine insight into what acquisition patterns distinguish sustainable fintech growth from subsidised growth in markets like Nigeria

To succeed in this role, you should have:
• 6+ years of hands-on paid acquisition experience, with the majority of that time spent on Google UAC / App Campaigns at meaningful scale
• Deep, demonstrable technical knowledge of Google's campaign infrastructure: bidding algorithms, audience signals, creative specs, and the mechanics of Smart Bidding
• Proven ability to architect and own the full measurement stack — Firebase, GA4, GTM, Conversion APIs — not just configure it but understand why each component matters
• Fluency in LTV/CAC modelling: you have built the models, owned the assumptions, and used them to make real budgeting and bidding decisions
• Experience operating in a fintech or financial services context, with direct knowledge of the acquisition compliance and trust dynamics unique to financial products
• Strongly Preferred
• Experience managing budgets larger that 10 Million USD annually
• Experience running Google acquisition in Sub-Saharan Africa or comparable emerging markets — Nigeria specifically is a significant advantage
• Familiarity with server-side conversion APIs, offline conversion imports, and enhanced conversions as mechanisms for improving signal quality in cookieless or app-first environments
• Experience working with data science or analytics teams to build custom bidding signals and offline LTV imports into Google's systems
• Prior work on dual-product or dual-segment acquisition (e.g., consumer and SME / business) with separate funnel logic

What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days
• Full audit of existing Google campaign structure, tracking integrity, and attribution model completed — with a written assessment and prioritised improvement plan
• Measurement stack gaps identified and remediation underway with engineering
• LTV/CAC baseline model built with documented assumptions, reviewed with Growth and Finance
• First governance cadence established — weekly performance review with clear owner, metrics, and follow-through log

In the first year
• Google channel operating as a reliable, scalable growth engine with predictable CAC across both personal and business banking segments
• Signal quality measurably improved — higher match rates, cleaner conversion data, reduced reliance on last-click proxies
• Attribution model validated against actual cohort data and actively used in budget allocation decisions
• Playbook documented: campaign architecture, bidding logic, audience strategy, and economic model all institutionalised — not living in one person's head
• A team (or foundations for one) built with clear ownership, development paths, and no single point of failure

What to expect in the hiring process
• A preliminary phone call with the recruiter
• A technical interview with the hiring manager
• A Case Study
• A behavioural and technical interview with a member of the Executive team
• All interview stages are virtual

jobs.title: Resident Internal Control Officer (RICO)
jobs.description:
About Us:

Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times, Moniepoint is Africa’s fastest growing fintech, trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of Naira’s in transactions monthly. Our mission is to enable financial happiness for every African, everywhere.

About this role:

The Resident Internal Control Officer is responsible for establishing a permanent, independent, on-site control presence at the assigned Moniepoint MfB branch. The primary objective is to monitor daily transaction integrity across all branch activities, mitigate operational risks, prevent and detect insider and outsider fraud, and ensure adherence to internal bank policies and procedures.

Scope note: Loan origination, disbursement, recovery and portfolio review, cheque operations, and compliance activities (including KYC/AML reviews and regulatory reporting) are outside the scope of this role. All other products, services, and activities conducted at the branch fall within the RICO's remit. Where a RICO notices a suspected compliance or AML concern while carrying out control reviews, it is referred to the Compliance function without delay.

Responsibilities
1. Daily On-Site Operational Controls
• Cash and vault controls: Perform daily vault, teller till, ATM/cash-recycler (where applicable), and petty cash counts, validating physical balances against the Core Banking Application (CBA) records and cash-in-transit documentation.
• Dual control and key custody: Enforce dual-control principles for vault access, cash movement, high-value transactions, and custody of keys, combinations, tokens, and sensitive stationery.
• Teller and counter operations: Review cash deposits, withdrawals, transfers, and teller end-of-day balancing for accuracy, correct authorisation, and adherence to transaction limits.
• Transaction and exception review: Review daily transaction logs, exception reports, reversals, backdated entries, and system overrides to detect unauthorised activity or breaches of approval limits.
• Reconciliation and general ledger: Verify timely reconciliation of settlement, nostro/correspondent, and inter-branch accounts; review suspense, sundry, and other control accounts for aged or unexplained items; confirm proper clearance.
• Deposit products: Test the accuracy of interest computation and booking on savings and fixed/term deposit accounts; verify early-liquidation approvals and rollover instructions.
• Account servicing: Review account maintenance activity, including mandate and signatory changes, BVN/NIN updates, account reactivation, dormant account handling, account closures, liens, and Post-No-Debit (PND) restrictions, to ensure each is properly authorised and supported.
• Electronic and agent channels: Monitor branch-linked electronic channels and services (POS, ATM, mobile/internet banking, USSD, agent banking) for irregular activity; control the issuance, activation, and custody of cards, PINs, and tokens.
• Staff and user access: Review system user profiles, access rights, segregation of duties, and staff account activity; flag dormant, shared, or excessive access.
• Assets and expenses: Verify physical asset registers and monitor branch operating expenses and procurement against approved budget limits.
• Physical security: Confirm that CCTV, alarms, strong-room integrity, cash-handling procedures, and the visitor register are functioning and in use.
2. Inspections, Investigations Reporting
• Investigations: Conduct targeted investigations into cash shortages and overages, operational errors, customer complaints, and suspected staff collusion or fraud, preserving evidence and escalating in line with policy.
• Surprise checks: Carry out unannounced cash, vault, asset, and process checks, and risk-based sample testing across branch activities.
• Remediation tracking: Track and follow up on remediation plans issued by Head Office Internal Audit or external examiners, where they relate to branch controls, until closure.
• Examination support: Serve as the branch point of contact during internal audits and external examinations, coordinating document requests and responses.
• Incident escalation: Escalate material incidents, fraud events, and control breaches to the Regional Lead and the Head, Distribution Network Risk Control immediately, in line with the incident escalation timelines. Findings and escalations are not subject to approval by branch management.
• Reporting: Compile and submit daily, weekly, and monthly control reports detailing branch risk trends, process gaps, control exceptions, and corrective actions taken.

Experience Background
• Education: Bachelor's degree or Higher National Diploma (HND) in Accounting, Banking Finance, Economics, or a related business discipline.
• Experience:

Minimum of 3 years' experience in internal control or internal audit within a Microfinance Bank, Commercial Bank, or Fintech company in Nigeria, with exposure to branch operations.
• Professional certification (any one of the following):
• CBN Microfinance Certification Programme (MCP) administered by the Chartered Institute of Bankers of Nigeria (CIBN).
• Associate of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Nigeria (ACA).
• Associate of the Chartered Institute of Bankers of Nigeria (ACIB).
• ACCA or CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner) will be an added advantage.

Skills Competencies
• Technical knowledge:
• Working knowledge of CBN guidelines for Microfinance Banks as they relate to branch operations and internal controls.
• Understanding of branch banking operations: cash management, deposit products, account maintenance, electronic channels, reconciliations, and general ledger controls.
• Hands-on experience with a modern Core Banking Application (e.g., Orbit, Finacle, T24, BankOne) and advanced Microsoft Excel; ability to analyse transaction data and exception reports.
• High moral integrity: Uncompromising ethical standards with zero tolerance for irregularities.
• Analytical mindset: Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to spot subtle patterns of fraud or process manipulation.
• Firm communication: Ability to stand one's ground objectively against peer pressure or branch management overrides, while communicating issues clearly to executive leadership.
• Independence and discretion: Maintains objectivity and confidentiality, and does not take part in the operational processes being controlled.
• Sound judgement and resilience: Works effectively under pressure and escalates promptly and appropriately.

What Success Looks Like in This Role
• Zero unmitigated cash discrepancies, dual-control breaches, or unauthorized system overrides across daily branch operations.
• Early detection and swift escalation of potential insider or outsider fraud, protecting bank assets and customer trust.
• Timely, accurate submission of daily, weekly, and monthly control reports that provide clear visibility into branch risk trends.
• 100% closure of internal audit and external examination remediation items within agreed timelines.
• Strong, independent control governance maintained objectively alongside branch operations.

You’ll be an expert at understanding how our always on strategy can support other key brand moments, collaborating seamlessly with our campaign team to bring this to life seamlessly.

• You have impeccable planning skills. You’ll have your finger on the pulse of money and wider culture to look at how we integrate trending conversations in to our brand world, tastefully and with meaningful value for our audience.

💰 £68,000 - £85,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. 

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. 

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps
• Intro call with the recruiter
• Video call with Hiring Manager
• Take home Task
• Full loop Behavioural and Role Specific interviews

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

jobs.description:
About PayPay

PayPay is a FinTech company that has grown to over 76M (as of November 2026) users since its launch in
2018. Our team is hugely diverse with members from over 50 different countries.

OUR VISION IS UNLIMITED_ 

We dare to believe that we do not need a clear vision to create a future beyond our imagination. PayPay will always stay true to our roots and realize a vision (future) that no one else can imagine by constantly taking risks and challenging ourselves. With this mindset, you will be presented with new and exciting opportunities on a daily basis and have the opportunity to grow and reach new dimensions that you could never have imagined. We are looking for people who can embrace this challenge, refresh the product at breakneck speed and promote PayPay with professionalism and passion.

※ Please note that you cannot apply or be selected in parallel with PayPay Corporation, PayPay Card Corporation and PayPay Securities Corporation.

 

Job Description

PayPay is looking for an Android Engineer to work on our payment product to deliver the best payment experience for our Japanese customers.

Team Missions
• Grow finance mobile service as the user's first touch point of PayPay.
• Actively follow new technology and make our app more convenient using it.
• Build new features rapidly along with a variety of technical approaches, native OS / KMM / own SDK etc and deliver with high quality.

Main Responsibilities
• Work closely with our product team to customize the payment experience
• Prototype new and redesign features
• Focus on UI/UX design principles and product driven development
• Work with an elite and focused team of app developers

Tech Stack

| Kotlin
| Coroutines/Flow, Jetpack Compose, Koin, OkHttp, Moshi, RxJava, Simple Stack, Kotest/MockK
| Github, Android Studio
| Firebase, AppsFlyer
| Figma
| Slack, Zoom

Qualifications
• 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 3 years at a product-based company.
• Deep understanding of modern Android development and mobile architecture.
• Strong proficiency in Kotlin/Java and object-oriented design principles.
• Proven experience integrating RESTful APIs.
• Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools and automated deployment pipelines.
• Practical experience leveraging AI/LLM tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Gemini) in professional software development workflows.
• Basic understanding of iOS development tools and the ability to build or maintain iOS features with AI assistance (hands-on iOS development experience is a plus).
• Strong commitment to code quality, maintainability, and engineering best practices.
• Business-level proficiency in both English and Japanese (JLPT N2 level or equivalent)

Preferred Qualifications
• Ability to develop features while conducting unit tests
• Knowledge of performance optimization
• Familiarity with Agile development
• Experience integrating and development payment service

PayPay 5 senses
• Please refer PayPay 5 senses to learn what we value at work.

Working Conditions 

Employment Status
• Full Time

Office Location
• Hybrid Workstyle
※ You will be expected to work in the office, in alignment with organizational guidelines and team objectives.
• LIFE in JAPAN FACTBOOK

Work Hours
• Super Flex Time (No Core Time)
• In principle, 9:00am-5:45pm (actual working hours: 7h45m + 1h break)

Holidays
• Every Sat/Sun/National holidays (In Japan)/New Year's break/Company-designated Special days

Paid leave
• Annual leave (up to 14 days in the first year, granted proportionally according to the month of employment. Can be used from the date of hire)
• Personal leave (5 days each year, granted proportionally according to the month of employment)
＊PayPay's own special paid leave system, which can be used to attend to illnesses, injuries, hospital visits, etc., of the employee, family members, pets, etc.

Salary
• Annual salary paid in 12 installments (monthly)
• Based on skills, experience, and abilities
• Reviewed once a year
• Late overtime allowance 
※Payroll payment can be changed to digital salary payment “PayPay Paycheck” for an amount set by you

Benefits
• Social Insurance (health insurance, employee pension, employment insurance and compensation insurance)
• 401K
• Translation/Interpretation support
• VISA sponsor + Relocation support

Tide is rapidly growing, expanding into new markets and always looking for passionate and driven people. Join us in our mission to empower small businesses and help them save time and money. 

About the role

The Tide Security Engineering team is made up of three core areas: Product Security, Threat Detection Response, and Identity.

Product Security (this role!) consists of application and cloud security experts. Their mission is to protect the products we build, covering everything from secure design reviews, secure code reviews to threat modelling and AI secure design review, ensuring security is embedded from the ground up.

Threat Detection Response focuses on protecting the company by building a robust detection and automation platform. We’re proactive in our defence, constantly hacking ourselves to improve our security posture and staying ahead of emerging threats. Our goal is to make Tide resilient against the ever-evolving threat landscape.

Identity is responsible for managing Tide's staff identity platform, ensuring that access to systems and infrastructure is secure, seamless, and aligned with modern security practices. The team uses strategies like zero trust, multi-factor authentication, and granular role-based access controls to safeguard our internal operations.

While each area has its own focus, collaboration is key - it's why we share the same Slack channel and hold our standups together as one cohesive team, ensuring alignment and seamless communication across all security functions.

 

What we’re looking for:

First and foremost you will be passionate about security and resilient software development processes. You will enjoy hunting for vulnerabilities in our web, mobile applications and AI agents, working with our engineering teams to remediate them strategically. You will be comfortable explaining security issues and concerns to product owners, engineers, VPs and executives and love the feeling you get when this results in them releasing a more resilient product. You will be a keen follower of all things Infosec and constantly be on the lookout for ways to apply new industry trends, tools and automations to your day-to-day role.

As a Senior Product Security Engineer you’ll:
• Regularly dive deep into mobile, web app technologies in order to understand feature development and proactively hunt for vulnerabilities
• Be proficient in securing cloud-native applications, ensuring that security best practices are applied consistently across our cloud environment
• Be proficient in threat modelling and guide developers in secure design principles to prevent vulnerabilities from being introduced in the first place
• Help remediate vulnerabilities through strategic initiatives, writing patches, or creating understandable and actionable vulnerability tickets.
• Be the subject matter expert across a wide range of security areas, particularly in Application Security.
• Make security invisible when possible, believing that gatekeeping and blocking product teams should be avoided in favour of enabling secure development.
• Mentor and coach junior engineers, sharing your knowledge to help raise the security bar across the organisation
• Leverage automation and security tools to seamlessly integrate security into our CI/CD pipelines, ensuring vulnerabilities are caught early without disrupting development.

What makes you a great fit:
• You have a breadth and depth of knowledge across AppSec/ProdSec and how AI agents are used.
• You know Burp Suite (or your favourite attack proxy) inside and out; bonus points if you’ve written or contributed to an extension that enhances its functionality.
• You have excellent spoken and written communication skills to articulate vulnerabilities clearly and persuasively, advocating for their remediation even when faced with competing production pressures.
• As a passionate senior security engineer, you have a blog, public speaking engagements, bug bounty profile, or a Git repository showcasing your work.
• You’re comfortable writing proof-of-concept (POC) scripts to demonstrate your findings and their potential impact, as needed.
• You have hands-on experience with securing cloud-native applications, ensuring that best practices are consistently applied

What you’ll get in return:
• Competitive salary

• Vitality Health Insurance, with a proactive focus on mental and physical wellbeing
• 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme
• 25 days holiday with the ability to buy extra days

• Spacious brand-new office in Liverpool street with an all-day snacks bar
• Enhanced family-friendly leave
• 3 days for L D or volunteering time off per year
• Flexible working options
• Sabbatical leave
• Share options

Tidean Ways of Working 

At Tide, we’re Member First and Data Driven, but above all, we’re One Team. Our Working Out of Office (WOO) policy allows you to work from anywhere in the world for up to 90 days a year. We are remote first, but when you do want to meet new people, collaborate with your team or simply hang out with your colleagues, our offices are always available and equipped to the highest standard. We offer flexible working hours and trust our employees to do their work well, at times that suit them and their team.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

• Establish the medium and long term organizational design of the Area Controlling function, building an operating model that scales with the business.
• Establish clear KPIs, performance benchmarks, and succession plans for the Group Control team.
• Own the teams budget and allocate resources effectively across product lines and core finance to support business growth, new product launches, and peak close periods.
2. End-to-End Product Process & Control Governance
• Own and document the end-to-end financial control framework for all product lines and core finance areas, from trade/transaction capture and valuation through to general ledger posting and external reporting.
• Oversee periodic P&L attribution, balance sheet substantiation, and adjustments to ensure financial results accurately reflect economic reality.
• Partner with Product, Operations, Treasury, IT, and Risk teams to review and approve New Product Launches, ensuring operational readiness and accounting compliance prior to launch.
• Identify control gaps across upstream and downstream systems, implementing remediation plans and maintaining compliance with SOX standards.
3. Month-End Close & Financial Reporting
• Direct and review the consolidated product month-end close process, ensuring strict adherence to group reporting timetables and IFRS / US GAAP accounting standards.
• Design, build, and maintain product-level P&Ls and automated KPI dashboards to strengthen financial controlling and surface actionable business insights.
• Perform senior-level review and sign-off on complex accounting judgments (working with Technical Accounting).
• Deliver insightful commentary and variance analysis on product performance, margin drivers, and balance sheet movements to the CFO, Wise Leadership Team, and Group Audit Committee. Partnering with FP&A.
• Act as a key point of contact for external and internal auditors.
4. Process Transformation & Systems Optimization
• Design, implement, and maintain robust SOX internal controls across end-to-end product processes
• Own and sign off the quarterly SOX sub-certification and attestation process for the Group Control function, ensuring all control owners validate operating effectiveness and maintain audit-ready documentation.
• Spearhead automation and standardisation initiatives to reduce manual touchpoints, accelerate close timelines, and enhance data granularity.
• Collaborate with Finance Change and Technology teams on ERP, sub-ledger, and reporting tool upgrades.

Qualifications & Experience
• Education & Certifications: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline. Professional accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA, or equivalent) is essential.
• Experience:

15+ years of progressive experience in Product Control, Financial Control, or Audit, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership capacity managing teams.
• Technical Expertise: Proven track record managing SOX-compliant control environments, owning key financial controls, and leading/overssing external audit walkthroughs. P&L attribution, and balance sheet control frameworks. US GAAP (preferred) and IFRS accounting methodologies.
• Leadership & Communication: Proven track record of influencing senior stakeholders, managing cross-functional relationships, and distilling complex financial data into clear narratives.
• Large-Scale Transformation Delivery: Proven track record playing a key role in major finance change programs—such as global ERP implementations, sub-ledger migrations, or greenfield SOX control rollouts—ensuring control integrity from design through go-live.
• Prioritization & Deadline Management: Exceptional ability to triage competing priorities across daily controls, month-end close, and strategic projects, keeping the team focused on high-risk areas under tight reporting deadlines.
• Decision Making: Not afraid of challenges and making decisions, can work autonomously and take initiative.

jobs.title: Director of Risk Analytics
jobs.description:
Role Overview:

Enterprise Risk Analytics at Wise is a critical capability. As we scale, the requirements for data-driven risk management are evolving. We need a talented Analytics Director to build and own our measurement frameworks, infrastructure, and reporting, ensuring audit-ready reporting and shared 1st/2nd line data governance. This role is highly strategic, focused on enabling the business to measure and manage risk across the full spectrum of major fintech risk domains.

What you’ll be doing:
• Lead the strategy and execution of the Enterprise Risk Analytics roadmap while coaching a high-performing team.
• Standardise risk metric calculation logic, KRIs/KPIs, and attribution logic while implementing sign-off processes to ensure data integrity.
• Partner with Data/Engineering to align instrumentation and data models with risk monitoring needs, ensuring reliable pipelines with clear data lineage.
• Drive insight-to-action loops, quantifying trade-offs between risk reduction, customer impact, and cost.
• Establish shared governance cadences (metric councils, steering groups) and foster 1st/2nd line collaboration to prevent drift across lines of defence.
• Provide analytics leadership for Financial, Fincrime, Ops, Resilience, and Reg stakeholders.

Who you are:
• Proven analytics leadership in a scaled fintech, financial services, or regulated technology environment (3-7 years management experience).
• Familiarity with control frameworks and LoD models, and how analytics supports assurance and oversight.
• Demonstrated ability to build cross-domain measurement and reporting, including governance and audit/evidence expectations.
• Strong stakeholder leadership: able to align and deliver through complex, matrixed organisations—especially across 1st and 2nd line.
• Experience with risk quantification approaches (scenario drivers, stress-style thinking, trade-off modelling).
• Track record building durable analytics foundations (pipelines, metric layers, monitoring/quality controls, operating rhythms).
• High bar for metric integrity, clarity of narrative, and decision-making discipline.

Desirable:
• Experience with operational resilience and/or technology reliability analytics (incidents, availability, recovery metrics).

Some important stuff we would like you to know:

To meet our regulatory obligations as a licensed financial services company, Wise needs to conduct background checks on all new hires, which in the Finance team includes Criminal and Credit checks. Please discuss with the Recruiter if you have any concerns regarding this process.

What do we offer:
• Salary: £135K - £190K.
• Company Restricted Stock Units.
• Numerous great benefits in our London office.

Key

benefits:
• Hybrid working.
• Paid annual holiday, sick days, parental leave and other leave opportunities.
• 6 weeks of paid sabbatical after 4 years at Wise on top of annual leave.

jobs.title: Regional Risk Lead - EMEA - 12 months Maternity Cover
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Senior Network Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Wise is one the fastest growing companies in Europe and we’re on a mission: to make money without borders the new normal. We’ve got 10 million customers across the globe and we’re growing. Fast.

Current banking systems don’t let us send, spend or receive money across borders easily. Or quickly. Or cheaply.

So, we’re building a new one.
