We’re looking for an exceptional Network Engineer for our Network Engineering team to deliver scalable, stable, and well documented solutions as part of the UT team and in collaboration with other Platform Engineering teams.

jobs.title: Senior Product Compliance Manager - India
jobs.description:
The Product Compliance & Risk (PC&R) team sits at the centre of Wise’s product development function, supporting our cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional compliant-by-design products for our customers.

We’re seeking a highly motivated, customer-centric individual to join our team to leverage their deep understanding of India regulatory requirements and expectations to launch new products, grow our presence and manage compliance risks in India.

This hands-on first line of defence (1LOD) role will involve working closely with product teams in APAC and globally to ensure our controls strike the right balance between meeting compliance requirements whilst maximising customer experience.

This is a hands-on role, with high levels of ownership over:
• Designing and continuously improving our products and controls: Leverage your deep understanding of the Wise product and regulatory requirements and risks to support new product launches. This includes communicating requirements in clear, practical terms, and taking a risk-based, scalable approach with the customer experience front-of-mind when designing, uplifting and implementing controls.
• Regulatory and financial crime risk management: Stay ahead of trends and the regulatory agenda in India, identify, assess and present risks quantitatively and qualitatively in clear and understandable terms, and work collaboratively to define and execute on risk mitigation plans.
• Regulatory change and remediation: Conduct regulatory gap analyses, define and scope actions to remediate gaps, and ensure implementation plans are executed in a timely manner. Collaborate with global teams to identify synergies with programs of work already completed or underway across the Wise Group, and ensure Wise Product teams are aware of the most recent regulations and guidance.
• External engagements: Represent Wise through external engagements such as audits and regulatory inspections, including explaining and defending our controls, and developing and executing remediation plans.

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Grow your hands-on Fintech knowledge at full speed, with high levels of ownership and autonomy.
• Collaborate with our amazing teams both locally and globally to build state-of-the-art products for our customers that are compliant-by-design.
• Be empowered to identify problems and opportunities, and take a lead in the solution design and implementation.

About you:
• High levels of ownership and autonomy, with the ability to proactively identify improvement opportunities or areas of elevated risk, prioritise, and drive work from inception to completion at pace with limited oversight. This includes anticipating risks and roadblocks, and demonstrating resilience to work through them.
• Problem solving attitude, with the ability to not only analyse and interpret complex regulatory and risk management frameworks, but to exercise sound judgement in proposing and implementing customer-centric and scalable solutions, using data to drive decision-making and quantify risks.
• Strong collaboration skills, to work effectively with different stakeholders globally (such as Product, Risk and Compliance), and to influence without authority.
• Challenge the status quo, thinking outside-the-box and questioning how we can achieve an optimal balance of achieving compliance whilst delivering the best outcomes for our customers.
• Previous experience working directly with product and engineering teams, including effectively translating regulations into actionable business requirements.
• Willingness to travel, as Wise offices are located across different countries.
• Legally authorised to work in Singapore.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - APAC Expansion

jobs.title: ERP Engineer - MC Business central
jobs.description:
Introduction

We're looking for a talented Software Engineer to join our team and take on a critical role in optimizing and extending our Microsoft Business Central (BC) environment. In this high-impact position, you will contribute to the configuration, customization, and integration of BC to support seamless business operations. You'll play a key role in building robust integrations with third-party applications, managing the underlying infrastructure, and leading our migration to the cloud-based version of BC. If you have hands-on experience with BC development, enjoy solving complex integration challenges, and are passionate about delivering scalable enterprise solutions, we want to hear from you.

This role is ideal for a strong full-stack engineer with expertise in ERP systems, particularly Microsoft Business Central, who thrives on tweaking configurations, deploying updates, and ensuring reliable data flows across our ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

What You'll Do
• Configure, customize, and extend Microsoft Business Central using AL (Application Language) or C/AL, including building and maintaining custom pages, reports, and extensions to meet business needs.
• Design, develop, and deploy integrations between Business Central and third-party applications via APIs (e.g., OData web services, REST APIs), enabling data synchronization for workflows like inventory, finance, and CRM.
• Manage and optimize the Microsoft SQL Server database that powers Business Central, ensuring data integrity, performance tuning, high availability, and compliance with best practices.
• Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools like Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions for efficient deployment, testing, and versioning of BC customizations and extensions.

• Uphold security, reliability, and monitoring standards for BC environments, including role-based access, audit trails, and proactive issue resolution.
• Participate in on-call rotations as needed to support production systems and contribute to process improvements for faster incident response.

jobs.title: FinCrime Operations Senior Lead - AML Investigations
jobs.description:
As a Financial Crime Operations Senior Lead, you will be responsible for developing and managing a team of Financial Crime Operations Team Leads and Specialists for specific SME areas. Your key objective is to ensure the effective assessment and mitigation of risks related to high-risk customers, while strictly adhering to AML/CFT regulations and aligning with Wise’s risk appetite and internal policies. The specialists on your team will possess an in-depth understanding of the unique risks associated with complex business structures, varied customer types and activities, and country-specific challenges, as well as the strategies required to mitigate these risks effectively.

In this leadership role, you will act as a vital connector between your operational team, which includes team leads and specialists, and Wise's senior leadership. This involves clearly communicating the overarching strategic objectives to your team and transforming these goals into actionable and pertinent directives that drive process optimization and performance improvement.

You'll be instrumental in aligning Wise’s overall mission and strategy with performance expectations, ensuring that your team’s efforts are efficiently strategized and executed for optimal success. This includes developing and owning a strategic roadmap spanning several quarters your team, enhancing processes, and cultivating a positive and empowering work environment. You will support your team’s growth and independence through comprehensive training, mentoring, coaching, delegation, and recognition.

As an experienced operations manager, you will design and implement customer-focused processes while maintaining a vigilant awareness of the risks inherent in the financial industry, specific product offerings, and regulatory requirements. Your approach will ensure that Wise's operations continually meet the expectations of our partners and regulatory bodies.

Your mission:
• Leadership and people development: Drive team performance and cultural excellence to support sustainable business growth. Lead by example, demonstrating values and work ethic that inspire accountability, proactive problem-solving, and a growth mindset. Manage and develop a high-performing team by role modeling success behaviors. Focus on cultivating a high-performance culture through talent development, career check-ins, and recommendations for growth. Build strong teams by hiring, coaching, and fostering skills and competencies. Promote continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and inclusion to empower your team to innovate and excel.
• Performance management: Foster a culture of excellence in your team by consistently meeting KPIs and SLAs in our metrics-driven environment. Refresh performance expectations to match business needs and address underperformance with clear action plans. Implement strong performance frameworks, provide actionable feedback, and ensure every team member operates efficiently.
• Operational management: In this role, you'll turn high-level plans into actionable changes and lead your team to success. You'll create phased implementation plans to minimize disruption and set clear metrics to track progress. Focus on optimizing team structure by managing recruitment and strategically placing staff. Continuously identify and address redundancies and inefficiencies. You'll develop scalable, compliant processes and collaborate with product and operational teams to enhance customer experience, boost automation, and meet financial and service goals. Strong data literacy is essential for analyzing complex data and making informed decisions. Governance is crucial; you'll escalate issues promptly, provide clear updates to senior leadership, and contribute to a customer-focused culture that balances regulatory objectives with excellent customer service.
• Quality assurance: Ensure the highest quality standards for your group's tasks by making decisions within established frameworks. Lead root cause analysis, turn insights into improvements, and mitigate risks. Ensure quality standards are integrated into processes, tools, and initiatives. Understand impacts, focus on findings, and propose actions for better outcomes. Collaborate with other functions, offering expertise to enhance processes and elevate quality across the team and organization
• Domain knowledge and expertise: Be a subject matter expert in Financial Crime areas with the ability to train and coach your team. Maintain a comprehensive understanding of our regulatory obligations and internal policies. Apply a risk-based approach to deterring and preventing money laundering and financial crime. Be able to represent the operational team processes and policies when working with internal auditing and testing parties. Retain an understanding of the wider Financial Crime and regulatory landscape and take on best practices to your team. Own operational incident management: from initial detection to response and remediation. Liaise effectively with functions and stakeholders, ensuring clear and timely communication throughout. Be responsible for developing action plans, driving remediation efforts, and providing context and subject matter expertise during and after incidents. The Senior Lead supports product-related incident management, ensuring a response to all critical events.
• Project management: Effectively Lead projects from start to finish, prioritizing tasks and maintaining documentation. Communicate milestones, address blockers, and delegate tasks while monitoring progress. Articulate project impact and value, and engage with stakeholders from technical teams to senior management. Negotiate and influence cross-functional teams to drive momentum and align with strategic goals.
• Planning and execution: Ensure operational area plans are set in place and provide insights to other stakeholders. Take full accountability in delivering, updating and making sure your area is making progress on their goals by measuring the effectiveness of the output of the team. There is a clear strategy within your domain that is connected with the wider organisational key objectives, including impactful OKRs and goals based on these plans, and being able to confidently present plans to varied audiences.
• Stakeholder management and communication: Lead complex projects with multiple stakeholders, setting priorities and ensuring timely delivery. Partner with Product to support group objectives and advocate for customer success. Manage diverse relationships, anticipate issues, and share key insights. Engage stakeholders promptly and lead discussions effectively. Communicate clearly and tailor messages to the audience, using data to deliver impactful and concise messages. Adapt to diverse stakeholders with confidence, ensuring professional and effective interactions.

jobs.title: COMMERCIAL ANALYST III | WHOLESALE COMMERCIAL OPERATIONS SP
jobs.description:

Pioneiros, mudamos o mercado ao lançar o primeiro banco digital do Brasil e seguimos criando tendências com tecnologia de ponta. Evoluímos para um Super App Financeiro Global, com soluções completas e inovação de primeira. As pioneers, we transformed the market by launching Brazil’s first digital bank and continue to shape the future with cutting-edge technology.
We have evolved into a Global Financial Super App, delivering complete solutions and leading innovation. Here, work has purpose: creating real opportunities, transforming people’s lives, and reshaping the financial market.
This is the Inter way of making things happen. If you want to be part of this transformation and leave your mark, your place is here.

Become Sangue Laranja.

Sobre a vaga e missão do cargo

 

Você fará parte da estrutura de PJ Atacado, atuando como facilitador(a) das operações comerciais e de crédito para os segmentos Large Corporate, Corporate e Middle Market.

 

 

Sua missão será apoiar diretamente os Gerentes Comerciais no acompanhamento, formalização e pós-venda das operações, garantindo organização documental, qualidade operacional, visibilidade sobre o status das demandas e acompanhamento da carteira, riscos e garantias. Você trabalhará em interface constante com áreas como Comercial, Crédito, Jurídico e Back-office, contribuindo para uma jornada mais fluida para clientes e áreas internas.

 

 

No seu dia a dia, você vai:
• Apoiar os Gerentes Comerciais nas demandas operacionais, no acompanhamento de propostas e no pós-venda de operações.
• Atuar como interface entre as equipes Comercial, Crédito, Jurídico, Back-office e demais áreas parceiras do Banco.
• Conferir documentos necessários para a formalização de operações de crédito, assegurando qualidade e completude das informações.
• Facilitar a gestão documental end to end, acompanhando pendências, etapas e retornos necessários para conclusão das operações.

• Elaborar relatórios e reports de produção para acompanhamento dos resultados e da qualidade operacional do time.
• Utilizar ferramentas de gestão, relacionamento e análise para organizar demandas, acompanhar indicadores e dar visibilidade às entregas.

 

 

O que buscamos

 

Obrigatórios:
• Perfil organizado, comprometido e resiliente para lidar com múltiplas demandas e prazos.
• Capacidade de atuar de forma proativa no acompanhamento de processos operacionais e comerciais.
• Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal para interação com diferentes áreas e suporte aos Gerentes Comerciais.
• Interesse ou vivência com rotinas de operações comerciais, crédito, formalização e/ou atendimento a clientes PJ.
• Conhecimento em Excel para controles, análises e elaboração de relatórios. 

 

 

Desejáveis:
• Vivência em instituições financeiras, especialmente em rotinas de PJ, atacado, crédito ou operações comerciais.
• Conhecimento em processos de formalização de operações de crédito e gestão documental.
• Familiaridade com ferramentas como Salesforce, Slack, Tableau, Jira, Sydle, Função e SCCI.
• Experiência com acompanhamento de carteira, vencimentos, garantias e suporte pós-venda.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

 

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

 

Your mission

As a Senior Product Manager at Bitpanda, you will take end-to-end ownership of key product areas and strategic pillars, scaling our offerings for financial institutions, banks, and strategic partners. Operating in a high-impact, complex, and regulated environment, you will define product strategy, shape the roadmap, and act as a key sparring partner to Product Leadership.

You will work closely within a collaborative structure, allowing you to focus deeply on product architecture, scalability, and technical execution while leveraging client-facing insights to inform your roadmap. This is a global, fast-paced role requiring seamless context-switching across markets, products, and evolving regulatory frameworks.

What you'll do
• Take end-to-end ownership of core product pillars, defining the long-term vision, strategy, and execution roadmap in close alignment with Product Leadership.
• Partner with Engineering to translate complex market and partner needs into clear, actionable, and scalable technical capabilities.
• Work closely with Client Solution Leads—and engage directly with external partners when needed—to weigh client-specific requests against long-term platform scalability and strategic priorities.
• Proactively integrate fintech and financial services regulatory requirements into the product lifecycle, collaborating closely with Compliance and Legal to ensure every launch meets global standards.
• Act as a central connector across Engineering, Sales, Client Solutions, Legal, and Compliance, managing senior stakeholders and driving clarity amid ambiguity and shifting priorities.

Who you are
• Proven track record managing B2B and/or B2B2C products within finance, banking, fintech, or crypto.
• Demonstrated experience operating as a Senior Product Manager or Lead Product Manager, with end-to-end ownership of complex products.
• Solid understanding of regulatory requirements in fintech or financial services, with hands-on experience shipping compliant products in highly regulated environments.
• Ability to partner effectively with engineering teams, break down technical trade-offs, and build scalable, platform-level solutions rather than one-off customisations.
• Comfortable thinking globally, switching contexts rapidly across multiple product pillars, and navigating evolving priorities in a dynamic environment.
• Strong communication skills with the ability to align senior internal stakeholders and engage credibly with institutional partners when required.

What’s in it for you
• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
• Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
• Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
• Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
• Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
• Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
• Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
• Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
• Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
• Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
• Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

 .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

 

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

jobs.title: Embedded Implementation Consultant
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Implementation at Brex

Implementation transforms new customers into power users. We lead the onboarding experience for companies adopting Brex Empower, helping them shift from outdated processes to a modern, employee-first approach. It’s a role that blends customer empathy, project management, technical expertise, process design, and change management. We take personal ownership of our customers' long-term success, and we set customers up thoroughly so they can be with ‘Brex for life’. As strategic advisors, we build trust, drive solutions with tenacity, deliver results fast, and work cross-functionally to make adoption seamless for customers.

What you’ll do

Embedded is Brex's most strategically important growth frontier and this role sits at the epicenter. You'll sit on the Implementation Team and will wire together partner ecosystems across Business Development and Product, configure complex integrations, and deliver customer experiences that genuinely delight. You won't be following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. This role focuses on ensuring successful onboarding and configuration of embedded services such as Navan, Zip, Coupa Cards, and ICCP partnerships

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our New York office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Lead implementation workstreams for embedded services across all customer segments
• Own end-to-end implementation for embedded-only customer projects. Partner with the BD team on net-new embedded partnership launches helping define how Brex integrates with the next generation of platforms.
• Configure embedded services in coordination with partner tech specs and Brex.
• Provide consultative guidance to customers to ensure embedded tools are correctly deployed.
• Maintain deep knowledge of embedded product evolution and serve as the internal authority, educating CSMs, VIP Support, and cross-functional teams.

Requirements
• Experience:

2-4+ years in a SaaS customer facing role
• Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with embedded finance or third-party SaaS integrations you understand how these ecosystems fit together and where friction hides.
• Communication: A natural communicator who can translate technical complexity into clear, confident guidance for Brex customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.
• Execution: Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple concurrent projects in a fast-moving environment where no two implementations look the same.
• Mindset: Energized by ambiguity. You thrive when the product is evolving and the partnership landscape is expanding.

Bonus points
• Experience in Financial, Expense Management, or ERP software.
• Familiarity with any of the following domains: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Billing, Expense Management, Travel, Procurement, or Corporate Card programs.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $119,328 - $181,930 USD. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

Sales at Brex

The Sales team is the driving factor behind revenue for Brex and every member of our team directly affects our bottom line. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring new customers, and building even stronger relationships with our current customers. Our winning culture recognizes big team wins and celebrates individual accomplishments. We ensure that top performers are recognized and have built a competitive environment to motivate and unify the team.

What you’ll do

Brex is looking for an individual to join the Revenue Operations Team, which is responsible for driving revenue growth in close partnership with post-sales revenue leaders. We help revenue teams drive consistent growth through regular reporting, analytical insights, process improvements, systems updates, strategic initiatives, cross-functional alignment, incentive design, and coverage model design. You should have an analytical mindset with a curiosity to get to the right solution to every problem. The ability to translate data into insights is critical as you will work closely with the Revenue Operations business partners, enablement, finance, systems, data, and revenue teams.

Responsibilities
• Create and update dashboards to give revenue leaders and operations partners the data they need to run their businesses
• Proactively identify opportunities to provide additional reporting or analytical clarity to better understand business performance
• Run deep dive analyses to identify challenges and opportunities within the business
• Partner with Revenue Operations business partners and revenue leaders to design operational solutions, implement them, and track success
• Evaluate various tool usage and effectiveness to ensure we are getting the most out of our revenue tech stack
• Build complex capacity and funnel models for annual planning and scenario evaluation
• Support data requests for deal deep dives or compensation tracking
• Own Revenue Operations processes for Post Sales, including intake, forecasting maintenance, onboarding, routing, and coverage models, to keep the team scalable and consistent.

Requirements
• 2+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, business operations, sales finance, or similar; preferably at a Fintech or SaaS company
• Strong problem solving skills and collaborative approach to solutioning
• Excellent written and verbal communication, especially with complex concepts
• Analytical mindset and desire for high data precision and accuracy
• Self-motivated and able to run with projects autonomously with minimal oversight
• Advanced spreadsheet and modeling skills - Google Sheets or Excel
• High familiarity with CRM data models (Salesforce preferred)
• Strong attention to detail including in documentation
• Strong sense of ownership, taking responsibility for results and driving issues to resolution

Bonus Points
• Experience with sales compensation design and tracking
• Knowledge of revenue recognition principles and finance systems
• Moderate SQL skills with experience in data visualization tools (Looker or Hex experience a plus)

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $114,808 - $143,510. jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Sales at Brex

The Sales team is the driving factor behind revenue for Brex and every member of our team directly affects our bottom line. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring new customers, and building even stronger relationships with our current customers. Our winning culture recognizes big team wins and celebrates individual accomplishments. We ensure that top performers are recognized and have built a competitive environment to motivate and unify the team.

What you’ll do

Brex is looking for an individual to join the Revenue Operations Team, which is responsible for driving revenue growth in close partnership with post-sales revenue leaders. We help revenue teams drive consistent growth through regular reporting, analytical insights, process improvements, systems updates, strategic initiatives, cross-functional alignment, incentive design, and coverage model design. You should have an analytical mindset with a curiosity to get to the right solution to every problem. The ability to translate data into insights is critical as you will work closely with the Revenue Operations business partners, enablement, finance, systems, data, and revenue teams.

Responsibilities
• Create and update dashboards to give revenue leaders and operations partners the data they need to run their businesses
• Proactively identify opportunities to provide additional reporting or analytical clarity to better understand business performance
• Run deep dive analyses to identify challenges and opportunities within the business
• Partner with Revenue Operations business partners and revenue leaders to design operational solutions, implement them, and track success
• Evaluate various tool usage and effectiveness to ensure we are getting the most out of our revenue tech stack
• Build complex capacity and funnel models for annual planning and scenario evaluation
• Support data requests for deal deep dives or compensation tracking
• Own Revenue Operations processes for Post Sales, including intake, forecasting maintenance, onboarding, routing, and coverage models, to keep the team scalable and consistent.

Requirements
• 2+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, business operations, sales finance, or similar; preferably at a Fintech or SaaS company
• Strong problem solving skills and collaborative approach to solutioning
• Excellent written and verbal communication, especially with complex concepts
• Analytical mindset and desire for high data precision and accuracy
• Self-motivated and able to run with projects autonomously with minimal oversight
• Advanced spreadsheet and modeling skills - Google Sheets or Excel
• High familiarity with CRM data models (Salesforce preferred)
• Strong attention to detail including in documentation
• Strong sense of ownership, taking responsibility for results and driving issues to resolution

Bonus Points
• Experience with sales compensation design and tracking
• Knowledge of revenue recognition principles and finance systems
• Moderate SQL skills with experience in data visualization tools (Looker or Hex experience a plus)

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $101,600 - $127,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

What you’ll do

As a Sales Manager at Brex, you will lead a high-performing team of sales professionals, guiding them to achieve and exceed ambitious targets. You’ll be instrumental in driving strategy, mentoring team members, and ensuring operational excellence. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced, high-impact environments, is passionate about leadership, and has a proven track record of success in sales. At Brex, we don’t just aim to hit quotas—we’re building a world-class team driven by innovation, resilience, and a relentless pursuit of excellence. Join us to shape the future of financial services for our customers while advancing your career in a company that recognizes and rewards your contributions.

In this role, you will lead a team of at least 8 high-performing Account Executives (AEs) dedicated to driving revenue growth and acquiring new customers within Brex's Small Business and Early Stage segment. In this pivotal role, you’ll empower your team to exceed ambitious targets, delivering impactful results that directly contribute to Brex’s success.

The ideal candidate has a proven track record of leading and scaling successful B2B SaaS and/or Payments sales teams, ideally within fintech, travel, spend management, banking, or financial services industries. You thrive in dynamic environments, combining strategic thinking with hands-on coaching to unlock your team’s full potential.

You will collaborate closely with the Senior Sales Director to design and implement sales strategies that align with Brex's broader goals and vision. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of sales at Brex, drive meaningful impact, and accelerate your career at the intersection of financial services and technology.

Where you'll work

This role will be based in our New York office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Lead a High-Performing Team: Guide, coach, and support a team of Account Executives (AEs) to consistently meet and exceed quotas, fostering a culture of excellence and accountability.
• Scale the Team: Recruit, hire, onboard, and train new AEs to support growth while improving internal enablement programs to ensure long-term success.
• Sales Strategy and Planning: Own weekly forecasting and ensure team members maintain an updated and accurate pipeline.
• Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams: Partner with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to develop and execute sales strategies that align with Brex’s overall goals and objectives.
• Win Deals: Build and maintain relationships with key decision-makers at mid-market companies to drive revenue growth and customer acquisition. Support your team in closing critical opportunities while teaching them to prioritize strategically for consistent success.
• Leverage Data: Continuously monitor and analyze sales performance metrics to identify trends, address challenges, and uncover opportunities for improvement.

Requirements
• 5+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, ideally within fintech, travel, or spend management industries
• 2+ years of experience managing a high-performing sales team with a consistent record of achieving or exceeding quotas
• Demonstrated success in driving revenue growth and acquiring new customers
• Consistent track record of achieving quota
• Strong leadership, coaching, and team-building capabilities
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to inspire teams and build relationships with stakeholders
• Excellent prospecting skills and the ability to train others to generate pipeline
• Superb organizational skills and the ability to help others become organized

Bonus points
• Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field
• Familiarity with financial products, credit cards, and business finance
• Familiarity with credit card management, encompassing a deep understanding of limits, rewards, and underwriting
• Keen awareness of the competitive landscape, industry trends, and market dynamics
• Familiarity with sales tools such as Gong, Salesforce, Outreach, etc. 

Compensation

The expected OTE range for this role is $207,920 - $259,900. The starting wage will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. The OTE figure listed here includes base salary and commissions, which may or may not be earned depending on performance. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

jobs.title: AI Agent Architect
jobs.location: Hong Kong SAR; Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
jobs.description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 90 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

 

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

 

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Key Responsibilities
• Agent SDK and Runtime — Design and implement the orchestration engine, runtime, and core primitives. Ensure that agentic loops remain steerable and verifiable while preserving conversational and adaptive capabilities.
• MCP Ecosystem Expansion — Expose internal systems as MCP servers, sub-agents, and agent skills. Establish unified mechanisms for tool discovery, dynamic registration, RBAC, rate limiting, and version management.
• Agent Development Lifecycle (ADLC) — Build an end-to-end toolchain that accommodates the non-deterministic nature of Agent behavior, covering Spec → Eval → Build → Test → A/B Testing → Canary Release → Monitoring → Continuous Iteration.
• End-to-End Ownership of Quality and Cost — Take ownership of accuracy, resolution rate, cost, and latency. Establish data-driven feedback loops for continuous Agent personalization and optimization.

Qualifications

Mandatory Requirements
• Education and Experience
• Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
• P7: 6+ years of experience, including at least 3 years in AI or Agent development. P7+: 8+ years of experience with proven zero-to-one Agent platform development experience.
• Engineering Fundamentals
• Proficiency in Go or Python, with strong production-grade system design capabilities and the ability to produce high-quality Technical Requirements Documents (TRDs).
• LLM Application Engineering
• Strong expertise in LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and the ReAct pattern.
• Experience in context window management, including token budgeting, conversation history compression, and sub-agent context compression.
• Production-Grade Agent Experience
• Proven experience taking an Agent system from zero to production and establishing a continuous improvement lifecycle.
• Experience must go beyond demos or proofs of concept, with actual production traffic and measurable effectiveness metrics.
• Hands-on Agent Engineering
• Familiarity with at least one Agent orchestration framework, such as LangGraph, Dify, Eino, Embabel, or OpenAI Agents SDK.
• Practical experience with multi-agent collaboration, including Agent Teams, parallel execution, DAG-based orchestration, or handoffs.
• Complementary Agent Capabilities — Deep Expertise in at Least One Area
• RAG engineering: vector retrieval, hybrid search, and reranking.
• Evaluation frameworks: LLM-as-a-Judge, Golden Sets, regression testing, and A/B testing.
• Engineering Discipline
• Ability to quantify Agent effectiveness and cost, with a strong focus on token efficiency.
• Understanding of PII masking and prompt injection prevention.
• Ability to identify regulatory and compliance boundaries in financial applications.

Preferred Qualifications
• Zero-to-one experience building Agent simulation or benchmarking platforms comparable in scope to τ-Bench.
• Experience with self-hosted LLM deployment, including inference frameworks such as vLLM and Triton, and models such as DeepSeek, Qwen, and GLM.
• Domain-specific AI application

experience:

Crypto and financial AI (risk management, KYC, compliance), AIOps (alert RCA and build diagnostics), customer service AI, or AI-powered software engineering.
• Publicly demonstrated AI security research, including prompt injection prevention, jailbreak mitigation, or AI-powered smart contract security.
• Core contributions to open-source projects such as LangChain, LangGraph, Dify, MCP, Eino, or Vercel AI SDK.
• Demonstrated technical influence through blogs, conference talks, research papers, or open-source contributions.

Why Join Us

 

At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. Our benefits include:
• Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
• Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
• Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
• Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
• Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

jobs.description:

岗位概述

我们正处于 AI 重塑金融基础设施的历史节点。作为 AI Agent 架构师，你将成为 AI 智能体系的核心构建者——不只是编写代码，而是定义下一代金融级 Agent 如何感知市场信号、规划执行路径、记忆业务上下文与跨系统协作。你将主导打造可承载真实金融场景的 Agent 体系，覆盖交易辅助、风控研判、合规监察、用户智能服务等核心业务，让 AI 在加密金融的高速、高压、高合规环境中真正自主完成复杂任务。这里没有边界模糊的分工，有的是直接影响亿级用户体验的技术决策权，以及一支对 LLM 与 Agent 技术有极高密度认知的精英工程团队。

核心职责
• Agent 体系架构设计：主导设计 AI 智能体架构，定义 Agent 在 Openclaw 平台上的运行模型、生命周期管理与资源隔离策略；构建支撑交易辅助、风控研判、合规监察等金融核心场景的 Agent 能力基座，确保系统在高并发、低延迟、强合规约束下稳定运行。
• 金融场景 Agent 工程化落地：将交易信号分析、风险识别、监管合规、智能客服等业务需求转化为可执行的 Agent 工作流；设计任务规划链路（ReAct / Plan-and-Execute）、异常回退机制与结果验证体系，推动 Agent 从 PoC 快速进入生产环境。
• Openclaw 平台建设与演进：深度参与 Openclaw Agent Runtime 的架构演进与性能优化；设计插件体系、能力注册中心与多 Agent 编排机制，降低业务团队接入成本，持续提升平台的扩展性与复用率。
• 工具生态与内部系统集成：构建标准化工具调用框架，打通 Bybit 内部交易引擎、风控系统、数据平台与外部 API；设计工具权限管控、调用链追踪与错误恢复机制，集成 MCP 等标准协议，构建金融级异构工具生态。
• 生产质量与可观测性体系：主导 Agent 系统的可观测性建设，包括 Trace 追踪、Evaluation 评测、成本监控与延迟治理；建立金融场景下的 Agent 质量基线与回归测试体系，持续提升系统稳定性与可解释性。
• 技术前瞻与团队赋能：持续追踪 Agent 领域前沿进展，将研究成果转化为 AI 工程实践；制定团队 Agent 开发规范与最佳实践，通过 Code Review、技术分享与方向评审推动团队整体 AI-native 工程能力提升。

任职要求
• 扎实的 LLM/Agent 工程经验：具备 3年以上 AI 系统开发经验，其中 1年以上 大型语言模型（LLM）、RAG 或 Agent 系统的生产环境落地经验；具备 Openclaw 平台的开发与优化实战经验，熟悉其 Agent Runtime 架构、插件体系与多 Agent 编排机制，能基于 Openclaw 独立完成复杂 Agent 应用的工程化落地与性能调优。
• 系统架构能力：具备分布式系统设计能力，熟悉微服务架构、消息队列（Kafka / RabbitMQ）、异步任务调度等工程模式；能够独立完成从需求分析、架构设计到技术选型的完整决策链路。
• 编程能力：熟悉至少一门后端语言（Golang / Java / Node.js）；具备 REST API 设计与 Docker / Kubernetes 容器化部署能力。
• LLM 核心技术理解：深入理解 Transformer 架构、Attention 机制、Prompt Engineering（CoT、Few-shot、Structured Output）；熟悉主流模型 API（OpenAI、Anthropic Claude、Google Gemini）及本地部署方案（Ollama、vLLM）。
• 工程质量意识：具备良好的代码设计习惯（设计模式、单元测试、CI/CD）；有构建 LLM 评测（Evaluation）体系或 Agent Tracing（LangSmith / Phoenix / Langfuse）的实战经验。

加分项
• 有 MCTS、A\*、强化学习（RL） 与 LLM 结合的规划/推理研究或工程经验，熟悉 SFT / RLHF 训练流程。
• 在 金融、Web3、合规 或其他高复杂度垂直领域有 Agent 系统落地经验，理解领域知识对 Agent 设计的特殊约束。
• 有开源贡献或在 NeurIPS / ICML / ACL / ICLR 等顶会发表过 Agent / RAG / LLM 相关论文。
• 具备 多模态（Multimodal） Agent 开发经验，包括图文理解、文档解析（PDF / 财报 / 研报）等非结构化数据处理能力。
• 熟悉 MCP（Model Context Protocol） 或参与过 Agent 标准协议的设计与实现。

About the Role

We're at an inflection point where AI is fundamentally reshaping financial infrastructure. As an AI Agent Architect, you will be a core builder of AI's intelligent ecosystem — not just writing code, but defining how next-generation financial-grade Agents perceive market signals, plan execution paths, retain business context, and orchestrate across systems. You will lead the construction of Agent capabilities purpose-built for real financial scenarios: trading intelligence, risk assessment, compliance monitoring, and smart user services — engineered to operate autonomously in crypto finance's high-velocity, high-stakes, and high-compliance environment.This is a role with genuine technical ownership. You'll make architectural decisions that directly shape the experience of hundreds of millions of users, alongside an elite engineering team with exceptional depth in LLM and Agent technology.

Key Responsibilities
• Agent Architecture Design: Lead the architectural design of AI's intelligent Agent layer — defining agent execution models, lifecycle management, and resource isolation strategies on the Openclaw platform. Build the foundational Agent capabilities powering core financial scenarios including trading intelligence, risk assessment, and compliance monitoring, engineered for high-concurrency, low-latency, and regulatory-grade reliability.
• Financial Scenario Agent Engineering: Translate complex financial use cases — trading signal analysis, risk identification, regulatory compliance, and intelligent customer service — into production-ready Agent workflows. Design task planning chains (ReAct / Plan-and-Execute), fallback and error recovery mechanisms, and result validation frameworks that accelerate the path from PoC to production.
• Openclaw Platform Development Evolution: Contribute deeply to the architectural evolution and performance optimization of the Openclaw Agent Runtime. Design the plugin ecosystem, capability registry, and multi-agent orchestration mechanisms to reduce onboarding friction for product teams and improve platform extensibility and reusability.
• Tool Ecosystem Internal System Integration: Build a standardized tool-calling framework connecting Bybit's internal trading engine, risk systems, data platforms, and external APIs. Design tool permission controls, call-chain tracing, and error recovery; integrate standards such as MCP to unify a financial-grade heterogeneous tool ecosystem.
• Production Quality Observability: Lead the observability stack for Agent systems, including trace monitoring, evaluation pipelines, cost tracking, and latency governance. Establish quality baselines and regression testing frameworks for financial Agent scenarios, continuously improving system stability and interpretability.
• Technical Vision Team Enablement: Track and internalize cutting-edge Agent research, translating advances into AI engineering practice. Define team-wide Agent development standards and best practices; drive AI-native engineering capability uplift through code reviews, technical sharing, and architectural reviews.

Requirements
• Proven LLM / Agent Engineering

Experience:

3+ years of AI systems development experience, including 1+ year of production experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG systems, or Agent frameworks; hands-on development and optimization experience with Openclaw, including familiarity with its Agent Runtime architecture, plugin ecosystem, and multi-agent orchestration mechanisms.
• Systems Architecture Proficiency: Strong distributed systems design skills including microservices architecture, message queues (Kafka / RabbitMQ), and async task scheduling; capable of independently driving the full decision chain from requirements analysis through architecture design to technology selection.
• Programming Expertise: Proficiency in at least one backend language (Golang / Java / Node.js); solid REST API design and containerized deployment skills (Docker / Kubernetes).
• Deep LLM Technical Understanding: Strong grasp of Transformer architecture, Attention mechanisms, and advanced Prompt Engineering (CoT, Few-shot, Structured Output); experience with major model APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini) and local deployment solutions (Ollama, vLLM).
• Engineering Quality Standards: Strong software design fundamentals (design patterns, unit testing, CI/CD); hands-on experience building LLM evaluation frameworks or Agent tracing pipelines (LangSmith / Phoenix / Langfuse).

Nice to Have
• Experience combining MCTS, A\*, or Reinforcement Learning (RL) with LLMs for planning and reasoning; familiarity with SFT / RLHF training pipelines.
• Proven Agent system deployments in high-complexity vertical domains such as Finance, Web3, or Compliance, with an understanding of domain-specific constraints on Agent design.
• Open-source contributions or publications in NeurIPS / ICML / ACL / ICLR on Agent, RAG, or LLM-related topics.
• Experience with multimodal Agent development, including vision-language understanding and unstructured document parsing (PDFs, financial reports, research papers).
• Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or prior involvement in designing and implementing Agent communication standards.

About the Role

Crypto financial markets generate enormous arbitrage opportunities, signals, and price dislocations every day — but most users lack the expertise to act on them. The AI Strategy Engineer we're looking for is someone who can transform these opportunities into executable AI-powered applications: one-click arbitrage, automated yield optimization, AI trading signals — giving ordinary users access to strategy capabilities that were previously reserved for institutional players.

You will lead strategy research, design, and deployment — developing deep expertise in funding rate arbitrage, basis trading, stablecoin yield strategies, cross-exchange arbitrage, and more. You will combine quantitative strategy logic with AI Agent execution frameworks to build automated systems that directly drive user retention and asset growth. This isn't a pure quant role, nor a pure engineering role — you need to understand markets, understand strategies, and know how to turn them into products users can actually use.

Key Responsibilities
• Quantitative Strategy Research Design: Research executable arbitrage opportunities in crypto markets including funding rate arbitrage, basis trading (perpetuals vs. delivery), stablecoin yield strategies (stablecoin lending loops, Launchpool hedging), and cross-exchange arbitrage. Complete strategy logic design, historical backtesting, and risk-adjusted return validation.
• AI Strategy Application Development: Package quantitative strategies into user-facing AI applications. Design execution workflows, trigger conditions, position management, and risk controls for scenarios such as one-click arbitrage, automated yield optimization, and promotional opportunity capturing. Integrate AI Agent capabilities to enable automated strategy analysis, decision-making, and execution.
• Market Signal Intelligence System: Build a multi-source market intelligence capability integrating exchange market data, on-chain data, and community sentiment signals. Use AI models to identify hot opportunities, entry timing, and take-profit/stop-loss strategies, providing users with disciplined, AI-assisted trading signals.
• Strategy Risk Control Position Management: Design risk frameworks for each strategy class, including maximum drawdown controls, dynamic position calibration, and circuit breakers for extreme market conditions. Regularly analyze live strategy performance, identify degradation factors, and drive iterative optimization.
• Strategy Productization for User Scenarios: Develop a deep understanding of different user personas (conservative yield-seekers vs. active traders) and translate strategy capabilities into perceivable product value — defining the core interaction logic, return visualization, and risk communication for strategy applications.
• Cross-System Strategy Integration: Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate strategies with exchange APIs (including third-party exchanges), and drive the engineering delivery of automated strategy execution with unified cross-exchange asset management.

Requirements
• Quantitative Strategy

Experience:

3+ years of quantitative strategy research or trading experience, with at least one strategy class delivered end-to-end in production (funding rate arbitrage, basis trading, statistical arbitrage, market-neutral, etc.); proficient with backtesting frameworks and able to independently conduct strategy validation and attribution analysis.
• Deep Crypto Market Knowledge: Strong command of crypto derivatives market mechanics including perpetual contract funding rates, delivery futures basis dynamics, stablecoin protocol yield structures (USDE / USD1 / BYUSD etc.), and DeFi protocol return mechanisms. Live trading strategy experience is strongly preferred.
• Programming Data Analysis: Proficient in Python for strategy development and data analysis (Pandas / NumPy / backtesting frameworks); experience with exchange API integration; able to work with market tick data, funding rate history, and other quantitative datasets.
• AI / Agent Integration: Hands-on experience building LLM applications or AI Agents; able to encapsulate strategy logic as agent-callable tools and construct automated strategy pipelines from signal analysis through decision-making to execution.
• Business Acumen Product Thinking: Able to identify actionable strategy opportunities from a user-value perspective and translate complex quantitative strategies into understandable, actionable product experiences; capable of independently driving strategy concepts from 0 to
1. Nice to Have
• Live trading experience with cross-exchange arbitrage (funding rate, cross-exchange spread, basis arbitrage) or on-chain DeFi strategies.
• Familiarity with on-chain analytics tools (Dune / Nansen / Glassnode) for mining strategy signals from on-chain indicators.
• Experience developing and operating automated trading systems (quant trading bots, grid strategies, DCA systems, etc.).
• Understanding of AI-driven signal generation, with practical experience combining market sentiment and quantitative models.

Anti-Money Laundering Officer (AMLO) – MiCAR / Crypto
1. Purpose of the Role

The Anti-Money Laundering Officer ("AMLO") is the designated key function holder responsible for establishing, managing, and continuously improving all policies, systems, and processes to counter the risks of the Company's involvement in money laundering, terrorism financing, bribery, and corruption. The AMLO serves as the central point of contact — both internally and externally — for all matters related to AML/CFT compliance.

This role is established in accordance with the Austrian Financial Market Anti-Money Laundering Act (FM-GwG), MiCAR (Regulation (EU) 2023/1114), the Austrian MiCA-VVG, and the FMA's published governance requirements for obliged entities.
2. Key Responsibilities

2.1 AML/CFT Framework Compliance
• Design, implement, and maintain the AML/KYC/CFT compliance framework across all business functions
• Develop and update AML/CFT policies, procedures, and internal controls
• Ensure rigorous implementation of the framework across the Company, including outsourced functions
• Monitor regulatory developments and ensure sustained compliance with Austrian and EU AML/CFT requirements

2.2 Risk Management
• Conduct and maintain the Company's Money Laundering/Terrorist Financing Risk Assessment
• Identify and assess ML/TF risks related to customers, geographies, products, services, and technologies
• Implement enhanced due diligence measures for high-risk scenarios (PEPs, complex structures, high-risk jurisdictions)
• Ensure that ML/TF risks are considered in the development of new products, the taking-on of new customers, and changes to the business profile

2.3 Monitoring Detection
• Oversee behavior and transaction monitoring systems
• Supervise the implementation and effectiveness of automated monitoring tools and alert management
• Ensure adequate processes for detecting unusual or suspicious activities

2.4 Reporting
• Act as the primary liaison with the Austrian Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU, A-FIU at the Federal Ministry of the Interior)
• File Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) as required — independent of management instruction when exercising this function
• Report at least quarterly to the Board of Directors on relevant events, findings, and compliance status in a formal report
• Escalate key/high-risk compliance issues within the governance structure

2.5 Sanctions Compliance
• Oversee sanctions screening processes and systems
• Ensure compliance with applicable EU and national sanctions regimes
• Coordinate with the Sanctions Officer on matters of overlapping responsibility

2.6 Training Awareness
• Design, implement, and oversee AML/CFT training programs for all staff
• Ensure staff in relevant functions receive adequate and regular training
• Promote awareness of AML/CFT obligations and red flags across the organization

2.7 Outsourcing Oversight
• Supervise and control all outsourced AML/CFT functions (incl. shared AML services at AT Holding level and third-party tools)
• Ensure that outsourcing arrangements do not impair the Company's AML/CFT compliance

2.8 Second Line of Defense
• Lead and supervise the second line of defense regarding AML/CTF, bribery, and corruption
• Work in close cooperation with the Head of Compliance on compliance matters
• Coordinate with the COO on client onboarding and KYC processes
3. Governance Reporting Lines

Aspect

Detail

Reports to

Board of Directors (direct ad-hoc access); COO for disciplinary matters

Formal reporting

Quarterly written report to the full Board

Independence

Not subject to management instruction when filing STRs or responding to FIU requests

Board access

Direct and unrestricted access to the Board at any time

Resources

Personal responsibility with access to AT Holding shared resources
4. Qualifications Requirements

4.1 Mandatory (per Austrian FM-GwG FMA guidance)
• Expert qualification in AML/CFT — demonstrated through relevant education, certifications (e.g., CAMS, ICA Diploma), and professional experience
• Good personal reputation (Zuverlässigkeit) — proven integrity, no criminal record relevant to the function
• Senior management-level positioning — sufficient seniority and authority within the organization
• Adequate professional experience — minimum 5 years in AML/CFT compliance, preferably in financial services or crypto-asset industry
• FMA-notifiable appointment — the FMA must be notified prior to appointment; the FMA may revoke the appointment if qualifications/reliability are not met

4.2 Knowledge Expertise
• Deep knowledge of Austrian AML/CFT legislation (FM-GwG, BWG, WiEReG)
• Understanding of EU regulatory framework (MiCAR, AMLD 4/5/6, Transfer of Funds Regulation)
• Familiarity with FATF standards and recommendations
• Understanding of crypto-asset-specific ML/TF typologies and risks
• Knowledge of sanctions regimes (EU, UN, OFAC as relevant)

4.3 Skills Competencies
• Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills
• Ability to communicate complex regulatory matters to senior management and board
• Analytical and risk-based thinking
• Experience with AML/CFT technology solutions (transaction monitoring, screening tools)
• Fluency in English; German highly preferred

4.4 Desirable
• Prior experience in a CASP or fintech environment
• Experience with regulatory examinations and FMA interactions
• Experience building AML programs from the ground up or during licensing processes
7. Authority Powers

The AMLO shall be granted:
• Unrestricted access to all information, data, records, and systems relevant to their function
• Sufficient powers and means to carry out their responsibilities
• Authority to instruct staff on AML/CFT compliance matters
• Independence from management instruction when filing reports with the FIU

The role and its scope must be set out in writing by management in a job description of the function.

Why Join Us

 

At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. Our benefits include:
• Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
• Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
• Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
• Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
• Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

Role Overview

This is a hands-on, full-cycle role that owns the whole fraud control loop: investigate, analyze, set up rules, monitor, and improve. You will work tickets daily, turn what you find into data-backed fraud rules and strategies, monitor how they perform, and keep refining them. Each stage feeds the next.

 

You will own the card risk control strategy, from set-up through ongoing performance, and be accountable for the fraud rate and the interception rate.

 

Key Responsibilities
1. Investigation
• Handle card risk tickets daily: review rule-triggered alerts, investigate suspicious accounts and transactions, and decide on block, decline, step-up, or card-lifecycle actions within SLA
• Investigate fraud typologies: account takeover, card testing, BIN attacks, merchant collusion, friendly fraud, and first-party abuse
• Assess merchant and transaction risk by MCC risk type, including high-risk merchants and non-card payment flows
• Manage disputes and chargebacks end to end under Visa/Mastercard rules: evidence, representation, pre-arbitration, and arbitration
2. Data Analysis
• Turn investigation findings into patterns: analyze ticket, alert, and transaction data to identify fraud trends, attack vectors, and coverage gaps
• Measure false positives against loss to judge whether existing rules are effective
3. Rule Set-up
• Design and set up fraud rules, velocity limits, and strategies based on the analysis
• Make sure rule triggers and decisions stay compliant; escalate linked AML/sanctions concerns to Compliance
4. Rule Monitoring
• Continuously monitor alert and ticket data after rules go live
• Track and report KPIs: fraud loss rate (bps), chargeback ratio, approval rate, alert handling time, recovery rate
• Keep the programme within scheme monitoring thresholds (e.g. VAMP, ECM/EFM) and support scheme and partner audits
5. Rule Improvement
• Adjust, retire, and add rules in response to monitoring results, balancing fraud loss against false positives and approval rate
• Feed fraud trends back to Product and Engineering to improve onboarding, 3DS, and authorisation controls

Requirements
• 3+ years in card fraud strategy or payments risk at an issuer, EMI, neobank, PSP, or card programme manager
• Proven hands-on experience building and tuning fraud rules and strategies, not only working tickets
• Hands-on knowledge of Visa and/or Mastercard dispute rules, reason codes, and chargeback timelines
• Experience with MCC-based risk, high-risk merchants, and non-card payments
• Strong data

skills:

SQL and Excel/Sheets to pull, slice, and explain fraud trends
• Fluent English; Mandarin or other European languages are a plus

Nice to Have
• Crypto-linked or prepaid/debit card programme experience, including crypto-to-fiat conversion at authorisation
• Card risk control experience across multiple countries/regions
• Experience launching a card programme in a new market or with a new BIN sponsor
• Scheme monitoring programme remediation experience
• Python or BI tooling (Looker, Tableau, Metabase)
• Certifications: CFE, ACAMS, or equivalent

jobs.description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 90 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Role Purpose

Lead the establishment and ongoing oversight of the Pakistan entity’s independent Compliance function and Anti-Money Laundering, Counter-Terrorist Financing and Counter-Proliferation Financing (AML/CFT/CPF) framework.

During the pre-licensing phase, the role holder will lead Compliance-owned licensing deliverables, develop the local control framework and assess operational readiness. Following licensing, the role holder will discharge the entity’s CO/MLRO responsibilities, advise the Board and senior management, and maintain effective engagement with PVARA, the Financial Monitoring Unit (FMU) and other relevant authorities.

The role combines CO and MLRO responsibilities, subject to applicable regulatory requirements and any required regulatory acceptance or approval. The suitability of the combined arrangement will be reviewed periodically, considering independence, conflicts, capacity, resources and the entity’s nature, scale and complexity.

 

Key Responsibilities
• Licensing and Operational Readiness
• Lead Compliance-owned components of the PVARA licensing application and coordinate relevant inputs from Legal, Business, Risk, Finance, Operations and Technology.
• Develop and maintain a regulatory obligations register, licensing deliverables tracker and local implementation roadmap.
• Assess gaps between group policies, systems and controls and applicable Pakistan requirements; oversee localisation and track remediation.
• Establish local Compliance and AML/CFT/CPF policies, governance arrangements, escalation procedures and regulatory reporting processes.
• Define local control requirements for customer onboarding, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, Travel Rule compliance and suspicious transaction reporting.
• Assess the suitability and readiness of local, group-provided and outsourced controls, including relevant pre-launch testing.
• Provide a documented Compliance and AML readiness assessment to the appropriate governance forum, escalating unresolved material gaps before launch.
• Compliance Oversight
• Establish, administer and maintain a documented, risk-based Compliance Management System (CMS) proportionate to the entity’s activities and risk profile.
• Advise the Board, relevant committees and senior management on applicable legal and regulatory requirements, licence conditions and regulatory developments.
• Develop and execute a risk-based Compliance Monitoring and Testing Plan; document findings, agree remediation ownership and deadlines with accountable functions, independently validate closure, and escalate overdue or inadequate remediation.
• Oversee compliance with applicable conduct, customer protection, complaints-handling, client-asset and market-integrity requirements, according to the entity’s licensed activities.
• Review proposed products, services and material business changes from a local compliance perspective, identifying requirements, restrictions and necessary controls.
• Ensure material non-compliance is investigated, promptly escalated and remediated, and notified to PVARA where required.
• Maintain regulatory submission and commitment trackers, overseeing timely and accurate Compliance-owned responses and escalating dependency risks.
• Act as the primary Compliance liaison with PVARA for supervisory engagement, inspections and information requests.
• Develop and oversee Compliance training for employees, senior management and relevant key individuals.
• AML/CFT/CPF and Financial Crime
• Establish, implement and maintain the entity’s AML/CFT/CPF framework, aligned with applicable Pakistan legislation, regulatory requirements and relevant directions or guidance.
• Lead the enterprise-wide financial crime risk assessment and oversee risk-based mitigation measures.
• Oversee customer due diligence, beneficial ownership identification, customer risk assessment, enhanced due diligence and ongoing monitoring.
• Oversee transaction monitoring, sanctions screening and targeted financial sanctions controls, including escalation and action on relevant alerts.
• Oversee virtual asset-specific controls, including blockchain analytics, risks associated with unhosted wallets and Travel Rule compliance where applicable.
• Receive and assess internal suspicious activity referrals, determine whether external reporting is required, and submit suspicious transaction reports to the FMU within applicable deadlines.
• Exercise independent judgement on suspicious transaction reporting without requiring business approval, while maintaining confidentiality and preventing tipping-off.
• Manage the entity’s FMU/goAML registration, access arrangements and reporting processes, as applicable.
• Ensure required customer, transaction and investigation records are retained for applicable periods and remain accessible and retrievable.
• Liaise with the FMU and other competent authorities on financial crime matters and oversee relevant information requests.
• Oversee AML/CFT/CPF training and awareness, tailored to employees’ responsibilities and exposure to risk.
• Governance, Reporting and Control Assurance
• Provide periodic reports to the Board or designated committee on Compliance and AML/CFT/CPF effectiveness, material risks, incidents, findings and remediation progress.
• Escalate urgent or material matters promptly rather than waiting for scheduled reporting.
• Attend relevant Board and committee meetings and provide independent advice and challenge.
• Assess and oversee group-provided and outsourced Compliance/AML services, including local regulatory suitability, service standards, data access, management information and escalation arrangements.
• Oversee delegated Compliance and AML/CFT/CPF activities and remain accountable for discharging the CO/MLRO responsibilities, without displacing the responsibilities of the entity, Board, senior management or operational control owners.
• Coordinate with Risk and Internal Audit, while preserving the distinction between Compliance oversight and independent audit assurance.
• Support periodic review of the role holder’s continuing fitness, propriety and suitability, including the required review of the MLRO appointment.
• Maintain effective handover and suitably qualified cover arrangements for absences, consistent with applicable regulatory requirements.

 

Qualifications and Experience

Essential
• A degree in law, finance, business or a related discipline, or an equivalent relevant professional qualification.
• At least eight years’ relevant Compliance and/or AML/CFT experience in financial services, including at least three years in a senior Compliance, MLRO or equivalent leadership role.
• Strong knowledge of Pakistan’s financial regulatory and AML/CFT framework, including the Virtual Assets Act, applicable PVARA regulations, the Anti-Money Laundering Act and FMU reporting requirements.
• Demonstrable understanding of virtual asset business models and their financial crime, conduct and operational risks.
• Practical experience with customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, investigations and suspicious transaction reporting.
• Experience developing risk assessments, policies, monitoring programmes and Board-level reporting.
• Ability to translate regulatory requirements into workable business, operational and technology controls.
• Be resident in Pakistan by the date of the formal CO/MLRO appointment and maintain residency as required under applicable regulations.
• Fluency in English and Urdu.

 

Desirable
• Professional certification such as CAMS, an ICA qualification or an equivalent Compliance/AML credential.
• Experience in virtual assets, exchanges, fintech or digital financial services.
• Experience supporting a regulatory licence application or establishing a local Compliance function.
• Experience engaging with PVARA, FMU, SECP, SBP or other relevant Pakistani authorities.
• Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools and Travel Rule solutions.
• Experience overseeing centralised group services and outsourced control arrangements.

 

Key Competencies
• Independence, integrity and sound judgement.
• Confidence to challenge senior management constructively.
• Clear communication with regulators, the Board and cross-functional teams.
• Strong analytical, investigative and problem-solving skills.
• Effective prioritisation in a developing regulatory environment.
• Ability to build a local control framework while working within a global organisation.

 

Authority and Independence
• Direct access to the local Board or designated committee, including the ability to escalate without prior management clearance.
• Timely and unrestricted access to relevant records, systems, personnel and management information necessary to discharge the role, subject to applicable confidentiality and data-handling requirements.
• Adequate resources and suitably qualified support proportionate to the entity’s activities and risk profile.
• No client-facing, sales or other responsibilities that compromise independence, create material conflicts or impair CO/MLRO duties.
• Remuneration arrangements that do not link the role holder’s performance to sales or revenue targets.
• Group reporting arrangements that do not restrict local regulatory accountability, Board access or independent MLRO decision-making.
• Board oversight of appointment, replacement and removal, with regulatory approvals or notifications completed as applicable.

 

Regulatory Appointment Conditions

The role holder must satisfy applicable fitness and propriety, residency, employment, competence and regulatory appointment requirements at appointment and on an ongoing basis. Any required PVARA approval, acceptance or notification must be completed in accordance with the applicable framework.
