About the Opportunity

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Partner who lives in the top of the funnel. This is a hands-on, sourcing-first role focused on building and owning talent pipelines across the US, LATAM, and APAC — with the heaviest emphasis on APAC, where our fastest hiring growth is happening and where deep market knowledge is hardest to buy.

You will spend the majority of your time proactively identifying, engaging, and converting passive talent — not processing inbound applications. You will map markets, build long-term talent communities, and become the person hiring managers come to when they need to know who’s out there. If you are energized by outreach that actually lands, by knowing a market better than anyone else in the room, and by building pipelines before the req even opens, this role is for you.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Proactive Sourcing (Core Focus): Own top-of-funnel sourcing across US, LATAM, and APAC. Build and execute multi-channel sourcing strategies using LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean and X-ray search, GitHub, Behance, Dribbble, Telegram, Discord, WeChat, Maimai, BOSS Zhipin, referrals, alumni networks, and crypto-native communities.
• APAC Pipeline Building: Serve as the sourcing engine for APAC hiring. Develop deep talent maps across key hubs — Singapore, Hong Kong, mainland China, Japan, Malaysia, Australia, and India — and build region-specific outreach strategies that account for local platforms, languages, notice periods, and compensation norms.
• Talent Mapping Market Intelligence: Produce competitor org maps, talent availability reports, and compensation benchmarks by region. Translate market data into practical guidance that shapes role scoping, level calibration, and hiring plans.
• Candidate Engagement Conversion: Write and test outreach that gets replies. Own the candidate experience from first touch through handoff, running screens that assess motivation, mobility, and fit while keeping candidates warm through long hiring cycles.
• Pipeline Ownership Nurture: Build and maintain evergreen pipelines and talent communities for recurring and hard-to-fill roles. Keep silver-medalist and passive-candidate pools active so we are never starting from zero when a req opens.
• Stakeholder Partnership: Partner with recruiters, hiring managers, and regional HR teams across time zones. Run intake and calibration sessions, share pipeline reviews, and set realistic expectations grounded in market reality.
• Sourcing Data Reporting: Track and report on sourcing funnel metrics — outreach volume, response rate, screen-to-submit, submit-to-onsite, and pipeline health by region. Use the data to redirect effort toward the channels that convert.
• Employer Brand in Market: Represent OKX to passive talent. Support regional recruiting events, meetups, and community engagement, and help position OKX as the destination employer in crypto across every market you cover.

What We Look For In You
• 5+ years of full-lifecycle recruiting or dedicated sourcing experience, with a demonstrable track record of building pipelines from scratch rather than working inbound applicant flow.
• Hands-on APAC sourcing experience strongly preferred — you have hired into at least one major APAC market and understand its platforms, candidate behavior, and hiring norms.
• Experience recruiting across multiple regions and time zones, ideally including US and LATAM alongside APAC.
• Advanced sourcing toolkit: Boolean and X-ray search, LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, portfolio platforms, and region-specific channels. Comfortable finding talent where it is not looking for you.
• Strong written outreach skills — you can craft personalized, high-response messaging at volume.
• Proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems and sourcing CRMs; disciplined about data hygiene and pipeline tracking.
• Comfortable operating with ambiguity and shifting priorities in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
• Nice to have:

crypto, Web3, or fintech recruiting experience; additional language capability relevant to APAC markets (Mandarin, Cantonese, Japanese, Bahasa); experience building talent communities or running sourcing jams and hiring events.

jobs.title: HRシステムエンジニア（AI駆動開発・データ基盤）
jobs.description:
PayPayについて

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7600万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50か国の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

OUR VISION IS UNLIMITED_

我々は自分たちの想像を超える未来を創るためにあえて明確なビジョンは必要ないと考えています。常にDay1であるスタンスを忘れずに、誰もが想像できないようなビジョン（未来）を実現していくのがPayPayです。
この壮大なビジョンに前向きに取り組み、他社に真似できない圧倒的なスピードでプロダクトを磨き上げ、日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、自ら課題発見し、周囲と協力して新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

業務について

▼People Analytics AI Tech Officeの紹介
私たちは、PayPayの急成長を支える人と組織の意思決定を、データとAIテクノロジーの力で科学し、進化させる専門家集団です。
従来の人事オペレーションの枠を超え、People Analytics（データ分析）とAI Technology（技術実装）を融合させることで、事業成長および組織生産性の最大化への貢献を目指しています。

▼募集の背景

AIを世界一活用する企業を目指すソフトバンクグループの一員として、PayPayは今、圧倒的なスピードで事業拡大を続けています。 組織が拡大・複雑化する中で、旧来のオペレーションモデルでは対応しきれない課題が増加しており、特に「シンギュラリティ」を見据えた抜本的な業務プロセスの再発明が急務です。
2025年に新設されたPeople Analytics AI Tech Officeでは、HR部門を横断して業務フローを解体・再構築できるプロフェッショナルを求めています。 
特に、最新のAIエージェント技術やPython等を用いた高度な自動化を駆使し、採用・労務・組織開発など多岐にわたる人事業務を内製化・自動化・無人化・高度化できるプロジェクトをリードしてくださる方を募集しております。

＜参考情報＞
・第13回日本HRチャレンジ大賞受賞（テーマ：世界No.1のD I企業へのチャレンジ）
・第11回HRテクノロジー大賞 人的資本経営部門優秀賞（テーマ：AI×人的資本経営で未来を拓き、グローバルNo.1へ）
・第8回HRテクノロジー大賞 イノベーション賞

【具体的な業務内容】

「HR領域の業務システム・AIソリューションの内製開発をリードしつつ、データ基盤構築まで一気通貫で担い、PayPayグループの組織推進力を最大化する」

急拡大・多様化するPayPayおよびグループ各社の組織課題・業務オペレーションをテクノロジーの力で解決するため、AI駆動開発を活用したHR業務システム・ツールの内製開発をメインミッションとしつつ、それらを支えるHRデータ基盤・パイプラインの設計・構築まで幅広くリードしていただきます。
HRの取り扱うデータ（従業員情報、健康情報、採用応募者情報など）はすべて機密レベルの高いものです。それらを安全・効率的に活用するためのセキュアなシステムを開発することが求められるポジションです。

※これまでのご経験・志向に応じて、以下の業務を担当いただきます。
1. HR領域のBPR・システム内製開発
• 採用、労務、評価、派遣管理などHR部門内および関連部門を跨ぐ業務フローの可視化・課題特定・要件定義
• 生成AI（ChatGPT / Gemini / Codex 等）やローコード（OutSystems / GAS）、Python等を活用した業務システム・AIエージェントの設計〜開発〜リリース（AI駆動開発）
• 導入後の保守運用、追加開発、および現場定着化支援（マニュアル作成、トレーニング、効果測定）
2. HRデータ基盤・パイプラインの設計・構築（データエンジニアリング）
• Snowflake / Databricks 等を活用したHRデータ基盤・データマートの設計・構築（ETL/ELTパイプライン整備）
• Workday等のHR基幹システムや各種社内ツールとのデータ連携・統合パイプラインの構築
• 従業員情報・健康情報等の機微データを安全に扱うためのセキュリティ・権限管理およびデータタグ付け・カタログ整備
• BIツール（Sigma）を用いたダッシュボード構築・データ可視化の支援

【開発・分析環境】
・生成AI：ChatGPT / Gemini / Codex 等
・言語・開発・ローコード：Python / SQL / Google Apps Script（GAS）/ OutSystems / GitHub
・データ基盤・クラウド：Snowflake / Databricks / Cloud Storage（GCP / AWS）
・BIツール：Sigma
・HR基幹システム：Workday

【過去開発事例】 ※いずれもAI駆動開発による事例です。
・採用アシスタントAIツール
・派遣管理デスク請求チェックAIツール
・HRBP向けコンサルアシスタントAIツール
・PayPayグループ内公募アシスタントAIツールなど

▼本ポジションの魅力
• AI×人事の新たな仕組みづくり：
最新のAI技術を実際のHR業務に取り入れ、数千名規模の組織にインパクトを与えるプロダクト開発に携われます。
• 高い裁量とスピード感：
業務課題の特定から企画・開発・導入まで一貫して携わり、自らの技術力やアイデアをスピーディーに形にできる環境です。
• 技術交流と専門性の広がり：
PayPay社内やソフトバンク・LINEヤフーグループとのAI活用事例の共有・勉強会などを通じて、技術的な知見を深めながら、HR領域の専門性も広げられます。

必要な経験/スキル

以下すべての経験・スキルをお持ちの方
• SE、アプリケーションエンジニア、社内SE、業務改善エンジニア等として、業務システム・自動化ツール・ローコードアプリなどの要件定義から設計・実装まで携わった経験
• 生成AI（ChatGPT、Gemini、Codex、Claude等）をシステム開発や業務自動化に活用し、設計から実装まで主体的に推進できるスキル
• 非エンジニア（人事・経営層等）と連携し、業務要件をシステム・データ設計に落とし込めるスキル

あると望ましい経験/スキル

以下いずれかの経験・スキルをお持ちの方
• SQL・Python等を用いたデータ抽出・加工、システム連携・データ処理の経験

• 開発組織の立ち上げや内製化、ナレッジ移管を推進した経験

PayPayが求める人物像

待遇・条件

jobs.title: Creative Director, Brand (Art)
jobs.location: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Brand Creative Team is evolving and elevating how the Robinhood brand shows up and reaches people – capturing attention, earning trust, and driving our next phase of growth. The next generation is figuring out their money, and we want them to do it with Robinhood. That means disruptive, culturally relevant work that cuts through where they actually spend their time and wins them over.

As Creative Director, Brand (Art) you will lead the work that defines the brand and changes how people see Robinhood. You will concept big ideas and own them from insight to execution, with story and exceptional design at the core. The bar is world-class: work that breaks through, commands attention and moves the business.

This role is based in our New York, NY or Menlo Park, CA offices, with in-person attendance expected 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do
• Concept and develop big ideas that break through. Create disruptive, culturally relevant brand campaigns and moments that are unmistakably Robinhood and impossible to ignore.
• Win the next generation. Make Robinhood a brand young investors want to hear from, talk about and trust with their money. Meet them where they live with ideas they'll actually want to be part of, not just ads they scroll past.
• Drive results with strategy. Start with the business goal and build ideas that move the numbers. Understand how people think about money, use data to sharpen the work, and measure it by what it delivers. Our company is highly strategic, and our creatives are too.
• Make work the world talks about. Take ideas from first insight to finished work across film, social, out-of-home, experiential, product launches and events, and refuse to let anything go out less than great. Set the pace for the category with work that gets people talking and shapes the conversation in culture.

jobs.title: Solution Architect - Engine by Starling
jobs.description:
Starling Bank is the UK’s first and leading digital bank on a mission to fix banking with more than 3,000 people in our UK offices and 4 MILLION customers in the UK! We built a new kind of bank because we knew technology had the power to help people save, spend and manage their money in a new and transformative way. Now we present… Engine by Starling.

Engine by Starling is Starling’s software-as-a-service (SaaS) business, the technology that was built to power Starling Bank, and over a year ago we split out as a separate business. We are on a mission to find and work with leading banks all around the world who have the ambition to build rapid growth businesses, on our technology.

This SaaS technology platform is now available to banks and financial institutions all around the world, enabling them to benefit from the innovative digital features, and efficient back-office processes that has helped achieve Starling's success.

At Engine by Starling, our technologists are at our very heart and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment that is all about building things, creating new stuff, and disruptive technology that keeps us on the cutting edge of fintech. We operate a flat structure to empower you to make decisions regardless of what your primary responsibilities may be, innovation and collaboration will be at the core of everything you do. Help is never far away in our open culture, you will find support in your team and from across the business, we are in this together!

The way to thrive and shine within Engine is to be a self-driven individual and be able to take full ownership of everything around you: From building things, designing, and discovering to sharing knowledge with your colleagues and making sure all processes are efficient and productive to deliver the best possible results for our customers. Our purpose is underpinned by five values: Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim For Greatness.

Hybrid Working

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Engine - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of place of work in London, so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person. Supporting these activities on client sites means the role will require travel around Europe, and occasional further travel.

About the role

As a Solution Architect (SA) you will use your understanding of the Engine technology and architecture to explain the Engine product, uncover client requirements and support the design of client solutions.

You will be involved in both the sales and delivery phases of a project as well as ongoing client success, collaborating with teams across Engine in Technology, Delivery, Product, Client Success and Business Development.

What you'll get to do:

This role blends deep technical expertise with strong communication and collaboration skills. You'll become an Engine expert, understanding its architecture, technology, and functionality, allowing you to effectively communicate its capabilities and value to both technical and non-technical audiences.

You’ll lead on technical designs during the Engine implementation phase, building relationships with a variety of stakeholders within clients and SI partners such as their Engineering leads and Service Owners. 

You will work closely with our clients and SI partners on the technical detail of implementing Engine, providing solutions to identified requirements and working with our Product and engineering teams to fulfil them. Your contributions will also extend to shaping Engine's product roadmap and supporting existing clients with additional capabilities to meet their strategic aims. You’ll help them maximise Engine’s current and future capabilities to solve their requirements and meticulously document scope and roadmap decisions to guide subsequent delivery waves, bringing in expertise from our Product Owners and engineering teams where required.

You will also be a technical champion for our existing clients, ensuring their ongoing success. This includes taking ownership of the technical aspects of client deliveries, collaborating closely with our SI partners to overcome challenges and achieve seamless integrations. You'll provide expert guidance to client engineering teams, using documentation, API specifications, and sequence diagrams to foster a deep understanding of Engine's architecture and functionalities. Additionally, you will collaborate closely with our Client Success team to troubleshoot technical issues, translate client needs into new technical requirements, and architect innovative solutions that enhance the Engine platform.

Must Have:
• Experience of end-to-end software engineering / solution architecture across the software delivery lifecycle
• Experience with software service design and integration, such as RESTful APIs, OpenAPI specification and sequence diagrams
• Experience of cloud infrastructure and large-scale cloud applications
• Experience working in a client-facing role and building relationships with stakeholders
• Strong interpersonal communication and collaboration skills. Experience delivering complex messaging to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have:
• Experience relating to retail or business banking, core banking, card processing or payments.
• Experience of delivery and implementation of core banking or large-scale digital transformation programmes, application migration and solution integration
• Commercial acumen with experience of building business cases
• Experience in a SaaS organisation in a Client Solutions or Client Engineering role
• Knowledge of financial regulations around the world
• Speaking multiple european languages is a massive plus

About you:
• You have a focus on delivery and getting things done for a client
• You have the ability to work well with people from a variety of levels, roles and technical backgrounds
• You’re able to communicate clearly about technical subjects
• You’re comfortable working in a varied role, collaboratively in a team, with a flat structure
• You’re comfortable travelling nationally to our London office (initial upskilling will require a period of time working with our Engineers & Product team in London)
• You’re comfortable travelling internationally

Interview Process: 

Interviewing is a two way process and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you! Our interviews are conversational and we want to get the best from you, so come with questions and be curious. In general you can expect the below, following a chat with one of our Talent Team:

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Commercial Services
jobs.description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:
• Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
• Over $300 million raised in funding
• 3,000 Tideans globally
• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE TEAM:

Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Commercial Services. You will report to the CDTO and partner with Product and Design leadership as one leadership team accountable for the outcomes of the domain.

Commercial Services is where Tide extends from helping members run their business to helping them grow it. You will shape how quickly every member becomes discoverable, how much of their buying and selling runs through Tide, and how far AI can turn that into a lasting advantage across every market we serve.

Sell gives every member a live, discoverable presence, from the Tide Business Pages we are launching for 2 million members across the UK and Europe, to Own Website, catalogue, bookings, CRM and lead capture, and embedded fulfilment through Delivery as a Service.

Buy turns that member base into a two-sided marketplace through the Tide Online Network, alongside Tide Promotions (gift cards, cashback and personalised offers), business supplies from partners, and Vendor Hub for e-procurement. 

You will be the single owner accountable for engineering delivery, architecture and people across both.

ABOUT

THE ROLE:

This role sits at the intersection of SME commerce, marketplaces and banking. Our members sit on both sides of the marketplace, our partners extend what we can offer them, and our banking platform lets us layer payments, credit, insurance and rewards into the experience at the point of need, which few commerce players can do. We need someone who can bring both streams onto one consistent engineering bar, ship quickly and build the platforms that turn Commercial Services into a material recurring revenue line for Tide.

 As Director of Engineering you will
• Set the engineering strategy and technical direction across the Sell and Buy value streams, from launch through to scale.
• Lead the Heads of Engineering for Sell and Buy, build the leadership bench underneath them, and own headcount planning, hiring and organisation design.
• Partner with Product and Design leadership on one shared plan, jointly owning delivery and outcomes, including members activated through real sales and purchases, engagement and recurring revenue.
• Scale the Tide Business Pages and Tide Online Network into a trusted, high-traffic marketplace, including search, listings, member-to-member leads, chat and buyer requests.
• Build the partner integration platform behind our website, gift card, business supply and logistics partners, enabling new partners and offers to be onboarded quickly and safely.
• Work with Payments, Acquiring, Credit, Insurance and Wealth to embed payments, credit, insurance and rewards into commerce journeys at the point of need.
• Build trust into the marketplace in partnership with Ongoing Monitoring and Risk, from verified seller status to initial and ongoing monitoring of listings and member-to-member communication.
• Set a consistent engineering practice and quality bar across architecture, delivery health measured through DORA metrics, reliability and security.
• Lead our move towards AI-assisted and agentic commerce, where a member describes what they need and Tide finds, compares and sources it.
• Apply our OnePlatform principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
• Director engineering leadership of a multi-team organisation of around 50 engineers across backend, frontend, data and analytics, led through at least one layer of engineering leaders.
• Domain experience in e-commerce, two-sided marketplaces, CRM or procurement platforms, including the trust and safety controls they need, with fintech or SME banking experience a plus.
• Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable product and commercial outcomes.
• Experience building partner and third-party integration platforms at scale.
• Strong product and design partnership instincts.
• Comfortable setting direction through ambiguity and launching new products into multiple markets.
• Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, architecture and technical quality.
• Experience bringing AI or agentic experiences into customer-facing commerce products would be a bonus.

OUR TECH STACK:
• Backend: Java, Spring/Spring Boot, microservices architecture
• Mobile/Web: Flutter / Angular
• Infrastructure: AWS (SNS+SQS), PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora, GCP (BigQuery, Vertex)
• Observability: Coralogix (OpenTelemetry
• Claude for agentic ways of working

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:
• Competitive Compensation - Competitive salary and share options.
• Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
• Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
• Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
• Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options.
• Life Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
• Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
• Volunteering Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
• Learning Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
• WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
• Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
• Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
• Snacks Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

#LI-AC1 #LI-Hybrid

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

 

Disclaimer

 

It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:
• Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
• All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
• Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
• Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.

 

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.

Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

• 3,000 Tideans globally
• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE TEAM:

The IT team at Tide is a small, high-impact group of around 20 people, combining a responsive service desk with strong project-based engineering capability. The team operates in a cloud-native environment, with Google Workspace at the core, and supports a large, globally distributed workforce. The focus is on enabling the business through reliable, secure access to a wide range of SaaS platforms, while continuously improving how services are delivered as the organisation scales.

ABOUT

THE ROLE:

You'll be the technical SME for our core IT platforms. As a senior individual contributor, you’ll own the architecture, configuration and health of the platforms every Tidean relies on. You’ll make the key design decisions, keep the platforms secure, well governed and documented, and drive improvements from design through to rollout. The major platforms in scope are:
• • Google Workspace: identity and access policies, DLP, email security and ChromeOS management
• Netskope (SSE/SASE): SWG, CASB, DLP and ZTNA
• Jamf Pro and Microsoft Intune: zero-touch provisioning, compliance, patching and encryption for the Mac and Windows fleet
• Atlassian: Jira Service Management as our ITSM platform and CMDB, plus Jira and Confluence
• Establish configuration as code mentality within the team: manage platform config through Terraform, Git and CI/CD where the tools allow it, and script everything else.
• Own the engineering side of endpoint security and compliance controls, including EDR integrations, OS and application patching, vulnerability remediation, encryption, device compliance and security baselines.
• Build monitoring, reporting and operational health metrics for workplace platforms, using APIs and automation to identify configuration drift, failures, capacity issues and emerging operational risks before they become incidents.
• Own technical design and architecture decisions for Workplace Technology, including platform standards, technical debt, vendor evaluation, proof of concepts, migration strategy and lifecycle planning.
• Act as L3 escalation for complex incidents, carry out root-cause analysis, and turn what we learn into lasting fixes.
• Support audit and compliance work (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2, FCA and DORA requirements) with evidence, controls and documentation.
• Mentor engineers and service desk colleagues, raise the team's technical bar, and write the runbooks and Confluence documentation that let others work independently.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
• Extensive experience with CaC (Configuration as Code) on SaaS platforms.
• Confident scripting in Python, Bash and PowerShell, and comfort working with REST APIs.
• 7+ years in IT or workplace engineering, including at least 3 years at senior level in a cloud-native, SaaS-first organisation of 1,000+ users.
• Deep hands-on Google Workspace administration at enterprise scale, including automation with GAM/GAMADV-XTD3, the Admin SDK APIs or Apps Script.
• Production experience designing and running Netskope or a comparable SSE/SASE platform (Zscaler, Prisma Access, Cloudflare One), including ZTNA and DLP.
• Strong experience with both Jamf Pro and Microsoft Intune, running a mixed Mac and Windows fleet end to end.
• Solid grasp of identity and access: SAML, OIDC, SCIM, MFA, conditional access and device trust.
• Clear, confident communication with engineers, stakeholders and non-technical users alike.

Nice to have:
• Admin-level experience with Jira, Confluence and Jira Service Management, including JSM automation and Assets.
• Experience in fintech or regulated financial services (FCA, DORA, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2).
• Working knowledge of GCP and AWS, particularly IAM and networking relevant to ZTNA.
• Relevant certifications (Google Workspace Administrator, Jamf 300/400, Netskope NSK200/300, MD-102, Atlassian ACP).

OUR TECH STACK:
• Google Workspace and Google Cloud Platform
• Netskope (SSE/SASE)
• Jamf Pro and Microsoft Intune
• Mac, Windows and ChromeOS endpoints
• Okta
• C1
• Cisco Meraki
• Jira, Confluence and Jira Service Management

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN: 

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:
• The gross annual salary for this position ranges from €62,000 to €87,200 but we are also open to discussing the salary further, taking into account your expertise and contributions.
• 25 days paid annual leave
• 3 paid days off for volunteering or L D activities
• Extended maternity and paternity leave covered by the company
• Personal L D budget in the amount of 500 EUR per year
• Additional health dental insurance
• Mental wellbeing platform
• Fully covered Multisports card
• Food vouchers
• Snacks, light food, drinks in the office
• WFH equipment allowance
• Flexible working from home

• Share options

jobs.title: Senior Product Compliance Manager - AI
jobs.description:
Our Product Compliance & Risk (“PC&R”) team sits at the centre of Wise’s product development function, supporting our cross-functional teams in delivering exceptional financial products for our customers while ensuring they’re compliant by design.

We’re seeking a Senior Product Compliance & Risk Manager, AI to own and improve the processes that support responsible AI use across Wise. Building on our AI governance foundation, you’ll turn regulatory requirements into practical controls, improve how teams onboard and manage AI use cases, and demonstrate that our governance processes work effectively.

Your Mission

Enable Wise to adopt AI confidently and responsibly by making AI governance practical, consistent and scalable. You’ll own the lifecycle of our internal AI use case management process, partnering with teams across the business to assess risks, maintain clear accountability and embed requirements into everyday workflows and tooling.

You’ll bring together regulatory understanding, sound risk judgement and operational delivery to ensure our AI inventory and supporting controls remain effective as technology, business needs and regulations evolve.

Key

Responsibilities:
• Own and improve AI use case management. Manage the process from onboarding and assessment through ongoing review, material changes and retirement. Build on the existing foundation, keeping ownership, decisions and follow-up actions clear.
• Improve tooling and workflows. Work with users and technical teams to identify friction, prioritise improvements and translate governance requirements into actionable changes to our in-house tooling.
• Translate regulatory developments into practice. Partner with Legal and Compliance to interpret evolving global AI requirements, including the EU AI Act, and embed them into policies, assessment criteria, procurement standards and operational controls.
• Develop assessment criteria. Partner with the AI governance group and subject matter experts to define proportionate assessments covering areas such as bias, privacy, security and model performance, including where expert judgement, testing or escalation is required.
• Support consistent AI adoption. Help standardise the way in which AI tools are adopted across Wise, working with teams to establish clear requirements for acceptable use, procurement and deployment.
• Maintain an accurate AI inventory. Ensure AI use cases, tools and products have current records of ownership, risk assessments, approvals and material changes.
• Connect teams and drive action. Act as a central point of contact across Product, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Cybersecurity and machine learning teams, helping resolve governance questions and track remediation through to completion.
• Demonstrate control effectiveness. Maintain clear evidence of how the AI governance process operates, monitor its effectiveness and prepare documentation and responses for internal assurance, auditors and regulatory bodies.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
About

the role:

Wise has always grown through product-led, self-serve channels. Now we're building something new: a dedicated sales function within Wise Business to help businesses understand, adopt and get the most out of Wise for their international financial needs.

As an Account Executive, you'll manage a high-volume pipeline of inbound leads generated through our website, marketing campaigns, events, referrals and partnerships. You'll be responsible for qualifying opportunities, running effective discovery calls, demonstrating the value of Wise Business and guiding customers through to successful activation.

This is a high-velocity, consultative B2B sales role, built around a structured, CRM-driven sales process. You'll need to be comfortable managing multiple opportunities at different stages, prioritising your time effectively and using data to drive conversion.

We're looking for someone who understands how a modern sales funnel works, enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and knows that closing a deal is only part of the journey. Success means bringing businesses onto Wise that actively transact and generate revenue, not simply getting them to sign up.

What you'll do:
• Manage and convert a high volume of inbound leads from our website, marketing campaigns, events, referrals and partnerships.
• Run structured discovery and qualification calls with business owners, finance leaders and operations teams, uncovering their challenges and identifying where Wise can add value.
• Apply consultative selling techniques and qualification frameworks such as SPICED to identify customer needs, build compelling business cases and progress opportunities.
• Build and present savings analyses that clearly demonstrate Wise's value compared with traditional banks and competitors.
• Own and manage your sales pipeline in Salesforce, maintaining accurate lead statuses, opportunity stages, activities, follow-ups and next steps.
• Manage approximately 80 leads per month, balancing new lead qualification with progressing and closing existing opportunities.
• Guide customers through sign-up, KYC and activation, working with internal teams to overcome blockers and ensure they start transacting.
• Work towards monthly and quarterly revenue and activation targets, with a focus on converting opportunities into customers who actively use Wise.
• Help develop and improve sales processes, playbooks and best practices, contributing to a growing sales function and future outbound sales initiatives.

jobs.title: Senior Growth CRM Specialist
jobs.description:
As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a Senior Growth CRM Specialist to own and elevate our Americas customer lifecycle strategy. 

Your Mission:

You will hold the vision for how we communicate with customers in Latin America. You will bridge the gap between our high-level CRM strategy and tactical execution, ensuring our customers receive the right message, at the right time, through the right channel.
• Mentorship: You will foster a culture of experimentation, autonomy, and continuous learning, helping your team grow their careers at Wise.
• Define the LatAm Strategy: You will own the end-to-end lifecycle strategy for our customers in LatAm. You will build sophisticated, automated journeys that drive activation, cross-sell and retention.
• Drive Commercial Impact: You will be responsible for key CRM metrics-improving conversion rates, reducing churn, and increasing lifetime value. You will use data to prove the value of your and your team’s work.
• Stakeholder Partnership: You will be the primary voice for LatAm CRM across the company. You will partner deeply with Product Managers, Product Marketing, Regional Leads, Analytics, and Creative teams to ensure our communications are aligned with product roadmaps and customer needs.

jobs.title: Customer Support Specialist (French Speaking)
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a French Speaking Customer Support Specialist to join our team in Tallinn. This role is a unique opportunity to apply your subject matter expertise to have a direct impact on Wise’s mission, ensuring a seamless experience for our customers globally.

Your mission: Wise has already pioneered new ways for people to transfer money across borders and currencies. As a Specialist, your mission is to act as a subject matter authority, navigating cross-functional complexities to deliver expert-level resolutions and world-class support across email, phone, and chat to ensure every interaction reflects our commitment to "money without borders."

Here’s how you’ll be contributing to the Customer Support team:
• Expert problem solving: Take full ownership of complex customer cases, using critical thinking to identify the best resolutions and delivering with high accuracy.
• Navigating complex interactions: Handle high-stakes customer conversations with professional and empathetic communication, especially during challenging moments.
• Cross-Team collaboration: Manage appropriate escalations to specialized teams, including KYC, Complaints, and Payment Operations, to ensure holistic case resolution.
• Peer support: Act as a point of contact for your colleagues, providing peer-to-peer support and sharing your knowledge to help the wider team grow.
• Process improvement: Identify and share feedback on processes and product health, contributing to the continuous improvement of the customer journey.
• Flexibility: Cover a variety of shifts to be there when our customers—and the business—need you most.

jobs.title: Senior Operations Solutions Specialist
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Operations Solutions Specialist to join our Global Product Operations (Acquiring) team to help build the world’s best experience for managing, moving, and accepting money.

The role is available in both locations: Budapest, Hungary or Tallinn, Estonia 

As a Senior Operations Solutions Specialist, your role will revolve around project management, with an emphasis on operationalising new products or features and improving existing operational processes connected to the Acquiring product domain, making sure that the processes scale well, are efficient and mitigate or minimise risks. You will take full ownership of projects, from initial scoping to final implementation. This includes assessing problem size and impact, creating rollout plans, collaborating across teams, conducting testing, and refining solutions. You will collaborate with various Wise functions (e.g. Product & Engineering, Risk, Compliance, Customer Support, Finance, Treasury etc) as you work to translate evolving customer and Servicing challenges into scalable, automated systems and processes.

 

In This Role, You'll Add To That Mission By
• Owning the operationalisation strategy and end-to-end delivery of complex products, initiatives or business-domain improvements.
• Defining domain roadmaps, priorities and success measures, balancing customer impact, operational risk, scalability and business objectives.
• Solving ambiguous, multi-stakeholder problems through advanced analysis, structured experimentation and close partnership with Product and operational teams.
• Designing scalable operating models, workflows and controls that anticipate risks early and eliminate material categories of manual work.
• Developing compelling and data-driven business cases, recommendations and strategic narratives that secure senior stakeholder alignment and remove delivery blockers.
• Managing multi-quarter initiatives with significant dependencies, maintaining delivery quality, transparency and operational stability.
• Setting strong practices within the domain, mentor colleagues and share reusable methods that improve product operationalisation across teams.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
We are hiring Business Operations Managers to lead high-impact operational domains across our core global product pillars:
• Money Movement: Powering the speed, reliability, and liquidity of how money moves across borders (Send, Spend, and Receive).
• Account & Onboarding: Designing zero-friction identity verification, onboarding pathways, and account management for millions of consumers and global enterprises.

As a BizOps Manager, you sit at the strategic nexus of Product, Operations, Analytics, and Go-To-Market teams. You are responsible for driving end-to-end operational strategy, removing customer friction, eliminating manual intervention, and ensuring our products scale efficiently as volume compounds.

During the interview process, we will evaluate your core operational and analytical toolkit, aligning you with the specific product domain that best matches your strengths and passions.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Drive Strategy & Execution: Owning the operational roadmap and unit economics for your domain, translating complex operational bottlenecks into clear, multi-quarter strategic programs.
• Bridge Product & Operations: Partnering directly with Product Managers, Engineers, and Servicing Leads to shape product features early, building operational readiness into launches, and eliminating root causes of customer contact and manual defects.
• Optimize Unit Economics & Scalability: Identifying and eliminating operational waste (e.g., manual reviews, third-party vendor costs, unnecessary operational handoffs), ensuring transaction growth does not require linear operational headcount growth.
• Customer Journey & Defect Reduction: Uncovering friction points in the end-to-end customer journey — from onboarding drops to payment delays — using customer insights and front-line feedback to champion UX and process improvements.
• Independent Data Analysis: Querying large-scale datasets, building dashboards, and tracking balanced success metrics (e.g., Conversion vs. Operational Cost vs. Compliance Risk) to back every initiative with rigorous quantitative evidence.
• Lead Through Influence: Aligning cross-functional stakeholders across global offices without direct authority, establishing clear operating rhythms and driving change management across diverse teams.

jobs.title: Payroll Specialist (Fixed Term Contract - 12 Months)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a payroll superstar to join our global team for a 12-month fixed term, with a specialized focus on our Estonia-based Wisers. Bringing a strong understanding of EMEA payroll functions, you’ll ensure accurate, effective, and timely processing - playing a key role in driving our culture and scaling our payroll model as we grow.

You’ll join a Global Payroll Team of 8 specialists (5 based in Estonia and 3 in Budapest) managing payroll across 25+ locations worldwide using Workday and CloudPay.

What You’ll Be Doing:
• End-to-End Payroll Operations: Partner with the wider Global Payroll Team to service 25+ countries using Workday (HRIS), focusing specifically on our EMEA and Estonia-based Wisers.
• Data Accuracy & Submissions: Prepare, review, cross-check, and analyze payroll inputs against strict deadlines, taking full ownership of timely submissions to our third-party payroll provider and ensuring payrolls always balance to inputs.
• Process Improvement & Documentation: Collaborate with your Payroll Lead to recommend new approaches, policies, and procedures for continuous improvement, while maintaining thorough documentation across all historical payroll files.
• Subject Matter Expertise: Deepen your expertise in local payroll and legislative matters for your allocated locations, supporting teammates with knowledge-sharing and additional transaction processing when needed.

Compliance:
• Legislative Alignment: Ensure full compliance with local payroll tax laws and regulatory deadlines, proactively tracking regulation changes to maintain accuracy and great service for our Wisers.
• Regulatory Inquiries: Partner with internal and external stakeholders to complete and respond to regulatory agency inquiries.

Financials, Audits, and Reporting:
• Financial Outputs: Take ownership of key payroll outputs, including payroll journals, General Ledger (GL) files, and ad-hoc reports.
• Timely Delivery: Ensure all financial reporting and payroll data are completed accurately and on schedule.

jobs.title: Senior Business Development Manager - Nordics
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced and entrepreneurial Senior Business Development Manager to join our Wise Platform team. In this role, you will take full commercial ownership of driving our growth with financial institutions and banks across the Nordics (Sweden, Denmark, Finland, and Norway). 

Wise Platform has already launched a transformational flagship partnership with Lunar Bank, which has piqued the interest of major regional institutions. You will help deliver world-class payment solutions to some of the largest banks, traditional financial institutions, and fast-growing fintechs—powered by Wise’s cutting-edge infrastructure.

A Bit About the Role

Ideally based in our London office, you will sit at the heart of our commercial engine while maintaining the flexibility for a remote structure depending on setup and experience. In this role, you will:
• Shape the Market Strategy: Act as the strategic bridge between Nordic bank and enterprise clients and our product teams. Your insights into the needs of the local market will directly steer our product roadmap and regional expansion strategy.
• Unlock Nordic Scale: Take end-to-end responsibility for mapping, pitching, negotiating, and closing partnerships across Tier 1 retail and corporate banks, as well as challenger banks in Sweden, Denmark, Finland, and Norway.

jobs.title: Market Abuse and Operations Delivery Specialist
jobs.description:
Wise is expanding its Assets product into stocks and ETFs. 

We’re looking for a Market Abuse and Operations Delivery Specialist to help run day-to-day trading operations for Wise Assets and perform first-line surveillance and investigation of market abuse alerts.

In this role, you will bridge day-to-day trade trading flow operations and market abuse surveillance. You’ll manage assigned operational workflows and review market abuse alerts using agreed procedures, escalating exceptions and complex cases to senior colleagues.

Working closely with Senior Delivery Specialists, Market Abuse Specialists, and second-line Compliance, you will help maintain effective controls by flagging recurring issues and suggesting practical runbook improvements as product volume grows.

What you’ll be doing

Market Abuse Coverage
• Support the Market Abuse Operations Specialist with regular monitoring and assigned alert reviews.
• Review trading activity and supporting evidence using agreed runbooks, determine whether alerts can be closed or require further review.
• Record the evidence reviewed and your rationale for closing or escalating each alert.
• Escalate potential concerns, complex cases and unclear findings to the specialist, senior colleagues or second-line Compliance through agreed channels.

Core Operations Delivery
• Execute core operational tasks associated with the trade flow life cycle and customer offboarding in line with documented SOPs, SLAs and quality standards.
• Use operational tools, dashboards and reports to investigate routine issues and support incident resolution
• Manage your assigned workload within agreed guidance, provide clear handovers for outstanding alerts and raise capacity or delivery concerns early.
• Identify and flag recurring issues, suggest practical workflow or runbook improvements.

jobs.title: General Accounting Senior Lead (Product accounting & Journaling)
jobs.description:
Join our FINANCE team and help navigate us through a critical transformation

The Finance team is critical in supporting the Wise mission. As we continue to scale globally and evolve our Finance operations, we need to ensure our core accounting processes are best-in-class, automated and robustly controlled.

We’re looking for a SENIOR GENERAL ACCOUNTING LEAD to join us in Tallinn!

You will play a pivotal role in ensuring financial excellence, compliance, and operational efficiency. This role offers the chance to drive automation, process optimization, and build strong internal controls. In this role, you will lead teams responsible for product-related accounting and journaling processes. You will drive operational efficiency, strengthen controls, optimize workflows, and foster a culture of continuous improvement in a fast-paced environment. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and are passionate about financial leadership, we welcome you to apply.

Your mission:
• Drive Process Optimization & Automation: Partner cross-functionally with other accounting teams, Product, Treasury, Engineering, and Finance Implementation teams to eliminate operational bottlenecks, automate manual tasks, and enhance system integrations. Drive automation through enhancements across multiple finance systems (including ERP) to maximize efficiency and transaction accuracy.
• Strengthen Internal Controls & Compliance: Own and refine operational controls across relevant accounting areas. Ensure strict compliance with group policies, internal audit standards, regulatory frameworks (SOX), and financial reporting standards (IFRS and US GAAP).
• Standardize Product Accounting Procedures: Oversee the streamlining of accounting for Wise products in a multi-currency, multi-entity global structure.
• Build & Lead Journaling Team: Build and lead a newly established journaling team, establishing core processes and ensuring proper journaling of transactions across finance ledgers.
• Support Business as Usual (BAU): Actively participate in day-to-day accounting operations, including performing reviews of the workings of the immediate team and directly assisting with month-end close activities.
• Manage External Audit Relationships: Serve as the primary Product Accounting point of contact for external auditors and key stakeholders.
• Lead & Scale Accounting Teams: Direct and coach other team leads overseeing product accounting and journaling processes. Manage resource allocation, performance, hiring, and talent development while fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
• Engage Key Stakeholders: Build strong relationships with internal partners across Finance, Legal, and Product.
• Establish Operational KPIs & Quality Metrics: Define, monitor, and deliver on SLAs and KPIs to accelerate month-end close speed, elevate accounting quality, and maintain balance sheet accuracy.

jobs.title: Regulatory Compliance Manager
jobs.description:
Since 2011, we’ve had a clear mission: Money without Borders. Built by and for people who live global lives, we’re the fairest, easiest way to manage your money across borders.

We’re just at the beginning of our story and we’re growing at an incredible pace. We won’t stop until anyone, anywhere can send, spend and receive money wherever they are, whatever they’re doing. There’s still heaps to do and we can’t do it alone.

We’re looking for a Regulatory Compliance Manager to join our growing Compliance Team. Your primary role will be to help manage our Australian Financial Services Licences (AFSL) across our two Australian entities covering both payments and investments while supporting cross-border marketing compliance in New Zealand. You will also play a hands-on role in supporting new product launches, offering a huge scope to grow your remit and progress within the team.

You’ll be primarily responsible for:
• Maintaining our AFSL, including having primary oversight of procedures and processes to meet all our Australian Financial Services Licence (AFSL) obligations and the key contact for the Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC).
• Providing Regulatory Compliance guidance specifically in respect to our AFSL and Corporations Act obligations to all functional areas of the Pacific tribe to empower the tribe to implement new products that meet our regulatory requirements.
• Building upon our existing horizon scanning and regulatory change management program, ensuring effective communications of regulatory changes to the business as well as timely implementations in line with our mission.
• Enhance our regulatory compliance control framework for growth in the Pacific, including enhancement of the regulatory risk (non financial crime) measurement and monitoring tools, preparing management information for reporting to the local Risk Committee and Board.
• Regulatory training based on needs assessment with areas carrying concentrated regulatory risk, and created for functional teams.

jobs.title: HR Operations Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for a resilient, hands-on People Operations Lead to join our growing hub in Hyderabad.

This is a pivotal leadership role at the intersection of local execution, regional scale, and global transformation. As we actively build out our Shared Services model, you will lead a hybrid team managing both Tier 1 queues and Tier 2 People Operations across APAC. APAC operates in a hybrid model where Tier 2 activities are managed in a regional ecosystem together with other teams in APAC, and Tier 1 activities are managed in a global ecosystem in partnership with Budapest and Sao Paolo.

Because our operating model is actively evolving, this role requires high energy, grit, and a genuine appetite for building from the ground up. You will balance day-to-day operational intensity with the strategic opportunity to shape how our team and processes look in the future.

Your mission is to lead and scale People Operations across India with speed, sound judgment, and relentless ownership. You will lead a team that ensures a seamless, compliant, and customer-centric Wiser experience across the entire employee lifecycle. Operating in a high-volume, rapidly shifting environment, you will roll up your sleeves to solve immediate operational bottlenecks while partnering with regional and global leads to design, automate, and evolve our Shared Services footprint for the future. 

Key

Responsibilities:
• Lead a Hybrid Tier 1 & Tier 2 Regional Team: Manage, coach, and upskill a diverse team of Tier 1 and Tier 2 Specialists based in Hyderabad, balancing immediate queue/SLA management with complex regional case resolution across APAC.
• Build and Evolve Our Shared Services Footprint: Play a critical role in standing up and scaling Wise’s Shared Services model. Identify tasks for centralisation, manage smooth transitions, and partner with regional leadership to continuously refine team structure, workflows, and capacity as the function matures.
• Bridge Regional and Global Alignment: Report directly into regional People Operations leadership while collaborating closely (via a dotted line) with the Global Tier 1 Lead to ensure APAC stays aligned with global processes, service standards, and tooling updates.
• Drive Operational Excellence & Automation: Champion a working smart mindset. Use queue metrics, ticket trends, and Wiser feedback to eliminate manual work, streamline workflows, and automate repetitive tasks.
• Ensure Multi-Market Compliance: Maintain strict adherence to diverse labour, immigration, payroll, and financial services regulations across India and broader APAC markets, proactively updating local SOPs as regulations or business needs shift.
• Set Performance Standards & Succession Plans: Define clear KPIs, OKRs, and aspirational development goals for your specialists to build high-performing, resilient teams with strong internal growth pathways.
• Use Data to Influence Stakeholders: Collate operational data and trends to partner effectively with People Partners (HRBPs) and senior business leaders, providing actionable insights during bi-annual planning cycles and day-to-day decision-making.
• Embrace Scope & Fluidity: Step directly into complex escalations or operational gaps when volume spikes, adapting your scope as the team scales and organisational priorities shift.

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Work in a fast growing and innovative People team within a thriving business.
• Contribute towards the bi-annual planning cycles, collate data on project deliverables, share ideas for improvements and lead new projects.
• Create continuous improvement within the team: partner with your global team to recommend new approaches and changes in policy and procedures, co-creating solutions with a global and mass customization outlook.
• Maximise advisory impact and partnership: collaborate with the People Partners (HRBPs) and senior stakeholders to share advisory data and trends to drive empowered and inclusive stakeholder relationships.

jobs.title: Senior Business Recruiter
jobs.description:
Wise is looking for a Senior Recruiter based in Hyderabad to help hire best-fit talent for Wise's business and GTM teams in India and beyond. You’ll own the end-to-end recruitment process as a trusted advisor and talent partner to your stakeholders, which will help our business to scale to enable Wise to achieve our mission - money without borders. 

Your mission:
• Identify and recruit best-fit talent for Wise's business and GTM teams in APAC - with a specific focus on the People, Marketing, Legal, Finance and Government Relations teams in Hyderabad.
• Lead end-to-end recruitment as the primary touch point for all future Wisers from sourcing outreach through each step of the interview process and to offer negotiations.
• Provide exceptional candidate experience that alings with Wise values and build a strong talent network locally and internationally.
• Become your hiring stakeholders' trusted advisor and talent partner. Develop relationships with with hiring teams, guide them through processes, share best practices and talent insights.
• Use data to support your hiring recommendations, as well as using it to retro processes, figure out the blockers to hiring, communicate how these can be overcome and continually optimise the process to make sure it is globally scalable.
• Drive hiring objectives and initiatives (e.g. referral programs, talent mapping, salary benchmarking, etc) through partnership and collaboration with wider People teams (e.g. People Operations) and Global TA teams, to support various initiatives.

jobs.title: Legal Counsel APAC
jobs.description:
About the role

Wise is expanding rapidly across APAC, the Middle East and beyond, and we're looking for a lawyer to join our legal team. You'll work with a high degree of autonomy, advising business teams on the moments that define our growth: launching in new markets, securing licences, and building the partnerships that make moving money instant, convenient, transparent and eventually free.

What you'll do
• Partner with Product, Expansion and other business teams across APAC (Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia, New Zealand, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Japan and beyond) and the Middle East, giving practical, risk-based advice that helps them move quickly and confidently
• Lead legal work on new market entry and new products, from initial concept through to launch
• Advise on financial regulation, support licence applications, and help build constructive relationships with regulators
• Structure, draft and negotiate commercial agreements with banks, payment partners, customers and suppliers
• Keep on top of legal and regulatory developments across our markets, and turn them into clear guidance and forward-looking recommendations
• Collaborate with colleagues across our global Legal team on company-wide priorities

Why this role
• Define your path to success - you’ll have the freedom and responsibility to help shape what is needed and then make it happen
• Build something for the future - we are continuing to grow rapidly and your work will be crucial in growing and maturing one of the companies of our time
• Your ideas count. We want your knowledge and your self-starting attitude

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Global Markets Operations
jobs.description:
Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

 

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

 

 

Your Mission:

Bitpanda is looking for a lawyer to take the helm of Bitpanda Broker MENA, our VARA-licensed virtual asset brokerage in Dubai. In this dual leadership and hands-on legal role, you will serve as the principal executive on site, overseeing business operations, growth, and governance while acting as primary point of contact with VARA, the Board, and Group functions. Because regulatory judgment is the foundation of a licensed digital asset business, you will combine strategic leadership with daily, pragmatic legal execution to keep our local operations compliant, agile, and built for sustainable growth across the UAE and MENA.

What You’ll Do
• Lead the Entity Regulator Relationships: Act as the senior executive and main point of contact with the wider Group, VARA and UAE authorities, leading business initiatives, supervisory engagements, licence variations, product approvals, and Board governance.
• Drive Compliant Business Operations: Oversee day-to-day brokerage operations, client onboarding, and local strategy while advising the team on UAE commercial, employment, and data protection laws.
• Draft Negotiate Key Agreements: Lead hands-on contract drafting and negotiation for critical local partnerships, including banking, custody, liquidity providers, outsourcing, marketing, and intra-group arrangements.
• Champion Risk Integrity: Partner closely with the Compliance Officer and MLRO to maintain strong AML/CFT, sanctions, operational risk, and consumer protection frameworks.
• Grow Regional Partnerships: Build trusted senior relationships with regulators, banks, custodians, and industry partners across the UAE and GCC while developing the local team.

Who You Are
• Qualified Legal Professional: You hold a law degree from a UAE, UK, or common-law jurisdiction (qualified/admitted lawyer strongly preferred) with 5–7+ years of PQE in corporate and regulatory matters at a top law firm, VASP, financial institution, or regulator.
• UAE Regulatory Specialist: You bring deep working knowledge of VARA rulebooks (and familiarity with ADGM FSRA, DFSA, or CBUAE frameworks), alongside solid AML/CFT and financial crime prevention expertise (Arabic is a strong advantage).
• Hands-On Commercial Negotiator: You have proven experience drafting complex commercial and financial agreements, managing corporate governance, and translating dense regulations into clear business actions.
• VARA "Fit Proper" Leader: You possess the integrity, executive presence, and spotless regulatory track record required to obtain VARA approval as a Managing Director / Responsible Individual.
• Trusted Advisor Stakeholder Manager: You possess strong board-level communication skills and the credibility to influence regulators, banking partners, and internal leadership across multiple jurisdictions.

 

What’s in it for you
• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
• Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
• Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.

• Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
• Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
• Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.

• Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
• Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

 .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

 

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.
