jobs.title: Partner Account Manager
jobs.description:
About us:

Branch is on a mission to empower workers with financial freedom. We do this by helping companies accelerate payments and providing working Americans with accessible, free financial services. We’re committed to building and delivering more inclusive, transparent, and frictionless financial products.

Our goal of empowerment extends to our own employees, too. Have a great idea? Share it today and it might just get implemented tomorrow. As a member of our team, your voice and creativity matter—and they can directly impact our products, company, and culture. 

We not only focus on attracting great talent from across the country, but also on building teams that help that talent thrive. That means valuing a diversity of opinions and working styles, while creating a shared belief in innovation, initiative, and winning together.

Come join our team as we develop new ways to improve the lives of working Americans.

About

the role:

Branch is a workforce payments platform that helps employers pay their people faster and more flexibly, including earned wage access, digital pay cards, and tip payouts. Much of how we reach customers runs through partners: the payroll, HR, and workforce management systems employers already use, the point-of-sale platforms and resellers that serve hospitality, the technology providers and consultants that serve banks and credit unions, and the referral partners that send us warm introductions.

The Partner Account Manager owns Branch's partnership strategy and the partner relationships behind it. You decide where partners can create the most value for Branch, build the plan to get there, and run the day-to-day relationships that turn partners into pipeline and revenue. This is a builder's role: you will set direction, open new channels, deepen the partnerships we already have, and put the operations in place to track and pay partners properly. You will work closely with Sales, Product, Integrations, Marketing, Legal, and Finance to get it done.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
• Own the partnership strategy: define where Branch should play, build the roadmap, and earn leadership buy-in
• Turn strategy into a working plan: target lists by channel, outreach materials, outbound sequences, and activity goals tied to pipeline
• Open new partner channels, including reseller networks and banking consultancies, for co-selling, lead generation, and co-marketing
• Serve as the primary contact for a portfolio of revenue-generating partners, building relationships beyond technical contacts into each partner's alliances and partnerships leadership
• Grow partners from referral relationships into integrated and go-to-market aligned partnerships, and introduce them to the full Branch product line
• Own the business relationship with the payroll, HR, and point-of-sale platforms Branch integrates with, so new integrations get built and existing ones stay reliable
• Lead account planning and quarterly business reviews with key partners, covering performance, pipeline, and risk
• Analyze Branch's partner and integration coverage against competitors and recommend where to invest
• Keep partner pipeline, activity, and performance current in HubSpot, report partner-sourced pipeline monthly, and make sure partner commissions and revenue share are paid accurately and on time

Qualifications (required):
• 3+ years in partnerships, channel, alliances, or partner account management at a B2B SaaS or fintech company
• Experience building or significantly expanding a partner channel or program, with a track record of partner-sourced pipeline and revenue
• Familiarity with payroll, HR technology, workforce management, or point-of-sale ecosystems; experience with earned wage access, payments, or banking partnerships is a plus
• Ability to negotiate commercial agreements and manage complex, multi-stakeholder relationships
• Strong communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to work with senior executives at partner organizations
• A data-driven approach: comfortable setting targets, measuring against them, and recommending where to stop investing
• Working knowledge of CRM and PRM tools (HubSpot/Euler or similar)
• Comfort with ambiguity and a fast-moving, high-growth environment

Compensation:

The base salary range for this role is $100-110k, plus a commissions component. The salary range displayed reflects an average base salary range for the position across all the U.S. The base salary offered to an applicant could be higher or lower based on each applicant's specific skill set, depth of experience, relevant education or training, etc.

Location:

This position is classified as REMOTE within the United States of America.

We are unable to hire candidates located outside of the domestic U.S.

Benefits:
• Market-leading medical, dental, and vision insurance
• Stock options
• Free Premium-Tier Origin Financial Wellness subscription
• Monthly home-office stipend
• 401k (TransAmerica)
• 12-weeks paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents
• Flexible time off + sick and safe time
• 11 paid company holidays
• Branch@Branch Same Day Pay Option

Identity Verification

As part of our application process, you'll receive a separate email from Greenhouse shortly containing a unique identity verification link. This step, powered by Persona, helps us confirm applicant identities and keep our hiring process secure for everyone. 

Upon identity verification, all biometric data is deleted. If you need support completing this application, please reach out to Careers@branchapp.com

Working at Branch

A remote-first company with employees located throughout the U.S., Branch emphasizes transparency, accountability, and trust to create a collaborative environment where our product, engineering, marketing, customer support, customer success, and sales teams can all thrive together. Learn more about what we do in this video!

Our collaborative spirit has helped us become an award-winning FinTech company, with Branch’s innovation and workplace recognized across industries. Branch has been honored by Inc., the Webby Awards, Benzinga FinTech Awards, FinTech Breakthrough Awards, Top Workplaces USA, Great Places to Work, and EY Entrepreneur of the Year, Heartland, among others. 

Learn more about our culture, approach, technology, and people here: https://www.branchapp.com/about

 

Branch is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Must be currently authorized to work in the USA without sponsorship or transfer.

No third-parties, please.

View how Branch collects your personal data here.

jobs.title: Credit Policy & Governance Associate
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Operations at Brex 

Operations is the backbone of Brex’s mission to power businesses through our Intelligent Finance Platform. We own credit, fraud, money movement, and payments, protecting our customers and our company. From product operations that ensure flawless launches to scalable systems that drive innovation and precision, we operate at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and customer success. If you want to work at the heart of the business, Operations is where you belong.

What you'll do

As an Associate, you will own credit policy and governance projects from analysis through recommendation and cross-functional implementation. You will be trusted to take a complex, loosely defined problem, decide how to approach it, and drive it to a result with light guidance from the team lead.

Your center of gravity is governance and policy. You will operate and improve Brex's credit governance framework: keeping policies, procedures, and exception monitoring current and well documented, and owning the recurring reporting that goes to second-line and enterprise risk functions, including Capital One. You will also manage policy and compliance requests from our bank partners (Fifth Third and Emigrant) and help keep those relationships in good standing through our acquisition transition.

Alongside that core, you will lead pieces of the team's risk appetite and provisioning work and the governance of our highest-balance, highest-exposure accounts. This is an internal-facing analytical and governance role: you will not be underwriting individual customers or working directly with Sales. It is a strong opportunity for someone who wants to grow toward owning a broader area of credit policy and governance in a newly regulated environment.

Where you'll work

This role will be based in our Seattle office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Own the credit policy, procedure, and exception monitoring cadence, and the regular reporting to second-line risk functions, with minimal oversight.
• Draft and maintain credit policy documentation: write clear, well-supported recommendations, update policies based on performance data, and document changes ahead of implementation.
• Drive policy changes through implementation: define tooling requirements with Engineering, assess operational impact and develop SOPs with Underwriting, and build buy-in before rollout.
• Develop and document the team's risk appetite statement, including the analysis behind loss rate targets, concentration limits, and product-level exposure caps.
• Lead governance and risk detection for the portfolio's highest-risk, highest-exposure accounts, and contribute to the provisioning methodology for these accounts.
• Build and maintain Hex dashboards that surface credit portfolio metrics and policy performance, and use them to identify issues and propose action.
• Track and report on key credit metrics such as approval rates, loss rates, utilization, and limit adequacy across segments and policy cohorts, and translate findings into recommendations.
• Prepare portfolio reporting, policy review materials, and model governance documentation for second-line and enterprise risk functions.
• Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for bank partner policy requirements and associated compliance reporting.
• Contribute to credit frameworks for new embedded partnerships and customer segments, including the analysis and monitoring infrastructure needed to evaluate new channels as they launch.
• Proactively build cross-functional relationships with Risk, Compliance, Data, Product, and Engineering to unblock work, and communicate findings and trade-offs at different levels, from analysts to senior leadership.

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or analytical field such as economics, statistics, mathematics, finance, or a related discipline.
• 2 to 3 years of experience in credit risk, policy, audit, strategy, or a related analytical function.
• Strong SQL

skills:

you can independently pull, clean, and analyze large datasets to answer open-ended business questions.
• Demonstrated ability to solve complex, multi-variable problems and exercise judgment on method and solution, not just execute a defined analysis.
• Ability to understand what a credit policy is trying to accomplish and to design how you would measure whether it is working.
• Track record of delivering projects independently, managing stakeholder expectations, and explaining resource needs in terms of business impact.
• Experience working cross-functionally to drive a project to implementation, including partnering with Engineers and operational teams.
• Strong attention to detail and analytical rigor, with a habit of checking your own work before sharing it.
• Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to summarize a complex analysis for a non-technical audience.
• Collaborative working style; this role sits at the intersection of several teams and requires someone who builds trust quickly and follows through.

Bonus Points
• Direct experience with bank partner, regulatory, or second-line reporting and compliance requests.
• Familiarity with governance frameworks, policy documentation, exception monitoring, or audit remediation.
• Familiarity with credit risk concepts: how lenders think about approval rates, loss rates, and limit-setting while balancing customer experience.
• Prior experience in a credit, risk, or strategy adjacent function at Brex or a similar fintech.
• Experience with Hex or similar BI/analytics tools.
• Experience developing agentic workflows.

Compensation: 

The expected salary range for this role is USD 111,000 - 138,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.title: Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager, Customer
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Marketing at Brex

Marketing tells the story of Brex to the world. From acquisition to activation, we translate product value into business results. Our team spans Revenue, Product, and Brand Marketing, and works closely with nearly every function at Brex. We move fast, experiment often, and think deeply about customer behavior. If you want your creativity to drive growth and shape perception, this is the place.

What you’ll do

As a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager, you will own how Brex grows revenue within its existing customer base. You’ll lead the strategy and execution for specific areas of the customer journey like onboarding, expansion, rewards, and offers programs, etc: getting customers to set up their accounts, adopt additional products, activate and engage with rewards, and take advantage of the right offers at the right time. You’ll design programs across email, in-product, and other owned channels, and you’ll be accountable for incremental impact on adoption, retention, and revenue, not just engagement metrics. You’ll bring a strong point of view on what to test, what to scale, and what to stop.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Seattle office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Own the strategy and roadmap for existing-customer lifecycle, including account set up, cross-sell and upsell, feature and product adoption, rewards activation and engagement, and partner and promotional offers.
• Build segmentation and trigger logic grounded in customer behavior, spend patterns, product usage, and account attributes so each customer receives the most relevant message, offer, or next best action.
• Design and orchestrate multi-channel programs across email, in-product, push, and other owned channels, with clear rules for frequency, suppression, and channel priority.
• Design measurement for incrementality, including holdouts and controlled experiments, and report on lift in adoption, retention, and revenue rather than opens and clicks.
• Run a disciplined experimentation program across audiences, offers, timing, and creative to identify the levers that drive incremental growth, and scale what works.
• Partner with Product, Product Marketing, Rewards/Partnerships, Finance, and Data to define offer strategy, eligibility, economics, and launch timing for new features, rewards, and promotions.
• Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Account Management so lifecycle programs complement human-led expansion motions, with clear handoffs, shared signals, and no conflicting outreach.
• Work with Product Marketing and Design to craft creative briefs and messaging that translate product value into clear customer benefits.
• Manage prioritization of incoming requests across stakeholders, and clearly communicate tradeoffs and timelines.
• Monitor program performance and share regular readouts with the team and leadership, translating insights into recommendations and next steps.
• Maintain strong governance over compliance, deliverability, and data hygiene in partnership with Legal, Compliance, and Marketing Ops, especially for offers and rewards communications.
• Mentor and provide guidance to more junior team members, and contribute to team best practices.

Requirements
• 6+ years of marketing experience, with significant experience in lifecycle, CRM, or retention marketing.
• Proven track record of building and scaling lifecycle programs across multiple channels that drove measurable incremental impact on expansion, adoption, retention, or revenue.
• Hands-on experience with customer marketing for existing customers, such as cross-sell/upsell, loyalty, rewards, or promotional offers programs.
• Strong grounding in segmentation, trigger design, and orchestration, beyond batch-and-blast email.
• Experience designing and interpreting experiments, including holdouts and incrementality testing; comfortable pushing back on vanity metrics.
• Strong analytical skills; comfortable querying and interpreting data with tools such as SQL, Looker, or similar BI tools.
• Ability to ruthlessly prioritize among multiple projects and timelines.
• Ability to build trusted cross-functional relationships and manage stakeholders at all levels, including Product, Sales, and Finance.
• Strong organizational, writing, and communication skills.

Bonus points
• Experience in fintech, payments, B2B SaaS, or other financial services with regulated marketing communications.
• Experience with rewards, loyalty, or partner-funded offer programs, including offer economics and ROI.
• Experience with our tools: Looker, Marketo, Salesforce, Hex, Knak.
• Experience with in-product messaging and customer data platforms.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $131,000 - $188,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.location: Chicago, IL, USA; New York, NY, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA
jobs.description:
About the role 

We are hiring an Associate on Chime’s Compliance Assurance Testing team. You will assess Chime’s compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies by performing independent testing of our products, services, and processes.
In this role, you will own assigned compliance reviews or testing workstreams from planning through reporting and follow-up. You will exercise independent judgment to identify compliance risks and control gaps, work directly with cross-functional teams, and communicate findings and recommendations. You will also coordinate with our bank partners’ legal and compliance teams as needed. This role will report to the Head of Compliance Assurance Testing.

In this role, you can expect to
• Own the execution of assigned compliance reviews or testing workstreams, including developing test plans, managing timelines, performing testing, and delivering well-supported conclusions.
• Assess compliance with applicable consumer financial protection laws and regulations, including the Truth in Lending Act (Regulation Z), Electronic Fund Transfer Act (Regulation E), Truth in Savings Act (Regulation DD), prohibitions on Unfair, Deceptive, or Abusive Acts or Practices (UDAAP), and applicable state requirements.
• Define the testing approach for assigned areas by researching regulatory requirements, conducting process walkthroughs, identifying key risks and controls, and developing test steps in alignment with the team’s methodology.
• Analyze data, evaluate supporting evidence, and document testing procedures and conclusions in clear, well-supported workpapers.
• Investigate testing exceptions and control gaps, assess root causes and potential impact, and prepare findings and recommendations for review and discussion with business teams.
• Manage follow-up on assigned findings and perform remediation validation testing to assess whether corrective actions address identified issues.
• Serve as the primary testing contact for assigned areas, coordinating documentation requests, resolving testing questions, and communicating progress and results. Coordinate assigned bank partner compliance review requests.
• Take responsibility for assigned improvements to testing procedures, tools, or reporting, including opportunities to use data analytics and AI automation.
• Maintain current knowledge of applicable laws and regulations and assess their relevance to Chime’s products, services, and testing activities.

To thrive in this role, you have
• 2–5 years of relevant experience in compliance testing, internal audit, risk consulting, or a related role within financial services or fintech.
• Knowledge of consumer financial protection laws and regulations, with demonstrated experience applying regulatory requirements to testing or control assessments.
• Experience reviewing documentation, analyzing data, identifying exceptions, and documenting conclusions.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to investigate discrepancies and draw well-supported conclusions.
• Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate with stakeholders across teams.
• The ability to take ownership of deliverables, work independently, manage competing priorities, and exercise sound judgment in evaluating and escalating compliance concerns.
• Comfort working through ambiguity and adapting to changing priorities.
• Experience with data analytics, automation, or AI tools is a plus.

We're hiring a Lead Recruiter to help Chime hire exceptional engineers. You'll join the Talent team and partner closely with engineering leaders and hiring teams to run thoughtful, high-quality technical searches from intake through close. You'll own the full recruiting lifecycle for hard-to-fill engineering roles, set the bar for candidate experience, and help shape how we use AI and new tools to hire better and faster as Chime grows.

In this role, you can expect to
• You'll own full-cycle recruiting for engineering and other technical roles, from intake and sourcing through offer and close
• You'll partner with engineering leaders to define what each team needs, calibrate on the bar, and keep searches moving
• You'll build strong pipelines through proactive sourcing and creative outreach to hard-to-find technical talent
• You'll run structured, efficient interview processes and keep hiring teams aligned on feedback and decisions
• You'll deliver a thoughtful, high-quality experience for every candidate, from first conversation through offer
• You'll track pipeline health and recruiting metrics, and use them to flag risks and adjust strategy early
• You'll find ways to improve recruiting workflows and test emerging tools, including AI-enabled recruiting technology

To thrive in this role, you have
• Deep full-cycle technical recruiting experience, including owning senior or hard-to-fill engineering searches end to end
• A track record of building trusted partnerships with engineering hiring managers and leaders
• Working knowledge of engineering roles, languages and tech stacks, enough to assess talent and hold credible conversations with candidates
• Strong sourcing skills across multiple channels, with examples of pipelines you built from scratch
• Clear communication and strong closing skills, including navigating competing offers and leveling conversations
• Comfort with recruiting data: you use pipeline metrics to make decisions and keep stakeholders informed
• Curiosity about new recruiting technology, with hands-on experience experimenting with AI recruiting tools

#LI-Onsite #LI-AM1

Wage Notice

$130,000 $180,000 USD

A little about us

At Chime, we believe that everyone can achieve financial progress. We created Chime—a financial technology company, not a bank*—on the premise that core banking services should be helpful, easy, and free. Through our user-friendly tools and intuitive platforms, we empower our members to take control of their finances and work towards their goals. Whether it's starting a savings account, purchasing a first car or home, launching a business, or pursuing higher education, we're proud to have helped millions unlock their financial potential.

We're a team of problem solvers, dreamers, and builders with one shared obsession: our members. From day one, Chimers have worked tirelessly to out-hustle and out-execute competitors to bring our mission to life. Their grit and determination inspire us to work harder every day to deliver the very best experience possible. We each bring an owner's mindset to our work, refusing to be outdone and holding ourselves accountable to meet and exceed the highest bars for our teams, our company, and our members.

We believe in being bold, dreaming big, and taking risks, while also working together, embracing our diverse perspectives, and giving each other honest feedback. Our culture remains deeply entrepreneurial, encouraging every Chimer to see themselves as stewards of our mission to help everyday Americans unlock their financial progress. 

We know that to achieve our mission, we must earn and keep people's trust—so we hold ourselves to the highest standards of integrity in everything we do. These aren't just words on a wall—our values are embedded in every aspect of our business, serving as a north star that guides us as we work to help millions achieve their financial potential.

• 🏢 Our in-office work policy is designed to keep you connected - with four days a week in the office and Fridays from home for those near one of our offices, plus team and company-wide events depending on location.
• 💻 Benefits that support your work and life, including backup child, elder, and pet care and subsidized commuter benefits for eligible employees.
• ✨ Comprehensive health, financial, and wellbeing benefits designed to support you at every stage of life.
• 🏝 Generous vacation policy and company-wide paid days off
• 🫂 1% of your time off to support local community organizations of your choice
• 👟 Annual wellness stipend to use towards eligible wellness related expenses
• 👶 Up to 22 weeks of paid parental leave for birthing parents and 12 weeks of paid parental leave for non-birthing parents
• 👪 Access to family planning reimbursement
• 💚 A challenging and fulfilling opportunity to join one of the most experienced teams in FinTech and help millions unlock financial progress

 

We know that great work can’t be done without a diverse team and inclusive environment. That’s why we specifically look for individuals of varying strengths, skills, backgrounds, and ideas to join our team. We believe this gives us a competitive advantage to better serve our members and helps us all grow as Chimers and individuals.

jobs.description:
About the Role

Chime is seeking a Program Manager to join our Strategic Operations and Transformation Office (SOTO) within the Operations and Member Experience (OMX) organization. Our team is responsible for leading OMX's highest-priority strategic initiatives that advance the organization's key results while supporting Chime's broader business objectives.

As a Program Manager, you'll act as a "GM for hire"—partnering directly with executive program owners and cross-functional leaders to drive a rotating portfolio of mission-critical initiatives selected by senior leadership. You'll bring structure to ambiguity, connect teams around shared goals, and lead complex programs from strategy through execution, ensuring meaningful business outcomes while continuously improving how work gets done.

You'll work closely with teams across OMX and collaborate with partners across Product, Engineering, Risk, Compliance, Marketing, Analytics, Legal, and other organizations to solve complex operational challenges. Beyond delivering programs, you'll identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and scalable operating practices that reduce manual effort, increase organizational capacity, and enable teams to focus on the highest-value work.

If you thrive in fast-moving environments, enjoy solving complex problems, and have a track record of leading cross-functional initiatives that create lasting business impact, you'll find a unique opportunity to help shape the future of how OMX operates and delivers for Chime's members.

In this role, you can expect to
• Lead end-to-end ownership of OMX's highest-priority strategic initiatives, delivering measurable business impact through exceptional program leadership.
• Bring structure to ambiguity by developing clear execution plans, aligning stakeholders, and driving complex initiatives from strategy through delivery with minimal oversight.
• Anticipate risks, proactively adapt to changing business priorities, and ensure programs remain on track through thoughtful planning, governance, and operational rigor.
• Build compelling, data-driven narratives and executive communications that drive alignment, influence decision-making, and accelerate progress across the organization.
• Partner directly with senior leaders and cross-functional teams to drive accountability, solve complex operational challenges, and deliver scalable solutions that advance OMX's strategic priorities.
• Continuously observe how teams across OMX operate, identifying patterns, inefficiencies, and opportunities beyond your assigned programs. Partner with SOTO to leverage AI, automation, and scalable operating practices that simplify workflows, increase organizational capacity, and improve how OMX executes at scale.
• Champion a culture of continuous improvement by introducing scalable operating mechanisms, strengthening program governance, and helping teams execute with greater speed, clarity, and efficiency.

To thrive in this role, you have
• 5+ years of experience in Strategy, Business Operations, Program Management, Management Consulting, Member Experience, or a related field.
• Exceptional program management skills with a proven ability to design simple, scalable solutions for complex business problems and lead initiatives from strategy through execution.
• Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with experience developing executive-level communications and presenting to senior leaders across the organization.
• Demonstrated success leading highly cross-functional initiatives and influencing outcomes without direct authority.
• An ownership mindset with the ability to independently identify challenges, proactively manage risks, and execute with minimal guidance in fast-paced environments.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including experience using Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar tools to inform decisions and measure business outcomes.

jobs.description:
Before the iPhone existed, Apple went to America's wireless carriers with terms none of them had ever granted: no carrier logo on the device, no carrier software, and control over how it was sold. Verizon walked away. Cingular said yes, reportedly before it had seen a working prototype, and on January 9, 2007 became the exclusive U.S. carrier for a phone the public had not yet seen. Apple gave up the reach of every other carrier, Cingular gave up control it had never surrendered, and both got something worth more. No template could have produced that agreement. People with the relationships, the nerve and a structure in mind did.

(Fun fact. Most people think it was A T, but “Cingular” was the one who negotiated and announced it, and “AT T” is what the carrier was called by the time the phone shipped in June
2007. That’s why most people say “the AT T and iPhone deal.”)

At Mercury, we are looking for the person who will do that for us. We are building the financial layer for ambitious people of all kinds, and the platforms where they already work are where we want to be: the default bank for AI, the core banking* partner for merchants. One signed agreement can put Mercury in front of millions of businesses. We are a company of founders and small teams trying to change the world, and this isn't a fixed role. We expect the nature of work is changing, and a leader paired with AI tools and the autonomy to build can create 10x outcomes: modeling deals, shaping integrations with our product teams and standing up the function as you go. Bring your relationships, and we will bring the product, the team and the room to build something that doesn't exist yet.

About Strategic Partnerships at Mercury

The Strategic Partnerships team drives customer growth, product expansion and strategic advantage through high-impact partner relationships. We have built a strong business through accounting firms, VCs, accelerators, incorporators and e-commerce partners, working closely with Product, GTM, Finance, Legal, Risk and Operations. That motion works. The next chapter is different, and it starts with you.

About the Role

This is a leadership role with a single mandate: land the handful of partnerships that change Mercury's trajectory. You will own Mercury's most ambitious platform relationships, including making Mercury the default bank for AI and the core banking partner for merchants, and you will be measured on deals that create distribution at a scale no direct sales motion can match.

These are one-of-a-kind deals. Nobody has a template for them, so you will design the structure, and neither side will have done anything quite like it before. You will do it largely through relationships you already have, with the senior executives who decide at the world's most important technology companies.

You will build the enterprise partnerships function from scratch, report into Mercury's leadership team and have a direct line to the CEO. As the motion proves out, you will hire and lead the team that runs it.

What You'll Do

Win the deals that matter most
• Own Mercury's top partnership targets across the AI ecosystem and the largest commerce, productivity and vertical software platforms, and make Mercury the financial layer underneath them.
• Open doors personally at the C-suite and senior executive level, using your existing network to get Mercury into rooms that most companies cannot reach.
• Take each deal through its full lifecycle, from first conversation and business case to term negotiation, legal close, integration scoping and launch.

Architect first-of-a-kind structures
• Design bespoke arrangements such as embedded finance programs, deep API and agent integrations, co-distribution models and joint product experiences that create lasting strategic lock-in.
• Use Mercury's full product suite (banking, payments, cards, APIs, MCP and CLI tooling) as strategic currency, matching the right capabilities to each partner's needs.
• Model deal economics for both sides, pressure-test the business case, and align Finance, Product, Engineering, Legal and Risk leadership behind it.

Build the function
• Define the Enterprise partnerships playbook: who we pursue, how we position, how we negotiate and what success looks like a year from now.
• Work with our bank partners and regulators' expectations in mind so that large, complex integrations can launch and scale safely.
• Hire and develop the team as the motion grows.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, Mercury has signed its first platform-scale agreements in AI and commerce, each with a clear integration plan, committed executive sponsors on both sides and measurable distribution. You have built the playbook and the relationships to repeat it.

What We're Looking For
• 15+ years in strategic partnerships, business development or corporate development, including senior leadership at a category-defining technology company or platform.
• A record of one-of-a-kind deals that you personally originated and closed. You can describe the counterparty, the structure, the economics and your own role in detail, and the counterparty would confirm it.
• Personal relationships with senior executives at leading technology companies. You can call decision-makers directly, you have recent history with them, and they will take the meeting.
• Deep experience structuring embedded, API-driven or distribution deals. You understand how technical integrations create commercial moats, and how to negotiate them.
• Strong commercial and financial fluency. You can model economics for both sides, structure complex incentives and negotiate with sophisticated counterparties.
• Executive presence and internal influence. You earn trust from Finance, Product, Engineering and Legal, and you can move a company behind a deal.
• Comfort building from scratch. Mercury has not had a dedicated enterprise partnerships function, and you are energized by that.
• Technical credibility. You do not need to write code, but you can hold a substantive conversation about APIs, integration architecture and what it means to embed financial infrastructure into someone else's platform.
• Strong plus: experience in fintech, payments, embedded finance or AI-native products.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

Total Rewards
The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits.

Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the SaaS and fintech industry and are updated regularly using the most reliable compensation survey data for our industry. New hire offers are made based on a candidate’s experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers.

$304,000 $380,000 USD

Sales Development has helped Mercury reach startup founders from their earliest days. As we grow, we’re taking on a new challenge alongside that work. jobs.description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

What We Do

At Moniepoint, we are a customer-focused community dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We leverage artificial intelligence and data-driven best practices to support our businesses, from providing credit and overdrafts to ensuring every transaction is secure.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out our stories on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

Job Title: Data Entry Officer

Reports To: Lead, Onboarding

Location: Delta State - Sapele

Work Mode: Outsourced and Hybrid

Job Purpose

The Data Entry Specialist ensures that customer accounts, product catalogues, inventory records, and pricing data are accurately entered and maintained within the Moniebook platform. Working closely with Onboarding Specialists and Account Managers, you keep data clean and ready from day one, enabling fast go-lives, reliable reporting, and a smooth experience for every retail customer. Success is measured by accuracy rates, turnaround time, and your contribution to a scalable, error-free operational foundation.

Key Responsibilities

Data Entry Record Management
• Input, update, and maintain merchant data, including product catalogues, SKUs, pricing, inventory levels, and customer profiles.
• Process bulk data imports from spreadsheets and CSV files, validating format and completeness before upload.
• Ensure all records adhere to Moniebook's data standards and naming conventions.

Onboarding Data Support
• Prepare merchant accounts ahead of onboarding by populating required product, inventory, and configuration data within agreed timelines.
• Review merchant-submitted data templates for errors or missing fields and follow up to resolve gaps before entry.
• Support the setup of catalogue structures, tax configurations, and payment settings as directed by the Onboarding team.

Data Validation Quality Assurance
• Conduct checks to identify and correct errors, duplicates, or outdated records.
• Cross-reference data across spreadsheets, CRM, and POS backend to ensure consistency.
• Flag and document data anomalies, routing them to the appropriate team for resolution.

Process Documentation
• Maintain accurate records of data entry activities, import logs, and correction history in the CRM.
• Document common errors and resolutions to build a shared knowledge base and reduce repeat mistakes.
• Identify recurring workflow bottlenecks and recommend improvements to the Operations lead.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Fulfil ad-hoc data requests from Onboarding Specialists, Account Managers, and Support teams within SLA windows.
• Coordinate with internal teams to gather missing customer data without delaying onboarding timelines.

Qualifications
• 1-3 years in data entry, data operations, or a similar role — preferably in SaaS, retail tech, or fintech.
• Exceptional attention to detail with a track record of high accuracy across large data volumes.
• Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets (data cleaning, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, basic formulas).
• Familiarity with CRM platforms or POS/back-office SaaS tools.
• Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Preferred
• Experience with bulk CSV imports, data migration, or catalogue management in a SaaS context.
• Exposure to retail operations, inventory systems, or point-of-sale platforms.
• Experience supporting an onboarding, implementation, or customer success team.
• The candidate should be based in Sapele

About You
• You're obsessively detail-oriented and take genuine pride in clean, accurate data.
• You're process-driven but proactive, you follow workflows and flag problems before they escalate.
• You're a team player who understands that your work sits at the heart of the customer journey.
• You're calm under pressure and can handle high volumes without cutting corners.
• You're tech-savvy and always looking for smarter, faster ways to work.

What Success Looks Like
• 99%+ data entry accuracy across merchant account builds and catalogue uploads.
• Zero go-live delays attributable to data readiness.
• All ad-hoc data requests fulfilled within defined SLA windows
• Open task backlog kept below 5% at any given time.
• Achieve >4.5+ average rating score from Onboarding Specialists and Account Managers on data quality and turnaround.

What we can offer you
• Culture: We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all voices are heard, and we look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
• Learning: We have a learning- and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing and training.
• Compensation: You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, and an annual bonus, plus other benefits.

What to expect in the hiring process
• A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
• An interview with the hiring team.
• An interview with a member of our executive team.

Moniepoint Inc. is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

jobs.title: Field Credit Officer (Edo North, Central and Ovia)
jobs.description:
About Us: 

Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times, Moniepoint is Africa’s fastest-growing fintech, trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of Naira in transactions monthly. Our mission is to enable financial happiness for every African, everywhere.

Job Title: Field Credit Officer 

Reports to: Regional Credit Manager 

Employment Type: Outsourced 

Work Mode: Onsite

About this role: 

As a Field Credit Officer, you would be saddled with the duty of onboarding and managing businesses that would access our credit products. You would be tasked with growing your loan portfolio while maintaining profitability by ensuring that all loans are repaid as and when due. As a result, you would play a vital role in the assessment of these businesses during their credit application and leverage innovative tools we have developed to help you monitor their performance during the course of the loan.

You would also be responsible for making deductions from several information sources about the 5Cs of credit, with capacity, character, and capital as major priorities. Make recommendations to management before, during, and after the disbursement of a loan facility as to the best actions to be taken, considering several economic factors.

Responsibilities:
• Identify and onboard viable businesses within your assigned geographical area to open business accounts with Moniepoint
• Engage customers to ensure optimal usage of accounts to allow them to qualify for access to credit
• Review and approve (or decline) loan requests by thoroughly analyzing all the data available
• Embark on physical visitation to potential borrowers’ business places for evaluation of business books, taking inventory and turnover into consideration
• Meet gross loan portfolio targets and portfolio profit targets by maintaining a healthy number of loan customers while ensuring that all loans in portfolio are performing
• Monitor active loan portfolio to ensure continued use of business account and loan repayment performance
• Perform all other credit-related functions as may be assigned by a supervisor 

Experience Background:
• Minimum of an OND in any business-related discipline
• Minimum of 2 years’ experience in a sales role for credit products in a financial institution
• Demonstrable knowledge of credit risk analysis
• Good knowledge of financial analysis is an added advantage
• Must reside within Edo North, Central or Ovia.

Skills Competencies:
• Apt attention to details
• Proven simple/complex analytical skills
• Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills
• Agility and perseverance 

What success looks like

in this role:
• Consistent achievement of gross loan portfolio targets and portfolio profit targets.
• Maintaining a healthy, performing loan portfolio with minimized default rates through rigorous physical visitations and monitoring.
• Successful onboarding and engagement of viable businesses that actively utilize Moniepoint business accounts.
• Accurate credit risk assessments based on key factors like capacity, character, and capital. 

Why join us:
• Competitive compensation, benefits, and career growth opportunities.
• Opportunity to work with Africa’s fastest-growing fintech and make a direct impact on business growth across the region.

jobs.description:
About us

Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times, Moniepoint is Africa’s fastest-growing fintech, trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of Naira in transactions monthly. Our mission is to enable financial happiness for every African, everywhere.

About Moniebook

The all-in-one business management software for retail and restaurant businesses. We sell, track inventory, manage bookkeeping, and accept payments — all from one platform. Offline-first, mobile-ready, and built for how Nigerian businesses actually operate. For more info https://moniepoint.com/moniebook

Job Title: Field Sales Lead

Reports to: Head, Customer Acquisition

Location: Nigeria (Field)

About this role

The Field Sales Lead drives acquisition and conversion performance across assigned regions by recruiting, managing, coaching, and supporting a team of Field Sales Agents (FSAs). You will serve as the operational hub of the regional field sales function, owning agent recruitment pipelines, ensuring consistent field activity, and delivering against regional acquisition targets. This is a hands-on, frontline role that combines team building with active performance management and structured field support.

Responsibilities

Team Leadership Coaching
• Lead Develop: Manage a team of Field Sales Agents across assigned states, providing daily direction, motivation, and performance support.
• Coach: Conduct regular meetings, field ride-alongs, and coaching sessions to develop FSAs' product knowledge, objection handling, and acquisition skills.
• Onboard: Onboard new Field Sales Agents and ensure they are fully ramped and hitting activity targets within their first 30 days.
• Performance Management: Identify frontline skill gaps and run targeted coaching interventions to address them quickly.

FSA Recruitment Talent Acquisition
• Recruit: Own the end-to-end recruitment pipeline for Field Sales Agents in your region, sourcing, screening, interviewing, and recommending candidates for hire.
• Pipeline Building: Maintain a live talent bench by proactively building relationships with potential FSA candidates in your states, ensuring the region is never understaffed.
• Workforce Planning: Partner with the Operations team to forecast FSA headcount needs based on regional acquisition targets and attrition trends.
• Recruitment Reporting: Track time-to-fill and onboarding completion rates, flagging recruitment blockers to leadership in a timely manner.

Sales Operations Performance
• Drive Targets: Own region-level acquisition targets (weekly and monthly) and ensure individual FSAs meet their assigned quotas.
• Track Activity: Monitor daily field activity metrics, visits completed, leads generated, acquisitions recorded, and follow-ups made, and intervene when performance trends downward.
• Field Support: Join FSAs in the field to support complex or at-risk acquisition opportunities where direct engagement is needed.
• Pipeline Management: Maintain clean, accurate, and up-to-date CRM records across your team on a daily basis.

Process Quality Assurance
• Process Adherence: Ensure all field activity is executed in line with the business's acquisition playbook and within agreed timelines.
• Quality Control: Review and score FSA fieldwork quality; share structured feedback in weekly team review sessions.
• Handoff Management: Coordinate a seamless handoff from FSAs to Implementation and Data Entry teams following a successful acquisition.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Relay structured feedback on lead quality, market conditions, and field blockers to the Growth and Marketing teams.
• Leadership Reporting: Provide leadership with clear weekly reports on team field activity, acquisition rates, recruitment status, and immediate blockers.

Experience Background
• 4–5 years of total experience in field sales, B2B sales, or territory management.
• At least 1–2 years of experience in a team lead, coordinator, or supervisory capacity.
• Demonstrated experience recruiting or building commission-based sales teams, either formally or as part of a team lead role.
• Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding acquisition or sales quotas.
• Experience coaching and developing junior field sales reps on activity execution and objection handling.
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical field sales experience preferred.

Skills Competencies
• Natural Team Builder: Proven ability to find the right people, bring them in, and get them performing fast.
• Frontline Leader: Ready to lead from the front with no hesitation going into the field alongside FSAs to model what great acquisition looks like.
• Balanced Management Style: Ability to balance accountability with empathy, holding people to numbers to genuinely drive their professional growth.
• Data-Informed People-First: Skillful use of daily activity metrics to coach rather than micromanage.
• Agility Focus: Highly adaptable to fast-paced, high-growth environments with the ability to manage competing regional priorities seamlessly.
• Radical Ownership: Deep commitment to regional outcomes, celebrating wins together, and treating misses as learning opportunities.
• Communication Tools: Strong verbal and written communication skills to deliver structured feedback, run effective team meetings, and represent the region to leadership. Comfort with sales work tools and daily pipeline management workflows.

What success looks like in this role
• Weeks 1–2: Complete full product and playbook onboarding. Shadow all FSAs in the field. Establish cadences with team members. Audit the existing FSA recruitment pipeline and playbook.
• Weeks 3–4: Run first structured field review sessions. Identify any headcount gaps and initiate active FSA recruitment in understaffed states.
• Month 2: Fully own regional KPI tracking on a weekly basis. Fill open FSA roles and ensure all new hires are progressing through onboarding on schedule.
• Month 3: Region achieves 85%–100% of the monthly acquisition quota. FSAs have active coaching plans in place, and the recruitment pipeline remains healthy.

Why join us
• Competitive compensation, performance bonuses, and career growth opportunities.
• Dynamic field support structures and tools built to facilitate high-performance execution.
• Opportunity to work with a fast-growing, industry-leading fintech brand driving financial inclusion.

jobs.description:

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.

 

📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰 Competitive Salary + Benefits 

We’re looking for several Product Marketing Leads to set the market intelligence and product strategy for individual product Collectives.

At Monzo, Product Marketing is a global product-market fit discipline rather than a GTM discipline. We’re embedded in squads with PMs, Designers and User Researchers, shaping products and propositions by acting as the voice of the market (UK, Ireland, Spain and future markets). We then partner closely with Integrated Marketing, who lead marketing strategy and execution, to bring those propositions to customers. Together, we aim to build and market category-leading products. If that’s your flavour of product marketing, Monzo is for you.

This is a player/coach role. You'll own Product Marketing for a Collective: understanding customers, shaping product strategy, defining positioning, and guiding how launches land in the market. If you love influencing what gets built as much as how it's communicated, you'll feel at home here.

Where you could join:
• Wealth is building the future of how people grow their money: helping millions of customers save, invest, and plan for retirement with the same simplicity and trust they expect from their current account. It spans Savings, Investments, Pensions, Insurance, and brand new kinds of wealth-building experiences. This is a role for someone who wants to challenge how traditional wealth products work to make growing money (finally) feel simpler and more useful for everyday customers.
• MonzOS is the intelligence layer of Monzo: an AI-powered operating system that helps customers find the right product, insight or action at the right moment. It brings together personalisation, recommendations, search and in-app discovery to make Monzo feel more useful every time someone opens the app. This is a role for someone who is excited by the challenge of making Monzo feel simple, trusted and indispensable in people’s financial lives.
• EU is building Monzo for millions of customers across Europe, taking what people love about Monzo in the UK and making it work brilliantly in new markets. This role will lead consumer market insight and competitor discovery for new countries, while supporting growth in already-live markets like Ireland and Spain. This is a role for someone who loves figuring out how to win a market: turning customer insight, competitor analysis and local context into practical, provocative choices for product and marketing.

Key Responsibilities

You and your team will…
• Set strategy for multiple categories. You'll own a one-year product marketing strategy for a complex, multi-product Collective. You will work to define how Monzo wins in multiple categories with multiple products over time.
• Set the market intelligence agenda. You'll decide what we need to understand about our customers, competitors, and the market. You’ll identify and size opportunities, and build the frameworks other teams use to prioritise and respond.
• Shape what gets built. You'll use market intelligence to shape product strategy across multiple areas, bringing a perspective that changes what we build and in what order. You'll sit alongside Product leadership, driving commercial outcomes through product differentiation.
• Define positioning that moves the business. You'll ensure every product starts with a customer problem, differentiated positioning, and a proposition worth talking about. You’ll demonstrate that positioning will shift customer perception and move revenue at scale.
• Own how we go to market. You'll decide when products launch, with what mechanic, and in what order, so launches across the Collective add up to more than a run of releases. You'll give Integrated Marketing a brief sharp enough that they never have to guess, then feed what the market tells you back into the proposition.
• Raise the bar for Product Marketing. You'll define what great looks like through high standards, coaching, feedback, and better systems. You'll improve how PMM works by embedding AI into our workflows, tools, and playbooks. On the manager track, you'll also be accountable for the development, performance, and careers of a small team.

Great PMMs come from all sorts of places. This is for you if:
• You think beyond a single product. You're comfortable owning strategy across multiple products and categories, where work spans multiple squads and the decisions have business-wide implications.
• You own the hardest calls in your domain. You're trusted to make high-stakes positioning and strategy decisions independently, and you're right often enough that Product and Marketing leadership seek your judgement. You're comfortable making difficult trade-offs between commercial needs, customer experience, and competitive urgency when the right answer isn't obvious.
• You bring senior people with you. You build consensus around difficult decisions, influence senior stakeholders across disciplines, and create clarity out of ambiguity. People look to you for guidance when the path forward isn't obvious.
• You're a player/coach. You still want to do the hardest strategic work yourself while coaching others through feedback, mentoring, and high standards. Whether or not you're a people manager, your impact is visible in the growth of the people around you.

The Interview Process

Our interview process involves three main stages:

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

You’ll hear from us throughout the application process, but if you’ve got any questions, please reach out to hiring@monzo.com. You can also use this email address to let us know if there’s anything we can do to make the process easier for you because of disability, neurodiversity or anything else.

What’s in it for you:

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

What You’ll Be Doing
• Build and maintain the core infrastructure of the AIOps platform, including the unified monitoring alerting system and the FinOps cost observability platform.

• 3+ years of DevOps or SRE experience; experience with AIOps or observability platform development is a plus.
• Proficient in Python; familiar with at least one of Go or Java. Full-stack capability (React/Vue frontend + backend API) is a plus.
• Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (Alibaba Cloud or AWS); familiar with cloud monitoring products (CloudWatch / Alibaba Cloud CloudMonitor) and cost management tools.
• Familiar with monitoring and logging stacks such as Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK.
• Experience maintaining and optimizing CI/CD toolchains (GitLab CI, Nexus, container registries).

jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

 

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

 

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

The Operations Control Specialist supports the integrity, continuity and control of the Group's digital-asset platform workflows through operational verification, exception management, risk-sensitive case handling and cross-functional resolution.

 

The role requires practical knowledge of Digital Asset platform workflows and blockchain transactions. Substantial industry experience, particularly in understanding transaction workflows, investigating complex issues and coordinating cross-functional resolution, provides a strong foundation for this position. The Specialist applies this industry expertise to designated financial activities within The Group's established control framework.

 

Working across Finance, Asset, Operations and Technology functions, the position combines cryptocurrency business understanding with independent judgement, disciplined controls and accurate operational records.

 

 

What You’ll Be Doing 

Digital Asset Transaction Management
• Execute designated digital asset activities with a focus on transaction integrity, accuracy and adherence to established financial controls.
• Interpret blockchain transaction information and validate asset, network and transaction attributes against authorised business instructions and operational records.
• Support approved operational reconciliation and Platform transfer verification workflows, monitor processing outcomes, and escalate discrepancies.
• Apply asset- and network-specific considerations when reviewing transactions and handling operational exceptions.

Transaction Integrity and Financial Controls
• Conduct independent checks across business instructions, platform records and available on-chain information to support transaction accuracy and completeness.
• Apply segregation-of-duties, access-control and evidence-retention requirements throughout assigned workflows.
• Identify inconsistent information, unusual transaction conditions and potential operational risks, exercising independent judgement on whether to proceed or escalate within established procedures.
• Maintain traceable operational records and support internal reviews and audit enquiries.
• Protect confidential business and transaction information and comply with applicable information-security requirements.

Reconciliation and Exception Management
• Reconcile designated digital asset transactions and balances across finance systems, operational platforms and blockchain records.
• Draw on knowledge of exchange transaction journeys to investigate discrepancies and distinguish processing or data issues from matters requiring technical investigation.
• Coordinate with the relevant teams to resolve exceptions, documenting findings, actions taken and outstanding dependencies.
• Communicate the financial and operational implications of unresolved issues clearly and follow up within the role’s remit.

Global Crypto Business Financial Support

Within the scope of assigned

responsibilities:
• Support a range of global digital asset financial activities, applying cryptocurrency exchange expertise to transaction processing, account-related workflows and exception management.
• Coordinate with relevant functions to maintain accurate records and resolve business and financial discrepancies.
• Contribute to control enhancements, process improvements and the development of relevant business requirements.

 

What We Look For In You
• 5+ years of hands-on experience in digital asset operations, fintech operational processes, fraud-risk operations, transaction support, or complex case management within a high-volume technology environment.
• Demonstrated experience using enterprise back-office systems supporting deposit and withdrawal workflows, transaction or fund-flow verification, case management, and escalation to product, R D or technology teams. Familiarity with the Group’s proprietary systems and operational-control framework is advantageous.
• Experience investigating complex exchange-related enquiries, assessing relevant information and coordinating resolution with operational or technical teams.
• Working knowledge of transaction lifecycle statuses, system records, operational evidence and common processing exceptions across digital-asset platform workflows.
• Understanding of blockchain network characteristics, digital asset transfer requirements and the operational implications of transaction errors.
• Ability to interpret relevant transaction information using exchange operational tools and blockchain explorers.
• Understanding of the distinction between external network records and internal platform ledger data, and their implications for transaction and balance reconciliation.
• Ability to apply cryptocurrency exchange expertise to financial workflows, transaction validation and exception management within established control requirements.
• Strong attention to detail, independent judgement, confidentiality awareness and accurate documentation.
• Effective communication and coordination across Customer Support, Finance, Asset, Operations and Technology functions.

 

Nice to Haves
• Experience handling escalated cryptocurrency transaction cases and identifying recurring operational issues.
• Exposure to multiple digital assets and blockchain networks and their differing operational characteristics.
• Familiarity with exchange back-office platforms, transaction-investigation tools or financial operations systems.
• Experience contributing to process improvements, knowledge sharing or system testing.
• Familiarity with independent verification, segregation of duties, approval requirements and audit trails in an operational environment.

 

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

 

Disclaimer: Please note that Hong Kong is a group-level service hub, and OKX does not carry on a business of operating a virtual asset trading platform in Hong Kong.

jobs.title: Staff/Senior Java Engineer, OKX Web3 Wallet
jobs.location: Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR; Singapore, Singapore
jobs.description:
Staff/Senior Java Engineer, OKX Wallet (Web3)

Who We Are

OKX Wallet is OKX's self-custody wallet, built for users worldwide to securely and conveniently store, manage, and use their on-chain assets. The wallet backend operates in a multi-chain, multi-asset, high-concurrency environment shaped by on-chain state uncertainty and strict fund-security requirements — combining the complex-systems challenges of traditional internet backends with the transaction, signing, and on-chain interaction problems unique to blockchain.

We're looking for a Senior Java Engineer with roughly 5–10 years of backend

experience:

someone with strong engineering fundamentals who can independently own core modules, exercise sound judgment on complex problems, and proactively coordinate across upstream and downstream teams to drive work to completion.

What You'll Do
• Own core wallet backend modules. Build and continuously improve address management, asset synchronization, transaction construction, broadcasting, on-chain confirmation, gas estimation, nonce management, and transaction-state tracking. Understand each module's role in the full wallet flow, and keep stability, performance, and maintainability front of mind. For complex requirements, break the problem down before choosing an implementation rather than stacking code or reusing old designs.
• Build transaction and on-chain interaction scenarios. Work on transfers, token approvals, contract interactions, cross-chain, swaps, DApp connections, and signature-request handling. Understand a transaction's full lifecycle — from initiation through construction, signing, broadcasting, on-chain confirmation, and final state update — and diagnose issues like stuck transactions, duplicate submissions, state inconsistencies, and on-chain success that isn't reflected in the business system, using logs, on-chain data, and call traces.
• Support multi-chain and new-chain integration. We already support EVM, Tron, and Solana, and continuously onboard new public chains, Layer 2 networks, and asset standards. Contribute to technical research, integration design, and feature development, accounting for differences in address models, account systems, transaction structures, signing methods, fees, and confirmation mechanisms — as well as node stability, asset sync, exception compensation, monitoring, and security boundaries.
• Ensure stable operation. Contribute to day-to-day stability work — monitoring, alerting, rate limiting, graceful degradation, retries, compensation, data reconciliation, and troubleshooting. When incidents occur, help investigate, narrow scope, and fix root causes; for recurring issues, drive systemic fixes such as added monitoring, stronger fallbacks, or design improvements.
• Drive your projects to delivery. Take ownership of the modules and projects you're responsible for. On work spanning product, QA, frontend, infrastructure, or other backend teams, proactively sync information, surface dependencies and risks, and drive issues to resolution. When requirements are unclear or opinions diverge, lay out the context, offer your own judgment, and help build consensus.
• Continuously raise engineering quality. Participate in design discussions, code reviews, and system optimization. Spot unreasonable designs, duplicated logic, and latent risks, and propose actionable improvements. Document technical decisions, post-incident learnings, and best practices, and help less-experienced teammates.
• Apply AI in daily development. Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.) to assist with code comprehension, scaffolding, unit tests, code review, troubleshooting, refactoring, and documentation — validating AI output for correctness, project conventions, performance, and security rather than using it unchecked.

What We're Looking For
• Solid Java backend fundamentals. ~5–10 years of Java backend experience with a strong grasp of collections, concurrency, thread pools, the JVM, network communication, and common performance issues. Proficient with Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, MyBatis, or comparable stacks, able to independently design and build medium-to-large backend modules and reason about the mechanics behind the frameworks you use.
• Strong system design ability. Experience with complex or high-concurrency systems; comfortable with idempotency, retries, compensation, caching, message queues, distributed locks, data consistency, rate limiting, and service degradation. Able to own module- or service-level design and clearly explain the core flow, failure scenarios, and key trade-offs.
• Cognitive ability and judgment. Able to understand context and goals on ambiguous problems, separate symptom from root cause, and choose a fitting solution based on business value, user experience, stability, cost, and security — rather than reflexively adding complexity.
• Drive and ownership. Able to independently own a module or project end to end, from design through development, testing, and launch. Proactively communicates and resolves dependencies, risks, and blockers, and follows through on launch outcomes rather than stopping at code merge.
• Blockchain or wallet experience. Experience with wallets, blockchain, trading platforms, on-chain data services, or related systems. Understands addresses, public/private keys, mnemonics, transaction signing, broadcasting, on-chain confirmation, gas, and nonce; familiar with the transaction mechanics of at least one of EVM, Tron, or Solana, and with token standards such as ERC-20 and TRC-20. (Strong backend fundamentals and fast learning can offset gaps in blockchain coverage.)
• High security awareness. Sensitive to private-key, signing, permission, and user-asset security; familiar with replay protection, API authentication, tamper resistance, sensitive-data protection, and least-privilege principles. Actively considers malformed input, duplicate requests, privilege bypass, and data-leak risks when building transaction features.
• Independent production troubleshooting. Able to diagnose live issues via log analysis, metrics monitoring, distributed tracing, and thread/memory analysis; can form hypotheses and narrow scope even with incomplete information. Hands-on experience with performance degradation, timeouts, message backlogs, data inconsistencies, memory issues, or unstable third-party services.
• Engineering in the AI era. Willing to use AI coding tools to improve daily efficiency and able to judge whether AI output meets real business requirements before shipping it. Has a basic understanding of prompts, context management, RAG, AI agents, and MCP, or a genuine willingness to keep learning — treating AI as an engineering tool, not requiring an algorithm/model-training background.

Nice to Have
• Integration work on new public chains, new asset standards, or cross-chain protocols
• Familiarity with WalletConnect, DApp Browser, or signature-request handling
• Knowledge of MPC, multisig, hardware wallets, or TEE-based key-security schemes
• Experience with Swap, staking, cross-chain bridges, or DeFi aggregation
• Address risk detection, allow/deny lists, anti-fraud, or wallet risk-control experience
• High-concurrency transaction systems, blockchain node services, on-chain data indexing, or transaction-state-tracking systems
• Familiarity with RPC calls, block scanning, chain reorgs, transaction compensation, and reconciliation mechanisms
• JVM performance tuning, stability governance, or complex production-incident experience
• Cross-team collaboration with a track record of driving projects to delivery
• Real projects built with AI — e.g. AI code review, development agents, MCP servers, intelligent troubleshooting, or knowledge bases
• Follows developments in AI coding assistants and LLM applications and shares practical takeaways with the team

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation
• Comprehensive insurance coverage for you and your dependents
• More benefits to be discussed after you join
