The Financial Crime Quality Assurance (QA) team at OKX is part of the Compliance Assurance function and is responsible for reviewing and rating the quality of AML Transaction Monitoring alert disposition and Financial Crime Investigations performed by the Global Financial Crime Investigations Team.

We are a team of risk-focused compliance experts who independently assess investigation quality, promote consistency in decision-making, and ensure compliance with AML/CFT requirements, internal policies, and regulatory expectations. By working closely with Operations, Product, and Compliance teams, we help strengthen financial crime controls and drive continuous improvement across the investigation lifecycle.

About the Opportunity

This is an exciting opportunity to lead the Financial Crime QA team within the Compliance Assurance function of a regulated crypto business. As QA Team Lead, you will manage a team of QA Analysts who review AML Transaction Monitoring alerts, Name Screening, EDD and other financial crime investigations.

You will own the day-to-day delivery and quality of the QA program, set and uphold review standards, and develop your team's expertise. Working closely with Financial Crime Operations, Compliance leadership and Product teams, you will turn QA insights into lasting improvements in investigation quality and the effectiveness of the firm's financial crime controls.

Team Leadership People Management – Lead, mentor and develop a team of QA Analysts. Set clear objectives, allocate daily workload, manage capacity and productivity, and conduct regular one-to-ones and performance reviews. Support hiring, onboarding and training of new team members, and foster a culture of accountability, integrity and continuous learning.
• QA Program Ownership – Own the end-to-end delivery of QA reviews across Transaction Monitoring, Name Screening, Sanctions, EDD and other AML investigations. Ensure reviews are completed on time, to a consistent standard, and in line with agreed sampling plans and service levels.
• Quality Oversight Second-Level Review – Perform second-level reviews of QA Analyst findings, validate defect ratings and resolve disputes or challenges from Operations. Personally review complex, high-risk or escalated cases, and act as the final QA decision-maker on borderline outcomes.
• QA Framework Methodology – Design, maintain and enhance the QA framework, including scorecards, error taxonomies, risk-based sampling methodologies, procedures and quality standards. Ensure the framework reflects AML/CFT regulatory requirements, internal policies, and emerging crypto-specific typologies.
• Calibration Consistency – Lead regular calibration sessions within the QA team and with Financial Crime Operations to align on policy interpretation, grey areas and scoring methodology, and reduce subjectivity in quality evaluations.
• Management Information Reporting – Produce and present QA MI, dashboards and trend analysis to Financial Crime and Compliance leadership. Identify systemic issues, root causes and emerging risks, and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations for management and governance forums.
• Stakeholder Management – Act as the primary QA point of contact for Financial Crime Operations leadership, Team Leads, Product, Policy and other Compliance teams. Drive agreement on corrective actions, escalate material control weaknesses, and support internal and external audits and regulatory examinations as required.

AIを含む最新技術とデータを駆使し、圧倒的なスピードでサービス開発と事業成長を実現します。 日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、ユーザーの為に新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

 

業務について

▼CS本部 プロダクトサポート部のご紹介
プロダクト・Techとビジネスの橋渡し役となることをミッションにした少数精鋭で編成されたチームです。プロダクト部門とビジネス部門の間で付加価値のあるハブになることで、社内の円滑なコミュニケーション、迅速な障害解消をサポートする部門です。社内関係先はCS・ビジネス・営業・リスク部門等と幅広く、また業務範囲も障害といったネガティブな案件から、プロジェクト推進まで、プロダクト部門に関する多様な案件を扱います。深いサポート精神のもと、柔軟にかつ迅速に動けるチームとして、PayPayのあらゆる案件の事業をサポートしていくチームです。プロダクト部門とは基本的に英語でのコミュニケーションになります（特にreadingとwriting）。日常的に開発部門と会話をするため、ITパスポートなど基礎的なシステム知識も求められます。社内関係先は幅広く、案件も多岐にわたるため、自分が詳しくない領域の仕事も担当します。単に伝える・理解する以上のコミュニケーションを意識する必要があります。ゴールや目的を正しく理解し、何事にも興味をもち、前向きに取り組むサポート精神が求められます。

▼募集の背景
急激な事業拡大が進む一方で、PayPayシステムや外部連携システムは複雑化しています。24時間365日サービスを提供し続ける中で起きるシステムトラブルの原因究明から復旧までビジネスとプロダクト部門のエンジニアの架け橋となり問題解決を行う迅速に行うために、プロダクトサポートがあります。高い技術力と多くのステークホルダーと円滑に調整を進められるプロフェッショナル人材が不足しており組織強化目的の実現に向けた募集となります。 

【具体的な業務内容】
関係部署とコミュニケーションを取りながらプロダクト部門と連携して、PayPayのプロダクトに関するエスカレーション対応、障害発生時の対応、改善提案を行う部門となります。

・CSや営業部門で解決できずあがってくるエスカレーションに対して問題の切り分け、プロダクト部門と連携し問題解決を推進する
・障害発生時、プロダクト部門と連携し問題の切り分けや社内外への障害報告を行い障害解消までの推進を行う
・日々のエスカレーションやユーザーの声を元にプロダクト部門へ改善提案を行いユーザー体験の向上を実現する
・社内ツールの権限付与やデータ抽出、更新作業を行う
・監査・リスクアセスメントへの障害報告資料の作成〜報告

▼本ポジションの魅力

・仕事を通じてPayPayサービスや仕様にもっとも広く・詳しくなれることができるのが本ポジションの魅力となります
・プロダクト部門とビジネス部門双方と関係を持ち課題解決できるため両方の知識や経験が得られます
・24時間365日サービスを支え続けるポジションであり時に大変ではあるが非常に責任あるやりがいのあることが魅力となります

 

必要な経験/スキル

・AI活用の経験
・自発的に学習し、常に最新のテクノロジーを取り入れる意欲のある方
・英語力（メールや社内チャット等で、文章のやり取りが可能なレベル。AIによる自動翻訳の支援もあります）
 -エンジニアやプロダクトマネージャとは、英語でコミュニケーションが必要になります
・複数のステークホルダーと折衝し、合理的な解決策に導く能力
・良好なチームワークを形成でき円滑に業務を遂行できる方
・本拠地およびCS拠点（東京四谷、博多、小倉、札幌）への出社・出張が問題ないこと

【スキル】
・ITパスポート、基本情報技術者などのスキル
・SQLを活用したデータ抽出の経験
・WEBアプリケーション開発保守運用の経験は歓迎
・ログ調査ができる方

【求める人材】
・主体的に取り組める方
・常に相手の目線に立って丁寧で繊細な仕事ができる方
・困っている人のために役に立ちたいと考えられる方

・出社およびリモートの組み合わせに対する受容性・適性
・システムエンジニアの経験
 -プロジェクトマネージメント（開発～リリースまでの開発チームの管理）スキル
 -API仕様書を理解して要件を定義できるテクニカルスキル
 -社内業務システムの開発を企画した経験

業務について

PayPayの3ラインオブディフェンスの最後の砦として、ビジネススピードに合わせ内部監査部の態勢を高度化させています。

 

＜内部監査の主なミッション＞
• 内部監査を通じて経営目標の効果的な達成、組織体への価値の付加を実現
• 経営活動の全般にわたる業務運営の管理、遂行状況を3線の立場で評価
• 内部監査結果に基づく情報提供ならびに改善への助言

＜チーム構成＞

現在は十数名程度のメンバーが在籍しており、テーマ監査、業務営業監査、システム監査の3チームで構成されています。
前職の出身企業は事業会社や監査法人など多様なメンバーが活躍をしております。

▼関連コンテンツ
• 「監査」と「統制」一体で上場を目指す。監査統制本部長が語る、PayPayの第3線（2024.10.22）
• 先を見据えたリスク評価と改善で、PayPayの成長スピードを支える内部監査室。（2023.02.02）

▼募集背景
• PayPayにおける事業・サービスの拡大（金融ビジネスや加盟店事業等）に対応できる専門性の高い国内金融機関トップクラスの内部監査部門の構築を目指し、 多様なバックグラウンド・経験・スキルを持った内部監査人材の確保のため
• 主にFintech企業で活用できるシステム監査、サイバーセキュリティ監査の経験が豊富な人材の確保のため

▼具体的な業務内容

システム監査、サイバーセキュリティ監査等の個別監査の実施の他、監査部門運営に係る以下の実務を想定しております。
また、当社のみならず、グループ会社のシステム監査、サイバーセキュリティ監査に関する支援も実施することを想定しています。
• 個別監査の遂行
• 予備調査
• 監査計画・監査手続書作成
• 監査対象領域の評価
• 原因分析及び改善案の立案
• 監査報告書の作成・報告
• 監査発見事項のフォローアップ 等
• オフサイトモニタリング
• 社内外のリスク情報の収集・整理 等
• リスクアセスメント
• 年間監査計画の基礎となる業務プロセスのリスク評価 等
• 内部監査態勢の向上
• 監査の実効性、効率性向上に向けた監査プロセスの改善 等

▼本ポジションの魅力
• 会社全体を俯瞰する立場から、経営目線で社内業務の改善・高度化、企業の成長に貢献することができます。
• モバイル決済最大手のフィンテック企業において内部監査業務経験を積み、新ビジネススキームを習得しつつ、監査キャリアを拡大できます。
• デジタル監査（分析支援ツール・AI活用）も含めた新たな監査手法等の導入に携わることができます。
• リスク高領域を中心に機動的に調査を進めるフレームワークの導入経験を積むことができます。
• ALL中途入社の多種多様な人材の中で切磋琢磨できる環境があります。

必要な経験/スキル

＜経験＞
• 以下のいずれかの内部監査経験を3年以上お持ちの方
• システム監査の実務経験
• サイバーセキュリティ等のセキュリティ関連監査の実務経験

＜スキル＞
• 以下のうち複数のスキル/特性をお持ちの方
• ステークホルダーとのコミュニケーションを円滑に行ない、課題を把握し、調査をスピード感をもって行なう意識と能力
• IIA国際基準に適合してアシュアランス業務を実施する能力
• ITのリスクおよびコントロール手段に関する知識 （ITガバナンス、情報セキュリティ、クラウドやAI等の最新技術、ITに係わる法務知識）
• リスクマネジメントおよび各リスクカテゴリをモニタリングするために必要な能力

あると望ましい経験/スキル

• 資金決済業法におけるシステム管理

jobs.title: Director and Associate General Counsel, Banking and Credit Cards
jobs.location: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Washington, DC
jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

We’re looking for a Director Associate General Counsel, Banking and Credit Cards, to join our Legal team. This role is a key part of Robinhood’s legal leadership and will function as a hands-on legal advisor while also managing a small team of attorneys. The ideal candidate will serve as a strategic partner to our Banking and Credit Card business, and work cross-functionally with Robinhood’s other regulated businesses.

This is a high-impact role for a legal leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment, can think across multiple regulatory frameworks, and is passionate about building and mentoring legal talent.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA, New York, NY, or Washington, DC office(s), with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do
• Lead and manage a team of attorneys supporting Robinhood’s Banking and Credit Card business.
• Provide practical, solutions-oriented legal advice to cross-functional teams on a broad range of regulatory issues affecting banking, deposit accounts, payments, and credit cards.
• Partner closely with compliance, product, operations, and executive leadership to identify legal risks and drive mitigation strategies.
• Support regulatory engagement and examinations as needed.
• Help build scalable legal processes, frameworks and controls to support a rapidly evolving financial technology company.
• Mentor and grow team members while promoting a strong culture of collaboration, accountability, and inclusion.

What you bring
• J.D. and membership in at least one U.S. state bar in good standing.
• 10+ years of relevant legal experience, with a strong background in consumer financial regulatory law, including, for example, banking, deposit accounts, payments, and credit.
• Experience managing legal professionals or cross-functional teams, with a track record of developing talent and delivering results.
• Ability to navigate complex legal and regulatory issues while delivering clear, risk-based, actionable guidance.
• Experience advising business and product teams on compliance with Truth in Lending Act (Reg Z), Truth in Savings Act (Reg DD), Electronic Fund Transfer Act (Reg E), Fair Credit Reporting Act (Reg V), Equal Opportunity Credit Act (Reg B), UDAAP under Dodd-Frank and UDAP under FTC Act, payment network rules (including NACHA and card networks), TCPA and CAN-SPAM, Expedited Funds Availability Act (Reg CC), Bank Secrecy Act/AML/OFAC Sanctions, laws governing rewards programs, and laws governing first- and third-party collections, including the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (Reg F).
• Experience advising business and product teams on legal issues affecting fintech-bank partnerships, including state licensing (lending, marketing, brokering, servicing, collections), usury, interest exportation, and contractual obligations under governing program and sponsorship agreements.
• Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth, and highly regulated environment.
• Strong communication skills and a business-oriented mindset.
• Demonstrated ability to quickly develop fluency in new substantive areas and effectively lead and collaborate with team members who bring deep subject-matter expertise.

Leadership expectations

Our ambitious roadmap requires a great culture shaped by exceptional leaders. Here’s what we expect from them:
• Drive high performance by setting clear, focused goals, giving real-time feedback, stretching top talent, and scaling impact through focus, innovation, and tech.
• Hire and retain top talent by setting a high bar, hiring only those who raise it, investing in onboarding, and addressing talent issues quickly and fairly.
• Create community by connecting work to purpose, removing friction while prioritizing safety, building trust and inclusion, and leading from the front with integrity.

What we offer
• Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
• Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
• Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.
• Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.
• Employer-paid life disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.
• Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
• Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process.

Base Pay Range:

Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC)

$278,000 $327,000 USD

Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL)

$245,000 $288,000 USD

Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL)

$217,000 $255,000 USD

Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity.

If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application.

AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.

Application Limit: Candidates may submit no more than 3 applications in any 90 days. Within that time, they may apply to each role only once.

Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the team, you will own capacity and efficiency for Robinhood's storage and database fleet, from Aurora clusters to S3 and the caches and volumes in between. You will build the systems that size this fleet to demand: Aurora reader counts and writer sizes set from market hours, declared events, and live load instead of fixed schedules; databases, caches, and volumes rightsized to what they actually use; and S3 data kept in the right storage class, with lifecycle rules that keep growth in check. You will take each from recommendations the Storage team validates to automation that safely applies its own changes in production. This is a 0-to-1 build with measurable impact on reliability at market peaks and on the AWS bill.

 

This role is based in our Bellevue, WA office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do
• Build forecast-driven capacity planning for the storage and database fleet, turning traffic history, load tests, and known events (market open, earnings, IPOs, promotions) into plans that scale up ahead and back down after, with an expiry on every temporary capacity hold
• Design and build a capacity planner for Aurora that sets reader counts and writer instance sizes from demand and load signals (IOPS, CPU, connections, replica lag), replacing fixed scaling schedules
• Rightsize databases, caches, and block storage (RDS, ElastiCache, DynamoDB, EBS) on instance size, provisioned IOPS and throughput, and idle capacity, and keep them right-sized as load changes
• Own S3 efficiency at scale: storage class and Intelligent-Tiering strategy, lifecycle and retention policies, noncurrent versions and incomplete uploads, and request costs, using Storage Lens and inventory data
• Take every recommendation to closed-loop automation with guardrails, progressive rollout, and rollback, in partnership with the Storage infrastructure team, handling constraints such as AWS capacity shortages, fallback instance types, and connection pooling
• Measure outcomes in cost and reliability (savings against baseline, forecast error, utilization, capacity left behind after events) and share our forecasts with the pod rightsizing system so compute and storage scale together

What you bring
• Deep hands-on experience operating AWS storage and databases at scale, especially Aurora or RDS (MySQL or PostgreSQL) and S3, including replication, read scaling, storage classes, and lifecycle management
• Capacity planning and forecasting

experience:

modeling time-series demand, load testing, and translating traffic into instance counts, sizes, and storage growth
• A track record of rightsizing infrastructure from utilization data (CPU, memory, IOPS, throughput, bytes stored) without hurting latency or availability
• Strong Python or Go engineering, with experience building automation that safely modifies production infrastructure (guardrails, progressive rollout, and rollback built in), not just systems that observe and report
• Familiarity with AWS storage and database pricing (S3 storage classes and requests, Aurora I/O-Optimized vs. Standard, Reserved Instances) is a strong plus

You will connect priorities across Member and the broader company, provide insights on business performance, drive cross-functional execution, and help ensure the Member team remains on track to achieve, and exceed, its objectives.

• Own quarterly and annual planning: Lead the Member Business Unit’s planning process in partnership with Finance, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Data Science, and business leaders. Set timelines and milestones, clarify requirements and ownership, coordinate inputs, and ensure planning materials are complete, cohesive, and executive-ready.
• Drive performance management and insights: Partner with Member teams to set meaningful OKRs, monitor progress against goals, and identify opportunities, risks, and performance trends. Build or oversee dashboards and analyses that explains what is happening, why, and what actions should follow.
• Connect strategy across the organization: Gather cross-functional dependencies, surface tradeoffs, and help align roadmaps and priorities across Member and the broader company. Connect the dots across teams to improve decision-making and execution.
• Serve as a strategic advisor to Member leadership: Maintain a deep understanding of the Member business, its objectives, and its role in SoFi’s broader strategy. Provide perspective on business health, organizational effectiveness, and opportunities to increase impact; represent the Member Business Unit on behalf of the Business Unit Leader as needed.
• Strengthen culture and team effectiveness: Partner with the People Business Partner and Member leadership to translate engagement survey feedback into actionable improvements, and drive initiatives that strengthen team health, culture, and performance.
• Lead executive communications: Develop clear, concise updates for Executive Staff, Member leadership, and other key stakeholders on business performance, strategic priorities, dependencies, risks, and progress against company and Member OKRs.
• Improve how the business operates: Identify opportunities to simplify processes, strengthen accountability, and improve team effectiveness. Develop recommendations and drive solutions from idea through implementation.
• Support high-impact strategic initiatives: Lead or contribute to special projects, business reviews, planning sessions, and offsites that advance Member’s objectives and SoFi’s mission.
• Use AI to amplify team impact: Identify and apply AI tools to accelerate analysis, synthesize information, improve decision-making, automate repeatable processes, and increase the efficiency and effectiveness of Member’s operating rhythms. Evaluate opportunities to adopt AI thoughtfully and responsibly across the business.

• Demonstrated ability to operate as a trusted advisor to senior leadership (VP+ level)

• Experience working with AI tools for analysis and process automation
• Proven track record of leading cross-functional programs from ambiguity through execution
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex topics into concise executive-ready materials
• Experience with OKR frameworks, strategic planning processes, and operating cadences at scale
• Ability to context-switch rapidly and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment

• You’re a full-stack operator: You can move fluidly from shaping strategy and clarifying priorities to building the plan, coordinating stakeholders, and driving execution through completion.
• You influence without authority: You build trust quickly and align senior leaders and cross-functional partners around shared objectives, even when priorities are competing or the path forward is not fully defined.

jobs.description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:
• Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
• Over $300 million raised in funding
• 3,000 Tideans globally
• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About the team:

Ongoing Monitoring sits in our first line of defence (1LOD) operations’ department, responsible for monitoring the activity of our SME customers (‘members’) for the purpose of preventing, detecting and reporting sanctions, money laundering, terrorism financing, tax evasion, bribery and corruption, money mules and fraud. 

It's an opportunity to work with an amazing team across multiple geographies, including analysts, team leaders, product and engineering managers, data scientists and operations managers. The role has exposure to many senior stakeholders across the business and is at the heart of what we do to protect our customers.

What we’re looking for: 

Here at Tide, we are looking for someone who
• has a good understanding of Financial Crime Typologies including money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, and sanctions evasion, bribery, tax evasion, and suspicious activities reporting.
• is passionate and proactive, who will help ensure Tide is taking all relevant steps to detect and prevent all aspects of financial crime.
• understands financial crime in a global financial set up with specific focus towards UK and Europe Geography.
• has exceptional communication skills in English (both Written and Speaking).
• can use expert judgement to recommend if a case warrants filing of a Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) 

This role is a key element of our ongoing monitoring team sitting within the first line of defence. You’ll be responsible for ensuring we put our genuine members first, through monitoring transaction types and behaviours across our customer base, whilst spotting and investigating potentially suspicious activity. 

As an Alert Review analyst you’ll be performing tasks related to the following

Transaction Monitoring Alert Review Analysis:
• Monitor and investigate alerts generated by automated transaction monitoring and sanctions screening systems.
• Conduct comprehensive, risk-based reviews of customer accounts and transaction histories to identify suspicious patterns or activities that deviate from a customer's normal behavior.
• Synthesize information from various sources, including customer profiles (KYC/CDD), public records, adverse media, and internal data.
• Assess the transactional activity in the context of financial crime typologies across a variety of payment types and financial products offered.
• Draft a concise, yet comprehensive report on findings prior to discounting the alert or reporting suspicious activity.
• Contact the member (customer) via email, chat or by phone to seek additional contextual information without tipping off.
• Contact representatives of partner banks via emails in cases where a fin crime investigation is required on Tide’s member

Suspicious Activity Reporting (SAR) Recommendations:
• Draft and present detailed, well-reasoned SAR recommendations to experts responsible for filing SARs to regulatory authorities.
• Construct a clear, concise, and defensible narrative outlining the suspicious activity, the investigative steps taken, and the rationale for the recommendation.
• Ensure all supporting documentation and evidence is accurately compiled and included in the case file for audit purposes.

Sanctions Screening:
• Analyze potential sanctions hits against international lists (e.g., OFAC, EU, UN, HMT) for cross border payment transactions.
• Apply a risk-based approach to differentiate between a true match and a false positive based on criteria like phonetic similarities, aliases, and supporting data.
• Escalate confirmed sanctions hits to management immediately for asset blocking or reporting.

Other tasks as part of the role
• Gain in-depth understanding of the technology and tools that aid in the alert review and analysis.
• Proactively calling out potential efficiencies in our tools and processes used for transaction analysis
• Managing your own case load to meet performance targets (Productivity, Quality and Customer experience)
• Participate in internal and external training programs related to fraud offences detection and prevention and other subjects that may form part of the day-to-day work requirements.
• Treating Tide members fairly by taking responsibility to ensure that their needs are met
• Make recommendations for process improvements to prevent future occurrences of fraud
• Establishing good relationships with various departments throughout the organisation to ensure good operational synergy
• Participate in internal and external training programs related to fraud offences detection and prevention and other subjects that may form part of the day-to-day work requirements.
• Treating Tide members fairly by taking responsibility to ensure that their needs are met

What makes you a great fit: 

You are open to flexible shift timings and patterns, it will be five days working with two days off not necessarily weekends.
• You have 2 to 4+ years of experience in a Transaction monitoring, Financial Crime risk related role in financial services
• You have a keen eye for process improvements, looking how we can work leaner and more robustly.
• You have an analytical mind and are able to digest large data sets and spot patterns and trends with ease
• You have exceptional communication skills, written and verbal. Are able to communicate with our members (including via telephone) , internal stakeholders regulatory bodies if required
• You have C1/C2 level of spoken and written English

What you get in return:
• Group Life Insurance
• 27 days holiday
• 3 days for L D or volunteering time off per year
• We invest in your development with a professional L D budget per year
• Snacks, light food, drinks in the office
• Enhanced family-friendly leave
• Sabbatical leave

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

THE ROLE:

Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind KYX (KYC and KYB). Our vision for KYX is a world where every genuine business, business owner, their team, and everyone connected to them, onboards to Tide in minutes, unlocks the products they need as they grow, and never has to think twice about their data, while we identify bad actors, stop them at the door, continuously review their activity and off-board them the moment they're found.

You will be accountable for engineering strategy, organisation and execution across three domains. Onboarding KYX covers identity and access for registration and login, due diligence policy execution and vendor orchestration across the onboarding journey, and the risk scoring and agentic AI that assesses new applicants. Continuous KYX covers ongoing due diligence through periodic and event-triggered reviews, and how business owners bring their own team members onto their account. Risk Scoring is the KYX Scoring ML team whose models power decisions across both domains.

This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, member-facing conversion and applied AI. KYX Ops and KYX Policy set the rules you build for, Second Line of Defence sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise onboarding conversion and due diligence quality while driving the cost of KYX servicing per member down, and who can scale agentic solutions into workflows where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.

As Director of Engineering, KYX you will
• Own the engineering strategy and organisation for KYX, from onboarding identity, access and due diligence through continuous monitoring to risk scoring, unifying leadership that today sits in separate Onboarding and Continuous KYX lines.
• Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science and ML engineering, distributed across Hyderabad, Delhi, Sofia, Belgrade, Bucharest and Vilnius.
• Own KYX Scoring ML as a shared capability serving both onboarding and ongoing decisioning, including the model lifecycle end to end from development through backtesting and staged rollout to production monitoring.
• Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, from onboarding risk scoring through to screening, review and verification, in line with Tide's agentic governance framework.
• Work with KYX Ops, KYX Policy, Second Line of Defence and Product across the UK, EU and India, and with IAM on the still-to-be-sharpened boundary around login and access.
• Deliver measurable outcomes: higher automated decisioning rates, better due diligence and screening quality, and a falling KYX cost per member.
• Build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated.

This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. You will shape how quickly and how well we onboard members, how confidently we scale into new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
• Experience leading engineering organisations in identity, onboarding, fraud, financial crime or another regulated decisioning domain.
• Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes: conversion, due diligence quality, unit economics and workflow automation.
• Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live.
• Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with Ops, Policy and second line risk and compliance functions,
• Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality.
• Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and unify previously separate engineering lines behind one roadmap.
• Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight, would be a bonus.

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:
• Competitive Compensation – Competitive salary and share options.
• Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
• Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
• Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
• Access to salary sacrifice benefits – like Nursery (could save up to 47% on fees!) and Cycle to Work discounts
• Health Insurance – Comprehensive Private family insurance plan.
• Life Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
• Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
• Retirement Planning – Build your retirement fund faster with Tide’s pension scheme on eligible earnings.
• Volunteering Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
• Learning Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
• WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
• Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office
• Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:
• Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
• Over $300 million raised in funding
• 3,000 Tideans globally
• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT

THE ROLE:

Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind KYX (KYC and KYB). Our vision for KYX is a world where every genuine business, business owner, their team, and everyone connected to them, onboards to Tide in minutes, unlocks the products they need as they grow, and never has to think twice about their data, while we identify bad actors, stop them at the door, continuously review their activity and off-board them the moment they're found.

You will be accountable for engineering strategy, organisation and execution across three domains. Onboarding KYX covers identity and access for registration and login, due diligence policy execution and vendor orchestration across the onboarding journey, and the risk scoring and agentic AI that assesses new applicants. Continuous KYX covers ongoing due diligence through periodic and event-triggered reviews, and how business owners bring their own team members onto their account. Risk Scoring is the KYX Scoring ML team whose models power decisions across both domains.

This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, member-facing conversion and applied AI. KYX Ops and KYX Policy set the rules you build for, Second Line of Defence sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise onboarding conversion and due diligence quality while driving the cost of KYX servicing per member down, and who can scale agentic solutions into workflows where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.

As Director of Engineering, KYX you will
• Own the engineering strategy and organisation for KYX, from onboarding identity, access and due diligence through continuous monitoring to risk scoring, unifying leadership that today sits in separate Onboarding and Continuous KYX lines.
• Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science and ML engineering, distributed across Hyderabad, Delhi, Sofia, Belgrade, Bucharest and Vilnius.
• Own KYX Scoring ML as a shared capability serving both onboarding and ongoing decisioning, including the model lifecycle end to end from development through backtesting and staged rollout to production monitoring.
• Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, from onboarding risk scoring through to screening, review and verification, in line with Tide's agentic governance framework.
• Work with KYX Ops, KYX Policy, Second Line of Defence and Product across the UK, EU and India, and with IAM on the still-to-be-sharpened boundary around login and access.
• Deliver measurable outcomes: higher automated decisioning rates, better due diligence and screening quality, and a falling KYX cost per member.
• Build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated.

This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. You will shape how quickly and how well we onboard members, how confidently we scale into new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
• Experience leading engineering organisations in identity, onboarding, fraud, financial crime or another regulated decisioning domain.
• Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes: conversion, due diligence quality, unit economics and workflow automation.
• Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live.
• Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with Ops, Policy and second line risk and compliance functions,
• Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality.
• Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and unify previously separate engineering lines behind one roadmap.
• Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight, would be a bonus.

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:
• Gross Annual Base Salary €100,000 to €140,650.
• Competitive Compensation - Competitive salary and share options.
• Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
• Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
• Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
• Health Insurance – Private health insurance with Bulgaria Zdrave, including extra dental care.
• Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
• Volunteering Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
• Learning Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
• WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
• Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
• Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
• Fully Covered Multi Sports Card – Granting access to hundreds of gyms and pools across Bulgaria.
• Monthly Food Vouchers -– Monthly food vouchers to enjoy your favorite meals with Edenred +
• Snacks Meals – Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices.

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

#LI-AC1 #LI-Remote

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

 

Disclaimer

• Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
• All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
• Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
• Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.

 

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.

Tide facts:

• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
• Over $300 million raised in funding
• 3,000 Tideans globally
• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE TEAM:

We are a close-knit team of around 20 lawyers based in the UK, Germany, France, India and Bulgaria. We are one of the most cross-functional teams in the company, helping Tideans accomplish their goals, grow the company and stay compliant. 

We place a lot of emphasis on team collaboration, honesty and support. We seek to make all new joiners feel part of Team Legal from day one. We're looking for an individual who'll not only fit into that team, but will bring new ideas, challenge us and roll up their sleeves when needed. We value business-minded lawyers who can provide pragmatic, actionable advice.

ABOUT

THE ROLE:

We are looking for a 5+ PQE UK-qualified or EU-qualified counsel who will join as a critical part of our team to help meet growing business needs and support our ambitious expansion plans.

As Employment Legal Counsel, you will have the opportunity to lead a wide range of legal initiatives in the employment area, providing strategic advice in a cross-jurisdictional context.

You will be able to lend your skills to a number of business areas across Tide with regular exposure to senior business stakeholders. 

As Employment Legal Counsel, you’ll be:
• Strategic HR Partnering: Serving as primary legal advisor to the People/HR team, Talent Acquisition, and executive leadership on all employment law matters.
• Cross-Border Workforce Expansion: Advising on international expansion, establishing local employment frameworks, Employer of Record (EoR) setups, contractor vs. employee classification assessments, and global mobility policies.
• Employment Litigation Disputes: Managing potential and active employment tribunal claims, grievances, disciplinaries and high-risk separations, including pre-action strategy and ACAS early conciliation. Supporting terminations across all of Tide’s jurisdictions, negotiating and drafting settlement agreements, and instructing and supervising external counsel.
• Incentives Executive Pay: Partnering on executive hires, restrictive covenants, retention strategies, and equity/incentive plan rules.
• Workplace Policies Compliance: Drafting and updating global employment contracts, handbooks and D I policies, and keeping Tide compliant with evolving employment laws across our operating hubs. This includes preparing for the phased reforms under the UK Employment Rights Act 2025, implementing pay transparency requirements, and managing working time rules across jurisdictions.
• M A / HR Due Diligence: Providing employment law input on corporate transactions, TUPE / business transfers, and post-acquisition HR integration.
• External Counsel Management: Managing local counsel across foreign jurisdictions efficiently and cost-effectively.
• Scale and Enablement: Further developing the collaboration between the Legal and People teams, building out processes, playbooks, escalation matrices and template banks. Designing and delivering training for managers, HR and the wider business on key employment law topics, and keeping stakeholders informed of legislative changes and their impact on Tide.

 

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR: 

You’ll have good working knowledge of technical areas of employment law in the UK and EU, particularly:
• Employment disputes (particularly in managing UK employment tribunal claims)
• Workforce restructuring (contractors to employees, temp workers to employees, remote to hybrid to on-site and vice versa, etc)
• HR compliance (employment laws, policies, frameworks)
• Discrimination, gender equality, pay transparency
• TUPE
• Whistleblowing
• Incentive plans, bonus schemes
• Working time arrangements, including on-call, shift work and averaged or aggregated working hours
• Settlement agreements
• Enforcement of restrictive covenants
• External counsel management
• You'll be strategically and commercially aware with an appreciation of the business
• Ability to build strong relationships with senior executives and stakeholders across the business

 

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN: 

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:
• The gross annual salary for this position ranges from €45,200 to €56,500 but we are also open to discussing the salary further, taking into account your expertise and contributions. Share options (equity) will be an additional aspect of your total reward
• 25 days paid annual leave
• 3 paid days off for volunteering or L D activities
• Extended maternity and paternity leave covered by the company
• Personal L D budget in the amount of 500 EUR per year
• Additional health dental insurance
• Mental wellbeing platform
• Fully covered Multisports card
• Food vouchers
• Snacks, light food, drinks in the office
• WFH equipment allowance
• Flexible working from home
• Sabbatical Leave

 

 

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

This is a predominantly remote role with occasional travel based on business needs. As a baseline, we anticipate bringing the team together in our Sofia office at least once a quarter.

 

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

ABOUT THE TEAM:
• The Company Formation (CoFo) team manages business registration and incorporation across multiple countries and jurisdictions by integrating with local government and third-party providers, and collaborating with strategic partners to utilize market-specific capabilities. Beyond registration, CoFo oversees the complete member onboarding lifecycle, ensuring cross-domain functionality and operability.
• To support our expansion into registering existing businesses and incorporating new ones in countries like Germany and France, the team is restructuring into two specialized focus areas:
• Established Markets: Dedicated to core operations in the UK.
• New Markets: A newly established team focused on scaling operations across Germany (DE) and France (FR).
• This position is critical to our growth and receives strong visibility from executive leadership. Because company formation is directly tied to new member onboarding, any friction in the process risks permanently losing prospective members. Consequently, building resilient, observable, and gracefully degradable services is essential for acquiring new members and successfully scaling into new markets.

ABOUT

THE ROLE:
• Lead and own the end-to-end delivery of company formation and business registration within the New Markets team, ensuring full compliance with local regulatory requirements and market-specific nuances.
• Architect, build, and maintain scalable distributed systems for seamless member onboarding with sustainable long-term strategy.
• Partner with the Established Markets team to extend a reusable core onboarding platform utilizing flexible state machines and market-specific adapters.
• Collaborate closely with product, compliance, and internal operations to define system architecture, execute key deliveries, and ensure all services are highly accurate, supportable, and fully compliant.
• Drive cross-functional engagement across domains to gain a complete understanding of their systems and optimise existing flows.
• Mentor and develop team members through active hands-on technical delivery and leadership.
• Guarantee high system stability, operational reliability, and performance by defining SLOs, improving observability tooling, and supporting effective on-call practices.
• Align with other engineering leaders to drive strategic cross-cutting infrastructure decisions and cross-team initiatives.
• Shape the team’s roadmap and vision for upcoming quarters, presenting strategic plans clearly to senior leadership.
• Manage team members, support their professional development, distribute workload, and ensure alignment on deliverable goals.
• Champion modern engineering practices by transitioning the team toward full-stack development and agentic workflows

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
• Tide is looking for a hands-on, technical Engineering Manager to direct the New Markets team, taking ownership of business registration and company formation capabilities across expanding markets.
• Key qualifications and skills required for this role:
• Proven track record in building and operating distributed systems
• Strong technical background (preferrably with the JVM ecosystem)
• Hands-on expertise with third-party service integrations
• Ability to lead, mentor, and empower engineering teams
• Strong self-drive and capability to operate autonomously
• Proactive problem solver who clears blockers for themselves and teammates
• Agile, adaptable mindset suited for a high-velocity environment
• Outstanding communication and stakeholder management capabilities
• Demonstrated experience with AI-assisted and agentic workflows

OUR TECH STACK: Our services run on AWS using Java and Spring Boot microservices, backed by AWS Aurora (PostgreSQL) as our primary database. Asynchronous and event-driven messaging is handled via AWS SNS / SQS. We use Coralogix for observability, Gradle for builds, and GitHub for CI/CD with automated testing, security scanning, and Kubernetes deployments via ArgoCD. Our mobile applications are built with Flutter, while our web platform is transitioning from Angular to Flutter (web). 

New joiners typically have something in production within their first two weeks. Claude Code is enabled for all engineers for agentic and AI-assisted development.

• 3 Paid Days off for Volunteering or L D Activities

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Payment Services
jobs.description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:
• Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
• Over $300 million raised in funding
• 3,000 Tideans globally
• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Accounts team is the platform layer behind how members open, manage, and understand their accounts at Tide. It owns account opening, regulatory compliance, account management, account switching (CASS), and the full transaction

experience:

the timeline at the centre of the app, transaction details and counterparty information, transaction history, statements, and exports. Every member who opens the app and looks at their balance or recent activity relies on this team. Tide is a global product used across regions, so the team works with different banking partners, regulatory regimes, and account structures, and it sits on top of Tide’s core ledger.

ABOUT THE ROLE 

As an Engineering Manager at Tide, you will lead the Accounts team. You will set its technical direction, own its delivery and reliability, and grow its engineers across backend, mobile, and web.
This is a product-facing platform team. A large share of the work shows up directly in the app, so you will work closely with product and design. It is also a financial system: a transaction that renders wrongly, a statement that does not reconcile, or an export that misses a record is a correctness problem, not a cosmetic one.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
• Leading the Accounts team across backend, Flutter mobile, and Angular web, setting its technical direction and holding it to delivery.
• Defining and maintaining the interface with the ledger: what the ledger guarantees, how Accounts services consume it, and who owns which data and schemas.
• Owning account opening, account management, and account switching (CASS), including the regulatory compliance that comes with them.
• Owning the member-facing transaction experience end to end: the timeline, transaction details, counterparty information, transaction history, statements, and exports.
• Setting technical direction for services that are read-heavy, data-rich, and tightly coupled to the app: performance, pagination and search at scale, data consistency with the ledger, and long-term architecture.
• Owning system stability and operational reliability for your services: SLOs, observability, on-call practice.
• Partnering with product, design, compliance, and operations to make sure what we ship is accurate, supportable, and compliant across all markets.
• Growing engineers at every level, across backend, mobile, and web. The team spans early-career through senior.
• Partnering with other teams at Tide that build on the Accounts platform, such as investment accounts and savings accounts, so the platform meets their needs.
• Aligning with other EMs across Banking on shared platform and infrastructure decisions. 

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Experience and background
• Meaningful engineering management experience. You have led teams through real delivery, not just been a strong tech lead. What matters is the quality of that experience, not the number of years
• Experience leading product-driven teams. You have worked closely with product and design and been accountable for customer outcomes, not just output
• A solid backend engineering foundation before moving into management, enough to earn credibility with the team and get into the detail when it matters
• Experience leading distributed, remote-first teams across time zones
• Proven experience aligning with senior leadership on deliveries and managing dependencies with neighboring teams
• Strong grasp of distributed systems: data consistency across services, reliability patterns, SLOs and SLAs, observability tooling

Technical depth
• Technically fluent: you can read the code, follow the architecture, and engage meaningfully with design decisions and production problems. You do not need to be shipping features regularly, but you need to understand what your team is building and why.
• Backend engineering in a strongly-typed language. Our stack is Java/Spring Boot, but Java experience is not a requirement. We want someone who can learn and work in our stack with confidence.
• Experience with microservices in a cloud-native environment (we are AWS heavy).
• Designing and operating APIs and data services that feed mobile and web clients: latency, pagination, caching, and backwards compatibility with released app versions.
• Relational database engineering, including data modelling and query performance for read-heavy workloads over large transaction histories.
• Event-driven and async systems experience.
• Familiarity with mobile and web delivery (Flutter and Angular, or similar), enough to make good trade-offs with client engineers.
• Exposure to agentic or AI-integrated systems, and engineering practices.

HOW YOU WORK
• You set technical direction and hold others to it. You are the person the team turns to when something is hard.
• You care about the member experience and about correctness in equal measure, and you do not let one erode the other.
• You are a good neighbor to other teams. You make interfaces explicit, agree expectations early, and treat partner teams across Banking as close collaborators.
• You communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders (product, design, compliance, operations) without losing precision.
• You develop engineers at every level, with a plan for each person.

OUR TECH STACK:
• Java, Spring Boot and JOOQ to build the RESTful APIs of our microservices (but we welcome people who are used to any strongly typed general purpose programming language!)
• Event-driven architecture with messages over SNS+SQS and Kafka to make them reliable
• Primary datastores are PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora (we are heavy AWS users)
• Docker, Terraform, ArgoCD and, EKS provided by the Cloud team to run the platform

• Growing engineers at every level, across backend, mobile, and web. The team spans early-career through senior.
• Partnering with other teams at Tide that build on the Accounts platform, such as investment accounts and savings accounts, so the platform meets their needs.

• A solid backend engineering foundation before moving into management, enough to earn credibility with the team and get into the detail when it matters
• Experience leading distributed, remote-first teams across time zones

• Advising senior stakeholders: giving the MLRO and Authorised Management timely, clear updates on control performance, incidents and remediation, and providing periodic reporting to senior leadership on control status, performance and emerging risks.
• Escalating with judgement: identifying and escalating material control weaknesses and emerging financial crime risks in line with governance protocols, with practical recommendations.
• Driving remediation: taking ownership of audit and compliance monitoring actions through to closure.
• Bridging first and second line: acting as the primary senior liaison between first line operations and the Compliance function, maintaining clear ownership boundaries and a constructive working relationship.
• Ensuring regulatory compliance: across EU and national requirements, including BaFin, ACPR, CSSF, Bank of Spain and Bank of Italy.

You thrive on ambiguity and take full ownership of a process or workflow from start to finish, building the structure and policies yourself without waiting for direction.

The successful candidate in this role will be focused on the following:
• Own key parts of the annual budget, quarterly reforecast and long-range planning cycles, from setting assumptions to final sign-off.
• Lead month-end performance reporting, including detailed variance analysis against budget and previous forecasts, with a clear explanation of what drove each variance and the outlook for the rest of the year.
• Build, maintain and improve driver-based financial models in our planning system (Aleph) that link operational drivers to P L, EBITDA and cash outcomes. Act as a subject matter expert for the system.
• Run scenario and sensitivity analysis and provide financial modelling and decision support on major initiatives, including organisational design, location strategy and large-scale investments, testing the impact of different growth, cost and investment options.
• Act as a Finance Business Partner to budget holders. Analyse spend and assumptions, support investment cases, and help leaders make informed trade-offs.
• Own the forecasting of people costs, including headcount, compensation, bonus and equity. Work with the People and Total Rewards teams so these costs are fully and accurately reflected in the plan.
• Maintain financial control over headcount and hiring approvals so that open roles stay in line with approved budgets.
• Flag risks and opportunities to the forecast early, using real-time operational data from source systems such as Workday and Greenhouse.
• Prepare insight-led reporting and investor/board materials for senior leadership, leading with conclusions supported by data. Build and automate the reports and dashboards behind them to cut manual effort and speed up decision-making.
• Track and analyse key business and cost-efficiency metrics, translating operational data into a financial story.
• Design and launch new FP A processes and policies independently, from scoping requirements through to adoption.
• Drive continuous improvement in FP A processes, data quality and tooling, including integrations between Aleph and our core finance and operational systems.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
• 7+ years of progressive experience in FP A, corporate finance or a similar role, ideally in a fast-growth tech or scale-up business. Experience with headcount or people-cost planning is a plus.
• Strong track record of owning core FP A processes from start to finish, including budgeting, re-forecasting, long-range planning and month-end reporting.
• Proven ability to build and maintain driver-based financial models, including people-cost and compensation drivers, that connect operating activity to financial outcomes.
• Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of an ambiguous process. This means taking a loosely defined problem, scoping the requirements yourself, designing the process, getting stakeholders to adopt it, and keeping it running over time with minimal direction.
• Excellent business partnering skills with budget holders and senior leaders, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and influence decisions.
• Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills and hands-on experience with dedicated FP A planning tools (e.g. Aleph, Anaplan, Adaptive, Pigment).
• Strong data skills, including hands-on SQL for pulling and analysing complex datasets.
• A systems mindset, with experience managing data flows between the planning tool and source systems such as the ERP/GL, HRIS (e.g. Workday) or ATS (e.g. Greenhouse).

• Docker, Terraform, EKS/Kubernetes used by the Cloud team to run the platform

The Data Platform Engineering team builds the platform that Tide's data producers and consumers rely on: backend engineers, data engineers, data scientists and, increasingly, AI agents. We own how data is produced, moved, stored, modelled, governed and served across the UK, EU and India, on GCP with BigQuery at the core.

Our mission is to make the right way the easy way: self-service capabilities with quality, security and cost controls built into the infrastructure, judged by whether teams choose to adopt them, not whether we mandate them.

About The Role

As Lead Engineer, Data Platform, you will be a hands-on individual contributor who leads platform initiatives within a clear technical direction set by the Data Infrastructure team. You will own small-medium platform initiatives and quarterly goals, taking them from design through to shipping and running them in production, and you will work closely with the Data Infrastructure Engineering Manager and the wider platform team.

In this role you will
• Design and deliver self-service paths so engineers can onboard new sources, datasets and pipelines without a ticket queue, with access, masking, quality and cost controls defined in infrastructure as code and CI/CD.
• Improve ingestion and transformation capabilities so data is fresher and more reliable, handling ordering, duplicates, late data, deletes, replay and backfill, and migrate pipelines without breaking downstream tables.
• Apply governance in what you build: residency, PII masking, least-privilege and just-in-time access, retention and erasure, and lineage.
• Set SLOs, freshness and quality checks, and alerting that tells on-call what matters.
• Find the main cost drivers in data platforms and pipelines, and add guardrails and attribution that teams can act on.
• Break work into phases that ship, with clear milestones, a migration path and a way to measure adoption.
• Use AI-assisted development to build and run the platform faster, and help prepare governed, well-described data that agents can use safely.
• Treat internal engineers as customers: write clear documentation and golden paths, and act on their feedback.
• Review designs and code for other engineers, and raise the bar for production-grade data and API work.

What We Are Looking For

Tide is looking for a hands-on Lead Engineer to deliver platform initiatives end to end and raise the quality of our data platform. We value what you have shipped and operated over job titles or team size. The ideal candidate will have:
• Independently designed, shipped and operated a meaningful platform or data infrastructure initiative used by internal engineering teams.
• Solid data engineering fundamentals: batch and streaming ingestion, CDC and event-driven patterns, data modelling, and correctness (idempotency, ordering, late data, backfill).
• Strong production engineering in Python and SQL, including building and operating APIs, pipelines or shared libraries.
• Practical infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent) and CI/CD for data and infrastructure, including IAM across environments.
• Working knowledge of data governance in practice: PII masking, access control, residency, retention and lineage.
• Observability for data pipelines: freshness and quality checks, SLOs, alert thresholds and incident response.
• The ability to justify technology choices against requirements, with an order-of-magnitude view of cost and capacity.
• Hands-on use of AI-assisted development with sound engineering judgement. Experience enabling AI tooling for engineering teams is highly preferred.
• Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to explain trade-offs to engineers and non-engineers across teams and time zones.
• Nice to have:

experience with global, decentralised teams, and in financial services or other regulated environments.

You do not need to match every tool below. Comparable cloud and data tooling experience is welcome.

 

OUR TECH STACK

Our data platform runs on GCP: BigQuery as our warehouse, Fivetran and event-driven ingestion, dbt, Apache Airflow (AWS MWAA), Looker, Atlan, Databricks, Terraform, GitHub, ConductorOne and Okta, Coralogix, and Claude for AI-assisted development. This role will suit an individual that can operate with a high degree of independence and has hands-on experience of proactively working with the product community. You are an expert and constructive critique of digital products with strong views on data-driven techniques to improve adoption and engagement of various products features. You will be working as a part of the product squad with a functional reporting into the Lead of Growth Product Analytics. 

Some of the things you’ll be doing:
• Product Discovery - hypothesis driven deep dives (existing product usage data) to identify user problems, quantify size of the problem and highlight solution(s) to impact revenue.
• Solution Confidence - product experiments are a means to an end. They help us produce data to build confidence on the product features we plan to invest in. You would be the champion of product experimentation and would observe data, propose, design and analyse product experiments.
• Product and Feature Performance Review - new features solve user user problems and drive product usage and thus adoption. You would work with product teams to identify features that need to be shipped, scaled or killed.
• User Research - solving user problems helps us achieve commercial goals. You would identify opportunities, perform data deep dives (exploratory and hypothesis driven) to improve our collective understanding of user problems and assist working groups to focus on and prioritise high impact user problems.
• Goals to KPI Translations - you would work with product managers to break overall revenue goals into business KPIs, identify impact hypotheses and convert into measurable product KPIs. You would work with analytics engineers to enable KPI reporting through visually speaking dashboards.
• Experimentation Product Growth - you will operate with a high degree of user behaviour awareness (backed by consistent event data observation) and assist product managers by designing experiments to drive product adoption. You would use custom data analysis and statistical methods to analyse experiment results.
• Self Serve Product Analytics - partner with data, engineering, data product and data science teams to deliver a world-class self-serve event data analytics platform for app and web products. Our experimentation stack includes platforms like LaunchDarkly for shipping variants, Segment for events, Heap for visualisation. You would be required to partner with data-science teams to build a stats-engine for relevant KPIs for each product enabling a seamless self-serve analytics for business and product teams.

Here at Tide, we are looking for a seasoned Manager who
• has a good understanding of the Trust and Safety domain with expertise in an e-commerce environment.
• Willingness to operate in a fast paced growing product line within Tide called Commercial Services that primarily focus on enabling Small and Medium Enterprises (SME Businesses) to sell their products online
• has understanding on Financial Crime Typologies including money laundering, fraud, online safety, trust and safety
• is passionate and proactive, who will help ensure Tide is taking all relevant steps to detect and prevent all aspects of fraud, financial crime.

• has exceptional communication skills in English (both Written and Speaking).
• can motivate the team and work in an extremely fast paced environment
• can use expert judgement to recommend articulating risks

 

As a Manager Commercial Services (AML PA), you’ll be:

Key Responsibilities
• Strategic Leadership and Operational Management:
• Lead, scale, and empower a high-performing team of Trust and Safety Specialists who also will work on AML Transaction Monitoring and Payment Sanctions Screening
• Primary focus will be towards Trust Safety operations but the role scope will cover AML Transaction Monitoring and Payment Sanctions Screening.
• Drive operational excellence across ongoing monitoring, alert review, and risk assessment workflows to maintain strict SLA compliance.
• Define performance metrics, oversee talent development, and champion continuous training in Trust and Safety Risks and financial crime typologies.
• Establish resource allocation strategies to efficiently balance operational workload and backlogs across financial services oversight.

Risk Governance and Quality Assurance:
• Serve as the final internal escalation authority for complex Trust Safety investigations.
• Ensure robust control mechanisms are in place to address evolving financial crime and trust threats specific to Commercial Services product offerings (online listings)
• Extreme ownership in leading conversations with cross functional stakeholders such as Product Development team, engineering teams, policy and procedures to drive a rapidly growing product line
• Manage and prioritize alert backlogs to mitigate risk and ensure timely resolution.
• Subject Matter Expertise and Compliance:
• Maintain deep domain expertise in financial services, Online safety Act, international sanctions screening regimes, and AML risks
• Provide strategic oversight on emerging Trust and Safety standards, financial crime typologies, and illegal transaction pattern detection.
• Act as a subject matter expert (SME) on complex cases, offering guidance on investigation strategies and documentation.
• Process Optimization and System Enhancements:
• Partner with Product, Engineering, and Analytics teams to optimize automated rules to detect risks related to Trust and Safety standards and financial crime typologies
• Leverage data analytics to identify risk trends, eliminate operational bottlenecks, and minimize false positives in payments sanctions screening.
• Analyze data to identify trends, patterns, and inefficiencies, and recommend solutions to reduce false positives and improve detection effectiveness.
• Stakeholder Management and Reporting:
