ABOUT THE ROLE

The Tide Security Engineering team is made up of three core areas: Product Security, Identity, Threat Detection Response

Product Security consists of application and cloud security experts. Their mission is to protect the products we build, covering everything from secure design reviews to threat modelling and penetration testing, ensuring security is embedded from the ground up.

Threat Detection Response (this role!) focuses on protecting the company by building a robust detection and automation platform. We’re proactive in our defence, constantly hacking ourselves to improve our security posture and staying ahead of emerging threats. Our goal is to make Tide resilient against the ever-evolving threat landscape.

Identity is responsible for managing Tide's staff identity platform, ensuring that access to systems and infrastructure is secure, seamless, and aligned with modern security practices. The team uses strategies like zero trust, multi-factor authentication, and granular role-based access controls to safeguard our internal operations.

While each area has its own focus, collaboration is key - it's why we share the same Slack channel and hold our standups together as one cohesive team, ensuring alignment and seamless communication across all security functions.

As a Security Operations Responder, you’ll be on the front line of defending Tide. Your primary focus is actively investigating threats through our security data lake and SOAR platform – but we don’t want anyone working the same alert by hand twice. Your goal is to make investigation effective at scale: cutting manual effort through automation, and working hand-in-hand with our Detection Engineering team to improve the true positive / false positive efficacy of what lands in the queue.

When the security queue is empty, you’ll be building – automations, enrichment and your own detections. An open mind and a curious approach are key: every investigation is a chance to make the next one faster and sharper.

As a Security Operations Responder, you’ll be:

Investigating and responding to threats (your primary focus)
• Actively triaging and investigating security alerts and threats through our security data lake and SOAR platform, across AWS, GCP, SaaS (such as Google Workspace and Okta), internal applications and employee endpoints (Windows, macOS).
• Driving every investigation to a clear, well-evidenced outcome – establishing scope, impact and root cause, and taking containment and remediation actions quickly and confidently.
• Leading the response to complex or high-severity incidents where needed, coordinating across security, IT and engineering teams through containment, remediation and recovery.
• Documenting investigations clearly and consistently, and contributing to the runbooks and investigation standards the whole team works to.

Scaling investigation through automation Improving detection efficacy
• Reducing manual investigation by building SOAR playbooks, security automations and services – from data enrichment and context gathering through to automated response, such as removing phishing emails from employee mailboxes. We want you to run with the “anything is possible” mantra.
• Spotting repetitive work in the queue and turning it into automated workflows, so the team’s time goes on the investigations that genuinely need human judgement.
• Identifying gaps in log sources, parsing and enrichment in the data lake, and working to close them so investigations have the visibility they need.
• Feeding investigation outcomes back to the Detection Engineering team – flagging noisy rules, tuning false positives and highlighting coverage gaps – to continuously improve TP/FP efficacy.
• Tracking investigation metrics (such as MTTD, MTTR, TP/FP rate and automation coverage) and using them to prioritise where to improve next.

Building when the queue is clear
• Writing, testing and shipping your own detections alongside Detection Engineering, following our test-driven, detections-as-code practices.
• Proactively hunting for sophisticated threats across our infrastructure, using threat intelligence and lessons from past investigations to stay ahead of attackers.
• Building or enhancing internal tools that streamline investigation, improve data visibility and increase response efficiency.
• Sharing knowledge and mentoring other members of the team, raising the bar for how we investigate and respond.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
• Significant hands-on experience in security operations, incident response or threat investigation, ideally in a cloud-native environment.
• Strong investigative instincts and log analysis skills at scale, with the ability to query a security data lake or SIEM fluently – strong knowledge of one of the following: Splunk, Scanner, Sentinel, SecOps.
• Strong understanding of modern attack and defence techniques which apply to Cloud (AWS, GCP), SaaS (such as Google Workspace and Okta) and desktop (Windows and macOS) environments, and the ability to map activity to frameworks such as MITRE ATT CK.
• Strong experience in security automation, from writing scripts (e.g. Python) to creating end-to-end automated workflows. Familiarity with SOAR platforms and automating investigation and response tasks.
• Experience writing or tuning detections, and a clear view of what separates a high-fidelity alert from a noisy one.
• Calm, methodical judgement during live incidents, including knowing when and how to escalate.
• An open mind and a curious approach – you enjoy pulling on threads, and you don’t stop at “false positives” without understanding why.
• Hands-on attitude and the ability to drive solutions to completion.
• Passion for passing on knowledge to fellow colleagues.
• Excellent spoken and written communication skills, including clear investigation write-ups for both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Bonus points if you have a repository showcasing automations, detections or tooling you’ve built.

jobs.description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Tide Security Engineering team is made up of three core areas: Product Security, Identity, Threat Detection Response

Product Security consists of application and cloud security experts. Their mission is to protect the products we build, covering everything from secure design reviews to threat modelling and penetration testing, ensuring security is embedded from the ground up.

Threat Detection Response (this role!) focuses on protecting the company by building a robust detection and automation platform. We’re proactive in our defence, constantly hacking ourselves to improve our security posture and staying ahead of emerging threats. Our goal is to make Tide resilient against the ever-evolving threat landscape.

Identity is responsible for managing Tide's staff identity platform, ensuring that access to systems and infrastructure is secure, seamless, and aligned with modern security practices. The team uses strategies like zero trust, multi-factor authentication, and granular role-based access controls to safeguard our internal operations.

While each area has its own focus, collaboration is key - it's why we share the same Slack channel and hold our standups together as one cohesive team, ensuring alignment and seamless communication across all security functions.

As a Security Operations Responder, you’ll be on the front line of defending Tide. Your primary focus is actively investigating threats through our security data lake and SOAR platform – but we don’t want anyone working the same alert by hand twice. Your goal is to make investigation effective at scale: cutting manual effort through automation, and working hand-in-hand with our Detection Engineering team to improve the true positive / false positive efficacy of what lands in the queue.

When the security queue is empty, you’ll be building – automations, enrichment and your own detections. An open mind and a curious approach are key: every investigation is a chance to make the next one faster and sharper.

As a Security Operations Responder, you’ll be:

Investigating and responding to threats (your primary focus)
• Actively triaging and investigating security alerts and threats through our security data lake and SOAR platform, across AWS, GCP, SaaS (such as Google Workspace and Okta), internal applications and employee endpoints (Windows, macOS).
• Driving every investigation to a clear, well-evidenced outcome – establishing scope, impact and root cause, and taking containment and remediation actions quickly and confidently.
• Leading the response to complex or high-severity incidents where needed, coordinating across security, IT and engineering teams through containment, remediation and recovery.
• Documenting investigations clearly and consistently, and contributing to the runbooks and investigation standards the whole team works to.

Scaling investigation through automation Improving detection efficacy
• Reducing manual investigation by building SOAR playbooks, security automations and services – from data enrichment and context gathering through to automated response, such as removing phishing emails from employee mailboxes. We want you to run with the “anything is possible” mantra.
• Spotting repetitive work in the queue and turning it into automated workflows, so the team’s time goes on the investigations that genuinely need human judgement.
• Identifying gaps in log sources, parsing and enrichment in the data lake, and working to close them so investigations have the visibility they need.
• Feeding investigation outcomes back to the Detection Engineering team – flagging noisy rules, tuning false positives and highlighting coverage gaps – to continuously improve TP/FP efficacy.
• Tracking investigation metrics (such as MTTD, MTTR, TP/FP rate and automation coverage) and using them to prioritise where to improve next.

Building when the queue is clear
• Writing, testing and shipping your own detections alongside Detection Engineering, following our test-driven, detections-as-code practices.
• Proactively hunting for sophisticated threats across our infrastructure, using threat intelligence and lessons from past investigations to stay ahead of attackers.
• Building or enhancing internal tools that streamline investigation, improve data visibility and increase response efficiency.
• Sharing knowledge and mentoring other members of the team, raising the bar for how we investigate and respond.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
• Significant hands-on experience in security operations, incident response or threat investigation, ideally in a cloud-native environment.
• Strong investigative instincts and log analysis skills at scale, with the ability to query a security data lake or SIEM fluently – strong knowledge of one of the following: Splunk, Scanner, Sentinel, SecOps.
• Strong understanding of modern attack and defence techniques which apply to Cloud (AWS, GCP), SaaS (such as Google Workspace and Okta) and desktop (Windows and macOS) environments, and the ability to map activity to frameworks such as MITRE ATT CK.
• Strong experience in security automation, from writing scripts (e.g. Python) to creating end-to-end automated workflows. Familiarity with SOAR platforms and automating investigation and response tasks.
• Experience writing or tuning detections, and a clear view of what separates a high-fidelity alert from a noisy one.
• Calm, methodical judgement during live incidents, including knowing when and how to escalate.
• An open mind and a curious approach – you enjoy pulling on threads, and you don’t stop at “false positives” without understanding why.
• Hands-on attitude and the ability to drive solutions to completion.
• Passion for passing on knowledge to fellow colleagues.
• Excellent spoken and written communication skills, including clear investigation write-ups for both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Bonus points if you have a repository showcasing automations, detections or tooling you’ve built.

Tide facts:
• Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
• Over $300 million raised in funding
• 3,000 Tideans globally
• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Tide Security Engineering team is made up of three core areas: Product Security, Identity, Threat Detection Response

Product Security consists of application and cloud security experts. Their mission is to protect the products we build, covering everything from secure design reviews to threat modelling and penetration testing, ensuring security is embedded from the ground up.

Threat Detection Response (this role!) focuses on protecting the company by building a robust detection and automation platform. We’re proactive in our defence, constantly hacking ourselves to improve our security posture and staying ahead of emerging threats. Our goal is to make Tide resilient against the ever-evolving threat landscape.

Identity is responsible for managing Tide's staff identity platform, ensuring that access to systems and infrastructure is secure, seamless, and aligned with modern security practices. The team uses strategies like zero trust, multi-factor authentication, and granular role-based access controls to safeguard our internal operations.

While each area has its own focus, collaboration is key - it's why we share the same Slack channel and hold our standups together as one cohesive team, ensuring alignment and seamless communication across all security functions.

As a Security Operations Responder, you’ll be on the front line of defending Tide. Your primary focus is actively investigating threats through our security data lake and SOAR platform – but we don’t want anyone working the same alert by hand twice. Your goal is to make investigation effective at scale: cutting manual effort through automation, and working hand-in-hand with our Detection Engineering team to improve the true positive / false positive efficacy of what lands in the queue.

When the security queue is empty, you’ll be building – automations, enrichment and your own detections. An open mind and a curious approach are key: every investigation is a chance to make the next one faster and sharper.

As a Security Operations Responder, you’ll be:

Investigating and responding to threats (your primary focus)
• Actively triaging and investigating security alerts and threats through our security data lake and SOAR platform, across AWS, GCP, SaaS (such as Google Workspace and Okta), internal applications and employee endpoints (Windows, macOS).
• Driving every investigation to a clear, well-evidenced outcome – establishing scope, impact and root cause, and taking containment and remediation actions quickly and confidently.
• Leading the response to complex or high-severity incidents where needed, coordinating across security, IT and engineering teams through containment, remediation and recovery.
• Documenting investigations clearly and consistently, and contributing to the runbooks and investigation standards the whole team works to.

Scaling investigation through automation Improving detection efficacy
• Reducing manual investigation by building SOAR playbooks, security automations and services – from data enrichment and context gathering through to automated response, such as removing phishing emails from employee mailboxes. We want you to run with the “anything is possible” mantra.
• Spotting repetitive work in the queue and turning it into automated workflows, so the team’s time goes on the investigations that genuinely need human judgement.
• Identifying gaps in log sources, parsing and enrichment in the data lake, and working to close them so investigations have the visibility they need.
• Feeding investigation outcomes back to the Detection Engineering team – flagging noisy rules, tuning false positives and highlighting coverage gaps – to continuously improve TP/FP efficacy.
• Tracking investigation metrics (such as MTTD, MTTR, TP/FP rate and automation coverage) and using them to prioritise where to improve next.

Building when the queue is clear
• Writing, testing and shipping your own detections alongside Detection Engineering, following our test-driven, detections-as-code practices.
• Proactively hunting for sophisticated threats across our infrastructure, using threat intelligence and lessons from past investigations to stay ahead of attackers.
• Building or enhancing internal tools that streamline investigation, improve data visibility and increase response efficiency.
• Sharing knowledge and mentoring other members of the team, raising the bar for how we investigate and respond.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
• Significant hands-on experience in security operations, incident response or threat investigation, ideally in a cloud-native environment.
• Strong investigative instincts and log analysis skills at scale, with the ability to query a security data lake or SIEM fluently – strong knowledge of one of the following: Splunk, Scanner, Sentinel, SecOps.
• Strong understanding of modern attack and defence techniques which apply to Cloud (AWS, GCP), SaaS (such as Google Workspace and Okta) and desktop (Windows and macOS) environments, and the ability to map activity to frameworks such as MITRE ATT CK.
• Strong experience in security automation, from writing scripts (e.g. Python) to creating end-to-end automated workflows. Familiarity with SOAR platforms and automating investigation and response tasks.
• Experience writing or tuning detections, and a clear view of what separates a high-fidelity alert from a noisy one.
• Calm, methodical judgement during live incidents, including knowing when and how to escalate.
• An open mind and a curious approach – you enjoy pulling on threads, and you don’t stop at “false positives” without understanding why.
• Hands-on attitude and the ability to drive solutions to completion.
• Passion for passing on knowledge to fellow colleagues.
• Excellent spoken and written communication skills, including clear investigation write-ups for both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Bonus points if you have a repository showcasing automations, detections or tooling you’ve built.

 

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN: 

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:
• 25 days paid annual leave
• 3 paid days off for volunteering or L D activities
• Extended maternity and paternity leave covered by the company
• Personal L D budget in the amount of 500 EUR per year
• Additional health dental insurance
• Mental wellbeing platform
• Fully covered Multisports card
• Food vouchers
• Snacks, light food, drinks in the office
• WFH equipment allowance
• Flexible working from home
• Sabbatical Leave
• Share options

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

 

#LI-MP1

#LI-Remote

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

• 3,000 Tideans globally
• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE TEAM
The Ledger team owns the core ledger. It's the system of record behind every account, balance and payment at Tide. Payments, cards and lending all sit on top of it. If it's slow or wrong, members can't pay people, and that hits their business directly. The team works on this one problem.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Tide is growing into new markets and new products, and the ledger has to scale with that. We're rewriting it and migrating to the new version. The goals are better performance for members and a foundation that keeps up as volumes and products grow. You'll help design it and deliver it.

This is a hands-on role in one team, working on one problem. You'll do architecture, system design, coding and mentoring. You won't have direct reports, but you'll own the technical direction of the ledger. You'll partner closely with the team's Engineering Manager and Product Manager, and lead by example.
We're also changing how we build and test. The team uses AI and agentic tools to deliver working software. We're applying the same approach to functional and performance testing, so we can deliver this work in a fraction of the time it would have taken before. You'll help shape how that works.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
• Design and own the architecture of the new ledger, and make the trade-off calls
• Write production code and review the team's, so the quality bar is clear
• Plan and lead the migration from the current ledger: staged rollouts, parallel running, reconciliation and rollback, with a small blast radius for every change
• Use AI and agentic tools to deliver faster, and help build AI-assisted functional and performance testing
• Own performance and reliability: latency budgets, SLOs and capacity as volumes grow
• Mentor and coach engineers at every level
• Partner with the Engineering Manager and Product Manager, and with the teams that build on the ledger
• Contribute to our Communities of Practice

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
Experience and background:
• You've built and run high-volume, real-time distributed systems with hard constraints, such as the time allowed to authorise a transaction
• You've worked on systems that are too important to fail, where an outage stops customers doing business. That could be in payments, FX, trading, gambling, finance or similar. Payments or banking experience is a bonus, not a requirement
• You've changed critical systems safely: rewrites, migrations and rollouts where you kept the blast radius small
• You've used agentic AI tools such as Claude to deliver working software, and changed how you work to get the best out of them. You believe in this approach
• You've mentored other engineers and set technical direction for a team, without being their line manager

Technical depth:
• Strong backend engineering in a strongly typed language. Java is preferred, but design and architecture skills matter more than the language
• Distributed systems: consistency, idempotency, concurrency, ordering and failure modes
• Relational databases at scale, ideally PostgreSQL: transactions, locking, and data modelling for correctness and performance
• Performance engineering: profiling, latency budgets and load testing
• Event-driven and asynchronous design
• Running services in a cloud-native environment (we are AWS-heavy)
• Testing: functional, performance and resilience

How you work:
• You make pragmatic trade-offs and can explain them
• You lead by example
• You coach and develop the engineers around you
• You use your authority well: you explain your decisions and bring people with you
• You can talk to non-technical stakeholders without losing precision
• Our tech stack
• Java and PostgreSQL, running on AWS
• Event-driven architecture with messaging over SNS and SQS
• Observability with Coralogix
• GitHub for CI/CD with automated testing and security scanning. New joiners typically have something in production within their first two weeks
• AI coding and agentic tools, including Claude, as part of everyday engineering

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN
• The gross monthly salary for this position ranges from 7500€ to 11000€, depending on your skills and experience
• Private Health Insurance
• 3rd Pillar Pension Fund Contribution
• 25 days Paid Annual Leave
• 3 Paid Days off for Volunteering or L D Activities
• Parental Leave days
• Family-Friendly Leave
• Personal L D Budget in the amount of 500€ per year
• Mental wellbeing platform Plumm
• WFH Equipment Allowance
• Sabbatical Leave
• Share options
• Team Events

• Confident scripting in Python, Bash and PowerShell, and comfort working with REST APIs.

• Deep hands-on Google Workspace administration at enterprise scale, including automation with GAM/GAMADV-XTD3, the Admin SDK APIs or Apps Script.
• Production experience designing and running Netskope or a comparable SSE/SASE platform (Zscaler, Prisma Access, Cloudflare One), including ZTNA and DLP.
• Strong experience with both Jamf Pro and Microsoft Intune, running a mixed Mac and Windows fleet end to end.
• Solid grasp of identity and access: SAML, OIDC, SCIM, MFA, conditional access and device trust.
• Clear, confident communication with engineers, stakeholders and non-technical users alike.

• Admin-level experience with Jira, Confluence and Jira Service Management, including JSM automation and Assets.
• Experience in fintech or regulated financial services (FCA, DORA, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2).
• Working knowledge of GCP and AWS, particularly IAM and networking relevant to ZTNA.
• Relevant certifications (Google Workspace Administrator, Jamf 300/400, Netskope NSK200/300, MD-102, Atlassian ACP).

The Tide Security Engineering team is made up of three core areas: Product Security, Threat Detection Response, and Identity.

Product Security (this role!) consists of application and cloud security experts. Their mission is to protect the products we build, covering everything from secure design reviews to threat modelling and penetration testing, ensuring security is embedded from the ground up.

Threat Detection Response focuses on protecting the company by building a robust detection and automation platform. We’re proactive in our defence, constantly hacking ourselves to improve our security posture and staying ahead of emerging threats. Our goal is to make Tide resilient against the ever-evolving threat landscape.

Identity is responsible for managing Tide's staff identity platform, ensuring that access to systems and infrastructure is secure, seamless, and aligned with modern security practices. The team uses strategies like zero trust, multi-factor authentication, and granular role-based access controls to safeguard our internal operations.

While each area has its own focus, collaboration is key - it's why we share the same Slack channel and hold our standups together as one cohesive team, ensuring alignment and seamless communication across all security functions.

• Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes across fraud detection and mitigation, unit economics reduction and workflows automation
• Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live and fast iteration of model development
• Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with second line risk and compliance functions and with regulators

The engineering, data science and platform capability behind it is one of the most technically demanding estates at Tide.

You will be accountable for the engineering strategy, organisation and execution across all Ongoing Monitoring value streams: real-time transaction monitoring for bank payments fraud, acquiring fraud, Anti Money Laundering, Counter Terrorist Financing, sanctions and prohibited activities monitoring, and the tooling our financial investigators depend on. That means ML models in production, agentic AI inside regulated workflows, and multi-market screening infrastructure that stands up to regulatory scrutiny.

This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, near real-time platform engineering and applied AI. Our first line operations teams are the primary internal customer, our second line sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise detection quality and reduce fraud losses while driving the cost of monitoring per member down, and scale agentic solutions where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.

As VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring you will:
• Set the engineering strategy for Tide's fraud, financial crime and ongoing monitoring platforms
• Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science, ML engineering and analytics engineering, primarily based in Hyderabad with product leadership split between Hyderabad and London
• Lead managers and senior engineers, and build the leadership bench underneath you
• Work with multiple stakeholders across risk, operations, business, design, product and engineering
• Own the Decision Engine and Decision Intelligence Platform as shared capabilities, unifying domestic and international payment flows
• Own the model lifecycle end to end, from development through backtesting, shadow deployment and staged rollout to production performance monitoring
• Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, including migrating Ongoing Monitoring agents onto Tide's shared agentic infrastructure and holding the line on our agentic governance framework
• Deliver measurable risk and efficiency outcomes: lower fraud losses, higher automated alert throughput, and a falling ongoing monitoring cost per member
• Build the operating model that connects first line operations, second line risk and compliance, payments and acquiring engineering, KYX, AI Platforms and data science leadership behind one roadmap
• Apply principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated

This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. Ongoing Monitoring is where we prove that trust scales, across every transaction we process. You will shape how quickly we protect our members, how confidently we enter new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
• Experience leading engineering organisations in fraud, financial crime, risk or another real-time decisioning domain
• Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes across fraud detection and mitigation, unit economics reduction and workflows automation
• Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live and fast iteration of model development
• Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with second line risk and compliance functions and with regulators
• Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality
• Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and align several functions behind one roadmap, operating model and set of priorities
• Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight would be a bonus

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

jobs.title: Product Lead - Money Laundering Prevention
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Product Lead to join our Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Squad to make a meaningful dent in global financial crime.

 

The AML Squad works across our offices in London and Tallinn. We are growing the Squad, and adding new teams to make faster progress in our fight against crime.

 

Wise moves £145B+ annually across borders and customers love us for how easy and how cheap it is. You know who else loves moving money cheaply across borders? Criminals looking to launder proceeds of crime.

 

This is where you come in. Our vision is clean money without borders. You’ll dive deep into criminal typologies, become an expert in how international crime takes place, and build advanced systems that prevent hyper-targeted, regional, criminal behaviour.

 

About the AML Squad

The AML Squad owns all anti-money laundering, terrorism financing and human exploitation typologies and risks. This includes customer risk scoring, risk prevention, live risk detection, investigations and reporting to Financial Intelligence Units across the globe.

 

The AML Squad is broken down into groups: AML Prevent, AML Detect and FinCrime Intelligence Exchange. This role sits within the AML Prevent Group. You’ll be the Product Lead for the group. 

 

The purpose of the AML Prevent Group is three fold:
• Prevent the onboarding of customers who present an out of appetite risk of money laundering, terrorism financing, or human exploitation typologies.
• For borderline cases, define and deploy the right enhanced due diligence (EDD) controls that must be passed before onboarding, in order for the customer to be within appetite risk of the above typologies.
• Monitor the changes in customer profile and transactions that indicate increased risk of the above typologies, and if required re-apply the EDD controls to ensure the customer remains within risk appetite, and can remain on the platform.
• You might have noticed the above AML Squad metrics are primarily about detection. The preventative focus is a new mission for the squad, and part of the role will include defining and maturing the right metrics to measure success.
• You’ll be responsible for setting strategy for the group, setting the product end state vision for the group.
• You’ll also define the right org design as we grow the group, hiring the right product folks and while managing and developing an existing Principal Product Manager, Senior Product Manager and Associate Product Manager.

 

You’ll own the challenge of:
• Setting new standards of preventing hyper specific and regional crime at scale, in a way that satisfies our regulatory obligations globally and works financially for our business.
• Working with regional compliance officers to deliver global controls that have a strong reputation with local regulators and law enforcement.
• Working with data scientists, product analysts, product designers, product compliance managers, operations leads and software engineers to ensure the team ship the best possible product. One that maximises money laundering prevention, at the lowest possible operational cost, and minimises good customer friction.

 

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Choose your own path to success - you’ll have the freedom to define the vision and the responsibility for making it happen
• Be flexible in how and where you work, we understand everyone needs a little something different so we’ll do our best to make it happen
• Travel to work with our teams in London and Tallinn as well as meet various partners and organisations globally when needed
• Inspire teams with your ideas, knowledge and self-starting attitude

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer – Tooling Platform
jobs.description:
We're looking for an exceptional Staff Product Designer to join our award-winning design team in London. You'll design the tools our investigators use to keep customers and their money safe, and help set the standards that other teams build on. You'll be part of Wise's global mission to build an open, fair, and human financial system. Because people without borders need money without borders.

Your mission:

Every day, our teams review customer accounts to spot and stop financial crime, fraud and other risks. Many of these reviews are complex. An investigator has to piece together many signals about a customer, decide what matters and reach a clear outcome. Our tools don't yet support these reviews as well as they could.

You'll lead the design work on this problem. As a Staff designer, you'll work with product, engineering, analytics and research in the Tooling Platform team, and with the designers across servicing, fraud and financial crime whose teams use it. You'll be hands-on from day one, and your role will grow with the platform.

What you'll be doing:
• Designing complex reviews. You'll start with investigative reviews, understanding how investigators build a picture of a customer and designing experiences that are faster and more reliable.
• Helping set the standard. Over time, you'll help define what "good" looks like for servicing tools and turn it into patterns teams can reuse and adopt.
• Looking after Wise Base. You'll maintain, improve and contribute to Wise Base, the design system we own for our servicing tools.
• Designing for people and AI assistants. You'll shape how investigators and AI assistants work together, from what the assistant suggests to the person's sign-off.
• Influencing across teams. You'll shape priorities with product partners and senior stakeholders, and raise the quality of design work across the squad.

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Ship work you're proud of. Craft tools that are clear, fast and trusted by the people who use them every day.
• Own your impact. Decide which problems matter most, and define how we measure success.
• Lead by making. Use prototypes and real cases to build conviction, and bring teams with you.
• Be part of a positive change in the world. We're fixing a broken, greedy system, and putting people and businesses in control of their money.

About you
• Exceptional craft. You're a seasoned designer whose portfolio shows impactful work, ideally including complex tools for expert users.
• Systems thinker. You've worked with design systems, and you turn one-off problems into patterns that scale.
• Experienced with AI. You use AI in your design work, or have designed for it.
• Strategic partner. You connect design choices to outcomes for users and the business, and you define the problem when the brief isn't clear.
• Clear communicator. You tell stories that bring product, engineering and senior stakeholders with you.
• Collaborative by default. You work in the open with product, engineering, analytics and research, and help other designers grow.

We're people without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We want to work with the best people, no matter their background. So if you're passionate about learning new things and keen to join our mission, you'll fit right in.

Also, educational qualifications aren't that important to us. If you've got great experience, and you're great at articulating your thinking, we'd like to hear from you.

And because we believe that diverse teams build better products, we'd especially love to hear from you if you're from an under-represented demographic.

jobs.title: WFM Capacity Planning Analyst
jobs.description:
Capacity Plan Development & Maintenance:
• Build and maintain workforce capacity plans across short- and mid-term horizons (e.g. weekly, monthly, quarterly) using approved methodologies.
• Translate validated demand forecasts into required headcount / FTE, hours and staffing profiles,skill- and channel-based capacity requirements.
• Ensure capacity plans reflect agreed SLA targets, productivity and AHT assumptions, shrinkage, availability, and operational constraints.

Demand Validation & Stakeholder Sign-Off:
• Partner with Demand Management to validate demand drivers and forecast inputs, understand launch timing, phasing, and risk.
• Partner with Analytics / Forecasting to validate volume, AHT, and productivity assumptions and challenge anomalies or inconsistencies in data.
• Partner with Operations to validate operational feasibility of capacity plans and confirm constraints, risks, and execution readiness.
• Drive formal capacity plan validation and sign-off, ensuring assumptions, risks, and trade-offs are clearly documented.

Capacity-to-Scheduling Handover:
• Own the structured handover of approved capacity plans to Scheduling, ensuring capacity outputs are translated into clear scheduling requirements, assumptions, constraints, and sensitivities are fully understood, and timing and phasing of capacity changes are explicit.
• Act as the primary point of contact for Scheduling on capacity clarifications, interpretation of plan outputs, plan changes or re-validations.
• Ensure changes to capacity plans are version-controlled, communicated clearly and re-approved where required.

Hiring Strategy Inputs & Workforce Supply Planning:
• Translate capacity plans into hiring requirements, including hiring volumes, start dates and ramp profiles, skill and location requirements.
• Partner with Operations, Talent Acquisition and Ops Partners to validate hiring feasibility and constraints.
• Highlight hiring risks such as lead-time misalignment, ramp shortfalls, attrition sensitivity.
• Support workforce supply decision-making by providing clear, data-backed hiring scenarios.

Data Collection & KPI Inputs for Capacity Exercises:
• Own the collection, validation, and preparation of data inputs required for capacity planning, including
• volumes and forecast outputs
• AHT and productivity metrics
• shrinkage, absence, and attrition data
• historical plan vs actual performance.
• Ensure data sources are consistent, documented, auditable and repeatable.
• Partner with Analytics and WFM execution teams to improve data quality and availability for future planning cycles.

Scenario Analysis, Risk Identification & Continuous Improvement:
• Run structured what-if scenarios to assess the impact of demand volatility, hiring delays, productivity changes, operational or policy constraints.
• Identify capacity risks such as under- or over-staffing, skill mismatches, timing gaps between demand and supply.
• Track plan vs actual outcomes to understand variance drivers, refine assumptions, improve future plans.
• Contribute to standardisation, tooling, and automation of capacity planning processes.

jobs.title: Senior ML Engineering Team Lead - Financial Crime
jobs.description:
About

the role:

Wise protects millions of customers and billions in transactions from fraud, money laundering and financial crime. Our ML systems are the front line of defense - operating at a global scale of 100K requests/minute under strict sub-50ms latency SLAs. We need an exceptional technical leader to own how these models are engineered, shipped and scaled.

We're hiring a Senior ML Engineering Lead to build and grow Wise's Risk Modelling engineering pillar. You will own the full model lifecycle standard for financial crime detection - from offline experimentation to production deployment and real-time monitoring and build the team to execute it. Your job is to build the automated engineering ecosystem and organisation that scales this safely to hundreds of models.

This is a rare greenfield leadership role with strong investment and engagement from Wise's CTO and senior leadership.

 

How we work:

Risk ML sits within Wise's FinCrime organisation, owning the full ML and AI foundation for financial crime detection. We're have three dedicated pillars - Feature Platform, Learning Loop and Risk Modelling. You'll lead the Risk Modelling pillar, leading a team of Senior ML Systems Engineers and Applied ML Engineers.

We operate with high autonomy and low hierarchy. You'll own the engineering strategy end-to-end - from architecture decisions and infrastructure design through to hiring, team culture and cross-platform partnerships. We value leaders who shape direction and build teams, not just manage delivery.

 

What will you be working on?:

The Model Factory: Architect the declarative pipeline that turns a configuration file into a deployed, monitored model - the engineering backbone for scaling to hundreds of models

The Experimentation Engine: Establish the reusable path from research (partnering with DS Research) to high-throughput production for traditional and modern architectures 

Model Operations: Build the infrastructure for automated retraining, drift detection, threshold simulation/management and audit trails - the operational layer required to run hundreds of models safely at scale

The Team: Recruit, lead and mentor a world-class team of ML engineers. Establish a high-performance, engineering-first culture from scratch - setting hiring standards, technical bar and growth paths

Cross-Platform Partnership: Define and navigate the partnership with key platform teams - owning the build vs consume decisions for your pillar

 

What do you need?:

You've explicitly led or built an ML Engineering or model lifecycle automation team (not just used one) at a high-growth company - you defined the standards that other engineering teams followed

System-level and mathematical depth: you can design a model factory architecture, review a training pipeline & debug a runtime inference latency regression

Experience in high-throughput environments where latency constraints are tight and model failures carry massive financial consequences

Track record of hiring and developing senior engineers - you've built a team, not just inherited one

Ability to navigate ambiguity and make architecture-level decisions with incomplete information - this is a greenfield build, not an optimisation role

Strong enough technically to guide and review across deep learning, ML systems and production infrastructure - you lead through depth, not just delegation

Nice to Have:

Experience at a tier-1 fintech or payments company

Experience with graph-based methods (GNNs, entity resolution) in production

jobs.description:
About

the role:

Wise moves billions across borders every year. Behind every transaction is a decision: is this safe? Our ML systems make that call - at scale, in real time, across every market we operate in.

Our Risk ML team is building the next generation of financial crime detection at Wise - investing in modern architectures like deep learning, graph neural networks, and foundation models to detect increasingly sophisticated fraud and money laundering patterns. We're looking for a Staff Applied ML Engineer to lead this evolution: defining the architecture strategy, shipping production neural models, and building the blueprint that scales across FinCrime domains.

This is a greenfield opportunity - you'll be setting the direction for how Wise applies modern ML to financial crime risk, with strong investment and engagement from senior leadership.

How we work:

Risk ML sits within Wise's FinCrime organisation, owning the full ML and AI foundation for financial crime detection. We're scaling into three dedicated pillars - Feature Platform, Learning Loop and Risk Modelling. You'll sit in Risk Modelling, working alongside data scientists, platform engineers, product and domain experts.

We operate with high autonomy and low hierarchy. You'll own problems end-to-end - from research and architecture decisions through to production deployment and impact measurement. We value engineers who shape direction, not just execute tickets.

What will you be working on?
• Designing and shipping ML and deep learning models for financial crime detection - sequence-based, graph-based, attention-based - serving real-time decisions at Wise's scale
• Defining the architecture strategy for how Wise applies modern ML to risk - which model families, which serving patterns, which training paradigms
• Building the reusable end-to-end pipeline pattern - from experimentation through training to production deployment - that future models follow
• Evaluating and prototyping foundation model and embedding approaches for transaction representation across FinCrime domains
• Partnering with Data Science on model evaluation, experimentation design and causal measurement in domains where clean A/B testing isn't always possible
• Mentoring engineers and data scientists on modern ML fundamentals, production best practices, and architectural decision-making

What do you need?
• Production experience shipping deep learning models at scale - systems serving real traffic under latency constraints
• Ability to make architecture-level decisions independently - model selection, training infrastructure, serving strategy - and explain the reasoning and tradeoffs
• Experience designing ML systems with hard latency and throughput requirements, including optimisation decisions (quantization, pre-computed embeddings, batching strategies)
• Strong fundamentals in deep learning: gradient dynamics, attention mechanisms, graph message-passing, sequence modelling
• Track record of influencing technical strategy across teams - you don't just build, you shape direction
• Python, PyTorch (or equivalent), distributed training, ML pipeline orchestration

Nice to Have:
• Experience in FinCrime, fraud detection, AML, or regulated financial services
• Experience with graph-based methods (GNNs, entity resolution, link analysis) in production

• Experience establishing modern ML practices in organisations scaling their ML capabilities

jobs.title: High Volume (Total Service) Support Specialist
jobs.description:
The High Volume Support Specialist is the frontline owner of trust and retention for our highest-volume customer segment. Your purpose is to deliver service and expert guidance so strong that our most valuable customers become our most passionate advocates. The customers you support are moving large amounts of money. This can be an anxious time, so emotional intelligence, accountability and clear ownership are critical to delivering effective support.

You will own the customer experience end to end, even when other teams are needed to solve the underlying issue. This means you are responsible for clear communication, regular updates, internal coordination, and making the next step easy for the customer. You will not override regulatory, KYC, Financial Crime, or risk decisions, but you will help customers understand what is happening, reduce unnecessary friction, and escalate issues with the right context.

You will support our high-volume Consumer and Business customers, where retention is the North Star metric. This is not a standard support role built around scripts or handoffs. You are a case owner, and you make the customer experience feel overwhelmingly human.

Your core mission is to turn every interaction, whether by email or live channels, into a reason for the customer to stay. You will handle complex enquiries with a solution-focused mindset and a high degree of autonomy. You are the customer’s champion, ensuring that even when things go wrong, the quality of service strengthens loyalty instead of weakening it.

You will work in a fast-paced environment where efficiency meets empathy. You are empowered to make decisions, solve problems creatively and own the outcome. You will also act as the eyes and ears on the ground, sharing insights with the High Volume Senior Lead to help refine our playbook and reduce friction.

RESPONSIBILITIES 

Case Ownership & Resolution
• Take full cradle-to-grave ownership of customer enquiries and issues by default. You are the customer’s single point of contact until the issue is resolved.; you do not "pass the buck." You consistently aim for first contact resolution, demonstrating your commitment to getting the right outcome and not just completing a task.
• Manage a dynamic workflow across different channels, ensuring high-volume demand is met without sacrificing quality.
• Use creative thinking to diagnose complex issues. Move beyond standard operating procedures when needed to find solutions that work for the customer and the business, from both a regulatory and efficiency perspective
• Work closely with other teams, such as KYC and Financial Crime to seamlessly facilitate customer issues and act as an advocate for the customer.

Retention & Loyalty
• Treat every interaction as a retention opportunity. Identify "at-risk" behaviors or sentiments and intervene with high-touch service and real time conversations, anticipating potential needs and likely friction to prevent churn.
• Educate customers on how to get the most out of our products, moving the conversation from "fixing a problem" to "adding value."
• De-escalate friction with professional empathy, transparency and confidence, turning negative sentiment into positive advocacy.
• Participate in initiatives and programmes designed to improve customer retention eg re-contacting self deactivated customers.
• Deliver empowered solutions that solve for tomorrow by proactively addressing future friction points before the customer even identifies them. 

Operational Excellence & Feedback
• Maintain rigorous adherence to High Volume KPI’s.
• Act as a feedback loop for the High Volume Senior Lead and wider management team. Use high-level root cause analysis to identify recurring trends, broken processes, customer education opportunities and product bugs that are driving high contact volumes.
• Document unique case resolutions and creative fixes so individual wins become scalable learnings for the wider team and knowledge base

jobs.title: 業務変革・プロジェクト推進担当（AI活用推進）
jobs.description:
PayPayについて/About PayPay

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7600万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

AIを含む最新技術とデータを駆使し、圧倒的なスピードでサービス開発と事業成長を実現します。 日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、ユーザーの為に新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

業務について

▼業務推進部の紹介

業務推進本部は事業の成長を支える「攻め」と「守り」の両輪として、PayPayの決済・金融・データ領域を横断し、「安心・安全」かつ「効率的な業務オペレーション」を実現する組織です。オペレーション戦略立案、企業データ活用、リスク管理、AIやテクノロジーを活用し多岐にわたる領域で業務変革を推進し、PayPayの安心・安全な金融サービス基盤を支えています。 

業務推進本部 Recruiting FactBook

■各部署の役割とミッション：
【取引管理部】
役割： PayPayの顧客リスクマネジメント部門として、本人確認（eKYC）、不正利用防止、マネーロンダリング（AML/CFT）対策など、顧客ライフサイクル全体のリスク管理を強化・最適化。
ミッション： 「サービスの安心・安全」と「ユーザー体験の向上」の両立。
特徴： AIとデータ分析を活用し、リスク管理の高度化と業務プロセスの効率化を実現。次世代のリスクマネジメントモデル構築をリード。
構成：20代～40代半ばの約40名で構成。

【加盟店管理部】
役割： 加盟店および法人の審査・管理に関するオペレーション業務、リスク対策の企画・構築推進。
ミッション： 加盟店獲得・GMV（流通取引総額）増加、コスト最適化、法人サービスの新規構築等を通じたPayPayグループ全体の成長貢献。
構成：20代～40代半ばの約30名で構成。

【ビジネス管理部】
役割：PayPayの売上（法人債権全般）を管理し債権回収の早期化、正確な残高の把握のためのシステム化、ルール化を推進、行政対応（差押等）
ミッション：債権管理基盤の確立で財務データ健全性を担保。
構成：20代後半から50代の約20名で構成。

 

▼募集の背景

キャッシュレス決済を中心に急拡大を続けるPayPayは、今、新たな金融・生活サービスへと事業領域を大きく広げています。この変革期において、私たちは業務構造を再定義し、盤石な成長基盤を築くことを急務としています。そこで、プロセス設計、基幹データ整備、リスク管理といった多岐にわたる領域で、経営戦略に直結するテーマを自ら企画し、推進できる方を募集します。PayPayの未来を共に創り上げていく、意欲あるあなたの挑戦をお待ちしています。

 

【具体的な業務内容】

jobs.title: Product Lead
jobs.description:
Trust is the first of a new breed of banks in Singapore – digitally native and focused on delivering a delightful customer experience. You will work in a fast-paced and collaborative environment to solve new and interesting challenges each day. Together with our Trust team, you will help shape the future of our bank.

As a Product Lead, you'd be able to work on and solve many interesting challenges which we are facing, learn new ways of working, and help build delightful high-quality products for our customers. 

 

Job Description 

 

Reporting to the Business Head of Cards and Lending, you will be part of a multidisciplinary team and get to design, assist in developing and delivering one of our key revenues generating product propositions. As a Product Lead, you will own and grow our core Card and Lending products, crafting a unified value proposition that anticipates and fulfils customer needs, in line with the Bank’s mission to redefine banking through simplicity, transparency, and trust. You are a digital native with a natural intuition for design and technology, coupled with a strategic mindset. You are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, get excited by solving complex problems and are happy to roll your sleeves up and get things done. 

 

The Role Responsibility:
• Own and evolve a flagship Cards Lending product, including full P L accountability
• Define and execute a forward-looking product strategy, leveraging data, market trends, and emerging technologies (including AI)
• Drive end-to-end product lifecycle management: acquisition, engagement, credit performance, and portfolio growth
• Develop innovative product propositions grounded in deep customer insight and analytics
• Identify and unlock new growth opportunities across customer and credit segments
• Embed AI and data-driven decisioning into product features, operations, and customer journeys
• Be the voice of the customer, translating complex needs into elegant, intuitive experiences
• Work closely with Engineering, Data, Risk, and Operations to deliver seamless, high-quality journeys
• Lead day-to-day execution while continuously experimenting, learning, and iterating 

 

Role Specific Technical Competencies:

Core

Advanced 

Product Analysis 

Advanced 

Product Development and Management 

Advanced 

Cards Lending Operations and Technology

Credit Risk Management 

Advanced 

 Agile certification 

Core 

 

You’ll Fit Right in If You Are
• A technologically curious mindset, with strong interest or hands-on experience in AI, automation, or data-driven products
• Comfortable navigating ambiguity and rapid change, with the ability to pivot quickly
• A builder mentality—you roll up your sleeves and make things happen
• Strong ability to simplify complex problems into intuitive customer experiences
• Highly collaborative, with the ability to influence across diverse teams
• A continuous learner who proactively explores new tools, domains, and ways of working
• Balanced in thinking—able to align customer needs, business goals, and technical realities 

Our Ideal Candidate:
• 10+ years of experience, with 6+ years in product management (preferably in Cards, Lending, or fintech)

We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. We encourage applicants of all ages.

jobs.title: Manager, Customer Service (Escalation & Trading Services, Mandarin Support)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

 

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

 

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

 

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

 

 

What You'll Be Doing
• Manage the day-to-day operations of the customer service team, continuously improving service quality, customer experience, and team efficiency.
• Monitor and analyze key customer service metrics, identify issues and root causes through data, and develop and drive improvement plans.
• Independently conduct data analysis, prepare business reports, and perform regular reviews to support team decision-making.
• Proactively leverage AI to improve work efficiency, including data analysis, report generation, information processing, and building simple tasks or workflows.
• Continuously optimize customer service processes, SOPs, knowledge bases, and productivity tools.
• Collaborate with Product, Operations, Technology, and other teams to solve business problems and ensure high-quality, on-time project delivery.

岗位职责:
• 负责客服团队日常运营管理，持续提升服务质量、用户体验及团队效率
• 关注并分析客服核心数据，通过数据发现问题、定位原因，并制定和推动改善方案
• 独立完成客服相关数据分析、业务报告及阶段性复盘，为团队决策提供支持
• 主动运用 AI 提升工作效率，包括数据分析、报告生成、信息处理及简单任务/工作流搭建
• 持续优化客服流程、SOP、知识库及相关效率工具
• 协同产品、运营、技术等团队解决业务问题，推动项目高质量、按时交付

 

What We Look For In You
• Strong Judgment Problem-Solving: Demonstrate strong comprehension and judgment, with the ability to quickly identify the core of a problem. Able to make sound assumptions based on experience, determine a reasonable path forward, and make high-quality decisions even when facing unfamiliar situations or incomplete information.
• Hungry Strong Drive: Demonstrate strong curiosity and a solution-oriented mindset, with a habit of digging into the “Why” behind problems. Proactively seek better solutions, mobilize resources across teams, drive issues through to resolution, and take ownership of results.

• Practical AI

Skills:

Have proven experience using AI to improve work efficiency. Able to effectively use AI for data analysis, reporting, information summarization, and building simple AI-powered tasks or workflows.

• Strong ownership, self-motivation, and a growth mindset, with a willingness to continuously learn, innovate, and improve.

任职要求:

• 进取心 推动力强: 有强烈的求知求解欲，习惯深入理解事情背后的 Why；面对困难能够主动寻找更优解，积极协调团队内外资源，持续推动问题解决并对结果负责

• 具备实际 AI 应用能力: 有真实的 AI 提效案例，能够熟练使用 AI 辅助数据分析、数据报告、信息总结等工作，并能搭建简单的 AI 任务或工作流
• 具备客服、客户体验或客服运营相关工作经验，有一定团队管理经验
• 具备较强的责任感、自驱力和成长意愿，愿意持续学习、创新和自我迭代

 

 

Benefits Perks:

jobs.title: Education Lead
jobs.location: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

Robinhood brought investing into the 21st century for a new generation of retail traders. The News Education team's mission is to develop approachable and relevant content and learning opportunities for that audience through critical information, news context, and inspiration. Sherwood News provides a suite of newsletters reaching over 15M subscribers, helping retail traders stay inspired and plugged in at every stage of their journey. This role will create content that complements markets news, helping people act on inspiration and make use of the full suite of Robinhood's products.

This role will lead the strategy and execution for a holistic Learning and Education journey for retail traders, creating short-form written and video content that meets traders where they are: in-app and on social media (including Robinhood Social). With a comprehensive understanding of finance, markets, new media, and product, this hire will partner closely with the editors and writers at Sherwood to identify the most accessible ways and formats to deliver information, product managers across the company to stay appraised of product launches, and legal and compliance to ensure the quality of information meets a high and actionable standard.

This role is based in our New York City, NY, Menlo Park, CA office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do
• Own content strategy and execution for Education, including content topics, mediums, and formats
• Partner with Product to build content calendar based on product roadmap and other company priorities
• Partner with Legal to ensure content is within the bounds of what is accurate, helpful, and relevant to customers
• Partner with News to brainstorm content angles and relevant topics that are relevant to customers based on market trends and happenings
• Establish goals for content performance and optimize strategy based on findings
• Engage with user research to identify gaps for learning for customers

What you bring
• Bachelor's or Master's Degree
• 6+ years of experience creating content for financial institutions, education functions, or in news / media covering markets and finance
• Interest in markets and how retail investors trade and manage their portfolios
• (Nice to have) Active trader or investor who uses these kinds of tools yourself
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills
• Motivated with action to bias and an ownership mindset
• User-centric with a strong product intuition

What we offer
• Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
• Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
• Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.
• Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
• Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not.
• Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.
• Employer-paid life disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.
• Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
• Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. 

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. The Internal Audit team helps Robinhood meet a complex set of global regulations for crypto-assets and payment services. Our mission is to give the Board of Directors, its Committees and company leadership independent, objective and timely assurance that our governance, risk management and internal controls work as intended, so we can spot new risks early and keep strengthening our control environment!

As Internal Audit Manager, you will lead and carry out audits of Operations, Compliance and Technology across our crypto business, in line with the Internal Audit plan. You will work with Internal Audit leadership to identify risks, document and test controls, and recommend improvements, and you will help share risk information between the regulated entities, Robinhood Markets (RHM) leadership and the Board.

This role is based in our Luxembourg office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do
• Plan and run audits of Operations, Compliance and Technology processes in our crypto business, from scoping through final reporting, in line with the Internal Audit plan.
• Perform walkthroughs, control testing and substantive testing, and prepare work papers, flowcharts, narratives and risk and control matrices (RCMs) that document your procedures, findings and conclusions.
• Write clear audit findings that state the issue, its root cause and its business impact, and agree on recommendations with the teams you audit and with leadership.
• Build RCMs for new audit areas, focusing on the controls that best reduce the highest risks, and assess whether policies, procedures and systems are adequate and efficient.
• Work with Business, Risk, Compliance, Legal and Technology partners to understand their processes, solve problems and recommend process improvements, while managing several audits and ad hoc requests at once.

What you bring
• 7+ years of external or internal audit experience at a company that provides financial products or services, including evaluating internal controls or compliance programs.
• Experience assessing the design and effectiveness of controls at a crypto exchange, market maker, custody provider, broker-dealer or similar financial institution, and working knowledge of crypto-asset regulations. Broker-dealer regulation knowledge is a plus.
• Experience supporting regulatory examinations, including preparing for them and responding to regulator questions and findings.
• A bachelor's degree in Audit, Finance, Operations or Technology, or equivalent practical experience. Certifications such as Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), or crypto and brokerage certifications, are a plus.
• Proficiency in written and spoken English, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects on time in a fast-changing, regulated, international setting. Occasional travel is required.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Java
jobs.description:
Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

 

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

 

Your mission

As an Engineer within Bitpanda’s your mission is to own, design, and scale the highly available, resilient back-end systems powering our core financial ecosystem. Whether building low-latency margin trading infrastructure, real-time risk assessment engines, or seamless payment and compliance pipelines, this work will directly shape how customers interact with digital assets at scale.

Collaborating closely with cross-functional stakeholders, spanning Product, Risk, Compliance, and Finance, will be essential to architect services that safeguard the platform, ensure regulatory compliance, and enable seamless growth as we expand across Europe and beyond.

What you’ll do
• Design and develop scalable, resilient, message-driven services using Java 25 Micronaut.
• Write clean and future proof code with 80% unit test test coverage, end to end and integration testing before deploying into event driven microservices architecture.

Sales

Sales is the growth engine at Brex. We bring in new customers, expand existing relationships, and drive the company’s bottom line. With unlimited territories and uncapped opportunity, your ambition sets the ceiling. We win together, celebrate often, and reward performance. If you want to sell a category-defining product with real ownership, this is your team.

What You’ll Do

We are seeking a results-driven Sales Account Manager I to serve as the strategic partner for our high-potential Growth customers. In this hybrid role, you will bridge the gap between relationship management and revenue generation. You will own a book of ~120-150 customers and be responsible for retaining their revenue, driving full platform adoption, and identifying opportunities to expand their Brex usage. You will be tasked with understanding their financial workflows—accounting processes to stakeholder dynamics—and translating those insights into measurable business value.

Where You’ll Work

This role will be based in our New York office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. Responsibilities
• Manage the company’s legal entities (domestic and international), ensuring compliance with all reporting, filing, and other obligations, including formations, qualifications, annual reports, registered agent coordination, and dissolutions
• Provide support for corporate transactions, including mergers, acquisitions, and post-transaction integration and entity restructuring, including managing due diligence processes and maintaining a diligence bank
• Maintain and organize corporate records, including bylaws, operating agreements, and other entity governance documents, and provide support for corporate governance activities, including preparing minutes, resolutions, written consents, and other governance documents
• Maintain comprehensive tracking systems for entity filings, corporate matters, and deadlines, and generate regular reports to inform stakeholders about their status
• Coordinate with attorneys, outside counsel, government agencies, registered agents, and various internal and external stakeholders to ensure timely compliance with deadlines and procedural requirements
• Assist in developing and maintaining standard operating procedures for corporate and entity management processes
• Lead and/or assist with project management for legal department projects and assist in the development or improvement of templates, department-wide business processes, and policies and procedures

Requirements
• 5+ years of experience as a corporate paralegal, preferably with a mix of in-house and law firm experience
• Proficiency in legal research, drafting corporate legal documents, and managing complex entity and transactional matters
• Strong technology skills and proficiency in Google Suite and Jira
• Ability to effectively communicate and collaborate with diverse teams, including remote and cross-functional groups
• Experience utilizing AI tools in professional setting
• High level of professionalism, discretion, and ethical conduct in handling confidential and sensitive information
• Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to work in a fast-paced environment
• Willingness to be a team player who pitches in to help out on other work-streams and topics; one of our key tenets is “One Brex” 

Bonus points
• Paralegal certificate
• Notary public certification
• Experience in companies with global entity structures and managing international filings
• Proficiency with contract management systems

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $135,000 - $169,000 USD. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.
