jobs.title: Product Compliance Manager - APAC Wise Platform
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Product Compliance & Risk Manager to help Wise Platform grow across APAC by translating regulatory requirements into practical product solutions, effective controls and clear decisions.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Commercial and second-line Compliance teams on new partnerships, product changes and existing services. You will own compliance assessments from understanding the proposed solution through to delivering recommendations and following through on agreed actions.

This is a hands-on role requiring independent judgement, detailed product understanding and the ability to make progress where requirements, information or ownership are unclear.

Your mission:
• Identify and interpret regulations applicable to new products and features, forming clear, evidence-based compliance positions for our products and markets across APAC;
• Collaborate with second-line compliance and Wise Platform teams to turn analysis into practical solutions that enable growth yet remain compliant;
• Proactively identify and manage regulatory risks across Wise Platform’s existing and new products in APAC, leading remediation efforts to address any gaps, owning delivery to resolution; and
• Communicate emerging risks and regulatory changes, explain their practical implications and escalate breaches to Compliance oversight teams.

jobs.title: AML Senior Product Compliance & Risk Manager - APAC
jobs.description:
About the role

We’re looking for an experienced AML expert to strengthen how Wise identifies and manages money laundering and terrorist financing risk across its APAC markets.

You’ll bring together regional regulatory expectations, local typology knowledge, and internal risk evidence to identify enhancements to AML control coverage and effectiveness. 

You’ll work closely with local Product Compliance & Risk (PC&R), Compliance, and Risk stakeholders from across our different APAC markets - as well as APAC and global Product and Engineering teams.

This is an individual contributor role in our first-line PC&R team. Based in Singapore and reporting to the Group Product Compliance Lead for APAC FinCrime, you’ll be the accountable PC&R owner for APAC AML risk and control effectiveness.

What you’ll do

Shape APAC’s AML risk and control priorities
• Lead APAC PC&R’s assessment of ML/TF typologies, control coverage, and control effectiveness across our APAC markets
• Work closely with local APAC market PC&R Managers to create a coherent regional view of AML risks, gaps, and priorities
• Identify and prioritise opportunities to introduce new controls or enhance existing controls - supported by clear problem statements, evidence, expected outcomes and relevant market context

Turn regional insight into control improvements
• Translate AML risks and regulatory expectations into clear outcomes and requirements for the relevant Product, Analytics, and Engineering teams
• Represent APAC in the design and localisation of controls developed by global AML Product, Analytics and Engineering - ensuring material regional nuances are considered from the outset
• Identify new APAC control opportunities and develop evidence-backed proposals that regional or global Product teams can evaluate and prioritise

Strengthen control effectiveness across the lifecycle
• Provide AML expertise throughout the control lifecycle: from typology and red flag identification through design, testing, deployment, and ongoing monitoring / assurance
• Work with AML Operational teams to understand how ML/TF risks manifest in practice and develop a deep understanding of operational handling to identify improvement areas
• Support cross-functional decisions by making the relevant evidence, trade-offs, dependencies, limitations, and residual risks clearly understood and visible

Build a robust, joined-up regional capability
• Connect AML work with adjacent areas (e.g. KYC, Customer Risk Assessment and Fraud) where layered controls or shared risk indicators can produce better outcomes
• Communicate APAC risks, evidence gaps, recommendations, and progress clearly to regional and global stakeholders
• Support regulatory engagements on AML topics across APAC, including coordinating responses to regulator requests and participating in regulatory inspections/exams
• Build strong working relationships across regional and global PC&R, Product, Analytics, Engineering, Operations, and Compliance teams

jobs.title: Campaign Manager
jobs.description:
YouTrip is the leading and fastest-growing multi-currency payment platform in Asia Pacific. In 2018, we pioneered the region's first multi-currency digital wallet. Now, YouTrip is the #1 multi-currency digital wallet trusted by millions across the region, processing over US$15 billion in total payment value annually. 

Our consumer and business propositions – YouTrip and YouBiz – empower individuals and businesses with inclusive, accessible, and affordable financial solutions. YouTrip has raised over US$110 million to date, including its recent Series B round led by global venture capital firm Lightspeed Venture Partners—underscoring strong investor confidence in its mission to transform digital financial services across the Asia Pacific. 

Recognised as World Economic Forum’s Global Innovator 2025, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies (2025, 2024), and LinkedIn’s Top Startup (2024, 2023), YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses.

Valuing an entrepreneurial culture of diversity and inclusion, we are seeking driven individuals to join our fast-growing regional team as we push the boundaries of innovative fintech solutions. 

You Will
• Own the campaign strategy and yearly calendar across the funnel, driving new user acquisition, activation and spending volume, with clear accountability for growth outcomes for each campaign.
• Lead integrated campaigns from insight to launch and post-campaign review, across online, offline and in-app channels.
• Lead spending campaigns proposals and results across travel peaks and lifecycle stages to drive first transaction, grow usage and spending.
• Own campaign budgets, and allocate spend across KOL, paid media and performance marketing.
• Lead partnership campaigns with brand and merchant partners to drive growth
• Lead the YouTrip Metal campaign strategy, driving awareness, exclusivity and spending through targeted campaigns, partnerships and benefits.
• Analyse campaign performance in depth and turn insights into clear improvements, beyond reporting.
• Manage and develop a team of campaign executives, setting direction, priorities and execution standards.
• Brainstorm and shape ideas with the other team leads in the marketing team, and work closely with the Content, Design, Product and Performance Marketing teams to deliver campaigns at speed and to a high standard.

You Are
• Minimum 5 years in campaign, growth or marketing roles (fintech, e-commerce, travel or tech preferred).
• Minimum 2 years of people management experience, as a hands-on player-coach.
• Proven experience in promotional, rewards and partnership campaigns, with a strong understanding of measurement and ROI.
• You are a builder. You enjoy creating, improving and finding better ways of working. You are comfortable navigating an evolving environment and taking initiative even when processes or plans are still taking shape.
• You think big and make things happen. You challenge the status quo, push for ambitious ideas and have the drive to turn them into meaningful results.
• You are comfortable with ambiguity, unexpected challenges and shifting priorities. You can make sound decisions, manage trade-offs and keep things moving without waiting for perfect clarity.
• You bring structure. You know how to prioritise, manage multiple workstreams and maintain high execution standards in a fast-moving environment.
• You make the team better. You actively contribute ideas, challenge constructively, welcome feedback and take responsibility for driving improvements across the team
• Experience with premium, loyalty or membership programmes is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Information Security
jobs.description:
Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

 

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

 

Your mission 

As an Information Security Senior Associate, you will execute and mature key parts of our GRC program in a regulated fintech environment. You’ll take charge of specific GRC domains (e.g., ISMS/ISO 27001, audit, risk management, TPRM), driving control design, testing, and cross-functional coordination. Operating with strong autonomy, you'll bridge high-level strategy and daily operations to help scale our security governance.

What you’ll do
• GRC domain execution: Manage daily operations of assigned GRC domains, track yearly plans, and build scalable playbooks to reduce audit friction and improve control consistency.
• Assurance audits: Coordinate internal and external audits end-to-end (planning, evidence gathering, auditor Q A, remediation). Translate regulatory requirements into actionable plans and draft formal audit responses.
• Risk management: Facilitate risk assessments for systems and products. Drive treatment plans with owners, escalate unacceptable residual risks, and prepare clear KRI/KPI reporting for leadership.
• Third-party risk management (if in scope): Drive vendor due diligence by evaluating security evidence and tracking remediation. Partner with Legal and Procurement to embed security obligations into contracts.
• Control testing improvement: Execute risk-based control testing (design and operating effectiveness). Identify recurring failures, propose process upgrades, and implement dashboards for evidence collection.

Who you are
• 2–4 years of experience in GRC, audit, security risk management, or compliance.
• Strong knowledge of ISO 27001 (or similar frameworks) and the ability to map requirements to real operational processes.
• Hands-on experience coordinating audits or risk assessments from planning through closure.
• Solid grasp of security fundamentals (IAM, SDLC, incident and vulnerability management, logging/monitoring, third-party risk).
• Excellent communication

skills:

can independently produce clear policy documentation, audit narratives, and manage stakeholder relationships.

 

What’s in it for you
• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
• Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
• Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
• Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
• Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
• Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
• Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
• Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
• Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
• Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
• Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

 .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

 

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

 

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

 

 

Your mission

As an Information Security Specialist, you will own and mature significant parts of our governance, risk, and compliance program in a regulated fintech environment. You’ll be the go-to person for one or more GRC domains (e.g., ISMS and ISO 27001, audit assurance, third-party risk, risk management, regulatory mapping), driving outcomes end-to-end: control design, operationalization with stakeholders, testing, metrics, and continuous improvement. You’ll operate with high autonomy, influence across teams, and help shape how we scale security governance as the company grows.

What you’ll do
• GRC domain ownership program maturity: Own one or more GRC domains (e.g., ISO 27001/ISMS, control testing, TPRM, risk governance, BCM), including yearly plans, cadence, and measurable outcomes; Build scalable processes and playbooks that reduce audit friction and improve control consistency across teams/entities.
• Assurance, audits regulatory readiness: Coordinate internal and external audits end-to-end (readiness planning, walkthroughs, evidence strategy, auditor Q A, remediation verification); translate new regulatory and customer requirements into control impacts, implementation guidance, and tracked delivery plans; draft and quality-review formal materials: audit responses, management action plans, risk acceptances, and control descriptions.
• Risk management decision support: Facilitate and challenge risk assessments for systems, products, and material changes; ensure consistent scoring and clear treatment decisions; drive risk treatment plans with accountable owners; escalate when timelines or residual risk are not acceptable; improve risk reporting for leadership: themes, systemic issues, KRIs/KPIs, and clear prioritization based on business criticality.
• Third-party risk management (if in your scope): Lead due diligence for critical vendors: define minimum security requirements, review evidence, and track remediation; Partner with Legal/Procurement to embed security requirements into contracts and ensure ongoing oversight (renewals, periodic reviews, SLA/security obligations)
• Control testing continuous improvement: Design and run a risk-based control testing plan (design and operating effectiveness), ensuring repeatability and traceability; identify recurring control failures and drive cross-functional improvements (e.g., clearer ownership, automation, better tooling, updated standards); introduce automation and dashboards where useful (e.g., evidence collection, control health reporting, risk and audit tracking).

Who you are
• Typically 4-7 years of experience in GRC, audit/assurance, security risk management, compliance, or information security.
• Strong working knowledge of ISO 27001 (or comparable frameworks) and ability to map requirements to controls, evidence, and real operational processes.
• Experience leading audits/assessments or significant parts of them (planning through closure).
• Security fundamentals across IAM, SDLC governance, incident management, vulnerability management, logging/monitoring, and third-party risk concepts.
• Excellent written communication: can produce policy/control documentation and audit-ready narratives with minimal supervision.

 

What’s in it for you
• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
• Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
• Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
• Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
• Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
• Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
• Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
• Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
• Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
• Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
• Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

 .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

 

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

jobs.location: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Sales at Brex

The Sales team is the driving factor behind revenue for Brex and every member of our team directly affects our bottom line. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring new customers, and building even stronger relationships with our current customers. Our winning culture recognizes big team wins and celebrates individual accomplishments. We ensure that top performers are recognized and have built a competitive environment to motivate and unify the team.

What you’ll do

As a Commercial Account Executive, you’ll fuel Brex’s growth by winning net-new revenue from small to mid-sized businesses. In this high-volume, fast-paced role, you’ll prospect, build strong partnerships, and close deals by showing the unmatched value of Brex’s all-in-one Financial Operating System—Corporate Card, Expense Management, and Travel.

Where you'll work

This role will be based in one of our Brex offices — San Francisco, Seattle, New York, Vancouver, or Salt Lake City. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work.

Responsibilities
• Full-Cycle Sales Execution: Own the end-to-end sales process from outbound prospecting to discovery, product demos, and closing deals.
• Pipeline Generation Management: Consistently source and qualify leads to maintain a strong, reliable pipeline.
• Value-Based Selling: Clearly communicate ROI and business value by understanding each prospect's goals and aligning Brex’s solutions to their needs.
• Customer-Centric Problem Solving: Build trust through insight and service, helping prospects navigate challenges and unlock growth.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Sales Development, Product, and Underwriting to create a smooth and impactful buyer experience.

Requirements
• 1+ years of closing experience in B2B SaaS sales, ideally in a high-volume or new business-focused role
• A high-performing SDR/BDR background with a strong track record of sourcing and qualifying opportunities due to high self-prospecting requirements in role
• Strong ability to communicate value and ROI to small or mid-sized business stakeholders
• Consistent quota attainment and a history of top-tier performance
• A proactive, self-motivated approach with a focus on results and customer impact

Bonus points
• Familiarity selling financial software (Expense Management, ERP, AP Automation, T E, Accounting Software, Banking, etc.)

Compensation

The expected OTE range for this role is $136,000 - $170,000. The starting wage will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. The OTE figure listed here includes base salary and commissions, which may or may not be earned depending on performance. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Marketing at Brex

The Marketing team tells the Brex story, determines messaging and positioning, and translates our products and features into tangible customer benefits. Our marketers are responsible for acquiring and growing customers and have a deep understanding of both the business and our customers. We’re a highly cross-functional team and partner most closely with the Product, Sales, and Design teams to show our prospects and customers how we can help them reach their full potential.

What you’ll do

As a Customer Marketing Manager at Brex, you’ll turn happy customers into proof our GTM and Marketing teams can sell with. You’ll report to our Manager, Customer Marketing, and work with them to to keep our reference program running smoothly, produce a steady flow of customer stories, and grow a bench of customers who are glad to speak about their success with Brex.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. Scaling our customer proof points requires dedicated bandwidth for case study production, event execution, and third-party reviews. You’re organized and story-driven, and you can turn a 30-minute customer conversation into something compelling, while keeping many small moving parts on track.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco, CA or New York, NY office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require three days per week in office - Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Run the customer reference program: triage requests, match them to advocates by segment, industry, product, and use case, and close the loop with Sales
• Recruit and onboard advocates, and protect them from burnout by tracking every ask and applying tier-based frequency guidelines
• Deeply understand our customers through interviews and direct conversations to inform stories and content
• Create case studies, quotes, video scripts, and social-ready stories across startup, midsize, and enterprise segments, from sourcing to customer sign-off to publishing
• Manage cross-functional content requests from GTM, Marketing, PR, and Product, and align customer content to CY’27 priorities and launches
• Partner with Product Marketing, Sales Enablement, and Events to keep a searchable HighSpot library of proof points and to support customer speakers for webinars, panels, and conferences
• Lead our Gartner Peer Insights and G2 review strategy as an always-on program, and prioritize AEO/GEO visibility of reviews to drive AI citations and influence buyers
• Manage logo approvals and work with Legal and GTM to secure permissions for customer names, quotes, and stats
• Monitor and report on program health (references fulfilled, content produced and used, advocate engagement), using data to optimize the program

Requirements
• 5+ years in marketing, communications, content, or customer-facing work (ideally at a B2B SaaS or fintech company)
• Strong writing and interviewing skills, with the ability to turn a 30-minute conversation into a compelling story
• Exceptional organization and follow-through across many moving parts and deadlines
• Proven ability to build trusted relationships with customers and cross-functional partners across GTM, Legal, and Marketing
• Customer-obsessed with deep empathy for the people you’re marketing to
• Data-minded, with comfort in spreadsheets and a CRM
• Good judgment and discretion with confidential customer information
• Adaptable and composed in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities
• Proficiency with AI tools for productivity and content creation

Bonus points
• Hands-on experience with a customer advocacy or reference management tool, or with Salesforce or similar CRM tooling
• Experience supporting webinars, panels, user conferences, or customer events
• Familiarity with finance, fintech, or B2B SaaS buyers

jobs.title: Senior Director, Compensation & Benefits
jobs.description:
Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role.

Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.

About People and Talent

People and Talent support the members of our MetaMask community. We strive to be the destination employer of choice for our ecosystem. That goal is embedded in all the work we do to attract, retain and support our incredible talent. 

Compensation and Benefits is a small but mighty team where you will serve as a trusted leader, responsible for evolving MetaMask’s compensation philosophy and strategically managing inclusive employee benefits and services that support our geographically diverse and remote workforce.

As a hands-on leader, you will bring a deep understanding of designing and scaling compensation and benefits programs and practices. You should have a proven track record of conceptualizing and executing successful strategies, leading action plans, and driving the achievement of organizational goals. This role requires both strategic thinking and strong tactical execution skills. You should be comfortable working in ambiguity, enjoy new challenges and have high levels of curiosity about blockchain and token compensation plans (experience in token compensation is also most welcome!).

No two days are the same, you’ll have plenty of variety and work with a diverse group of incredible individuals who put ‘people first’ and are serious about building the workplace of the future. Not to mention that we have a lot of fun too!

If you are a positive, self-motivated, and collaborative person who is excited about bringing your experience to MetaMask, then we would love to hear from you.

What you’ll do

As a hands-on leader, you will bring a deep understanding of designing and scaling compensation and benefits programs and practices. You should have a proven track record of conceptualising and executing successful strategies, leading action plans, and driving the achievement of organisational goals. This role requires both strategic thinking and strong tactical execution skills. You should be comfortable working in ambiguity, enjoy new challenges and have high levels of curiosity about blockchain and token compensation plans (experience in token compensation is also most welcome!).

No two days are the same, you’ll have plenty of variety and work with a diverse group of incredible individuals who put ‘people first’ and are serious about building the workplace of the future. Not to mention that we have a lot of fun too!

If you are a positive, self-motivated, and collaborative person who is excited about bringing your experience to MetaMask, then we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Head, IT Audit
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Job Title: Director, IT Audit

Department: Internal Audit

Reports to: Chief Audit Officer

About this role

The Director, IT Audit provides strategic leadership for the organization’s technology audit function. This executive role oversees comprehensive risk assessments, evaluates IT governance and cybersecurity controls, ensures strict regulatory compliance, and advises executive leadership and the Audit Committee on mitigating technology risks across enterprise infrastructure, applications, and cloud environments.

Responsibilities
• Audit Strategy Planning: Develop and execute an annual, risk-based IT audit plan aligned with corporate business objectives, regulatory requirements, and emerging technology trends.
• Cybersecurity Infrastructure Assessment: Direct complex audits covering network security, cloud architecture (Google/AWS), identity and access management (IAM), data privacy, and business continuity/disaster recovery.
• Governance Compliance Frameworks: Evaluate alignment and compliance with industry frameworks including ISO 27001, NIST, COBIT, SOC 2, and applicable data privacy laws (e.g., GDPR, NDPR).
• Executive Leadership Governance: Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of IT auditors and technical specialists. Foster continuous professional development and technical proficiency.
• Reporting Stakeholder Management: Present audit findings, comprehensive risk evaluations, and practical remediation plans directly to the Chief Audit Officer and Senior Executive Management.
• Continuous Monitoring Analytics: Drive innovation by embedding automated audit techniques, data analytics, and continuous controls monitoring (CCM) into the overall audit lifecycle to enhance efficiency.

Experience Background
• 10+ years of progressive experience in IT auditing, technology risk management, or cybersecurity, including 4+ years in a senior leadership/management role.
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related quantitative discipline.
• Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) required. Additional credentials such as CRISC, CISM, CISSP, or CIA are highly desirable.
• Deep technical understanding of cloud environments (Google AWS), network infrastructure, database security, API, application controls, and IT General Controls (ITGCs).

Skills Competencies
• Exceptional stakeholder management, executive presence, oral and written communication, strategic problem-solving, and conflict resolution skills.
• Strong proficiency in risk assessment prowess and deep thinking.
• Advanced predictive prescriptive data analytics skills.
• Self-driven capacity, agility, customer obsession, professional skepticism, and urgency.

What success looks like in this role
• Establishment of a robust, proactive, risk-based IT audit strategy that protects enterprise assets and cloud infrastructure.
• High-performing, technically proficient IT audit team delivering clear, high-impact evaluations and actionable remediation plans.
• Continuous integration of automated audit controls, analytics, and full compliance with industry regulatory standards and frameworks.

Why join us
• Competitive compensation, benefits, and career growth opportunities.
• Fully remote work culture and support for professional development

jobs.title: Implementation Officer (Enugu)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint is Africa’s all-in-one financial ecosystem, empowering businesses and their customers with seamless payment, banking, credit, and management tools. In 2023, we processed $182 billion and are Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer. We are on a mission to create financial happiness for everyone, everywhere.

What We Do

At Moniepoint, we are a customer-focused community dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We leverage artificial intelligence and data-driven best practices to support our businesses, from providing credit and overdrafts to ensuring every transaction is secure.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out our stories on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

Job Title: Implementation Officer

Reports To: Lead, Onboarding

Location: Enugu - Nsukka

Work Mode: Hybrid

Employment Type: Outsourcing

Job Purpose

The Implementation Officer ensures new retail customers successfully adopt Moniebook POS into their daily store operations through structured, high-touch onboarding experiences. This role bridges the gap between sales and long-term customer success by transforming newly signed customers into confident, active users who derive maximum value from the platform within their first 30-60 days.

Operating as the customer's primary guide during the critical early adoption phase, you will understand each retailer's unique operational needs, configure Moniebook to fit their workflow, deliver effective training, and drive product adoption that sets the foundation for retention and expansion. Activation rates, time-to-value, feature adoption depth, and seamless handoffs to Account Managers measure success.

Key Responsibilities
• Onboarding Program Design Execution: Create and execute tailored onboarding plans that guide customers from signup to full operational usage. Define clear milestones, timelines, and success metrics for each customer's onboarding journey.
• Product Setup Configuration: Guide customers through initial Moniebook POS setup.
• Training Delivery Enablement: Conduct engaging live training sessions (both one-on-one and group) that educate retail staff on core Moniebook features, best practices, and operational workflows. Create an environment where users feel confident and empowered to use the POS system independently.
• Adoption Monitoring Progress Tracking: Monitor customer usage data, transaction volume, feature adoption, and engagement signals. Proactively identify at-risk customers showing low adoption and intervene with targeted support to get them back on track.
• Relationship Building Trust Establishment: Build strong, trust-based relationships with key stakeholders during the onboarding period. Be responsive, empathetic, and solutions-oriented in addressing concerns and questions.
• Issue Resolution Escalation Management: Provide troubleshooting support for technical issues, user errors, or configuration challenges during onboarding. Escalate complex technical issues to Product/Engineering teams while maintaining customer communication and managing expectations.
• Documentation Knowledge Sharing: Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, onboarding progress, configuration details, and issues in CRM/CS platform. Document common customer questions and best practices to improve onboarding resources and internal knowledge base.
• Account Manager Handoff: Execute smooth, well-documented handoffs to the account manager upon onboarding completion. Provide context on customer goals, usage patterns, relationship notes, and any ongoing concerns to ensure continuity of support.
• Feedback Loop Product Insights: Capture and share customer feedback, feature requests, usability issues, and competitive insights with Product and Account management teams. Act as the voice of the customer to inform improvements to product development and the onboarding process.

Qualifications
• 2-4 years of experience in customer onboarding, customer success, implementation, or account management roles (preferably in SaaS, retail technology, or POS systems)
• Must have completed NYSC or possess a valid exemption/exclusion certificate.
• Proven track record of successfully onboarding customers to software platforms and driving product adoption
• Excellent communication and presentation skills with ability to train diverse audiences
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, able to diagnose customer challenges and recommend effective solutions
• Customer-first mindset with genuine passion for helping people succeed and delivering exceptional experiences
• Highly organised and detail-oriented, capable of managing multiple onboarding projects simultaneously while maintaining quality
• Self-motivated, proactive, and adaptable, comfortable working independently and taking ownership of customer outcomes
• Technical aptitude and comfort with software tools
• Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Communication, or related field (or equivalent work experience) 

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience creating training materials, documentation, or knowledge base content
• Exposure to SaaS onboarding methodologies, customer health scoring, or CS best practices
• The candidate should be based in Enugu - Nsukka (Please include your residential address as well)

About You
• You're deeply customer-obsessed; you measure your success by your customers' success and genuinely care about their outcomes
• You're an exceptional teacher and communicator who can explain complex concepts simply and make technology accessible to non-technical users
• You're naturally empathetic and patient; you understand that change is hard and meet customers where they are with understanding and support
• You're process-driven but flexible; you follow structured onboarding frameworks while adapting to each customer's unique needs and pace
• You thrive on problem-solving and troubleshooting; you're resourceful, persistent, and don't give up until the customer succeeds
• You're a team player who collaborates seamlessly across Sales, Product, Support, and Account managers to deliver great customer experiences
• You're energised by fast-paced, dynamic environments where no two days are the same and continuous learning is the norm
• You take initiative and ownership. When you see a problem or an opportunity to improve the customer experience, you act on it

What Success Looks Like
• 90%+ of onboarded customers reach 'active user' status (defined by processing transactions and using key features) within their first 30 - 60 days
• Customers go live with Moniebook POS in their retail operations within the target onboarding timeline (typically 1-2 weeks from signup)
• Customers actively use 3+ core Moniebook features by the end of onboarding, demonstrating comprehensive platform adoption beyond basic transactions
• Achieve a 4.5+ average rating score on post-onboarding surveys.
• Customers you onboard show 
What we can offer you
• Culture: We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all voices are heard, and we look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
• Learning: We have a learning- and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing and training.
• Compensation: You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, and an annual bonus, plus other benefits.

What to expect in the hiring process
• A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
• An interview with the hiring team.

About the Opportunity

Building machine learning systems for risk at a global crypto exchange is fundamentally different from conventional ML engineering. The data spans on-chain activity, fiat deposits and withdrawals, trading behaviour, account access patterns, device intelligence, identity information, and customer interactions—signals that very few organizations can analyze together.

The problems are complex, adversarial, and constantly evolving. Models must identify emerging fraud patterns, scams, account takeovers, payment abuse, and other forms of financial risk while minimizing disruption to legitimate customers. Success is not measured only through offline model metrics. It is measured through prevented losses, improved approval rates, reduced false positives, faster investigations, and more reliable customer experience.

This role sits within a multidisciplinary risk team of machine learning engineers, data scientists, risk strategy specialists, analytics engineers, product managers, and operations teams. You will work across the full ML lifecycle — from problem formulation, feature engineering, and model development to real-time deployment, monitoring, experimentation, and continuous iteration.

You will also help shape how AI is used across the risk organization. LLM-assisted development, automated model workflows, AI-powered investigations, and intelligent review agents are part of the team’s daily work. We are looking for engineers who already use these tools effectively and can help establish safe, scalable, and production-ready AI practices.

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to build models and AI tools that help detect fraud and protect users at a global crypto exchange. You’ll apply deep learning and XGBoost, develop practical AI agents, and use AI coding tools in your daily work.

jobs.title: Staff/Sr Staff Software Engineer, Payment
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. 

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. 

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Payments Team, based in the US. Payments is where OKX meets the real financial world. Our team has built and operates the infrastructure connecting OKX to dozens of payment channels across global markets, giving users deposit and withdrawal options that are fast, convenient, and — most importantly — trustworthy. That platform moves and safeguards user assets at institutional scale, continuously, across time zones and regulatory environments.

 

This is not a greenfield team looking for its footing. The team is established, the platform is in production at scale, and we are actively expanding — both in scope and in headcount. That combination is rare: you get the leverage of joining a growing team where your work visibly shifts the roadmap, along with the discipline that comes from a system already trusted with real money.

 

It's also an unusually good place to learn. Payments is a domain that's hard to pick up from the outside — every market has its own rails, its own settlement behavior, its own failure modes, its own compliance expectations. Here you'll work across a wide range of payment methods and channels, and you'll build the judgment that comes from operating financial systems where the stakes are real: how to design for correctness when money is on the line, how to reconcile, how to recover, how to keep a platform observable enough that you find problems before your users do.

 

You'll work closely with product managers, designers, and partner-facing teams, and you'll set the technical bar for the engineers around you — through design docs, code reviews, and the everyday habit of doing things properly when nobody's watching.

 

If you like the sound of a team where the problems are genuinely hard, the standard is high, and your opinion changes the outcome, we'd like to talk.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Design and build the core. Develop high-scale, 24/7 APIs and distributed payment services across multiple cloud providers, using Java and Spring Boot as the primary stack. Own systems end to end, from design doc through production ownership.
• Expand our global reach. Help integrate and scale new payment channels and methods across markets, each with its own technical, operational, and reliability characteristics.
• Protect user assets. Build for correctness first: consistency, idempotency, reconciliation, failure recovery, and the operational tooling that lets us stand behind every transaction.
• Build with AI agents across the engineering lifecycle, and help set the patterns for using them safely on systems that move money.
• Use AI development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) in your daily workflow to speed up coding, unit testing, and troubleshooting.
• Set the technical bar. Participate actively in design and code reviews, giving and receiving direct, constructive feedback. Help evolve the standards a growing team builds on.
• Solve the hard problems. Investigate complex distributed-systems challenges and drive them to resolution rather than handing them off.
• Partner across functions. Work with product, design, and partner teams across regions to turn ambiguous requirements into shipped systems, and to unblock dependencies before they become delays.
• Grow the team’s capability. Mentor engineers and share what you learn. Seniority here is measured in leverage, not just output.
• Stay curious. Keep pace with a fast-moving industry and bring the good ideas back.
• Collaborate directly with Mandarin-speaking partners, vendors, and clients to manage daily communications, gather project requirements, and resolve operational issues.

What you'll take away from this role
• Deep, practical fluency across a wide range of global payment methods and channels, knowledge that is genuinely hard to acquire anywhere else
• Experience designing and operating systems entrusted with substantial user assets, where correctness and recoverability are non-negotiable
• A track record of shipping in a regulated, high-stakes domain at real scale
• Hands-on experience applying AI agents and agentic engineering to production systems that move money

What We Look For In You
• 7+ years of backend software development experience, with a proven track record of building and operating high-availability, large-scale applications.
• Strong engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and software design patterns, and the judgment to know when to reach for which.
• An AI-first mentality. You use AI to extend your knowledge and capability and to work in complex systems with confidence.
• Familiarity with agentic engineering.
• Enjoy using AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity, while keeping a strong focus on engineering quality and best practices.
• Ownership instinct. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tickets. When something’s broken or unclear, you move toward it.
• Ability to drive cross-team collaboration, managing complex dependencies and competing requirements without losing momentum.
• Excellent problem-solving skills, and comfort operating with autonomy in a fast-paced environment.
• Strong written and verbal communication. You can explain a complex technical trade-off to an engineer and to a non-technical stakeholder, and land it with both.
• Genuine interest in crypto or fintech, and in building things that make money move better.
• Preferred: Professional working proficiency in both English and Mandarin (verbal and written) to effectively communicate with Mandarin-speaking stakeholders and review Chinese-language business documents.

jobs.title: 業務監査担当
jobs.description:
PayPayについて/About PayPay

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7600万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

AIを含む最新技術とデータを駆使し、圧倒的なスピードでサービス開発と事業成長を実現します。 日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、ユーザーの為に新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

業務について

▼PayPay内部監査部の紹介

個別監査の計画・実施・報告、全社組織のリスクアセスメント、オフサイトモニタリング等を担う組織で、PayPayの3ラインモデルの第3線として、ビジネススピードに合わせ、米国上場企業に相応しい強固なガバナンス態勢を構築・高度化させています。

 

＜内部監査の主なミッション＞
• 内部監査を通じて経営目標の効果的な達成、組織体への価値の付加を実現
• 経営活動の全般にわたる業務運営の管理、遂行状況を3線の立場で評価
• 内部監査結果に基づく情報提供ならびに改善への助言

＜チーム構成＞

現在は十数名程度のメンバーが在籍しており、テーマ監査、業務・営業監査、システム監査、SOX監査の4チームで構成されています。
前職の出身企業は金融機関や事業会社、監査法人など多様なメンバーが活躍をしており、AI等の最新テクノロジーを駆使しながら業務にあたっています。

▼関連コンテンツ
• 「監査」と「統制」一体で上場を目指す。監査統制本部長が語る、PayPayの第3線（2024.10.22）
• 先を見据えたリスク評価と改善で、PayPayの成長スピードを支える内部監査室。（2023.02.02）

▼募集背景
• PayPayにおける事業・サービスの拡大（金融ビジネスや加盟店事業等）に対応できる専門性の高い国内金融機関トップクラスの内部監査部門の構築を目指し、 多様なバックグラウンド・経験・スキルを持った内部監査人材の確保のため
• 会社が上場後の新たなステージを迎え、上場後ガバナンス態勢の監査や法令等遵守態勢監査等の拡大に向けた体制強化が急務となっているため
• グループ全体の成長を支えるグループ監査の拡大のため

▼具体的な業務内容

業務監査の主担当として、以下の実務を想定しています。また、当社のみならずグループ会社への協働監査も実施します。
• 個別監査の遂行
• 予備調査
• 監査計画・手続書作成
• 対象領域の評価、原因分析・改善案の立案
• 財務報告に係る内部統制の評価
• 監査報告書の作成・報告
• 発見事項のフォローアップ等
• 上場後ガバナンスの検証・支援
• 上場後ガバナンス態勢の監査での検証、ステークホルダーへのレポーティング強化
• AI活用による内部監査態勢の向上
• AI活用による監査主要業務および管理・報告業務の効率化推進
• リスクアセスメント・オフサイトモニタリング
• 年間監査計画の基礎となる業務プロセスのリスク評価
• 社内外リスク情報の収集

▼本ポジションの魅力
• 上場企業として会社全体を俯瞰する立場から、経営目線で厳格なガバナンス・リスク管理の実践に直接貢献できる
• モバイル決済最大手のフィンテック企業で、新サービスや新ビジネススキームに対する監査経験を積むことができる
• デジタル監査（AI活用や分析支援ツール）を含めた新たな監査手法の導入や、AIの監査業務活用に関するガバナンス構築に自ら携わることができる

必要な経験/スキル

以下いずれかのご経験を3年程度以上お持ちの方
• 金融機関での業務監査経験
• 事業会社での業務監査経験
• 監査法人やコンサルティングファームでの業務監査経験

あると望ましい経験/スキル
• CIA、CISA、CPA（公認会計士）等の資格保有者、または取得を目指している方
• コンプライアンス、リスク管理、不正モニタリング等の実務経験
• 生成AIの利用（監査業務での利用、データ分析等）、AIガバナンスの知見・経験
• 金融機関もしくは監査法人での内部統制評価経験
• 当局検査の対応経験
• ビジネス英語

PayPayが求める人物像
• PayPay 5 sensesに当てはまる方
• 複数部門との調整業務経験、またはそれに相当するコミュニケーション能力
• 既存の方法、思考に捉われすぎず、業務改善や高度化に取り組む高いモチベーション
• 変化の多い環境下でのマルチタスクスキル、必要時には専門分野外タスクにも貢献できるチームワーク

待遇・条件

雇用形態
• 正社員

勤務地
• Hybrid Workstyle
※所属組織のルールおよび業務指示に応じて出社対応頂きます。

勤務時間
• スーパーフレックス制（コアタイム無し）
• 原則：午前9時～午後5時45分（実働7時間45分＋休憩時間 1時間）

休日

休暇（法定休暇および会社福利厚生）

※PayPay独自の特別有給休暇制度で、本人/家族/ペットなどの病気/ケガ/通院付き添い等にご使用頂けます。

給与

jobs.title: Applications Developer, Workday
jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

The People Systems team builds and maintains secure, scalable HR technology that supports employees across the company. The team partners closely with People Operations, Compensation, Payroll, Finance, and Enterprise Technology to deliver reliable systems and improve how employees experience internal tools. The focus is on improving system performance, enabling new capabilities, and supporting company growth through thoughtful system design. This team plays a key role in supporting acquisitions and expanding global workforce operations.

As an Applications Developer, Workday, you will help configure, maintain, and enhance Workday solutions across key HR functions, focusing on Payroll, Absence, Time tracking, Benefits and core HCM. You'll work closely with business partners to understand their needs, translate requirements into system configurations, and build solutions that simplify processes and improve the employee experience. You will be the subject matter expert in this space, as well as help identify opportunities where automation and AI can help improve processes.

This role is based in our Toronto, Canada office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do
• Configure, maintain, and enhance Workday modules, including Payroll, Absence, Time Tracking, Benefits and HCM, ensuring systems are reliable and scalable.
• Partner with People Operations, Compensation, Payroll, and other business teams to gather requirements and translate business needs into effective Workday solutions.
• Build and maintain Workday configurations across these modules, business processes, custom reports, and security settings to support evolving business needs.
• Work alongside Payroll to drive US and International payroll configuration, help troubleshoot payroll errors, support ongoing payroll processing
• Partner with Benefits to own and scale Workday configuration of Benefit plans, enrollment events, Open Enrollment readiness, integration updates
• Support company growth initiatives, including acquisitions, global expansion, and the rollout of new Workday functionality
• Own the Workday release cycle in these modules: review what’s new, regression-test the critical business processes and config setup, and decide which new features to adopt and roll out.

What you bring
• 3+ years of hands-on experience administering and configuring Workday, with deep hands on working knowledge across PATT, Benefits, HCM
• Experience configuring Workday business processes, building custom reports, security configuration and maintaining system functionality.
• Strong understanding of HR processes and how Workday supports People Operations, Payroll, Compensation, and related business functions.
• Ability to gather business requirements, troubleshoot issues, and independently deliver practical system solutions.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience partnering with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
• Familiarity with Workday integrations (including PECI, RaaS, EIBs), data flows, APIs, and tools such as Workday Studio is a plus.
• Interest in leveraging automation and modern AI tools to improve workflows and drive operational efficiency.

This individual will be helping solve correctness, scaling, and reliability challenges on a backend-first, high-performance, and world-class institutional trading platform.

By making business meaning, ownership, provenance, quality, freshness, and access policies machine-readable, you will help end users and AI systems work from consistent, governed context.

This is an individual contributor role with broad organizational impact. You will personally contribute code, prototypes, architecture, and operational improvements while setting technical direction across engineering, data, security, privacy, legal, risk, analytics, and product teams. You will build reusable enterprise capabilities and reference patterns that partner teams can adopt, while domain teams retain ownership of their application-specific use cases and serving paths.

What you will own:
• Data Trust architecture and strategy: Define and execute the technical direction for data contracts, metadata and catalog modernization, lineage, data quality, privacy, and access controls. Translate business, regulatory, and engineering requirements into a coherent platform strategy and sequence investments for long-term impact.
• Declarative enforcement primitives: Build platform services, libraries, and reference patterns that make contracts, quality rules, privacy policies, and access requirements versioned, testable, observable, and automatically enforceable across the data lifecycle.
• Semantic context for analytics and AI: Establish the technical foundations for a governed semantic context layer that connects business definitions, metadata, lineage, ownership, quality, freshness, and access policy. Enable trusted discovery, analytics, and AI-assisted or agentic experiences without turning this role into a model-development function.
• Reliability across batch and streaming data: Lead the evolution of Data Trust capabilities across Snowflake, AWS data services, Kafka-based ingestion, and other batch or low-latency environments. Establish explicit SLOs, failure modes, correction paths, and operational ownership, supported by automated detection, containment, remediation, and recovery.
• Mission-critical operational rigor: Raise the standard for production data systems through observability, integrity checks, audit evidence, incident learning, and safe automation. Help move the organization from reactive troubleshooting and manual compliance activity toward proactive, measurable control.
• Cross-organizational technical leadership: Drive multi-quarter initiatives across teams and functions, earning alignment on difficult architectural tradeoffs and investment decisions. Serve as a trusted technical authority for Data Trust while mentoring senior engineers, strengthening design and implementation practices, and raising the broader engineering bar.

What success looks like in the first 12–18 months:
• A clear enterprise architecture and delivery path exists for Data Trust primitives spanning contracts, metadata, lineage, quality, privacy, and reliability.
• Priority data domains have materially improved coverage, observability, SLOs, and automated enforcement.
• The platform provides production-ready patterns for governing data in both batch and low-latency environments.
• Initial semantic context capabilities are operating in production and provide more reliable, traceable context for analytics and AI use cases.
• Manual investigation, recurring data failures, and compliance evidence-gathering are measurably reduced.
• Engineering and partner teams have adopted reusable standards and capabilities rather than creating isolated point solutions.

What you’ll need:
• Experience Education: 15+ years of software or data engineering experience (or 13+ years with a Master’s degree) with a proven track record of designing, building, and operating distributed data platforms at enterprise scale.
• Platform Architecture Expertise: Deep experience designing horizontal, multi-tenant platform services that other engineering teams depend on. You understand the failure modes of distributed systems, eventual consistency, and how to balance latency, availability, and cost.
• Data Trust Governance Depth: Practical, battle-tested experience building or managing components of the modern data trust stack, such as data contracts, metadata catalogs, data quality frameworks, end-to-end lineage, and fine-grained access control (RBAC/ABAC).
• Batch Streaming Mastery: Advanced knowledge of modern data ecosystems, specifically Snowflake, Kafka (or similar streaming platforms), and AWS data services. You know how to govern data in motion just as effectively as data at rest.
• Hands-On Engineering: Mastery of one or more core programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go) and advanced SQL. You are comfortable writing production-grade code, conducting rigorous code reviews, and building declarative infrastructure (Terraform, CI/CD).
• Cross-Organizational Leadership: A history of successfully driving multi-team, cross-functional technical initiatives. You know how to build consensus across Engineering, Security, Privacy, and Product teams, translating compliance and risk requirements into frictionless engineering primitives.
• Operational Rigor: Experience managing Tier-0/mission-critical infrastructure. You build systems with a "trust but verify" mindset—relying on automated testing, drift detection, and circuit breakers rather than manual processes.

Nice to have:

Experience:

Prior experience operating in a highly regulated environment where auditability, data privacy (CCPA/GDPR), and data integrity are architectural requirements, not afterthoughts.
• AI Infrastructure Exposure: Experience building semantic layers, knowledge graphs, or context engines that ground LLMs and autonomous agents in governed enterprise data.

jobs.title: Financial Assistance Head of Compliance & Insights
jobs.description:
Financial Assistance Head of Compliance & Insights

Location: Cardiff & Manchester

Reporting to: Director of Financial Assistance

Closing date: Thursday, 26th November at 5pm

About Starling 

At Starling, we are on a mission to provide people with a fairer, smarter, and more human alternative to traditional banks. We are building a leading digital bank, driven by fast technology, fair service, and honest values. Our vision is to create a banking industry that serves everyone, which we accomplish by developing best-in-class proprietary technology, offering an exceptional customer experience, and establishing a strong, sustainable business.

Our five core values – Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim for Greatness – are at the heart of everything we do, guiding our strategy and shaping our culture. We're a branchless, largely paperless bank, committed to responsible banking, sustainability, and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

Hybrid working: All Starling colleagues spend a minimum of 10 days per month in the office with flexibility to work the rest from home.

The Opportunity

As a hands-on technical 1st Line of Defence (1LoD) practitioner, this role oversees regulatory compliance assurance, local risk and control management, Standards authoring, and insight-led continuous improvement across all retail and business banking Financial Assistance operations. Operating directly in the technical detail, the role translates complex regulatory obligations (including FCA, PRA, Consumer Duty, and CONC) into clear local Standards and robust 1LoD controls aligned to Bank risk appetite. By combining frontline compliance monitoring with deep-dive root cause analysis, the role converts operational, quality, and customer findings into actionable intelligence that drives continuous improvement and informs strategic direction.

What You'll Do
• Compliance Monitoring and Oversight: Directly perform and lead continuous 1LoD compliance monitoring, thematic reviews, and controls testing across all retail and business banking collections and recoveries operations to guarantee adherence to UK legal frameworks, regulatory guidelines, and internal governance standards. Detect compliance deficiencies or regulatory breaches and oversee effective remediation.
• 1LoD Risk & Control Management: Own and maintain the Financial Assistance local Risk and Control framework and risk register. Direct the identification, design, testing, exception and control reporting, and remediation validation of local risks and controls, and coordinate cross-functional responses to regulatory shifts and emerging risks.
• Policies and Standards: Author and maintain local Financial Assistance Standards, ensuring they align directly with the Bank's Customer in Financial Difficulties (CiFD) policy and legal and regulatory obligations. Manage cross-functional document consultation (across Legal, Compliance, Credit Risk, and Operations), secure formal policy approval, and provide ongoing first-line compliance assurance against Bank-wide policies and Standards.
• Insights & Continuous Improvement Enablement: Synthesise qualitative and quantitative intelligence from compliance testing, quality outputs, complaints, and operational data to uncover systemic friction, vulnerable customer pain points, and emerging conduct trends. Direct the execution of structured deep-dives and thematic reviews, translating insights into measurable operational and journey improvements.
• Conduct, Customer Outcomes & 2LoD Interface: Act as the primary 1LoD technical SME for regulatory matters across retail and SME arrears, translating obligations into actionable controls and strategies. Collaborate with second-line Compliance, Credit Risk, Legal, and Internal Audit to drive a unified compliance posture, managing assurance reviews and issue validation with authoritative detail.
• Reporting & Specialist Coaching: Prepare and oversee authoritative compliance, risk, and insight reports for senior management, governance forums, and regulatory bodies. Provide hands-on technical direction, coaching, and quality assurance for a lean specialist team, balancing light-touch people management with personal technical delivery.

What You'll Bring:
• End-to-End CiFD & Portfolio Expertise: Deep subject matter expertise across the complete Customer in Financial Difficulties (CiFD) lifecycle, spanning pre-arrears, collections, forbearance, and recoveries, across both Retail Banking and SME/Business Banking portfolios.
• UK Regulatory Mastery: Comprehensive operational command of the UK regulatory landscape governing retail and commercial debt (FCA CONC, MCOB, Consumer Duty, PRA expectations, Insolvency/Breathing Space legislation, and LSB Standards of Lending Practice).
• 1LoD RCSA & Standards Authoring: Expert practitioner knowledge of 1LoD risk and control frameworks (RCSA), control testing methodologies, and drafting audit-ready operational Standards and policy dispensations.
• Root-Cause Insights & Continuous Improvement: Strong analytical grasp of operational MI, quality and outcome testing, and structured continuous improvement methodologies to convert assurance findings into systemic operational fixes.

Behaviours & Competencies:
• Hands-On Technical Rigour & Precision: Thrives in the technical detail—personally authoring Standards, interrogating raw data, and testing controls with meticulous attention to quality rather than relying purely on delegation.
• Analytical & Root-Cause Thinking: Connects dots across disparate compliance, quality, outcome testing, and customer data points to separate isolated human errors from systemic control or journey weaknesses.
• Constructive Challenge & Integrity: Demonstrates professional courage and objectivity when surfacing compliance gaps or challenging operational and strategic proposals that risk poor customer outcomes.
• Pragmatic Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration: Translates dense regulatory rules into workable 1LoD controls, partnering seamlessly across Strategy, Operations, Legal, and 2LoD Risk/Compliance.
• Thriving Under Pressure & Cultural Alignment: Balances competing regulatory and operational priorities in a fast-paced environment while actively embodying and promoting the Bank's core values.

Why Join Starling?
• Make an Impact: Work on projects that directly shape the future of banking and improve the financial lives of our customers. Starling is technology-led, and you'll have the freedom to accomplish your goals in innovative ways.
• Culture of Excellence: Be part of a collaborative, empowered, and forward-thinking team. We encourage experimentation, ownership, and a relentless focus on "doing the right thing.”
• Growth and Development: We are committed to your professional growth, offering opportunities to learn new technologies, take on new challenges, and own interesting things from day one.
• A Bank That Cares: We're a Living Wage employer, committed to flexible working, and dedicated to creating a fair, open, and safe working environment with compassion and inclusion at its core.
• Comprehensive

Benefits:

We offer a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package, including:
• Company-enhanced salary sacrifice pension scheme (7% employer contribution)
• Private Medical Insurance with Vitality including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and Peloton.
• 25 days holiday (plus take your public holiday allowance whenever works best for you)
• An extra day’s holiday for your birthday
• Life Insurance at 4x your salary.
• 16 hours of paid volunteering time a year.
• Ability to buy or sell annual leave.
• Generous family-friendly policies.
• Annual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell up to five extra days off
• Incentivised refer a friend scheme
• Perkbox membership giving access to retail discounts, a wellness platform for physical and mental health, and weekly free and boosted perks
• Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work, Salary Sacrificed Gym partnerships and Electric Vehicle (EV) leasingOur Commitment to Equality

Starling Bank is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster diversity & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment at Starling Bank are considered without regard to race, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. When you provide us with this information, you are doing so at your own consent, with full knowledge that we will process this personal data in accordance with our Privacy Notice. By submitting your application, you agree that Starling Bank will collect your personal data for recruiting and related purposes. Our Privacy Notice explains what personal information we will process, where we will process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over our use of your personal information.

We use AI tools to support various parts of our recruitment process, helping our team manage applications and assessments more efficiently. These tools are strictly used for support and do not replace human judgment with all final hiring decisions being made by our team. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please reach out to us.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About

the role:

We're looking for a Senior Staff Engineer (IC5) to join our Consumer Onboarding team. Our mission is to guide personal customers through setting up their Wise account and resolving their first international money needs in a way that's clear, easy, and delightful.

Onboarding is one of the most critical moments in a customer's journey with Wise. Get it right, and we build trust from day one. Because we sit at this key point in the customer journey, we deal with high volumes of traffic and need to balance speed, scale, and reliability with a smooth user experience. This makes it an exciting space for engineers who want to solve complex problems at scale while having a direct, visible impact on millions of customers.

How we work:

At Wise, we believe in autonomy, alignment, and impact. As an IC5 engineer, you won't just be executing tasks - you will be a visionary. You will own fundamental components and shared systems, collaborate across multiple teams, and define the long-term technical strategy for onboarding. We value open communication, high technical standards, and a genuine focus on solving real customer problems.

What will you be working on?

In the near future, you will be driving technical solutions for our biggest upcoming challenges:
• Scalable Onboarding Architecture: Designing systems that can support rapid growth in new markets and customer segments without compromising speed or reliability.
• Cross-Team Technical Alignment: Defining the technical contracts and integration points between Onboarding and other teams across Wise, such as Marketing, FinCrime, and KYC.
• End-to-End Journey Ownership: Building and evolving robust, scalable onboarding flows from account creation through to a customer's first successful transfer.
• System Health & Performance: Leading initiatives to improve the maintainability, latency, and cost efficiency of our core onboarding systems.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer  - Consumer Onboarding
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an experienced Backend Engineer for our Consumer Onboarding team. This is a unique opportunity to have a massive impact, helping a growing number of customers around the world choosing Wise to move their money without borders.

The Consumer Onboarding team is dedicated to guiding personal customers through setting up their Wise account and resolving their first international money needs in a way that’s clear, easy, and delightful. • Drive and deliver high impact projects end to end - from understanding customer problem, design solution alongside your team, driving technical discovery, scoping and execution to delivery
• Own the health of systems and services in your team, ensuring our system remain maintainable, scalable and performing to support our growth and scale
• Collaborate with other senior engineers and engineering lead across Onboarding squad and Wise to ensure your team’s work is aligned with the wider technical strategy.
