jobs.title: Product Manager - Support Experience
jobs.description:
A bit about the Support Squad

The Support Squad consists of several product teams, and collectively owns the entire end-to-end support journey for millions of Wise customers. Our mission is to provide high quality support at the lowest cost. We do this by preventing the need for support in the first place, building world-class self-service tools, automating resolutions through conversational AI, and empowering our support agents with the best infrastructure and intelligent tooling. 

 

One of our largest investment areas in the last year has been conversational support automation - we launched a Wise Support Assistant, helping a large majority of our customers self serve problems. We’re now scaling the Wise Assistant to solve deep and complex customer problems.

 

The Opportunity & Your Mission

We’re looking for a Product Manager to focus on owning our customer facing support experience to help with our core Wise job: money movement. This means you have the space to:
• Shape the support

experience:

Working closely with the team’s Designer, Researcher, Data Scientist, AI Engineers and Product Engineers, you’ll help to rebuild Wise’s support experience working from first principles. You’ll design and execute A/B experiments; architect how LLMs should interface with complex internal systems, and help to build the best support journey used by millions of customers.
• Ship new conversational experiences & automations: You will partner closely with Content Design and Engineering to ship AI-powered conversational experiences that resolve customer intents instantly and effectively. This role requires an iterative mindset; beyond the initial launch, you will drive continuous improvement through rigorous experimentation and feedback loops.

You’ll be responsible to:
• Lead the support experience roadmap: You will partner closely with the other teams in the Support Squad to create a product strategy, and execute on a multi-quarter roadmap, enabling embedded solutions into a conversational journey.

 

What does success look like?

Your success is defined by creating a superior automated experience that reduces customer effort and friction, or simply preventing the need to contact in the first place. In your first 6 months, you will have:
• Impact our Customer Support

Experience:

Made a measurable dent in our customer support experience through both high-quality automation and by addressing root-cause issues, putting us on a clear path towards our 2027 goals.
• Impact our Automation Rate: Launched significant improvements to our conversational support channels that have quantifiably improved the Wise customer experience.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Lead - Generative AI Platform
jobs.description:
About

the role:

For our customers, using Wise is as simple as sending money from A to B. Yet behind our app and website is a complex engine of currencies, routes, products and features, generating terabytes of data each day.

The Data Products and Insights squad is at the core of systems that store, process, and leverage data, machine learning models, and generative AI capabilities. Ultimately, this provides real-time insights and innovative ML and AI driven solutions that serve as key drivers for business growth.

Your mission will be to lead the team building and maintaining a platform that enables everyone at Wise to rapidly experiment and bring to production Generative AI based systems, providing tooling, guidance and guardrails so that teams can ensure the safety of our customers and their data.

You will guide the sustainable growth of this critical function, leading other engineering leads and having the opportunity to shape multiple teams across AI enablement and controls.

Your input will directly affect how Wise builds and scales Generative AI capabilities across the company, enabling teams to move with speed and confidence while maintaining reliability, security and operational excellence.

 

How we work:

We operate with a belief in automation, programmatic implementation, and reusable design. We’re looking for people who can step back and think holistically about the ecosystem, but also follow through and help implement the design; drawing on the resources across the rest of the Platform Tribe.

As we grow, it is imperative to protect our customers’ money and navigate complex regulatory requirements world-wide. You will have a focus on running and maintaining services and libraries, making sure we have the right observability and service management elements in place, with an eye for high-availability, assessing and reducing engineering load and devising more effective ways for the team to look after its cloud-based platform.

We need to sustain this growth by continuously iterating on the services we run, with a focus on availability, security, and ease of use. We’re looking for an engineer with relevant experience who can understand and respond to complex requirements and deliver simple solutions to help our teams achieve our mission with speed and confidence.

 

What will you be working on?:
• You are an experienced leader, confident in problem-solving and guiding engineering teams through the complexities of project delivery using both agile and traditional methodologies.
• Great communication skills and the ability to build consensus - you’re comfortable making a case for what you believe we should be doing.
• Experience being a self-starter, self-motivated and collaborative.
• The mindset to solve problems from scratch.
• Comfortable taking ownership of vendor negotiations and explaining costs to the business.
• Willingness to give and take regular feedback - regular feedback is part of our culture.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description:
You’ll join a lean, global Revenue Operations team and work closely with Wise Business commercial leadership, regional sales teams, Finance, Analytics, Marketing and CRM.

Building on our existing lead management and sales process foundations, your focus will be commercial performance and building a unified end-to-end process:quotas, forecasting, sales productivity, outbound effectiveness, lead management and capacity planning as we expand across regions.

We’re looking for someone who combines strategic judgement with the willingness to get into the details. You’ll spot opportunities before they become requests, prioritise the changes with the greatest potential impact, and bring people together to make them happen.

Your ownership will continue through implementation, adoption and measurement. Success means stronger revenue growth, faster customer activation, more productive sales teams and better commercial decisions - not simply completed projects.

Your mission
• Find and unlock growth opportunities. Understand the journey from prospecting and qualification through activation, ongoing usage and revenue. Identify where we lose momentum, quantify the opportunity, and build a focused agenda to improve conversion and accelerate revenue.
• Raise the team’s performance and ambition. Partner with regional leaders to set stretching, evidence-based goals and establish clear expectations for performance. Bring constructive challenge to reviews, surface gaps early, and turn discussions into decisions and action. Share what works across regions and help colleagues strengthen their commercial judgement.
• Build quotas and capacity plans that support growth. Translate commercial ambitions into plans grounded in market opportunity, sales capacity, rep ramp and productivity. Make clear recommendations on where to invest, how to deploy resources, and which improvements will increase the return on that investment.
• Make forecasting a tool for better decisions. Build a forecasting approach that connects pipeline, conversion, activation and revenue. Explain what is driving performance, challenge assumptions, and work with commercial leaders on actions to close gaps and capture upside.
• Improve payback and sales productivity. Work with Finance and Analytics to understand the economics of our sales motions. Develop a practical payback playbook that helps leaders decide which segments, channels and approaches to scale, improve or stop.
• Turn outbound activity into commercial results. Partner with Marketing, CRM and Sales to develop and test targeted outbound campaigns. Measure performance through to activation and revenue, learn quickly, and scale approaches that demonstrate attractive returns.
• Use systems and automation to multiply impact. Work with GTM Tooling & Systems and Analytics to translate commercial needs into effective tools, reporting and workflows. Apply automation and AI where they improve conversion, decision-making or selling capacity, and measure whether those benefits materialise.

jobs.title: Product Director, Receive
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Technology Vendor Manager
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Technology Vendor Manager to join our Vendor Management team in Tallinn.

In this role, you will centrally manage and govern technology vendor relationships, ensuring global regulatory compliance, operational alignment, and maximising ROI from our vendors. You will hold technology vendors accountable for agreed SLAs and KPIs, driving contract negotiations, supplier performance governance, invoice reconciliation, and cost efficiency frameworks. Responsibilities include overseeing 30–60 day pre-renewal review cadences with Procurement, managing domain vendor portfolios (KYX, FinCrime, CS/SSE), and driving contact deflection and automation in close alignment with Product, Engineering, and Finance.

About the team

Technology Vendor Management forms part of the wider Vendor Management organisation. The team includes Tech Vendor Managers and Tech Vendor Coordinators managing domain portfolios across KYX, FinCrime, and CS/SSE. The team’s goal is to optimise current vendor spend and performance while future-proofing our tech ecosystem through scalable, automated vendor management frameworks. The role works closely with Product, Engineering, Procurement, Corporate Finance, Data & Analytics (D&A), Risk Management, and vendor leadership.

How you’ll contribute to the team
• Establish quantitative KPI & SLA performance controls for Tier 1 tech vendors and automate monthly tracking with D&A.
• Lead pre-renewal cadences 30–60 days in advance with Procurement to drive commercial negotiations and contract renewals.
• Drive key strategic initiatives including vendor consolidation, automation/deflection, and maintaining the Historic Cost and Volume Sheet.
• Manage financial tracking and OPEX cost-savings frameworks in collaboration with Corporate Finance.
• Oversee technical vendor onboarding, offboarding, POC evaluations, and metadata hygiene in tools like Omnea.
• Maintain monthly Vendor RAG reporting and initiate improvement projects when a specific need arises.

jobs.title: Partner Risk Assessment Specialist
jobs.description:
Role & Job purpose

As a Partner Risk Assessment Specialist, you will play a critical role in ensuring that Wise adheres to regulatory and compliance requirements. You will be responsible for onboarding and risk assessing banks and online platforms partnering with Wise. This position offers the unique opportunity to influence Wise’s mission and establish partnerships that facilitate instant, borderless money for more people.

Your mission

Wise Platform helps financial institutions and large enterprises leverage Wise’s infrastructure to offer their customers world class payments products through their own platforms. Wise Platform is a start-up within a scale up. We’re a cross functional team across sales, account management, product, engineering, compliance, analytics and many other functions. We’re based across the world – from London to Singapore, Austin and beyond. 

Your primary mission will be to onboard banks and online platforms, assessing their compliance policies, producing comprehensive compliance memos to determine partner risk and hand-holding partners through their KYC journey.

 

Job Responsibilities
• Policy and Procedure Review:
• Conduct thorough and detailed due diligence on our banks and online platforms to assess their compliance with regulatory requirements, internal policies, and industry standards.
• Review partners’ documentation, including Know Your Customer (KYC) information, legal agreements, and other relevant materials to ensure accuracy and completeness.
• Document your findings in compliance memos that summarize potential risks.
• Assist in the development and improvement of the compliance onboarding process to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
• Onboarding New Partners:
• Manage the onboarding process for banks and online platforms, ensuring seamless integration with Wise Platform.
• Keep abreast of regulatory developments and industry best practices to ensure that the onboarding process aligns with the latest compliance standards.
• Develop and maintain strong relationships with partners to facilitate smooth onboarding and address any compliance-related queries or concerns.
• Risk Assessment and Control Recommendations:
• Evaluate and recommend appropriate monitoring controls based on the inherent risks identified during the onboarding process.
• Apply broad industry, operational risk, and regulatory knowledge to drive onboarding excellence
• Cross team collaboration:
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders, such as Legal, Risk Management, and Business Development, to obtain necessary information and approvals for client onboarding.
• Act as a SME to senior stakeholders and/or other team members related to Enterprise Due Diligence processes and compliance requirements

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Financial Institutions Partnerships
jobs.description:
YouTrip is the leading and fastest-growing multi-currency payment platform in Asia Pacific. In 2018, we pioneered the region's first multi-currency digital wallet. Now, YouTrip is the #1 multi-currency digital wallet trusted by millions across the region, processing over US$15 billion in total payment value annually. 

Our consumer and business propositions – YouTrip and YouBiz – empower individuals and businesses with inclusive, accessible, and affordable financial solutions. YouTrip has raised over US$110 million to date, including its recent Series B round led by global venture capital firm Lightspeed Venture Partners—underscoring strong investor confidence in its mission to transform digital financial services across the Asia Pacific. 

Recognised as World Economic Forum’s Global Innovator 2025, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies (2025, 2024), and LinkedIn’s Top Startup (2024, 2023), YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses.

Valuing an entrepreneurial culture of diversity and inclusion, we are seeking driven individuals to join our fast-growing regional team as we push the boundaries of innovative fintech solutions.

About the team:

YouTrip's Corporate Development team shapes and executes our growth strategy. Our work spans fundraising and investor relations, M&A, partnerships with banks and card schemes, FX and remittance, and the commercial deals behind new products and markets.

In this role, you will focus on our financial institution partnerships. You will manage our relationships with the banks, card schemes and payment partners we work with, bring their expertise and best practices into YouTrip, and help shape the FI infrastructure that supports our growth across markets. As a lean team, we work across each other's areas, so you can expect to support the wider team's priorities as they arise.

This role suits someone with experience as a banker, such as in FI coverage, transaction banking or corporate banking, or someone from a fintech company who has worked closely with banking and payment partners. 

You Will:
• Manage relationships with banks, card schemes and payment partners across our markets, and bring their insights and best practices into how YouTrip operates
• Assess the FI infrastructure YouTrip relies on, including banking, settlement, FX and payment partners, and structure recommendations on how it should evolve as we grow
• Build the analysis and business cases behind partnership decisions
• Run the operational workstreams that keep our partnerships running, including bank onboarding, account opening, facilities and guarantees
• Keep the partner pipeline, pricing and commitments tracked and up to date
• Prepare for bank and card scheme meetings and follow through on the outcomes
• Work with finance, product, legal, compliance and operations, as well as external counterparties, to get things done
• Support the wider team on other priorities as they arise, such as new market entry, fundraising and commercial deals

 

What success looks like after 12 months:
• You are a trusted day-to-day contact for our key banking, card scheme and payment partners
• You have shaped recommendations on our FI infrastructure that management has acted on
• You have supported the partner workstreams behind at least one new market launch
• You manage several workstreams at once, escalating decisions rather than tasks
• You have built AI-enabled workflows or templates that the team relies on

 

You Are:
• An individual with 4 to 5 years of experience in banking, fintech or professional services, ideally in FI coverage, transaction banking, corporate banking, or treasury / FX sales
• Fluent written and spoken English
• An independent learner who is comfortable with ambiguity and can move work forward with limited direction
• Able to turn analysis into a clear business case and recommendation for management
• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to coordinate internal teams and external counterparties
• Proficient with AI tools (such as Claude, Gemini or similar) as part of your daily workflow
• Interest in working in a fast-paced fintech environment
• Experience managing bank partnerships would be an advantage

jobs.title: Intern, Data Engineering
jobs.description:
Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

 

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

 

Your Mission

As a Data Engineering Intern in our Data Hub team in Barcelona, you will build and operate a modern data platform that empowers teams across Bitpanda. Working alongside experienced data engineers, you will gain hands-on experience turning raw data into reliable, high-quality data products. This role provides direct mentorship, best-in-class engineering standards, and an environment where your growth is actively supported.

Hiring for these positions kicks off in October 2026 for a 6-month, full-time role, starting on February 1,
2027. What you'll do
• Build reliable data pipelines: Write clean Python and SQL code to design, implement, and maintain ETL pipelines for data ingestion and transformation.
• Create impactful data products: Develop clean datasets and data models that empower analysts, business stakeholders, and decision-makers across Bitpanda.
• Master engineering standards: Apply solid engineering practices, including version control, automated testing, code reviews, and CI/CD workflows.
• Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with teams across Product, Operations, and Finance to translate business requirements into pragmatic data solutions.
• Manage projects: Take ownership of data engineering workflows and project deliverables under the guidance of experienced team members.

 

Who you are
• Data enthusiast: You have a foundational background in Computer Science or completed a relevant coding bootcamp with a strong focus on data engineering.
• Python SQL skilled: You have practical experience writing Python scripts and SQL queries through personal projects, coursework, or practical training.
• Cloud data aware: You grasp core data engineering concepts and have basic exposure to cloud environments (preferably AWS, or GCP/Azure).
• Curious growth-minded: You are highly motivated, comfortable asking questions, eager to receive feedback, and excited to solve tough engineering problems.
• Collaborative team player: You are fluent in English with strong communication skills and eager to work alongside analysts and engineers to build useful data tools.

What’s in it for you
• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
• Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
• Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
• Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
• Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
• Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
• Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
• Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
• Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
• Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
• Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

 .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

 

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

jobs.title: Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
About us:

Branch is on a mission to empower workers with financial freedom. We do this by helping companies accelerate payments and providing working Americans with accessible, free financial services. We’re committed to building and delivering more inclusive, transparent, and frictionless financial products.

Our goal of empowerment extends to our own employees, too. Have a great idea? Share it today and it might just get implemented tomorrow. As a member of our team, your voice and creativity matter—and they can directly impact our products, company, and culture. 

We not only focus on attracting great talent from across the country, but also on building teams that help that talent thrive. That means valuing a diversity of opinions and working styles, while creating a shared belief in innovation, initiative, and winning together.

Come join our team as we develop new ways to improve the lives of working Americans.

About

the role:

The Compliance Analyst is a hands-on member of the Branch Compliance team, supporting the day-to-day operation of our Compliance Management System (CMS). Branch delivers its products through sponsor bank partnerships, so this role sits at the intersection of Branch's compliance program and our bank partners' expectations. You will review alerts and cases, handle customer complaints, and help test and document how our controls work. You will work closely with the entire Compliance team and gain exposure to AML/BSA, OFAC, EFTA/Reg E, ACH, UDAAP, and TCPA across products such as earned wage access, deposit accounts, and payments.

What You'll Do:

Financial crimes and onboarding
• Review and disposition alerts from transaction monitoring, primarily cash/credit loads, documenting the rationale for each decision
• Investigate unusual or potentially suspicious activity and escalate potential UAR referrals, maintaining strict confidentiality
• Recommend and help test changes to alert rules and thresholds as risk trends evolve, in coordination with Compliance Managers

Complaints and consumer compliance
• Monitor and triage customer complaints for regulatory concerns, including UDAAP and EFTA/Reg E

jobs.title: Risk and Recovery Contact Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About us:

Branch is on a mission to empower workers with financial freedom. We do this by helping companies accelerate payments and providing working Americans with accessible, free financial services. We’re committed to building and delivering more inclusive, transparent, and frictionless financial products.

Our goal of empowerment extends to our own employees, too. Have a great idea? Share it today and it might just get implemented tomorrow. As a member of our team, your voice and creativity matter—and they can directly impact our products, company, and culture. 

We not only focus on attracting great talent from across the country, but also on building teams that help that talent thrive. That means valuing a diversity of opinions and working styles, while creating a shared belief in innovation, initiative, and winning together.

Come join our team as we develop new ways to improve the lives of working Americans.

About

the role:

Branch's fraud and disputes customers now reach us around the clock. Our BPO partner handles inbound phone and chat 24/7 for fraud claims, dispute intake, account unlocks, and account takeover (ATO) contacts, backed by a seven-day back office. That front office is where most customers first tell us something went wrong, and where a bad actor is most likely to try to talk their way into an account.

As Risk and Recovery Contact Operations Manager, you own the inbound phone and chat operation for Risk Recovery. You know its health hour by hour, you are accountable for its performance, and when someone asks how the 24/7 operation is running, you are the answer. The BPO executes the contacts. You own the procedures, the quality bar, the coverage, and the outcomes, regardless of who picks up the phone. Enterprise Systems owns the BPO contract, renewals, and contractual SLAs; you own the day-to-day operation.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with real ownership. It is a focused version of a full BPO support manager role: one vendor, Risk Recovery lines of business only, no internal team to manage. It suits someone with BPO contact center experience who also understands fraud, disputes, or risk, and who wants to own an operation rather than a queue.

Responsibilities:

Run the 24/7 Office:
• Own the daily health of R R inbound phone and chat: volume, speed to answer, abandonment, handle time, first-contact resolution, transfers, and misroutes
• Lead a daily stand-up with BPO operations leads to review prior-day performance and set the day's priorities
• Watch intraday coverage and act on gaps before they become a backlog or a missed SLA
• Drive resolution on the call. The initial target is resolving 50% of fraud contacts on the phone, without a hand-off to the back office

Staffing/Coverage:
• Supply the R R inputs the staffing model depends on: contact volume by line of business, work mix, handle-time assumptions, and arrival patterns
• Partner hands-on with Support's BPO Manager on forecasting and scheduling in Zendesk WFM; you own whether R R coverage is right, they own the WFM tooling and the CX relationship
• Hold the BPO to its staffing commitments, including the overnight floor and billable FTE minimums; confirm delivered hours against schedules before invoices go to the Director for approval

Contact Procedures Ownership:
• Own the BPO-facing phone and chat procedures for R R: call flows, scripts, and macros. Build the identity verification controls set by the Manager of Risk Controls into those call flows, and report where they break down in practice
• Build them on the domain SOPs owned by the Managers of Risk and Recovery Program Operations; domain SOPs stay with their owners
• Translate daily friction on the phones into specific, solvable problems for the right Manager of Risk and Recovery Program Operations, Product, or automation partner

Training Quality:
• Own R R new-hire and refresher training for BPO front-office agents, built on current procedures
• Run the day-to-day QA operation for BPO calls and chats, including scoring, sampling and calibration sessions, against the QA criteria set by the R R QA owners and approved by the Operations Manager
• Own the QA outcome: make sure feedback is coached, applied and visible in live contacts, hold agents accountable, and issue corrective action plans to the BPO, tracked to closure. Share what QA and the floor are showing with the R R QA owners, who own trend analysis and the process changes that follow

Operational Review Reporting:
• Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for the BPO on R R contact operations
• Run weekly operational reviews with BPO leadership and provide the front-office performance input for monthly and quarterly business reviews
• Be the first escalation point for front-office performance; resolve at your level or escalate with a recommendation attached
• Give Enterprise Systems the performance data it needs for contractual SLA oversight, service credits, and renewals. Route contractual and non-user-facing vendor issues to Enterprise Systems; own everything that affects users day to day
• Lead the operational side of transitioning new contact work to the BPO, with procedures, training, and escalation paths in place before go-live
• Publish a weekly front-office scorecard: coverage, speed to answer, abandonment, handle time, resolution on the call, quality, and escalations
• Surface trends and risks before they appear in a management report

• 4–6 years in contact center operations, including at least 2 years working directly with a BPO or offshore partner
• 2+ years in fraud, disputes, chargebacks, payments, or risk operations at a financial institution, fintech, or payments processor, or similar work experience
• Hands-on experience with workforce management: forecasting inputs, scheduling, intraday management, and adherence
• Experience building QA programs, calibrations, and agent training
• Strong analytical skills; comfortable living in contact center data
• Strong writing and communication skills; able to hold a vendor accountable and keep the relationship productive

• Because the operation runs 24/7, you may occasionally need to attend meetings outside standard hours to align with BPO shift leaders. The role may require periodic travel to BPO sites.

jobs.title: Accounting Partnerships Manager
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Partnerships at Brex

Sales is the growth engine at Brex. We bring in new customers, expand existing relationships, and drive the company’s bottom line. With unlimited territories and uncapped opportunity, your ambition sets the ceiling. We win together, celebrate often, and reward performance. If you want to sell a category-defining product with real ownership, this is your team.

What you’ll do

Brex’s Accounting Channel is undergoing exponential growth, and we are looking for a partner manager to accelerate the team. In this role, you'll be at the forefront of shaping and expanding our market presence, driving a critical engine of our company's success. We're on the hunt for a dynamic professional who excels at forging powerful alliances in the accounting and OCFO ecosystems. You’ll be responsible for building strong relationships, cultivating partnerships from the ground up, seamlessly integrating new partners into our ecosystem, and consistently hitting targets by transforming these connections into a steady stream of client referrals. If you have a history of exceeding expectations and a passion for creating mutually beneficial business relationships, this could be your chance to make a significant impact in a fast growing environment.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our New York office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Identify, cultivate, and deepen relationships with high-potential accounting firms
• Craft and implement tailored go-to-market strategies for each partner
• Facilitate smooth onboarding of new partners and their teams
• Drive client referrals from our accounting partners to fuel revenue growth for Brex
• Serve as a product expert, articulating our value proposition to partners
• Be the connective tissue for partners to the Brex ecosystem
• Work cross-functionally across marketing, growth, direct sales, and product engineering to drive co-marketing opportunities, onboard new clients, and inform our product roadmap
• Conduct regular performance reviews with key partners
• Identify and build relationships with multiple stakeholders within accounting firms
• Become an expert in Brex's product, features, and workflows and augment the voice of our Accounting Partners

Requirements
• 3+ years in a closing sales or partnerships role
• Demonstrated track record of consistently hitting targets and quotas
• Ability to identify client needs through thoughtful questioning, active listening, and analysis; including but not limited to shared mutual referral goals, enablement sessions, and MBR/QBRs where necessary
• Ability to deliver tailored, consultative solutions that align with partner’s needs and business goals
• Ability to evaluate partnership performance, identify areas for optimization, and implement data-driven solutions
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with excellent listening skills
• Thrives in a fast-paced, evolving startup environment
• Proven ability to build trust and credibility with internal and external stakeholders.
• Passion for community events and activations with partners

Bonus points
• Experience in collaborating with accounting firms
• Accounting background (CPA certification or relevant industry experience is a plus)

Compensation

The expected OTE range for this role is $135,600 - $169,500. The starting wage will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. The OTE figure listed here includes base salary and commissions, which may or may not be earned depending on performance. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Compliance

The Compliance team helps the company grow responsibility, advocating for Brex and for the thousands of growing businesses we serve. We own the compliance policies for Brex, provide strategic advice and guidance to all Brex teams, protect Brex from Financial Crime and other compliance risks, and represent the company externally on key regulatory and policy issues. Reimagining the financial system in a highly regulated environment requires creativity and resourcefulness, and we welcome the challenge.

What you’ll do

As the Screening Transaction Monitoring Associate, you will review and escalate potential sanctions matches and politically exposed persons (PEPs) hits across our customers, payments, and vendors. You will review and assess screening data to make sound match decisions and assess the sanctions risk each alert poses. Clear communication is essential for documenting match dispositions, writing escalation memos, and discussing potential sanctions exposure with senior management. Experience working with external financial partners, auditors, and regulators is valuable. Adaptability is crucial, as sanctions programs, designations, and geopolitical risk can change overnight, as is keeping a positive, collaborative mindset while managing a high volume of alerts.

Where you’ll work
This role will be based in our Seattle office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Review and disposition customer, payment, and vendor screening alerts against OFAC, UN, EU, UK, and other applicable sanctions lists, escalating true matches and potential violations
• Conduct PEP reviews, including enhanced due diligence on high-risk relationships
• Take ownership of the effectiveness of our screening controls, spotting, scoping, and driving improvements to workflows
• Assist with the preparation of required sanctions reports, such as OFAC blocked and rejected transaction reports
• Monitor sanctions program changes and new designations
• Support screening vendor integrations and answer questions from L1 alert reviewers
• Help reduce screening false positive rates without weakening coverage
• Help develop and deliver internal sanctions and Financial Crimes training
• Take ownership of the success of our internal controls, spot, scope, and drive opportunities for improvement

Requirements
• 4+ years of experience across a variety of financial risk operations (Sanctions, PEP, AML, SAR, BSA, 314a, Watchlist, 314b, Third Party Payment Processing, Fraud, Bribery/Corruption, Due Diligence, etc)
• Strong knowledge of US sanctions programs and OFAC regulations and relevant US financial regulations authorities (ex: FinCEN, FINRA, BIS, etc.)
• Experience with OFAC reporting requirements and timelines, including blocked and rejected transaction reports and voluntary self-disclosures
• Experience with escalating to and communicating with OFAC, banking partners, law enforcement, or other regulators
• Ability to analyze complex ownership structures and money movement across payment methods to identify sanctions exposure
• Familiarity with data analytics tools (SQL, Looker, Snowflake, Hex, Excel), including designing, debugging, and organizing data for a wide audience
• Experience with ComplyAdvantage or similar screening platforms and Unit 21
• Demonstrated ability to work as part of a cross-functional, multi-disciplinary team (Operations, Customer Experience, Legal, Engineering, Product Management, Data) in designing operational work-streams and internal controls

Bonus points
• Insatiable curiosity
• Eagerness to learn
• Detail oriented
• Desire to build

Compensation
The expected salary range for this role is $111,197 - $138,996. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

You'll own defined risk analysis projects from investigation through recommendation, working closely with the DCO risk lead and partnering with Product, Operations, and Finance to turn analysis into practical risk decisions that shape a growing business.

• Partner with Product, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Compliance to evaluate how funding, settlement, and processing failures create financial risk across the trade lifecycle, and help draft and maintain related risk procedures and control documentation.
• Prepare concise risk analyses, incident reviews, and management materials that clearly separate confirmed facts, assumptions, open questions, and recommendations.

Required Skills and

Experience:
• 1 to 3 years of experience in market risk, counterparty risk, derivatives clearing, or trading operations at a major financial institution, exchange, or clearinghouse.
• Working knowledge of derivatives products and margin models, including how trades create positions, funding needs, and settlement obligations, and how initial and variation margin protect against counterparty exposure.
• Familiarity with clearing risk concepts such as stress and backtesting, collateral management, or settlement exception analysis.
• Demonstrated ability to take an open-ended risk question, structure a work plan, source the right data, and deliver a considered recommendation with minimal direction.

jobs.title: Operational Excellence & Incident Response Manager, Predictions
jobs.description:
About us
Crypto.com is building the regulated home for prediction markets and derivatives in the United States. Through Crypto.com Derivatives North America and OG.com we operate a CFTC-designated contract market and a registered clearinghouse. OG.com Prediction Markets lists event contracts on sports, politics, economics, culture, and crypto, including single-event contracts and combos.
 
The problem you'll solve
It's Saturday night in the US. A partner broker messages: their customers' orders are stuck, and their support queue is filling up. You do not yet know if it is our gateway, their routing, the market data feed, or the settlement logic. People who can fix it are in the US, in Asia, or asleep. Today, whoever sees the message first owns it. That is the gap.
You are the single owner of every production incident that touches OG.com Prediction Markets, the exchange, the clearinghouse, or our partner brokers, from the first alert to the final review. You do not write the fix. You decide who does, within minutes. You keep every affected partner current. You make the risk call on what happens in the next 20 minutes, the next 3 hours, and on Monday morning. Root cause is identified in the first 30 minutes. An issue does not sit open for four hours.
A platform failure usually hits many partners at once, not one. You run that room.
You report to the SVP of Product. You do not have a team on day one. Within 6 to 12 months, a person who is good at this builds the rotation and owns the partner relationships that come with it.
What you decide: severity, who gets paged, the live timeline, every partner update while the incident is open, and the recommendation to pause, halt, cancel, or keep trading. The on-call approver approves a pause or halt. Exchange Operations owns the listing and the settlement call. Engineering owns the code.

We are becoming an intelligent, proactive ally that handles the complexity of users financial life. We aren't just selling financial products; we are building a truly smart agent that understands users, anticipates their needs, and helps people reach their financial goals.

Our ML Search team brings together Backend, Product, Machine Learning Scientists and Data Scientists. As a Lead Machine Learning Scientist, you’ll build and ship models that help customers search for and find answers about their financial lives. You'll make it effortless for them to find the right products at the exact moment they need them.

Whether it’s surfacing the right savings product at the perfect moment, helping customers manage their spending, or simplifying financial planning, our work makes banking smarter, more intuitive, and truly customer-first.

What you’ll be working on:

As a Lead Machine Learning Scientist, you'll be a technical leader and individual contributor. We have a modern, cloud-native data platform with billions of rows of data built for fast iterations. You'll leverage your deep expertise to develop and deploy advanced ML models to our more than 15 million customers.

 

Your work may involve user and product embeddings to better understand customer behaviours, contextual bandits for optimising real-time decisions, or personalised ranking algorithms that improve search and discovery. You'll also build scalable, explainable, and responsible AI solutions that enhance trust, transparency, and the overall customer experience.

 

The technical approaches you take to help solve customer problems will be very much in your hands and we’ll strongly encourage and support experimentation and innovation. We’ll be expecting you to justify and demonstrate effectiveness along the way, making sure the approach meets our business and customer needs.

 

You should apply if:

What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!
• You have a multiple year track record of excellence leading the development and deployment of advanced Machine Learning models to tackle real business problems preferably in a fast moving tech company
• You have experience developing and shipping state of the art ML models to production and delivering business impact
• You're impact driven and excited to own the end to end journey that starts with a business problem and ends with your solution having a measurable impact in production
• You have a self-starter mindset; you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so
• You speak Python fluently and have extensive, hands-on experience with scikit-learn. You are comfortable using SQL, and keen to learn Go lang which is used in many of our backend microservices
• You’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity and have experience helping your team and stakeholders resolve that ambiguity
• You want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day
• You have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions
• You're excited about fast-moving developments in Machine Learning and can communicate those ideas to colleagues who are not familiar with the domain
• You’re adaptable, curious and enjoy learning new technologies and ideas

Nice to haves:

• Commercial experience writing critical production code and working with microservices

We’ve built a bank that feels human, not just functional. Our product is our personality. We blend research, empathy, data and craft to turn everyday interactions into memorable experiences.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

The Strategic Markets and Global Marketing teams are responsible for accelerating sustainable growth across OKX’s priority markets. We work across regions and functions to identify opportunities, develop market strategies, strengthen execution, and build repeatable operating models that can scale globally.

 

We are looking for a Chief of Staff to serve as a trusted strategic and operational partner to the Executive Vice President of Global Markets and Marketing. This is a high-impact role at the intersection of strategy, market expansion, business performance, and organizational execution.

 

You will translate strategic priorities into clear operating plans, drive high-priority cross-functional initiatives, improve decision-making through rigorous analysis, and ensure alignment across regional and global teams. You will also act as a connective layer between the Strategic Markets and Global Marketing leadership teams and key partners across Product, Marketing, Business Development, Operations, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and other functions.

 

The ideal candidate combines strong commercial judgment, analytical rigor, executive presence, and hands-on execution. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, challenging assumptions, and taking ownership of complex initiatives from initial problem definition through to measurable results.

 

What You’ll Be Doing 

Strategic Planning and Execution
• Partner directly with the Executive Vice President of Global Markets and Marketing to define priorities, develop strategic plans, and translate objectives into clear initiatives, milestones, and areas of accountability.
• Drive the annual and quarterly planning processes for Strategic Markets and Global Marketing, ensuring alignment between regional priorities and broader company objectives.
• Lead complex, high-priority initiatives spanning multiple markets, business units, and functional teams.
• Identify execution risks, dependencies, and organizational gaps early, and work with stakeholders to resolve them.
• Ensure key decisions are translated into action, with clear ownership, timelines, and measurable outcomes.

Market Growth and Business Performance
• Develop data-driven analyses and recommendations regarding market expansion, investment allocation, customer growth, partnerships, and other strategic opportunities.
• Monitor market performance, commercial trends, competitive developments, and emerging risks across priority markets.
• Partner with regional leaders to assess performance, identify growth opportunities, and strengthen local market strategies.
• Build business cases and scenario analyses to support resource allocation and investment decisions.
• Help develop repeatable market-entry and growth playbooks that can be applied across regions while accounting for local market conditions.

Operating Cadence and Governance
• Establish and continuously improve the operating cadence for Strategic Markets and Global Marketing, including leadership meetings, business reviews, planning sessions, and regional performance reviews.
• Develop dashboards and management reports that provide leadership with a clear view of performance, priorities, risks, and required decisions.
• Create effective governance mechanisms for cross-functional initiatives, ensuring appropriate escalation and timely decision-making.
• Maintain disciplined follow-through on leadership decisions, commitments, and strategic initiatives.
• Improve the quality and flow of information among regional teams, functional partners, and senior leadership.

Executive Advisory and Decision Support
• Serve as a trusted thought partner to the Executive Vice President of Global Markets and Marketing on strategic, commercial, operational, and organizational matters.
• Synthesize complex information into clear insights, recommendations, executive briefings, and materials that support decision-making.
• Prepare presentations, business reviews, strategic updates, and other materials for senior leadership.
• Represent the Strategic Markets and Global Marketing leadership teams in selected meetings and initiatives, ensuring continuity, alignment, and follow-through.

Cross-Functional Leadership
• Build strong relationships with regional leaders and global stakeholders across Product, Marketing, Business Development, Operations, Finance, Legal, Compliance, HR, and Communications.
• Act as a connector across teams, clarifying objectives, resolving competing priorities, and removing barriers to execution.
• Lead special projects and time-sensitive initiatives that do not have a natural owner elsewhere in the organization.
• Support organizational planning, resource prioritization, and ways of working as the Strategic Markets and Global Marketing function evolves.
• Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, transparency, and high performance.

 

What We Look For In You
• Experience in strategy, business operations, management consulting, investment banking, technology, fintech, financial services, or a similarly fast-paced and analytical environment.
• Demonstrated experience partnering directly with senior executives and influencing leaders across multiple functions and markets.
• A strong track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from strategy through execution.
• Strong commercial judgment and the ability to connect market insights, customer needs, business performance, and company priorities.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, including experience developing business cases, performance analyses, and executive-level recommendations.
• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex topics into clear decisions and action plans.
• Strong executive presence and the ability to build trust with stakeholders across different functions, cultures, and levels of seniority.
• High ownership, sound judgment, and a willingness to operate at both strategic and hands-on levels.
• Ability to thrive in ambiguity, adapt quickly, and maintain momentum in a rapidly changing environment.
• High integrity and discretion when handling confidential or sensitive information.
• Professional fluency in English. 

Nice to Haves
• Experience in crypto, fintech, digital assets, payments, or another highly regulated and rapidly evolving industry.
• Experience supporting international expansion or managing initiatives across multiple geographic markets.
• Prior experience as a Chief of Staff, strategy leader, business operations leader, or regional operator.
• Familiarity with go-to-market strategy, growth planning, partnerships, and regional operating models.
• Additional language capabilities relevant to OKX’s international markets.

 

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

Disclaimer: Please note that Hong Kong is a group-level service hub, and OKX does not carry on a business of operating a virtual asset trading platform in Hong Kong.

 

Notice:

All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.

Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

• Support organizational planning, resource prioritization, and ways of working as the Strategic Markets and Global Marketing function evolves.
• Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, transparency, and high performance.

 

What We Look For In You
• Experience in strategy, business operations, management consulting, investment banking, technology, fintech, financial services, or a similarly fast-paced and analytical environment.
• Demonstrated experience partnering directly with senior executives and influencing leaders across multiple functions and markets.
• A strong track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from strategy through execution.

jobs.title: Senior Risk Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Risk Manager

OKX Europe Markets Ltd | Malta | Regulated by the Malta Financial Services Authority (MFSA)

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of blockchain to users around the world through OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Team

The Group Risk function provides independent, second-line oversight of risk across the Group's portfolio of entities. This role sits within that function, focused on the risk oversight of the Company's Trading Venue segment.

About the Opportunity

This is a unique opportunity to build and own the risk function for a multi-asset-class Trading Venue — spanning a broad range of financial instruments — with a DLT overlay. You will be responsible for identifying, assessing and managing the risks specific to operating a Trading Venue, including market conduct, participant risk, systems and controls, and the distinct operational and settlement risks introduced by the DLT infrastructure. You will hold PQ (Approved Person) status with the MFSA and act as the venue's dedicated point of accountability for risk matters.

What You'll Be Doing
• Trading Venue Risk Framework: Design, implement and maintain a risk management framework specific to the Trading Venue segment, covering market, operational, conduct and technology risk
• Market Surveillance Oversight: Independently assess the effectiveness of the venue's market surveillance arrangements in identifying rule infringements, disorderly trading conditions, market abuse indicators and system disruptions
• Participant Risk Assessment: Assess prospective and existing members'/participants' trading ability and financial resource adequacy relative to the venue's settlement arrangements, working alongside Compliance's onboarding and fit-and-proper due diligence
• Systems and Controls Oversight: Independently assess the adequacy of the venue's systems and controls framework, including algorithmic trading resilience, capacity and technology risk
• DLT Infrastructure Risk Oversight: Assess the adequacy of the Trading Venue's arrangements specific to the DLT infrastructure
• Business Continuity Oversight: Independently assess the adequacy of the venue's business continuity arrangements (DRP, BCP, BCM) against MFSA requirements
• Regulatory Liaison: Support the Company's regulatory relationship with the MFSA on Trading Venue-specific risk matters, including correspondence, notifications and reporting

What We Look For In You
• Bachelor's degree in finance, law, business administration or a related field; a relevant risk or regulatory certification is preferred
• 8+ years' experience in a risk, compliance or regulatory role within a Trading Venue, Regulated Market, MTF/OTF operator or Exchange/equivalent market infrastructure
• Sound understanding of the MFSA regulatory framework (or an equivalent ESMA-supervised NCA) and MiFID II requirements applicable to Trading Venues
• Familiarity with DLT-based market infrastructure and the associated operational and settlement risk considerations is highly desirable
• Strong analytical ability, with the capacity to assess venue-level risk exposures, identify gaps and produce well-reasoned written analysis
• Comfortable operating with significant autonomy in a newly established, independent reporting line, exercising sound judgement and escalating appropriately
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders across Risk, Compliance, Legal and Technology
• Eligible to hold PQ (Approved Person) status with the MFSA, or to obtain it in due course

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: 金融サービス・事業開発（BizDev）/ リーダー候補
jobs.description:
PayPayについて/About PayPay

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7600万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

AIを含む最新技術とデータを駆使し、圧倒的なスピードでサービス開発と事業成長を実現します。 日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、ユーザーの為に新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

 

業務について

▼PayPay金融戦略本部の紹介

金融戦略本部は、PayPayの顧客基盤・加盟店基盤や豊富な決済データと、グループ各社が持つ金融機能を掛け合わせ、AI時代の新たな金融体験を創り出す、事業開発のプロフェッショナル集団です。
給与デジタル払いをはじめとする、日常の資金移動を支える金融プラットフォームの構築に加え、PayPayアプリ上で利用できるポイント運用や、PayPay証券が提供するミニアプリの事業推進を担っています。
また、加盟店向けには、「PayPay資金調達」の事業推進に加え、銀行代理業として、PayPay銀行が提供する「PayPay店舗専用ローン」や法人口座の利用拡大を推進しています。
顧客課題の発見から、事業戦略の策定、サービス企画、グロースまでを一気通貫で担い、新しい金融の当たり前を事業として実現していきます。

 

▼関連コンテンツ
• PayPayでツクル金融のミライ_Vol. 01
• PayPayでツクル金融のミライ_Vol. 02
• PayPayでツクル金融のミライ_Vol. 03
• PayPayでツクル金融のミライ_Vol. 05
• その仕事はユーザーファーストか？業界の常識を超えた「金融」サービスへの追求
• 機械学習モデル×ユーザーファーストで、想定の5倍の成果を生んだ「PayPay資金調達」
• 給与デジタル払いで「人生の選択肢」を増やす。お金の流れを変えるサービスを日本で初めてリリース
• 金融を“変える側”に回る選択 — 価値を起点に仕事をする事業開発

▼募集の背景
スマホファーストな金融サービスのUIUXを拡充していくためには、ユーザーが抱える課題に対する解決策（そのほとんどは、まだ世の中に存在していません）をUIUXやサービスで実現することになります。
ところが、ユーザーが抱える課題は、目に見えないことが多いです。ユーザーに聞いても教えてくれません。
それを発見し課題を構造化して解決策まで昇華できるのは、金融サービスをより良くしていきたいと言う強い情熱がある人だけだと思っています。
本気のユーザー・ファーストな金融サービスを実現すること、それを新しく入ってくれる方に実行していただきたいです。

▼業務内容

金融プラットフォーム開発部は、スーパーアプリに向けて進化中の「PayPay」を中心としたPayPay経済圏を実現するため、新規事業開発・サービス企画・実行を担うチームです。

決済を祖業とし、続々と提供している証券・保険・銀行など金融分野を強固な経済圏として確立するためには、各サービスの強力な連携や圧倒的な流入を生み出す新たな仕掛けが必要です。
その仕掛けづくりをコンシューマと事業者の両面に目を向けて、仮説検証を行いながら、ユーザファーストな金融サービスの発明・開発を行っています。

PayPayの金融事業を国内No.1にし、「誰でも・自然に・簡単に」利用できるサービスの発明を通じてPayPayの収益拡大および事業成長を一緒に担っていただける仲間を募集します。

◆業務内容
• 当社主体のコンシューマ向け・事業者向けのサービス企画および推進
• 決済・金融の周辺知識をフル活用したサービスモデルの立案・構築
• グループ金融機関との協業に向けた調整、ビジネス要件定義
• 社内外の関係各署との横断的なプロジェクトマネジメント
• グロースおよび改善を目的とした施策の立案～実行

◆対象プロダクト
• PayPay給与受取
• 振込チャージ
• PayPayビジネスアカウント
• Web3
• Agentic Commerce
• 他、新規サービス

▼本ポジションの魅力
• PayPayのユーザ基盤をベースに、大きな市場に対する新規事業開発にチャレンジできる
• 0→1フェーズで、調査・企画・開発・グロースまで、新規事業開発の一連のプロセスに携われる
• プロダクトの社内開発で、真にユーザーファーストなサービス開発に携われる
• グループアセットを活用して、グローバルな先進事例を踏まえた戦略立案・事業推進が行える

必要な経験/スキル

以下のいずれか、または複数のご経験をお持ちの方
• 事業開発 、サービス企画 、プロジェクトマネジメント 、グロース推進の経験
• 流動性が高くスピードが速い組織での勤務経験（急成長フェーズの事業会社・スタートアップ等）
• 社内外のステークホルダーとのコミュニケーションスキル

 以下のいずれかを1つ以上強みとしてPRできる方
• 課題解決力：問題を特定して原因を掘り下げる論理的思考力や、改善に向けて周囲を巻き込んで動く実行力がある
• 全社横断的な推進力：課題解決に必要なステークホルダーを巻き込み、適切な優先順位で新規事業を立案・推進できる

あると望ましい経験/スキル
• 新興技術・テクノロジへの強い関心興味
• 新規事業を立ち上げた経験（各種法規など、サービス開発の際に注意が必要な点を把握している）
• ビジネス英語力（TOEIC800点以上）

PayPayが求める人物像
• PayPay 5 sensesに当てはまる方

待遇・条件

雇用形態
• 正社員

勤務地

※所属組織のルールおよび業務指示に応じて出社対応頂きます。

勤務時間

We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

Robinhood's Employee Relations team partners with leaders and employees to navigate the moments that matter most — workplace concerns, investigations, performance, conflict, and accommodations. Our Employee Relations Business Partners bring clarity and care to complex, sensitive situations, guiding managers through difficult conversations and ensuring every process reflects both our values and our obligations. We sit at the intersection of people advocacy and business accountability, and we do this work with rigor, empathy, and a deep commitment to fairness.

As an Employee Relations Business Partner, you will own the end-to-end employee relations and performance strategy for a dedicated client group, acting as a strategic partner to leadership on performance, conduct, and organizational health. You’ll drive how performance management shows up across your client group, shape the policies and processes that govern it company-wide, and act as the connective tissue between People Partners, Legal, and business leadership when the stakes are highest. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who wants to own the full performance and ER strategy for a client group — not simply execute against an existing playbook.

This role is based in our Chicago, IL and Westlake, TX offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. 

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do
• Own the end-to-end employee relations and performance strategy for your client group — acting as a trusted strategic partner to leadership on performance, conduct, and organizational health
• Drive performance management strategy and execution across your client group, advising leaders on performance improvement plans, corrective action, and complex termination decisions
• Design, implement, and evolve ER and performance-management policies and procedures in partnership with Legal and Compliance, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and company values
• Serve as the primary ER advisor to People Partners and business leaders, providing guidance and recommendations on complex, high-risk employee and performance matters and pushing back where needed
• Analyze case and performance trends across your client group to identify systemic issues, and translate findings into concrete policy, process, or people-strategy changes
• Partner with Learning Development and Legal to design and deliver training on performance management, policy adherence, and manager effectiveness
• Own case and performance documentation in HR Acuity, ensuring decisions meet compliance and audit standards, and produce reporting for leadership

What you bring
• 10+ years of HR experience, including 6+ years as a core Employee Relations Business Partner in a dynamic, high-growth, or highly regulated environment
• A demonstrated track record of owning performance management strategy for a client group from coaching managers through corrective action to complex termination decisions
• Deep knowledge of federal and state employment law (Title VII, ADA, FMLA, and similar), with the judgment to apply it in ambiguous, fast-moving situations
• Experience building or scaling ER and performance-management policy and programs not only operating within an existing framework
• Strong executive presence and stakeholder management skills; comfortable advising, and when necessary challenging, People Partners, Legal, and senior business leaders
• A data-informed approach to identifying performance and workforce trends and driving proactive risk reduction
• Experience with case management systems (e.g., HR Acuity) and rigorous documentation practices

What we offer
• Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
• Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
• Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.
• Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
• Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not.
• Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.
• Employer-paid life disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.
• Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
• Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.
