jobs.title: Global Director of Sales
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.

 

📍London | 💰£133,900 - £175,000 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨

 

Our Monzo Business team ⭐

Monzo Business helps businesses manage their money, and more than +1 million businesses in the UK bank with us. Now, we’re exploring how we can help more established businesses switch to Monzo, across the UK and Europe.

Many of those businesses have more complex needs. They may need help understanding whether Monzo is right for them, moving their banking, or getting the most from our products. A great conversation with the right person can make a real difference.

We’ve started building a sales team and testing a more personal approach. We’re looking for someone to take those early learnings and build a repeatable, effective sales-led growth function for small and medium-sized businesses.

This is a chance to build something new. You’ll help shape which customers we serve, where a human conversation adds the most value, and how Sales works alongside self-serve, Product, Marketing and Operations. You’ll build the team and the playbook—and stay close enough to the work to test, learn and change direction yourself.

You’ll also have the opportunity to build an AI-native sales function from the start. We want someone who can rethink how the team finds, understands and serves customers: using AI and automation to remove work, improve decisions and give people more time for conversations that matter. That means experimenting, measuring what changes, and helping the team adopt better ways of working as the technology evolves.

 

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...
• Lead Sales for Monzo Business globally. You’ll define our sales strategy, build and lead the team, and be accountable for its performance and commercial impact. That means reaching and winning the right customers, improving conversion and productivity, and building a sales motion that can grow sustainably.
• You’ll work closely with RevOps, Product and other teams to help shape the targets, insights, tools and customer journeys Sales needs, and use them to guide decisions and improve results.
• Build the SMB sales motion. Turn what we’re learning from our pilot into a clear strategy for the businesses we can serve best. Test how inbound, outbound and self-serve journeys work together, and identify where a sales conversation makes a meaningful difference.
• Make growth count. Scale a sales motion that brings more high-quality business customers to Monzo, focusing investment where Sales can drive incremental growth and deliver strong returns.
• Build the team. Hire, coach and develop high-performing Sales teams and Sales Managers. Set clear expectations, create a culture of learning and accountability, and Put the right team structure, incentives and ways of working in place as we grow.
• Design the system around the customer. Work with RevOps, Marketing, Partnerships and Operations on targeting, lead generation, routing, sales process, reporting and forecasting. Spot where the journey breaks down and bring people together to fix it.
• Make Sales and Product ‘One Team’. Share what you learn from customers and the sales funnel with Product, and work together on the experience, capabilities and product signals that help the right businesses discover and get value from Monzo.
• Build an AI-native way of working. Identify and test opportunities to redesign how the team works—from finding and prioritising prospects to preparing for conversations, following up, coaching and forecasting. Work with specialist teams to put useful tools and workflows in place, measure their impact and embed the ones that work.
• Use data to guide our approach. Build a clear view of the funnel, productivity, customer quality and sales economics. Use evidence to guide where to invest, what to change and when we’re ready to scale.
• Earn customers’ trust. Build a sales culture that puts customers first and delivers good outcomes, working with our Risk, Compliance and Legal teams as we grow.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…
• You’ve built or substantially changed an SMB sales motion in an early or ambiguous environment, and helped it grow into a repeatable, high-performing operation. You can tell us what you built, what you learned and what changed as you scaled.
• You understand selling to small and medium-sized businesses, including how to build a relatively high-volume, efficient motion with shorter sales cycles. You know how to combine human conversations with digital journeys.
• You’re an experienced sales leader and coach. You’ve hired and developed teams, managed performance and helped people do their best work. You’re comfortable getting close to customers and deals yourself.
• You think about the whole system. You understand how customer acquisition, marketing, product, people, processes, data and technology fit together, and can see where a change in one part affects the rest.
• You use AI and automation in your own work and have applied them to change how the team operates. You can explain the problem you were solving, what you tested, how you brought people along and what difference it made.
• You’re a practical change leader. You have experience putting practical changes into action. You can review and improve established ways of working, make progress through ambiguity and help a team adopt new approaches.
• You know how to get the best from Revenue Operations. You understand the foundations of a healthy sales engine, from lead routing and CRM to forecasting, funnel analysis and sales productivity, and know how to build them with the people who specialise in them.
• You work well with Product and other teams. You can connect what customers need and what Sales is learning to product and business decisions, and bring people together around a shared outcome.
• You’re commercially sharp. You understand the economics of growth, use data to challenge assumptions and can balance near-term results with building for the long term. You know when to keep experimenting and when to scale.
• You might have built in financial services, technology or another business selling to businesses. We care more about what you’ve done and how you think than the exact path you took to get there.
• You don’t need to tick every box. If this role excites you and you think you could make a difference, we’d love to hear from you.

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £133,900 - £175,000 ➕ equity Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

📍 This role is based in our London office

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps
• Intro call with the recruiter
• 30 min hiring manager call
• 2 hours of technical and behavioural interviews
• Stakeholder chat

This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! 

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

jobs.title: Legal Counsel, Litigation
jobs.location: New York, United States; San Jose, California, United States; United States (US)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity

The Global Legal team provides legal advice and guidance to OKX and its affiliated entities across all coverage areas and geographic locations, and supports business growth by working with all teams within the company to help them achieve their goals. Our team has attorneys around the world, and handles legal matters in literally hundreds of countries . The Global Litigation, Regulatory Enforcement and Investigations team handles OKX’s disputes, enforcement matters and government engagement worldwide at the intersection of litigation, regulation and emerging technology.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Third-party legal process:
• Review and respond to subpoenas, Section 1782 applications, garnishments, and court orders including TROs, preliminary injunctions and receivership orders served on OKX.
• Negotiate scope with issuing parties and directly interface with opposing counsel, object or move to quash where appropriate, and manage productions or other required actions through to closure.
• Address competing or conflicting orders from multiple jurisdictions, coordinating with OKX’s international legal process team and global litigation team.
• Government and law enforcement requests:
• Respond to US law enforcement and government process escalated by the legal response operations team, including grand jury subpoenas, court orders, and asset freeze and seizure requests.
• Litigation and demands:
• Assess and respond to litigation demands and threatened claims, handling matters directly where appropriate and escalating as needed.
• Assist with matters that progress from legal process into litigation, working with senior team members and external counsel.
• Cross-functional partnership: Work with Compliance, Risk, Operations and data teams to gather facts and deliver accurate, timely responses; advise stakeholders on disclosure and privacy risk.
• Process and reporting: Develop templates, playbooks and standard responses; embed AI to drive efficiency; identify trends and recommend process improvements.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About the Team

Product managers at OKX are the CEOs of their areas of focus. We develop growth-focused product strategies, manage cost/profitability and then deliver powerful strategies that guide customers through simple transaction workflows. We are building an integrated and beautiful crypto-finance experience for mobile and web. Product managers collaborate across business units and align user research, design and UX writing, brand and marketing, technical project management and engineering, testing, data, compliance and legal teams. We are a multi-cultural and decentralized team with a deep passion for bitcoin, crypto and Defi. We are objective oriented and everyone contributes to data analysis to drive business growth.

 

About the Opportunity

As the Product Manager, you will be responsible to discover new markets and revenue opportunities and innovate new products to address the market needs. Act as an internal champion to build consensus and influence senior management for new product ideas. Identify, define, implement and instrument market research, product design, product implementation and product release processes.

Define, build and scale OKX's payment systems that powers money movement globally to help our customers gain access to a wide array of crypto assets. The scope of this role includes defining managing product roadmaps, features including user experience and end to end integration with local international payment providers while proactively managing the risk associated with your product. Tracking KPIs and driving growth of your product features is at the core of PM’s at OKX, while collaborating with multiple key stakeholders like designers, engineering, legal, risk, compliance, marketing, customer support finance across the organization and get them aligned on your product roadmap and deliverables.

You’ll be joining our growing product team to help define the future of our company and product. If you are an entrepreneurial product leader, who doesn’t hesitate to propose bold ideas and roll up your sleeves to put them into action, this role will be a great fit for you.

 

What You'll Be Doing
• Be the owner of your payment products (ACH, Cards, Wire, SEPA, FAST, PIX, etc), you truly own it!
• Define drive every aspect of your product from developing the roadmap/backlogs/iterations in order to hit your goals KPIs
• Outline features, technical integration requirements, work with your squad of product designers, content writers, data analysts and engineers to bring your product to life
• You verify your squad deliverables, align your customer support teams including all key stakeholders for any feature release/announcements to your retail users
• Manage your product dashboard by tracking all your product data metrics
• Drive adoption, usage of your products working closely with marketing, risk teams, keep close eye on customer frictions and voice of customer to optimize your product experience
• Ensure that there are effective internal tools in place for any new product launch

What We Look For In You
• Product management experience in the payments space with past experience in payments clearing, settlement and fiat custody
• Visionary for trending and future crypto market needs and payments industry changes
• Product innovator that can achieve business goals with unique product offering and business models
• Previous experience designing and building payments systems and understanding of risk management associated with these payment options
• Entrepreneurial mindset: Experience working in a fast-paced environment with competing resources and priorities. Opinionated and willing to make calls with limited information. Ability to navigate through ambiguity to advocate for resources
• Excellent written and verbal communications skills; ability to translate strategy into clear and actionable plans for product development, engineering, design and marketing
• Technical, comfortable with delving into the product, the platform and the implementation details. Able to engage with engineering beyond just product and user experience needs; willing to roll up sleeves and design scalable and extensible solutions
• Metrics driven with proficiency in identifying, defining, tracking and acting upon metrics Experience identifying KPIs and working with engineering and analytics on instrumentation and monitoring
• Familiarity with cryptocurrency exchanges and passion for crypto and blockchain innovations
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline

 

Nice to Haves
• Past experience working with payments systems or crypto platforms is strongly preferred

 

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

 

Disclaimer: Please note that Hong Kong is a group-level service hub, and OKX does not carry on a business of operating a virtual asset trading platform in Hong Kong.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Machine Learning & Data Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Staff Engineer, Machine Learning Data Infrastructure

We are looking for an experienced engineer to lead the architecture and hands-on development of the ML and data infrastructure behind our risk and fraud prevention systems. You will help teams move models from experimentation into reliable production services, improve model execution performance, and build scalable data foundations for training, evaluation, and real-time decisions.

 

Responsibilities

- Improve model inference latency, throughput, resource utilization, and cost. Profile the full prediction path—from feature retrieval and preprocessing to model execution—and deliver measurable improvements without unacceptable model-quality regressions.

- Build reusable infrastructure for model packaging, versioning, deployment, serving, monitoring, and rollback across cloud platforms and regions.

- Design and optimize offline data pipelines on Databricks, Apache Spark, and warehouse/lakehouse technologies, addressing data modeling, partitioning, joins, shuffles, skew, incremental processing, and cost.

- Connect offline and online feature pipelines, ensuring point-in-time correctness, consistent feature definitions, freshness, lineage, and reproducible backfills.

- Evolve reliable feature services and data integrations supporting risk models and decision systems.

- Set technical direction, mentor engineers, and lead delivery across ML, data engineering, cloud infrastructure, security, and product teams.

Required qualifications

- A record of building and operating large-scale distributed systems, ML infrastructure, or data platforms, with technical ownership across teams.

- Hands-on experience optimizing production model performance, supported by measurable improvements in latency, throughput, utilization, or cost.

- Deep understanding of Databricks and Spark, or comparable offline data platforms, including execution plans, distributed query optimization, storage layouts, data correctness, and workload cost management.

- Experience with the model lifecycle, including training/serving integration, validation, deployment, observability, and rollback.

- Strong Python, SQL, and at least one backend or systems language such as Java, Scala, Go, or C++.

- Ability to turn ambiguous requirements into clear architecture and deliver maintainable systems through hands-on engineering and technical leadership.

Helpful experience

- SageMaker, Alibaba Cloud PAI/EAS, or comparable ML platforms.

- Inference optimization using tools such as ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, or Triton.

- Delta Lake, MLflow, feature stores, Kafka, Flink, and low-latency data stores.

- Fraud detection or financial risk systems.

You'll contribute across the full audit lifecycle — from planning and execution through reporting and remediation validation — and build lasting relationships with business partners and management teams along the way.

What you bring
• Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g. Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or Computer Engineering).
• 5+ years of auditing experience, including exposure to Operations, Risk Management, Compliance, or IT/Information Security.
• Strong technical expertise and analytical skills, with the ability to communicate and partner with business, engineering, data, and product teams.
• Ability to thrive in fast-paced environments, work with ambiguity, and adapt quickly to change.
• Ability to operate independently while juggling multiple projects and initiatives in a dynamic, high-tech environment.
• Professional auditor certification (e.g. CIA issued by the Slovenian Institute of Auditors (SIA), CISA, ACCA, CPA).
• Passion for Robinhood's products and our mission to democratize access to global financial systems.
• Work experience in industries such as e-money, payment services, brokerage, or crypto financial products (e.g. payments, lending, spot, derivatives, tokenization).
• Familiarity with licensing and regulatory compliance requirements in Europe and Asia (e.g. MiCA, CASP/VASP, PSD2, MiFID II, MAS, DORA, GDPR, AMLD).
• Some exposure to direct communication with financial regulators (e.g. ATVP, Central Bank of Lithuania, CSSF, ESMA, FCA, MAS).

jobs.title: Marketing Governance & Operations Lead
jobs.description:
Marketing Governance & Operations Lead

Location: London

Reporting to: Chief of Staff to CMO and Director of Marketing Operations

Closing date: Tuesday, 1st December at 5pm

About Starling 

At Starling, we are on a mission to provide people with a fairer, smarter, and more human alternative to traditional banks. We are building a leading digital bank, driven by fast technology, fair service, and honest values. Our vision is to create a banking industry that serves everyone, which we accomplish by developing best-in-class proprietary technology, offering an exceptional customer experience, and establishing a strong, sustainable business.

Our five core values – Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim for Greatness – are at the heart of everything we do, guiding our strategy and shaping our culture. We're a branchless, largely paperless bank, committed to responsible banking, sustainability, and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

Hybrid working: All Starling colleagues spend a minimum of 10 days per month in the office with flexibility to work the rest from home.

The Opportunity

We’re hiring a Governance & Operations Lead to join our Marketing team during a pivotal new phase of growth. We are looking for an experienced leader who is responsible for establishing, overseeing, and maintaining the governance, risk, and control framework across all marketing activities. This role ensures that marketing campaigns, customer communications, brand assets, and data-driven targeting adhere to internal risk standards, regulatory mandates, and consumer duty guidelines without stifling creative velocity.

What You'll Do
• Work with 1LOD Risk to operationalise tailored Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSA) across the marketing department.
• Conduct proactive risk assessments on new marketing initiatives, product launches, brand campaigns, and go-to-market strategies prior to release.
• Partner with 1LOD Risk to own and define robust controls across Marketing.
• Act as a first-point of contact for new governance activity as it arises.
• Monitor changes in relevant laws (e.g., consumer duty, advertising standards, data privacy like GDPR/CCPA, fair treatment of customers) and embed necessary control points into marketing operations.
• Identify, log, and manage marketing incidents, operational failures, or legal/regulatory breaches; lead root-cause analysis and enforce action plans.
• Evaluate third-party advertising, media, and vendors for risk exposure, defining and implementing the necessary controls.
• Serve as the central subject matter expert (SME) advising creative, growth, and product marketing teams on compliant execution while conducting routine risk training across the marketing function.
• Partner with the Data Privacy team to act as the first buffer between our marketing and growth goals and the data regulations we need to comply with (GDPR and PECR). Act as the first point of contact for DP-related matters in the marketing team.
• Establish standardised libraries of approved claims, disclaimers, and substantiation data so creative teams are not reinventing compliant copy for every launch

What You'll Bring:
• 5+ years of experience in operational risk or compliance, specifically supporting marketing or brand, and ideally within financial services.
• Hands-on experience in facilitating Risk & Control Self-Assessments (RCSA), process mapping, key risk identification, and assessing residual risk levels in marketing environments.
• Deep understanding of advertising regulations (e.g., ASA, FCA guidelines), data protection laws (GDPR), and consumer duty

Behaviours & Competencies:
• Excellent cross-functional communicator capable of balancing regulatory rigour with commercial goals and creativity.
• Outstanding ability to break down complex, dense regulatory frameworks into pragmatic, easy-to-digest concepts that resonate with creative marketing professionals.
• Hands-on practitioner role situated within the Marketing Marketing team, actively collaborating with 1LOD Risk and 2LOD partners rather than acting solely in an advisory capacity.

Why Join Starling?
• Make an Impact: Work on projects that directly shape the future of banking and improve the financial lives of our customers. Starling is technology-led, and you'll have the freedom to accomplish your goals in innovative ways.
• Culture of Excellence: Be part of a collaborative, empowered, and forward-thinking team. We encourage experimentation, ownership, and a relentless focus on "doing the right thing.”
• Growth and Development: We are committed to your professional growth, offering opportunities to learn new technologies, take on new challenges, and own interesting things from day one.
• A Bank That Cares: We're a Living Wage employer, committed to flexible working, and dedicated to creating a fair, open, and safe working environment with compassion and inclusion at its core.
• Comprehensive

Benefits:

We offer a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package, including:
• Company-enhanced salary sacrifice pension scheme (7% employer contribution)
• Private Medical Insurance with Vitality including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and Peloton.

jobs.title: Regulatory Relations Manager
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Regulatory Relations Manager to join our North America Regulatory Compliance team in Austin. 

You’ll own the workstreams that keep Wise’s 55+ US and Canadian licenses and registrations active and in good standing, and you’ll be a primary point of contact for our state, federal and Canadian regulators. You’ll work closely with Product, Legal, Finance, Banking and Operations.

You’ll also help build the policies, processes and governance that make regulatory relations scalable as Wise grows.

If you want to own regulator relationships at the intersection of tech and financial services, we’d love to hear from you.

Your mission: 

As a Regulatory Relations Manager (Individual contributor, reporting to the North America Compliance Lead), you'll make sure Wise engages regulators in the US and Canada in a timely, accurate way and keeps all of our licenses and registrations in good standing. Your responsibilities will include:
• Manage licensing and registration workstreams ensuring required regulatory notices, requests, and reporting are delivered timely and accurately to regulators.
• Own end-to-end renewal and application processes to ensure required licenses and registrations are up-to-date and in good standing at all times.
• Coordinate regulatory reporting and notifications with Finance, Legal, Operations and other stakeholder teams.
• Support regulatory exams and audits as subject matter expert for all licensing and regulatory reporting requests and inquiries.
• Represent Wise externally as a primary point of contact for US and Canada regulators on licensing and registration matters.
• Evolve the compliance program by building and embedding efficient regulatory relations workstreams into the Compliance Management System, including the development of policies, procedures, and governance, required to maintain oversight.
• Deliver reporting and insights to senior management to support and anticipate regulators’ areas of focus and concern.

What you’ll bring:
• 5+ years in compliance, licensing or regulatory affairs at a fintech, money transmitter or other financial institution.
• Hands-on experience managing regulator relationships, including exams, requests and regulatory reporting.
• Experience working closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance and Legal teams.
• Working knowledge of US money transmission licensing (state-by-state, NMLS) and consumer compliance (such as Reg E and UDAAP), plus familiarity with Canadian MSB requirements.
• Strong written and verbal communication, including presenting to senior leadership and regulators, with practical, actionable recommendations.
• Ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements and turn them into practical processes, using data to inform decisions.
• Familiarity with project management, knowledge management and GRC tools (Confluence, Jira, gSuite, Office, Slack, etc.).
• Willingness to travel, as Wise offices are located across different countries.
• Legal authorization to work in the US.

Nice to have:
• Experience working with international teams and an understanding of global regulatory environments.
• Experience applying for or renewing state money transmitter licenses, and unclaimed property reporting experience.
• J.D., Certified Regulatory Compliance Manager (CRCM), CAMS or a similar qualification.
• Prior experience working with the CFPB, OCC, FINTRAC and/or state regulators (e.g. NYDFS, CA DFPI).
• Experience building or working within a Compliance Management System.

We’re people without borders — without judgment or prejudice. We want to work with the best people, no matter their background. If you’re passionate about learning new things and you have great experience and the right skills for the role, we’d like to hear from you.

Because we believe diverse teams build better products, we especially encourage applications from under-represented groups.

jobs.title: Privacy Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Purpose of the Role

The Privacy Operations Specialist plays a critical role in enabling the Privacy function to operate efficiently, consistently, and at scale. By triaging, managing and responding to Data Subject Rights Requests (DSRRs) across multiple jurisdictions, you ensure that requests are handled accurately, within statutory timelines, and in line with legal, regulatory, and internal requirements.

In this role, you will navigate a range of request types, balancing speed, quality, and risk. You will take ownership of requests end-to-end, applying structured thinking and sound judgement to determine the appropriate approach, while escalating where needed.

Working closely with Privacy, Legal, Customer Support, and other cross-functional teams, you will contribute to a high-performing Privacy Operations function — supporting strong governance, reducing friction, and enabling the business to meet its data protection obligations with confidence.

 

Key

Responsibilities:

DSRR Handling
• Manage and respond to Data Subject Rights Requests (DSRRs) end-to-end, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant handling in line with SLAs and regulatory requirements.
• Handle a broad range of request types, including access, erasure, rectification, restriction, and objection requests, across multiple jurisdictions and data protection frameworks.
• Monitor and triage incoming requests, ensuring they are correctly prioritised and actioned based on urgency, complexity, and risk.
• Coordinate with internal teams and systems to gather relevant data, ensuring completeness and accuracy of responses.
• Prepare clear, well-structured responses, applying established frameworks, templates, and guidance.
• Manage multiple requests simultaneously while maintaining a high standard of quality, attention to detail, and deadline adherence.
• Identify and escalate complex or high-risk requests where appropriate, applying sound judgement and awareness of risk.

Risk Management & Compliance
• Apply a good understanding of data protection requirements (e.g. GDPR and relevant local regulations), ensuring all responses meet internal policies and external obligations.
• Assess risk within requests, balancing operational efficiency with appropriate controls and escalation where needed.
• Maintain accurate records and audit trails for all requests, ensuring transparency, traceability, and compliance.
• Support responses to audits, regulatory queries, and internal reviews by providing accurate data and documentation.

Stakeholder Collaboration
• Work closely with Privacy, Legal, Customer Support, and other cross-functional teams to gather information and resolve requests efficiently.
• Act as a reliable point of contact within Privacy Operations, ensuring clear and effective communication with stakeholders throughout the request lifecycle.
• Provide guidance to internal teams in agreed areas, helping them understand DSRR requirements and processes.
• Support cross-functional initiatives relating to data protection and privacy operations, with guidance from senior team members where required.

Operational Support & Continuous Improvement
• Contribute to process improvement initiatives by identifying inefficiencies, suggesting enhancements, and supporting implementation.
• Support the maintenance of SOPs, guidance, and documentation, ensuring they are accurate, up to date, and accessible.
• Contribute to tracking and reporting of DSRR volumes, performance, and trends, supporting operational insights and decision-making.
• Support wider Privacy Operations activities as required, including elements of the annual ROPA updates, due diligence processes, or consent and preference management.
• Assist with onboarding, training, and upskilling of new team members, sharing knowledge and best practices.
• Managing requests and escalations on #privacy slack channel
• Completing sailpoint schema access approvals

jobs.title: Legal Counsel
Internal Audit Technology Lead - India
jobs.description:
A bit about the role

Wise is looking for an Internal Audit Technology Lead - India to join our growing IA team in Hyderabad. 

The role will be responsible for leading Wise’s India Internal Audit function across multiple legal entities.

Your main task will be to lead and coordinate the internal audit process for each of the entities within the region, including Wise Payments Limited. The scope includes both global and regional processes and working with colleagues within the company and externally with partnering firms.

The role presents a great opportunity to focus on the development and delivery of audit engagements in a fast paced environment, focussed on data driven audit techniques and continuous monitoring. Relevant experience working in assurance, risk or control roles and deploying technology enabled assurance is key to driving the internal audit agenda. 

We are a fast growing team, therefore you have the unique opportunity to collaborate and shape the operations, methodology and approaches of the Internal Audit function, both regionally and globally. 

 

Your mission
• Support the implementation and operation of the internal audit assurance framework, including development of continuous monitoring and automated audit routines.
• Support key projects to deliver an aligned assurance model across Wise and more specifically for the APAC region.
• Support the annual audit plan for the Wise Global legal entities including updating the audit universe and completing risk assessment and budgeting processes.
• Build and support a strong and self-sufficient internal audit team, locally and globally.
• Oversee delivery of the audit plan to ensure timely and relevant audit outcomes.
• Monitor the implementation of Internal Audit recommendations by the teams, measure the effectiveness of the improvements and report to oversight committees.
• Develop strong relationships internally and externally, including with the Board and the local regulator. Be seen as a trusted advisor to the business.
• Promote and help embed a strong control culture, driving meaningful and relevant assurance programmes at Wise.
• Strategically lead your teams through audit programmes, business partnering, change management and other domains. 

 

A bit about you

Skills:
• You have proven experience working in risk, control or assurance.
• You have worked in technology, fintech or broader financial services industries.
• You have working knowledge of the India or APAC relevant regulatory frameworks and requirements.
• You are able to work independently, you assume responsibility and you make your own judgement.
• You take ownership over complex areas and solve problems with no or very limited guidance.
• You have very strong coordination skills and you are able to hold teams accountable for meeting deadlines and delivering high quality outputs.
• You seek to use data analytics and technology in your work and decision making processes.
• You demonstrate attention to details but can summarise key messages succinctly, verbally and in writing adjusting your style and level of information based on the target audience.
• You are passionate about driving change, making improvements and helping stakeholders.
• You are not afraid of making decisions, can work autonomously and take initiative.
• You’re a strong relationship builder across all levels of the business and externally. You manage and influence stakeholders with ease.
• You have managed the delivery of the audit plan, responsible for planning, staffing, delivery and reporting of multiple audit engagements.
• You have interacted directly with the Board and Regulators, providing clear messages of matters relevant to them.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II - Wise for Banks
jobs.description:
About the team

Banks need flexibility in how they fund international payments, settle with Wise and convert currencies. Our Cash Management team builds the products that give them that control and make Wise work for more partners and their customers.

The problems are concrete. How can a bank lock in an exchange rate today and provide the funds later? How can it send payments first and settle with Wise afterward? We build the capabilities behind those choices, helping partners manage their cash around the needs of their business.

We’re a small, growing team developing new products in a domain with plenty to learn and shape. You’ll have a meaningful say in how we solve customer problems, design our systems and maintain engineering quality as we grow. The work combines product development with the challenge of building dependable services that move money across systems.

You’ll work closely with product managers, partner banks and engineers across Wise whose systems handle accounts, incoming payments and liquidity. Together, you’ll understand partner needs, agree how those systems fit together and turn complex requirements into practical products.

About the role

We’re looking for a senior engineer who enjoys understanding a customer’s problem, designing a solution and taking responsibility for how it performs in production.

This is a hands-on role with substantial ownership. You’ll have the autonomy to move work forward, alongside colleagues who contribute through shared design, reviews and pairing.

You will:
• Own solutions from problem to production. Work with product managers and engineers to understand partner needs, shape the approach, and design, build, test and operate backend services.
• Make thoughtful technical decisions. Explain tradeoffs clearly and balance delivery time, reliability and maintainability, including when the information available is incomplete.
• Build across system boundaries. Work with other teams to agree clear interfaces and understand how changes affect the wider payment journey.
• Improve the systems you operate. Strengthen testing and observability, diagnose production issues, and use what you learn to make services more dependable.
• Help the team succeed. Contribute across workstreams, share domain knowledge and help other engineers grow through reviews, pairing and mentoring.

Our backend stack includes Java, Spring Boot, Kafka and PostgreSQL. You’ll deepen your understanding of funding, settlement and currency conversion, using that knowledge to make better product and engineering decisions. As the team’s scope grows, there will be opportunities to take on broader technical ownership and influence how we build.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Senior Specialist
jobs.description:
Join Wise’s Quality Assurance team and help us build world-class, scalable operations that keep customers safe and deliver great experiences. In this role, you’ll provide independent, expert assurance over how work is done—spotting risk, identifying control gaps, and turning insights into clear, practical improvements. You’ll balance attention to detail with strong judgement, using data and tools to form well-reasoned conclusions that stand up to scrutiny.

You’ll work closely with partners across the business, sharing themes and trends, contributing to consistent decision-making, and helping raise the bar on quality—while keeping pace in a fast-moving environment aligned to our mission of Money Without Borders.

We are looking for candidates with extensive experience in AML Investigation, SAR Reporting, Fraud, Sanctions.

Key

Responsibilities:
• Trains and coaches QA specialists to achieve and maintain competence across the team, through accreditation and ongoing monitoring (through Calibration including “Check-the-Checker” testing).
• Continually perform horizon scanning to identify planned changes which impact QA practices and ensure that assessment performed by QA Specialists adapt to these.
• Reviews the most complex and high-risk cases and leads on thematic reviews using test scripts and scorecards to assess compliance with policies, guidance and risk appetite.
• Acts as a Subject Matter Expert, resolving complex queries/escalations from QA specialists and coaching them to drive correct, consistent decision making and effective Root Cause Analysis. Supports Audit/Regulatory activity when required.
• Leads calibration activity internally within QA, and with other stakeholders (e.g. Operations, Products and Line 2) to ensure consistent, correct outcomes are achieved and drive best practice. Challenges QA findings to ensure they are fair and correct, based on risk appetite and policy.
• Foster team collaboration, sharing knowledge and best practice and mentor colleagues to enhance team capabilities.
• Uses advanced analytical techniques and AI to analyse QA outcomes and data to identify trends and analyse/investigate more complex issues and root causes inform actionable insights and recommendations.
• Presents insights to stakeholders and Forums (when required), influencing continuous improvement.
• Take a proactive approach to consistently achieving individual and team targets (KPIs, SLAs), demonstrating a strong commitment to both quality and speed. Meet deadlines, optimise processing times and take full ownership and accountability to deliver results. Perform additional tasks as assigned by your lead, demonstrating adaptability and a proactive approach. This includes actively participating in meetings, training, and internal events to support broader team and company objectives.
• Embody and uphold Wise’s values in daily interactions.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst - Payment Operations
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Analyst who is passionate about our mission of Money Without Borders to join our team in Tallinn! You'll partner with our Payment Operations organisation to help drive data-driven decisions that would improve the quality of our data models, and improve the way we forecast our operational capacity.

The Payment Operations organisation is responsible for ensuring that our customers’ payments flow smoothly. The organisation focuses on resolving issues surrounding the movement of funds, to deliver a fast and convenient payment experience for our customers.

As a Senior Payment Operations Analyst, you will be driving our analytics effort to build and optimise data models that are used to identify operational actions and customer friction points in the payment processing journey. You will also work on building an operational forecasting model to predict capacity based on the future workload demand.

This is a great opportunity for an analyst that has strong product thinking, understands customer pain points and is passionate about data modelling and building data pipelines. You will also be part of a wider team of 150+ analysts that you can collaborate with on cross-team projects, have knowledge sharing sessions and bring ideas on how we can improve analytics across Wise. 

This is an IC2 role. For more information on our Analytics Career Map and levelling structure, click here.

Here's how you'll be contributing to the team:
• Collaborate with various senior stakeholders in the organisation and effectively communicate your insights into real change for our customers. Join us in working towards our mission.
• Support the organisation’s drive to make data-driven decisions through improving the quality of our data assets through building scalable and efficient data pipelines. In addition, build the organisation’s confidence in planning future capacity through developing a robust forecasting model.
• Proactively contribute to, own, create and track key metrics and results for the organisation, keeping them accountable throughout the quarter. For example, understanding the forecast accuracy, and the data health of our pipelines.
• Expose the vast amount of data available to the organisation in a meaningful and actionable way and support other teams in discovering insights from data through meaningful reports and effective visualisations.

jobs.title: Senior Finance Business Partner
jobs.description:
As a financial technology company moving billions of GBP of customer money in over 70 countries, Wise must have bulletproof financials. We need timely, accurate, and scalable financial data to be compliant with regulations and make strategic business decisions to support our hyper-growth and financial objectives.

We’re on the hunt for a highly strategic Finance Business Partner to join our FP&A team in London. You’ll be part of the team that helps pilot the rocket ship.

Your mission:
• You will be a strategic partner to senior stakeholders across the business, including People and Workplace, helping them form long-term plans, and proactively identify insights to support decision making.
• You will be driving our planning process and improving our ability to forecast headcount and operating costs, enabling the business to continue growing sustainably and lowering prices for customers
• You will build frameworks (models and reports) to analyse Wise’s cost base, identify risks and opportunities and derive actionable insights
• You’ll provide deep dives on key business and financial metrics and focus on actuals to forecast variance comparison to drive accuracy, optimal decision making and develop strategy
• You’ll use this deep knowledge to help build a narrative on our results and manage communications and reporting to various stakeholders including Department leads and our leadership team

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Play a crucial role in using data to help manage Wise’s financial growth sustainably and shape financial strategy to optimise growth investment and cost management
• Partner with Department leads to help them understand their performance, cost base and assist them with decision making
• Own your own path to success. You’ll have a high level of autonomy and responsibility.
• Learn and grow, there’s a lot to be done!

jobs.title: APAC Marketing Director
jobs.description:
Our Regional Marketing team ensures we deliver on our mission to make international money transfers instant, affordable, and transparent for everyone, everywhere.

The Regional Marketing team plays a pivotal role in driving Wise’s mission across international markets, ensuring millions of people and businesses save money on cross-border payments. By crafting tailored, data-driven, and locally relevant strategies, this team ensures Wise’s messaging resonates with diverse audiences — adapting to unique market dynamics, cultural insights, and competitive landscapes. Beyond driving user acquisition and growth, the regional marketing leads execute impactful, market-specific campaigns while working in close collaboration with central teams across media, creative, PR, and Product. Together, they ensure Wise’s global presence remains powerful, agile, and authentically connected to local audiences, fueling sustainable growth and reinforcing Wise’s position as a leader in international finance.

We’re looking for a Director of Regional Marketing (APAC) to join us and do things differently.

You’ll act as the bridge between central teams and regional needs, ensuring strategies are locally relevant, impactful, and aligned with Wise’s broader mission. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II - Account Integrity
jobs.description:
About

the role:

Join us as a Senior Software Engineer in our critical Account Integrity team. This is a high-impact engineering role with a strong product focus, dedicated to solving complex, real-world adversarial problems to directly protect our global customer base.

How we work:

The Account Integrity Team

The Account Integrity team is on the front lines, dedicated to safeguarding our platform against sophisticated financial crime. We leverage cutting-edge machine learning, real-time transaction monitoring, and advanced data analysis to create robust controls and detection capabilities. Our vision is to build a globally scalable fraud prevention engine that protects customer accounts, prevents scams, and consistently surpasses regulatory expectations.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager - Finance Risk and Controls
jobs.description:
At Wise, our mission is Money Without Borders: instant, convenient, transparent and eventually free. As we continue to grow and scale, we're looking for a Finance Risk & Controls - Assistant Manager to join our Finance team in Hyderabad. You will help to build and strengthen our internal control environment and support SOX compliance activities as per US SOX requirements. 

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys understanding processes, identifying risks and helping teams implement practical controls that enable business growth while maintaining compliance.

You will work closely with the Finance Risk & Controls Senior Manager and gain exposure to key finance transformation initiatives, SOX programmes, and partner with cross functional stakeholders across the business, Finance, Product, Procurement, Operations and Technology teams.

 

Your Mission
• Perform control testing activities: Perform SOX and internal control testing. Assist to gather evidence from control owners and validate completeness and accuracy. Run the SOX testing programme which helps to track, record testing results, performs control testing, identify gaps, and records these issues for resolution (remediation) activities.
• Perform SOX readiness and remediation activities: To prepare, record, and maintain list of issues, track control deficiencies and remediations in progress/ completed. Follow up with process owners on agreed actions and target dates. To assist in validating remediation evidence and closure documentation. Assist in the remediation of Significant Deficiencies (SD’s) / Material Weaknesses (MW’s) and support in first-time implementation of controls.
• Support end to end process and control documentation: Support in preparing process maps and Risk & Control Matrices (RCMs). Work closely with process owners to ensure documentation remains accurate and up to date. Support process walkthroughs and documentation updates for new and changing processes in line with SOX standards.
• Support the implementation of new and improved processes and control design across Finance: Assist in identifying process risks, evaluating control design, embedding controls across end to end processes. Identify process control improvements (enhancements) across Finance, Procurement, Revenue, Treasury and Record-to-Report processes
• Support the Finance Risk and Controls Self Assessment: - Coordinate periodic risk and control self-assessments (RCSA). To consolidate results and prepare summaries for internal manager’s review. Periodic and timely Monitor action plans and ensure timely follow-up.
• Data analysis and reporting Prepare risk and control metrics, dashboards and status reports. Support reporting on testing outcomes, control deficiencies and track issue remediation progress. To Identify trends and emerging risks for discussion with the wider teams.
• Partner with stakeholders/ process owners across the business: Build strong working relationships with Finance, Risk, Internal Audit and non-Finance teams. To provide guidance on control requirements and documentation standards. Support projects impacting financial processes and internal controls.

 

What you'll get from the role
• Meaningful impact: You will establish and strengthen Wise's control environment while supporting SOX readiness and finance transformation initiatives.
• Learning and development: You will gain exposure to a broad range of Finance processes, gain in-depth knowledge of Wise's business and collaborate with teams across the business.
• Global exposure: You will work with stakeholders / business process owners across multiple geographies, including Finance, Risk, Audit and Technology teams.
• Career progression (Room to grow): You will develop expertise in SOX, internal controls, risk management and stakeholder engagement across the business, in a fast-growing, global FinTech thereby creating a strong foundation for progression into manager-level roles.

jobs.description:
YouTrip is the leading and fastest-growing multi-currency payment platform in Asia Pacific. In 2018, we pioneered the region's first multi-currency digital wallet. Now, YouTrip is the #1 multi-currency digital wallet trusted by millions across the region, processing over US$15 billion in total payment value annually. 

Our consumer and business propositions – YouTrip and YouBiz – empower individuals and businesses with inclusive, accessible, and affordable financial solutions. YouTrip has raised over US$110 million to date, including its recent Series B round led by global venture capital firm Lightspeed Venture Partners—underscoring strong investor confidence in its mission to transform digital financial services across the Asia Pacific. 

Recognised as World Economic Forum’s Global Innovator 2025, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies (2025, 2024), and LinkedIn’s Top Startup (2025, 2024, 2023), YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses.

Valuing an entrepreneurial culture of diversity and inclusion, we are seeking driven individuals to join our fast-growing regional team as we push the boundaries of innovative fintech solutions. 

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Staff Software Engineer with an exceptional command of backend tech to join our dynamic team. As a Staff Software Engineer, you play a crucial role in the design, development, testing, and maintenance of software systems. This position requires a high level of technical expertise, leadership, and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, and maintain high-quality software solutions in accordance with project requirements and coding standards.
• Take ownership of complex technical challenges and drive them to resolution, leveraging advanced technical skills and problem-solving abilities.
• Mentor and guide junior engineers, providing technical leadership, code reviews, and constructive feedback to support their growth and development.
• Take ownership of several software components, ensuring their robustness, availability, and scalability.
• Participate in architectural discussions and contribute to the design and implementation of scalable and reliable software systems.
• Plan and execute projects, ensuring efficient and on-time delivery of software products.
• Lead by example in adhering to best practices for software development, including version control, testing, documentation, and deployment processes.
• Troubleshoot and debug complex issues in production environments, working collaboratively with operations and support teams to ensure timely resolution.
• Contribute to the recruitment and hiring process by participating in interviews, evaluation candidates, and providing input on hiring decisions.
• Star current with industry trends, advancements, and best practices in software engineering, sharing knowledge and insights with the broader team.
• Actively participate in code reviews, design discussions, and sprint planning meetings to contribute to the overall success of the team and projects.
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, or a related field.
• 8+ years of experience in software development, with substantial experience in backend and cloud infrastructure.
• Expert-level proficiency in designing and developing high-performance, concurrent applications with Golang.
• Knowledge on other languages like Golang, Java, Python will be an added advantage.
• Having prior experience in FinTech domains would be an added advantage.
• Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles.
• Experience with distributed systems, microservices architecture, and cloud native computing..
• Solid knowledge of software testing methodologies and tools, including unit testing and integration testing for backend applications.
• Demonstrated ability to lead projects, collaborate effectively with teams, and mentor junior engineers.
• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to tackle complex technical challenges.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Golang

Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

 

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

 

Your mission

Build out Bitpanda's All-in-one digital asset infrastructure empowering banks, fintechs, and online platforms to seamlessly offer regulated trading and custody services for millions of people globally. You'll shape the future of our entire platform by building powerful systems from the ground up, optimize performance at scale, and drive engineering excellence throughout the stack.

What you’ll do:
• Architect and build high-performance, distributed systems in Go — think scalable, resilient, and message-driven from day one.
• Craft elegant, clean, and tested code, backed by robust test suites and thoughtful design — not just “working” code, but code you’re proud of.
• Collaborate with sharp minds across engineering to explore ideas, vet solutions, and push boundaries — from whiteboard to production.
• Level up our infrastructure, creating secure, scalable environments where speed doesn’t compromise safety.
• Shape our microservices architecture, making it more modular, reliable, and future-proof — your input won’t just be heard, it’ll be built.

Who you are:
• Pro-level Go skills — you’ve written production-grade Golang and know how to structure, test, and scale real-world systems with it.
• Database versatility — you're comfortable designing and querying both SQL and NoSQL databases, and you know when to use which.
• API mastery — solid experience designing and working with REST, GraphQL, and gRPC, and an opinion on when each one shines.
• Streaming-native thinking — hands-on with Kafka or similar message brokers, and you understand the value of event-driven architecture.
• Cloud-native experience — you're familiar with AWS services like EKS, DynamoDB, and Secrets Manager, and know how to stitch them together into secure, scalable solutions.

What’s in it for you
• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
• Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
• Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
• Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
• Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
• Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
• Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
• Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
• Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
• Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
• Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

 .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

 

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. jobs.title: Director, Incident & Availability Engineering
jobs.description:
About the role

Availability and resilience are core to keeping Chime reliable for millions of members who count on us for their everyday financial lives. The Incident Availability Engineering organization is responsible for the systems, tooling, and culture that keep Chime up, resilient to outages, and fast to recover when incidents occur. We're looking for a Director to lead this org and define what comes next: an intelligent, automated platform where AI and ML aid in real-time incident triage, root cause analysis, and automated mitigation. If you have experience building scalable availability, reliability, and incident response systems and want to lead this critical pillar of Chime's technical infrastructure, we'd love to talk.

In this role, you can expect to
• Lead the Incident Operations and Availability Engineering teams, inclusive of tech lead managers (TLMs) and senior engineers across Incident Management, Availability Tooling, Resilience Engineering, and Observability. You'll report to the VP of Platform Engineering.
• Set the multi-year vision and roadmap. Unify incident management, alerting, chaos engineering, and availability tracking into an intuitive, seamless reliability platform.
• Drive a culture of ownership and accountability, both inside the larger Platform Engineering team as well across all Product Engineering functions.
• Partner closely with Product Engineering, Security, Core Infrastructure, and Data teams. Co-own reliability SLAs/SLOs, drive cross-functional alignment on availability goals, and cultivate a blameless engineering culture.
• Empower engineering teams to ship reliably. Build tools and practices that make service health, error budgets, and incident readiness transparent and low-friction for product and infrastructure teams.
• Hire, coach and grow strong tech lead managers who stay hands-on technically while leading their teams. Build an inclusive, high-ownership team people want to join and stay on.
• Ensure operational readiness, disaster recovery, and compliance. Partner with Risk and Security leaders to conduct game days, disaster scenarios, and maintain audit-ready incident governance.

To thrive in this role, you have
• 10+ years in software or infrastructure engineering, including 5+ years leading teams and at least 2 years leading tech lead managers or engineering managers in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Infrastructure, or Availability domains.
• A track record of building SRE, incident response, observability, or availability platforms operating at high scale.
• Experience leveraging ML or LLM-based tooling for anomaly detection, root cause analysis, or automated remediation, along with a firm understanding of governance and safe execution in production environments.
• Deep expertise in incident response lifecycle, disaster recovery, chaos engineering, and driving SLO/SLA frameworks across large engineering organizations.
• Strong distributed systems, high availability architecture, and telemetry/observability background (tracing, metrics, logs, event processing).
• Clear executive communication skills during high-stakes incidents and a proven ability to lead cross-functional post-mortems and reliability initiatives.
• Bonus: experience in fintech, high-availability financial services, or managing mission-critical 24/7/365 infrastructure.

About the Role

Chime is the largest and fastest-growing U.S. player in the challenger-banking space. Through our banking partners, we offer access to bank accounts with fee-free overdraft, provide members the chance to receive early access to their paychecks, help them improve their credit, and more! We're hiring a Sr. CRM Operations Manager to help transform how Chime's Lifecycle Marketing CRM team operates and scales. You'll lead our most important cross-functional CRM initiatives, connecting Lifecycle Marketing, MarTech, Engineering, and other partners to turn complex business needs into scalable systems and processes. This isn't a daily campaign execution or engineering role—your impact will come from bringing teams together, solving complex operational challenges, and building systems that help us move faster.

In this role, you can expect to
• Lead high-impact CRM initiatives: Own complex, cross-functional programs such as platform migrations, channel integrations, and automation transformations—from early discovery through implementation and adoption.
• Connect Marketing with Product and Engineering: Translate lifecycle marketing goals into clear business requirements, data specifications, and technical priorities, helping teams align on what needs to be built and why.

• Strengthen channel health and compliance: Partner with Legal, Compliance, Data, and channel owners to improve deliverability, consent management, frequency capping, and messaging quality.
• Drive the evolution of lifecycle automation: Help move our CRM ecosystem beyond manual, campaign-focused workflows toward automated, scalable, and intelligent member journeys.
• Influence teams and priorities: Work closely with senior stakeholders to resolve dependencies, navigate competing priorities, and drive decisions without relying on direct reporting authority.
• Deliver measurable operational impact: Establish success metrics and connect improvements in workflows, systems, and governance to efficiency, execution quality, risk reduction, and downstream business outcomes.

To thrive in this role, you have
• 8+ years of experience in CRM operations, marketing program management, or marketing technology alignment, with a track record of working in complex marketing environments.

jobs.title: Staff Data Scientist, Product Marketing
jobs.description:
About the role

Chime is looking for a Staff Data Scientist to establish the analytical direction for Product Marketing (PMM). As PMM’s dedicated analytics partner, you will help leaders forecast card demand, understand how members discover and activate Chime products, and connect member research with behavioral evidence to guide strategy and investment.

Your work will span three priorities. You will evolve card demand planning into a rigorous, repeatable forecasting process. You will build on existing research and analytical prototypes to establish reliable measurement of product activation and the member lifecycle, from account opening and first direct deposit through adoption, engagement, and retention. You will also partner with Research to translate qualitative findings into testable hypotheses and assess how broadly those findings apply across the member population.

As a Staff individual contributor, you will define ambiguous problems, set analytical standards, and deliver practical solutions. You will establish a prioritized roadmap with PMM leadership and partner with Product, Growth Analytics, Research, Card Operations, Finance, Data Engineering, and Enterprise Data Metrics to turn analytical work into trusted data products and business decisions.

In this role, you can expect to

Build reliable card demand forecasting
• Own the methodology for card demand forecasting, translating business planning needs into appropriate forecast horizons, granularity, refresh schedules, and performance measures.
• Develop and evaluate time-series and driver-based models incorporating member growth, product launches, marketing activity, seasonality, replacement demand, and other relevant inputs.
• Establish historical backtesting, benchmark comparisons, forecast bias and error monitoring, and uncertainty estimates. Investigate misses and continuously improve performance.
• Partner with PMM, Card Operations, and Finance to translate forecasts into planning scenarios and assess implications for inventory, supplier lead times, cost, and service risk.
• Build reproducible forecasting workflows with documented assumptions, stakeholder inputs, monitoring, and clear ownership.

Establish product activation and member lifecycle measurement
• Define measurement frameworks for product discovery, activation, adoption, and sustained engagement across the member lifecycle, accounting for cohort, tenure, eligibility, and member segment.
• Build on existing activation research and analytical prototypes to establish production-ready measurement, including cohort analyses anchored to milestones such as first qualifying direct deposit.
• Evaluate proposed operating metrics, including Activated Member Rate, assessing product selection, thresholds, observation windows, sensitivity, and relationships with downstream engagement and retention.
• Balance timely operational signals with cohort maturity and analytical validity. Distinguish predictive relationships from causal evidence and identify where further validation is needed.
• Identify friction and drop-off across onboarding and cross-product journeys, size opportunities, and recommend actions to improve activation and sustained use.
• Partner with Enterprise Data Metrics and source-data owners to develop tested dbt models, historical backfills, governed metric definitions, and reliable Hex reporting.
• Establish metric governance, versioning, and historical comparability as products, eligibility rules, and definitions evolve.
• Create recurring monitoring and business-review mechanisms that help PMM understand performance and distinguish changes in member behavior from the incremental impact of its initiatives.

Connect member research with quantitative evidence
• Partner with User Research and PMM to translate qualitative findings about member needs, motivations, and barriers into testable hypotheses.
• Use behavioral data, segmentation, funnel analysis, and statistical methods to assess the prevalence of research findings and how they differ across member groups.
• Combine qualitative and quantitative evidence to guide positioning, messaging, onboarding, and product adoption strategies.
• Design, power, and interpret experiments to evaluate these strategies, coordinating analytical ownership with Product and Growth Analytics.
• Apply appropriate causal inference methods when randomization is not feasible, clearly communicating assumptions, uncertainty, and limitations.
• Identify where behavioral evidence and research findings diverge, and recommend follow-up analysis or research to resolve the gaps.

Lead analytical strategy and influence decisions
• Establish PMM’s analytics roadmap, balancing urgent forecasting needs with foundational measurement and longer-term strategic questions.
• Set standards for forecasting, experimentation, metric validation, and interpretation within your scope.
• Influence VP-level and executive decisions through clear recommendations, scenario analysis, and compelling written and verbal communication.
• Resolve conflicting assumptions, definitions, and priorities across PMM, Product, Growth, Finance, and other partners.
• Use AI tools to accelerate analysis, coding, and research synthesis while validating outputs and maintaining reproducibility.
• Raise the analytical bar through methodological guidance, peer review, and reusable tools and approaches.

To thrive in this role, you have
• A bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Operations Research, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
• Extensive experience in analytics or data science, with a track record of independently setting analytical direction, solving ambiguous problems, and influencing decisions across multiple teams.
• Hands-on experience building and operating demand forecasts used in business planning. You can explain how you selected methods, evaluated performance, quantified uncertainty, investigated errors, and incorporated stakeholder inputs.
• Strong knowledge of time-series analysis, regression, statistical modeling, and forecasting evaluation, with sound judgment about when a simple approach is sufficient.
• Experience measuring consumer product activation, adoption, engagement, and retention through cohort analysis, lifecycle measurement, and funnel analysis.
• Strong experimentation and causal inference skills, including the ability to distinguish observational patterns, predictive signals, and evidence of incremental impact.
• Expert SQL and advanced Python or R skills, with experience working with large datasets in cloud warehouses such as Snowflake.
• Experience translating analytical prototypes into recurring workflows, reliable data models, and decision tools in partnership with data teams.
• A track record of influencing senior leaders, establishing priorities, and building productive relationships across business and technical teams.
• Clear communication with nontechnical audiences, including the ability to explain uncertainty and turn findings into actionable recommendations.
• Comfort serving as a dedicated analytical partner while collaborating across a centralized Data Science and Analytics organization.

Nice-to-have
• Card demand, inventory, supply chain, or other operational demand forecasting.
• Product Marketing, lifecycle marketing, or consumer financial services analytics.
• Collaboration with User Research to connect qualitative findings with quantitative evidence.
• dbt, semantic layers, Hex, and governed self-service analytics.
• Fintech or consumer products with multiple interconnected offerings.

• Build and scale AI agents that absorb more of their operating system, freeing your hours for higher-leverage work.
• Run the few things they own that have no organizational home, from framing to clean handoff, without adding process.

• Drive resilience and disaster recovery for online datastores: zonal failover, backups and replication, restore tooling, and regular recovery validation.
