jobs.title: Senior Manager, Growth
jobs.description:
Responsibilities 
User Acquisition Operations
• Own the weekly operating rhythm for CDC paid UA — spend plans, pacing, optimization decisions, and performance reporting across all channels (Meta, Google, Apple Search, programmatic DSPs, affiliates, regional platforms, and emerging networks), across every market we operate in
• Manage the relationship with our performance agency on a daily basis — standups, creative briefings, channel strategy, spend allocation, and trading decisions
• Drive channel-level optimization using CAC, CPFT, pLTV ROAS, and lower-funnel conversion metrics. You’re expected to know what’s working, what’s not, and why before anyone asks
• Lead GTM execution for new product launches and market openings (spot, perpetual contracts, card rips, new offer structures) — from tracking readiness through creative production through spend activation
• Build and maintain the weekly trading deck and leadership updates. Present performance narratives to VP and C-level stakeholders with clarity and confidence
• Own the competitive monitoring cadence — Sensor Tower, app store rankings, ad intelligence — across key markets, and translate competitive signals into channel and creative decisions
• Own market prioritisation — which countries we open, in what order, and what each market needs in localisation, payment rails, and channel mix before we commit spend

 

Sub-function: Creative Strategy 

Our creative pipeline is currently managed between agency and leadership. This role takes ownership of the full creative lifecycle for performance marketing.
• Own the creative learning agenda — what hooks, formats, and concepts we’re testing, what’s winning, and what to kill. Maintain a structured view of creative performance by channel, format, and audience
• Lead creative briefing for the agency and UGC creators. Translate product updates, offers, and cultural moments into production-ready briefs with clear deliverables and timelines, localised for each market we run in
• Drive format expansion beyond static display — UGC video, social-native content, meme-format creative, and AI-assisted production pipelines
• Establish a rapid refresh cadence to combat creative fatigue across channels, and ensure channel-specific sizing and placement specs are met
• Coordinate with brand and content teams on production shoots, scripting, and asset capture for UA use

 

Sub-function: Martech

Our martech stack spans AppsFlyer, Segment, Firebase, Google Tag Manager, Meta CAPI, Impact (affiliates), and multiple ad platform integrations. Today this is led by our VP with execution support from a solo martech lead. This role becomes the strategic owner.
• Serve as the growth team’s primary point of contact for all tracking, attribution, and signal infrastructure. You’re the person who knows whether events are firing, payloads are complete, and platform signals are flowing
• Partner with our martech lead to prioritize and unblock implementation work — new product event instrumentation, platform pixel/CAPI builds, conversion upload pipelines, and deep link configuration
• Own the relationship with platform measurement teams (Google gTech, Meta measurement partners, AppsFlyer TAMs) across regions and ensure their recommendations translate into shipped work
• Drive martech readiness for every product launch and offer change. If tracking isn’t ready, you’re the one who flags it and owns the escalation
• Understand the full signal chain from user action to ad platform optimization loop — SDK events, server-to-server integrations, CAPI payloads, consent parameters, and AEM eligibility requirements
• Handle the multi-market layer — regional MMP configuration, multi-currency revenue handling, and market-specific consent and privacy regimes

 

Sub-function: Measurement

Measurement maturity is the constraint on scaling. This role owns the roadmap for closing attribution gaps and building toward incrementality-based decision-making.
• Own the attribution framework — last-click, MECE logic, promo code overlap rules — and ensure it’s consistently applied across reporting, agency data, and leadership updates
• Define and maintain measurement plans for each product line (spot, perps, rips) including KPI definitions, LTV attribution windows, and what “success” looks like at each funnel stage
• Lead the build-out of conversion feedback loops for each platform — Google Ads click ID upload pipelines, Meta CAPI integration, and Apple SKAN/AdAttributionKit readiness
• Partner with data science on pLTV model validation, cohort economics tracking, and the eventual transition from CPA to ROAS-based bidding
• Scope and prioritize incrementality testing (geo holdouts, per-channel lift measurement) and marketing mix modeling as the program matures
• Maintain reporting credibility — when agency data and Tableau data don’t match, you’re the person who investigates, explains, and fixes it
• Normalise reporting across currencies and markets so performance is comparable country to country, and so a CAC in one region means the same thing as a CAC in another

Requirements:
• 5+ years in performance marketing or growth, with direct ownership of paid UA budgets across Meta, Google, Apple Search, and at least one programmatic partner
• Hands-on experience with mobile measurement partners (AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Branch), server-to-server integrations, and ad platform conversion APIs (Meta CAPI, Google Ads S2S)
• Experience marketing trading or investing products — you understand funding rates, spreads, deposit and withdrawal flows, and why an active trader’s value profile looks different from a casual user’s
• Track record running paid UA across multiple international markets — localisation, regional channel mix, a multi-time-zone operating rhythm, and market-by-market regulatory nuance
• Strong working knowledge of attribution models, SKAN/AdAttributionKit, AEM eligibility, and the privacy-era signal landscape
• Experience managing or closely partnering with a performance creative function — you’ve briefed UGC creators, reviewed ad concepts, and made data-backed creative decisions
• Comfort with ambiguity and competing priorities. You’ll be launching multiple products, fixing attribution gaps, and building new measurement infrastructure simultaneously
• Exceptional communication skills — you can explain a CAPI payload issue to an engineer and a CAC trend to a CMO in the same day
• Experience in crypto, trading, fintech, or financial services is strongly preferred — you’ve marketed a product where the user is putting capital at risk. What matters most is that you’ve scaled paid UA in a high-velocity, multi-product environment

Why This Role:
• You’re joining at an inflection point — new products launching, measurement stack being built, creative pipeline evolving. The person in this seat will shape how all of it comes together
• You’ll have real ownership across UA, creative, martech, and measurement. This is not a channel manager role — it’s a multi-discipline growth operator role with a clear path to director
• You’ll work with a small, senior team that moves fast and makes real decisions. No layers of approval — the VP is your skip and the CMO is one level above that
• Part of Crypto.com — a global platform with the resources and ambition to build a category-defining product, and the speed and autonomy of a startup growth team
• Global remit — the markets you open and the playbooks you build will define how we scale internationally, not just in one country

At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Serving nearly 4 million Canadians from coast to coast, we offer a wide variety of financial services from banking and lending, to trust and credit union solutions. 

We've been at this since 1970, challenging the conventions of traditional banking with smarter, faster, and more connected financial experiences.

Purpose of Job 
As part of a growing and dynamic Commercial Portfolio Management team, the Bilingual Senior Commercial Account Manager is responsible for the day-to-day management of an assigned group of lending partners and associated portfolio of mortgages, from funding through maturity. The Bilingual Senior Account Manager’s portfolio will be comprised of complex construction, renovation, and portfolio mortgages secured by all asset classes and ranging in size from $5.0 million to $50.0 million. Participation in syndicated transactions of $150.0 million or more can also be expected. Work product must adhere to established policies and underwriting standards and meet compliance and control requirements.

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Third Party Risk Management, you will conduct third party risk assessments, help build out related risk reporting, and carry out second line oversight activities to help reduce the impact of third-party risks.

This position focuses on enterprise-wide TPRM, rather than in-depth expertise in a specific domain like security or privacy. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II - Risk Control & Governance
jobs.description:
Job Description

We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Engineer to join the Risk & Control Governance team / Risk Assessment Group. You'll be instrumental in building the governance, assurance, and data foundations that ensure every risk decision at Wise is consistent, explainable, auditable, and continuously monitored.

This role works at the intersection of the Risk API platform, Product, and Financial Crime (FinCrime) teams — offering a unique opportunity to build the systems that give Wise confidence in every risk assessment it operates at scale.

You will be the driving force behind the platform's trustworthiness and integrity, focusing on:
• Data Governance: Building and maintaining data ownership, lineage, and quality monitoring systems that ensure every risk decision is powered by trusted data.
• Control Assurance: Designing continuous monitoring and validation systems that verify controls perform as intended — including trigger validation, drift detection, coverage analysis, and control health scoring.
• Auditability & Explainability: Implementing end-to-end audit trails, change history tracking, and explainability tooling that enables one-click regulatory evidence generation.
• Scalable Solutions: Designing robust, high-throughput solutions that handle large volumes of data and can be quickly understood and scaled across multiple distinct risk domains.

 

What will you be working on?

You will join the team at a pivotal moment, with your contributions being immediately visible and critical to the success of the entire Risk Assessment platform's governance layer.

The core challenge for the team — and your immediate focus — is to build the assurance and governance foundations that the platform currently lacks, ensuring every control can answer: Was the right trigger used? Was the right data available? Was the right decision made? Is the control still effective?

 

Your immediate impact will be to:
• Build Data Trust: Implement data quality monitoring, data contracts, and lineage tracking that give the organisation full traceability from risk decisions back to source data.
• Deliver Continuous Assurance: Design and build automated monitoring systems that continuously validate control effectiveness — detecting drift, false positives/negatives, and coverage gaps before they become incidents.
• Enable Auditability: Create audit trail infrastructure and explainability tooling that dramatically reduces the effort required for regulatory reporting and compliance evidence generation.
• Integrate with Risk API: Work closely with the Risk API team to embed governance and assurance capabilities into the core platform, ensuring clean integration points and shared data contracts.

Qualifications

What do you need?
• Strong Backend Engineering: Proven experience building high-throughput, data-intensive systems in any language. Hands-on expertise with Kafka, SQL and NoSQL databases, and designing for scale and reliability.
• Data Engineering Aptitude: Experience with data quality frameworks, pipeline orchestration, or lineage tracking. You understand what it takes to make data trustworthy at scale.
• Systems Thinking: Ability to reason about complex distributed systems, identify failure modes, and design solutions that are both robust and operationally simple.
• Ownership & Autonomy: Comfortable operating with ambiguity, defining your own work from high-level objectives, and driving delivery end-to-end without close direction.
• Collaborative Mindset: Ability to work effectively across team boundaries — particularly with the Risk API team, Product, and FinCrime stakeholders — to align on contracts, data models, and integration patterns.

Additional information

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

jobs.title: SAR Quality assurance specialist
jobs.description:
As a Quality Assurance Specialist with a focus on SAR Reporting at Wise, you are responsible for providing expert, objective assurance on the quality and effectiveness of our operational processes and controls. Your core function is to ensure risks are identified, assessed and mitigated in line with policy requirements, and to identify weaknesses, assess risk materiality and report outcomes. You will apply your risk expertise and critical thinking to conduct holistic and detailed reviews in line with agreed methodologies and KPIs, and make recommendations to drive continuous improvement. This role plays an integral part in helping Wise achieve its mission of Money WIthout Borders, through effective and value-add assurance.

This is a role for specialist who has had experience with external suspicious activity reporting, regulatory compliance and FIUs.

Activities performed on the job
• Conduct holistic, risk-based reviews using test scripts and scorecards to assess risk outcomes, compliance with global and regional policies, relevant guidance and risk appetite.
• Assess risk, materiality and root causes for each finding, providing clear and robust reasons aligned to policy compliance and/or risk mitigation.
• Participate in calibration exercises to share findings, best practice and ensure consistent, correct decisions are made across the team.
• Clearly communicate outcomes to stakeholders covering key risks, issues, root causes, and recommendations, maintaining robust records and audit trails.
• Analyse, assess and communicate emerging themes and trends, recommending opportunities for continuous improvement.
• When assigned, scope, plan, and execute root cause analysis or targeted investigations.
• Contributes to team collaboration and knowledge sharing to enhance team capabilities.
• Take a proactive approach to consistently achieving individual and team targets (KPIs, SLAs), demonstrating a strong commitment to both quality and speed. Meet deadlines, optimise processing times and take full ownership and accountability to deliver results.
• Perform additional tasks as assigned by your lead, demonstrating adaptability and a proactive approach. This includes actively participating in meetings, training, and internal events to support broader team and company objectives.
• Embody and uphold Wise’s values in daily interactions.

jobs.title: Senior II iOS Engineer - Send Experience
jobs.description:
About

the role:

Wise moves billions every month. Every single transfer runs through Send Experience.

We own the send flow end-to-end: the product millions of customers touch, the discovery layer that makes local payment networks like Pix and UP feel native, and the platform holding tens of millions of recipient accounts worldwide. Three teams. One of the highest-impact surfaces in fintech.

We're making international transfers feel as easy as sending a message. As an iOS product engineer, you won't just build that — you’ll decide what it looks like.

Our mission is to make sending money as easy as possible. As an iOS engineer, you’ll be working on making the app experience truly exceptional. International at heart, feeling local and frictionless.

How we work:

We’re a team split between London and Tallinn. We follow a hybrid working model, ensuring enough collaboration in-person and focus time where people find it best.

What will you be working on?:

Over 10 million customers will use what you build. That's not a vanity metric, it’s the weekly reality.

The role is UI- and product-focused. The work is deeply creative: flows that need to feel effortless whether it's a first transfer from São Paulo, or a hundredth from London. Where animation timing, information hierarchy, and interaction design are real engineering problems — not afterthoughts.

And this is not a ticket factory. You'll sit with product and design from day one of an idea, challenge what "best" looks like, and ship your answer. The strongest features we've built started with an engineer saying "what if we did it this way instead." We need more of that.

Concretely:
• Craft send experiences that feel local everywhere
• Build the future of recipient discovery: search, QR scanning, and more
• Push what our iOS app can do, with thoughtful transitions, responsive interfaces, and micro-interactions that make people smile
• Own features end-to-end, from technical design to watching real customers use your work
• Raise the bar across Wise by collaborating with 60+ mobile engineers to lift UX and code quality across the entire app

What do you need?:

We know it's rare to tick every box. If you have most of these and are hungry to learn the rest, you should apply.
• You've built app experiences people love and can show it
• Strong in Swift
• A genuine eye for craft: you notice when a transition is 100ms too slow or a layout doesn't breathe
• You think in customer problems, not tickets: you push back when something doesn't make sense and propose what should exist instead
• Familiar with architectural patterns like MVVM or VIPER (we use both, happy to explore others)
• You write testable code and care about what happens after you merge Solid understanding of REST APIs, you're comfortable at the boundary between mobile and backend
• You communicate clearly: technical ideas to non-technical people, strong opinions held loosely
• You work autonomously, but you make the people around you better too

Nice to Have:
• Experience with SwiftUI, Structured Concurrency, or CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions)
• Familiarity with internationalisation patterns for apps serving many markets
• A fintech background — but absolutely not required

Your mission is to enable, protect, and empower the business and people of Wise by ensuring Wise’s purchases support our commercial objectives, flow through frictionless processes and deliver the best value for money.

About

the Role:
• Develop and execute long-term procurement strategies that align with Wise's business objectives. This includes conducting market analysis to stay ahead of industry trends and predict shifts in supply and demand.

• Mentor and develop procurement team members, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and professional growth.
• Ensure all procurement activities comply with internal policies, legal requirements, and industry regulations while promoting integrity and transparency across all operations.
• Stay abreast of industry best practices and leverage them to improve Wise's procurement processes and strategy. Encourage creative problem-solving and new procurement solutions to maximize organizational effectiveness.

 

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Choose your path to impact. As a Lead You’ll take ownership from day one. Of course, you will have feedback from smart, curious people across Wise but you’ll experience unique levels of ownership and empowerment within your role.
• Be extremely hands on. No far away leaders in Wise, and in this role you’d be expected to take on the work yourself.
• Be part of our mission to make money without borders the new normal.

jobs.title: Engineering Operations Manager: Large-Scale Programmes, SOX & Controls
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Technical Programme Manager to lead large-scale engineering programmes and help engineering tribes improve planning, prioritisation and delivery.

You’ll turn broad priorities into clear plans, work through technical dependencies and help teams resolve risks and competing priorities. You’ll also lead technology control improvements, working with engineering and specialists in Risk, Compliance and Audit on requirements including SOX and IT General Controls.

This role suits someone who takes initiative, brings structure to ambiguous problems and follows delivery through to completion. You’ll be comfortable working closely with engineers, challenging incomplete plans and making sure decisions lead to action.

How we work

You’ll join a small Engineering Operations team, working across engineering and business functions. We bring clarity to complex work through practical planning, clear ownership and consistent follow-through.

You’ll partner with tribe leadership on planning and operational improvements, and coordinate delivery with engineering teams and control owners. Engineering teams retain responsibility for technical decisions, while control owners remain accountable for control execution and evidence.

What you’ll achieve:
• Lead complex technical programmes. Turn broad priorities into clear outcomes, scope, workstreams and milestones. Drive delivery across engineering teams, from initial planning and technical dependencies through rollout and ongoing operations.
• Partner with engineering leaders. Support tribe-level planning, prioritisation and operational reviews, helping teams make realistic commitments and follow through on them.
• Resolve risks and dependencies. Identify blockers early, clarify ownership and bring the right people together to resolve competing priorities and make decisions that keep delivery moving.
• Make progress and decisions clear. Give stakeholders a dependable view of delivery, risks and trade-offs. Challenge unsupported progress updates and escalate issues with clear impact and practical options.
• Deliver technology control improvements. Work with engineering, Risk, Compliance and Audit to translate control requirements, including SOX and IT General Controls, into practical delivery plans. Coordinate remediation, testing readiness and validated closure.
• Improve how engineering operates. Use data and automation to reduce manual reporting and coordination. Build practical frameworks, guidance and training that help teams adopt better ways of working.
• Make changes sustainable. Establish clear ownership, processes and handovers so programme outcomes and control improvements become part of everyday operations.

What you’ll bring:
• A strong track record of independently leading complex technical programmes across multiple engineering teams and business functions, with clear delivery outcomes.
• Enough technical understanding to work through system dependencies, implementation constraints and rollout decisions with engineers.
• Experience working closely with engineering leaders on planning, priorities, dependencies and operational improvements.
• Experience delivering technical programmes involving security, technology risk, regulatory requirements or control improvements. You can work with specialists to turn requirements into engineering plans and follow them through to completion. Direct SOX or ITGC experience is valuable.
• An understanding of control ownership, evidence requirements and the distinction between implementing a change and having it validated for closure.
• The ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear plans, take ownership and drive progress without relying on formal authority.
• Strong stakeholder management and the confidence to challenge unclear ownership, incomplete plans and unsupported progress claims.
• Clear communication, including the ability to facilitate difficult discussions and give leaders concise updates on progress, risks and decisions.

jobs.title: Staff ML Scientist / Engineer
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a strong technical contributor with a background in machine learning and systems engineering. Bonus point if they owned the roadmap of services/tools used by more than one internal team.

This is a highly autonomous person that identifies low-hanging fruit worth tackling to move us ever closer to the vision they create for the problem-space they own. They must be able to communicate with stakeholders and users, steer short-term deliveries without compromising milestones in the roadmap, set guidelines and standards.

They collaborate with Data Science Leads to align work that would otherwise be siloed. They review experiments and design documents to improve projects from the get-go. 

This role is a unique opportunity to scale and advance the impact of Data Science in Servicing tribe – namely Fincrime, KYC and Customer Support squads. What you build will have a direct impact on Wise’s mission and millions of our customers.

About

the Role:

Our team exists to enable hundreds of specialized risk ML models – their lifecycle, governance and interface with compliance – while removing as much of the maintenance toil from Data Scientist and product teams.

We split the work in two tracks: Labels and Models
• Labels: central platform for risk labels
• Models: libraries and services to experiment, eval, promote and track models

Historically Wise is a company of very autonomous and distributed teams, which means different implementations exist to prevent and mitigate risk vectors.

We’ve invested a lot into centralizing risk assessments and their inputs (features) and have strong adoption from FinCrime, Verification, Mitigation and Global Products teams.

We’re now expanding this investment to the next critical component in scaling Wise: more and better ML /AI while keeping auditors and regulators happy.

Here’s how you’ll be contributing:
• Software engineering: e.g. testing + CI/CD, monitoring/alerting + disaster recovery
• MLOps: Terraform and AWS infra, ML governance for hundreds of models
• Data Engineering: distributed processing at terabyte scale
• Science: drive experiments to prove value of new methodologies / algorithms applied to cross-team domains

You will drive high-priority projects from proof-of-concept to MVP, to service / tooling, estimate and measure impact.

jobs.title: Lead, Markets Control & Analytics
jobs.description:
Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

 

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

 

Your mission
As Markets Control Analytics Lead, you will drive P L transparency, pricing and hedging analytics, front-to-back operational KPIs, and robust control frameworks across traditional and digital asset classes. You'll get to turn complex trading data into actionable insights, strengthen P L transparency and build automated, scalable processes that improve trading performance and support better business decisions.

What you’ll do
• P L Performance: Own the daily P L process across all asset classes, including production, validation, reconciliation, variance analysis, attribution and trader sign-off.
• Trading Analytics TCA: Analyse pricing, hedging, inventory and FX performance, including execution quality, spreads and trading costs, to identify opportunities for P L improvement.
• Operational KPIs Dashboards: Define and monitor front-to-back KPIs across Trading, Operations, Custody and Settlement, building dashboards that drive transparency, efficiency and scalability.
• Controls Automation: Establish robust P L and KPI controls, automate reporting and collaborate with Trading, Treasury, Risk, Data and Engineering to ensure data integrity and operational excellence.
• GL Reconciliation: Own the monthly Trading P L-to-General Ledger reconciliation across products, partnering with Accounting to ensure accurate valuation, realised P L and financial reporting.

Who you are
• Education: Degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting or a related field; CFA, CPA or ACCA is a plus.
• Experience:

7+ years in front-office (e.g., Quant Trading) or middle-office (e.g., Product Control, Trading Operations) roles within banking, trading or fintech.
• Markets Knowledge: Strong understanding of trading P L, hedging and inventory risk across asset classes, including P L bases such as cash, FIFO, average cost and mark-to-market. Experience with crypto, stablecoins, precious metals or FX is a plus.
• Technical

Skills:

Proficient in Excel, SQL, Python or similar tools, with experience in analytics, dashboards and automation.
• Mindset: Hands-on, analytical and entrepreneurial, with the ownership and drive to build and scale a high-impact function.

What’s in it for you
• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
• Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
• Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
• Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
• Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
• Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
• Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
• Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
• Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
• Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
• Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

 .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

 

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Frontend (Banking)
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Engineering at Brex

Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams span Software, Data, Security, and IT, and operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration. We tackle hard technical problems, own our outcomes, and push for excellence at every level - from architecture to deployment. It’s an environment where engineering is a craft, and builders become leaders.

What you’ll do

As a Frontend Engineer on the Banking Experience team, you’ll build and scale the web and mobile features our banking customers rely on every day. We’re a customer-obsessed, full-stack team: you’ll own features from user experience through data models and metrics, working closely with Product, Design and various platform teams. You’ll use data to decide what to build, advocate for customers, and help us launch into new markets. We’re looking for engineers who care as much about the product as the code, and who want to drive direct business impact with a high quality bar.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our New York office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities:
• Work with engineers across the company to build new features and products.
• Work side-by-side with user facing teams (Sales, Support) to best understand the needs of our customers.
• Design and implement experiments to improve our customer’s experiences.
• Own problems end-to-end, thinking through everything from user experience, data models, scalability, operability and ongoing metrics.
• Tune and polish features to a high-degree of excellence
• Data driven outcomes

Requirements:
• 4+ years of professional experience architecting, developing, and testing client-side code end to end
• Experience developing software for the Web platform, including cross-browser compatibility
• Experience with modern tools like ES6+, React, GraphQL, Webpack, Vite, React Native (not a hard requirement)
• Uphold our high engineering standards
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Compensation:

The expected salary range for this role is $152,000 - $190,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.title: Director, Data Engineering
jobs.description:
About the role

Data Engineering sits at the heart of Chime: nearly every product, analytics and AI initiative runs through the data our teams build. As a Director of Engineering, you'll lead Data Foundations and Insights, managing engineering managers and staff engineers who build the foundations the rest of Chime depends on. You'll partner closely with product, analytics, ML and business leaders to make sure our data reflects the true end state of the business for analysts and AI tools alike. And you'll play a core role in Chime's AI transformation, making sure the foundations are built right from day one.

In this role, you can expect to
• Lead and grow an organization of engineering managers and staff engineers, setting a high bar for quality, reliability and ownership.
• Build strong partnerships with product, analytics, ML, risk and business leaders, and keep them confident in what your org delivers.
• Set the multi-year technical vision and roadmap for Chime's data foundations, and tie each investment to business and member outcomes.
• Make sure our data reflects the true end state of the business, so analysts and AI tools can trust it and act on it.
• Shape the data architecture that underpins Chime's AI transformation, making the right foundational calls early.
• Balance competing priorities across many partner teams, making clear trade-offs and explaining them well.
• Hire, coach and develop leaders, and build a team culture of trust, candor and inclusion.

To thrive in this role, you have
• Experience leading engineering organizations through managers, including managing managers and staff-level engineers.
• A track record of building trusted partnerships with cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders, and keeping them aligned through competing priorities.
• Deep understanding of modern data architecture: ingestion, transformation, storage, governance, and serving data for analytics and ML/AI use cases.
• Experience setting technical strategy and a multi-year roadmap, and making the case for investment to executives.
• Sound judgment on architecture trade-offs at scale (batch vs. real-time, build vs. buy, cost vs. reliability), with the technical depth to earn credibility with staff engineers.
• Clear, concise written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Bonus: experience building data foundations for AI and LLM-powered tools, or working in fintech or another regulated industry.

jobs.title: People Programs Lead, People Operations
jobs.description:
About the role

We’re looking for a People Programs Lead to own and evolve key workforce programs, including Immigration, Employer of Record (EOR), and Contingent Workforce. As part of People Operations, you’ll build scalable processes that support business needs, manage operational risk, and deliver a thoughtful experience for employees, partners, and managers.

This role combines program leadership with hands-on execution. You’ll serve as the central point of accountability for your programs, partnering with Legal, Recruiting, People Partners, Payroll, Finance, Procurement, and external providers to navigate complex situations and keep work moving. As business needs evolve, you’ll take on new People programs and bring structure, clear ownership, and sustainable processes to emerging priorities.

In this role, you can expect to

Lead immigration operations
• Own the day-to-day immigration program and drive improvements across sponsorship, case initiation, renewals, employee communications, and reporting.
• Partner with immigration counsel and internal stakeholders to coordinate cases, track critical milestones, and escalate risks and decisions.
• Translate counsel’s guidance and policy changes into clear operational processes and timely communications for employees and managers.
• Manage vendor performance, program spend, and data accuracy while providing a high-touch experience during sensitive transitions.

Own Employer of Record programs
• Manage EOR operations across onboarding, employment changes, and offboarding, coordinating with providers and internal partners.
• Establish clear processes for evaluating and implementing EOR arrangements, with appropriate Legal, Finance, Payroll, and business review.
• Monitor provider service quality, costs, and issue resolution to support a consistent worker and manager experience.

Build and manage the Contingent Workforce program
• Own the operational framework for contingent workers, including intake, approvals, onboarding, extensions, and offboarding.
• Partner with Legal, Procurement, Finance, IT, and business leaders to establish clear requirements for worker engagement, documentation, access, and lifecycle management.
• Maintain visibility into the contingent workforce, including engagement dates, ownership, spend, and upcoming actions.
• Strengthen manager guidance and accountability to improve consistency and reduce operational gaps.

Improve and scale People programs
• Independently lead cross-functional initiatives from problem definition through implementation, adoption, and ongoing measurement.
• Develop playbooks, standard operating procedures, manager resources, and employee communications that make complex programs easier to navigate.
• Identify opportunities for self-service, automation, and AI-enabled workflows, partnering with People Technology to implement improvements.
• Define program metrics, surface trends and risks, and recommend improvements based on data and stakeholder feedback.
• Take ownership of additional People Operations programs as business priorities emerge, establishing scope, governance, and sustainable support models.

To thrive in this role, you have
• 5+ years experience in People Operations or People program management, with a track record of independently owning complex, cross-functional programs.
• 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience managing an employer-sponsored immigration program and partnering with external immigration counsel.
• Experience supporting EOR arrangements, contingent workforce programs, or other complex workforce operations.
• Strong program management skills, including the ability to define scope, manage dependencies, resolve issues, and deliver results through partners.
• Sound judgment when handling sensitive information, balancing competing needs, and recognizing when legal guidance or leadership decisions are needed.
• The ability to turn ambiguous requirements into practical processes, clear documentation, and effective communications.
• A continuous improvement mindset and experience using data, systems, and automation to reduce manual work and strengthen service delivery.
• Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to influence partners without direct authority.

jobs.title: Senior Training Lead
jobs.description:
About the role

Chime is building a world-class Member Services organization, and the quality of that experience starts long before a member ever reaches an agent. It starts with how well that agent was trained. We're creating this role to raise the bar on two things at once: how consistently training gets delivered across our partner network, and how accountable our BPO partners are for delivering it well. As our Sr. Training Lead, you'll own training governance for Operations and Member Experience, spend real time in the classroom at our vendor sites training new hire agents yourself, and hold our partners' training teams to a higher standard than they've been held to before.

This is a new role on our Learning, Training, and Content Operations team. It's remote, with approximately 30% domestic and international travel to our BPO partner sites.

In this role, you can expect to
• Own training execution across our lines of business, ensuring BPO trainers are facilitating our programs and content as expected, that agents are receiving the support they need during new hire training, that agents are completing training on time, and provide feedback to the Learning team about opportunities.
• Guide a group of BPO master trainer contractors to drive training excellence with BPO training teams.
• Travel to our partner sites roughly 30-40% of the time and train in the room, facilitating new hire classes, delivering Train-the-Trainer ahead of site launches and major releases, and co-facilitating alongside BPO trainers so you see delivery quality firsthand instead of reading about it.
• Own trainer effectiveness at our BPOs end to end, including trainer certification and recertification, training lead calibration, a real observation and coaching cadence, and the decision about who is cleared to teach a Chime class.
• Hold our BPO partners accountable for training delivery the way a vendor manager would: build the scorecard, run the governance cadence with partner training leadership, bring the data to business reviews, and drive corrective action plans when a site misses.
• Measure what matters, using graduation rates (overall and on-time), nesting performance, speed to proficiency, trainer certification rates, and early-tenure quality and performance to find where delivery is breaking down and fix it.
• Partner closely with Learning, Content, Quality, Workforce Management, Partner Operations, and LOB Operations so that launches land on time and agents are ready on day one.
• Diagnose the gaps in how we train today and partner to rebuild the standard, bringing a point of view on what good looks like rather than waiting for it to be defined for you.

To thrive in this role, you have
• 7+ years in training, learning, or talent development within a contact center, BPO, or other high-volume service environment, including hands-on facilitation of new hire classes for frontline agents. You are still comfortable in front of a room.
• Proven experience managing outsourced or BPO partners and holding them accountable for outcomes, including building performance metrics, governance frameworks, scorecards, and corrective action mechanisms. You've had the hard conversation with a vendor and kept the relationship.
• Experience building training governance from the ground up: certification and train-the-trainer programs, facilitation standards, observation and coaching models, and the documentation that makes them hold up over time and under audit.
• Strong coaching skills with other trainers, and the judgment to tell the difference between a content problem, a facilitation problem, and an operations problem.
• Comfort with data, with the ability to evaluate program effectiveness, identify trends across sites and vendors, and translate what you find into business requirements and decisions.
• The ability to influence without authority across internal stakeholders and external partners at every level, from a trainer on the floor to a partner's site leadership.
• Willingness to travel domestically and internationally approximately 30-40% of the time. Experience in financial services, fintech, or another regulated environment is a plus.

jobs.title: Compliance, International Investigations Associate
jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? Coinbase is building the future of finance for people, institutions and their agents, with one place to trade crypto, equities, derivatives and prediction markets, use stablecoins, and connect AI agents with clear controls. The bar is high and the pace is intense, and we like it that way. This isn’t a place for complacency. It’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits and do the best work of your career. If you’re ready to build the future of finance with a championship team who refuse to settle for “good enough,” you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for in-person working sessions

As a Senior Investigator in Coinbase’s Financial Intelligence Unit within Compliance (2LoD), you’ll help drive Coinbase’s financial crime investigations capability across multiple jurisdictions. This team leads complex reactive and proactive investigations, develops intelligence on emerging typologies and risk patterns, and translates investigative insights into high-quality SAR/STR decisions, escalations and programme improvements. You’ll work on high-impact matters across Coinbase’s global platform, partnering closely with MLROs, local compliance teams, operations teams and cross functional stakeholders to protect Coinbase and its customers from financial crime. 

What you’ll do:
• Own end-to-end investigations into complex AML/CFT matters, from alert review or referral, through case development, disposition and SAR/STR submission to relevant FIUs.
• Conduct delegated MLRO reviews of Suspicious Transaction Reports and Suspicious Activity Reports prior to filing, ensuring accuracy, quality and regulatory defensibility.
• Lead proactive investigations, using transaction data, on-chain activity, trading behaviour and cross functional intelligence and OSINT to identify emerging typologies, threat patterns and high-risk activity.
• Develop actionable intelligence from casework and analytics to inform escalations, regulatory reporting, control enhancements and improvements to detection and investigation workflows.
• Partner internally with Country MLROs, local compliance teams, operations teams and other stakeholders on high-risk matters, information sharing and investigation strategy.
• Partner with law enforcement agencies and external stakeholders on suspicious activity reporting, information requests, and intelligence sharing.
• Support investigation quality through case review, structured feedback and contributions to policies, procedures, training and programme maturity.

Required Skills and

Experience:
• 4+ years conducting and reviewing complex crypto financial crime investigations including experience across a range of products such as retail and institutional transfers, spot trading and derivatives.
• Experience preparing, reviewing and filing SARs/STRs with strong understanding of multi-jurisdiction AML/CTF regulatory obligations and reporting expectations.
• Demonstrated ability to perform data-driven investigations using SQL, blockchain analytics tools and other research techniques to extract investigative insights, identify suspicious behaviour and develop defensible conclusions.
• Strong investigative judgement and the ability to produce clear, structured long-form reports tailored to technical, compliance, leadership, and cross-functional audiences.
• Experience identifying financial crime typologies, contributing to proactive investigations and turning investigative findings into programme or control improvements.
• Utilises generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

• Partner with Conversation Design and Product to translate complex business logic into executable agent procedures within the decentralized architecture.

• Deep understanding of the LLM lifecycle including context window management, token optimization, structured output parsing (Pydantic, JSON mode), and multi-agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, Google ADK, or similar).
• Strong proficiency in Python with hands-on experience in microservices architecture, asynchronous programming, high-throughput APIs, and vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, or equivalent).

jobs.title: Associate, Resource Management
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

At Current, we're looking for an Associate, Staffing Talent Operations to support day-to-day resource management, staffing coordination, and talent operations across our multidisciplinary agency.

Reporting to the Director, Staffing Talent Operations, this person will work closely with Production, Operations, and department leads to manage resource allocations, monitor team capacity, and ensure staffing plans are accurate and up to date.

The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience with Adobe Workfront, understands resource management within an agency environment, and is comfortable managing multiple staffing priorities. We're looking for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and able to keep teams aligned on who's working on what.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
• Manage day-to-day resource allocations, staffing schedules, and project assignments in Adobe Workfront across active and upcoming projects.
• Participate in weekly departmental resourcing calls, documenting staffing decisions, allocation changes, and action items.
• Make real-time updates in Workfront during resourcing meetings and follow up to ensure all staffing changes are accurately reflected.
• Monitor team capacity, availability, and utilization across departments, including Creative, Strategy, Design, Production, and Technology.
• Partner with Production and department leads to understand project timelines, staffing needs, and upcoming resource requirements.
• Identify scheduling conflicts, resource gaps, and over- or under-allocation, escalating concerns and helping coordinate solutions.
• Track upcoming and TBD resource requests, following up with teams to ensure open staffing needs are addressed.
• Support short- and long-term resource forecasting, utilization reporting, and staffing documentation.
• Assist with freelance resource coordination, recruiting activities, candidate tracking, and maintaining talent pipelines.
• Help maintain accurate staffing data, improve resource management processes, and support Workfront best practices.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED
• 2-4 years of experience in resource management, staffing operations, or a similar role, preferably within a digital or creative agency.
• Strong hands-on experience with Adobe Workfront is required, particularly resource planning, allocations, scheduling, and capacity management.
• Experience managing staffing and resource allocations across multiple projects, departments, or disciplines.
• Understanding of resource forecasting, utilization, project timelines, and staffing requirements.
• Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities.
• Ability to capture staffing decisions accurately and make system updates in real time.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working directly with producers, project managers, and department leads.
• Proactive problem-solving skills and the ability to identify staffing conflicts and follow through on next steps.
• Proficiency in Google Sheets or Excel for tracking, reporting, and maintaining staffing data.
• Experience supporting freelance staffing, recruiting coordination, or talent pipeline management is a plus.
• Familiarity with digital production workflows, project budgets, and scope management is a plus.

WHY CURRENT

At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact.

We're a remote-first agency with teams across the US, working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates.

You'll have the opportunity to work across multiple departments, help shape how we manage staffing and talent, and play an important role in supporting our teams as the agency continues to grow.

The target hourly compensation range for this contract role is $30-$45 per hour. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location. This position is initially offered as maternity leave coverage, with the potential for conversion to a permanent role based on performance and business needs.

jobs.description:
Mercury is building a complete finance stack for startups. Since we launched Mercury in 2019, our customer base has grown to over 450,000 startups and small businesses from all around the world. With growth comes the need to ensure our customer experience is top of mind even in the most challenging scenarios.

We’re working to build something like magic for a really wide range of startup businesses. A key piece of the magic we’ve built thus far has been smart, product-driven support, and we’re looking to bring on an operational-focused, thoughtful Support Manager to help us continuously improve our Customer Support experience as we scale quickly.

You’ll join as a manager on our Customer Support team, partnering closely with our existing Customer Support Leadership team to execute the operational function of the team and support the wider strategic vision. You’ll manage your own cohort of specialists who are dedicated to managing customer interactions and operational tasks across key customer workstreams. You’ll work closely with our Voice of the Customer, Customer Trust, Operations, WFM and CX Eng teams to improve our product and general customer-facing processes to provide clear, thoughtful, and accurate support systems to help customers.

You’ll need to understand how our products and internal teams work in detail. Banking* has a lot of moving pieces, so this is harder than it might seem. Finding efficient, elegant solutions for problems stemming from the oft-convoluted U.S. financial system isn’t always easy, but if you’re good at your job, our users will never know it.

Your Role:
• Lead Develop: Hire, mentor, and manage a customer support team that excels in product knowledge, user support, and the US banking* system
• Performance Management Development: Own team performance management by setting clear goals, tracking key metrics, and driving continuous improvement across your team. Foster a culture of continuous learning and professional growth within your team, providing regular feedback and coaching
• Process Improvements, AI Automation: Refine and evolve our support processes, building workflows that drive efficiency and effectiveness across the organization including AI tools and automation to make Support faster and more effective. Take ideas from pilot to production while keeping every workflow within our compliance, privacy, and regulatory standards
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with compliance, engineering, product, and banking partners to resolve complex issues, improve our product based on Customer Support interactions, and implement changes that make for a better customer experience
• Customer Advocacy: Champion our customers by advocating for their needs with data-driven insights and compelling narratives
• Hands-On Leadership: Be ready to dive into tickets alongside your team during peak times or critical issues, be a sounding board for escalations, and help wherever the team needs as a leader on the front lines

What we’re looking for:
• 3+ years of experience leading customer support or other user-facing teams, preferably in high-growth technology companies
• A collaborative leadership style and comfort sharing ownership of a function with a peer manager
• Expertise in adding structure for support teams growing quickly
• Enjoyment in teaching and mentoring others on how to become really skilled at support
• Previous experience partnering cross-functionally with engineering, product, risk, and compliance teams
• Comfort navigating data visualization tools (Omni, Metabase, etc.)
• Experience managing complex operational projects that affect multiple teams
• Consistent empathy while helping entrepreneurs build successful businesses

• A penchant for questioning the first answer, and enjoyment in going levels deeper to find all the edge cases
• Rigor when designing new processes, and a high bar for the quality of your work
• Creativity while working within difficult constraints

The ideal candidate may also have:
• Experience managing or partnering with a BPO or outsourced support vendor, including quality programs, SLAs, and vendor performance management

jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within United States
jobs.description:
Mercury is building radically different banking and offering a complete finance stack for startups and business owners. We work hard to create the easiest and safest banking* experience possible to simplify entrepreneurs’ and business owners’ financial lives. At Mercury, compliance is a strategic function. We have a modern approach where teams move fast and compliance provides the frameworks, systems, and regulatory expertise that make that speed sustainable while protecting our customers and earning their trust.

We're hiring a Senior Manager, Compliance Governance to lead the core programs of Mercury's Compliance Management System: compliance risk assessment, enterprise policy governance, enterprise compliance training, and compliance reporting, along with oversight of compliance issues. This leader will mature these programs to meet the expectations of a regulated bank and lead them through regulatory examinations. Mercury has obtained a provisional national bank charter and is currently building towards final approval.

This role is well-suited for someone who knows what regulators expect from a CMS and can adapt established frameworks to how Mercury actually operates. The individual will lead a team of compliance professionals, be a key leader within Mercury's Compliance team, and operate in a highly collaborative environment. The role involves especially close coordination across the Compliance function, with partnership with Enterprise Risk, Legal, Internal Audit, executive leadership, and our banking* partners.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

Key Responsibilities
• Lead and develop the Compliance Governance team: set priorities, hold a high bar, and develop your team’s capabilities.
• Own the compliance risk assessment, including methodology, execution, and alignment with Mercury's enterprise risk framework.
• Own enterprise policy governance: the policy lifecycle, standards, and ownership across Mercury.
• Own enterprise compliance training: a risk-based curriculum that measures whether training works, not just whether people completed it.
• Oversee compliance issues within Mercury's enterprise issues management program, partnering with Enterprise Risk Management on identification, remediation, and validation.
• Design and deliver compliance reporting to executive leadership and governance committees, with metrics that show whether programs are working.
• Support exam and audit readiness for the CMS.
• Provide credible challenge across the business and escalate when it's warranted.
• Use technology and automation to make governance programs scalable, measurable, and less manual.
• Partner across Compliance (Advisory, Oversight Monitoring, Financial Crimes) and with Risk, Legal, and Internal Audit.

Qualifications
• 8+ years of experience in compliance or risk management at a fintech, bank, or other regulated financial institution, including 3+ years leading teams
• Hands-on experience owning core CMS components, such as compliance risk assessment, policy governance, training, compliance reporting, or issues management
• Experience leading or playing a central role in regulatory examinations, including managing requests, engaging with examiners, and responding to findings
• Broad knowledge of banking regulations, including consumer protection and BSA/AML, sufficient to provide credible challenge with subject matter experts
• Demonstrated ability to present compliance programs to, and persuade, executive leadership, Board committees, banking partners, and regulators
• Pragmatic judgment, with the ability to tell which framework requirements are non-negotiable and which can be tailored to the business
• Strong understanding of 1LOD/2LOD roles and how Compliance should govern, challenge, and partner with the business
• Proficient with AI tools, or eager to get there, to drive efficiency in compliance work
• Willingness to roll up your sleeves, with a high quality bar and a strong sense of ownership
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• CRCM or a comparable compliance certification
• Familiarity with enterprise and operational risk management frameworks
• Experience with GRC platforms and compliance automation

jobs.title: Senior Product Design Manager - Business Banking & Investments
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States
jobs.description:
Art Blakey led the Jazz Messengers from behind the drums. He brought musicians including Wayne Shorter and Lee Morgan into the band, encouraged them to write new music, and helped them develop into bandleaders themselves. His contribution was both the music he made and the talent he brought forward. Blue Note Records

We’re looking for a Product Design Manager with that combination of creative leadership and personal craft. Someone with strong design judgement, deep visual craft, and the ambition to change what businesses expect from financial software.

You’ll lead design for Mercury’s Business Banking* and Investments teams, spanning payments, accounts, and treasury. These teams help businesses move money, organize their accounts, and put idle cash to work. As the team grows, you’ll be accountable for the quality of its work, the development of its designers, and the impact of the experiences it ships.

Our ambition goes beyond making familiar banking workflows look better. We want to question how they work, identify what customers should no longer have to think about, and create something meaningfully better. That takes a leader who can recognize a promising idea, push it further, and bring a team together to make it real.

Visual design matters deeply in this role. So do interaction design, simplicity, and the judgment to make them work together. You should have a clear point of view about what excellent looks like and the hands-on ability to demonstrate it. You’ll hold a high standard through specific feedback, compelling direction, and a willingness to work alongside the team. People should feel inspired to do the best work of their careers, and supported in getting there.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

In this role, you’ll:
• Raise the quality bar of the team's work. Own the visual and interaction quality of the experiences your team ships, from the structure of a complex workflow to typography, composition, spacing, and motion. Make the standard concrete through thoughtful critique and clear direction. Review the implemented experience, not just the design file.
• Challenge the status quo. Partner with Product and Engineering to shape an ambitious direction for payments, accounts, and treasury. Question inherited assumptions, including our own. Help the team distinguish genuine constraints from familiar habits, explore alternatives, and turn the strongest ideas into simpler, more useful products.
• Take ownership from problem to outcome. Identify opportunities without waiting for a brief. Create clarity when the path is ambiguous, bring the right people together, make decisions, and work through obstacles. Your responsibility continues after handoff and launch: understand what changed for customers and the business, and act when the results fall short.
• Get hands-on where your craft makes a difference. Sketch a stronger direction, prototype an interaction, or work through a difficult flow with a designer. Be able to show what better looks like, not only describe it. Use your skills selectively to advance the work and develop the designer’s judgment without taking over their ownership.
• Turn ambition into excellent work that ships on time. Make deliberate decisions about scope, sequencing, and where to spend the team’s attention. Surface tradeoffs early and resolve them with your partners. Know which details are essential to the experience and where a simpler approach will help the team move faster without compromising what matters.
• Build a healthy team with high expectations. Develop designers’ taste, confidence, and ability to deliver. Give direct, useful feedback, set clear performance expectations, and address gaps with care and conviction. Explain why the work matters and bring people together around a shared vision. Celebrate the designers behind the work and make their contributions visible across Mercury Design.

You should:
• Have strong visual and interaction design craft. Your portfolio demonstrates thoughtful typography, composition, hierarchy, and interaction design in shipped products.
• Know how to simplify complex product experiences. You can work through complicated workflows, information architecture, and product constraints to make experiences clear and intuitive.
• Have managed designers and raised the quality of their work. You can show how your coaching, feedback, and clear expectations helped designers grow and improved what reached customers. You know how to inspire ambition while holding people accountable.
• Have set a product vision and helped a team deliver it. You can connect an ambitious direction to practical decisions about scope and sequencing, with shipped work and clear customer or business impact.
• Stay close to the design work. You’re comfortable sketching, prototyping, and working through detailed design problems alongside designers, with the judgment to know when your direct contribution will help.
• Build strong partnerships with Product and Engineering. You’ve shaped priorities together, worked through competing constraints, and used clear storytelling to build alignment around design decisions.
• Think and work like an owner. You act on what’s best for customers and the business, not just what’s in the brief. You spot problems and opportunities before they’re assigned, make decisions with incomplete information, and adapt without drama when priorities shift. You stay close to implementation and outcomes, and you care more about making Mercury better than about whose idea it was.
• Build conviction without relying on authority. You can tell a clear story about where the product should go and why. You start disagreements with curiosity, make your reasoning specific, and change your mind when a better idea emerges. You help people pursue a demanding standard because they understand and believe in it.

What success looks like

A year from now, the team’s shipped work demonstrates a visibly higher standard of visual craft, interaction quality, and simplicity. It has moved beyond incremental improvements to deliver new approaches with clear customer and business impact. Designers are ambitious, motivated, and growing in their judgment. They own their work, deliver reliably, and receive recognition across Mercury Design for what they contribute.

Please share examples of both your own design craft and work produced under your leadership. We’d like to understand the standards you set, the assumptions you challenged, the decisions you owned, and what ultimately shipped.

jobs.title: Analytics Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

About the role

At Moniepoint, as an Analytics Manager, you will use data to make better decisions, faster for the business. You will own metrics, measurement, experimentation and the analysis/data roadmap for a business area. You’ll use data to quantify business KPIs and conduct analyses to uncover unknowns, helping the business unit achieve its goals for acquisition, conversion, activation, retention, and revenue. As a leader of the business unit, the role sits at the intersection of product management, data engineering, and growth.

What you’ll do
• Strategic Leadership: Build a disciplined, exceptional analytical team. Develop and execute a comprehensive data and analytics roadmap and strategy
• Team Building Management: Hire, develop, and retain a high-performing team of analytics professionals
• Data Insights Analytics - including forecast building, business analysis and model development and productionisation. Drive the generation of actionable insights from data to support various business functions, including product, operations, marketing and engineering. What is our actual CAC per channel? Which customer segments are more/less engaged? What are our customers’ share of wallet - how can we use this? What is the typical behaviour of a Moniepoint consumer? What products cause the biggest incremental engagement?
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with growth, product, and engineering managers to ensure we collect the right data for meaningful business insights. Bring data leadership and rigour to our approach to product development. Build a strategic understanding of the business and structure complex projects to bring them to life.

Business: Growth
• Create and maintain the yearly forecast and budget for your products.
• Define the product's growth plan and lead execution across the entire funnel from acquisition through to monetisation and retention
• Own and optimise specific business metrics or commercial goals, covering the entire funnel from new user acquisition through conversion, activation, retention, and expansion
• Perform detailed product analysis covering the product management funnel with all its aspects, implementing changes into the buying funnel to improve conversion
• Design and execute A/B testing programs to optimise sales and conversion rates/adoption at each funnel stage
• Lead testing and optimisation efforts for the conversion funnel across offline and online channels, prioritising tests that drive the biggest business impact
• Improve the product's design and deploy experiments to improve lifetime value (LTV) and decrease churn 

Technical: Data Analytics
• Use deep, flexible, and comprehensive analytics covering the entire funnel from marketing acquisition to product usage
• Analyse user behaviour to improve the sales funnel and increase conversions, using advanced analytics to assess campaign performance and refine strategies
• Define and track growth metrics including customer acquisition cost (CAC), activation rate, retention rate, payback time, and revenue per customer
• Conduct cohort analysis and journey mapping to identify bottlenecks and optimisation opportunities

What you need to succeed
• +5 years in Analytics and Analytics Management.
• 2+ years in a management role managing teams and driving strategic initiatives
• Proven track record in a consumer-FMCG environment, preferably in a CPG or fintech environment
• Deep experience scaling product businesses, with demonstrated ownership of significant revenue targets

Technical Skills
• Strong analytical skills with ability to drive metrics and benchmarks, plus experience with growth experiments, A/B testing, and funnel optimisation
• Deep SQL knowledge.
• Proficiency in product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Grafana, Tableau, Looker, etc)
• Deep understanding of data analytics, user behaviour analysis and segmentation

Leadership Soft Skills
• Strong communication skills to interact with teams, stakeholders, and users through verbal presentations, written reports, and visual media
• Proven ability to build, mentor, and scale high-performing product teams
• Expertise in data analytics tools and digital marketing platforms with the ability to manage and mentor teams of marketers, analysts, and designers
• Strategic thinker with strong commercial awareness and business acumen

Key Performance Indicators
• User acquisition and activation rates
• Customer retention and churn rates
• Expansion revenue (upsell/cross-sell)
• Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) / Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) ratio
• Product adoption metrics

What sets you apart
• Advanced degree in Business or STEM
• Experience in Growth Analytics, Product analytics, Credit risk analytics
• Background in both mass-marketing and product-led growth models
• Experience managing P L or budget responsibility

What you’ll get
• Culture - We put our people first and prioritise the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
• Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
• Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.

What to expect in the hiring process
• Online SQL take-home task (30 mins): Take-home test.
• Business Case 1 (1 hour - 1 hour 30 mins): Live case. No take-home required.
• Business Case 2 (1 hour - 1 hour 30 mins): Live case. No take-home required.
• Exec Interview (30 mins - 1 hour): Culture Fit. No take-home required.
