jobs.location: Remote Roles - LATAM; San Jose, California, United States
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity

The Americas Compliance team is hiring a Senior Compliance Manager to own compliance for OKXICE TSV and for the joint venture's new broker-dealer. OKXICE TSV is the tokenized securities venue run by the OKX and Intercontinental Exchange joint venture under the SEC's Innovation Exemption, and it lets eligible US users trade tokenized US-listed stocks on-chain. The joint venture is also registering a broker-dealer with FINRA. You'll be the main person accountable for meeting the exemption's ongoing conditions and for taking the broker-dealer through FINRA membership and into operation. You'll work closely with Legal, Finance, Product, Web3 Risk Control and our AML, Sanctions and Surveillance teams, as well as outside counsel and the broker-dealer's clearing firm. These are new businesses, so you'll help build the programs as well as run them.

What You'll Be Doing
• Own the compliance program for the venue's SEC exemption, including tracking each condition, testing controls and keeping records ready for regulatory examination.
• Manage the venue's public notice: review revisions, control versions, and make sure the notice matches how the product actually works. This includes corrections and material-change filings within the required deadlines.
• Run the issuer notice process from start to finish, including tracking delivery, handling objections and confirming each stock's listing date.
• Track and monitor TSV limits on an ongoing basis, including per-stock and volume limits against consolidated market data, periodic tier rechecks, trading halts and eligible stablecoins. Escalate breaches, significant operational events and required SEC notifications.
• Oversee participant onboarding and ongoing wallet maintenance and monitoring, including KYC/KYB, daily sanctions and on-chain wallet rescreening, keeping wallet-to-participant records current, and issuing and revoking the soulbound token (SBT) credential that grants access.
• Lead the broker-dealer through the FINRA new membership application, including Form BD, the business plan and supporting exhibits, responses to FINRA staff requests, and the membership interview.
• Coordinate the evidence FINRA needs before approval, such as the officer and director structure, authorized signatories on the broker-dealer's bank accounts, bank statements, the independent auditor engagement, the clearing agreement, and flow-of-funds and demo materials.
• Build the broker-dealer's compliance program, including written supervisory procedures, the supervisory control system, an AML program under FINRA Rule 3310 with customer identification procedures, and books and records under SEC Rules 17a-3 and 17a-4.
• Once the broker-dealer is approved, run its ongoing compliance, including the annual certification under FINRA Rule 3130, supervisory control testing under Rule 3120, regulatory filings, and FINRA examinations and inquiries. Work with the Financial and Operations Principal on net capital and FOCUS reporting.

 

What We Look For In You
• 8+ years of compliance experience at a FINRA-registered broker-dealer, exchange, alternative trading system (ATS) or digital asset firm, with direct experience of SEC- and FINRA-regulated activity.
• FINRA Series 24 (General Securities Principal) registration, or the ability to qualify within an agreed period after joining.
• Hands-on experience with a FINRA new membership or continuing membership application, including preparing the application and handling FINRA staff questions through to approval.
• Working knowledge of the federal securities laws and FINRA rules that apply to broker-dealers and trading venues, such as Regulation ATS, Regulation NMS, the net capital and customer protection rules, and market manipulation rules, plus the ability to apply them to new market structures.
• Experience building or running compliance programs under regulatory conditions, exemptive relief or no-action positions.
• Familiarity with how blockchain-based trading works, including self-custodied wallets, smart contracts, liquidity pools and on-chain screening.
• Strong drafting skills, with experience turning complex technical or legal detail into clear public disclosures and procedures.
• Sound judgment and the ability to work with Product, Engineering and Legal teams across time zones.

 

Nice to Haves
• Experience with tokenized securities, transfer agents or digital asset broker-dealers.
• Exposure to OFAC sanctions programs and blocked property handling for on-chain assets.
• Experience reporting to a board or joint venture governance body.
• Series 14 (Compliance Official) registration.
• Experience working with a clearing firm under a fully disclosed clearing arrangement.
• A JD or a similar legal background.

Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

The Asset Movements Operations team at Robinhood is dedicated to offering fast, safe, and secure execution of customer requests such as wires, checks, and internal account transfers. As a critical pillar of Robinhood's brokerage business model, our team focuses on risk management and operational accuracy to support the firm's growth. We collaborate with Customer Experience, Clearing, Fraud, and Financial Crimes teams to troubleshoot complex issues and ensure seamless processing. Our culture thrives on teamwork, continuous improvement, and a shared dedication to protecting our customers' assets. Together, we are building the future of retail brokerage operations!

As an Asset Movements Operations Specialist, you will play a central role in executing daily financial transactions with precision and resolving customer requests. In this position, you will be accountable for high-priority wire, check, and journal processing while identifying operational inefficiencies. You will collaborate with project and operations teams to launch and scale Robinhood's electronic financial products. Your analytical skills will be key in mitigating money movement risks and safeguarding customer and firm assets. This is an exciting opportunity to help build our brokerage infrastructure and grow your career with us!

This role is based in our Denver, CO or Westlake, TX office , with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week (Wednesday, Thursday and Friday). 

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do
• Process high-priority transactions, including wires, checks, journals, and bank-linking, ensuring accuracy and timely completion.
• Evaluate and manage money movement risks from both a customer and firm perspective to mitigate financial losses.
• Collaborate with project and operations teams to test, launch, and scale retail brokerage products and operational systems.
• Develop and document operational processes and procedures to improve efficiency and maintain compliance standards.
• Serve as a subject matter expert in asset movements, collaborating with Customer Experience, Clearing, Fraud, and Financial Crimes teams to resolve complex customer issues.

What you bring
• A Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience), along with 4+ years of experience in brokerage operations or financial services.
• Active FINRA Series 7 license; an active FINRA Series 24 license is preferred.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a demonstrated ability to identify process inefficiencies, propose concrete solutions, and manage operational risk.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex operational and compliance concepts clearly.
• Exceptional attention to detail, deep knowledge of banking operation standards, and advanced familiarity with securities industry compliance policies.

What we offer
• Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
• Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
• Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
• Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not
• Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more

jobs.description:
Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

The Role

The First Line of Defense (1LOD) Business Controls Testing (BCT) team executes independent, evidence-based control testing to evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of SoFi’s internal controls across in-scope business processes.

As a Business Controls Testing Senior Analyst, you will independently plan and execute complex control reviews, partner with business and control owners, and communicate clear, well-supported results. You will apply sound risk judgment to identify control gaps, evaluate potential impacts, and drive timely resolution activities. This role requires a strong command of control testing methodology, the ability to navigate ambiguity, and an effective, solutions-oriented approach to stakeholder management.

What You’ll Do
• Execute design effectiveness and operating effectiveness testing, including transactional testing, in accordance with the 1LOD BCT Playbook, procedures, and applicable policies.
• Lead control-owner engagement throughout the testing lifecycle, including walkthroughs, test-script development, evidence requests, status updates, and results discussions.
• Assess processes, risks, controls, data, and documentation to identify weaknesses, gaps, or vulnerabilities; determine whether controls are appropriately designed and operating effectively.
• Produce complete, accurate, and timely workpapers, testing reports, findings, and supporting documentation in required trackers and systems of record, including AuditBoard.
• Clearly articulate testing results, risk implications, and recommended actions to control owners, business partners, management, and other stakeholders.
• Drive accountability for timely evidence submission, issue remediation, and follow-up activities; perform validation or re-performance testing, as needed.
• Partner with issue management and control owners to support the development of actionable remediation plans, milestones, owners, and timelines for identified control failures.
• Exercise judgment in resolving diverse and complex testing issues; proactively identify roadblocks, communicate risks and downstream implications, and propose practical, principle-based solutions.
• Maintain productive relationships across product, process, and control-owner teams, as well as 1LOD Risk Business Controls and Enterprise Risk Management partners.
• Conduct peer quality-assurance reviews, provide constructive feedback, and contribute to consistent application of BCT methodology and documentation standards.
• Support onboarding, training, cross-training, and knowledge sharing for team members.
• Contribute to cross-functional initiatives and continuous-improvement efforts that strengthen testing processes, reporting, and the overall control environment.

What You’ll Need
• 5+ years of relevant experience in risk management, internal controls, control testing, audit, quality assurance, compliance, or a related field; experience in financial services, banking, fintech, or another regulated environment is strongly preferred.
• Demonstrated experience executing control design and operating effectiveness testing, including writing or using test scripts, performing transactional testing, assessing evidence, and documenting results.
• Strong understanding of operational risk management, internal controls, control design, issue remediation, and control-testing methodologies.
• Ability to independently manage a portfolio of testing activities, prioritize competing deadlines, and provide proactive status updates and timely escalations.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to use data to assess risk, reach evidence-based conclusions, and recommend pragmatic solutions.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex control and risk concepts for varied audiences and facilitate productive stakeholder discussions.
• Proven ability to build trust, influence without direct authority, and drive shared accountability in a cross-functional, matrixed environment.
• High attention to detail, sound judgment, intellectual curiosity, and a continuous-improvement mindset.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace, particularly Excel/Google Sheets; experience with GRC platforms such as ServiceNow/AuditBoard is preferred.
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in a first-line risk and controls, operational risk, internal audit, or second-line risk function.
• Experience supporting risk and control self-assessments (RCSAs), issue management, remediation validation, or regulatory/exam readiness.
• Experience testing and deep understanding of technical/ITGC/InfoSec related controls.
• Professional certification or progress toward certification, such as CIA, CISA, CRCM, CRCM, CPA, or equivalent.

jobs.description:
Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

The Role

The Independent Compliance Testing (ICT) Program serves as a key second line of defense at SoFi, helping ensure regulatory requirements are met across applicable lines of business.

As an ICT Compliance Specialist, you will perform independent compliance testing, monitoring, audit, and remediation validation activities across the enterprise. You will assess business-line adherence to applicable consumer and commercial lending, credit card, payments, and servicing laws and regulations.

This role will focus on customer restitution and remediation validation, ongoing monitoring of compliance metrics and controls, audit readiness, issue management, and corrective-action testing. The successful candidate must have hands-on experience conducting audits or compliance reviews, evaluating controls, documenting testing procedures, identifying findings, and validating remediation.

The ICT Compliance Specialist will report to the Regulatory Compliance Testing Team Lead and may support testing across additional financial-services subject areas as needed.

 

What You’ll Do
• Execute independent compliance testing, audit, validation, and monitoring activities in accordance with ICT methodology, standard operating procedures, and team leadership guidance.
• Develop and execute audit and compliance testing procedures to assess the design and operating effectiveness of controls.
• Perform risk-based validation of customer remediation and restitution activities, assessing accuracy, completeness, fairness, and timeliness.
• Evaluate remediation milestones and validation tollgates, including scoping, population identification, calculation methodology, payment execution, and sustainability.
• Conduct ongoing and quarterly monitoring of key compliance metrics, operational controls, and regulatory requirements.
• Analyze trends, exceptions, control gaps, and emerging risks to identify potential systemic issues.
• Validate the accuracy and integrity of data provided by first-line business teams for metrics related to SCRA, FCRA, Regulation B, and other applicable regulations.
• Partner with Data Analytics and technical teams to review queries, logic, inclusion and exclusion criteria, lookback periods, and impacted-population methodologies.
• Recalculate restitution and remediation amounts to confirm that financial relief is accurate and aligned with approved criteria.
• Identify, classify, document, and track audit and compliance findings through remediation and issue closure.
• Perform follow-up testing, sustainability reviews, and validation procedures to confirm that corrective actions have been fully implemented and remain effective.
• Investigate potential errors through structured inquiry, sampling, data analysis, and root-cause analysis.
• Determine whether identified issues are isolated or systemic and assess their potential compliance and customer impact.
• Coordinate validation intake, audit planning, testing milestones, planning meetings, status updates, and stakeholder communications.
• Prepare clear audit workpapers, validation memoranda, monitoring reports, sampling strategies, dashboards, and executive-level reporting.
• Maintain complete, accurate, and audit-ready documentation supporting testing conclusions and independent review.
• Coordinate with business teams, Compliance, Internal Audit, and other stakeholders during regulatory examinations and internal audits.
• Provide requested documentation, data, testing results, and issue-status updates within established deadlines.
• Establish and maintain effective working relationships with Compliance Officers, Issue Owners, Member Remediation, business leaders, Internal Audit, and cross-functional partners.
• Identify opportunities to improve monitoring and audit efficiency through data analytics, automation, and technology-enabled compliance solutions.
• Complete all testing, monitoring, documentation, and reporting activities in accordance with established timelines and the program’s annual validation plan.

What You’ll Need
• Bachelor’s degree.
• At least 6+ years of professional experience in internal audit, compliance audit, regulatory compliance testing, compliance monitoring, or regulatory risk, preferably within financial services or a regulated banking institution.
• Demonstrated hands-on experience conducting internal audits, compliance audits, regulatory reviews, or control assessments.
• Experience developing audit scopes, testing procedures, sampling approaches, workpapers, findings, and audit or validation reports.
• Experience evaluating control design and operating effectiveness.
• Experience tracking corrective actions and performing follow-up testing to confirm remediation and sustainability.
• Strong working knowledge of consumer lending, credit cards, payments, servicing, and applicable laws and regulations.
• Familiarity with Regulation Z, Regulation B, the Fair Credit Reporting Act, the Truth in Lending Act, the Equal Credit Opportunity Act, the CARD Act, the Fair Credit Billing Act, the Servicemembers Civil Relief Act, the Military Lending Act, E-SIGN, and applicable state laws.
• Experience evaluating data populations, sampling methodologies, calculations, controls, and remediation outcomes.
• Strong documentation skills, including preparation of audit workpapers, validation memoranda, monitoring reports, and audit-support materials.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, critical-thinking, and root-cause-analysis skills.
• Ability to identify trends and risk themes from data and translate findings into clear business conclusions.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
• Ability to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders and operate independently under established methodology and leadership guidance.
• Experience supporting internal audits, regulatory examinations, or external audits.

Nice to Have
• CRCM, CIA, CISA, CPA, CAMS, or other relevant compliance, audit, risk, or financial-services certification.
• Experience with SQL, data analytics, dashboarding, or automated monitoring tools.
• Experience with customer remediation, restitution, or enterprise issue-management programs.
• Experience working with consumer and commercial financial products.
• Experience preparing executive reporting related to audit, compliance monitoring, findings, remediation, and risk trends.

• Lead and coach engineers, own hiring, mentoring and performance to grow technical capability and delivery impact.
• Translate product strategy into technical roadmaps that move KPIs
• Guide architecture and technical design decisions, ensuring we build systems that scale globally.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support bank integrations and expand our payment network.
• Drive engineering excellence through code reviews, mentoring and adoption of best practices.
• Understand and contribute to team systems deeply enough to be hands-on when needed.
• Identify opportunities to improve the Send product, balancing short-term delivery with long-term technical health.
• Have an overview of the broader Wise Platform squad, sharing learnings and shaping how we build software company-wide.

jobs.title: Senior Business Development Manager - Travel
jobs.description:

The Wise Platform team is a high-performing group of fintech innovators focused on transforming the way large, multinational organizations move money globally. jobs.title: Sales Team Manager - Wise Business
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Lead Commercial Analyst
jobs.description:
Wise Platform takes all of the world-class payments products Wise has built over the last 15 years and enables hundreds of millions of consumers and businesses to access them in the places where they already move and manage their money - with banks and online platforms.

Today, we’re already powering payments for some of the world’s top neobanks like Monzo, N26, and Nubank, alongside a growing list of leading global banks such as UniCredit, Morgan Stanley and Standard Chartered. In the online platforms space, we’re powering payments for partners across a whole range of industry verticals and use cases. Whether that’s leading marketplaces like Google, Agoda, or Upwork, workforce management tools like Deel, or investment platforms like Interactive Brokers - we’re bringing the power, simplicity, and transparency of Wise to even more people and businesses.

And, we’re just getting started! Wise Platform is one of the newest and fastest growing products at Wise. We’re a global and highly cross-functional team, spearheading Wise next phase of growth!

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Lead Regional Analyst (Northam) to join our deal-flow analytics team in Wise Platform. You will partner with our Commercial and Delivery teams based in North America, empowering them with data and insights to drive growth. Your analysis and sales intelligence will enable us to optimise sales and delivery processes, reduce time to revenue and drive team performance. You will not just answer business questions—you will proactively identify the questions we should be asking. If you’re a commercially minded analyst, with a knack for bringing data life and passion for helping businesses grow, we’d love to hear from you! 

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING
• You will deliver high-impact, scalable data solutions such as building and maintaining robust reporting models and data products that directly support the sales and delivery team's efficiency and effectiveness.
• You will lead the design and implementation of North America's key performance indicators (KPIs). Acting as a strategic advisor to regional leadership, you will anchor our measurement around revenue generation, ensuring absolute clarity on team performance while prescribing actionable, data-backed interventions to drive commercial objectives.
• You will collaborate with Finance and Sales Ops to drive monthly and bi-weekly performance updates, providing executive commentary, insights, and strategic recommendations. Furthermore, you will aggregate behavioral trends from partner transactions to equip sales teams with data-driven hooks, while leading quarterly performance-to-goals reviews to align leadership on IC target setting and improve forecast accuracy.
• As a principal individual contributor, you will design and maintain standardized global assets to eliminate redundant effort and fragmentation across all regions for areas such as forecasting, sales insights, etc.
• You will be leveraging advanced analytics, crafting dashboards and visualisations that bring commercial performance data to life, tell a clear story, and offer diagnostic power, some examples include:
• Strategic Deal Acceleration (The "Spoke"): You will lead tactical deal acceleration for North America by building custom prospect decks (QBDs), complex business cases for specific opportunities, and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) for existing accounts. You will prioritize critical (P1) late-stage, high-value deals to drastically reduce turnaround time (TAT) and increase overall win rates.
• GTM Planning & Market Sizing: Partnering tightly with Sales Enablement and Product Analysts, you will build addressable market sizing (TAM/SAM/SOM) and tailored entry strategies for target verticals. You will estimate the wallet size of high-priority target accounts to systematically build Target Account Lists (TAL) and localize GTM strategies across the region.
• Account Optimization & Wallet Share Expansion: Moving entirely beyond passive reporting, you will proactively run deep-dive wallet share analysis of existing partner portfolios to uncover untapped expansion revenue. You will identify over performing and underperforming metrics—such as volumes, user behavior, and currencies—and flag these to Account Managers to guide proactive forecast revisions and highlight clear growth opportunities.
• You will collaborate with analysts in the team to enhance our forecasting capabilities. This allows us to performance manage the business, teams and partners - alongside supporting operational teams to capacity plan effectively.
• You will shape how we leverage data to sell Wise Platform, identifying key insights and crafting compelling data-driven narratives that empower commercial teams to convert prospects into partners.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II - Cash Management
jobs.description:
About the team

Banks need flexibility in how they fund international payments, settle with Wise and convert currencies. Our Cash Management team builds the products that give them that control and make Wise work for more partners and their customers.

The problems are concrete. How can a bank lock in an exchange rate today and provide the funds later? How can it send payments first and settle with Wise afterward? We build the capabilities behind those choices, helping partners manage their cash around the needs of their business.

We’re a small, growing team developing new products in a domain with plenty to learn and shape. You’ll have a meaningful say in how we solve customer problems, design our systems and maintain engineering quality as we grow. The work combines product development with the challenge of building dependable services that move money across systems.

You’ll work closely with product managers, partner banks and engineers across Wise whose systems handle accounts, incoming payments and liquidity. Together, you’ll understand partner needs, agree how those systems fit together and turn complex requirements into practical products.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Engineer who enjoys understanding a customer’s problem, designing a solution and taking responsibility for how it performs in production.

This is a hands-on role with substantial ownership. You’ll have the autonomy to move work forward, alongside colleagues who contribute through shared design, reviews and pairing.

You will:
• Own solutions from problem to production. Work with product managers and engineers to understand partner needs, shape the approach, and design, build, test and operate backend services.
• Make thoughtful technical decisions. Explain tradeoffs clearly and balance delivery time, reliability and maintainability, including when the information available is incomplete.
• Build across system boundaries. Work with other teams to agree clear interfaces and understand how changes affect the wider payment journey.
• Improve the systems you operate. Strengthen testing and observability, diagnose production issues, and use what you learn to make services more dependable.
• Help the team succeed. Contribute across workstreams, share domain knowledge and help other engineers grow through reviews, pairing and mentoring.

Our backend stack includes Java, Spring Boot, Kafka and PostgreSQL. You’ll deepen your understanding of funding, settlement and currency conversion, using that knowledge to make better product and engineering decisions. As the team’s scope grows, there will be opportunities to take on broader technical ownership and influence how we build.

What will you be doing?
• Design, develop, and maintain highly scalable services in Java and Spring Boot within a microservices architecture.
• Apply domain-driven design to build robust, scalable solutions.
• Lead development efforts in event-driven architectures using Kafka or similar messaging systems.
• Architect, design, and optimise relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) to ensure performance and scalability.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support partner integrations and expand the Wise payment platform globally.
• Participate in code reviews, champion best coding practices and mentor junior engineers.

jobs.title: KYC Operations Team Lead - Deactivations
jobs.description:
As the Team Lead for KYC Operations on our newly established Deactivations Team, you will be at the forefront of strengthening Wise's commitment to regulatory compliance and protecting our financial ecosystem. Your mission is to build and guide a team of senior analysts who will become the authority in enhanced due diligence (EDD) and masters of risk assessment. You will lead your team who investigate complex KYC cases, empowering them with the duty to guarantee that every decision is compliant and accurate. It's a team that delivers justice and upholds our integrity when it matters the most.

As this is a newly formed team at Wise, you won't just be following established guidelines - you'll be a primary architect in their creation. You will lead the effort to shape the team's processes, enhance its tools, and develop its operational strategy. Your leadership, insights, and the feedback from your team will be crucial in building this function from the ground up.

This is a unique opportunity for a sharp, inspiring leader who excels in high-pressure situations and has a passion for developing expert investigators. If you are eager to build a team of subject matter experts in the comprehensive KYC/FinCrime arena and seek a position where your leadership will significantly influence our clients, enhance our reputation, and mentor the next wave of talent —then this opportunity is perfect for you.

Job Responsibilities
• Team Leadership

Lead by example and drive a customer focused mindset across your team. Promote a culture of ownership and accountability. Build high-performing teams that value knowledge sharing and continuous learning.
• People management

Coach and develop a strong team of KYC Analysts. Come up with initiatives to help your team to grow their skills, behaviours, and competencies. Design and manage development plans on identified opportunities. Conducts career map check-ins and makes recommendations for promotions, salary raises, and other decisions.
• Operational management

Identify and propose opportunities for process improvements. Collaborate with central functions and other operational teams as needed to increase operational efficiency. Provide guidance and support on complex, high-risk cases and escalations, which may include acting as a direct point of contact for customers via email, phone, or video call during sensitive inquiries, interviews, or escalations.
• Performance management

Measure team KPIs and ensure performance targets and quality standards are met while maintaining focus on customer experience. Conduct regular one on one coaching sessions, usually on a weekly or biweekly basis. Run team meetings to ensure that your team is kept up to date with the latest information, share best practices and enhance overall team spirit.
• Expertise Sharing

Be a subject matter expert in your area with the ability to train and coach your team on operational topics. Maintain a good understanding of our regulatory obligations, internal policies, and applying a risk-based approach to deterring and preventing money laundering and financial crime. Able to perform deep dives, understand root causes of problematic cases and propose solutions to senior leadership.
• Planning and execution

Ensure key performance indicators are being met and provide insights to other stakeholders. Take full accountability in delivering your own initiatives and making sure your team is making progress on their goals.
• Stakeholder management and communication

Collaborate closely with your stakeholders ensuring clear communication and coordination of actions. You communicate mindfully and professionally while choosing the right formats and platforms to convey your message to a wider audience in a timely manner. Your initiatives and reports are well documented and it has a clear scope that includes potential impact in different areas.
• Quality assurance and control

Implement and maintain a robust quality assurance framework for your team. Conduct regular checks and reviews of your team’s casework to ensure accuracy, consistency, and adherence to the highest standards of our policies and regulatory obligations. Provide targeted coaching and constructive feedback based on quality findings to drive continuous improvement. Analyse quality metrics to identify trends, address root causes of errors, and develop initiatives that enhance the team's overall performance and mitigate risk.

jobs.title: Social Content Intern
jobs.description:

jobs.title: CRM Automation Specialist
jobs.description:
Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

 

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

 

Your mission

Keep Bitpanda's Braze running right. You will own the configuration of our Braze workspaces, from the data model behind attributes, events and segments to our templates and content blocks. You understand how APIs and data integrations work, and you can work directly with engineers to scope solutions and fix data issues. Your work lets the CRM team ship campaigns without worrying about the infrastructure underneath.

 

What you'll do
• Configure and maintain our Braze workspaces: attributes, segments, templates, content blocks and Liquid logic.
• Set up multi-market sends with Localisation so every language version is right.
• Run QA before every send and own deliverability hygiene.
• Fix broken attributes, templates and sends first-line; escalate pipeline issues to our MarTech Engineer.
• Document the setup so the team is never dependent on one person.

 

Who you are
• You have two to four years administering Braze (or similar CRM platform) for a multi-market programme.
• You own configuration, attributes, templates and QA hands-on; you are not looking for a strategy role.
• You are comfortable with Liquid, HTML and CSS for email templates, basic SQL for segment checks and reading integration API documentation.
• You document what you build and you check before you send.

 

What’s in it for you
• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
• Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
• Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
• Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
• Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
• Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
• Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
• Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
• Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
• Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
• Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

 .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

 

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive, Marketplaces
jobs.description:
About us:

Branch is on a mission to empower workers with financial freedom. We do this by helping companies accelerate payments and providing working Americans with accessible, free financial services. We’re committed to building and delivering more inclusive, transparent, and frictionless financial products.

Our goal of empowerment extends to our own employees, too. Have a great idea? Share it today and it might just get implemented tomorrow. As a member of our team, your voice and creativity matter—and they can directly impact our products, company, and culture. 

We not only focus on attracting great talent from across the country, but also on building teams that help that talent thrive. That means valuing a diversity of opinions and working styles, while creating a shared belief in innovation, initiative, and winning together.

Come join our team as we develop new ways to improve the lives of working Americans.

About

the role:

We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Enterprise Account Executive to join our Marketplaces sales team. Branch is a leader in the marketplace payments space, with some of the largest labor and delivery marketplaces in the world — including Uber and Instacart — among our largest customers. In this role, you will be responsible for driving new business acquisition and revenue growth by selling our innovative FinTech solutions to enterprise-level clients. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of managing complex sales cycles, building strong relationships with C-level executives, and a deep understanding of the financial services industry.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
• Own and manage a named book of enterprise and upper‐mid‐market labor and seller marketplace clients to build strategic relationships at C-suite, VP, and director levels.
• Lead full sales cycles, from inbound and outbound prospecting through contract negotiation and closing.
• Partner closely with our embedded payments platform partner's sales organization to jointly identify, pursue, and manage shared accounts — driving co-sell and cross-sell opportunities and enabling their sellers to effectively position Branch within their deals.
• Develop and execute comprehensive account plans to win new business and expand with existing clients.
• Work cross‐functionally across Product, Finance, and Engineering to design and deliver custom solutions as part of a technical selling process.
• Drive and refine the marketplace strategy: help define and scale repeatable engagement models, sales motions, and positioning for Branch’s platform offerings.
• Use metrics and financial analysis to quantify value propositions and ROI for prospective clients.
• Collaborate with internal teams to shape product roadmap based on client feedback, competitive landscape, and market demand.
• Hit or exceed revenue targets, sales quotas, and other KPIs relevant to platform and enterprise deals.

Qualifications (required):
• 5–8 years of experience in enterprise sales, preferably selling platforms, embedded finance, payments, or infrastructure solutions.
• Have closed sizable ($500k+ ARR), complex deals (multi-stakeholder, multi-quarter cycles, including technical and non‐technical buyers).
• Are comfortable engaging senior executives (CTOs, CFOs, COOs) as well as technical leaders (engineers, security / compliance).
• Have strong product acumen and are capable of understanding and communicating both technical and financial value.
• Are highly analytical — you know how to build business cases, model ROI, and use data to drive decisions.
• Are self-motivated, resourceful, and can thrive in a fast‐moving environment that requires both strategic thinking and hands-on execution.
• Are excellent communicators, both written and verbal.

Qualifications (preferred):
• Previous experience in fintech, embedded finance, or payments infrastructure.
• Experience selling into or working with HR technology and vertical SaaS platforms.
• Familiarity with risk, regulatory, and compliance considerations in financial services.

Compensation:

The On-Target Earnings (OTE) range for this role is $260-$300k (base compensation + commission). The compensation range displayed reflects an average range for the position across all the U.S. The compensation offered to an applicant could be higher or lower based on each applicant's specific skill set, depth of experience, relevant education or training, etc. 

Location:

This position is classified as REMOTE within the United States of America.

We are unable to hire candidates located outside of the domestic U.S.

Benefits:
• Market-leading medical, dental, and vision insurance
• Stock options
• Free Premium-Tier Origin Financial Wellness subscription
• Monthly home-office stipend
• 401k (TransAmerica)
• 12-weeks paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents
• Flexible time off + sick and safe time
• 11 paid company holidays
• Branch@Branch Same Day Pay Option

Identity Verification

As part of our application process, you'll receive a separate email from Greenhouse shortly containing a unique identity verification link. This step, powered by Persona, helps us confirm applicant identities and keep our hiring process secure for everyone. 

Upon identity verification, all biometric data is deleted. If you need support completing this application, please reach out to Careers@branchapp.com

Working at Branch

A remote-first company with employees located throughout the U.S., Branch emphasizes transparency, accountability, and trust to create a collaborative environment where our product, engineering, marketing, customer support, customer success, and sales teams can all thrive together. Learn more about what we do in this video!

Our collaborative spirit has helped us become an award-winning FinTech company, with Branch’s innovation and workplace recognized across industries. Branch has been honored by Inc., the Webby Awards, Benzinga FinTech Awards, FinTech Breakthrough Awards, Top Workplaces USA, Great Places to Work, and EY Entrepreneur of the Year, Heartland, among others. 

Learn more about our culture, approach, technology, and people here: https://www.branchapp.com/about

 

Branch is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Must be currently authorized to work in the USA without sponsorship or transfer.

No third-parties, please.

View how Branch collects your personal data here.

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Sales
jobs.location: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Sales at Brex

The Sales team is the driving force behind revenue at Brex, and Enterprise Sales continues to scale Brex upmarket. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring customers, and expanding value across our portfolio. Brex wins by changing how companies control spend (corporate cards, spend management, and expense in one platform, with AI agents that act upstream of the expense report) against both legacy tools and modern competitors. We celebrate individual accomplishments and team wins, with a high-performance culture rooted in collaboration, transparency, and execution.

What You’ll Do

As Director of Sales for our Enterprise segment, you will lead a team of approximately five Account Executives driving new customer acquisition as Brex moves further upmarket. You will own team performance and help customers build the business case for an enterprise-wide platform spanning corporate cards, spend management, and expense management.

You will operate at every level: in the deals, not above them. That means joining customer conversations, coaching multi-threading and executive engagement, and running a proactive operating cadence for account planning, pipeline inspection, deal reviews, and forecasting. Observing a forecast from the sidelines is not the job; being present on customer calls and shaping deal strategy with your AEs is non-negotiable. Success means exceeding team targets, developing strong enterprise sellers, and introducing repeatable ways of working that raise performance across Enterprise and Brex.

Where You’ll Work

This role can be based in any of our hubs: San Francisco, New York, Seattle, or Salt Lake City. Our hybrid environment combines the energy and connection of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three days per week in the office - Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also offer up to four weeks per year of fully remote work. 

Responsibilities
• Lead, coach, and develop approximately five Account Executives; hire and onboard additional talent while setting clear expectations for performance and accountability.
• Own team bookings and new customer acquisition; guide account prioritization and pipeline creation across direct, partner, and Capital One commercial bank opportunities.
• Establish a proactive operating cadence for account planning, pipeline inspection, deal reviews, and forecasting, with clear milestones, risks, owners, and next steps.
• Join customer calls and actively shape deal strategy, helping AEs build executive relationships, establish value before signature, and align Finance, Accounting, IT, HR, and Travel and Expense stakeholders.
• Orchestrate complex opportunities across Product, Marketing, Finance, Pricing, and implementation teams; translate customer needs into business cases, resolve blockers, and align commitments with delivery readiness.
• Partner with implementation and customer-facing teams on mutual action plans that extend from signature through go-live, helping closed deals convert into realized revenue.
• Build and test industry-specific messaging and sales playbooks from customer insights and successful deals; share effective practices across Enterprise and the broader business.
• Build trust through transparency, candid feedback, and direct conflict resolution; take ownership of improvements and partner with Enterprise Sales leadership and cross-functional GTM partners (Product, Marketing, Finance, Implementation, and Enablement) to strengthen how the segment operates.

Requirements
• 5+ years of first-line Enterprise sales leadership experience, including direct management, hiring, and development of Account Executives or transferable leadership experience.
• Proven record of meeting or exceeding team targets in complex, competitive B2B sales, with evidence of improving seller performance and sales execution.
• Experience leading enterprise-wide platform sales with long cycles and multiple buying functions; ability to establish a compelling business case and secure commitment before deployment.
• Hands-on deal leadership: joins customer conversations, coaches multithreading and executive engagement, and helps teams resolve difficult decisions that stall opportunities.
• Strong operating and project management discipline, with an established approach to account planning, pipeline management, forecasting, and coordinating internal and customer stakeholders.
• Ability to influence cross-functional priorities, articulate the commercial value of customer needs, and coordinate execution across Product, Marketing, Finance, and customer-facing teams.
• Experience selling with partners and navigating the dependencies of a complex platform; financial services, spend management, or Office of the CFO experience is a plus.
• Clear communicator and low-ego, high-ownership leader who builds trust, acts with sound judgment in ambiguity, and introduces improvements that other teams can adopt.

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Sales
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Sales at Brex

The Sales team is the driving force behind revenue at Brex, and Enterprise Sales continues to scale Brex upmarket. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring customers, and expanding value across our portfolio. Brex wins by changing how companies control spend (corporate cards, spend management, and expense in one platform, with AI agents that act upstream of the expense report) against both legacy tools and modern competitors. We celebrate individual accomplishments and team wins, with a high-performance culture rooted in collaboration, transparency, and execution.

What You’ll Do

As Director of Sales for our Enterprise segment, you will lead a team of approximately five Account Executives driving new customer acquisition as Brex moves further upmarket. You will own team performance and help customers build the business case for an enterprise-wide platform spanning corporate cards, spend management, and expense management.

You will operate at every level: in the deals, not above them. That means joining customer conversations, coaching multi-threading and executive engagement, and running a proactive operating cadence for account planning, pipeline inspection, deal reviews, and forecasting. Observing a forecast from the sidelines is not the job; being present on customer calls and shaping deal strategy with your AEs is non-negotiable. Success means exceeding team targets, developing strong enterprise sellers, and introducing repeatable ways of working that raise performance across Enterprise and Brex.

Where You’ll Work

This role can be based in any of our hubs: San Francisco, New York, Seattle, or Salt Lake City. Our hybrid environment combines the energy and connection of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three days per week in the office - Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also offer up to four weeks per year of fully remote work. 

Responsibilities
• Lead, coach, and develop approximately five Account Executives; hire and onboard additional talent while setting clear expectations for performance and accountability.
• Own team bookings and new customer acquisition; guide account prioritization and pipeline creation across direct, partner, and Capital One commercial bank opportunities.
• Establish a proactive operating cadence for account planning, pipeline inspection, deal reviews, and forecasting, with clear milestones, risks, owners, and next steps.
• Join customer calls and actively shape deal strategy, helping AEs build executive relationships, establish value before signature, and align Finance, Accounting, IT, HR, and Travel and Expense stakeholders.
• Orchestrate complex opportunities across Product, Marketing, Finance, Pricing, and implementation teams; translate customer needs into business cases, resolve blockers, and align commitments with delivery readiness.
• Partner with implementation and customer-facing teams on mutual action plans that extend from signature through go-live, helping closed deals convert into realized revenue.
• Build and test industry-specific messaging and sales playbooks from customer insights and successful deals; share effective practices across Enterprise and the broader business.
• Build trust through transparency, candid feedback, and direct conflict resolution; take ownership of improvements and partner with Enterprise Sales leadership and cross-functional GTM partners (Product, Marketing, Finance, Implementation, and Enablement) to strengthen how the segment operates.

Requirements
• 5+ years of first-line Enterprise sales leadership experience, including direct management, hiring, and development of Account Executives or transferable leadership experience.
• Proven record of meeting or exceeding team targets in complex, competitive B2B sales, with evidence of improving seller performance and sales execution.
• Experience leading enterprise-wide platform sales with long cycles and multiple buying functions; ability to establish a compelling business case and secure commitment before deployment.
• Hands-on deal leadership: joins customer conversations, coaches multithreading and executive engagement, and helps teams resolve difficult decisions that stall opportunities.
• Strong operating and project management discipline, with an established approach to account planning, pipeline management, forecasting, and coordinating internal and customer stakeholders.
• Ability to influence cross-functional priorities, articulate the commercial value of customer needs, and coordinate execution across Product, Marketing, Finance, and customer-facing teams.
• Experience selling with partners and navigating the dependencies of a complex platform; financial services, spend management, or Office of the CFO experience is a plus.
• Clear communicator and low-ego, high-ownership leader who builds trust, acts with sound judgment in ambiguity, and introduces improvements that other teams can adopt.

Compensation

The target OTE range for this position is $316,400 - $395,500. Final base salary determination accounts for individual expertise, geographical location, relevant background, market dynamics, and internal equity alignment. Beyond base pay, comprehensive offer packages may encompass equity grants alongside additional total rewards components.

Greenlight is a family technology company on a mission to help families raise financially smart kids and navigate life together. Its suite of products — including the Greenlight app, debit card, Safe Family GPS trackers, and Family Hub — brings together financial tools, safety features, and everyday family management in one connected experience. At Greenlight, we're here to make the day-to-day easier and futures brighter, so families can spend less time managing life, and more time living it. That's why we get out of bed every morning.

We want someone process-focused with strong interpersonal skills who can manage relationships externally and influence internally. This team is growing quickly, moves fast, and is always iterating, so you will be expected to juggle several projects at once while building reproducible processes. If you are a naturally inquisitive self-starter who loves to learn, this role is for you.

It takes a talented team to aim for a mission like ours. We're looking for people who ask "is it bold enough?" People who bring their real selves to the table and push the people around them to do the same. We win by never hesitating to jump in, offer a hand, or share the credit, because we know we're stronger together than apart. And through all of it, the mission stays the thing we measure ourselves against: are we doing right by the families counting on us? If that sounds like your kind of team, we'd love for you to apply.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

About the role

The Senior Business Analyst plays a key role in shaping the growth and success of Moniepoint’s payment products. You'll design, test, and implement strategies that improve user acquisition, boost retention, and elevate product engagement. This role blends deep quantitative analysis with collaborative, strategic thinking. You'll partner with teams across the business to ensure our payment solutions meet real market demands and grow efficiently as we scale. Ultimately, you'll make sure our products not only attract users but also scale sustainably to create financial happiness for everyone.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

Key Responsibilities
• Partner closely with product managers, business development, and data engineering teams to help our growth team uncover problems and make product metrics highly visible.
• Translate complex product and business questions into simple, actionable insights.
• Build, maintain, and scale self-service dashboards and custom visualisation tools.
• Own end-to-end analytics for our growth products—from gathering data requirements and estimating opportunity sizes to designing experiments and conducting post-launch impact reviews.
• Cultivate trusted relationships across teams, acting as a collaborative link between technology, business, and product.
• Apply advanced mathematical and statistical modelling techniques (including A/B tests, multivariate testing, clustering, and supervised learning) to solve practical business problems that drive high-impact results.

Qualifications
• 3 to 4 years of professional experience (excluding academic projects and internships) in a quantitative analysis role within high-scale tech companies, tier-1 consulting firms, or investment banks with strong programming demands.
• Excellent SQL skills (which we will test during our interview process).
• Practical experience designing, running, and analysing experiments on digital products (such as A/B and multivariate tests).
• Hands-on experience with popular visualisation tools like Tableau or Looker.
• Experience applying statistical modelling and advanced analytics to deliver practical, product-shaping insights.
• Strong skills in statistical programming (Python) and familiarity with tools like Pandas, SciPy, and Jupyter notebooks.
• Clear, professional spoken and written English.

Additional skills
• Product management
• Analytics
• Marketing
• Data Science
• Design
• Customer Success

What we can offer you
• Culture - We put our people first and prioritise every team member's well-being. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
• Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
• Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.

What to expect in the hiring process
• A preliminary phone call with one of our recruiters.
• A panel interview with a member of the hiring team.
• A behavioural and technical interview with a member of the Executive team

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Control Analyst, 9 Month Fixed Term Contract
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.

 

Senior Financial Control Analyst

📍London/Cardiff | 💰£56,000 - £75,000 + Benefits

⭐ Our Financial Control Team:

Monzo is growing fast - new products, new markets and new locations. As we expand we need to make sure we can support our businesses and control our processes, so we are growing our team to meet these exciting new challenges! We are looking to introduce a Senior Financial Control Analyst on a 9 Month Fixed Term Contract. 

Our team sits within Monzo’s Finance collective and our job is getting the numbers right. We’re currently a team of seven qualified accountants, split between our Cardiff and London offices, and we ensure the ledger’s correct at every month-end. We work closely with all areas of Finance and the product teams to make that happen.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by… 

We're looking for a proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded accountant to work on our financial accounting, and help us build a world-class finance function. This role would be well suited to a qualified accountant with 2+ years of post-qualification experience.

We have some really exciting challenges under way like making sure we maximise our new SAP S4/HANA general ledger, expanding into the European Union, pushing forward with our automation plans, continuing to grow our customer base, growing our lending business and adding to our marketplace. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way, while helping us optimise our financial control processes with the help of technology. You’ll report to our Financial Control Manager.

Your day-to-day:
• Manage a tight process with the rest of our internal Finance team to ensure a swift month-end close process and group consolidation.
• Understand the business and our products to write insightful management commentary.
• Understand our accounting systems and make sure we are taking advantage of all features we can to minimise manual elements of reporting.
• Embrace the opportunity to improve and transform processes, driving incremental improvements through to adoption of AI.
• Learn SQL skills to run reports and propose solutions that make our processes efficient and scalable.
• Support our year end process working with external auditors and our Financial Reporting squad.
• Help review new products, assessing the accounting and implementing them in our banking platform and accounting system.
• Work with the business to assess the impact of changes in accounting standards and make proposals on accounting policy matters for new products launched.
• Help maintain the integrity of our chart of accounts and financial static data.
• Resolve miscellaneous inquiries and support the overall finance team wherever needed - from forecasting and valuations, to bank transfers, transfer pricing and tax policy research!

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…
• You’re a qualified accountant with a few years’ post-qualification experience, ideally in financial reporting/controlling teams and working in a retail banking environment
• You have a strong understanding of technical accounting standards
• You have a great eye for detail
• You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key financial controls
• You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s making a bank transfer or pulling together reports for investors
• You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds
• You’re interested in using data (SQL skills would be a bonus)
• You embrace change and are motivated to improve and innovate process
• You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment
• What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰£56,000 - £75,000. 

📍This role can be based in our London or Cardiff office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) 

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. 

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. 

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps
• Recruiter Screening Conversation
• Initial HM Interview
• Role Specific Interview
• Behavioural Interview 

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! 

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

#LI-TP1

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

We are looking for a dynamic Treasury Capital Manager in Dublin to become a key part of the team building the new Monzo European entity. Reporting into the Director of Treasury and Capital, you will shape, develop and implement the Capital management process and infrastructure in tandem with supporting the growth and strategic development of the business. As well as skills and experience in Treasury and Capital Management, the ability to adapt, be creative and work in a fast paced environment with wider Group colleagues will be essential talents as the business grows.

As part of a new and growing team, the Treasury Capital Manager will be responsible for ensuring that Monzo effectively manages its capital and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements in Europe. This is an opportunity to be part of something from the start and make a real difference.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
• Strong leadership abilities and experience in working across dispersed teams.
• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.
