Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

The role:

SoFi is seeking an energetic, organized, and resourceful Direct Mail Marketing Manager for a one-year contract to manage the end-to-end direct mail creative process for the SoFi Credit Card product, from strategy and planning through creative development, stakeholder review, approval, production, and tracking. This role will also analyze campaign performance and provide recommendations to optimize future direct mail strategies and creative.

At SoFi, you’ll become part of a new kind of finance company whose ambition is to help our members achieve financial independence and reach their goals. We aim to be at the center of our members’ financial lives and help every member get their money right. We created student loan refinancing, addressing the biggest financial challenge of a new generation through a modern approach to lending and personal finance. Next, we expanded our products and services across loans, investing, and cash management. SoFi has achieved significant growth, with ambitious plans ahead, but to continue this growth, we need great talent. And that starts with you.

What you’ll do: 

This role owns four core areas of responsibility:
1. Creative Strategy Planning
• Lead end-to-end creative strategy and execution for Credit Card direct mail campaigns, partnering with Product Marketing Manager (PMM) to align initiatives with business goals, priorities, and growth objectives.
• Lead quarterly creative planning with the creative agency, using audience insights, customer behavior, performance data, and test-and-learn principles to develop strategic recommendations for the Product Marketing Manager.
• Lead upfront data and audience planning with DM Data Strategy, Marketing Data Science and agency team defining targeting, segmentation, personalization, measurement requirements, and data inputs that inform the creative strategy, testing plan, and campaign brief.
• Own the creative roadmap and partner with the creative agency to develop compelling messaging, visual storytelling, offers, personalization, branding, and calls to action.
2. Campaign Production Management
• Serve as the day-to-day campaign lead and primary liaison among Product Marketing Manager, the creative and data strategy agency, DM Data Strategy, Marketing Data Science, other internal stakeholders, and print vendors.
• Serve as the lead DM representative in Credit Card business unit meetings, Marketing Data Science handoff meetings, and other recurring meetings. Prepare slides as needed, capture key decisions and action items, and distribute notes to appropriate stakeholders.
• Translate approved strategies into actionable campaign plans, creative briefs, testing plans, and production requirements.
• Manage monthly direct mail tests and creative variations, ensuring audience definitions, segmentation, data requirements, personalization, and creative variants are aligned and executable.
• Own campaign timelines and the shared production calendar, including data due dates, creative milestones, review rounds, release dates, print dates, and drop dates.
• Manage assets, versioning, production samples, dependencies, risks, and bottlenecks to ensure campaigns launch accurately and on time.
• Maintain the monthly campaign matrix, including audience targeting, creative variations, testing plans, data requirements, and other campaign details.
• Partner with Marketing Data Science to update campaign matrices and verify that targeting and personalization information is accurate before each drop.
• Lead weekly status meetings with Product Marketing Managers, including agenda development, stakeholder alignment, and action-item follow-up.
3. Compliance, Quality Operations
• Lead the Compliance and Legal review process for direct mail materials, partnering with Product Marketing and the creative agency to ensure executions meet regulatory, disclosure, brand, and business requirements.
• Manage creative review and quality control across messaging, data, personalization, offers, URLs, disclosures, and final production files.
• Serve as the central point of accountability for ensuring every campaign is accurate, compliant, data-aligned, approved, and production-ready.
• Manage campaign production and postage costs, partnering with the DM billing team to keep campaigns within budget.
4. Performance, Insights Competitive Intelligence
• Partner with Marketing Data Science, analytics, and the creative agency to evaluate campaign and creative test results against product and business goals.
• Translate audience, performance, and campaign data into actionable insights that inform creative recommendations, messaging, offers, personalization, segmentation, and future test strategies.
• Lead weekly Product Marketing Manager performance updates and monthly reporting, presenting results and optimization recommendations to Product Marketing and cross-functional stakeholders.
• Apply campaign learnings to improve future direct mail initiatives and inform the creative roadmap.
• Build and maintain a competitive direct mail library, monitoring competitor activity, creative trends, offers, formats, personalization, and audience strategies.
• Share monthly competitive and performance insights with the broader Marketing organization to inform future campaign and product marketing strategy.

What you’ll need:
• Bachelor's degree with 4+ years of project management experience, preferably supporting direct mail or other marketing campaigns within financial services or another highly regulated industry.
• Experience partnering with cross-functional teams to execute complex, multi-channel campaigns and operational initiatives.
• Experience managing high-volume direct mail, CRM, lifecycle, or integrated marketing creative execution, ideally within financial services, credit cards, banking, or another highly regulated industry.
• Strong project and production management skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, creative versions, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously.
• Highly proficient in Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets, Docs, Slides, Gmail, and Calendar, Tableau, Snowflake; comfortable building and maintaining detailed trackers and production workflows.
• Strong understanding of creative development, production, version control, review/approval processes, and vendor management.
• Experience working directly with Legal, Compliance, Creative, Marketing, Analytics, Data, and external production vendors.
• Strong attention to detail and a high level of ownership, particularly when managing personalized credit card communications where small errors can have significant downstream impact.
• Comfortable working in a test-and-learn environment, using campaign performance data to inform future creative decisions.
• Excellent communication and organizational skills with the ability to keep senior stakeholders informed while driving day-to-day execution.
• Financial services or credit card marketing experience strongly preferred, particularly familiarity with regulated marketing, compliance reviews, disclosures, and credit-related communications.

jobs.title: Head of Credit Decision Modelling and Strategy
jobs.description:
Starling is the UK’s first and leading digital bank on a mission to fix banking! We built a new kind of bank because we knew technology had the power to help people save, spend and manage their money in a new and transformative way. Read more about our story here.

We’re a fully licensed UK bank with the culture and spirit of a fast-moving, disruptive tech company. We’re a bank, but better: fairer, easier to use and designed to demystify money for everyone. We employ more than 3,500 people across our London, Southampton, Cardiff and Manchester offices.

To support our ongoing growth, we’re looking to recruit a Head of Credit Risk Modelling and Strategy within the 2nd line Credit Risk Team. The role will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the financial stability of the Bank by leading the development and continuous improvement of regulatory and operational credit risk models and credit decisioning strategies. The role requires a deep understanding of credit risk principles, regulatory requirements, and credit model and strategy development. As part of the second line of defence, you will work closely with, and provide insight to, stakeholders across the business, while delivering robust credit risk models and strategies that align with the Bank’s overall risk appetite and strategy.

Key Accountabilities and Responsibilities
• Lead the development, monitoring and maintenance of the Bank’s credit risk decisioning models, including acquisition scorecards and affordability models.
• Develop and monitor automated decisioning strategies for the Bank’s lending products.
• Define standards for credit risk model development which align to the Bank’s Model Risk Framework, and ensure these are implemented within the team.
• Ensure all credit risk models and strategies comply with relevant UK regulatory standards, including PRA and FCA requirements.
• Collaborate with key internal stakeholders, including the first line Asset Management and Finance teams, to ensure models and strategies support business objectives.
• Ensure all models and standards are documented to a high standard, and present outputs to senior stakeholders and committees.
• Lead and develop a high performing team of risk modelling analysts, and support individual continuous professional development.
• Keep track of industry trends and regulatory requirements to continually enhance the Bank’s management of credit risk.
• 10+ years’ experience in Credit Risk within a Banking environment.
• Strong experience of credit risk modelling, gained through model development or validation related roles.
• Strong understanding of retail and SME lending products.
• Experience of developing and maintaining credit risk strategies, ideally in an unsecured retail lending environment.
• Experience of a range of lending products (mortgages, unsecured retail lending, SME lending) preferred.
• Proven experience in influencing, negotiation and relationship management.
• Strong communication skills, with experience of preparing and presenting documents in relation to models.
• Coding experience in Python, R, SAS or similar.
• Good knowledge of model risk governance.
• 25 days holiday (plus take your public holiday allowance whenever works best for you)
• An extra day’s holiday for your birthday
• Annual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell up to five extra days off
• 16 hours paid volunteering time a year
• Salary sacrifice, company enhanced pension scheme
• Life insurance at 4x your salary
• Private Medical Insurance with VitalityHealth including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and Peloton
• Generous family-friendly policies
• Perkbox membership giving access to retail discounts, a wellness platform for physical and mental health, and weekly free and boosted perks
• Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work and Salary Sacrificed Gym partnerships

About Us

We’re on a mission to radically reshape banking – and that starts with our brilliant team. Whatever came before, we’re proud to bring together people of all backgrounds and experiences who love working together to solve problems.

jobs.title: Senior Credit Decision Modelling Analyst
jobs.description:
Starling is the UK’s first and leading digital bank on a mission to fix banking! We built a new kind of bank because we knew technology had the power to help people save, spend and manage their money in a new and transformative way. Read more about our story here.

We’re a fully licensed UK bank with the culture and spirit of a fast-moving, disruptive tech company. We’re a bank, but better: fairer, easier to use and designed to demystify money for everyone. We employ more than 3,500 people across our London, Southampton, Cardiff and Manchester offices.

We are looking for a talented and passionate Senior Credit Decision Modelling Analyst to join our 2nd line Credit Risk team. Our team plays a critical role in developing and maintaining credit risk models and strategies across Starling, including the models used to assess our new lending applications. If you have experience in credit risk model development, and are eager to be part of the team that plays a vital role in credit risk management, we want to hear from you! 

As a Senior Credit Decision Modelling Analyst, you will be responsible for:
• Developing and implementing credit risk models and strategies.
• Working closely with stakeholders to ensure that model developments meet business requirements.
• Producing detailed model documentation, including methodology, assumptions, and limitations.
• Monitoring model performance and conducting regular reviews to ensure accuracy and stability.
• Collaborating with model validation teams to address any findings and ensure models are robust.
• Presenting model developments to Senior leadership, and representing the Credit Risk Modelling team with internal and external stakeholders.
• Minimum 3 - 5 years’ experience in developing credit risk models.
• Proficient in the use of analytical tools such as Python/R/SQL/SAS and spreadsheets.
• Graduate level education preferable, ideally in a numerical degree (or an equivalent work experience).
• Good understanding of unsecured lending products, ideally covering both retail and SME.
• Good knowledge of regulatory and risk management guidelines relating to credit risk.
• Ability to articulate model development methodologies and findings in a succinct and clear way that is suitable for the target audience.
• Organised, flexible and adaptable, with the ability to switch between tasks seamlessly.
• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
• Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager - API Experience & Security
jobs.description:
Your customers are the developers, security teams, and operational teams at our partners. Companies like Morgan Stanley, N26 and Ramp rely on Wise Platform APIs to run critical payments journeys in production. It’s your job to ensure they can connect securely, operate reliably, and troubleshoot issues quickly — without needing manual support.

As the Senior Product Manager for API Tooling, you will own the roadmap and execution for the API access, security and webhook infrastructure and tooling of Wise Platform API integrations. You’ll focus on reducing partner-impacting incidents (especially auth- and webhook-related), improving observability and self-serve troubleshooting, and modernising the auth and security foundations so the platform can scale safely over the next few years. You will partner and work closely with the Security, Account Access and Wise Platform teams to build API solutions suitable for our enterprise partnerships.

Your mission: Make Wise Platform integrations secure-by-default and reliable in production, with self-serve operational API visibility that reduces failures and support load.

What you’ll be working on
• Own the Wise Platform partner API access, webhook service and WP API security offering, making it easy for developers to securely connect and troubleshoot our APIs.
• Design in partnership with the Security team, credential management, authentication strategies, and secure connection protocols that balance security with developer experience.
• Build and improve webhook reliability, observability, and usability.
• Deliver API and webhook logs and diagnostics tooling that helps partners and internal teams investigate and recover from issues faster.
• Ensure the auth and security infrastructure of Wise Platform is robust and scalable for the long term service demands.

In this role, you will;

Own the roadmap
• Define and execute a roadmap centred on secure access, reliability, and operational excellence in production.

Drive execution
• Work closely with engineering to ship improvements that measurably reduce incidents, support load, and time-to-resolution.
• Make pragmatic trade-offs between scope, security, reliability, and delivery speed.

Collaborate cross-functionally
• Partner with platform engineering, security, compliance, support, sales, and other product teams to deliver a cohesive partner experience.
• Align internal teams on ownership boundaries and operational processes for incident prevention and response.

Be customer-obsessed
• Engage directly with partner developers and operational teams to understand real production pain (auth failures, webhook issues, visibility gaps).
• Use data and incident learnings to prioritise the highest-risk and highest-impact improvements.

Measure and iterate
• Define success metrics around reliability and operability (e.g., incident rates, auth failure rates, webhook delivery success, support ticket drivers, time-to-resolution, self-serve adoption).

Deliver impact
• Deliver measurable reductions in partner-impacting incidents, improved troubleshooting speed, and stronger security posture that supports enterprise adoption.

jobs.title: Senior Product Analyst - WISE Platform - Send for Partners
jobs.description:
ABOUT WISE PLATFORM

Wise Platform takes all of the world-class payments products Wise has built over the last 15 years and enables hundreds of millions of consumers and businesses to access them in the places where they already move and manage their money - with banks and large tech platforms.

Today, we’re already powering payments for some of the world’s top neobanks like Monzo, N26, and Nubank, alongside a growing list of leading global banks such as UniCredit, Morgan Stanley and Standard Chartered, to name a few. In the tech platforms space, we’re powering payments for partners across a whole range of industry verticals and use cases. Whether that’s leading marketplaces like Google, Agoda, or Upwork, workforce management tools like Deel, or investment platforms like Interactive Brokers - we’re bringing the power, simplicity, and transparency of Wise to even more people and places.

And, we’re just getting started! Wise Platform is one of the newest and fastest growing products at Wise. We’re a global and highly cross-functional team, spearheading Wise next phase of growth! 

THE ROLE

As the Senior Product Analyst in Send for Partners, you’ll sit at the centre of one of Wise Platform’s biggest products: helping the world’s largest banks and platforms send money across borders. You’ll work with the Send for Partner’s team to uncover opportunities that shape the product roadmap, measure success of initiatives and performance against KPIs, and work cross functionality to support product features from ideation to scale. This is a highly autonomous role in a fast-scaling “start-up within a scale-up” environment. You’ll turn ambiguous partner problems into crisp insights, compelling narratives and clear product bets, working closely with Product, Engineering, Commercial and Finance to ship improvements that unlock volume, reduce friction, and increase margin.

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Manager - WISE Platform
jobs.description:
THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Senior Product Analytics Manager [AL2] to lead analytics for our Online Platforms vertical. You’ll be at the centre of one of Wise Platform’s biggest growth opportunities, working with product, engineering, operations and commercial leaders to shape our product and go-to-market strategy. As part of the vertical leadership team, you’ll shape its priorities, building conviction through your insights and analysis and drive cross-functional stakeholders to action.

This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role in a fast-scaling “start-up within a scale-up” environment. You’ll turn ambiguous problems into structured analysis, insights into compelling narratives and opportunities into high-conviction product bets.

The role will require you to be hands-on and develop a deep understanding of our products, partners and opportunity areas. You’ll own the verticals performance and be willing to get your hands dirty, helping analysts and cross-functional partners to work through some of the most complex and ambiguous problem areas.

You’ll manage a team from day one, while building and scaling a high-performing product analytics function for the vertical. You’ll set a clear analytics vision and roadmap, develop analysts and establish the data, metrics and ways of working needed to support the vertical as it grows.

You’ll help us answer questions such as:
• Where are our biggest product, growth and commercial opportunities?
• Who should we be building and selling our products and solutions for?
• What products should we build or improve to unlock growth?
• How can we reduce time to revenue and ensure partners scale effectively?
• Where is friction occurring across the onboarding and transaction lifecycle, and how should we address it?
• How should we position and prioritise our products to create the greatest long-term impact?
• How should we structure and resource our teams?

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING
• Own the vertical’s growth and performance end-to-end. You’ll define and proactively manage the vertical and sub-teams’ KPIs and metrics suite, ensuring there is a clear understanding of product performance. You’ll identify root causes, undertake deep dives and work with counterparts to turn your insights into actionable recommendations.
• Lead product discovery, market and opportunity sizing for product initiatives, understanding their short- and long-term impact against our KPIs. You’ll use this work to shape strategy, prioritise opportunities and influence product and commercial roadmaps.
• Build and scale a high-performing product analytics function as the vertical grows, setting its vision, priorities, operating model and ways of working. You’ll also build the analytics foundations needed to scale, including reliable data models, clear metric definitions and effective self-serve reporting.
• Lead, coach and develop a team of product analysts from day one, creating a high bar for analytical quality, commercial thinking and impact.
• Partner with product, engineering, operations and commercial leadership to turn complex analysis into compelling narratives and clear recommendations, influencing senior stakeholders and driving cross-functional teams to action.

jobs.title: Staff Content Designer — Grow Squad (12m FTC)
jobs.description:
How should global money work? How do you take a complex, stressful experience and make it simple, calming even? How do you challenge the way it’s always been done? How do you collaborate in a human-centred way to ship work you’re truly proud of?

These are just a few of the challenges a Staff Content Designer will work on as part of Wise’s global mission to build an open, fair, and human financial system. Right now we move £6 billion every month for over 12 million people. But we're only 2% done — because people without borders deserve money without borders.

What you’ll be doing:

You’ll be working with the cross-functional teams that make up Grow — a squad that’s rethinking how people can earn a return on all of their money, no matter the currency, goal or risk appetite. 

In this role, you’ll focus on enabling Wise customers to earn a return on their money. You’ll invest time in deeply understanding our customers and their needs, so that you can design and deliver experiences that make complex processes like choosing an investment product, understanding gains or paying tax easy and effortless. You’ll build systems that help the squad bring the product to new markets, balancing a global vision with local nuance.

You'll also be part of the Content Guild, and will regularly collaborate with the content community across Wise.

Here’s how you’ll contribute:
• Get to know our customers, building empathy and a deep understanding of their needs
• Use your expertise to discover, design and deliver simple, beautifully crafted, intuitive experiences that customers love
• Influence teams and stakeholders to increase customer-centeredness, creativity, and content quality across the squad
• Work with designers from other squads to build a single, seamless experience for customers

 

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Deliver impact and ship work you’re proud of
• Own content projects from end-to-end
• Elevate content quality — defining what good looks like in the squad, then helping deliver it
• Be part of a positive change in the world. We’re fixing a broken, greedy system, and putting people and businesses in control of their money

About you:
• You’re an accomplished Staff Content Designer with extensive experience shipping world-class consumer products
• You’re comfortable navigating complexity and ambiguity — and can successfully collaborate in this environment
• You have an eye for quality. You know how to deliver it yourself, and how to support other designers to do the same
• You’re influential, inspiring, and able to work with others in a culture that values autonomy and empowerment
• You’re highly empathetic, both to customers and the people you work with
• You’re a trusted partner who builds effective relationships with your peers across the business

 

Heads up, this probably isn’t for you if:
• Your experience is mostly in marketing content, advertising, copywriting, journalism or social media — and you have no hands-on experience of content design or working in UX

 

We’re people without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We want to work with the best people, no matter their background. So if you’re passionate about learning new things and keen to join our mission, you’ll fit right in. And because we believe that diverse teams build better products, we’d especially love to hear from you if you’re from an under-represented demographic.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - API Experience & Security - WISE Platform
jobs.description:
Your customers are the developers, security teams, and operational teams at our partners. Companies like Morgan Stanley, N26 and Ramp rely on Wise Platform APIs to run critical payments journeys in production. It’s your job to ensure they can connect securely, operate reliably, and troubleshoot issues quickly — without needing manual support.

As the Senior Product Manager for API Tooling, you will own the roadmap and execution for the API access, security and webhook infrastructure and tooling of Wise Platform API integrations. You’ll focus on reducing partner-impacting incidents (especially auth- and webhook-related), improving observability and self-serve troubleshooting, and modernising the auth and security foundations so the platform can scale safely over the next few years. You will partner and work closely with the Security, Account Access and Wise Platform teams to build API solutions suitable for our enterprise partnerships.

Your mission: Make Wise Platform integrations secure-by-default and reliable in production, with self-serve operational API visibility that reduces failures and support load.

What you’ll be working on
• Own the Wise Platform partner API access, webhook service and WP API security offering, making it easy for developers to securely connect and troubleshoot our APIs.
• Design in partnership with the Security team, credential management, authentication strategies, and secure connection protocols that balance security with developer experience.
• Build and improve webhook reliability, observability, and usability.
• Deliver API and webhook logs and diagnostics tooling that helps partners and internal teams investigate and recover from issues faster.
• Ensure the auth and security infrastructure of Wise Platform is robust and scalable for the long term service demands.

In this role, you will;

Own the roadmap
• Define and execute a roadmap centred on secure access, reliability, and operational excellence in production.

Drive execution
• Work closely with engineering to ship improvements that measurably reduce incidents, support load, and time-to-resolution.
• Make pragmatic trade-offs between scope, security, reliability, and delivery speed.

Collaborate cross-functionally

Measure and iterate

Deliver impact
• Deliver measurable reductions in partner-impacting incidents, improved troubleshooting speed, and stronger security posture that supports enterprise adoption.

jobs.title: Staff Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About the Role

At Wise, our Staff Analyst is one of our most senior individual contributor roles in Analytics.

A Staff-level Analyst at Wise is a senior IC who defines and owns the analytical direction for a broad problem space or domain — identifying the right problems to solve, shaping priorities and ways of working, setting the measurement approach, building scalable solutions, and influencing senior stakeholders to drive outcomes across multiple teams.

You'll work closely with teams and leaders across Wise, including Product, Engineering, Operations and other business functions. Rather than being focused on a single team or squad, your impact will span a broader domain, helping to connect priorities, identify opportunities and improve how we use data to make decisions.

You'll connect the dots across teams, identify where approaches are fragmented, and help create more consistent and scalable ways of working, measuring performance and solving problems.

This is a role for someone who can be both a best-in-class technical leader and a strong hands-on deliverer — setting direction and standards while still getting deep into the work when needed.

What you'll do
• Own and shape the analytical direction for a broad problem space or domain, with impact extending across multiple teams.
• Identify the highest-value problems to solve and help set priorities across that space, connecting analytical work to wider business goals.
• Partner with teams across Product, Engineering, Operations and other business functions to influence strategy, priorities, decision-making and ways of working.
• Connect the dots across teams, spotting where similar problems are being solved differently and helping unify approaches where it creates value.
• Partner with senior cross-functional stakeholders to challenge assumptions, create alignment and influence direction.
• Lead large, complex analytical initiatives from problem definition through to measurable business or customer impact.
• Design strong measurement, experimentation and performance frameworks that help teams understand outcomes and make better decisions.
• Build scalable data solutions, frameworks and analytical approaches that can be reused across teams and domains.
• Champion technical excellence across SQL, data modelling and analytical engineering.
• Mentor other Analysts and raise the technical and analytical bar across Wise.

What you'll bring
• Strategic thinking — you can own a broad problem space, identify what matters most and connect analytical work to wider company goals.
• Best-in-class technical capability — expert SQL, strong data modelling skills and a track record of personally delivering complex analytical work.
• Cross-functional partnership — you've worked closely with teams across different functions, helping shape direction and decisions rather than operating as a downstream reporting function.
• Cross-team thinking — you naturally spot connections between teams, identify duplication or inconsistency, and create approaches that scale beyond a single team or function.
• Senior stakeholder influence — you're comfortable working with senior leaders, challenging constructively and shaping how teams make decisions.
• High autonomy — you create clarity where there is ambiguity, proactively identify opportunities and don't need a neatly defined problem handed to you.
• Product, operational and business judgement — you understand the trade-offs behind the numbers and focus on customer and business impact, not just analysis.
• Experimentation and measurement expertise — you can define hypotheses, success metrics and robust ways to measure outcomes, adapting your approach to different types of problems and domains.
• Technical leadership without people management — you lead through expertise, standards, frameworks, mentoring and the quality of your own delivery.

jobs.title: Internal Audit Senior Specialist

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer II  - Real Time Data Engineering- Java
jobs.description:
We are looking for a passionate Senior Data Engineer II to join our Treasury Global Liquidity team. In this role, you will help design and build the foundations of our real-time liquidity observability stack and core streaming data pipelines that power global financial operations at Wise.

You will be responsible for delivering key infrastructure initiatives, setting the technical streaming strategyand building robust, scalable systems that handle high-velocity financial movement with zero room for error. You will have a direct and measurable impact across multiple Wise products by enabling dynamic, real-time capital positioning as one of the founding engineers of a high-visibility team, laying the groundwork today and scaling the full engineering capability over the next year.

At Wise, we operate in autonomous, cross-functional teams. You will work in a highly collaborative environment, partnering closely with Product Managers, Data Scientists, Quantitative Analysts, and Treasury Ops.

Engineering at Wise is founded on clear communication, healthy debate to reach technical clarity, and a deep consciousness of system edge cases and failure modes before code hits production.

What will you be working on?

You will transform the financial engineering impact by pioneering our real-time Liquidity Attribution Model (LAM)! You will architect high-throughput Kafka and Flink streaming pipelines that continuously process global bank transactions, dynamically balancing demand against supply intraday. 

This is an opportunity to architect low-latency streaming pipelines that deliver instant, global liquidity visibility across every currency, jurisdiction, and nostro account. 

You'll build the high-octane engine behind our cash positioning, routing high-value transactions instantaneously with fine-grained event controls, fueling ML forecasting models to maximize yield on surplus capital, and bulletproofing our event architecture against out-of-order spikes, network partitions, and schema shifts.

You will also master a cutting-edge Medallion architecture and pairing streaming pipelines with sub-second OLAP querying, empowering Treasury Ops with instant, precise visibility into unencumbered liquidity redefining how global treasury operates at scale long before end-of-day.

The squad operates with high ownership and low ego, thriving on clear, actionable communication that bridges the gap between complex streaming architecture and real-world Treasury impact. 

Navigating high-stakes trade-offs across latency, financial cost, regulatory boundaries, and customer experience is second nature to us. This will give you the opportunity to proactively chase clarity using collaborative RFCs, whiteboard sessions, and direct stakeholder loops to solve ambiguity before it hits production. 

Above all, we lead by example: writing well-tested, maintainable code, rigorous design reviews, and constantly raising the engineering bar together.

jobs.title: Front Office Associate

• A true people person with a passion for exceptional service, as well as a positive, energetic, and solution-oriented approach to work.
• Tech-savvy, especially with tools like Google Sheets, Slides, and Docs.
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both in person and via written channels (email, internal comms, etc.).

 

What’s in it for you
• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.

• Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
• Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
• Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
• Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
• Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
• Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

 .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

 

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

jobs.title: Manager, Technical Recruiting (Engineering)
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Recruiting at Brex

Recruiting is where every career at Brex begins. We’re the first point of connection for future builders and leaders, helping candidates see what’s possible. We partner with leaders across the company to find exceptional talent and build high-performing teams. We move quickly, think strategically, and take pride in creating a thoughtful, welcoming candidate experience from the very first contact. We don’t just fill roles, we shape the culture at Brex, finding the next generation of builders and leaders.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for a Technical Recruiting Manager to lead a team of technical recruiters and sourcers supporting Engineering at Brex. You’ll own hiring strategy and delivery for a defined set of Engineering teams, partner directly with Engineering leaders, and coach your team to hit pipeline, quality, and candidate experience goals.

This is a player-coach-ready people leadership role: your primary job is building and developing a high-performing team, with the judgment to step into searches that need senior attention. You’ll report to the Director of Technical Recruiting and work closely with Engineering leadership, People Business Partners, Recruiting Operations, Compensation, and Finance as we grow in a post-acquisition environment as part of Capital One.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Lead, coach, and develop a team of Technical Recruiters and Sourcers hiring across Engineering
• Own recruiting delivery for your Engineering teams: pipeline quality, conversion rates, time-to-fill, and candidate experience
• Partner with Engineering managers and directors to translate hiring plans into sourcing, assessment, and closing strategies
• Run weekly pipeline reviews and surface risks, trade-offs, and recommendations to the Director of Technical Recruiting and Engineering leadership
• Drive consistency in interviewer calibration, debriefs, and offer strategy across your team
• Give direct, timely feedback and run effective 1:1s, career conversations, and performance cycles
• Onboard and enable new recruiters and sourcers; raise the craft of the team
• Partner with Recruiting Operations, Compensation, and Finance on headcount planning, tooling, and capacity
• Use data to diagnose funnel problems and drive process improvements

Requirements
• 5+ years of technical recruiting experience in high-growth or venture-backed tech companies
• 1+ years of people management experience, or a proven track record leading recruiters as a team lead or senior IC
• Demonstrated experience hiring software engineers across multiple levels, including senior and staff-level roles
• Track record of developing recruiters through coaching and direct feedback
• Strong analytical instincts; comfortable reading pipeline data and translating it into action
• Experience as a trusted partner to Engineering managers and senior engineers
• Ability to operate with autonomy and handle ambiguity in a fast-moving, evolving org

Bonus Points
• Experience hiring in multiple geographies, including Brazil or other international hubs
• Experience hiring for AI/ML, Infrastructure, Platform, or Security roles
• Experience navigating recruiting through an acquisition or org integration

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Recruiting at Brex

Recruiting is where every career at Brex begins. We are the first point of connection for future builders and leaders, helping candidates see what is possible. We partner with leaders across the company to find exceptional talent and build high-performing teams. We move quickly, think strategically, and take pride in a thoughtful, welcoming candidate experience from the first contact. We shape the culture at Brex by hiring the designers who define how our products look, feel and function.

What you'll do

Partner with product leaders to understand team needs and role requirements, and keep hiring goals aligned for Product roles. Source, engage and assess strong product talent through multiple channels, supporting the recruitment lifecycle from outreach to onboarding. Build pipelines for current openings and for upcoming hiring needs, with a focus on attracting diverse product talent. Track key hiring metrics, flag where candidates drop off, and help improve recruiting effectiveness. Work with the team to keep evaluation fair and consistent, and represent Brex in the product community, including events and social platforms.

Where you'll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work.

Responsibilities
• Lead sourcing and outreach for Product roles, using recruiting platforms, product communities and social networks.
• Screen profiles for product sense, strategy and execution, and cross-functional collaboration.
• Work with product leaders to calibrate the product bar and hiring profile, with guidance from senior recruiters on strategy.
• Schedule and coordinate interviews, including profile reviews and product case exercises, for a high-quality candidate experience.
• Give hiring managers regular updates on pipeline health and progress.
• Keep candidate data accurate and up to date in recruiting systems and dashboards.
• Contribute ideas to improve recruiting processes, inclusive hiring and candidate experience.
• Help promote Brex's employer brand in the product community.

Requirements
• At least 2 years of experience recruiting or sourcing for technical roles ideally in-house, in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
• Solid sourcing skills and familiarity with AI tools, recruiting platforms and product talent networks.
• Ability to review product profiles and understand product sense and how product teams work, and willingness to learn more.
• Clear communication, relationship-building and stakeholder skills.
• Comfort with recruiting data: reads basic metrics and suggests improvements.
• Ability to manage several searches at once with guidance on priorities.

Bonus points
• Experience recruiting product managers across Product, Growth or Platform.
• Exposure to compensation and market data for product roles.
• Interest or experience in employer branding for the product community.
• Experience hiring across multiple geographies (US, Canada, LATAM).

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $126,550 - $158,200. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

Design and product talent markets reward recruiters who understand the craft: how to read a portfolio, how to talk about design process and product sense, and how to make a candidate feel the quality of the work before they join. We want a leader who brings that depth and can teach it to a team.

This is a people leadership role. Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Seattle office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Lead, coach, and develop a team of Technical Recruiters and Sourcers focused on Product Management and Design hiring
• Own hiring strategy and delivery for Product and Design: pipeline quality, conversion rates, time-to-fill, and candidate experience
• Partner with Product and Design leaders to translate hiring plans into sourcing, assessment, and closing strategies
• Shape how we assess design talent, including portfolio review, craft and case-study interviews, and calibration across design and product interviewers
• Build sourcing strategies for thin, high-bar markets, including senior Product Designers, Design Managers, Design Researchers, and Product leaders
• Maintain a clear view of pipeline health; surface risks and recommendations to the Director of Technical Recruiting and leadership
• Drive consistency in interview quality, debriefs, and offer strategy across your team
• Give direct, timely feedback and run effective 1:1s, career conversations, and performance cycles
• Partner with Recruiting Operations, Compensation, and Finance on headcount planning, tooling, and capacity modeling

Requirements
• 6+ years of recruiting experience in high-growth or venture-backed tech companies, including significant Design recruiting
• 2+ years of people management experience leading recruiting teams
• Demonstrated experience hiring Product Designers and Product Managers across levels, including senior, staff, and leadership roles
• Deep understanding of the design craft and portfolio-based assessment, and the credibility to advise Design leaders on process and bar
• Track record of developing recruiters through coaching and direct feedback
• Strong analytical instincts; comfortable reading pipeline data and translating it into action
• Experience as a strategic partner to Product and Design leadership
• Ability to operate with autonomy and handle ambiguity in a fast-moving, evolving org

Bonus Points
• Experience hiring Design Managers, Design Directors, or Head of Design roles
• Experience hiring for Design Research, Content Design, Brand, or Design Systems
• Experience hiring in fintech or B2B SaaS

Compensation

jobs.title: Embedded Engineer [Office of the CTO]
jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? Coinbase is building the future of finance for people, institutions and their agents, with one place to trade crypto, equities, derivatives and prediction markets, use stablecoins, and connect AI agents with clear controls. The bar is high and the pace is intense, and we like it that way. This isn’t a place for complacency. It’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits and do the best work of your career. If you’re ready to build the future of finance with a championship team who refuse to settle for “good enough,” you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for in-person working sessions

Coinbase's Compliance organization manages regulatory obligations across products, operations, and growth — spanning transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, regulatory change management, and exam readiness across 60+ global entities. This role sits directly inside the Office of the CTO, embedded as a founding engineer within Compliance. You'll identify high-value workflow opportunities, rapidly prototype solutions using Coinbase's existing AI platform, and drive measurable adoption of AI tooling across the Compliance org. You'll be the connective tissue between Compliance stakeholders and the engineering teams who maintain Coinbase's AI platform, acting as advocate, translator, and builder in one.

What you'll do:
• Embed with Compliance leadership and frontline teams to surface the automation opportunities with the greatest business leverage — developing ground-level understanding of workflows like transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, regulatory change management, and exam preparation.
• Prototype quickly and pragmatically using Coinbase's existing AI platform as the default foundation before recommending net-new builds.
• Own the Compliance automation roadmap in partnership with the Chief Compliance Officer and Compliance leadership, translating complex regulatory workflows — case resolution, trade surveillance, risk assessment, policy management — into engineering requirements and engineering constraints back to stakeholders clearly.
• Define the build-vs-buy strategy for Compliance tooling, evaluating what Coinbase should build internally, adopt from partner teams, procure from vendors, or retire.
• Ensure every automated compliance output is traceable, reviewable, and defensible to regulators — with auditability, approval gates, evidence retention, and human-in-the-loop controls as first-class design concerns, not afterthoughts.
• Drive adoption through brown-bags, prototype walkthroughs, and feedback loops that bring Compliance teams along on the journey and ensure tools actually get used.

Required Skills and

Experience:
• 5+ years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated ability to ship production systems in ambiguous, stakeholder-heavy environments, with greenfield experience a strong plus.
• Hands-on experience deploying LLM-based applications, including prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, hallucination guardrails, and human-in-the-loop design for high-stakes compliance outputs.
• Proven ability to embed with non-technical domain experts, rapidly internalize complex workflows, and translate them into engineering requirements.
• Familiarity with compliance and regulatory systems concepts: transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, regulatory filing workflows, case management, and audit-ready data handling.
• Familiarity with multi-agent orchestration concepts including how agent systems handle handoffs, escalation, and auditability.
• Experience in a Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or embedded technical advisory capacity, ideally in compliance-tech, RegTech, or financial services environments.
• Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About The Team

The Service Stability Engineering Team envisions service stability as one of the core competitive strengths of the company's products. By building end-to-end, link-level risk management capabilities, the team aims to achieve sustainable automatic identification and analysis of stability risks, transforming from "reactive governance" to "proactive governance." This approach shifts more stability-related matters forward and addresses them early, preventing issues before they arise and enhancing user experience.

 

What You’ll Be Doing
• Oversee non-functional aspects of relevant business lines, closely collaborate with business units to ensure service stability.
• Based on data analysis, identify stability risks throughout the entire chain, detect unreasonable architectural designs in advance, uncover root causes of issues, and systematically address problems;
• Explore new technologies, tools, and architectural patterns, and promote the implementation of best practices in application architecture.

What We Look For In You
• Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field, with over 8 years of experience in development and architecture.
• Proficiency in Java, hands-on experience with the Spring Cloud microservices technology stack, solid computer science fundamentals, and a grasp of Linux, storage, and network I/O principles.
• Possess experience in high-concurrency distributed system architecture or high-concurrency scenario component design and development, with an understanding of Java concurrency libraries.
• Understanding of core Middleware technologies like Nginx, Redis, ElasticSearch, Kafka, MySQL, Docker and Kubernetes.
• In-depth understanding of the business architecture currently managed, along with a strong methodology for architectural design.
• Capable of rationalizing architectural designs for new business lines and providing targeted optimization suggestions.

Nice-To-Haves
• Proficiency in speaking, reading and writing in both English and Mandarin to collaborate effectively with global and cross-functional team members.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependents
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

About the Onchain Data Team

The Onchain Data team builds the core data and technology infrastructure behind OKX Web3. We connect to diverse blockchain networks and collect, process, govern, interpret, and serve large-scale onchain data, delivering accurate, real-time, and reliable capabilities to Wallet, DEX, Explorer, Risk, CeFi, and AI products.

Our scope includes, but is not limited to:
• Multi-chain data ingestion, parsing, computation, and unified data models;
• Data capabilities for onchain assets, transactions, addresses, tokens, contracts, and projects;
• Blockchain explorers, the Project Marketplace, Onchain Data APIs, bots, and agents;
• Labels, risk detection, risk-control data, and security investigation capabilities;
• DEX trending rankings, token scoring, and other onchain data products;
• Global multi-region deployment, high-availability architecture, performance optimization, and system reliability;
• Deep application of AI in engineering, data analysis, risk investigation, and intelligent operations.

You will work on challenges involving heterogeneous chains, large-scale data, real-time computation, high concurrency, high availability, data accuracy, and complex cross-functional collaboration. Your work can directly improve user experience, asset security, and business growth.

What You May Work On

This is a broad hiring track rather than a single fixed role. Your responsibilities will be matched to your strengths, experience, and interests, and may include one or more of the following:
• Design, build, and evolve onchain data infrastructure, data services, or business systems, taking ownership of the quality and outcomes of critical modules.

The Robinhood Crypto Product Compliance team supports Product teams in developing and launching crypto products and services in alignment with regulatory requirements. The team serves as the primary compliance partner for product initiatives, providing guidance on product design, customer communications, and operational processes related to crypto offerings. Team members work closely with Product, Legal, Risk, Marketing, and Operations teams to support compliant product launches and ongoing enhancements. This team plays a key role in helping Robinhood deliver crypto experiences that meet customer needs while maintaining strong regulatory standards!

As Crypto Product Compliance Lead, you will support the development and enhancement of Robinhood’s crypto products and services. You will lead initiatives responsible for reviewing product designs, customer communications, and operational processes to support compliance with applicable regulations and firm policies. The role includes advising teams throughout the product lifecycle, from ideation through launch and post-launch enhancements. You will also work closely with Product, Legal, Risk, and Operations partners to support regulatory reviews, examinations, and business initiatives related to crypto products.

This role is based in our New York, NY and Menlo Park, CA offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. 

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do
• Partner with Product teams and other business partners, including Legal, Risk, and Operations, during the design, testing, launch, and enhancement of crypto products and services.
• Advise on regulatory requirements and operational processes related to crypto products, including consumer protection, AML, sanctions, and financial crimes compliance considerations.
• Develop appropriate compliance framework for new products.
• Review product features, customer communications, and marketing materials to support compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and firm policies.
• Provide timely guidance to business partners on compliance questions, regulatory developments, and product-related issues.
• Support regulatory examinations, inquiries, filings, and internal compliance reviews, including developing and executing compliance testing and monitoring, related to Robinhood Crypto products.

• Passion for Robinhood’s mission to democratize finance for all and interest in crypto products and financial technology.
• 7+ years of experience in financial services, including experience supporting crypto products within compliance, risk, legal, audit, or operations functions.
• Experience with brokerage products.
• Awareness of anti-money laundering, sanctions, and financial crimes compliance requirements related to crypto products.
• Experience advising on consumer protection requirements.
• Experience advising on DeFi projects.
• Strong understanding of MiFID requirements is required.
• Ability to manage projects and coordinate work across technical and non-technical teams in a regulated environment.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills with experience presenting compliance guidance to business partners and leadership teams.
• Familiarity with global crypto regulatory frameworks, including MiCA, is a plus.
• Familiarity with traditional brokerage is a plus.
• Insatiable curiosity.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Exchange Platform
jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

Bitstamp made history in 2011 as the world’s first regulated crypto exchange. As a key part of the Robinhood family, the Exchange Platform team owns the full service lifecycle. We are the architects of a modern, high-velocity ecosystem that enables our global expansion, ensuring the world’s longest-running exchange remains unshakeable.

As a Staff Backend Engineer on the Exchange Platform team, you will define the technical vision, long-term architectural roadmap, and engineering standards for our platform modernization strategy. You will serve as a primary technical leader across the Bitstamp exchange ecosystem—architecting the next generation of cloud infrastructure for mission-critical, low-latency services, driving complex distributed systems integrations, and elevating the technical bar across Robinhood.

This role is based in our London office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. 

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

Requires participation in an on-call rotation to support business needs.

What you’ll do
• Architect Strategic Infrastructure: Define and drive the long-term architectural vision for high-availability, low-latency cloud platforms, setting engineering standards that ensure performance, reliability, and portability across our global ecosystem.
• Lead Modernization at Scale: Spearhead multi-quarter modernization initiatives, driving the transition of foundational services to resilient, containerized cloud environments while optimizing deployment pipelines and auto-scaling patterns.
• Direct High-Stakes Integrations: Lead the technical alignment and distributed architecture bridging Bitstamp’s exchange backend with Robinhood’s global infrastructure, solving complex cross-organization technical challenges.
• Eliminate Operational Toil Technical Debt: Anticipate future scalability bottlenecks and architect self-healing systems and intelligent automation that radically reduce operational load and boost developer velocity.
• Exercise Systemic Ownership: Take end-to-end accountability for ambiguous, high-impact technical initiatives—navigating complex trade-offs between speed, resilience, cost, and maintainability.
• Foster Technical Leadership Culture: Mentor and elevate senior engineers, lead architectural design reviews, and establish engineering best practices that raise the bar across the organization.
• Uphold Platform Resilience: Act as a senior escalation point for high-severity incidents, lead rigorous post-mortems, and institute systemic safeguards to ensure 24/7 unshakeable platform integrity.

What you bring
• Extensive Technical Leadership: 8+ years of relevant experience in backend and distributed systems engineering, with a proven track record of operating as a technical lead or Staff-level engineer in high-scale environments.
• Deep Cloud Container Mastery: Advanced architectural expertise with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and enterprise-scale AWS cloud services (EC2, ECS/EKS, Aurora, DynamoDB).
• Distributed Systems Low-Latency Acumen: Deep understanding of high-concurrency, low-latency backend architectures, event-driven systems, fault tolerance, and data consistency models.
• Strategic Autonomy Execution: Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous, organization-wide problems from inception to production, successfully delivering high-impact business outcomes.
• Cross-Functional Influence: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to build technical consensus, influence cross-functional roadmaps, and align senior engineering and product stakeholders across multiple geographies.
• Operational Excellence: A pragmatic, systems-thinking mindset that balances forward-looking architectural evolution with the operational realities of supporting a 24/7 financial exchange.

What we offer
• Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
• Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, and equity ownership
• Top tier benefits to fuel your work, including supplemental health insurance, ancillary insurance, and mental health support programs
• Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not

jobs.description:
Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

Role Summary:

We are looking for a talented and detail-oriented Sr Data Engineer to tackle data challenges. You will design, build, and maintain critical data pipelines and datasets, supporting areas like recruiting, compensation, talent management, and learning and development. Your work will enhance data accessibility and empower the People Team and business leaders to make informed decisions with high-quality, reliable data.

Key

Responsibilities:
• Develop and maintain robust data pipelines and datasets.
• Build foundational data products for key business areas.
• Enhance self-service data capabilities for the People Team.
• Ensure high standards in ETL/ELT operations, data quality, and pipeline reliability.

Join us to drive impactful change and support SoFi's mission of fostering a thriving workplace through data excellence.

What you’ll do:
• Design and build production dbt models in Snowflake that integrate Workday and other People systems into well-modeled, documented datasets, including slowly changing dimensions for People history.
• Build and operate Airflow DAGs that ingest People systems data and orchestrate dbt runs, keeping loads reliable and re-runnable.
• Own data quality and observability: dbt tests, freshness checks, row-count validation, and monitoring so issues are caught before stakeholders see them.
• Implement and maintain row-level security and access controls for People data, partnering with governance and security teams.
• Build and maintain semantic models and AI agents, held to the same modeling, access, and quality standards as our pipelines.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, such as other data engineers, people analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders, to translate requirements into production-ready deliverables, and communicate technical trade-offs to non-technical partners.
• Enforce data governance policies and practices to maintain data integrity, security, and compliance with relevant regulations.
• Mentor other engineers through code review, modeling standards, and technical guidance.

What you’ll need:
• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in data engineering and analytics technical strategy.
• Proficiency in data engineering tech stack: Python / SQL / dbt / Airflow / Gitlab .
• Proficiency in relational and cloud database platforms such as Snowflake, Redshift, or GCP
• Thorough knowledge of data modeling, database design, data architecture principles, data operations, and CI/CD.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capability to simplify complex issues into actionable plans.
• Experience with sensitive or regulated data and access controls.
• Experience with AI agents or LLM-assisted analytics, and with the HR / People function, is advantageous.
