jobs.title: Client Solutions Consultant - Engine by Starling
jobs.description:
At Engine by Starling, we are on a mission to find and work with leading banks all around the world who have the ambition to build rapid growth businesses, on our technology. 

Engine is Starling's software-as-a-service (SaaS) business, the technology that was built to power Starling, and two years ago we split out as a separate business. 

Starling has seen exceptional growth and success, and a large part of that is down to the fact that we have built our own modern technology from the ground up. This SaaS technology platform is now available to banks and financial institutions all around the world, enabling them to benefit from the innovative digital features, and efficient back-office processes that has helped achieve Starling's success.

As a company, everyone is expected to roll up their sleeves to help deliver great outcomes for our clients. We are an engineering-led company and we’re looking for people who will be excited by the potential for Engine’s technology to transform banking in different markets around the world. Our purpose is underpinned by five values: Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim For Greatness.

Hybrid Working

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Engine - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of one of our offices so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person.

Some travel (including international) may be necessary depending on the client and nature of the engagement.

About the role

As a Consultant within our Client Solutions team, you will act as a pivotal bridge between our global clients and Engine's cutting-edge SaaS platform. You will work closely with financial institutions to unpack their strategic challenges, helping them tackle complex hurdles through a technology-centred approach.

Collaborating in tandem with our Product and Engineering functions, you will design and implement robust, forward-looking solutions tailored to client needs, ensuring our partner banks unlock the full power of Engine’s modern banking technology.

In this role, you will be instrumental in guiding implementations from initial discovery through to go-live and operational handover. 

What you’ll get to do:
• Delivery Ownership: Take responsibility for delivering designated workstreams, actively representing the client’s priorities and operational needs during internal planning and decision-making forums.
• Client Relationship & Discovery: Build trusted, lasting relationships across all levels of client organisations. Understand their overarching vision, day-to-day challenges, and strategic priorities, applying your deep knowledge of the Engine product suite.
• Solution Design: Collaborate closely with our product teams and solution architects to design scalable solutions that meet the immediate requirements of the client whilst enhancing capabilities for future partners.
• Cross-Functional Coordination: Coordinate end-to-end solution delivery alongside our Engineering teams in alignment with overall programme timelines and key milestones.
• Progress & Visibility: Maintain clear reporting on workstream milestones, risks, and progress across internal and client stakeholders.
• Run Transition: Support smooth programme transitions from delivery into business-as-usual (Run), sharing in-depth client context and setting the Run team up for long-term operational success.
• Practice Scaling: Contribute actively to the growth and maturity of the wider Client Solutions function as Engine expands globally, sharing key learnings from implementations to help refine and establish our core delivery methodologies.

Read more about our SeniorClient Solutions Consultant, Cam Jarvis's, time here: https://enginebystarling.com/careers/product-consultant/
• You have experience (3-4 plus years) in client facing roles, in a consulting role, or at a technology company
• You have experience in financial services and technology delivery
• You have experience delivering complex programmes
• You can rapidly understand client problems and present solutions in a structured and informative manner

To succeed in this role, you will bring a balanced blend of hands-on delivery expertise and consultative engagement:
• Core Expertise: Demonstrated experience within Project Management and Product or Technology delivery environments (ideally across SaaS, fintech, or modern digital platforms).
• Analytical & Problem-Solving Capability: A structured, methodical approach to breaking down ambiguous or complex challenges, paired with an inquisitive mindset and a genuine appreciation for the detail of how systems function.
• Technical Curiosity: A strong technical aptitude and curiosity to understand modern software architecture and how technical components come together to create compelling customer propositions.
• Stakeholder Engagement: Adaptable and thoughtful communication skills, with the ability to build rapport and convey technical concepts clearly across diverse audiences—from senior bank executives and consulting partners to software engineers.
• Facilitation

Skills:

Comfortable and engaging when facilitating discovery sessions, scoping workshops, and collaborative working groups.
• Autonomy & Drive: Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable operating with high degrees of autonomy in a fast-paced, scaling environment.
• Adaptable Mindset: Flexible and pragmatic in your approach to delivery, capable of pivoting between different client environments, methodologies, and project frameworks without losing attention to detail.

Interview process

Interviewing is a two way process and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you! Our interviews are conversational and we want to get the best from you, so come with questions and be curious. In general you can expect the below, following a chat with one of our Talent Team:
• First-stage interview a member of the Client Solutions team (45 minutes)
• Second, more in depth, interview to explore how you approach client discovery and solution structuring, with two members of the Client Solutions team (60 minutes)
• Final values & leadership conversation to discuss mutual fit and answer any remaining questions you have about Engine (45 minutes)
• 33 days holiday (including public holidays, which you can take when it works best for you)
• An extra day’s holiday for your birthday
• Annual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell up to five extra days off
• 16 hours paid volunteering time a year
• Salary sacrifice, company enhanced pension scheme
• Life insurance at 4x your salary & group income protection
• Private Medical Insurance with VitalityHealth including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and Peloton
• Generous family-friendly policies
• Incentives refer a friend scheme
• Perkbox membership giving access to retail discounts, a wellness platform for physical and mental health, and weekly free and boosted perks
• Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work, Salary Sacrificed Gym partnerships and Electric Vehicle (EV) leasing

You may be put off applying for a role because you don't tick every box. Forget that! While we can’t accommodate every flexible working request, we're always open to discussion. So, if you're excited about working with us, but aren’t sure if you're 100% there yet, get in touch anyway. We’re on a mission to radically reshape banking – and that starts with our brilliant team. Whatever came before, we’re proud to bring together people of all backgrounds and experiences who love working together to solve problems.

Engine by Starling is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster diversity & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment at Engine by Starling are considered without regard to race, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. 

When you provide us with this information, you are doing so at your own consent, with full knowledge that we will process this personal data in accordance with our Privacy Notice. By submitting your application, you agree that Engine by Starling and Starling will collect your personal data for recruiting and related purposes. Our Privacy Notice explains what personal information we will process, where we will process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over our use of your personal information.

jobs.title: Regulatory Product Compliance Manager
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Regulatory Product Compliance and Risk Manager to support a rapidly expanding product in North America. This role will report to the Regulatory Product Compliance Lead and is responsible for supporting the team’s work to ensure Wise's US and Canada Regulatory Compliance program is best-in-class, meeting all regulatory obligations, effectively managing regulatory compliance risk, and scaling to enable continued growth.

 

This is a unique opportunity to directly impact Wise’s mission, whilst developing your skills in a fast-paced environment. You will cut through complexity to make high-stakes decisions, build momentum across multiple teams, and coach others to deliver exceptional results. 

 

Job

Responsibilities:
• Collaborate with product managers and engineers to develop new products and features for NorthAmerica, and ensure an effective risk assessment considering all regulatory compliance risks are adequately reviewed and assessed prior to launch
• Working knowledge with either state money transmission licensing requirements related to Permissible Investments, Regulatory Reporting; 

Or Consumer Compliance Regulations (e.g. Regulation E, UDAAP, California Consumer Protection Act), Privacy (GLBA), and applicable state privacy and consumer protection regulations.
• Support the issue management process by updating status of issues and developing action plans for closure, and ensure that all artifacts are properly retained to evidence closure.

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Manager - Treasury
jobs.description:
We're looking for an Implementation Manager to join our fast-growing Finance & Treasury Product team in London or Tallinn. This is a unique opportunity to have an impact on Wise's mission by making sure our customers' money stays safe as we launch new products and expand into new markets.

Your mission

Wise customers trust us to keep their money safe. Safeguarding is how we make sure that every penny we hold for customers is protected, in every country we operate in.

Today we run safeguarding across 11 legal entities and client asset protection (CASS) across
6. That means more than 500 bank accounts in scope, 5+ external audits a year, regular internal audit and regulator reviews, and several new legal entities launching every year.

As Wise grows, so does our Safeguarding team. Our global team builds and runs the automated controls and tools that every entity relies on, while regional teams own what happens locally. As the Implementation Manager, you'll connect the two. You'll make sure new products and entities are onboarded into our controls properly, and that incidents are handled quickly and transparently.

You'll work closely with the Safeguarding Product Manager, Safeguarding Engineering and Analytics, Treasury and Regulatory Product Compliance, Finance, Payment and Treasury Operations, and regional controllers around the world.

 

How you'll contribute to our mission

New product reviews, onboarding and approval

- Run the safeguarding review and approval process for new products and product changes, making sure every step is followed and nothing launches without the right controls in place.

- Follow up with product teams, Treasury Regulatory Product Compliance and Finance to keep projects moving.

- Keep a clear, up-to-date tracker of projects that need safeguarding support, and report on their status.

 

New entity launches

- Support new legal entities as they launch, working out how they'll be onboarded into our global systems and controls.

- Define how controls need to be set up locally for each entity, for example safeguarding timings.

- Work with Regional Finance and Compliance so that local controllers are ready to take ownership from day one.

 

Execution and implementation

- Plan and lead the work to integrate new Wise products into our safeguarding systems, together with product managers, engineers, data analysts and operations specialists.

- Own large, complex integrations from start to finish, and support the team with clear documentation: requirements, project plans, resourcing, testing and delivery.

 

Support

- Keep documentation of product flows and safeguarding calculations up to date.

- Get hands-on when things go wrong: help product and engineering teams understand the impact of an incident, drive it to resolution, and improve controls so it doesn't happen again.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Paid Search Manager (B2B)
jobs.description:
At Wise, we're on a mission to empower users to make smarter, more transparent financial decisions. We operate as a collective of autonomous teams, trusting and empowering everyone to take ownership and execute on the things that drive the greatest impact for our users.

The landscape of search is rapidly evolving, driven by generative AI, sophisticated machine learning, and a shift toward in-app discovery. We're looking for a highly strategic, data-driven Paid Search Manager to help us acquire net-new customers for Wise Business across multiple platforms, markets and languages. Your focus will be exclusively on B2B acquisition: helping new businesses and business owners discover Wise and sign up for a Wise Business account. You’ll bring at least 4 years of hands-on paid search experience and should be comfortable working with campaign data, identifying opportunities and turning insights into action. Experience in B2B or business-customer acquisition is highly preferred, alongside an understanding of how business needs, decision-making and conversion journeys can differ from those of personal customers. Working closely with other Paid Search specialists and cross-functional partners, you’ll contribute to the growth of Wise Business while developing your skills in managing increasingly complex, global campaigns.

You will own and shape our search strategy, integrating modern AI capabilities, maximising efficiency across all platforms, and empowering the wider team by sharing advanced insights and fostering a culture of shared learning.

What you’ll be doing: 

Search Strategy & Execution
• Manage and optimise paid search campaigns focused on acquiring net-new Wise Business customers and driving efficient business account sign-ups.
• Work across large-scale Google Ads and Microsoft Ads accounts covering multiple markets, languages and business customer segments, with the potential to expand to new engines and video platforms in the future
• Monitor campaign performance, identify trends and recommend practical actions to increase sign-ups and improve acquisition efficiency.
• Support campaign launches and expansion into new markets, business segments and search or discovery channels.
• Contribute to the overall Business strategy within the Paid Media team, from forecasting, to planning, to delivery
• Proactively looking for both tactical and strategic optimisation opportunities, and translating this into campaign delivery

AI and Automation
• Use platform automation and AI-powered features, such as automated bidding, Performance Max and AI Max, to improve B2B campaign performance and operational efficiency.
• Identify opportunities to make recurring campaign-management and reporting processes more efficient through automation, templates or improved ways of working.
• Stay informed about developments in search marketing, generative AI and the ways business customers discover and evaluate financial services.

Testing and the Business Customer Experience
• Support the end-to-end delivery of structured tests across ad copy, assets, targeting, bidding and landing pages.
• Develop clear hypotheses, monitor results and turn findings into actionable recommendations for business customer acquisition.
• Test messaging that responds to the different needs, challenges and motivations of businesses and business owners.
• Use search-term, campaign and customer-behaviour insights to improve the relevance and clarity of Wise Business advertising.
• Work with colleagues across Marketing, Wise Business, Product and Analytics to help prospective business customers find the information and services most relevant to their needs.

Reporting and Analysis
• Maintain and improve campaign reports and dashboards, ensuring B2B acquisition performance is communicated clearly and accurately.
• Analyse campaign data to identify optimisation opportunities, emerging business-customer segments, risks and areas requiring further investigation.

 

Team Leadership & Collaboration
• Collaboration & Team Empowerment: Act as a key strategic partner and subject matter expert within the team. You will focus on empowering your colleagues by sharing advanced learnings, fostering collaborative problem-solving, and helping to establish strong communication and best-practice processes that elevate the entire team.
• Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead high-impact, cross-channel initiatives and projects - working closely with SEO, Product, Analyst and Paid Marketing teams - to drive holistic user growth and enhance the overall customer journey.

jobs.title: Group Regulatory Compliance Manager - Anti-Bribery & Corruption, Conflict of Interest, Gifts Hospitality & Entertainment
jobs.description:
Join Wise as a Compliance Manager, playing a pivotal role in shaping and executing our core compliance frameworks within a global, rapidly expanding Fintech. You'll be instrumental in ensuring Wisers globally adhere to regulatory requirements, ethical boundaries, and internal policy frameworks, directly contributing to our sustainable growth and mission of making money borderless. 

Reporting into the Group Regulatory Compliance Team, you will manage a global remit focusing on anti-bribery and corruption, donations, gifts and entertainment, third party due diligence, conflicts of interest, and other general compliance matters. We are looking for an entrepreneurial compliance professional who thrives building things from scratch, is adept at future-proofing programmes as we scale, and who is constantly identifying opportunities to enhance and streamline processes. You will also be comfortable being flexible in your role and picking up work in other areas of the team where required. Work is busy and varied as Wise continues to progress its mission. We are therefore looking for a generalist compliance manager with Anti-Bribery and Corruption and Conflicts of Interest experience

Your Mission
• Policy & Core Ethics Framework Ownership: Design, implement, and maintain the global compliance frameworks for Anti-Bribery & Corruption (ABC), Gifts, Entertainment & Hospitality (GEH), and Conflicts of Interest, ensuring alignment with local regulations across all our operating jurisdictions, and the design of effective and robust controls. This will include having oversight of how teams across Wise implement processes to support the overall framework.
• Conflicts & Registry Management: Own the operational design and enforcement of our global registers, ensuring associated policies and standards are effectively socialised and embedded across the business.
• EWRA & Governance Reporting: Lead Wise’s Enterprise-Wide Risk Assessment where required. Prepare high-quality governance reports and Management Information (MI) for the Board and Senior Management, highlighting emerging trends and control effectiveness. Act as a trusted partner supporting local Compliance Officers, and other global compliance colleagues on critical cross-border projects and initiatives.
• Third-Party Risk & Due Diligence: Own the framework for vendor and partner compliance. Run robust compliance due diligence checks, review red flag reports regarding third parties and suppliers, and ensure risk-mitigation steps are executed seamlessly alongside Third Party Risk Management.
• Individual Accountability & Regulatory Conduct: Manage and scale Wise's alignment with global individual accountability regimes (e.g., mapping executive responsibilities, overseeing regulatory "Fit and Proper" assessment frameworks, and tracking conduct-related certifications across regional entities) where required.
• Policy Breach Investigations: Oversee the compliance investigation pathway for internal policy breaches, ensuring root-cause analysis is performed to prevent future operational gaps.
• Consumer Protection Frameworks: Provide group-wide compliance horizon scanning, testing, and monitoring against evolving global consumer protection legislation and payment transparency standards.
• Future-proofing, and automation: Actively look for opportunities to enhance, automate, and streamline our activities to replace manual compliance tracking with scalable, automation-first solutions.
• Cross-Functional Partnership & Culture: Partner dynamically with the People Team, Compliance Learning, Third Party Risk Management, and other key internal stakeholders to drive and embed compliance initiatives globally. Support the drafting and delivery of clear, highly engaging Ethics & Compliance presentations across the business.

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Build from scratch: You are energised by picking up projects that are work in progress - even blank. You can take ambiguous concepts and engineer clean, robust, and scalable operational workflows from day one. You will build frameworks and processes that are future-proof and scalable.
• Champion a data-driven approach to ethics and conduct risk management, simplifying complex multi-jurisdictional obligations and eliminating operational bottlenecks.
• Drive international impact by collaborating with compliance officer networks across North America, APAC, and Europe to harmonise core ethics standards.
• Inspire and influence stakeholders with clear communication, pragmatic advice, and a passion for creating a highly accountable corporate environment.
• Own project lifecycles end-to-end, building automated tech solutions to track registers, simplify disclosures, and track clear compliance metrics.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager – Financial Crime
jobs.description:
Your Mission:

In this role, you'll be working as part of the Europe and UK regional team. As a licensed institution serving millions of customers in Europe and the UK, preventing financial crime and misuse of Wise is of pivotal importance.

You'll own some of Europe & UK's highest-stakes financial crime controls end to end: from the regulatory requirement, to building the control, to the data that proves the control works. This isn't a policy role. You'll decide what to build, ship it with engineering, and be the person who can answer "is this control actually working?" with evidence.

The bar is high on both sides. A control that misses risk puts our licences at stake. A control that goes too far blocks honest customers and floods our operations teams. Your job is to find the version that does neither. More and more, that means rethinking a control with automation and AI instead of adding another manual step.

What You'll Own
• The roadmap for a set of KYC/CDD, EDD and ongoing controls across Europe and the UK, from discovery through launch and iteration
• Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) for your area. When one trends the wrong way, you find the root cause, ideate a solution and prioritise accordingly
• Turning regulation, audit findings and internal reviews into controls that measurably work, with clear success metrics, guardrails, monitoring and evidence
• Regional fit for global controls. You'll bring improvements from our Global Due Diligence and Financial Crime Prevention teams into Europe and the UK, and push back when the regional answer needs to be different
• Controls that require less manual review and reduce friction for legitimate customers, using AI and automation where they genuinely help
• Controls built into launches, not bolted on afterwards, so every new product or feature in Europe and the UK goes live with the right controls in place

This Role Will Give You the Opportunity to:
• Have a significant impact on the safety and security of Wise and its customers, and on our relationship with our regulators
• Take regulatory requirements and deliver controls that measurably work
• Work on problems where the stakes are real: our licences, our relationships with regulators, and millions of customers' access to their money
• Work where product, regulation and data meet, which few PM roles offer in this depth
• Build practical AI and automation into controls that have to stand up to regulatory scrutiny
• Work with a talented, diverse team to develop and implement innovative ways to prevent financial crime
• Make data-driven decisions about customers in scope of controls, how controls perform and where to invest next
• Influence and motivate a cross-functional team, fostering a culture of ownership, responsiveness, and excellence

jobs.title: Engineering Lead - Personal Onboarding Verification
jobs.description:
The team you will be joining: Personal Onboarding Verification

The Personal Onboarding Verification team is part of the Global KYC and Onboarding Squad. The team is responsible for KYC (Know Your Customer) compliance procedures that our customers go through before using our products. The team achieves this by building systems for identity verification in collaboration with data scientists, data analysts and third parties. Together we’re using computer vision, optical character recognition (OCR), biometrics & facial recognition, large-scale data analytics, and machine learning (ML) models.

Wise operates at global scale, onboarding millions of new customers each year in addition to supporting the needs of our large existing customer-base. Our products provide coverage across 160+ countries and over 40 currencies. The Personal Onboarding Verification team is at the centre of that, building systems that cut through the operational complexity of working under 70+ financial licenses while providing a frictionless onboarding experience wherever in the world our customers may be.

Having product-focused and forward-thinking engineers has allowed Wise to cater to the needs of customers unlike any other business. We already have a world-leading platform and product, but there is more to do.

Your mission:

As an Engineering Lead for Personal Onboarding Verification, you will:
• Lead, coach, and mentor a cross-functional team of engineers, supporting their growth and empowering them to do their best work.
• Be an active contributor to delivery. Support day-to-day execution, get hands-on when the team needs it, and stay in touch with the technology stack. You’ll lead by example.
• Work closely with the function leads in the team (Product, Design, Analytics, Data Science) and your team members to shape the roadmap, set the technical and product vision and ensure the team delivers on product goals in a robust and scalable way.
• Enable your team to succeed by ensuring they are well-resourced, can plan effectively, and are set up to commit to and deliver on their roadmap.
• Have a deep understanding of the tech and product of your teams - building out a clear tech strategy that follows from our product and marketing goals, setting high standards for quality, leading by example.
• Own the health and productivity of the team, fostering a culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.
• Collaborate with other engineering leads and teams across the Squad and other Wise teams to ensure your team’s work is aligned with the wider technical strategy.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Wise for Enterprise
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Compliance Manager/Assistant Manager
jobs.description:
We Are

YouTrip is the leading and fastest-growing multi-currency payment platform in Asia Pacific. In 2018, we pioneered the region's first multi-currency digital wallet. Now, YouTrip is the #1 multi-currency digital wallet trusted by millions across the region, processing over US$15 billion in total payment value annually. 

Our consumer and business propositions – YouTrip and YouBiz – empower individuals and businesses with inclusive, accessible, and affordable financial solutions. YouTrip has raised over US$110 million to date, including its recent Series B round led by global venture capital firm Lightspeed Venture Partners—underscoring strong investor confidence in its mission to transform digital financial services across the Asia Pacific. 

Recognised as World Economic Forum’s Global Innovator 2025, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies (2025, 2024), and LinkedIn’s Top Startup (2024, 2023), YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses.

Valuing an entrepreneurial culture of diversity and inclusion, we are seeking driven individuals to join our fast-growing regional team as we push the boundaries of innovative fintech solutions. 

You Will:
• Review and assist in the approval of high-risk onboarding cases in Singapore, including making well-documented, risk-based decisions and escalate where needed.
• Own and enhance the customer due diligence framework for both individual and corporate customers. This covers identity verification, beneficial ownership, source of funds/wealth, name screening and customer risk rating.
• Oversee name screening procedures for onboarding and on an ongoing basis.
• Work with Product and Engineering on potential system enhancements, including configuration and performance of the name screening function and watchlist management.
• Understand onboarding processes and controls at group level, while ensuring Head Office AML/CFT controls are aligned with local requirements.
• Guide and support onboarding and operations teams with clear, practical advice on case handling, escalation criteria and edge cases.
• Perform quality assurance and sampling on onboarding and screening decisions. Identify control gaps, recurring issues and training needs, and report on KYC and screening metrics and trends.
• Keep up with regulatory developments, enforcement trends and industry typologies, and turn them into updates to policies, procedures and risk-rating criteria.
• Support regional teams on onboarding and screening queries, process improvements and market-entry readiness where required.

You Are:
• An experienced KYC professional with 8–10 years in a KYC function for the Manager level (at least 7 years for Assistant Manager), including hands-on experience approving or reviewing high-risk onboarding cases
• Familiar with name screening systems and procedures, including alert review and disposition, match logic and list management
• Well-versed in CDD/EDD, beneficial ownership, sanctions and PEP screening, and customer risk-rating methodologies
• Sound in judgment, with the confidence to make and defend risk-based approval decisions
• A strong collaborator and communicator, able to work effectively across business, operations and compliance teams
• Adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity, keeping pace with changing processes and regulatory expectations
• Ideally experienced in supporting a head office, regional or group function across multiple jurisdictions
• Bonus points if you’re familiar with eKYC and digital onboarding, or have knowledge of transaction monitoring and ML/TF typologies across customer types

YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses. jobs.title: Director, Head of Private Equity
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Partnerships at Brex

The primary focus of the Partnerships team at Brex is to drive net new pipeline and revenue. We originate, launch, and scale partnerships across emerging distribution channels, embedded models, and other strategic bets that accelerate Brex's growth trajectory.

As Brex nears $1B in revenue, we are building a best-in-class Partnerships organization grounded in clear priorities and disciplined execution. Every member of our team directly contributes to top-line growth by expanding Brex's reach across key ecosystems, from technology platforms to financial sponsors who influence large customer networks.Within Business Development, the Private Equity Channel team is responsible for building partnerships with PE firms to drive new customer growth, generate pipeline, and increase engagement and monetization of existing customers.

Over the past 12 months, Brex's PE channel hit an inflection point, turning Tier 1 private equity firms into active referral sources for their portfolio companies due to demonstrable ROI. That model was proven through consistent in-market presence: dinners, conferences, events, and the trust that compounds across repeated value-added touchpoints. The channel is now at a critical scaling moment. With a proven playbook and a growing book of top-tier sponsor relationships, we are hiring a Director to take ownership of the entire PE channel — leading the team, sharpening the strategy, and raising the ceiling on what this channel can deliver.

What You'll Do

We are hiring a Director, Private Equity Channel to lead and scale Brex's PE partnerships organization. Based in New York, you will own the full PE channel strategy: setting direction, managing and growing the team, holding the most senior sponsor relationships, and driving the referral engine that turns PE firms into durable, high-conviction distribution partners for Brex.

This is a player-coach role for a senior operator who has both the relationship credibility to command a room with managing directors and the management instincts to build a team around them. You will inherit a functioning playbook and existing tier 1 partners, and your mandate is to manage these key relationships while building and scaling the team.

Where You'll Work

This role will be based in our New York City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Hire, develop, and manage a team of Partner Managers across East Coast, West Coast, and emerging PE geographies, setting the bar for performance and career growth
• Own the PE channel strategy end-to-end — target firm prioritization, coverage model, engagement motion, and referral conversion — and identify new growth vectors across geographies, firm tiers, and portfolio models
• Build the internal case for channel investment and headcount, presenting performance and roadmap to senior leadership
• Personally own and deepen relationships with the most strategic Tier 1 PE firms, serving as escalation point and executive sponsor across the team's book
• Represent Brex across the PE ecosystem at premier industry events, dinners, and conferences
• Partner with Marketing on field events and content, and with Sales leadership on handoffs and referral-to-close conversion
• Drive internal alignment with Finance, RevOps, and Partnerships on channel prioritization and metrics infrastructure during planning cycles

Requirements
• 8–12+ years of experience in PE business development, financial services sales, partnerships, or a related senior role with consistent, demonstrable exposure to the private equity ecosystem.
• 4+ years of people management experience; track record of hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing BD or sales talent.
• Established senior-level relationships within the New York private equity community; credible with managing directors and partners at leading PE firms from day one.
• Proven channel builder — experience standing up or significantly scaling a partnerships motion, not just maintaining one.
• Strong commercial instincts; able to connect PE relationship activity to pipeline generation, ARR outcomes, and executive-level narratives.
• Excellent written and verbal communication; executive-ready in both internal stakeholder management and external partner engagement.
• High organizational acumen — able to manage a team, a personal book of relationships, and strategic workstreams simultaneously without dropping quality.
• Based in New York; comfortable being in-market regularly for dinners, events, and partner engagements.
• Self-directed and entrepreneurial; able to operate with high autonomy while maintaining tight alignment with Partnerships leadership.

Compensation

The expected OTE range for this role is $316,400 - $395,500. The starting wage will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. The OTE figure listed here includes base salary and commissions, which may or may not be earned depending on performance. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.title: Director, Head of Private Equity
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Partnerships at Brex

The primary focus of the Partnerships team at Brex is to drive net new pipeline and revenue. We originate, launch, and scale partnerships across emerging distribution channels, embedded models, and other strategic bets that accelerate Brex's growth trajectory.

As Brex nears $1B in revenue, we are building a best-in-class Partnerships organization grounded in clear priorities and disciplined execution. Every member of our team directly contributes to top-line growth by expanding Brex's reach across key ecosystems, from technology platforms to financial sponsors who influence large customer networks.Within Business Development, the Private Equity Channel team is responsible for building partnerships with PE firms to drive new customer growth, generate pipeline, and increase engagement and monetization of existing customers.

Over the past 12 months, Brex's PE channel hit an inflection point, turning Tier 1 private equity firms into active referral sources for their portfolio companies due to demonstrable ROI. That model was proven through consistent in-market presence: dinners, conferences, events, and the trust that compounds across repeated value-added touchpoints. The channel is now at a critical scaling moment. With a proven playbook and a growing book of top-tier sponsor relationships, we are hiring a Director to take ownership of the entire PE channel — leading the team, sharpening the strategy, and raising the ceiling on what this channel can deliver.

What You'll Do

We are hiring a Director, Private Equity Channel to lead and scale Brex's PE partnerships organization. Based in New York, you will own the full PE channel strategy: setting direction, managing and growing the team, holding the most senior sponsor relationships, and driving the referral engine that turns PE firms into durable, high-conviction distribution partners for Brex.

This is a player-coach role for a senior operator who has both the relationship credibility to command a room with managing directors and the management instincts to build a team around them. You will inherit a functioning playbook and existing tier 1 partners, and your mandate is to manage these key relationships while building and scaling the team.

Where You'll Work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office, but would involve travel to our other hub locations. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Hire, develop, and manage a team of Partner Managers across East Coast, West Coast, and emerging PE geographies, setting the bar for performance and career growth
• Own the PE channel strategy end-to-end — target firm prioritization, coverage model, engagement motion, and referral conversion — and identify new growth vectors across geographies, firm tiers, and portfolio models
• Build the internal case for channel investment and headcount, presenting performance and roadmap to senior leadership
• Personally own and deepen relationships with the most strategic Tier 1 PE firms, serving as escalation point and executive sponsor across the team's book
• Represent Brex across the PE ecosystem at premier industry events, dinners, and conferences
• Partner with Marketing on field events and content, and with Sales leadership on handoffs and referral-to-close conversion
• Drive internal alignment with Finance, RevOps, and Partnerships on channel prioritization and metrics infrastructure during planning cycles

Requirements
• 8–12+ years of experience in PE business development, financial services sales, partnerships, or a related senior role with consistent, demonstrable exposure to the private equity ecosystem.
• 4+ years of people management experience; track record of hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing BD or sales talent.
• Established senior-level relationships within the New York private equity community; credible with managing directors and partners at leading PE firms from day one.
• Proven channel builder — experience standing up or significantly scaling a partnerships motion, not just maintaining one.
• Strong commercial instincts; able to connect PE relationship activity to pipeline generation, ARR outcomes, and executive-level narratives.
• Excellent written and verbal communication; executive-ready in both internal stakeholder management and external partner engagement.
• High organizational acumen — able to manage a team, a personal book of relationships, and strategic workstreams simultaneously without dropping quality.
• Based in New York; comfortable being in-market regularly for dinners, events, and partner engagements.
• Self-directed and entrepreneurial; able to operate with high autonomy while maintaining tight alignment with Partnerships leadership.

Compensation

The expected OTE range for this role is $316,400 - $395,500. The starting wage will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. The OTE figure listed here includes base salary and commissions, which may or may not be earned depending on performance. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Design at Brex

Design at Brex creates the experiences that make complex systems feel effortless through thoughtful, scalable design. Whether crafting interfaces, shaping product strategy, or harnessing AI to empower our users, we obsess over quality and clarity. This is a team for designers who want to build, not just talk about building. We ship constantly, use AI to move faster, and care deeply about craft. Product designers at Brex partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Data, and Go-to-Market teams to solve high-stakes problems for ambitious companies that rely on Brex to run their finances.

What you’ll do

As a Senior Product Designer, you’ll lead ambiguous, cross-functional product work from problem definition through shipped execution. You’ll turn complex financial workflows into clear, intuitive experiences that help customers move faster, make better decisions, and trust the systems they use every day.

You’ll be expected to operate with high ownership and low oversight: identifying what needs to be true, breaking ambiguity into actionable paths, facilitating alignment across partners, and shipping iteratively toward measurable customer and business outcomes. You’ll bring strong craft, product judgment, and systems thinking to the work — raising the quality of both the product experience and the way the team designs.

About the team

The Travel Expenses design team designs how employees spend, report, and get reimbursed, and how finance teams set and enforce the rules behind it. Our work covers travel booking, expense management, reimbursements, and the policy and compliance tools that sit underneath them.

Most of our customers don’t think about this software until something goes wrong: a receipt is missing, a reimbursement hasn’t arrived, a trip falls outside policy. Our job is to make those moments clear and quick for employees, and to give finance teams the control and visibility they need without adding work for everyone else. We’re also building AI agents that handle the manual parts of expenses and compliance, and we design how those agents behave, explain themselves, and recover when they’re wrong.

Responsibilities
• Own the design direction for a core area of travel and expenses and set a vision and roadmap for it with Product and Engineering.
• Take loosely defined problems and decide what needs to be true, what to build first, and what to leave out. Turn them into clear scope, milestones, and shippable increments.
• Define the underlying models (states, transitions, edge cases) before designing screens, so the product behaves consistently across surfaces, and bring those models to the other teams that depend on them.
• Plan, run, and synthesize your own research, and use customer feedback and data to make and validate design decisions.
• Design AI-assisted experiences, including how an agent asks for confirmation, explains what it did, and lets people fix mistakes.
• Partner with Product and Engineering as an equal on scope, sequencing, and tradeoffs. Raise risks early and keep design involved through build.
• Work across team boundaries on shared components, policy rules, and payment flows. Resolve conflicts before they reach engineering, and represent design in cross-team planning.
• Raise the quality bar for the team through critique, clear standards for content, color, and component states, and contributions to the design system.
• Mentor other designers through feedback, pairing, and sharing how you approach ambiguous problems.
• Present work and rationale clearly to leadership, partners, and customers, and document decisions so others can build on them.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco, Seattle, or New York City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work.

Requirements
• 6+ years of product design experience, with a track record of shipping end-to-end features in fast-paced product teams.
• Strong portfolio of shipped product work, ideally across complex workflows, systems, or customer-facing business software.
• Experience independently leading ambiguous product initiatives and turning loosely defined problems into clear, executable plans.
• Strong product thinking, including the ability to connect design decisions to customer needs, business goals, and measurable outcomes.
• High craft across UX, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, and systems thinking.
• Experience partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Data, and other cross-functional partners throughout the product development process.
• Ability to facilitate discussions, synthesize inputs, communicate tradeoffs, and build alignment across stakeholders.
• Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve and designers are expected to bias toward learning, iteration, and shipped impact.
• Clear communication, strong feedback habits, and a collaborative approach to improving both your own work and the work of others.

Bonus points
• Experience designing financial products, developer tools, enterprise software, or other complex B2B workflows.
• Experience using AI tools for prototyping, research synthesis, design exploration, or day-to-day workflow acceleration.
• Experience contributing to or evolving a design system at scale.
• Experience conducting or partnering on generative and evaluative research.
• Strong ability to translate complex product, technical, or business constraints into simple customer experiences.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $192,000 - $240,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.title: Prime Financing Trading Analyst
jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? Coinbase is building the future of finance for people, institutions and their agents, with one place to trade crypto, equities, derivatives and prediction markets, use stablecoins, and connect AI agents with clear controls. The bar is high and the pace is intense, and we like it that way. This isn’t a place for complacency. It’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits and do the best work of your career. If you’re ready to build the future of finance with a championship team who refuse to settle for “good enough,” you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for in-person working sessions

As a Prime Financing Trading Analyst on the Institutional Prime Finance team, you'll help manage and grow Coinbase's institutional financing book across lending, margin, and shorting products. This team is building a full-service prime brokerage platform that enables institutions to deploy trading strategies and achieve capital efficiency at scale. You'll trade day-to-day across the financing desk, optimize net interest margin, and work directly with hedge funds, ETF issuers, market makers, and corporates to deliver bespoke financing solutions.

What you'll do:
• Trade the financing book daily, managing long and short side liquidity across Prime Financing and CB Institutional products.
• Optimize net interest margin on principal borrow/lend activity through active position management and pricing adjustments.
• Support asset and client pricing for financing implementation across lending, margin, and shorting products.
• Engage directly with institutional clients, including hedge funds, ETF issuers, market makers, UHNW individuals, and corporates, to structure financing solutions.
• Build and refine custom client solutions that improve onboarding, internal processes, and overall client experience.

Required Skills and

Experience:
• 2+ years of experience in equity or fixed income financing, prime brokerage, or derivatives at a bank, broker-dealer, or crypto exchange.
• Proficiency in Python, SQL, or similar programming languages applied to trading analytics, pricing models, or data analysis.
• Demonstrated knowledge of fiat and crypto funding market fundamentals, including repo, securities lending, and margin financing mechanics.
• Proven ability to communicate clearly with institutional clients and internal stakeholders while managing competing priorities with urgency.
• Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

jobs.title: Senior and Staff Data Scientist - Credit and Lending ML
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States
jobs.description:
About a week before Hurricane Sandy made landfall, the two leading forecast models flatly disagreed: the American one carried the storm safely out into the Atlantic, the European one turned it hard left into New Jersey. The European model wasn't running a better simulation, it was running an ensemble. Hundreds of thousands of people were evacuated on the strength of the spread in forecast distribution, days before any single forecast could have justified moving them, and on October 29th, 2012, Sandy came ashore almost exactly where the models had put it.

At Mercury, we're building the future of financial infrastructure for startups and growing businesses. We're extending credit to those businesses, and we're doing it with proprietary access to some of the best data for understanding a borrower's business, from bank transactions to financial reporting to payroll. We're looking for a Senior/Staff Data Scientists to turn that record into a lending decision, partnering closely with Credit, Product, and Engineering.

In this role, you'll build and own the inference layer behind our small business lending program; you'll ship it into production with the monitoring and documentation that make it trustworthy; and you'll help Credit and Product decide what we should be lending in the first place.

Here Are Some Things You'll Do On The Job:
• Build and own the models behind our lending program - transaction classification, recurring inflow/outflow detection, annual revenue estimation, forecasting with seasonality, anomaly detection, and more
• Turn messy data streams - bank transactions, storefront sales, and more - into a defensible view of a business's health
• Deploy models into a production environment with observability, monitoring, and tests
• Partner with Credit on underwriting policy: what data is asked for, when follow-up information is worth the friction, and how to quantify uncertainty
• Partner with Product on the shape of the product: from principal sizes and pricing to repayment terms
• Assess where predictive modeling actually moves the underwriting program

"We may say most aptly that the Analytical Engine weaves algebraic patterns just as the Jacquard loom weaves flowers and leaves."

— Ada Lovelace, 1843

What Lovelace saw in the loom was the pattern — flowers and leaves, repeated faithfully, each one begun by a hand that chose it. Mercury is built from patterns too. Every component, every interaction our customers come to trust, starts with someone deciding how it should go, and making it good enough to be used again and again. Tending those patterns, and giving everyone at Mercury the means to weave with them, is the work of our Design System team, and the north star of this role.

As a Senior Frontend Engineer on the Design Systems team, you will build and care for those patterns: the components and foundations that everything else at Mercury is built on. Done well, a single decision here makes every product team faster.

The ground under that work is shifting, though. Software is being built in new ways, and AI is increasingly part of how design systems are made and used. We are looking for someone who is fluent at that intersection: deeply versed in design systems, and equally as serious about what it takes to build a system that holds up at the leading edge of AI.

As part of this role, you will:
• Build and maintain the components, patterns, and foundations (tokens, type, color, layout) that Mercury's product is woven from, holding a high bar for accessibility, performance, and pixel-level craft.
• Lead projects that ship new UI patterns to solve real pain points for product teams, helping them build better experiences faster.
• Develop a design system that's as ready for AI as it is for people, applying the technology to create leveraged outcomes.
• Invest in the design system's prototyping experience, shaping the next iteration of how our design function rapidly prototypes, iterates on the product, and explores new concepts.
• Raise the craft and AI fluency of the people around you, through mentorship and clear best practices.

We're looking for someone who cares about the foundational work that lets other people do their best work, and who's eager to help define what a design system means in a world where agents build alongside us. A successful candidate will likely have:
• 7+ years of frontend development, with deep experience in React, TypeScript, and modern web technologies.
• Experience building or maintaining a design system or shared component library.
• A thorough command of modern frontend tooling: build systems, CI/CD, and testing.
• High agency, and comfort creating clarity in ambiguous spaces. You take ownership and move without waiting for a defined path.

jobs.title: Business Development Assistant - Engine by Starling
jobs.description:
At Engine by Starling, we are on a mission to find and work with leading banks all around the world who have the ambition to build rapid growth businesses, on our technology. 

Engine is Starling's software-as-a-service (SaaS) business, the technology that was built to power Starling, and two years ago we split out as a separate business. 

Starling has seen exceptional growth and success, and a large part of that is down to the fact that we have built our own modern technology from the ground up. This SaaS technology platform is now available to banks and financial institutions all around the world, enabling them to benefit from the innovative digital features, and efficient back-office processes that has helped achieve Starling's success.

We draw upon our experience as knowledgeable bankers, and best in class technologists to become the chosen option for these banks, and preferred partners for leading consultancies.

As a company, everyone is expected to roll up their sleeves to help deliver great outcomes for our clients. We are an engineering-led company and we’re looking for someone who will be excited by the potential for Engine’s technology to transform banking in different markets around the world.

Hybrid Working

We have a hybrid approach to working here at Engine - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of our London office so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person. We don't like to mandate how much you visit the office and work from home, that's to be agreed upon between you and your line manager. 

Role Purpose

Supporting the Business Development team, the purpose of this role is to support the wider sales team on winning new business, co-ordinating day-to-day with other business functions in the formatting of sales bids and collateral and helping to manage Hubspot across a global team, reporting into the EMEA Regional Director. 

In this role, your time will primarily be split between supporting high-priority outcomes from the new sales process and managing day-to-day operations across HubSpot and internal communication channels

Key Accountabilities or Responsibilities
• Working alongside the sales team to help complete RFI, RFP and general bids
• Manage NDAs and other front of funnel work to support lead generation and new opportunities as and when they arise
• Assist with prioritisation of resourcing sales facing resources amongst the team working across the sales leadership function globally in relation to bid management.
• Lead as the point person for the set up of internal tools for commercial bids (Slack/Teams channels, team drives, asset libraries including the management of confidential client data)
• Assist with bids and formatting where needed of key sales documents
• Run and own the agenda and minutes of Regional sales meetings including the follow up on actions both directly and indirectly with clients or partners where appropriate
• Work closely with our reporting team on Hubspot and ensure there is a strong hygiene on data with regards to our internal sales processes and approval structures.
• Direct team onboarding, setting up tech access, equipment, & welcome guides for new joiners where appropriate
• Coordinating schedules, diaries and managing calendars for the regional managers and full team where needed in the support of workshops and discoveries including team offsites, client event, logistics, & group travel.

Behaviours & Competencies:
• Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
• Effective team player with the ability to step into sales situations under pressure
• An eye for quality with the ability to quickly identify gaps and own them
• Effective self-management, time-management skills

Skills:
• You will have deep experience of sales operations and systems with a preference for those who have Hubspot Academy skillsets.
• You have worked in a SaaS or software firm with 2-3 years experience of sales processes and supporting teams on end-to-end sales bids.
• Proficiency utilising common administrative systems
• Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.

Interview Process

Interviewing is a two way process and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you! Our interviews are conversational and we want to get the best from you, so come with questions and be curious. In general you can expect the below, following a chat with one of our Talent Team:
• 30 minutes with our EA to CEO
• 30 minutes with a team member from Sales
• 30 minutes with the MD for Europe

• 16 hours paid volunteering time a year
• Salary sacrifice, company enhanced pension scheme
• Life insurance at 4x your salary & group income protection
• Private Medical Insurance with VitalityHealth including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and Peloton
• Generous family-friendly policies

• Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work, Salary Sacrificed Gym partnerships and Electric Vehicle (EV) leasing

So, if you're excited about working with us, but aren’t sure if you're 100% there yet, get in touch anyway. We’re on a mission to radically reshape banking – and that starts with our brilliant team. Whatever came before, we’re proud to bring together people of all backgrounds and experiences who love working together to solve problems.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Fincrime Reporting
jobs.description:
When Wise’s investigation teams find suspicious activity, we have a legal obligation to report it to Financial Intelligence Units (FIUs) around the world — quickly, accurately and in the format each country requires. Case volumes keep growing as Wise expands into new products and countries, and every FIU has its own rules, formats and submission channels. Without technical leverage, reporting would only scale by adding more people — an expensive route that makes consistency and quality hard to maintain.

The FinCrime Reporting team is the interface between Wise’s FinCrime teams and external FIUs. When AML, Fraud or KYC investigators escalate a case, we determine where it must be reported, gather the right data from across Wise, generate a report that meets local requirements, submit it, and manage what happens next — including keeping funds frozen while law enforcement decides whether a transaction can go ahead. Our goal is to automate this end to end, so reports are faster, more accurate and fully auditable, and our operations specialists can focus on the cases that genuinely need human judgement.

Scope of Responsibilities

FinCrime Reporting is looking for a full-stack Product Engineer to help us build the systems and tools that turn financial crime investigations into high-quality suspicious activity reports. You’ll own components and medium-sized projects across back-end services and the back-office tools our specialists use every day, such as:
• The rules engine that decides which FIUs a case must be reported to, so more cases can skip manual review.
• Data pipelines that gather transactions, customer and case context, and calculate the figures in each report correctly and consistently.
• LLM-assisted narrative generation — including the input data, evaluation, hallucination checks and validation that make generated reports accurate and trustworthy.
• Back-office tools that help reporting specialists review, edit and approve reports quickly, with the right information in one place.
• Automated report submission to FIUs through APIs, SFTP, email and web portals.
• System controls for funds-freezing and other regulatory processes, with a complete audit trail.

What will you be doing?
• Design and build reliable, full-stack systems for suspicious activity reporting — from back-end services and data to the back-office interfaces our specialists use.
• Own your work end to end: design, implementation, deployment, and ongoing support in production.
• Partner with Product, Operations, Compliance and Data Analysts to understand how reporting works in practice, remove manual steps, and measure the impact of your work.
• Build automation and bring AI capabilities into production, with attention to correctness, evaluation, traceability, and appropriate human oversight.
• Write well-tested, maintainable code, and improve reliability, security, and technical quality through code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing.

Technologies you’ll work with

Our back-end stack is Java, Spring Boot, and Kafka, with SQL databases. Our back-office front end is built with React and TypeScript on Next.js. Services run in Docker containers on Kubernetes in AWS, and our LLM workflows run in Python on Wise’s internal AI platform. You’ll work with distributed services, asynchronous processing, and integrations with external government systems.

We design for scalability, observability, privacy, security, reliability, and cost.

jobs.title: Startup & VC Partnerships Manager
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Sales at Brex

The Sales team is the driving factor behind revenue for Brex and every member of our team directly affects our bottom line. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring new customers, and building even stronger relationships with our current customers. Our winning culture recognizes big team wins and celebrates individual accomplishments. We ensure that top performers are recognized and have built a competitive environment to motivate and unify the team

What you'll do

As a Startup VC Partnerships Manager, you'll be the face of Brex in the startup ecosystem. You'll build trusted relationships with top-tier VCs, accelerators, incubators, law firms, and high-growth founders, and turn those relationships into a steady stream of new customers.

The role has two sides that reinforce each other. On the community side, you'll represent Brex in the market by hosting events, driving engagement, and creating meaningful connections that bring real value to founders. On the partnerships side, you'll identify and cultivate partners from the ground up, build tailored go-to-market plans for each one, onboard them into the Brex ecosystem, and manage the relationship over time.

Success will be measured by your ability to bring in new startups, grow Brex's market share among top venture networks, develop new channel relationships, and deliver high-quality experiences that strengthen Brex's position in the startup space. If you have a track record of exceeding targets and a passion for building mutually beneficial relationships, this is a chance to make a significant impact in a fast-growing environment.

Where you'll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

Sales and pipeline
• Drive top-of-funnel customer acquisition for newly incorporated, Pre-seed through Series B companies through direct sales, strategic partnerships, relationship building, and high-impact community events
• Consistently hit targets by converting partner relationships into a steady stream of client referrals
• Serve as a product expert, articulating Brex's value proposition to partners and founders

Partnerships
• Identify, cultivate, and deepen relationships with high-potential VCs, accelerators, incubators, law firms, and other ecosystem partners
• Craft and implement tailored go-to-market strategies for each partner
• Facilitate smooth onboarding of new partners and their teams, and be the connective tissue between partners and the Brex ecosystem
• Conduct regular performance reviews with key partners and use the data to optimize each relationship

Community and brand
• Expand your existing network of top-tier founders and VCs who are eager to support your efforts
• Launch initiatives that bring founders and VCs together in meaningful and differentiated ways
• Be the respected brand and face of Brex for Startups. You are the flag bearer for Brex and everyone should know you in the market

Value add to founders
• Leverage your network, your colleagues' networks, and your skills to help founders on several fronts: accessing capital (debt and equity), sourcing talent for key roles, and connecting them with potential customers

Cross-functional and operations
• Work closely with marketing, growth, direct sales, underwriting, operations, finance, revenue operations, and product engineering to drive co-marketing opportunities, onboard new clients, and inform the product roadmap
• Maintain strong data hygiene in Salesforce and leverage tools such as Hex, Retool, Scratchpad, Botdog, Rings, Harmonic, Pitchbook and Nooks
• Use AI tools (Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, Granola, etc.) to work more efficiently

Requirements
• 2+ years of experience in venture capital, at a startup, or in a partnerships or closing sales role
• Established network within the startup ecosystem and proven experience working directly with VCs and founders
• Strong understanding of the venture community and how to drive partnerships within it
• Demonstrated track record of consistently hitting targets and quotas
• Experience building communities both virtually and in person, with a passion for events and activations with partners
• Ability to deliver tailored, consultative solutions that align with partners' needs and business goals
• Ability to evaluate partnership performance, identify areas for optimization, and implement data-driven solutions
• Proven ability to build trust and credibility with internal and external stakeholders
• Self-starter with strong leadership skills, intellectual curiosity, a collaborative mindset, high EQ, and a positive, winning attitude
• Thrives in a fast-paced, evolving startup environment

Compensation

The expected OTE range for this role is USD $135,600 - $169,500. The starting wage will depend on a number of factors including the candidate's location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. The OTE figure listed here includes base salary and commissions, which may or may not be earned depending on performance. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

About Fam (previously FamPay)

Fam is India’s first payments app for everyone above
11. FamApp helps make online and offline payments through UPI and FamCard. We are on a mission to raise a new, financially aware generation, and drive 250 million+ young users in India to kickstart their financial journey super early in their life.

We’re reimagining how the next generation experiences fintech—going beyond payments to build a lifestyle brand that blends money, identity, and everyday experiences into one seamless, intuitive journey.

Founded in 2019 by IIT Roorkee alumni, Fam is backed by some of the most respected investors around the world like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (Sequoia Capital) India, Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital and the likes of Kunal Shah, Amrish Rao as angel investors.

About the role :- 
At Fam, data plays a big role in how we build, improve and scale our products. We're looking for a Data Analyst who enjoys digging into data, asking the right questions and finding insights that others might miss. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Business and Finance teams, helping turn complex datasets into decisions that make a real impact. This is an opportunity to work on diverse problems, take ownership of your analysis, experiment with AI tools and help shape products used by millions of users. If you're curious, analytical and enjoy figuring things out, we'd love to have you on the team.
Must-haves
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics or another quantitative field.
3-5 years of experience in SQL skills with experience writing complex queries involving joins, CTEs and window functions.
Ability to independently extract, clean, structure and analyse large datasets.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for identifying trends and patterns.
Ability to interpret data and translate findings into meaningful business and product insights.
Understanding of key product and business metrics.
Comfortable using AI tools to improve analytical workflows, write and optimise queries, automate repetitive tasks and explore new ways of solving problems.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work with multiple stakeholders.
A proactive approach with the ability to take ownership of problems and drive them to closure.

Experience working in fintech, consumer internet or high-growth startups.
Familiarity with tools such as Metabase, Looker, Mixpanel or Amplitude.
Working knowledge of Python and Excel.
