Coinbase is building the future of finance for people, institutions and their agents, with one place to trade crypto, equities, derivatives and prediction markets, use stablecoins, and connect AI agents with clear controls. The bar is high and the pace is intense, and we like it that way. This isn’t a place for complacency. It’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits and do the best work of your career. If you’re ready to build the future of finance with a championship team who refuse to settle for “good enough,” you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for in-person working sessions

The Enterprise Architecture team turns business objectives into technology decisions across Coinbase's business systems including custom-developed, third-party applications, and agentic automations, partnering with business functions and engineering teams to buy, build, and scale software applications with a focus on design patterns, technical debt, and security. This Staff Enterprise Architect will own key Enterprise Engineering (EE) initiatives such as Technical Debt, Application Portfolio Management, Integration Keys Mechanism, and contribute to the Architecture Forum. 

What you’ll do:
• Provide leadership and expertise in the development, maintenance, and governance of enterprise architecture guidelines and design patterns to ensure the reliability and scalability of the application ecosystem.
• Develop and maintain technical roadmaps to guide the evolution of the application ecosystem from current to future states, aligning with strategic and business capability roadmaps.
• Drive application portfolio health programs focused on identifying, mitigating, and eliminating technical debt and security hardening where appropriate.
• Evaluate new applications and platforms to ensure alignment with the organization’s technology and governance strategies, policies, and standards from business, application, data, solution, and technology perspectives.
• Develop and maintain system diagrams that illustrate the relationship between business value, capabilities, and technology.
• Contribute to an Architecture Forum of architects and engineers, facilitating collaboration, debate, and education on acceptable design patterns and solutions.
• Lead the analysis and evaluation of leading and emerging technologies and market trends, assessing their impact and opportunities for the enterprise architecture, with a focus on digital capabilities and innovations to support business strategy.
• Work closely with solution architects to provide frameworks, guidelines, and best practices for implementing and configuring applications and database technologies.
• Contribute to large-scale, enterprise-wide transformation initiatives, overseeing technical aspects from current state assessments through delivery and execution.

 

Required Skills and

Experience:
• Experience in Enterprise Architecture: At least five (5) years of hands-on experience in Enterprise Architecture, with a proven track record of collaboration with domain, data, and security engineers, as well as solution architects.
• Expertise in Architecture Standards: Demonstrated ability to develop, document, and publish Enterprise Architecture guidelines and design patterns that align with organizational objectives.
• Cybersecurity: Proficient in security best practices including authentication, authorization, encryption, integration key management, and logging.
• Technical Debt Management: Significant experience in leading efforts to identify, monitor, and strategically reduce technical debt across the enterprise.
• OKRs Delivery with Architectural Impact: Strong background in setting and achieving Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) that have broad and lasting impacts on architectural decisions and outcomes.
• Team Collaboration and Leadership: History of working within high-performing teams, offering constructive feedback, and fostering an environment of continuous improvement.
• Escalation Management and Decision-Making: Skilled in handling complex escalations, effectively communicating trade-offs, and driving decisions to timely and successful resolutions.
• Effective Stakeholder Communication: Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex architectural concepts to a diverse range of stakeholders, including senior technical and business leaders, subject matter experts, peers, and technical delivery teams.

Nice to haves:
• Passion for Emerging Technologies: Strong enthusiasm for the crypto, blockchain, and NFT industries, with an understanding of their impact on the economy.
• Enterprise Platform

Experience:

Familiarity with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce.com, NetSuite, Anaplan, Workday, Contentful, or comparable systems, with the ability to leverage these tools effectively.
• Performance Optimization for High-Load Systems: Experience in designing or enhancing the performance of high-load customer service platforms, ensuring scalability and reliability.
• Quantitative Risk Modeling in Architecture: Experience in developing quantitative architecture risk models, including the measurement of technical debt and trade-offs using risk factors.
• Understanding of SDLC Methodologies: Knowledge of various Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) methodologies, including both Agile and non-Agile approaches.
• Systems-Level Programming Proficiency: Proficiency in at least one systems-level programming language, with Go being highly preferred.
• Frontend and Backend Development

Skills:

Familiarity with modern development frameworks and languages, including Go, React, JavaScript, TypeScript, and their related ecosystems.
• Data Management Expertise: Experience with SQL and modern data stores, such as Snowflake, for managing and querying large datasets.
• Salesforce Architecture Knowledge: Deep understanding of Salesforce (SFDC) architecture, including multi-org strategies and customization best practices.
• Proficiency with Development and Collaboration Tools: Strong proficiency in using Git, Confluence, Jira, LeanIX, or equivalent tools for version control, documentation, project management, and enterprise architecture.

2021. Join a Challenger

Together we have over $142 billion in combined assets under management and administration, with a clear mandate to drive change in Canadian banking to enrich people's lives. Our customers have named our EQ Bank digital platform (eqbank.ca) one of the top banks in Canada on the Forbes World's Best Banks list since 2021.

À titre d’analyste en fraude – Cartes, le titulaire du poste est responsable d’effectuer des analyses et des enquêtes afin de détecter, évaluer, traiter et signaler toute activité pouvant représenter un risque de fraude ou de criminalité financière.
 
La personne assure également la gestion des appels entrants et accompagne les clients dans le cadre des enquêtes en cours, en veillant à ce que les incidents potentiels soient adéquatement analysés, documentés, suivis et escaladés conformément aux procédures établies.
 
En tant qu’expert-conseil en matière de prévention de la fraude, le titulaire contribue à l’identification et à la réduction des risques criminels grâce à une approche rigoureuse, structurée et basée sur l’analyse de renseignements. The incumbent will manage inbound calls and assist clients to ensure potential threats and investigations are evaluated, documented, managed and escalated by following standard operating procedures. They will provide subject matter expertise and oversight of criminal risk by following a disciplined and intelligence-based approach to detection and research of activities and events in alignment with EQ Bank’s fraud program and standards to ensure compliance as well as support trending, analysis and insights generation.

jobs.title: Android Engineer
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.

 

📍 Barcelona, Spain | 💰 Base salary for this role is depending on experience + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits 
Hybrid model: 3 days a week in the office

 ⭐ Our Mobile Engineering team

 

Our mobile engineers have a variety of different backgrounds

There are ~60 Android engineers at Monzo and we’re looking for more to join the team. We have several non-graduates; only some of us studied Computer Science; some of us have worked in huge companies; some have only ever worked in startups; others are former consultants. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you.

 Monzo works in small, interdisciplinary teams

We have around 650 engineers out of roughly 5,500 people in total - and we have big ambitions. There are many interesting challenges ahead, and we're happy for people to move between teams or to specialise, whatever you prefer. As an engineer here you'd be able to work directly with anyone across the company, and we run regular knowledge-sharing sessions so you’ll learn heaps about everything from how banks work to effective communication.

 

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

We’re searching for product-focused Android engineers to evolve our native mobile app. You’ll take pride in building polished user experiences, and you’ll balance the need for well-tested resilient code with moving fast and iterating. 

You’ll be working on a product that is a part of day to day life for more than 11 million people already, and your work here will shape the way that people interact with their finances.

As an Android Engineer at Monzo you'll work in a small, autonomous product squad alongside iOS Engineers, Backend Engineers, User Researchers, Product Designers, Product Managers, QA Testers, and Data Scientists.

You and your team will be responsible for an overall company goal, rather than building a specific feature - you'll have the opportunity to have impact on both what we build, and how we build it. Mobile engineers at Monzo work on everything from the personal banking product to customer support tools. We also have a small mobile platform squad dedicated to enabling other engineers to move faster.

Every week we meet as an Android discipline to discuss tools, techniques, problems we're encountering across the company and work together to improve our codebase and processes.

You'll report to an engineering manager who will meet with you every 1-2 weeks 1:1. They’re dedicated to helping you grow and develop as an engineer.

Our Android app

Our app is 100% Kotlin, built using MVVM (Model View ViewModel) and Coordinators, and modularised by product feature.

We use RxJava, Retrofit and Moshi for API calls and Dagger for dependency injection. We’re starting to use Coroutines for most new features. Room is our choice for persistence, and we use repositories for interacting with data. We’ve built out our design system with Compose. 

We use GitHub Pull Requests to do code reviews, and write unit tests for our ViewModels, Coordinators, and any other classes which contain logic. We write tests for all of our Compose screens and snapshot test them with Happo. We also use Espresso to test flows, which are executed via our continuous integration system.

We’ve previously written about building Monzo Chat on Android, which goes into detail on some of these elements.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…
• You care about the impact your work has on our customers, and optimise for outcomes rather than the number of lines of code you output
• You’re excited about and have experience in programming in Kotlin
• You’ve shipped and iterated on at least one app in the Play Store
• You have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions
• You love turning excellent design into beautiful products
• You’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity
• You have an understanding computer science principles

We're on the look out for L30 Engineers at the moment, you can read more in our Engineering Progression Framework you will be interviewed across the whole framework, so if you're not sure what level you're aiming for chat to your recruiter! 

🙌 What’s in it for you:

💰Base salary range for this role is depending on experience + equity + stock options benefits 

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

📚 Learning budget of €1,200 a year for books, training courses and conferences

🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps

Our interview process involves three main stages:
• Initial Call
• Take home task or pair coding exercise
• Final interview including a system design and a behavioural interview 

This process should take around 2-3 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! 

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

There’s a detailed blog on the interview process, for extra details, hints and tips.

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. 

If you're successful in applying for this role, we'll work with you to find a start date. In some cases, there might be a delay in when you can be released from your current role so that we can make sure things continue to run smoothly. We’ll be sure to communicate this with you and keep you updated.

LI-JS1

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage.

jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.

 

📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰£79,000 - £93,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits

About the team:

Our Borrowing (lending) business is growing rapidly across both existing products and with the planned launch of new initiatives. As our lending portfolio grows, our second line of defence Credit Model Validation team is growing with it - and we’re looking for a Credit Model Validation Manager to join us!

Our Credit Model Validation team provides independent oversight and challenge to our model development teams in the first line of defence. We help Monzo grow safely and make sure the models we use are fit for purpose, appropriately governed and deliver good outcomes for our customers. You’ll join our validation squad and provide expert independent validation and oversight across a broad suite of credit models.

This is a generalist role rather than one focused on a particular model type. You’ll work across models used for impairment, capital, stress testing, forecasting and credit decisioning, including IFRS 9 PD, LGD, EAD and economic response models; decision science scorecards and origination PD models; and Net Present Value (NPV) / unit economics models.

Strong data and analytical skills are a must, as is broad expertise in credit risk modelling and model risk management. You’ll have hands-on experience in model validation and/or development within financial services, and be comfortable getting into the data and code to form an independent view across different model types.

Your day-to-day
• Leading hands-on independent validation across Monzo’s credit model portfolio - covering models used for IFRS 9 impairment, capital and stress testing, forecasting, credit decisioning and unit economics - and making sure they are fit for purpose, appropriately governed and performing as expected
• Reviewing and challenging key model-led credit risk assessments, including impairment adequacy, ICAAP and stress testing, using independent analysis to assess assumptions, limitations and impacts
• Developing a deep understanding of Monzo’s credit models and how they are used, and using this to provide impactful input and challenge to model developers and users
• Contributing to making model validation more consistent, scalable and technology-enabled - building reusable analytical tools and tests, experimenting with AI-assisted approaches and helping the team embed them safely
• Reviewing ongoing model performance monitoring to ensure our lending models perform within our risk thresholds, and providing support to our first line of defence teams when action is required
• Performing statistical analyses, model replication and challenger work where appropriate to test assumptions, assess performance and strengthen validation conclusions
• Improving and helping to embed our Model Risk Framework, including our policies, standards, model inventory, governance and validation approach. This means making sure we follow up-to-date regulatory expectations and that our processes remain proportionate and relevant as modelling techniques evolve
• Writing clear and impactful model validation reports, and presenting the findings and actions in relevant committees
• Partnering with colleagues in first line of defence credit strategy, modelling and finance teams - and with wider risk teams across Monzo - to support effective model governance and consistent validation standards across the organisation

You should apply if you:
• Have a strong background and practical experience in credit model development and/or validation across a range of model types. You’ll have meaningful experience with IFRS 9 impairment, Internal Ratings Based (IRB) or other capital models, alongside broader exposure to several areas such as stress testing, economic response, forecasting, decision science scorecards or NPV / unit economics modelling
• Understand model risk management in practice, including independent validation, model governance, ongoing monitoring, model change and issue management, and how regulatory expectations apply across the model lifecycle
• Are impact-driven and want to improve how validation is done, not only complete individual reviews. You can turn repeatable work into practical methods, tools or guidance that improve quality and consistency across the team.
• Are curious about AI and automation, and can assess where they add value, the risks they introduce, and the controls and human oversight needed. Experience with AI-assisted analytical or coding tools is useful, but not essential
• Are data driven, with strong analytical skills and deep knowledge of statistical techniques for credit and model risk. Strong SQL and Python skills are essential. You can produce clear, reusable and tested code, using collaborative practices such as version control, peer review and documentation. Experience with Tableau, Looker or similar is a plus.
• Can assess models in the context of how they are used - including accounting, capital, credit strategy, risk appetite and customer outcomes - and can distinguish technical model performance from the wider risks of relying on the model
• Have strong written and verbal communication skills, and are able to articulate problems and solutions using clear and simple language. This is particularly important for breaking down complex issues and priorities to non-experts
• Have a track record of building and maintaining trusting relationships with stakeholders at all levels, and can provide effective and respectful challenge

Our technology stack

We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies (note we do not expect applicants to have prior experience of all them):
• Google Cloud Platform for all of our analytics infrastructure
• dbt and BigQuery SQL for our data modelling and warehousing
• Python for data science and machine learning
• Go to write our application code
• AWS for most of our backend infrastructure

The interview process:

Our interview process usually involves up to four main stages via Google Meet:
• An initial call with our recruiter
• A call with our Senior Model Validation Manager, the hiring manager for the role
• A role-specific call with colleagues from our credit modelling and model risk teams. We’ll share a short case study in advance, but you won’t need to submit a written response; we’ll use it to guide the discussion during the interview.
• A behavioural interview
• 🙌 What’s in it for you
• 💰 £79,000 - £93,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance benefits.
• 📍 This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).
• ⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.
• 📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.
• 🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given MacBooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.
• ➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

We’ll close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage, so please apply as soon as you can - we don’t want you to miss out!

About our Data Discipline 

We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. Data is central to how we understand our customers, shape our products, manage risk and grow Monzo sustainably. We believe in empowering teams with high-quality, trusted data and self-serve analytics, while creating space for Data practitioners to focus on the highest-impact questions, opportunities and decisions.

Our Data Discipline is deeply embedded in Monzo’s product areas. Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, and Machine Learning Engineers work in cross-functional squads alongside Engineers, Designers, Product Managers and other disciplines. This means Data is not a downstream service, and instead we shape strategy, challenge thinking, build the data foundations teams need to move quickly, and share accountability for customer and commercial outcomes.

 

Our EU team ⭐

Our EU Data team is a full-stack Data team, and together we're building Monzo's presence across Europe from the ground up. We're entering new markets, learning what customers in each one need and finding product-market fit for Monzo. 

 

Our mission is to make money work for everyone, everywhere. As Data Director for EU expansion you'll lead the Data team and shape our product strategy as we grow, deciding where we place our bets, working out what to measure before there's a playbook, and making sure each new market learns fast enough to compound into the next.

 

You'll work closely with EU leadership (our EU CEO, Country Managers and VP of Product) and Monzo's global Leadership team (the CTO, Head of Data and other Data Directors), sitting on the EU Tech Leadership team and helping shape our global data strategy. To do this well you'll need to relish ambiguity, bringing analytical rigour and commercial judgement to bets that often have to be made before the data is complete.

 

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

You'll own the full learning loop that EU expansion runs on, and you'll co-own the product development loop alongside EU Leadership, Product and Engineering. In a new market that often means building those loops from scratch, so you're accountable not just for measuring what happens, but for framing the questions, defining what good looks like, and building the systems that answer them. You'll be a senior voice on the EU Tech Leadership team, the person who reframes the hard problems and puts a number on the trade-off between what's valuable for customers and what's valuable for the business.

Shaping product and commercial strategy:
• You'll decide where Monzo should bet as we enter each new European market, sizing the opportunity and finding product-market fit for the products and segments most likely to win.
• You'll use sharp commercial judgement to work through the ambiguity of building in a new market, from pricing and positioning to the levers that drive growth, bringing Data into strategy early so we shape priorities rather than react to decisions already made.

Owning the data strategy and the learning loops:
• You'll set the data strategy for EU and stand up the foundations each new market needs, from the events we log and the metrics and experiments we design to the forecasts markets learn from.
• Lead the goal-setting process for EU Expansion, bringing clarity to metric selection and target setting, in close partnership with Finance.

Changing how decisions get made:
• You'll represent Data directly at the ExCo level, building a shared language of metrics and analytical reasoning so that Data drives EU strategy rather than reporting on it.
• You'll drive cross-collective collaboration, spotting the high-leverage connections across the business, for example how savings features drive engagement in our Wealth collective.

Building and leading a high-performing team:
• You'll build, grow and retain a high-performing, full-stack Data team, where everyone shares accountability for product and business outcomes.
• You'll raise the performance bar, develop the next generation of Data leaders, and model an inclusive, high-craft Data culture as we scale.

What we're doing here at Monzo excites you, and the idea of helping take it across Europe especially so!

• You're an empathetic people leader who has grown full-stack Data teams of both individual contributors and managers, comfortable representing Data at ExCo and to C-level peers, and you know what it takes to attract, develop and retain top talent.

The Engineering Manager role at Monzo is split into three pillars - people, product, and technical leadership. Engineering Managers are accountable for the technical and delivery outcomes for their area - that means supporting and developing best in class engineering talent, as well as creating an inclusive team environment for people to do their best work.

The Role

We're continuously hiring Engineering Managers as we continue to grow and build new teams. We hire on a pipeline based approach which means your application will be considered across all of our open EM positions. We use the interview process to assess your strengths and we'll match you to a role that best aligns with your experience. Of course, this is a collaborative process so you can also tell us which roles you're most interested in as you progress through interviews 😊 We're currently hiring across Platform, Core App, and Expansion.

You’ll spend your time:
• Taking accountability for delivery across your squad(s), collaborating with the Technical Lead and Product Manager.

• Is comfortable operating with ambiguous problem areas with a high degree of autonomy.
• It’s a bonus if you have experience working in an experimentation led environment.
• Has delivery experience and is able to guide the squads in achieving their outcomes.
• Focuses on outcomes over processes, who optimises for the highest impact and leverage.
• Is able to input, understand and challenge engineering decisions - but to empower the team to make those decisions themselves
• Has an understanding of what good looks like for a high-performing team of engineers and ability to chart a course to get there
• Is able to to coach people to achieve their goals
• Has a natural ability to inspire and motivate a team

We consider your application across all open EM roles at Monzo independent of which role you've applied for, so if you've recently applied to a similar role at Monzo and have been unsuccessful, please wait 6 months before applying again.

You’ll be responsible for structuring, organising, supporting and challenging your team to deliver on their mission.

Is this role right for you?

While this is not a role which requires hands-on-coding, we are looking for an experienced manager who has a strong technical and delivery background and has worked as a software engineer in previous roles.

We recognise that Senior Engineering Managers lead in different ways, we’re looking for someone who is adept at:
• Delivery and Execution: Enjoys taking accountability for delivery across your squad(s), collaborating with the Technical Lead and Product Manager.
• Engineering and Operational Excellence: Actively fosters a high bar for engineering excellence within your teams. You’re accountable for the technical outcomes your teams deliver alongside individual engineer performance and growth, so holding a high bar (and clearly articulating your expectations) is key.
• People Leadership: Has experience directly managing at least 2-3 Engineering Managers and leading orgs of around ~20 engineers. You can support, coach and develop them through their career with regular 1:1s and continuous feedback.
• Technical Influence: Partners with senior engineers to drive technical initiatives that raise the bar for our engineering practices.
• Stakeholder Relationships: Builds strong stakeholder relationships with other teams, and creates a focus space for engineers to do their best work.
• Organisational Wide Impact: Collaborates with the wider engineering organisation to contribute to company-wide best managerial and technical practices and standards.

We consider your application across all open EM roles at Monzo independent of which role you've applied for, so if you've recently applied to a similar role at Monzo and have been unsuccessful, please wait 6 months before applying again.

How we work 💻:

Locations Flexible Working : 

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. 

We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. 

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨

Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼

The interview process:

After an initial informal recruiter call you go through two main stages
• Initial Call (1 hour) You'll meet with one of our Senior Engineering Managers or Engineering Directors. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular people leadership, product delivery and technical leadership. They’ll ask example based questions (‘Tell me about a time when…’)
• Loop Stage (3 hours 30 mins) The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability) and one 30 minute reverse interview (more details below).

The Loop is one stage and the interviews in this stage are:

- Team and Org Management (1 hour)
An example based interview with 1-2 of our engineering leaders. They’re interested to hear examples from your previous experience on the teams you’ve led, how you’ve shaped and partnered with product, and the impact you had.

- System Design (1 hour)
You'll partner with a Staff or Principal Engineer on a technical whiteboarding exercise.

- Behavioural (1 hour)
Similar to Team and Org Management, this is an example based interview with 1-2 Engineering Leaders. This interview focuses on your people leadership style and core behaviours as an Engineering Manager.

- Chat with an Engineering Leader (30 mins)
At Monzo, we believe interviews are a two-way street. This will be your opportunity to ask us any questions about Monzo, engineering leadership or our teams – whatever’s on your mind. 

All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀

Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You’ll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team throughout the process.

All our data lives in one place and is super easy to use. 90% of day-to-day data-driven decisions are covered by self-serve analytics through Looker, which gives data scientists the headspace to focus on more impactful business questions and analyses.

As a Staff Data Scientist, you’ll lead efforts on strategically important, business-critical problems. You’ll apply judgement in areas of organisational or technical complexity, steward initiatives end-to-end, and focus your hands-on contribution where it can create the greatest impact. You’ll be a trusted technical partner to senior leaders, raise the bar for Data Science across Monzo, and build capability in others through coaching, reusable approaches and clear standards.

Our Data Science team ⭐

We are excited to be expanding and are hiring across our Data Science teams. Whether your interests lie in Borrowing, Growth, Payments, Fincrime, Wealth or Core, we are looking for versatile people who can contribute across squads and collectives. While we allocate teams after the interview process, we aim to match your skills and aspirations with the most suitable role. Throughout the process, you will meet team members from across our Data Science collectives, who will guide you through the opportunities available. Join us and be part of shaping our future!

🔑You’ll play a key role by...
• Shape and lead the data strategy for a large domain or collective, connecting customer and commercial goals to a clear portfolio of high-impact Data Science work
• Identify, frame and lead strategically important problems where the path is ambiguous, dependencies span teams, and decisions involve meaningful customer, commercial, regulatory or operational trade-offs
• Partner with senior leaders across product, engineering, ML, design, research, risk and operations, bringing an independent technical perspective that influences strategy and turns it into measurable outcomes
• Establish measurement strategies and metric maps that clarify how customer behaviour, product changes and business outcomes connect, enabling teams to test assumptions and make better decisions faster
• Set and evolve best practices for experimentation, causal inference, forecasting, optimisation and decision science, choosing methods that are proportionate to the decision and its risks
• Remain hands-on where your expertise is most valuable: exploring complex data, designing analyses and experiments, building models or prototypes, and resolving the hardest technical questions
• Steward critical data products and initiatives end-to-end, ensuring they are robust, well-governed, clearly documented and adopted by the people who need them
• Balance pace and analytical rigour, making pragmatic trade-offs while protecting the quality, reproducibility and interpretability of your work
• Raise Data Science standards across Monzo through technical direction, proposals, reviews, reusable methods and thoughtful challenge
• Coach and mentor data scientists and analytics engineers, using live projects and wider discipline initiatives to build sustainable capability beyond your own individual output

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…
• You have an exceptional track record of leading complex, business-critical Data Science work from ambiguous problem framing through to measurable outcomes
• You have shaped strategy across a large product or business domain and can influence senior leaders through clear, independent judgement
• You bring deep expertise across several Data Science disciplines and can set the technical direction for work involving significant complexity, uncertainty or risk
• You repeatedly create clarity across organisational boundaries, resolve difficult dependencies and turn long-term strategy into decisive action
• You communicate complex ideas, assumptions and risks with clarity, and hold a consistently high bar for analytical quality, governance and reproducibility
• You remain a highly credible hands-on practitioner with SQL and Python, while raising standards and multiplying the impact of experienced colleagues

The interview process:

Our interview process involves:
• Recruiter Call
• Initial Call
• Technical assessment
• Final Interviews
• Business Fit/Collaboration
• Case Study
• Technical Interview

Our average process takes around 2–3 weeks, but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process.

For more insight into the hiring experience at Monzo, check out our blog post written by one of our Recruiters - Data Hiring at Monzo.

💰 £124,400 - £165,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits

✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK or Spain

✅ We can sponsor visas

📍 This role can be based in our London or Barcelona offices, but we’re also open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Operations
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.

 

📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰Competitive base salary and stock options | Benefits

Help build the future of customer operations

We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Operations is at the heart of that mission. It’s where we help millions of customers, solve complex problems and keep Monzo safe. Now, we’re redesigning how customer operations work by bringing together intelligent automation, human expertise and world-class technology.

We’re looking for a Staff Technical Program Manager to lead complex company wide programmes driven by the Operations collective. You’ll turn ambitious ideas into clear plans, bring a large and varied group of partners with you and help teams deliver lasting change.

This role is about more than keeping work on track. You’ll shape how we work across the collective, influence domain and collective leaders across Monzo, connect technical delivery to operational outcomes and make sure change works for the people who use it every day.

What you’ll do

Lead programmes that cut through all operational domains at Monzo

You’ll lead high-impact programmes from strategy through to measurable outcomes. These may cover AI-powered customer support, tools that help our Customer Operations teams, or the platforms and processes behind millions of operational decisions.

Build strong partnerships at every level

You’ll work with a large and varied group of partners. This could include frontline Operations teams, subject matter experts, product and engineering teams, risk and compliance partners, senior leaders and executives.

Drive change, not just delivery

You’ll help the whole collective adopt new ways of working. You’ll understand how changes affect people, processes and technology, then build that into the programme from the start.

Key

Responsibilities:
• Lead end-to-end planning and execution of major product or platform programs that cross multiple teams and markets
• Manage cross-collective programmes:
• Define programme roadmaps and milestones, set priorities, manage trade-offs, identify and manage the critical path and risks, ensure alignment with the business goals and ambition
• Collaborate and communicate with multiple stakeholders, both technical and non-technical across the business to ensure alignment and speed of delivery
• Manage dependencies, timeline and the sequencing of delivery
• Drive effective decision making to remove blockers
• Ensure operational effectiveness across your collective/area

 

You should apply if:
• You have strong experience managing complex technology programmes or products from inception to launch
• You’re an exceptional communicator who can create clarity for technical and non-technical audiences
• You are comfortable working in a global business with a presence in multiple markets and want to be part of scaling this further
• You can work effectively with a diverse range of people and working styles to get stuff done, and are able to thoughtfully and constructively challenge and influence the people you work with
• You can make complex work easy to understand without losing the important detail
• You understand how functionality comes together (across products and platforms) to deliver value for users, and can proactively identify and mitigate delivery risks, and can propose and drive a technical solution
• You are comfortable personally diving deep into the data to make good decisions in complex situations where there’s often no “right answer”
• You can influence across teams even when you don’t manage them directly and can influence senior leaders, resolve disagreement and build alignment without relying on authority.
• You’ve driven organisation-wide change and can show how you supported adoption, not only delivery

You don’t need to match every point. If you’re excited by the role and believe you could have an impact, we’d love to hear from you.

What makes this role different

Most companies are adding AI to existing support processes. We’re redesigning the operating model itself.

You’ll help shape how intelligent automation and human expertise work together in a highly regulated environment. The programmes you lead will affect how teams across Operations work and how millions of customers get help.

You’ll have the scope to influence strategy, the responsibility to turn it into action and the chance to build ways of working that scale.

How we work 💻:

Locations Flexible Working : 

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. 

We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. 

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨

Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼

All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀

• More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: Head of Intergovernmental & Regulatory Affairs - EU & UK
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by technology. Founded in 2017, we are revolutionising world systems through our cutting-edge digital asset exchange, Web3 portal and blockchain ecosystems. We reshape the financial ecosystem by offering some of the most diverse and sophisticated products, solutions, and trading tools on the market. Trusted by more than 50 million users in 180 countries globally, OKX empowers every individual to explore the world of Web3. With our extensive range of products and services, and unwavering commitment to security and reliability, we provide an essential trading platform for the world's investors and institutions. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. As strong believers in the value of blockchain technology, we are committed to building a more inclusive and open financial future and we know that starts with the people who build it.

About the Team:

OKX's Global Legal team provides legal advice and guidance to OKX and its affiliated entities across all coverage areas and geographic locations, and supports business growth by working with all teams within the company to help them achieve their goals. We are a high-functioning, collaborative and fast-paced team who enjoys the cutting-edge nature of our work and our industry. Our team of 60+ lawyers are located around the world, and the OKX Chief Legal Officer is based in the United States.

 

About the Role

This is an essential, high-profile role leading Intergovernmental and regulatory affairs for OKX in the EEA and UK. Your role will be to lead our engagement with regulators, policymakers, and government stakeholders across the region. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role that sits at the intersection of policy, regulation, and business strategy, and is critical to our ability to operate and grow in regulated markets globally.

You will serve as a trusted representative of the company in government and regulatory forums, shape our policy positions, and work closely with senior leadership to ensure our regulatory strategy keeps pace with an evolving global landscape.

 

What You'll Do
• Develop and execute a global government relations strategy aligned to the company's business objectives and expansion priorities
• Build and maintain relationships with regulators, government agencies, legislative bodies, and industry associations across key jurisdictions
• Monitor, analyse, and interpret regulatory and legislative developments (including MiCA, DORA, FSMA and equivalent frameworks) and translate their implications for internal stakeholders
• Represent the company in regulatory consultations, policy roundtables, and industry working groups
• Develop the company's policy positions and draft regulatory submissions, consultation responses, and position papers
• Partner with the wider Legal team as well as colleagues from Compliance, Product, Communications and Business teams to ensure regulatory considerations are embedded in business decisions
• Advise senior leadership and the Board on geopolitical and regulatory risk
• Lead and grow a team of government relations and public policy professionals

What We're Looking For
• 12+ years of experience in government relations, public policy, or regulatory affairs — ideally with exposure to financial services or emerging technology
• Deep understanding of the global crypto and digital assets regulatory landscape
• Existing relationships with regulators or government officials in EEA and UK
• Experience engaging directly with regulators — whether from industry, government, or a regulatory body itself
• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; able to translate complex regulatory concepts for non-technical audiences
• Strategic thinker who can operate at both a policy level and a practical, execution-oriented level
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment with competing priorities

Why Join Us
• Shape regulatory strategy at one of the most dynamic moments in the history of digital finance
• Direct access to senior leadership and meaningful influence on business decisions
• Competitive compensation including token/equity participation
• Flexible, global working environment

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, Institutional Liquidity & Growth
jobs.description:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Hong Kong, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

 

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 

 

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Institutional Liquidity Product Manager to own the management and improvement of liquidity across OKX's spot, margin, futures, perpetual swap and options markets.

You will work closely with institutional traders, market makers, HFT firms and quantitative teams to identify liquidity gaps and develop market-structure, product and commercial solutions that improve execution quality and market competitiveness.

This is a strategic and hands-on role combining market microstructure expertise, quantitative analysis, product delivery and commercial ownership. You will partner with Quant, Data, Engineering, Risk, Relationship Managers , Operations and external liquidity providers to turn order-book data and client trading behaviour into measurable improvements in spread, depth, slippage, trading volume, market share and resilience during stressed markets.

What You’ll Be Doing 

Liquidity Strategy, Analytics and Delivery
• Analyse institutional client needs, market-maker and HFT trading behaviour, market trends, competitor liquidity, fee structures, order types and liquidity programmes to identify opportunities for differentiation.
• Own the liquidity product roadmap across spot, margin, futures, perpetual swaps and options, including monitoring capabilities, order types, market structure, maker protection and liquidity improvement initiatives.
• Translate quantitative analysis and institutional trading requirements into clear product specifications and solutions. Work closely with Quant, Data, Engineering, Matching Engine, Risk and Relationship managers teams to deliver scalable solutions from problem definition through launch.
• Define targets, baselines, guardrails and post-launch measurement for each liquidity initiative. Use controlled or phased rollouts where appropriate, evaluate causal impact and ROI, and continuously adjust the roadmap based on data and client feedback.

Institutional and Market Maker Engagement
• Understand participants' market-making, hedging, arbitrage, inventory-risk and latency-sensitive strategies, and translate these needs into product and programme requirements.
• Partner with Institutional Relationship Management teams to onboard and engage liquidity providers, communicate product and programme changes, gather structured feedback and improve participation in priority markets.

What We Look For In You
• Proven experience in liquidity management, electronic trading or market structure within a crypto or traditional exchange, market maker, HFT firm, proprietary trading firm, quantitative fund or institutional trading platform.
• Strong understanding of institutional and HFT trading strategies, including market making, cross-venue arbitrage, price discovery, hedging, inventory and risk management, adverse selection, toxic flow and latency-sensitive execution.
• A quantitative background in mathematics, statistics, computer science, financial engineering or a related field is strongly preferred.
• Hands-on ability with SQL and Python, with experience analysing large-scale order-book, order and trade data. Experience with Level 2 or Level 3 market data is highly valued.
• Deep knowledge of market microstructure, order books, matching, tick size, maker/taker economics, order types, execution quality and liquidity dynamics across spot and derivatives.
• Front-to-back knowledge of crypto, FX, equities, fixed income or listed derivatives, with the ability to apply that knowledge to new products and market structures.
• Strong product execution and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to drive cross-functional delivery across Quant, Data, Engineering, Risk, Finance, Sales and Operations from problem definition to measurable outcome.
• Able to communicate credibly with traders, quants, engineers, senior executives and external partners.
• Fluent in English and Mandarin.
 

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

Please note that Hong Kong is a group-level service hub, and OKX does not carry on a business of operating a virtual asset trading platform in Hong Kong.

jobs.description:
Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

The role

We're seeking an analytical, execution-oriented Product Marketing Manager to drive engagement and retention marketing for SoFi Checking and Savings, the foundation of our deposits business and our largest driver of member growth. This role focuses on our existing member base: deepening the relationships we already have, growing and retaining balances and direct deposits, and bringing dormant accounts back to life.

Your core KPIs will be deposits and direct deposits, with a specific focus on growing and retaining balances across our existing member base. You'll own the promotions and offers that ladder to those goals, working directly with the technical teams that build and implement them. You'll work alongside our Lifecycle Marketing team on engagement and retention campaigns, and partner closely with product and engineering on product-led experiments that turn accounts into everyday banking habits. This includes driving ongoing account utilization as well as reducing churn and reactivating dormant members.

Analytical rigor is central to this role. Segmentation, audience development, and offer testing are primary levers for driving deposit and direct deposit growth, and we're looking for someone with the quantitative depth to identify opportunities within the member base and the judgment to prioritize the ones worth pursuing.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with a meaningful piece of the business to drive. You'll be the day-to-day marketing owner of this segment of our business, working in close partnership with the Product Marketing lead for Checking Savings. You'll collaborate with product, engineering, data science, lifecycle, channel owners, our in-house creative studio, finance, and compliance.

What you’ll do:
• Drive day-to-day engagement and retention marketing for Checking Savings, with core KPIs on deposits and direct deposits across our existing member base
• Grow and retain balances and direct deposit relationships by identifying the highest-leverage member segments, sizing the opportunity, and building the plan to move them
• Own the promotions, sweepstakes, and offers tied to your KPIs, from offer construction and setup through launch, compliance review, and post-campaign analysis, working directly with the technical teams that build and implement them
• Develop sophisticated segmentation and testing programs, designing audience and offer tests that identify and unlock incremental value across the member base

jobs.title: Junior Technical Project Manager - Engine by Starling
jobs.description:
At Engine by Starling, we are on a mission to find and work with leading banks all around the world who have the ambition to build rapid growth businesses, on our technology. 

Engine is Starling's software-as-a-service (SaaS) business, the technology that was built to power Starling Bank, and a year ago we split out as a separate business. 

Starling Bank has seen exceptional growth and success, and a large part of that is down to the fact that we have built our own modern technology from the ground up. The Engine technology platform is now available to banks and financial institutions all around the world, enabling them to benefit from the innovative digital features, and efficient back-office processes that has helped achieve Starling's success.

Our people are at the very heart of Engine and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment that is all about building things, creating new stuff, and disruptive technology that keeps us on the cutting edge of fintech. We operate a flat structure to empower you to make decisions regardless of what your primary responsibilities may be, innovation and collaboration will be at the core of everything you do. Help is never far away in our open culture, you will find support in your team and from across the business, we are in this together!

The way to thrive and shine within Engine is to be a self-driven individual and be able to take full ownership of everything around you: From building things, designing, and discovering to sharing knowledge with your colleagues and making sure all processes are efficient and productive to deliver the best possible results for our customers. Our purpose is underpinned by five values: Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim For Greatness.

Hybrid Working

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Engine - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of London so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person.

About Engineering at Engine by Starling - https://enginebystarling.com/

We are hiring a Technical Program Manager to join our Technology team at Engine. You will be responsible for delivering a critical, strategic programmes within a technical and product domain.

This role will involve technical understanding with complex strategic coordination in a multi-client environment. You will support product consultants, engineering leads and our account managers with planning and commitment setting, as we scale internationally and continue to grow our client base with competing needs. 

Working closely with Engine’s Engineering and Product teams and reporting directly into Engineering, along with external payment schemes and technology providers, you will oversee the end-to-end implementation of a diverse range of complex projects across different areas of the business. Reporting directly to Engineering and collaborating closely with Engine’s Engineering and Product teams, your role will be to manage the end-to-end implementation of various complex projects. This will involve working across different business areas and engaging with external payment schemes and technology providers.

We're looking for someone who thrives delivering in a flexible environment; previous experience working in Financial Services or Technology companies would be an advantage. This role has room to grow, with opportunities to take on wider programme management of challenging inter-woven engineering and product deliveries.

If you’re interested, our main backend stack is; Java microservices in Kubernetes (EKS), on AWS & GCP using TeamCity for CI / CD (with multiple production releases per day) backed by Terraform and Grafana.

What You'll Do:

Key Responsibilities
• Overall management and co-ordination of a technical programme, managing a portfolio of multiple complex, inter-dependent projects. You’ll serve as the key bridge between Engineering, Clients and our Delivery partners.
• Work closely with Engineering Leads to support the Software Development Lifecycle, understanding work dependencies and complexities. Collaborate across multiple teams to coordinate work and effort. Support Product and Engineering to produce an achievable plan.
• Working with Product Leads to maintain a clear, real-time understanding of all client competing needs against our internal capacity. Proactively identifying risks of over-commitment to ensure realistic delivery timelines.
• Owning relationships with external parties such as vendors and payment schemes. Ensuring service is provided to a high standard and holding them accountable where they play a key role in project delivery.
• Provide key reporting and metrics for delivery progress and tracking against plans.
• Continually monitor processes and implement improvements.

Ideally you will have:
• End-to-end Project or Programme Management experience, ideally within a technology or financial services environment.
• Proven experience working directly with Engineering and Product teams to deliver complex technical solutions and experience in the software-as-a-service sector.
• A 'hands-on' and adaptable approach to programme delivery, with the ability to thrive in a flexible, fast-paced environment where priorities can shift.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience communicating complex technical topics.
• Strong interpersonal skills and a creative problem-solving ability to navigate ambiguity and technical hurdles.
• Technical skills and the ability to talk to Product and Engineering teams.
• Strong experience working on cards projects is highly desirable

Our interview process:

Interviewing is a two way process and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you! Our interviews are conversational and we want to get the best from you, so come with questions and be curious. In general you can expect the below, following a chat with one of our Talent Team:
• First interview (60 mins) - with someone from the team to get to know you, discuss the role, your skills, and how we work at Engine.
• Final interview (45 mins) - with the Technical Programme Manager and Engineering Director
• 33 days holiday (including public holidays, which you can take when it works best for you)
• An extra day’s holiday for your birthday
• Annual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell up to five extra days off
• 16 hours paid volunteering time a year
• Salary sacrifice, company enhanced pension scheme
• Life insurance at 4x your salary & group income protection
• Private Medical Insurance with VitalityHealth including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and Peloton
• Generous family-friendly policies
• Incentives refer a friend scheme
• Perkbox membership giving access to retail discounts, a wellness platform for physical and mental health, and weekly free and boosted perks
• Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work, Salary Sacrificed Gym partnerships and Electric Vehicle (EV) leasing

About Us

You may be put off applying for a role because you don't tick every box. Forget that! While we can’t accommodate every flexible working request, we're always open to discussion. So, if you're excited about working with us, but aren’t sure if you're 100% there yet, get in touch anyway. We’re on a mission to radically reshape banking – and that starts with our brilliant team. Whatever came before, we’re proud to bring together people of all backgrounds and experiences who love working together to solve problems.

Engine by Starling is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster diversity & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment at Engine by Starling are considered without regard to race, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. 

When you provide us with this information, you are doing so at your own consent, with full knowledge that we will process this personal data in accordance with our Privacy Notice. By submitting your application, you agree that Engine by Starling and Starling will collect your personal data for recruiting and related purposes. Our Privacy Notice explains what personal information we will process, where we will process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over our use of your personal information.

jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel, Governance & Company Secretarial
jobs.description:
Job description

You will serve as the principal governance advisor and strategic partner to the Boards, local management and executive committees of Wise’s Belgian and Dutch entities and their branches, which operate under the supervision of the National Bank of Belgium (NBB) and the De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) respectively. You will help ensure our corporate governance and operational resilience continue to meet the highest standards of governance discipline.

In this high-impact role, you will be responsible for sustaining and enhancing our subsidiary governance framework, supporting operational resilience, and navigating complex regulatory environments. You will act as the key liaison between local management and subsidiary Boards and the Group, ensuring that governance is not just a process, but a strategic enabler of our global scale-up.

You will advise the subsidiary Boards and executive committees directly and operate with a high degree of autonomy and mandate across multiple regulated entities and two regulators.

What you’ll do: Provide a full governance and company secretarial service to the relevant Wise entities. This includes:

Advise on regulatory authorisations, variations and notifications, support supervisory engagement and regulatory correspondence, and translate EU and Belgian/Dutch regulatory change into practical board-level action. Provide independent legal judgment on the regulatory dimensions of new products, licences and group restructurings.
• Corporate governance ownership: Act as the primary governance advisor for multiple complex and regulated subsidiaries. Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of board and executive committee management, including agenda setting, driving high quality reporting and meeting minutes, tracking actions and maintaining statutory records.
• Entity governance and regulatory compliance: Managing the annual board calendars to secure timely approvals, renewals, compliance attestations, statutory filings, and mandatory regulatory evaluations. Monitor changes in the legislative and regulatory landscape, advising the Board and senior management on the impact of new requirements and best practices.

Influence and constructively challenge senior decision-makers - including demanding and strongly-held personalities - presenting complex governance issues clearly and steering them towards pragmatic solutions that balance growth objectives with regulatory expectations.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Fincrime Reporting
jobs.description:
When Wise’s investigation teams find suspicious activity, we have a legal obligation to report it to Financial Intelligence Units (FIUs) around the world — quickly, accurately and in the format each country requires. Case volumes keep growing as Wise expands into new products and countries, and every FIU has its own rules, formats and submission channels. Without technical leverage, reporting would only scale by adding more people — an expensive route that makes consistency and quality hard to maintain.

The FinCrime Reporting team is the interface between Wise’s FinCrime teams and external FIUs. When AML, Fraud or KYC investigators escalate a case, we determine where it must be reported, gather the right data from across Wise, generate a report that meets local requirements, submit it, and manage what happens next — including keeping funds frozen while law enforcement decides whether a transaction can go ahead. Our goal is to automate this end to end, so reports are faster, more accurate and fully auditable, and our operations specialists can focus on the cases that genuinely need human judgement.

Scope of Responsibilities

FinCrime Reporting is looking for a full-stack Product Engineer to help us build the systems and tools that turn financial crime investigations into high-quality suspicious activity reports. You’ll own components and medium-sized projects across back-end services and the back-office tools our specialists use every day, such as:
• The rules engine that decides which FIUs a case must be reported to, so more cases can skip manual review.
• Data pipelines that gather transactions, customer and case context, and calculate the figures in each report correctly and consistently.
• LLM-assisted narrative generation — including the input data, evaluation, hallucination checks and validation that make generated reports accurate and trustworthy.
• Back-office tools that help reporting specialists review, edit and approve reports quickly, with the right information in one place.
• Automated report submission to FIUs through APIs, SFTP, email and web portals.
• System controls for funds-freezing and other regulatory processes, with a complete audit trail.

 

What will you be doing?
• Design and build reliable, full-stack systems for suspicious activity reporting — from back-end services and data to the back-office interfaces our specialists use.
• Own your work end to end: design, implementation, deployment, and ongoing support in production.
• Partner with Product, Operations, Compliance and Data Analysts to understand how reporting works in practice, remove manual steps, and measure the impact of your work.
• Build automation and bring AI capabilities into production, with attention to correctness, evaluation, traceability, and appropriate human oversight.
• Write well-tested, maintainable code, and improve reliability, security, and technical quality through code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing.

Technologies you’ll work with

Our back-end stack is Java, Spring Boot, and Kafka, with SQL databases. Our back-office front end is built with React and TypeScript on Next.js. Services run in Docker containers on Kubernetes in AWS, and our LLM workflows run in Python on Wise’s internal AI platform. You’ll work with distributed services, asynchronous processing, and integrations with external government systems.

We design for scalability, observability, privacy, security, reliability, and cost.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Servicing Platform

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
The team you’ll be working with: Mitigation Platform Squad

At Wise, we’re on a mission to make financial services faster, simpler, and more accessible for everyone. To achieve our mission, we also need to safeguard our platform against financial crime and ensure our customers’ money is safe. The Mitigation Platform Squad plays a critical role in this by providing a highly scalable platform to orchestrate which information we need to request from our customers, and then have automations and Servicing Agents to review it. We enable Wise to remain compliant at scale.

We are developing the infrastructure that provides teams at Wise with insights into the operational cost and risk associated with their ownership of the Wise product. This empowers them to enhance the product, reducing Wise's cost for customers and enabling a smoother experience when additional information is required from them. The infrastructure also enables automation of Servicing processes through a rich API in a distributed environment, and it is the core connection between customers and our Servicing agents.

What does our squad look like?

We’re a full stack Squad, with Designers, Product Managers, Analysts, Backenders and Frontenders, with three teams, each owning part of our domain: Ingress to Mitigation domain, Collection, Case Assignment, Case Handling To deliver impact faster, we engage with other teams at Wise, so we deliver a platform with the right complexity and adaptability that gets more impactful for Wise on every release. Collaboration is at the heart of what we do — we value ownership, knowledge sharing, and a commitment to building stable, scalable systems while embracing fast-paced learning and iteration.

What we expect from you

As a Senior Staff Engineer, you'll be embedded in one team at a time, being instrumental in building and maintaining robust and scalable systems. You’ll collaborate closely on feature implementation and issue resolution, as well as discovering the main problems in the space, driving the long-term technical strategy around your ownership, balancing immediate business needs with sustainable architecture and long-term scalability. This includes documenting at the appropriate abstraction level to scale the adoption of our developments. We're looking for a proactive individual with a strong foundation in backend technologies, a passion for writing clean and efficient code, and a desire to learn and grow within a supportive environment.

jobs.title: Lead Data Scientist - Treasury Liquidity
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Engineering Lead - Fincrime
jobs.description:
The AUP (Acceptable Use Policy) team is part of Fincrime. We design, build, and operate the preventative and detective controls that monitor transactions and customer activity. If someone tries to use Wise for prohibited activities, we detect it, review it, and take action.

Join us as we shift our strategy from "Policy-First to Risk-Driven" to drive growth. We want to enable all legal activities and minimise friction for legitimate customers, while surgically targeting and neutralising genuinely illicit, high-risk behaviours.

As the Engineering Lead, you will lead a highly collaborative, cross-functional squad, alongside data scientists, analysts, compliance managers, and designers.

How we work:

We operate with high autonomy, low control, and a belief that the best ideas win. We don’t just hand you a roadmap; you will partner directly with your Product Manager, Compliance Lead, and Lead Data Scientist to define both the product and technical vision for the team.

What will you be working on?
• Risk Detection: Close coverage gaps and scale our detection systems by integrating advanced Machine Learning models and building robust controls to spot AUP violations.
• Supercharge Operations: Architect automated workflows and intuitive internal tooling to reduce the cost per case and median handling times for our operations analysts.
• Own the Architecture: Keep our services highly available, resilient, and secure. You’ll ensure we have the right monitoring, observability, and decoupled architectures to scale alongside Wise's massive global volume.
