Your responsibilities will include:
• Participating in end-to-end red and purple team operations, as well as designing and delivering cyber resilience exercises (e.g. threat modelling, tabletops, targeted testing, and simulations that evaluate Starling's response and recovery capabilities).
• Emulating real-world threat actors and leveraging MITRE ATT&CK to test the organisation's defences across both cutting-edge cloud infrastructure and the endpoint estate.
• Utilising dedicated research time to identify emerging threats, understand new vulnerabilities, and adapt Threat Actor TTPs that can be leveraged during assessments.
• Working alongside defensive teams post-engagement to actively remediate vulnerabilities, refine playbooks, and improve the overall security and resilience posture of the organization.
• Engaging in continuous learning and professional development, keeping up to date with current trends in both offensive security and operational resilience.

Operations will emulate real threat actors and target cutting edge technology in Starling Bank’s platform as well as ranging across the endpoint estate. You will use emerging threat intelligence to inform and develop effective attacks.

You will be an early member of the team and have the opportunity to shape the development and growth of the team.

You will have:
• 2+ years of experience in Offensive Security (Red Teaming, Pentesting) OR highly technical other cyber security domains. Alternatively, Cyber Resilience experience in delivering Response and Recovery focused cyber simulations (Threat Modelling, Tabletops, Targeted Testing).
• Experience emulating real-world cyber threats to test the organisation's defences and response capabilities. Understanding cyber kill chains and common MITRE TTPs.
• Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CRTO, OSEP, OSMR, OSCP) OR equivalent practical experience in defensive, offensive, or cyber resilience operations.
• Familiarity with standard C2 frameworks (e.g., Mythic, Cobalt Strike) and common offensive security tooling.
• Strong network and operating system fundamentals e.g Windows, Linux.
• Big picture understanding of cloud technology (AWS & GCP) and modern software engineering paradigms (CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code).
• Ability to work to defined rules of engagement, showing strong discipline, integrity, steady judgement, and the communication skills to bridge the gap between technical exploits and business recovery.

Though not necessarily required, the ideal candidate would also bring:
• Experience chaining offensive operations directly into broader organisational resilience or response exercises.
• Exposure to financial sector threat-led penetration testing frameworks (e.g., CBEST, STAR, or DORA) or operational resilience regulations.
• Deep understanding of macOS operating system fundamentals.
• Experience in payload modification, scripting (Python, Go, PowerShell, bash), or software engineering (Java, Kotlin, Go).
• Experience in Social Engineering such as phishing, physical break-in, or vishing.
• Experience and enthusiasm for sharing knowledge internally to educate staff on the threat landscape and response processes.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer - Engine by Starling
jobs.description:
At Engine by Starling, we are on a mission to find and work with leading banks all around the world who have the ambition to build rapid growth businesses, on our technology. 

Engine is Starling's software-as-a-service (SaaS) business, the technology that was built to power Starling Bank, and a year ago we split out as a separate business. 

Starling Bank has seen exceptional growth and success, and a large part of that is down to the fact that we have built our own modern technology from the ground up. This SaaS technology platform is now available to banks and financial institutions all around the world, enabling them to benefit from the innovative digital features, and efficient back-office processes that has helped achieve Starling's success.

We draw upon our experience as FinTech experts, and best-in-class technologists, to become the chosen option for these banks, and preferred partners for leading consultancies.

As a company, everyone is expected to roll up their sleeves to help deliver great outcomes for our clients. We are an engineering led company and we’re looking for someone who will be excited by the potential for Engine’s technology to transform banking in different markets around the world.

Hybrid Working

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Engine - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of one of our offices so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person. 

About the Role

At Engine by Starling we’re at an exciting point of our journey, building out a series of mobile SDKs and web portals to delight our clients as we help them bring best-in-class digital banking to customers around the world. We like to spend our time building products that we’re really proud of. We focus on the experience, often delivering things with real polish but sometimes making a fast strategic move. We’re always working closely and collaboratively with our product teams and clients to solve problems, build new products and improve existing ones. 

You’ll be able to own the design of products and features, working closely with the rest of the Engine team to design the product, and then staying closely involved as our engineering team builds, helping make sure the outcome is as good as possible. The Engine team works with clients around the world. Some of the interesting challenges will be balancing the needs of both clients and their customers, creating journeys that work in multiple regions. 

Responsbility
• Lead design work across multiple product areas, solving complex, ambiguous problems with product owners and tech leads. Anticipating and pre-empting unintended consequences and risks
• Own the entire product design lifecycle, from discovery through to delivery, ensuring your work directly impacts the domains goals and desired outcomes
• Design the visual and functional experience of our mobile SDKs and web portals for your product domains. Such as payments, lending, saving, onboarding, and cards to name a few
• Adopt and develop our multi-brand design system to ensure a consistent user experience and unrivaled client configuration
• Contribute to our ways-of-working, suggesting improvements and simplifications to team processes
• Ensure our products are designed and documented to a standard that enables rapid adoption and meaningful configuration by our clients
• Champion design, both internally and externally, demonstrating how best-in-class design can transform banking
• 5+ years experience as a UX / Product Designer working with design systems, tools, and research platforms (Figma, User Testing etc)
• Lots of examples of designing thoughtful, accessible experiences for customers, driving inclusive and accessible design that demonstrates tangible impact for customers and businesses
• Accomplished visual design quality - able to push and evolve our design language to the next level
• Experience planning and running various research methods to test and evaluate our ideas
• Proactively communicates complex design decisions and strategies persuasively to all audiences and stakeholders. Anticipates and challenges design decisions that conflict with principles or user safety.
• The Engine team is a collaborative and friendly environment where we encourage openness and the sharing of opinions. You should be comfortable seeking and giving feedback, sharing your work, and contributing to discussions. This role also involves partnering effectively with cross-functional stakeholders and product owners.

Nice to have
• Experience in a Product Design role for a FinTech or Software Startup / Scaleup - ideally with mobile design experience
• Experience navigating and resolving conflicting requirements between end-users and enterprise clients, making pragmatic design trade-offs that satisfy both user needs and business viability
• Experience designing across multiple platforms end-to-end, sometimes simultaneously, including; iOS, Android, and Web.
• Practical experience driving adoption, alignment, and maturity of a design system - extending the system beyond Figma and UI components.
• Strong visual craft (illustration, iconography, motion etc), with a desire to define visual standards that help the wider design team maintain standards
• Experience leading internal 'communities of practice' to improve a specific area of design maturity (e.g. research, accessibility, or design systems)
• Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, or related field (or equivalent professional experience)

Interview process

Interviewing is a two way process and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you! Our interviews are conversational and we want to get the best from you, so come with questions and be curious. 

In general you can expect the below, following a chat with one of our Talent Team:

jobs.title: Lead Data Analyst - Financial Reporting
jobs.description:
The Mission

Wise is on a mission to build money without borders, making moving and managing money instant, convenient, transparent, and eventually free. At the heart of this mission is our ability to report financials with absolute integrity and speed.

We are looking for an analyst to sit at the intersection of Data Analytics and Financial Reporting. You aren’t here to do traditional accounting; you are here to build the data infrastructure and automation that ensures our financial statements are accurate, consistent, and audit-ready as we scale globally.

What will you be working on
• Metric Ownership & Data Logic: Define and own the logic for key performance metrics. You will ensure there is clear attribution for every line item that manifests in our financials. At Wise, analysts have end-to-end ownership of data pipelines so you will also manage orchestration and validation.
• System & Ledger Integration: Ensure data flows seamlessly between our internal data lakes and reporting tools (like Anaplan and Planful). You’ll be the expert on how data maps from our internal systems to the General Ledger.
• Audit Data Architecture: Act as the primary bridge for our auditors by structuring complex data extracts. You’ll build the "source of truth" queries that prove our financial integrity.
• Stakeholder Partnership: Work closely with Finance leadership to provide structured reporting that ensures consistency across Wise’s various financial disclosures.

What do you need
• Data Mastery: You have a strong quantitative foundation and are comfortable navigating massive and complex datasets. You can write optimized SQL queries to extract "financial truth". Exposure to other technical skills considered a plus (Dbt, Python, Airflow, BI tools).
• Foundational Finance Literacy: You don’t need to have a finance/ accounting background, but you are comfortable with basic financial concepts. You understand the Balance sheet and P&L statements, and understand how transactions result in a ledger.
• Technical Agility: You are a quick learner when it comes to tools. Whether it's internal data platforms or tools like Anaplan/Planful, you enjoy mastering new systems to improve data quality.
• The "Find a Way" Mindset: You are an individual who thrives on autonomy. You don’t wait for a ticket; you identify gaps in reporting efficiency and you build the solution.

What’s in it for you
• A seat at the revolution: You’ll be part of a team changing how the world moves money.
• Ownership: You’ll have the freedom to decide which tools and processes are best to solve the problems at hand.
• Growth: We have a clear Analytics Career Map. There is a clear path for progression and a budget for your self-development.
• Wiser

Benefits:
• Generous stock options (RSUs) in a growing public company.
• Flexible working model (Office/Home hybrid).
• Paid 6-week sabbatical after 4 years of service.
• Annual development budget and "Me-days."

Our Values
• This isn’t just a job, we’re a revolution.
• We get it done.
• Customers > team > ego.
• No drama. Good karma.

Ready to help us build the future of finance? Apply now.

jobs.title: Head of Financial Crime Compliance and MLRO, Japan
jobs.description:
Wise is on a mission to build money without borders. We help people and businesses move and manage money internationally, making their lives easier and saving them money.

Protecting our customers and preventing financial crime are essential to that mission. We’re looking for a Head of Financial Crime Compliance and Money Laundering Reporting Officer to lead our Japan financial crime compliance programme and help us grow safely.

You’ll work closely with regional and global specialists across Compliance, Product, Engineering, Operations, Banking and Wise Platform. You’ll bring Japanese requirements into decisions about our products, processes and controls, combining deep technical expertise with practical leadership.

You’ll serve as Japan MLRO. The role is also intended to hold the formal appointment of Officer Responsible for Sanctions Compliance under the applicable Ministry of Finance foreign-exchange framework, subject to regulatory confirmation and the entity’s appointment process.

You’ll have defined decision-making authority and the ability to escalate material concerns directly to the Board. You’ll contribute to the Japan Risk and Compliance Committee and attend relevant Board discussions to present financial crime matters.

Here’s how you’ll be contributing:
• Lead the Japan financial crime programme and exercise responsibilities of Japan MLRO. Set priorities and maintain a clear local framework covering anti-money laundering, counter-terrorist financing, proliferation financing and sanctions. Translate Japanese requirements and Group standards into effective policies, controls and accountabilities, including taking on a local director appointment if required to meet regulatory expectations.
• Lead financial crime regulatory engagement. Coordinate engagement with the Ministry of Finance, Financial Services Agency, Kanto Local Finance Bureau and other relevant authorities, working with the Japan Compliance Lead. Lead responses within your remit to inspections, information requests and findings, and explain how our controls operate in practice.
• Discharge the sanctions compliance mandate upon appointment. As Officer Responsible for Sanctions Compliance, take responsibility for the relevant sanctions risk assessment, policies, mitigation measures, procedures, training and record-keeping arrangements. Exercise required approvals within the agreed governance framework and bring matters requiring Board approval to the appropriate forum.
• Understand and assess our risks. Lead financial crime risk assessments across customers, products, payment corridors, delivery channels and partnerships. Use the findings to prioritise control improvements and assess proposed changes to the business.

Work with Data, Engineering and Operations to assess coverage, data quality, rules and thresholds, and use investigation outcomes and emerging typologies to improve detection.

jobs.title: IT SOX Advisory Specialist
jobs.description:

We specialise in the comprehensive testing, assessment, and continuous improvement of technology-related controls. Your Mission

jobs.title: FinCrime Investigator - Fraud (Thai Speaking)
jobs.description:
As a FinCrime Operations Investigator, you will play a critical role in safeguarding Wise and its customers from financial crime. You will be responsible for investigating and analyzing customer accounts, transactions and activities on our platform to detect and prevent money laundering, fraud, and other illicit activities. You will leverage your expertise to identify suspicious patterns, conduct thorough investigations, and ensure compliance with AML/CTF regulations and internal policies and procedures, all while adhering to Wise’s risk appetite. This role offers a unique opportunity to deepen your expertise in the FinCrime domain, contribute to a rapidly growing global company, and make a tangible impact on protecting our users and the integrity of our platform.

 

Job Responsibilities
• Conduct in-depth investigations of potentially suspicious activity, utilizing both internal and external data sources.
• Analyze complex financial transactions and customer behavior to identify patterns indicative of money laundering, fraud, or other financial crimes.
• Evaluate and assess alerts generated by transaction monitoring systems and other detection tools.
• Gather and analyze supporting documentation, including KYC information, transaction records, and other relevant data.
• Review and interpret data to identify patterns and potential risks associated with financial crime. Support the team in making informed decisions based on data insights.
• Prepare detailed and comprehensive investigation reports, documenting findings and recommendations.
• Act as a point of escalation for complex FinCrime cases from other operations teams, providing guidance and expertise.
• Mentor and train other team members on FinCrime investigation techniques and best practices.
• Collaborate with product and engineering teams to improve fraud detection rules, processes, and system enhancements.
• Stay up-to-date on emerging FinCrime trends, typologies, and regulatory changes.
• Communicate effectively with internal stakeholders, including compliance, legal, and customer support teams.
• Liaise with financial institutions and law enforcement agencies as needed.
• Participate in ad-hoc projects and initiatives related to FinCrime prevention and detection.
• Maintain accurate and complete records of all investigations and related activities.
• Provide input on process improvements and backlog exercises.
• Complete all company-assigned mandatory, refresher or ad hoc trainings on time and with diligence.
• Customer Communication: Communicate clearly, professionally, and empathetically with customers via approved channels to obtain necessary details or clarifications for reviews, always upholding our high customer experience standards. A key part of this involves avoiding unnecessary customer contacts and preventing delayed case resolutions. All communication must be precisely tailored to ensure clarity and efficiency.
• KPIs: Take a proactive approach to consistently achieve individual and team targets (KPIs, SLAs, QA), demonstrating a strong commitment to both quality and speed. This includes meeting deadlines reliably, optimizing processing times, and taking full ownership and accountability for all responsibilities to deliver exceptional results.
• Other: Perform additional tasks as assigned by your lead, demonstrating adaptability and a proactive approach. This includes actively participating in meetings, training, and internal events to support broader team and company objectives.

jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
All our customers start their Wise journey by going through customer verification. We do this to keep our customers' money safe and to prevent criminals from using our products for illegal activities.

We in Personal Onboarding Verification are building and running the global KYC (Know Your Customer) system that provides the functionality to verify our customers. This system needs to keep up with increasingly sophisticated methods of criminals, but do it in a way to keep our product convenient and cheap for customers.

In addition to building global KYC features, our team also builds the framework for our Regional Teams to localize the verification experience. Our colleagues in Regional Teams extend the system with local verification vendors, collect documents specific to the country and implement any other checks that the local regulations mandate.

To succeed, our team needs to implement a system that keeps up with state of the art technology, enables several teams to contribute while keeping complexity and load manageable and has the data and observability to analyse our flows and prove they work according to regulations.

Team you will be working with: 

You'll join our Personal Onboarding Verification team – a diverse, cross-functional group passionate about solving complex problems with elegant solutions. We bring together engineering disciplines across the stack, designers, data analysts, and product managers who collaborate closely to deliver exceptional customer experiences. Our team is responsible for the critical verification journey that consumers complete before using Wise's products. We own the entire verification lifecycle – from document collection flows and automated review systems to agent tooling and compliance monitoring. We operate with high autonomy, make data-driven decisions, and celebrate both technical excellence and customer impact. As a team that touches both regulatory requirements and customer experience, we have unique opportunities to innovate in a space traditionally resistant to change.

jobs.title: Issuance Automation Solution Specialist
jobs.description:
We are looking for an Issuance Automation Solution Specialist to join our Issuance team.

This role will build and maintain the systems, automations, and dashboards that enable our inventory operations to scale efficiently. You’ll work across Issuance Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, and regional teams to reduce manual work, improve inventory accuracy, and support reliable product launches.

In the first six months, you’ll focus on automating key workflows. Longer term, you’ll own the inventory management tools and reporting, while continuously improving stock availability, lead times, and supply chain efficiency.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys solving operational problems with data, systems, and automation.

What you’ll do

Platforms & automation
• Own the architecture, development, and ongoing maintenance of our inventory management system.
• Design workflows that allow inventory operations to scale without creating additional manual work for the team.
• Build monitoring and alerting requirements for inventory risks, including stock shortages, potential stock-outs, delayed arrivals, and unproduced cards.

Inventory management & optimisation
• Develop methodologies for just-in-time stock replenishment and determine appropriate reorder quantities.
• Monitor stock levels and identify opportunities to minimise both low-stock risk and excess inventory.
• Build visibility into purchase orders, stock arrivals, and outstanding inventory requirements.

Reporting & inventory health
• Define the key metrics used to evaluate inventory health and operational performance.
• Build and maintain dashboards to provide clear visibility into stock health, shortages, ageing, arrivals, and other relevant operational metrics.
• Own inventory-related reporting for management on a monthly and quarterly basis.

Operational & launch support
• Support regional launches alongside Product Specialists and other cross-functional teams.
• Ensure inventory, operational workflows, and tracking mechanisms are ready ahead of launch.
• Improve processes based on lessons learned from launches and ongoing operations.

What success looks like

Success in this role will be measured by:
• A clear and continuously improving automation roadmap for Issuance operations.
• Significant reduction in manual and spreadsheet-based work across the team.
• High accuracy and reliability of inventory records and reconciliation.
• Improved visibility into inventory health, stock risks, purchase orders, and arrivals.
• Scalable operational processes that can support additional products and markets without proportional increases in team workload.
• Timely and actionable inventory reporting for business reviews and decision-making.
• Strong operational readiness and execution for regional product launches.

What we’re looking for

We are looking for someone who combines strong operational thinking with an ability to build practical systems and analyse data.

You may be a good fit if you have:
• Experience in operations, supply chain, inventory management, business operations, or process automation.
• Experience using Airtable, including linked databases, formulas, automations, interfaces, and workflow design.
• Strong analytical skills and confidence working with operational datasets.
• Experience building dashboards, reporting frameworks, or operational metrics.
• An ability to translate manual business processes into scalable and automated workflows.
• Strong attention to detail, particularly when working with inventory, reconciliations, financial records, or operational data.
• Experience investigating operational issues, identifying root causes, and implementing sustainable improvements.
• Strong project-management skills and the ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders.
• Comfortable working cross-functionally with teams such as Product, Engineering, Finance, and Operations.
• A continuous-improvement mindset and an interest in finding simpler, faster, and more scalable ways of working.

jobs.title: Principal Product Designer – LATAM
jobs.description:

Based in Sao Paulo, you’ll be joining our rapidly growing LATAM squad - helping grow our market-share by shipping new region specific features and journeys. You’ll understand the needs of our customers and deliver work that feels familiar, scalable and unmistakably Wise.

Your mission: 

This is a unique opportunity to be our first designer in LATAM. Reporting to the Design Director for Regional, you’ll play a key role in shaping a product used by millions to substantially improve the experience for our US customers. This role requires craft, curiosity, and collaboration.

As a Principal-level individual contributor, you’ll be establishing and raising the bar for the design of the Wise product in this region. Our product is global by scale and design, yet we’re aware that locally relevant and familiar experiences are key to building a product that users love and use everyday. You’ll be able to balance systems thinking with market specific insight to deliver upon this mission.

Day to day you’ll be working with an Sao Paolo-based full-stack team of product, marketing, analytics, engineering, banking and compliance. • Building influence. Champion a design-driven approach by effectively communicating your rationale through clear and compelling storytelling
• Leading by making. Identify opportunities, prioritise what matters, and drive the outcome forward through what you create.

 

This role will give you the opportunity to:

Who We Are

About the Opportunity

This role will support the Compliance function for OKX Türkiye, helping ensure the business operates in line with MASAK, SPK and wider local regulatory requirements. You’ll work across AML/CFT, KYC/EDD, regulatory reporting, marketing and product compliance, customer protection and compliance controls, while partnering closely with Product, Legal, Marketing, Risk and Operations. The role is ideal for an experienced compliance professional who can interpret regulation, identify risks and control gaps, and translate regulatory requirements into practical solutions within a fast-paced fintech and crypto environment.

 

What You’ll Be Doing
• Support the establishment, execution and maintenance of OKX TR’s local Compliance Program in accordance with MASAK regulations (Law No. 5549), SPK requirements and applicable internal policies.
• Assist in the review and oversight of customer due diligence processes, including individual and corporate onboarding, identity verification, enhanced due diligence, customer risk assessment and ongoing monitoring requirements.
• Support the preparation, review and maintenance of suspicious transaction reporting processes, including case analysis, supporting documentation, internal coordination and communication with MASAK where required.
• Assist in the handling of regulatory, law enforcement and official authority requests, ensuring that relevant information is reviewed, documented and provided in line with applicable regulatory timelines and internal procedures.
• Support the review of marketing campaigns, campaign terms and conditions, GTM materials, reward mechanics, influencer / KOL content, social media content, customer-facing communications, website / app content and research / educational materials from a local Compliance perspective.
• Assist in assessing marketing and customer-facing materials against Türkiye-specific regulatory expectations, including fair and clear communication, customer protection, misleading statements, investment advice risk, guaranteed return language, reward disclosures, crypto-asset reward mechanics and onshore / offshore separation.
• Support Compliance review of new products, product changes, customer journeys, product documentation, business initiatives and launch materials, helping ensure that local regulatory requirements are considered before implementation.
• Assist in the preparation and review of internal procedures, regulatory registers and control documents relating to Compliance-related product, system, marketing and operational enhancements.
• Support the monitoring of customer activity, risk indicators and compliance controls to help identify potential suspicious activity, financial crime risks, data-quality issues or process gaps requiring further review or escalation.
• Assist in identifying, documenting and following up on control gaps, system limitations and remediation needs, including issues affecting customer data, account status visibility, regulatory reporting, KYC flows and operational controls.
• Assist in regulatory mapping and horizon-scanning activities by tracking applicable MASAK, SPK and other relevant regulatory requirements, and supporting the mapping of obligations to internal processes, owners and controls.
• Support the preparation and maintenance of Compliance trackers, management reports, Board-level inputs, regulatory DDQs, audit support materials, internal knowledge bases and workflow mappings.
• Work closely with Product, Legal, Marketing, Customer Support, CDD, Risk, Operations and Global Compliance teams to support effective implementation of local regulatory requirements across business processes.
• Contribute to automation, reporting and operational-efficiency initiatives, including workflow mapping, data analysis, compliance tools and system enhancement requests.

 

What We Look For In You
• 3–5 years of experience in compliance, AML/CFT, regulatory compliance, risk management, financial crime, internal controls, legal / regulatory advisory or a similar role, preferably within financial services, fintech, crypto, payments or another regulated environment.
• Background in technology-driven, fintech, financial services or regulated environments; crypto experience is a plus but not mandatory.
• Understanding of, or strong interest in, AML/CFT, KYC, EDD, sanctions, PEP, Travel Rule, customer due diligence, regulatory reporting, marketing compliance and customer protection controls.
• Familiarity with MASAK and SPK regulations/requirements
• Ability to interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into practical operational processes, controls, documentation, customer communications and product / system requirements.
• Experience or strong interest in reviewing marketing materials, campaign terms, customer-facing communications, product documentation, website / app content, research content or regulatory disclosures.
• Strong analytical, research and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risk patterns, control gaps and process weaknesses.
• Well-organised, detail-oriented and able to manage documentation, trackers, controls and multiple workstreams accurately.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Turkish, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
• Familiarity with compliance databases, case management systems, screening tools, reporting systems, data analysis or workflow automation is a plus.
• Proactive mindset, high integrity and ability to work in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Security
jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

The mission of our team is to build a scalable and secure AI platform that enables security teams across Robinhood to develop and operate AI-powered agents and security solutions with confidence.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the AI Security team, you’ll help build the foundational platform, infrastructure, and security primitives that make it easier for teams to develop AI-powered security capabilities at scale. You’ll work on complex engineering problems at the intersection of AI, distributed systems, and security, with a particular focus on areas such as identity, authentication, authorization, encryption, and platform safety.

You’ll partner closely with security and engineering teams across Robinhood to create systems that make AI development easier while ensuring security is built into the platform from the start. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys building platforms, solving complex technical problems, and helping shape how AI is securely adopted across security.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA and Bellevue, WA office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

 

What you’ll do
• Design and build a scalable AI platform that enables security teams to develop, deploy, and operate AI-powered agents and security capabilities
• Build foundational platform services, APIs, libraries, and SDKs that make it easier for teams to integrate AI into security workflows
• Design secure systems with strong identity, authentication, authorization, encryption, and data protection controls
• Build and operate reliable, large-scale distributed systems that support AI-powered security use cases
• Develop platform capabilities and guardrails that enable teams to safely build and operate AI agents
• Partner with security, infrastructure, and engineering teams to understand their needs and translate them into reusable platform capabilities
• Identify opportunities to improve platform performance, developer experience, reliability, and security through automation
• Help shape the technical direction and architecture of Robinhood’s AI Security platform as the team and platform continue to grow

 

What you bring
• 5+ years of software development experience
• 3+ years of experience building large-scale distributed systems, with experience designing systems around security concepts such as authentication, authorization, identity, or encryption
• Experience building AI platforms, AI infrastructure, or production systems that support AI-powered applications or agents
• Proficiency in Go or Python, with strong problem-solving and production debugging skills
• Experience with cloud-native platforms and distributed systems technologies such as AWS, Kubernetes, gRPC, or Kafka
• Strong understanding of security fundamentals and experience incorporating security into the design of production systems
• Experience designing and building reusable platform capabilities, APIs, libraries, or developer tooling
• Proven experience delivering large engineering projects with meaningful, long-term impact
• Strong technical judgment and the ability to make thoughtful trade-offs across security, reliability, scalability, and developer experience
• Ability to solve complex engineering problems and collaborate effectively across security and engineering teams

• Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching

jobs.title: Manager, Cross-Border Payment Operations
jobs.location: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Banking Operations at Brex

Operations is the backbone of Brex’s mission to power businesses through our Intelligent Finance Platform. We own credit, fraud, money movement, and payments, protecting our customers and our company. From product operations that ensure flawless launches to scalable systems that drive innovation and precision, we operate at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and customer success. If you want to work at the heart of the business, Operations is where you belong.

What you’ll do

As a Manager, Banking Operations at Brex, you’ll lead a team at the center of how money moves through the platform. You’ll coach analysts, strengthen judgment and documentation standards, and build the operating rhythms that keep a high-stakes monitoring function accurate, resilient, and ready to scale. Operations sits at the heart of Brex, owning money movement and partnering across product, engineering, compliance, and customer-facing teams to deliver with speed and precision.

In this role, you’ll oversee payment monitoring across Fedwire, SWIFT, ACH, checks, and stablecoins, guiding your team through exceptions, escalations, and complex decisions in real time. You’ll shape people, process, and technology: developing talent, improving onboarding, strengthening controls, and turning frontline insight into better workflows. If you’re excited by leading great people, solving hard operational problems, and building systems that help Brex move faster without compromising quality or compliance, this is a high-impact role with real room to shape how Banking Operations scales.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Salt Lake City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

Marketing at Brex

The Marketing team tells the Brex story — turning product innovation into customer obsession. We develop messaging, shape the brand, and bring our platform to life through thoughtful, compelling content. Our team spans Revenue Marketing, Product Marketing, and Brand Marketing, and works cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Business Development, and Design to drive growth and build trust.

What you’ll do

Brex is seeking a deeply analytical, growth-rooted Senior Growth Marketing Manager to own, scale, and optimize our Paid Social engine, with Meta as the core growth driver and a clear mandate to test and scale emerging channels.

In this role, you will be accountable for down-funnel pipeline, efficient CAC, and customer acquisition. You won't just optimize campaigns; you will engineer signal architecture, build scalable audience models, and establish a high-velocity creative testing engine. Critically, you know how to build brand through a performance lens, connecting upper-funnel investments to near-term impact and long-term value creation. You’ll help accelerate Brex’s growth by scaling what works, continuously improving how we operate, and unlocking new opportunities for impact.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our New York City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. Team members are expected to work in-office three days per week (Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays). Brex also offers the flexibility to work remotely for up to four weeks per year, in one-week increments.

Responsibilities
• Growth Pipeline Ownership: Own Meta + emerging channel budgets, CAC efficiency, conversion, and downstream pipeline/revenue across self-serve and sales-led motions.
• Signal Measurement Strategy: Partner with Data and Marketing Ops to improve conversion signals, CAPI, and offline conversion tracking, enabling platforms to optimize toward higher-quality customers.
• Structured Experimentation: Build and execute a continuous, hypothesis-driven testing framework across audiences, bidding strategies, optimization events, landing pages, and creative concepts; document learnings to turn paid social into a predictable acquisition channel.
• Full-Funnel Growth: Build paid social strategies that create demand at the top of the funnel and efficiently convert it through retargeting and lower-funnel programs.
• Creative Strategy: Translate performance data into creative hypotheses and partner with Brand and Design to test, iterate, and scale winning concepts.
• Audience Strategy: Use first-party data, intent signals, modeled audiences, lookalikes, and platform automation to identify and scale high-value audiences.
• Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with Analytics, Marketing Ops, Field / Events team, PMM, and Sales to connect paid social performance programs to downstream pipeline and revenue outcomes.

Requirements
• 5+ years of growth or performance marketing experience, with deep hands-on expertise managing and scaling Meta as a primary acquisition channel.
• Demonstrated experience owning a paid social channel end to end, including strategy, budgets, forecasting, campaign architecture, optimization, and performance reporting.
• Relentlessly analytical: Deep understanding of unit economics (CAC, LTV, payback periods), attribution modeling, and how to connect platform metrics directly to down-funnel business impact.
• Experience running full-funnel paid social programs, from awareness/video and demand generation through conversion and pipeline.
• Strong expertise in audience strategy and platform automation, including first-party audiences, lookalikes, broad targeting, retargeting, and automated campaign products.
• Strong understanding of conversion signals and measurement, including Meta CAPI, server-side tracking, attribution, conversion-event strategy, and CRM/offline conversion data.
• Demonstrated experience building structured experimentation roadmaps across creative, audiences, bidding, optimization events, and new platform capabilities.
• Strong creative judgment and experience writing briefs and translating performance data into actionable creative recommendations.
• Excellent communicator who can operate autonomously and influence cross-functional partners across Brand, PMM, Design, Analytics, Engineering, Marketing Ops, and Sales.

Bonus Points
• Experience in fin-tech marketing or marketing to finance professionals.
• Familiarity with product-led growth or hybrid demand models.

Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Product at Brex

 

The Product team is at the forefront of Brex's mission to empower employees anywhere to make better financial decisions. With a deep understanding of the business, we identify and scope the most impactful opportunities for Brex to tackle. We align cross-functional teams—including Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Design—on key decisions, set strategy, and drive products from inception to launch.

What you’ll do

 

Travel is one of the most complex—and stressful—areas of company spend. Growing companies must keep bookings moving, travelers supported, policies enforced, payments working, and expenses organized after every trip.

As Senior Product Manager, you will own and scale Brex Travel, our integrated travel experience. You will build across discovery, booking, trip organization, group travel, servicing, payments, and reconciliation—connecting every stage to Brex Card and Expense Management.

You will turn travel technology, inventory, and servicing partners into a cohesive Brex product. Across Engineering, Design, Operations, Partnerships, and GTM, you will drive adoption, bookings, volume, and reliability while using AI to reduce traveler and administrator effort.

Where you’ll work

 

This role will be based in either our San Francisco, Seattle, or New York office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Own the strategy and roadmap for the Brex Travel experience.
• Build the journey across discovery, booking, trip organization, group travel, servicing, payments, and reconciliation.
• Connect Travel with Brex Card and Expense Management so booking context flows through payment and accounting.
• Turn partner technology, inventory, and servicing capabilities into a differentiated Brex product.
• Own adoption, repeat usage, bookings, travel volume, conversion, and reliability.
• Improve payment, change, disruption, and support workflows for travelers and administrators.
• Use AI across planning, booking, trip management, servicing, and reconciliation to remove work.
• Align Engineering, Design, Operations, Partnerships, Finance, Sales, and Customer Success around outcomes.

Requirements
• A track record of owning and growing an end-to-end product.
• Experience in travel, online booking, marketplaces, or another operationally complex domain.
• Strong customer judgment alongside fluency in backend systems and operations.
• Experience building on partner, platform, inventory, or servicing infrastructure.
• Quantitative ownership of adoption, bookings, volume, conversion, or comparable marketplace metrics.
• Fluency in servicing, payments, reconciliation, reliability, and exception handling.
• Practical judgment about how AI can reduce customer and operational effort.
• Travel product experience is strongly preferred; adjacent marketplace, payments, booking, or complex consumer-product experience can translate.

Compensation

 

The expected salary range for this role is $184,000 - $230,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

• Build and maintain intelligence feed integrations, enrichments, and tagging so new sources land modeled and usable by stakeholders
• Ship intelligence into downstream controls and data pipelines, including detections, blocklists, data warehouses, and agent workflows
• Partner across Security and Product to translate intelligence requirements into production capabilities
• Rapidly prototype and implement features, fixes, and tooling as required by the team's Intelligence Analysts and stakeholders

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Cards
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States
jobs.description:
As the story goes, in 1949 Frank McNamara finished dinner at a New York restaurant and found he'd left his wallet in another suit. His fix was a card that let members eat now and pay later. That card became Diners Club, widely credited as the first multipurpose charge card. It was a piece of cardboard and a promise: the restaurant trusted the card, the card trusted the member, and someone had to make sure the money actually moved.

More than seventy-five years later, the promise hasn't changed, but the machinery has. When a Mercury customer taps their card, the request goes from the merchant's terminal through an acquirer and a card network to us. In a fraction of a second, we check the balance, apply the customer's spend controls, screen for fraud and say yes or no. After that comes clearing, settlement, disputes and reporting, and every cent has to reconcile.

Cards are the way Mercury customers spend money. The Cards Integration team owns the whole Mercury card, not just the swipe: issuance, physical card shipping, spend controls, lifecycle management, authorization, money movement, settlement and reporting, and the infrastructure underneath. We're a full-stack team, and our job is to make the Mercury Debit and IO cards reliable, correct, useful, and innovative.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who thinks deeply about systems architecture, cares about the customer experience, and will dive into any problem to move the team forward. We value high ownership, working in pairs and teams rather than alone, and attention to detail. Those matter when you run systems held to four nines of reliability, and everyone around you will care about them too.

In this role, you will
• Lead projects from idea to tech spec to implementation to launch, working with your PM, EM, tech lead, and teammates at each stage. When you lead a project, it's yours to see through.
• Learn how debit and credit cards actually work under the hood (authorization, clearing, settlement, disputes) and use that knowledge every day.
• Build features across the stack, from the card experiences customers use to the backend systems that move money.
• Help keep our operations excellent. Our systems are some of the most observable at Mercury, and with great observability comes great responsibility.
• Mentor other engineers and raise engineering quality through design reviews, code reviews, and collaboration.
• Work with product, design, operations, risk, compliance, sales, and many other teams.

You should
• Have strong full-stack experience, a product mindset, systems thinking, and a knack for getting things across the line.
• Have made architectural decisions on complex systems, and be able to explain your reasoning and the trade-offs.
• Be excited to put new features in customers' hands, and care just as much about keeping existing ones working like a charm.
• Care about correctness in systems where failure has real financial consequences.
• Communicate clearly, handle ambiguity well, and enjoy mentoring others.
• Be comfortable with our tech stack (Haskell and TypeScript) or be ready to learn.
• Bonus: experience in fintech, payments, or card issuing.

We encourage you to try our demo site if you're interested in applying for the role.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

jobs.title: Workforce Business Partner (Lagos)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Job Title: Workforce Business Partner (Lagos)

Reports to: Team Lead, Workforce Partner

Job Purpose

The Workforce Business Partner (WBP) serves as a strategic partner to business leaders, driving the alignment of people strategy with business priorities. This role exists to ensure that every people-related initiative — from performance enablement and workforce planning to leadership effectiveness — is executed with precision, empathy, and measurable impact.

Beyond traditional HR delivery, the WBP acts as a trusted advisor, shaping organizational health and fostering a culture of accountability, engagement, and inclusion. The role bridges the gap between business needs and people solutions, ensuring that talent is positioned as a key enabler of growth and innovation.

Key Responsibilities
• Partner with business leaders to translate organizational goals into actionable people plans that drive capability, performance, and retention.
• Lead workforce planning and organizational design discussions to ensure the right structure, roles, and talent are in place to meet current and future needs.
• Coach and influence leaders on talent strategy, performance management, and Independent Contractor engagement to strengthen leadership effectiveness and team culture.
• Act as a trusted advisor on IC relations matters, ensuring fair, consistent, and business-aligned resolutions in collaboration with the Workforce Relations COE.
• Analyze people data and insights to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, presenting data-driven recommendations to business leaders.
• Champion change management and communication strategies that support transformation, adoption, and continuous improvement within business units.
• Ensure compliance with internal policies and local labor laws while promoting a positive, high-performance culture. 

Qualifications
• 2–4 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 2 years in a Business Partnership or advisory capacity.
• Demonstrated experience working in fast-paced, matrixed, or multinational environments.
• Strong understanding of core HR functions — performance management, people relations, organizational design, and workforce planning.
• Proven ability to use HR data and analytics to inform decision-making.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience supporting technical or commercial business units in a fintech, banking, or tech environment.
• Demonstrated success influencing senior stakeholders and leading complex change initiatives.

About You
• You’re a strategic thinker who sees the big picture but executes with precision.
• You build trust quickly and communicate with empathy, clarity, and confidence.
• You thrive in ambiguity and can balance multiple stakeholders with ease.
• You’re data-driven — you make decisions grounded in insight, not intuition.
• You’re committed to continuous improvement, always seeking better ways to drive business impact through people.

What Success Looks Like
• You have established yourself as a trusted advisor to senior business leaders, influencing key people and organizational decisions.
• Business units under your support demonstrate improved engagement, retention, and performance outcomes.
• You’ve delivered a measurable improvement in workforce planning accuracy and performance management effectiveness.
• Leaders actively seek your input on strategic and people-related matters, not just HR processes.
• You’ve successfully embedded at least one COE-led initiative (e.g., new policy, performance framework, or workforce process) within your business unit with strong adoption and feedback.

Why join us
• Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and impactful career growth opportunities.
• Fully remote/flexible work culture backed by continuous support for your learning and professional development.

jobs.title: Head of UK Legal, Deputy General Counsel
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by technology. Founded in 2017, we are revolutionising world systems through our cutting-edge digital asset exchange, Web3 portal and blockchain ecosystems. We reshape the financial ecosystem by offering some of the most diverse and sophisticated products, solutions, and trading tools on the market. Trusted by more than 50 million users in 180 countries globally, OKX empowers every individual to explore the world of Web3. With our extensive range of products and services, and unwavering commitment to security and reliability, we provide an essential trading platform for the world's investors and institutions. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. As strong believers in the value of blockchain technology, we are committed to building a more inclusive and open financial future and we know that starts with the people who build it.

 

About the team

OKX's Global Legal team provides legal advice and guidance to OKX and its affiliated entities across all coverage areas and geographic locations, and supports business growth by working with all teams within the company to help them achieve their goals. We are a high-functioning, collaborative and fast-paced team who enjoys the cutting-edge nature of our work and our industry. Our team of 60+ lawyers are located around the world, and the OKX Chief Legal Officer is based in the United States.

 

About the opportunity 

As Deputy General Counsel and Head of Legal, UK, you will lead the UK legal function, working closely with the UK CEO and other key UK stakeholders and reporting into the Global Legal team. You will provide strategic legal advice to the UK business and work closely with global legal colleagues and senior business leaders on regulatory, commercial and strategic matters.

 

You will be a member of the UK management team and represent the legal function at relevant Board and committee meetings.

 

The right candidate will have direct legal experience and an enthusiastic belief in the digital asset space, 14+ years of experience working for a top-tier law firm, in-house at a financial services or digital assets company or with a financial services regulator and possess excellent writing and analytical skills. The ideal candidate has deep experience in financial services and digital asset regulation, U.K. licensing, marketing and advertising, and contract law.

 

We offer a competitive base salary and bonus structure as well as excellent benefits and an opportunity to work in a cutting-edge industry that will be the future of financial services.

 

What You’ll Be Doing
• Supporting OKX's business expansion into the United Kingdom. This role will be the primary legal point of contact for the OKX U.K. entity, and will be called upon to support the business in its licensing and legal efforts to expand into the U.K. Market. The right candidate will also have experience in government and regulatory relations and will be responsible for ensuring OKX is a valued contributor to the developing legal frameworks in the sector. This will include representing OKX in relevant industry associations and promoting OKX's view point in consultation efforts.
• Supporting the business in virtually all legal coverage areas, including but not limited to product development, regulatory matters, IP and trademark enforcement, corporate governance, licensing efforts, token listings for OKX U.K., contract negotiation, compliance legal support, institutional sales and partnerships, and marketing and advertising;
• Analyzing and advising on the legal risk of new and existing digital assets and managing the legal component of the new asset review process;
• Collaborating with product and business development teams to achieve company-wide projects and goals; and
• Managing legal requests from all areas of the business and effectively advising on legal concepts and legal risk with an eye towards the strategic goals of business leaders.
• You will be working from OKX's London office three days a week. You may work remotely two days a week.

What We Look For In You
• Law degree at a top-tier law school and qualified to practice law in the U.K.
• 14+ years of legal experience at a top-tier law firm and/or in-house legal team, preferably in the cryptocurrency/digital assets and/or financial services industry.
• Experience advising on digital asset and blockchain technology legal issues and have a basic understanding of the relevant legal and regulatory landscape.
• Experience working with the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) and obtaining U.K. financial services and/or crypto exchange licenses.
• Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, growth-stage and multi-cultural environment.
• Ability to effectively advise and build trust with business teams.
• Ability to navigate through a rapidly-changing legal landscape and deal with legal ambiguity.
• Ability to work in a high-functioning legal team and feel comfortable in a collaborative working environment.
• Self-starter, quick learner who is highly driven, proactive, responsive and precise.
• Experience working on cross-jurisdictional matters and a global legal team.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events

jobs.title: Infrastructure Architect
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

Lead infrastructure architecture and core platform development for the AI Native era, covering CI/CD, AIOps, observability, and monorepo engineering. Build platforms that support multiple programming languages across host-based and containerized environments.

Use platform engineering, intelligent tooling, and automated quality controls to enable developers and AI agents to work together, improving developer productivity, software quality, and production reliability.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Infrastructure Architecture and Evolution: Define platform architecture, technical standards, and roadmaps, balancing scalability, reliability, security, and cost. Lead critical component design, hands-on development, and implementation across teams.
• AI Native Engineering Capabilities: Connect code, documentation, dependencies, test results, and runtime data into usable engineering context. Expose capabilities through APIs, CLIs, and SDKs for developers and agents to understand and review code, run tests, and resolve issues. Establish task evaluations, output validation, and execution permissions.
• Infrastructure for Multiple Languages: Build extensible toolchains, dependency management, testing, and delivery capabilities for ecosystems such as Go, Java, Python, C++, and Rust. Use standard protocols and SDKs to support communication across languages, interface compatibility, and consistent telemetry, reducing platform integration effort.
• Monorepo and Build Systems: Define repository structure, module boundaries, dependency policies, and code ownership to support changes across modules and independent service releases. Apply practices from systems such as Bazel and Buck2 to deliver incremental and reproducible builds, affected-test selection, remote caching, and remote execution.
• CI/CD and Quality Engineering: Build shared platforms for builds, tests, artifacts, and releases across hosts and containers. Improve configuration governance, automated quality gates, progressive delivery, health verification, and rollback to shorten delivery cycles and reduce change risk.
• Observability and Reliability: Unify metrics, logs, traces, and profiling, linking telemetry to code, configuration, dependencies, and deployments. Establish SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and alerting practices, and feed production findings back into engineering quality improvements.
• AIOps and Automated Remediation: Combine telemetry, topology, change history, and operational knowledge to enable anomaly detection, incident investigation, root cause analysis, and controlled remediation. Use incident replay, evaluation, and feedback to reduce recovery time and repetitive operational work.

What We Look For In You
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. At least 8 years of infrastructure or platform engineering experience, including 3 years in architecture or technical leadership.
• Deep expertise in at least one of CI/CD, build systems, observability, or AIOps, with experience designing, implementing, and operating large production systems.
• Strong knowledge of Linux, networking, distributed systems, and troubleshooting. Experience with deployment, configuration management, resource isolation, and production diagnostics in host-based and Kubernetes environments.
• Experience building infrastructure for multiple languages, with an understanding of toolchain, dependency, and runtime differences. Ability to design shared platform interfaces and extensible language integrations.
• Familiarity with open-source infrastructure practices originating at Google or Meta, such as build and dependency management with Bazel or Buck2, or cross-language communication and interface contracts with gRPC and Protocol Buffers. Experience evaluating, integrating, or optimizing relevant technologies.
• Experience with automated testing, quality gates, and release engineering, using observability and reliability measures to improve delivery workflows.
• Practical experience applying LLMs or agents to engineering workflows, including context construction, tool use, task orchestration, evaluation, and safe execution.
• Proficiency in at least one of Go, Python, Java, C++, or Rust, with strong hands-on coding and debugging skills. Ability to drive implementation through design reviews, technical guidance, and collaboration across teams.

Nice to Haves
• Experience at Google, Meta, or other leading technology companies, and a background in infrastructure, developer productivity, or AI Native engineering platforms, are preferred.
• Leading large monorepos, build platforms supporting multiple languages, remote execution platforms, or enterprise developer productivity platforms.
• Building AI-powered code review, test generation, incident diagnosis, or automated remediation systems and validating them in production.
• Operating large environments spanning hosts and containers, improving software supply chain security, or contributing to relevant open-source projects. 

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

The AI Platform Agentic Apps team builds the agent platform behind every AI agent at Robinhood — today giving a growing number of engineers and employees an AI teammate that ships code, queries data, and runs operational workflows on their behalf. We're building toward the same platform powering the agents millions of customers interact with directly, in real time. These agents don't just answer questions; they're designed to take real action across carefully curated meta harnesses. This is agentic AI at real scale, in a regulated financial environment, and it will change how Robinhood works. We move fast, raise the bar, and care deeply about building things that matter!

As Engineering Manager, you will lead the charge in developing critical infrastructure for Agentic applications spanning Robinhood products. You will guide the engineering organization in leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to create real, scalable products that act in the world on behalf of Robinhood's customers and employees. This role calls for a visionary leader with a strong software engineering background, a passion for developing platforms, and deep expertise in applied ML at scale. You'll partner closely with Legal, Compliance, and Security to build agents that can be trusted to act in a regulated brokerage environment — driving everything from eval-gated releases to audit trails that hold up under scrutiny.

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Our Global Payroll team is at the foundational stage of building a world-class global payroll ecosystem, and it's a great time to join! We partner closely with Corporate Tax, Corporate Engineering, Accounting, Benefits, Legal, and Global Mobility to make sure employees are paid accurately and on time. We build systems and processes that scale across weekly, bi-weekly, and international payroll cycles. We also work hand in hand with external payroll and tax providers, and we expect strong accountability on both sides. Ethics and accuracy sit at the center of how we work.

As a Senior Payroll Tax Specialist, you will report to the Sr. Manager, Global Payroll and serve as the internal subject matter expert and primary operational contact for our external providers. You will own payroll tax processing and reporting across US, Canadian, and global entities, keeping us compliant with local, state, federal, and international regulations. You will configure and test withholding tax setups in Workday, reconcile liabilities, and lead quarter-end, year-end, and audit readiness. An early focus will be resolving legacy tax account discrepancies and putting in place the reconciliation foundation we need to scale, so your work will shape how this function runs for years to come! You will also partner with teams across Finance, Engineering, and People to deliver accurate reporting and analysis.

This role is based in our Chicago, IL, Menlo Park, CA and New York, NY offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you'll do
• Own withholding tax configuration in Workday, including setup, mapping, and maintenance of state, local, and international tax tables, and partner with Corporate Engineering to test changes in sandbox before production release.
• Run payroll tax processing and reporting across weekly, bi-weekly, and international payroll cycles, including multi-state and internationally mobile employees, and support payroll transitions from M A activity.
• Verify accuracy after each payroll with parallel reconciliations, and reconcile payroll tax liabilities weekly across US, Canadian, and global entities, along with quarterly returns filed by third-party providers.
• Resolve and permanently close out legacy tax discrepancies and historical imbalances, including GL payroll clearing account variances and unclaimed payroll check (escheatment) requirements.
• Lead quarter-end and year-end execution, including W-2s, T4s, and global equivalents, plus corrections and amended returns (W-2C, Form 941-X), and prepare for payroll tax audits with the IRS, CRA, HMRC, and state and local authorities.
• Manage agency notices and new tax account setups, act as the point of contact for third-party providers, and deliver reporting and liability analysis to Finance, Accounting, Corporate Tax, and People Operations.

What you bring
• 8+ years of progressive, hands-on payroll tax experience across US and Canadian payroll, with international experience a plus.
• Hands-on experience configuring and maintaining payroll tax rules in an enterprise ERP (Workday Payroll preferred) and working with third-party tax filing providers such as ADP SmartCompliance.
• Solid understanding of payroll tax reconciliation, including liability reconciliation, quarter-end and year-end filings, and corrections and amendments.
• Advanced Excel skills for data analysis and reconciliations, plus comfort using AI tools to streamline reconciliations and filings.
• An analytical approach to untangling ambiguous tax scenarios with limited guidance.
• Experience holding vendors accountable and collaborating across Engineering, Finance, and Tax teams.
• Bonus: Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) and a bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Taxation, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

The AI Platform Agentic Apps team builds the agent platform behind every AI agent at Robinhood. These agents don't just answer questions — they're designed to take real action across carefully curated meta harnesses. This is agentic AI at real scale, in a regulated financial environment, and it will change how Robinhood works!

As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer on the AI Platform Agentic Apps team, you will design and build the harness that every agent at Robinhood runs on. A critical part of the role is making those agents trustworthy at scale: trajectory-level evals that measure how an agent reasons and acts, and action guardrails — permission models, approval gates, and sandboxing — built as platform primitives that other teams adopt. You'll be a technical anchor on a growing, high-caliber team, collaborating with product, infrastructure, and fellow ML engineers to take ambitious ideas from zero to one and into production. You'll help define the team's technical direction, mentor engineers, and shape how Robinhood decides an agent is ready to ship. This role offers a rare combination of technical depth, platform-scale impact, and the satisfaction of building systems that genuinely don't exist anywhere else.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

• Design and build the core of Robinhood's agent harness — orchestration, tool integrations, context and memory management — so one platform can safely power both high-trust internal agents and tightly scoped customer-facing ones.
• Ship agentic applications end to end on that harness, from an ambiguous problem to a production agent that takes real action on behalf of employees or customers, and feed what you learn back into the platform.
• Build trajectory-level evaluation systems that score how an agent got to an answer, not just the answer — tool-call correctness, planning and recovery, multi-step task completion — backed by simulation environments and synthetic task generation.
• Architect action guardrails as platform primitives: least-privilege tool scoping, permission models, human-approval gates for high-risk or irreversible actions, step and budget limits, sandboxing, and rollback.
• Make evals and guardrails products other teams adopt — SDKs, CI regression gates on prompt, model, and tool changes, continuous red-teaming, and production tracing that closes the loop from real traffic back into eval sets and guardrail models.
• Set the technical bar through architecture reviews, code reviews, and mentorship, and be the person who can make — and defend with data — the "don't ship" call.

A Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.
• Hands-on experience building agentic systems end to end — tool use, orchestration, context management, multi-step planning — on top of frontier models, in production.
• Deep expertise evaluating agents: you've built trajectory-level evals, tool-call scoring, and simulation environments, and you can articulate why final-answer accuracy is insufficient for systems that act.
