jobs.title: Banking Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Banking Operations Management is a global function with regional specialisation across APAC, Europe, NorthAm, MEA and LatAm. The team currently has 7 Banking Operations Managers, supported by the BOM Function Lead and project management support.

The team is currently based across Singapore, São Paulo, Austin, Budapest and Tallinn. APAC currently has one BOM in Singapore, with a second joining in Hyderabad and supported by the APAC Function Lead; this role will add a third APAC BOM to support the scale and complexity of the region. Current BOM scope excludes Japan.

The role reports to the APAC Banking Operations Managers Function Lead. It is a senior individual contributor role with high autonomy, broad stakeholder exposure and a strong expectation to build structure where it does not yet exist. 

Here’s how you’ll contribute:
• Own operational relationships with key global banking partners, including regular performance reviews, escalations and action follow-up.
• Drive partner performance by monitoring speed, reliability, incidents, service level agreement (SLA) gaps, risk signals, fees and avoidable operational costs.
• Translate complex internal problems into partner improvement plans, making sure issues have owners, next steps, timelines, escalation paths and expected outcomes.
• Hold partner banks accountable for operational commitments, including SLA performance, incident resolution, responsiveness and long-term fixes.
• Support incident and post-incident corrective action follow-through for issues caused by or involving partner banks, making sure root causes are understood and repeated problems are addressed.
• Build operational visibility across Wise by improving shared partner records, documentation and reporting around partner performance and relationship management.
• Work with Banking, Finance, Legal, risk and controls, and banking governance teams on partner fees, losses, contract/SLA discussions, controls and regulatory expectations.
• Help regional and internal teams work more effectively with banking partners by sharing context, best practices and clear operating routines.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Lead, Programmatic & Video
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Marketing at Brex

The Marketing team tells the Brex story — turning product innovation into customer obsession. We develop messaging, shape the brand, and bring our platform to life through thoughtful, compelling content. Our team spans Revenue Marketing, Product Marketing, and Brand Marketing, and works cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Business Development, and Design to drive growth and build trust.

What you’ll do

Brex is seeking a strategic, data-driven Growth Marketing Lead, Programmatic Video to shape how we invest across programmatic display, YouTube, CTV, online video, audio, and emerging channels.

You’ll own a high-impact media portfolio spanning Brand and Growth, with the opportunity to define how these programs work together, prove their incremental impact, and identify where Brex should invest next. You’ll combine deep programmatic expertise with strong measurement, audience, and experimentation instincts to turn media insights into smarter investment decisions and scalable growth. Critically, you know how to build brand through a performance lens, connecting upper-funnel investments to near-term impact and long-term value creation.

This is a highly visible role for someone excited to build: evolving our media operating model, strengthening our technology and partner ecosystem, and helping establish the systems and capabilities that will shape the next phase of Brex’s paid media strategy.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. Brex also offers the flexibility to work remotely for up to four weeks per year, in one-week increments.

Responsibilities
• Own strategy, investment, and performance across programmatic display, video (CTV, OLV, YouTube), audio, and emerging digital channels across Brand + Growth.
• Evolve Brex’s media operating model and partner ecosystem, including DSP/vendor evaluation, onboarding, agency and partner management, and development of scalable processes and best practices as ownership and capabilities evolve.
• Build integrated audience strategies using first-party data, intent, contextual, modeled, and third-party signals to reach priority audiences across the funnel.
• Build the measurement framework for the portfolio, partnering with Analytics and Data Science on attribution, incrementality, geo/holdout tests, brand lift, and approaches that connect upper-funnel investment to downstream business outcomes.
• Partner cross-functionally with Brand, PMM, and Design to translate campaign objectives and performance insights into media strategy, creative requirements, testing plans, and actionable learnings.
• Shape the future of the portfolio by identifying emerging channels, technologies, and AI-enabled opportunities and bringing clear recommendations into quarterly and annual planning.
• Build scalable governance and operating standards across programmatic media, including QA, risk controls, and documentation.

Requirements
• 7+ years of hands-on experience in growth or performance marketing, with deep expertise in programmatic media and video/CTV advertising.
• Demonstrated experience owning a multi-channel media portfolio and significant budgets, including investment planning, forecasting, optimization, and scaling decisions.
• Deep knowledge of the programmatic ecosystem and major DSPs (e.g., DV360, The Trade Desk, or similar), including bidding, inventory, audience strategy, brand safety, and vendor management.
• Strong understanding of full-funnel B2B marketing and experience connecting awareness and consideration investments to downstream business outcomes.
• Advanced fluency in measurement, attribution, and incrementality, including experimentation design, lift studies, holdouts/geo tests.
• Demonstrated ability to build audience architectures using first-party, contextual, intent, modeled, and third-party data.
• Strong creative judgment and experience partnering with Brand and Creative teams on video, display, and performance creative strategy and testing.
• Excellent communicator with demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, lead complex cross-functional initiatives, and mentor other marketers.
• Highly autonomous, strategic, and comfortable building new capabilities and operating models in a fast-moving environment.

Bonus Points
• Experience in fin-tech marketing or marketing to finance professionals.
• Familiarity with product-led growth or hybrid demand models.
• Experience evolving media operating models and building greater in-house programmatic, video, or CTV capabilities.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $167,240 - $240,407. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analytics Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity

As a Senior Business Analytics Manager, you'll use data to strengthen Compliance across three priorities: Trusted Data, Growth Enablement, and Proactive Risk Prevention. You'll help ensure that regulatory reports, audit responses, and legal evidence are reliable, traceable, and reusable, while transforming customer, transaction, and financial data into actionable insights.

 

You'll partner with Compliance, Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Business teams to build trusted data foundations, automate recurring requests, and create metrics that reveal operational effectiveness and compliance friction. You'll also conduct root cause and control-gap analysis, help remove compliance-related business roadblocks, support market and licensing initiatives, and surface risks before they are identified externally.

 

What You'll Be Doing:
• Facilitate and govern internal and external data requests across OKX global entities, ensuring timely, first-time-right delivery for regulatory reporting, audits and exams, and legal evidence.
• Build and maintain request records, evidence and definition libraries, and data-governance records to improve data reliability, traceability, and reusability.
• Productize high-frequency recurring requests into automated or self-service data pipelines, improving turnaround time and cost efficiency.
• Build and automate Compliance dashboards based on North Star metrics as well as input and guardrail metrics to provide transparency into operational effectiveness, customer and platform risk, and business friction.
• Conduct deep-dive, root-cause, and control-bypass analyses to proactively identify and prevent compliance risks.
• Partner with Compliance, Business, Marketing, and local market teams to remove compliance-related roadblocks in current operations and support new markets, licences, applications, and market-access assessments.
• Collaborate across Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Finance to continuously improve data pipelines and analytics products.

 

What We Look For In You:
• Relevant working experience of at least 7 years. (must)
• Proficiency in database management systems like MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, or PostgreSQL. (must)
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. (must)
• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. (must)
• Hands-on experience with machine learning algorithms and AI tools. (nice to have)
• Strong compliance domain knowledge, including KYC, AML, the Travel Rule, insider trading controls, and regulatory requirements across jurisdictions. (nice to have)
• Experience supporting regulatory reporting, regulatory examinations, and internal or external audits. (nice to have)
• Preferred industries are Fintech, Digital Payment, Tech companies. (nice to have)

 

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependents

jobs.title: Channel Sales Manager - North America
jobs.description:
Channel Sales at Wise Platform is a high-growth function. As part of our strategy to scale globally, we are expanding the team with a dedicated manager based in Austin, Texas to look at scaling the function in North America. 

Our team’s goal is to accelerate the adoption of Wise Platform by leveraging a trusted strategic channel partner ecosystem to win new deals, shorten sales cycles, and scale through channels.

As the Channel Sales Manager (NAM), you will build, scale, and operationalise our channel sales function across the region. You will focus on identifying, structuring, and nurturing relationships across top-tier core banking providers, payment platforms, system integrators (SIs), and strategic consultancies.

Key Responsibilities
• Channel Partnership Enablement & Operations: Own the governance, cross-market NAM coordination, and end-to-end lifecycle of new and existing partners - including commercial alignment, technical onboarding, contracting and launch.
• Core Banking & Vendor Ecosystem Development: Identify and build strategic relationships with top-tier core banking providers and payment platforms to create pre-integrated connectors and scalable GTM pathways.
• System Integrator & Consultancy Strategy: Build and execute go-to-market alliances with global and regional SIs and consultancies that deploy technology for banks in the broader NAM region.
• BD Alignment & Pipeline Generation: Work closely with the Business Development team - passing on qualified leads, partner-sourced opportunities, and account intelligence collected through channel activities to accelerate direct deal flows.
• Ecosystem Assessment & Immediate Impact: Take immediate ownership of active regional partner relationships and execute a comprehensive ecosystem assessment across NAM players to map out high-priority channel partners for discovery to bring into active execution..
• Commercial Metrics & KPIs: Drive key commercial success metrics, targeting partner-sourced pipeline, time-to-live through repeatable integrations, and long-term transaction volume flowing through NAM channels.

What You Will Learn & Career Growth
• High-Visibility Impact: Work directly alongside NAM commercial leads and global leadership to shape and scale the regional channel strategy from the ground up.
• Cross-Functional Exposure: Collaborate daily across BD, Pre-Sales, Product, Engineering, Finance, and Legal to build scalable commercial models.
• Industry Transformation: Drive long-term impact on Wise Platform’s sales opportunities and sales cycle by shifting regional GTM from direct outreach to scalable, pre-integrated partner channels.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer II - Wise for Banks
jobs.description:
About the role

We’re looking for a senior engineer who enjoys understanding a customer’s problem, designing a solution and taking responsibility for how it performs in production.

This is a hands-on role with substantial ownership. You’ll have the autonomy to move work forward, alongside colleagues who contribute through shared design, reviews and pairing.

You will:
• Own solutions from problem to production. Work with product managers and engineers to understand partner needs, shape the approach, and design, build, test and operate backend services.
• Make thoughtful technical decisions. Explain tradeoffs clearly and balance delivery time, reliability and maintainability, including when the information available is incomplete.
• Build across system boundaries. Work with other teams to agree clear interfaces and understand how changes affect the wider payment journey.
• Improve the systems you operate. Strengthen testing and observability, diagnose production issues, and use what you learn to make services more dependable.
• Help the team succeed. Contribute across workstreams, share domain knowledge and help other engineers grow through reviews, pairing and mentoring.

Our backend stack includes Java, Spring Boot, Kafka and PostgreSQL. You’ll deepen your understanding of funding, settlement and currency conversion, using that knowledge to make better product and engineering decisions. As the team’s scope grows, there will be opportunities to take on broader technical ownership and influence how we build.

We are seeking an energetic, highly organised, and proactive Workplace Operations Coordinator to join

our team in Singapore. Sitting at the heart of our office culture, this role plays a critical part in curating a

welcoming, inclusive, and collaborative community environment for our employees.

You will combine day-to-day building operations and facilities management with creative community

jobs.title: Senior Partner Operations Manager - APAC - Wise Platform
jobs.description:
As a Senior Partner Operations Manager, you'll own the operational strategy and execution for a portfolio of high-value enterprise partners on Wise Platform - driving continuous improvement in their payments’ experience, so partners stay operationally stable and ready to grow.

That breaks into two parts:
• Owning the operational strategy: You set and drive the strategy behind improving operational performance and volume retention for your partner portfolio - working to improve the partnership operations, in close partnership with the Account Management team (who own the commercial relationship).
• Resolving root causes of issues identified: You put that strategy into action day-to-day, working with cross-functional teams across operations, product, tech, legal, compliance, implementation, and business development to keep partners stable and unlock growth.

You will be co-owning Wise Platform partner revenue retention and operational performance, working closely with the Account Management team and Wise operational teams to ensure Wise Platform Partners get the most value from our partnership, are operationally stable and can expand to new products and solutions. 

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Co-own revenue retention, operational performance, and relationships for your Enterprise platform partners - leading operational initiatives with internal teams to unblock growth opportunities. In practice, this means driving operational performance analysis and working to smooth out operations for the partners in your portfolio. You'll address operational concerns on the partnership as the final escalation point, spotting and resolving recurring friction patterns, while managing stakeholders and running business review meetings. You'll also propose solutions for partners looking to improve their operational state and support them through execution - ultimately removing the operational obstacles standing in the way of growth.
• Partner with Account Managers to drive retention targets by improving transfer success, reducing operational issues, lowering contact rates, and enhancing overall partnership scalability. To do this - we expect you to use data insights to track performance, proactively addressing risks, and implementing initiatives that improve key retention metrics, ensuring long-term partner satisfaction and minimising churn.
• Own operational success plans and data-driven business reviews, including helping manage Quarterly Business Reviews, to maximise the value partners get from Wise. Build plans aligned to key metrics (success rates, contact rates, customer satisfaction), holding both partners and internal teams accountable to timelines. Regularly present data analysis and progress updates to partners, using the insights to shape ongoing strategic improvements.
• Advocate for partner needs by providing feedback to internal teams, influencing product roadmaps, and ensuring our platform evolves to meet the complex needs of enterprise banking and fintech clients.
• Optimise internal and external processes, using data-driven insights to identify recurring challenges and implement solutions that scale operations and improve partner experiences.
• Develop trusted relationships with senior stakeholders at partner organisations, ensuring alignment on operational goals and fostering long-term, strategic collaboration. Influence the partners to implement the endpoints & webhooks to help automate internal & partner’s support operational teams by sending the data via API to our partner.
• Analyse the quality of the servicing we provide to our partners and their customers. Getting the feedback from partners and reviewing how internal procedures and SLAs help partners and their end-users get the most efficient service from Wise. Identify and raise the key improvement areas.

By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Operations at Brex

Operations is the backbone of Brex’s mission to power businesses through our Intelligent Finance Platform. We own credit, fraud, money movement, and payments, protecting our customers and our company. From product operations that ensure flawless launches to scalable systems that drive innovation and precision, we operate at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and customer success. If you want to work at the heart of the business, Operations is where you belong.

What you'll do

As a Fraud Strategy Associate, you’ll own the end-to-end integrity of Brex’s fraud and risk ecosystem across credit, deposit, and card payment rails. You'll find patterns, trace root causes, and build the detection logic, automations, and reporting that keep fraud in check without adding friction for customers. You’ll design your own solutions, see fraud across every product vertical, and partner with Risk, Data Science, Engineering, and Product to build prevention into the product itself. 

Where you'll work

This role will be based in our Salt Lake City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

Strategic Analysis Detection
• Data Mining: Use SQL and Python to mine large-scale data, and apply LLM-based tools to detect and automate the identification of fraudulent patterns across credit, deposit, and card payment rails.
• Vendor and Rule Optimization: Design and refine automated detection logic to proactively mitigate risk while maintaining a frictionless experience for legitimate customers.
• Emerging Threat Intelligence: Stay ahead of industry trends and regulatory shifts to rapidly deploy new defensive strategies against novel fraud vectors.

Operational Excellence Process Ownership
• Workflow Architecture: optimize the internal processes for fraud investigations, ensuring operational discipline, case visibility, and high-fidelity documentation.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the strategic bridge between Risk Leadership, Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, and Product teams to integrate fraud-prevention infrastructure into the core product lifecycle.
• Tooling Infrastructure: Define and manage the technical requirements for internal AI-driven tools and third-party risk-reduction platforms.

Metrics, Reporting Performance
• KPI Management: Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) such as false positive rates, fraud capture rates, and operational turnaround times.
• Executive Dashboards: Build and maintain scalable reporting suites to provide real-time visibility into fraud exposure and program effectiveness for senior stakeholders.
• Impact Assessment: Conduct deep-dive post-mortems on fraud incidents to quantify financial impact and recommend structural process improvements.

Requirements
• Technical Mastery: Capable with SQL and/or Python for data wrangling, statistical modeling, and automation.
• Industry

Experience:

3+ years of experience in fraud strategy, risk operations, or data-driven business operations within a financial services or high-growth fintech environment.
• Operational Mindset: Proven ability to build scalable processes and manage complex projects from data exploration through to operational rollout.
• Communication: Exceptional ability to synthesize complex analytical findings into clear, executive-level strategic narratives.

Bonus Points
• Advanced Certification: Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) designation.
• Experience with Snowflake, Salesforce, and data visualization platforms like Hex.
• Experience managing fraud risk and operational workflows for products spanning multiple geographic jurisdictions.
• Experience utilizing AI tools to enhance internal operational efficiency.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $95,040 - $118,800. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

jobs.title: Business Operations, Senior Associate
jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? Coinbase is building the future of finance for people, institutions and their agents, with one place to trade crypto, equities, derivatives and prediction markets, use stablecoins, and connect AI agents with clear controls. The bar is high and the pace is intense, and we like it that way. This isn’t a place for complacency. It’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits and do the best work of your career. If you’re ready to build the future of finance with a championship team who refuse to settle for “good enough,” you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for in-person working sessions

We're hiring for opportunities across Consumer, Institutional, Base, and Stablecoins and will work through placement / fit through the interview process. As a Business Operations Senior Associate on the Business Operations Strategy team, you'll partner directly with senior leadership on Coinbase's highest-priority strategic and operational challenges. You'll work primarily with product and sales leaders, structuring complex problems, building quantitative business cases, and translating data into executive-level recommendations that shape product and segment strategy.

What you'll do:
• Structure complex, ambiguous strategic problems for Coinbase's leadership team and develop actionable recommendations backed by data and quantitative modeling.
• Build business cases and financial models that identify new opportunities and directly inform Institutional product and go-to-market strategy.
• Develop and maintain a deep understanding of competitive positioning, peer benchmarks, and the evolving crypto landscape to sharpen strategic recommendations.
• Design and implement experiments to validate hypotheses, measure impact, and drive measurable changes across Institutional products.
• Own problems end-to-end, from initial framing through analysis, recommendation, and implementation, not just the slide deck.
• Strengthen team capabilities by improving existing processes, frameworks, and operational tooling.

Required Skills and

Experience:
• 5+ years of experience in management consulting, investment banking, corporate strategy, or product strategy, with demonstrated ownership of end-to-end strategic workstreams.
• Proven ability to build quantitative models and business cases that have directly influenced executive or leadership decisions.
• Familiarity with institutional finance, capital markets, or crypto/digital assets markets.
• Track record of delivering clear, concise written and verbal recommendations to senior stakeholders in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
• Exposure to SQL and BI tools (e.g., Hex, Superset, Looker) or crypto analytics tools (e.g., Dune Analytics, Etherscan) is a plus but not required.
• Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

jobs.title: Partner Operations Manager
jobs.description:
As a Partner Operations Manager, you'll own the operational strategy and execution for a portfolio of high-value banking and fintech partners on Wise Platform — driving continuous improvement in how payment solutions are delivered, so partners stay operationally stable and ready to grow.

That breaks into two parts:
• Owning the operational strategy: You set and drive the strategy behind improving operational performance and volume retention for your partner portfolio — continuously improving how payment solutions are delivered, in close partnership with the Account Management team (who own the strategic relationship).
• Executing cross-functionally: You put that strategy into action day-to-day, working with Wise operational teams plus product, tech, legal, compliance, implementation, and business development to keep partners stable and unlock growth.

You will be owning Wise Platform partner volume retention and operational performance, working closely with the Account Management team and Wise operational teams to ensure Wise Platform Partners receive the most value from our product, operationally stable and ready to grow. You will also work with other functions, including product management, tech, legal, compliance, implementation and business development.

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Co-own revenue retention, operational performance, and relationships for your Enterprise platform partners - leading operational initiatives with internal teams to unblock growth opportunities. In practice, this means driving operational performance analysis and working to smooth out operations for the partners in your portfolio. You'll address operational concerns on the partnership as the final escalation point, spotting and resolving recurring friction patterns, while managing stakeholders and running business review meetings. You'll also propose solutions for partners looking to improve their operational state and support them through execution - ultimately removing the operational obstacles standing in the way of growth.
• Partner with Account Managers to drive retention targets by improving transfer success, reducing operational issues, lowering contact rates, and enhancing overall partnership scalability. To do this - we expect you to use data insights to track performance, proactively addressing risks, and implementing initiatives that improve key retention metrics, ensuring long-term partner satisfaction and minimizing churn.
• Own operational success plans and data-driven business reviews, including helping manage Quarterly Business Reviews, to maximize the value partners get from Wise. Build plans aligned to key metrics (success rates, contact rates, customer satisfaction), holding both partners and internal teams accountable to timelines. Regularly present data analysis and progress updates to partners, using the insights to shape ongoing strategic improvements.
• Advocate for partner needs by providing feedback to internal teams, influencing product roadmaps, and ensuring our platform evolves to meet the complex needs of enterprise banking and fintech clients.
• Optimize internal and external processes, using data-driven insights to identify recurring challenges and implement solutions that scale operations and improve partner experiences.
• Develop trusted relationships with senior stakeholders at partner organizations, ensuring alignment on operational goals and fostering long-term, strategic collaboration. Influence the partners to implement the endpoints & webhooks to help automate internal & partner’s support operational teams by sending the data via API to our partner.
• Analyze the quality of the servicing we provide to our partners and their customers. Getting the feedback from partners and reviewing how internal procedures and SLAs help partners and their end-users get the most efficient service from Wise. Identify and raise the key improvement areas.

jobs.title: Senior Digital Analyst (Data Activation)
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Digital Analyst specialising in Marketing Data Activation to join our Digital Analytics team. This is a technical Individual Contributor role at the intersection of Digital Analytics, Marketing Technology and Data Engineering.

You’ll help us build and operate the data activation capabilities that allow Wise Marketing teams to safely use our first-party customer and event data across advertising platforms.

A big part of your role will focus on our Reverse ETL ecosystem: working with data in our data warehouse, building and improving SQL/dbt models, configuring activation pipelines, improving monitoring and helping ensure the data we send to Marketing platforms is accurate, reliable and well governed.

You’ll think about the whole system: where data comes from, how it is modelled, how customer marketing identifiers are resolved, how it is activated, how we know it arrived successfully and what happens when something breaks.

You’ll work closely with Analytics Engineers, Data Engineers, Marketing Analysts, Paid Media teams and other technical stakeholders to build a Marketing activation capability that is scalable, observable and easy to use.

You will also contribute to the wider Digital Analytics stack, including technologies such as Google Tag Manager, server-side tracking, Singular and other Marketing measurement and data infrastructure.

What you'll be doing
• You’ll take technical ownership of Paid Media activation through our data warehouse, Reverse ETL and the surrounding data ecosystem.
• You’ll help move us away from manual checks towards proper production monitoring and observability of our marketing activation pipelines.
• You’ll use SQL and dbt to build and maintain Marketing-specific datasets used for customer audiences, conversion signals and other activation use cases.
• You’ll work with Analytics Engineering and Data Engineering on modelling patterns, architecture and standards, while developing increasing ownership of the Marketing-specific transformation layer.
• When something goes wrong, you’ll help diagnose where in the chain the problem exists. You’ll take an end-to-end view of the service without needing to own every underlying system.
• You’ll help teams understand whether a requirement is best solved through warehouse-based activation, our real-time tracking stack, an MMP such as Singular, another integration pattern or work from an upstream Engineering/Data team.

jobs.title: Internal Comms Designer
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an experienced designer with strong presentation design skills (Figma/Google Slides) to join our in-house Brand and Creative team in London. You’ll bring order and craft to presentations and comms across Wise, building on-brand, scalable systems that elevate every team’s output — with the confidence to train nondesigners to use what you build, and to work closely with senior and C-suite stakeholders under pressure during peak periods.

The ideal candidate is an organised self-starter with at least 4 years of experience in similar in-house teams or branding agencies. We’re looking for a designer with strong craft, communication skills, attention to detail, and a positive, eager-to-learn attitude.

Your mission

Wise exists to build money without borders. Over a decade ago, we challenged the way the world moves money – cutting out hidden fees and making international finance simpler and fairer. Today, we help millions of people and businesses send, spend and manage money across countries with ease, making money simple, accessible and smart for everyone, everywhere.

The Brand and Creative team is made up of 25+ designers, motion designers, copywriters, strategists and creative ops managers based in London and Singapore. Our mission is to bring Wise’s story to life with clarity and creative excellence across every touchpoint. We work to ensure Wise is recognised and trusted worldwide, helping people and businesses move money faster, cheaper, and more transparently.

What you’ll do

The majority of this role will focus on:
• Designing presentations that strengthen our brand internally (Figma and Google Slides). Create visually engaging presentations for internal events and meetings, turning complex information into clear, compelling stories.
• Creating and evolving our presentation templates and systems (Figma and Google Slides). Develop and roll out easy-to-use templates and tools that empower colleagues across Wise to create consistent, on-brand work independently.

You’ll also:
• Design major company-wide events and conferences throughout the year. Collaborate with internal teams on presentations, event branding, signage, and print and digital communications—often with fast turnarounds.
• Work closely with senior stakeholders. Ask the right questions and simplify complex business and product updates, shaping them into impactful presentations for company-wide audiences.
• Support our workplace experience. Partner with the Workplace team to create signage, uniforms, and other branded materials for our offices.
• Provide design support for reports (InDesign). Create polished, on-brand reports and review materials using InDesign when needed.
• Use AI tools to accelerate your workflow. We’re actively incorporating AI into the way our team works, so you should be curious, comfortable experimenting, and keen to find smarter ways of working.

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Develop: You’ll be working with a talented and passionate bunch of designers, copywriters and animators. We’re a feedback friendly organisation and you’ll have loads of opportunities to learn and be challenged.
• Bring clarity: You’ll turn complexity into clear, confident narratives, working with senior and C-suite stakeholders
• Have impact: You’ll join our exciting mission to build money without borders and show people that Wise is the smartest way to manage their international money.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer I - Risk Control & Governance
jobs.description:
Job Description

We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Engineer to join the Risk & Control Governance team / Risk Assessment Group. You'll be instrumental in building the governance, assurance, and data foundations that ensure every risk decision at Wise is consistent, explainable, auditable, and continuously monitored.

This role works at the intersection of the Risk API platform, Product, and Financial Crime (FinCrime) teams — offering a unique opportunity to build the systems that give Wise confidence in every risk assessment it operates at scale.

You will be the driving force behind the platform's trustworthiness and integrity, focusing on:
• Data Governance: Building and maintaining data ownership, lineage, and quality monitoring systems that ensure every risk decision is powered by trusted data.
• Control Assurance: Designing continuous monitoring and validation systems that verify controls perform as intended — including trigger validation, drift detection, coverage analysis, and control health scoring.
• Auditability & Explainability: Implementing end-to-end audit trails, change history tracking, and explainability tooling that enables one-click regulatory evidence generation.
• Scalable Solutions: Designing robust, high-throughput solutions that handle large volumes of data and can be quickly understood and scaled across multiple distinct risk domains.

 

What will you be working on?

You will join the team at a pivotal moment, with your contributions being immediately visible and critical to the success of the entire Risk Assessment platform's governance layer.

The core challenge for the team — and your immediate focus — is to build the assurance and governance foundations that the platform currently lacks, ensuring every control can answer: Was the right trigger used? Was the right data available? Was the right decision made? Is the control still effective?

 

Your immediate impact will be to:
• Build Data Trust: Implement data quality monitoring, data contracts, and lineage tracking that give the organisation full traceability from risk decisions back to source data.
• Deliver Continuous Assurance: Design and build automated monitoring systems that continuously validate control effectiveness — detecting drift, false positives/negatives, and coverage gaps before they become incidents.
• Enable Auditability: Create audit trail infrastructure and explainability tooling that dramatically reduces the effort required for regulatory reporting and compliance evidence generation.
• Integrate with Risk API: Work closely with the Risk API team to embed governance and assurance capabilities into the core platform, ensuring clean integration points and shared data contracts.

Qualifications

What do you need?
• Strong Backend Engineering: Proven experience building high-throughput, data-intensive systems in any language. Hands-on expertise with Kafka, SQL and NoSQL databases, and designing for scale and reliability.
• Data Engineering Aptitude: Experience with data quality frameworks, pipeline orchestration, or lineage tracking. You understand what it takes to make data trustworthy at scale.
• Systems Thinking: Ability to reason about complex distributed systems, identify failure modes, and design solutions that are both robust and operationally simple.
• Ownership & Autonomy: Comfortable operating with ambiguity, defining your own work from high-level objectives, and driving delivery end-to-end without close direction.
• Collaborative Mindset: Ability to work effectively across team boundaries — particularly with the Risk API team, Product, and FinCrime stakeholders — to align on contracts, data models, and integration patterns.

Additional information

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

jobs.title: Channel Sales Manager - APAC
jobs.description:
Channel Sales at Wise Platform is a high-growth function. As part of our strategy to scale globally, we are expanding the team with a dedicated manager based in Singapore to look at scaling the function in APAC. 

Our team’s goal is to accelerate the adoption of Wise Platform by leveraging a trusted strategic channel partner ecosystem to win new deals, shorten sales cycles, and scale through channels.

As the Channel Sales Manager (APAC), you will build, scale, and operationalise our channel sales function across the region. You will focus on identifying, structuring, and nurturing relationships across top-tier core banking providers, payment platforms, system integrators (SIs), and strategic consultancies.

Key Responsibilities
• Channel Partnership Enablement & Operations: Own the governance, cross-market APAC coordination, and end-to-end lifecycle of new and existing partners - including commercial alignment, technical onboarding, contracting and launch.
• Core Banking & Vendor Ecosystem Development: Identify and build strategic relationships with top-tier core banking providers and payment platforms to create pre-integrated connectors and scalable GTM pathways.
• System Integrator & Consultancy Strategy: Build and execute go-to-market alliances with global and regional SIs and consultancies that deploy technology for banks across Southeast Asia, India, and the broader APAC region.
• BD Alignment & Pipeline Generation: Work closely with the Business Development team - passing on qualified leads, partner-sourced opportunities, and account intelligence collected through channel activities to accelerate direct deal flows.
• Ecosystem Assessment & Immediate Impact: Take immediate ownership of active regional partner relationships and execute a comprehensive ecosystem assessment across APAC players to map out high-priority channel partners, starting with system integrators across SEA and India.
• Commercial Metrics & KPIs: Drive key commercial success metrics, targeting partner-sourced pipeline, time-to-live through repeatable integrations, and long-term transaction volume flowing through APAC channels.

What You Will Learn & Career Growth
• High-Visibility Impact: Work directly alongside APAC commercial leads and global leadership to shape and scale the regional channel strategy from the ground up.
• Cross-Functional Exposure: Collaborate daily across BD, Pre-Sales, Product, Engineering, Finance, and Legal to build scalable commercial models.
• Industry Transformation: Drive long-term impact on Wise Platform’s sales opportunities and sales cycle by shifting regional GTM from direct outreach to scalable, pre-integrated partner channels.

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Engineer - Customer Risk Assessment
jobs.description:
At Wise, we’re on a mission to make financial services faster, simpler, and more accessible for everyone. But to achieve our mission, we also need to safeguard our platform against financial crime and ensure our customers' money is safe.

For our customers, using Wise is as simple as sending money from A to B. Yet behind our app and website is a complex engine that must navigate strict regulatory requirements worldwide. The Customer Risk Assessment team is at the absolute core of this effort. We are building the centralized platform that gives Wise deep visibility into any customer and their associated financial crime (fincrime) risk. By tying together all fincrime topologies into a unified view, we empower teams to make fast, accurate decisions.

Your mission will be to help build out this centralized platform, tying complex risk signals together while also owning the common components of risk mitigation. You will directly impact how Wise scales its compliance operations, enabling us to move with speed and confidence without ever compromising on the safety of our customers.

How we work:

We’re a cross-functional team of backend and frontend engineers working hand-in-hand with Product Managers, Analysts, and Designers. Collaboration is at the heart of what we do. We value ownership, open feedback, and a commitment to building stable, scalable systems while embracing fast-paced learning and iteration.

We operate with a belief in automation, programmatic implementation, and reusable design. We’re looking for engineers who can step back and think holistically about the entire fincrime ecosystem, but also follow through and help implement the design. You won't just be handed a list of Jira tickets; you will be expected to understand the underlying problems, challenge the proposed solutions, and propose simple, effective solutions that protect our customers' money.

What will you be working on?:

You’ll be having a real-world impact by building the systems that enable Wise to evaluate customer risk globally. Specifically, you will:
• Build the full stack: Design, develop, and deploy resilient backend microservices in Java (Spring Boot) and build intuitive, accessible frontends using React and TypeScript.
• Create a 360-degree risk view: Build the centralized tools that aggregate data across multiple fincrime topologies, giving our teams full visibility into customer risk profiles.
• Drive risk mitigation: Own and develop the common components of our risk mitigation handling, ensuring our Servicing Agents have scalable, standardized workflows.
• Scale operations: Break down complex bottlenecks in our servicing and compliance processes, delivering adaptable platform solutions that other Wise product teams can evolve to fit their specific needs.
• Take ownership: Take full ownership of the product journey—from identifying a problem and empathizing with stakeholders, to creating an execution plan and shipping it to production.

jobs.title: Internal Audit Manager - Fincrime
jobs.description:
We are looking for an Internal Audit Manager (FinCrime) to join our specialist FinCrime team within Wise Internal Audit. The FinCrime team has a global remit and works collaboratively with regional teams. This role is based in Singapore.

Your main task will be completing financial crime internal audits. You will be responsible for planning, assigning, and supervising the operational activities of the team as well as completing your own tasks. You will make recommendations to improve governance, risk management and internal controls. Your responsibilities will vary audit to audit and will include completing design and operating effectiveness testing yourself, as well as oversight of other team members. 

You will also complete issue validation testing by designing and conducting testing of implemented control improvements. 

The role presents a great opportunity to focus on the development and delivery of audit engagements in a fast paced environment, focussed on data driven audit techniques and continuous auditing. Relevant experience working in assurance, risk or control roles and deploying technology enabled assurance is key to driving the internal audit agenda.

Your mission
• Support the implementation and operation of the internal audit assurance framework.
• Deliver audits per the audit plan to ensure timely and relevant audit outcomes.
• Support building a strong and self-sufficient internal audit team.
• Monitor the implementation of Internal Audit recommendations by the teams and measure the effectiveness of the improvements.
• Develop strong relationships with key stakeholders, internally and externally.

A bit about you

Skills:
• You have proven experience working in risk, control or assurance and you want to continuously improve how to get the job done.
• You can plan and scope audits including designing and executing comprehensive, risk based test plans and identify areas for improvement in well written reports. Your work meets quality standards and you can oversee others to do the same.
• You seek to use data analytics and technology in your work and decision making processes. Practical experience in data analytics preferred.
• You demonstrate attention to detail but can summarise key messages succinctly, verbally and in writing, adjusting your style and level of information based on the target audience.
• You have a good understanding of the current financial crime regulatory environment, including Corruption, Drug Trafficking and Other Serious Crimes (Confiscation of Benefits) Act (CDSA), Financial Services and Markets Act 2022 (FSMA), Wolfsberg guidance and MAS guidance.
• You have strong experience and specialism in financial crime topics including FinCrime risk management, KYC/KYB, Customer and Enhanced Due Diligence, Fraud, Transaction Monitoring, Screening and Reporting.
• You are able to work independently, you assume responsibility and you make your own judgement.
• You take ownership over complex areas and solve problems with no or very limited guidance and know when to escalate and ask for support.
• You have very strong coordination skills and you are able to hold teams accountable for meeting deadlines and delivering high quality outputs.
• You are agile and adaptable to change.
• You are collaborative - you enjoy sharing your knowledge and upskilling others.

jobs.title: Brex Rotational Program
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

The Brex Rotational Program

Throughout this 18-20 month program, you'll rotate through two of our G A teams, learning about areas such as risk management, finance, automation, and data analysis. You'll contribute to critical process improvements and developments, implementing our processes while leveraging AI to streamline workflows and enhance decision-making.

You'll challenge the status quo, bringing insights from each rotation to the next to improve cross-team communication and efficiency. We believe in a founder mindset — and this program is designed to show you how you can take ownership of your growth. During each rotation, you'll complete a core project focused on key data insights, process implementation, or process improvement—many of which will involve exploring and applying AI solutions. You'll then have the opportunity to share your findings with your program class and Brex Executives.

The program is supported by our leadership team, and you'll have frequent meetings with various Brex leaders. This provides a unique opportunity to work closely with and learn from executives who are at the forefront of building an AI-native company.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Vancouver office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Handle day-to-day tasks efficiently.
• Analyze business inefficiencies and propose process improvements to leadership, leveraging AI to drive solutions.

jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Engineering at Brex

Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams span Software, Data, Security, and IT, and operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration. We tackle hard technical problems, own our outcomes, and push for excellence at every level — from architecture to deployment. It’s an environment where engineering is a craft, and builders become leaders.

What you’ll do

As a Salesforce Lead, you will be responsible for designing, testing, implementing, and supporting the Salesforce PaaS/Saas at Brex. You will work closely with functional leaders, organizational units, and subject matter experts to identify, develop and deploy new business processes including: Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, Customer Account Management, IT and core business processes. We’re searching for someone with a record of success aligning business processes with Salesforce best practices, translating business requirements into technical specifications, and implementing the solutions. 

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our New York office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Work collaboratively with functional business units and help translate business requirements into logical technical designs; defining technical solutions in Salesforce.com to support business work processes and bring the design to life through declarative or programmatic solutions
• Participate in cross-functional teams that address strategic business issues across departments (Marketing, Sales, Operations, Support, and others as needed) aligning business processes with Salesforce best practices
• Coordinate the evaluation, scope and completion of new development requests
• Use advanced declarative and programmatic tools to design, build, test, deploy, and support Salesforce solutions
• Coding and development according to current industry standards and best practices
• Manage change management and deployment process for Salesforce code base
• Conduct code reviews for ongoing projects to ensure high code quality and design patterns are followed

Requirements
• 7+ years of progressive experience in Salesforce development with Salesforce implementations in a complex B2B environment
• Ability to assess the impact of new requirements on Salesforce.com and all upstream and downstream applications, systems and processes
• Strong understanding of the Salesforce platform, with the ability to build custom apps and objects, formula fields, workflows, custom views, and other content of intermediate complexity
• Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills with the ability to work with key stakeholders across the organization; manage laterally and upward
• Ability to communicate effectively with diverse people and individuals at various levels within the organization
• Familiarity with advanced Apex programming concepts including core design patterns, limits and bulk patterns, efficient and reliable trigger handling, asynchronous operations and effective unit testing
• Experience with Salesforce APIs to integrate Salesforce with other tools and third-party applications
• Expertise using key Salesforce core programming languages (Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components, HTML, XML, JavaScript, CSS, AJAX, SOQL, RestAPIs)
• Experience with CI/CD and deployment techniques in Salesforce
• English proficiency/fluency, both written and speaking (note: interviews will be conducted in English)

Bonus points
• Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I, Platform Developer II, Architect)
• Experience building Slack applications and integrating with Slack
• Experience working in a SCRUM or Agile methodology
• Previous non-Salesforce software engineering experience
• University or College Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or related experience
• Front-end development experience with HTML, CSS, and the Lightning Design System
• Experience as a Salesforce Administrator or Business Analyst

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $240,000 - $300,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? Coinbase is building the future of finance for people, institutions and their agents, with one place to trade crypto, equities, derivatives and prediction markets, use stablecoins, and connect AI agents with clear controls. The bar is high and the pace is intense, and we like it that way. This isn’t a place for complacency. It’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits and do the best work of your career. If you’re ready to build the future of finance with a championship team who refuse to settle for “good enough,” you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for in-person working sessions

This is a 12-week internship during summer
2027. You'll join Coinbase as a software engineer intern and help build the next generation of crypto-forward products and features. You'll solve large-scale, complex technical problems at the intersection of web-scale applications and blockchain technology, shipping real code that impacts millions of users.

During the application process, you'll select your preferred team from the groups below. Your application will be primarily considered for your selected team in the specified location. Following the hybrid internship, any full-time return opportunity would be remote-first.

Product Group Teams (internship location = San Francisco):
• Base - Scale the crypto economy by creating integrations, fiat onramps, and developer tools on Coinbase's Ethereum L2 network, connecting builders to 108M+ users and $100B+ in assets.
• Consumer - Build the fastest way to access crypto through the Coinbase retail and wallet apps, advanced trade, dApps, and staking.
• Developer - Help build out Coinbase Developer Platform - trusted crypto infrastructure at scale. Payments, Wallets, Trading, and Stablecoin APIs for the global financial system.
• Institutional - Enable thousands of large financial institutions to securely custody digital assets, stake, and participate in the crypto economy.
• Platform - Create the scalable, compliant foundational systems (Identity, FinHub, Payments, Blockchain and Infrastructure) that underpin all Coinbase products.
• Enterprise AI - Build AI-powered tools and platforms that boost employee productivity and collaboration, partnering with ML, IT, and HR to bring custom and third-party AI solutions into everyday workflows.
• Enterprise Engineering (EE) - Develop platforms that enhance customer support, internal tools and compliance through automation and customer-first engineering.

Core Teams (internship location = New York City):
• Security - Build solutions for critical security, compliance, and privacy needs, including the Workforce IAM Platform and security oversight tooling.

What you'll do:
• Write high-quality, well-tested code that ships to production and directly impacts Coinbase customers.
• Collaborate with engineers, designers, and product managers to turn technical and product vision into delivered features.
• Participate in code reviews, providing and receiving feedback that raises the quality bar for your team.
• Own a defined project end-to-end, from scoping through implementation and launch, within your 12-week internship.
• Learn and apply crypto and blockchain domain concepts to real engineering problems in a production environment.

Required Skills and

Experience:
• Demonstrates the ability to responsibly use generative AI tools and copilots (e.g., LibreChat, Gemini, Glean) in daily workflows, continuously learn as tools evolve, and apply human‑in‑the‑loop practices to deliver business‑ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in efficiency, cost, and quality.
• Programming experience in any language (academic, personal projects, or professional).
• Demonstrated ability to break down ambiguous problems into concrete implementation steps.
• Familiarity with at least one of: web development, mobile development, backend systems, or infrastructure.
• Utilize generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Serving nearly 4 million Canadians from coast to coast, we offer a wide variety of financial services from banking and lending, to trust and credit union solutions. 

We've been at this since 1970, challenging the conventions of traditional banking with smarter, faster, and more connected financial experiences.

What's kept us moving? The people behind it all: challengers who ask better questions, push back on old assumptions, and look for a better way forward.

If you're driven to help reshape how banking works for Canadians and the businesses that power our economy, this could be your next big opportunity. 

We can’t wait to get to know you! 

The Work
 
As part of a growing and dynamic commercial team, the Commercial Mortgage Analyst is responsible for underwriting annual reviews for CMHC-insured commercial mortgages. The Underwriter must adhere to established policies and underwriting standards, meeting compliance and control requirements, while finding creative solutions in a timely manner in order to achieve service goals as well as annual target volumes. Additional credit-related and administrative duties are also required such as reporting and pipeline management as well as networking with external business partners along with various staff within the Commercial department & other internal departments.

💰 Competitive discretionary bonus

The incumbent will be working hybrid and in office time will be spent working from EQ Bank’s additional office space located at 2200-25 Ontario Street, Toronto, ON.

We believe our organization is stronger — and our people thrive — when we honour and celebrate diverse experiences, identities, and perspectives. We provide a barrier‑free recruitment process and work environment. If you require accommodations at any stage, we will work with you to ensure you can bring your best self to the process and beyond.
As part of our recruitment process, EQ uses AI to help screen, assess, and/or select applicants for this position. All AI-enabled outputs are reviewed and validated by our talent team. All candidates considered for hire must successfully complete a criminal background check and credit check. While we appreciate every application, an EQ recruiter will contact only those whose skills and experience most closely match the requirements of the role.

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

About the role

The Senior Business Analyst plays a key role in shaping the growth and success of Moniepoint’s payment products. You'll design, test, and implement strategies that improve user acquisition, boost retention, and elevate product engagement. This role blends deep quantitative analysis with collaborative, strategic thinking. You'll partner with teams across the business to ensure our payment solutions meet real market demands and grow efficiently as we scale. Ultimately, you'll make sure our products not only attract users but also scale sustainably to create financial happiness for everyone.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

Key Responsibilities
• Partner closely with product managers, business development, and data engineering teams to help our growth team uncover problems and make product metrics highly visible.
• Translate complex product and business questions into simple, actionable insights.
• Build, maintain, and scale self-service dashboards and custom visualisation tools.
• Own end-to-end analytics for our growth products—from gathering data requirements and estimating opportunity sizes to designing experiments and conducting post-launch impact reviews.
• Cultivate trusted relationships across teams, acting as a collaborative link between technology, business, and product.
• Apply advanced mathematical and statistical modelling techniques (including A/B tests, multivariate testing, clustering, and supervised learning) to solve practical business problems that drive high-impact results.

Qualifications
• 3 to 4 years of professional experience (excluding academic projects and internships) in a quantitative analysis role within high-scale tech companies, tier-1 consulting firms, or investment banks with strong programming demands.
• Excellent SQL skills (which we will test during our interview process).
• Practical experience designing, running, and analysing experiments on digital products (such as A/B and multivariate tests).
• Hands-on experience with popular visualisation tools like Tableau or Looker.
• Experience applying statistical modelling and advanced analytics to deliver practical, product-shaping insights.
• Strong skills in statistical programming (Python) and familiarity with tools like Pandas, SciPy, and Jupyter notebooks.
• Clear, professional spoken and written English.

Additional skills
• Product management
• Analytics
• Marketing
• Data Science
• Design
• Customer Success

What we can offer you
• Culture - We put our people first and prioritise every team member's well-being. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
• Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
• Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.

What to expect in the hiring process
• A preliminary phone call with one of our recruiters.
• A panel interview with a member of the hiring team.
• A behavioural and technical interview with a member of the Executive team

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. About the Opportunity

AI is not a feature at OKX. It is the next fundamental layer of how we serve users, operate at scale, and maintain trust in a regulated, global market.

We are hiring a Senior Directort of Product, AI Agent (Chatbot) to own OKX's full AI product agenda — outward, through a crypto-native AI assistant that transforms how users experience our platform; and inward, through agentic systems that make our operations intelligent, auditable, and scalable. This is a single role with a unified mandate: building the AI layer that defines OKX's next decade.

 

What You’ll Be Doing 

User-Facing AI Lead the strategy and execution of OKX's conversational AI assistant — an experience that lets users onboard, trade, stay informed, and get support through natural language. You will define what this product is, how it earns user trust, and how it deepens over time.

 

Operational AI Agent Systems Own the agentic AI roadmap for OKX's internal functions — compliance, risk, fraud, and operations. You will identify the highest-leverage workflows, lead their systematic transformation into agent-driven systems, and ensure every output is traceable and regulatorily defensible.

 

AI Platform Own the product design of shared infrastructure that powers both mandates — orchestration, evaluation, safety architecture, and the governance layer that makes AI products configurable and auditable across all markets.

What We Look For In You
• 12+ years in product tech, with 5+ years in a senior leadership role owning technically complex products at scale
• Proven track record shipping conversational AI or agentic AI products — as the owner, not a contributor
• Deep familiarity with LLM product architecture: multi-agent systems, RAG, tool use, evaluation, and safety design
• Experience operating in regulated environments where auditability and explainability are hard requirements
• Strong consumer product instinct alongside operational product rigor
• Fluency in financial markets and what it takes to earn user and institutional trust
• Executive-level communication in English and Mandarin

Nice-To-Haves
• Background in crypto, fintech, or financial services at global scale
• Graduate degree in a technical field
• Experience with successful Conversational AI or Agentic AI products 

Why this role

OKX operates at a scale where the gap between what AI can do and what we have built is still enormous. This role exists to close that gap — on both sides of the platform, simultaneously. If that is the kind of problem you want to own, we want to talk.
