jobs.title: Tax Manager
jobs.description:
You’ll be part of a commercially-minded Tax team, helping to ensure our tax affairs are efficient, transparently compliant and slick so that our mission is sustainable.

Your mission:

As Tax Manager, you will function as the regional subject matter expert for various stakeholders and ensure overall compliance with reporting, remediation and improve the management of U.S. and Canadian tax operations. Your core responsibilities will include:
• Manage the outsourced preparation of U.S. federal and state corporate tax compliance, and Canadian tax computations across direct tax. This includes managing the relationship with outsourced service providers and the maintenance of supporting documentation, review of tax returns, quarterly estimated payments, and extensions.
• Assist with the preparation of ASC740 and local GAAP tax disclosures and provisioning including return-to-provision, valuation allowance analysis and UTP tracking.
• Manage tax audit and examinations, including responses to tax authority inquiries and information requests.
• Assist tax-related SOX internal controls, maintain master tax calendars, and ensure complete adherence to all statutory and internal filing deadlines.
• Work closely with financial controllers, accounting, and finance system teams for sources of data and information, including directly extracting information from our ERP system, improving tax data accuracy and identifying opportunities to enhance and automate tax processes.
• Engage in team-wide initiatives including budgeting, forecasting, planning, risks and controls. It is important to be interested and engaged in all tax initiatives and to work closely with all members of the tax team.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (IC3 - Backend)
jobs.description:
About Servicing Platform

At Wise, we are on a mission to build money without borders -instant, convenient, transparent and eventually free. Behind every transaction lies a critical responsibility: holding over £20B+ in customer balances, moving £145B+ across borders annually and protecting innocent customers from fraudsters, sanctioned entities and financial crime.

The Servicing Platform sits at the very heart of this mission. We build the foundational identity engines, high-throughput risk platforms and real-time APIs that power all customer servicing, onboarding and risk decisions across Wise globally.

As Wise expands its engineering presence in Hyderabad, we are building core execution capability to modernize our identity and risk infrastructure. As a Backend Engineer (IC3), you will tackle real-time scale challenges, execute complex system migrations and onboard products to next-generation risk APIs that gate billions in cross-currency volume.

What You Will Be Working On

You will join a high-velocity engineering squad focused on platform adoption and system reliability:
• Platform Implementation & Migrations: Drive the hands-on technical integration of Wise products onto our modernized Identity, Account and Risk APIs. You will unblock product and FinCrime squads by executing key migrations such as deprecating legacy models and services and improving integrations into Fin Crime domains.
• High-Performance Infrastructure: Build, maintain and optimize low-latency, high-availability microservices. You’ll work toward achieving sub second risk check speeds for real-time transactions.
• Data Lineage & Governance: Implement robust schemas, data contracts and immutable data flows to ensure complete auditability and data consistency across the full customer and transaction lifecycle.
• Operational Excellence: Maintain the operational health (SLAs/SLOs, monitoring, alerting) of critical platform components. Participate in incident resolution and post-mortems to ensure zero downtime for money moving out of Wise.
• Global Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams (Product, FinCrime, Risk Assessment) and engineering peers across London, Tallinn and Hyderabad.

jobs.title: Procurement Operations Manager
jobs.description:
As the Procurement Operations Manager at Wise, you will not just be managing the procurement process + system; you will also be involved with building the architecture of our procurement infrastructure. You will be a key contributor in Wise’s end-to-end source-to-pay (S2P) transformation, deploying procurement processes, and establishing governance that balances compliance with agility. Alongside this strategic build, you will own the day-to-day BAU Procurement operations—ensuring the smooth execution of daily PR/PO lifecycles, resolving system bottlenecks, and maintaining high data integrity to support the business uninterrupted. This role requires a blend of strategic building and hands-on execution. 

 

Key Responsibilities
1. Procurement Operations
• Manage the E2E processes on our Procurement/TPM tool “Omnea” and identify + resolve bottlenecks and/or bugs.
• Own vendor master data integrity, vendor onboarding, and the purchase order (PO) approval workflow.
• Act as Procurement’s system administrator and super-user for our Procurement/TPM tool “Omnea”, owning all Procurement processes within the system & ensuring seamless integrations with ERP (BC) and AP system (Medius).
• Drive the Wise Procurement Standards, ensuring all buying activities follow the correct buying channels and treatment strategies.
• Build dashboards and reporting mechanisms to track key operational metrics, pipeline visibility, and contract renewal schedules and enable the Category Management team.
• Manage and optimise global buying channels (e.g., punch-outs, hosted catalogs, P-Cards, and purchase orders) to ensure intuitive user experiences and high compliance.
• Tail Spend Management: Develop and execute strategies to actively manage and reduce tail spend, vendor consolidation and moving ad-hoc spend into structured buying channels - negotiating where applicable.
• Author and maintain comprehensive, Procurement standard operating procedures (SOPs), process and governance documentation to comply with internal controls and external audit requirements.
2. Process & Infrastructure Design
• Manage change management initiatives associated with new procurement processes, policies, or technology rollouts, ensuring high adoption across internal stakeholders and external suppliers.
• Create clear, UX friendly procurement processes and playbooks that ensure compliance whilst balancing agility and speed.
• Design and deploy a comprehensive matrix of corporate buying channels (including punch-outs, hosted catalogs and guided buying pathways). Ensure these channels are UX friendly, intuitively structured to automatically route spend to Wise’s preferred suppliers to minimize maverick buying, and maximize touchless processing across the organization.
3. Vendor Risk & Compliance
• In partnership with Third Party Risk and key SMEs, ensure our Procurement process operates within a robust Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) framework suitable for a regulated financial entity.
• Ensure all operational procurement activities align with financial regulations (e.g., SOX, SOC2, FCA, GDPR, DORA, where applicable).
• Manage the operational lifecycle of critical vendors, tracking SLAs, performance, and compliance metrics.
• Procurement Controls Management: Design, implement, and monitor procurement operational controls, conducting regular self-assessments to detect and remediate control gaps prior to formal audits.
• Compliance Automation: Partner with TPRM and TPM Tech to automate compliance checks within the S2P process to minimize human error and manual overheads.
4. Stakeholder Enablement & Culture
• Act as the primary bridge between key stakeholders involved in the S2P process e.g Finance, Legal, InfoSec, and budget holders.
• Train the organization on how to buy goods and services efficiently, shifting the perception of procurement from a "blocker" to an enabler.

jobs.title: Senior Product Analyst (IC2), SEND
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Product Analyst who’s passionate about our mission — Money Without Borders — to join our Global Send Experience team.

The team’s goal is to make sending money across borders and domestically feel seamless, almost magical. Send is Wise’s original product, and the insights you uncover will shape decisions affecting millions of customers and billions of pounds in money moving.

We’re also expanding the ways people can move money across borders. You’ll help us understand where customers need new ways to send, and turn those opportunities into products and experiences. Working closely with the Product Manager and Engineering Lead, you’ll help shape the strategy, prioritize features and guide the product from early ideas through launch and global scale. This is a chance to help build what comes next for Send from the ground up.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

You’ll help the Global Send Experience team understand how people send money today, where the experience falls short, and what new ways of moving money customers need.
• Find opportunities: Combine customer, product and market data to uncover friction in the sending experience and new cross-border use cases we could support.
• Shape what we build: Work with Product Managers, Engineers and other Analysts to size opportunities, test assumptions and help the team choose what to prioritize.
• Measure what matters: Define success measures for your area, monitor how they change, and make sure the team can trust the data behind them.
• Learn through experimentation: Design and analyze experiments and other evaluations to understand whether product changes make a meaningful difference for customers.
• Influence decisions: Turn analysis into clear recommendations, explain the trade-offs and help the team act on what it learns.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING
• Strong SQL skills and experience working with large, complex datasets.
• Experience using data to shape product decisions, from defining a problem and sizing an opportunity to measuring the results.
• A sound understanding of experimentation and statistics, and experience applying them in a product context. Python or R experience is useful.
• The ability to explain complex findings clearly and tailor your recommendations to different audiences.
• Curiosity about customer behavior and the judgment to distinguish a useful insight from an interesting number.

NICE TO HAVE
• Experience helping launch a new product, feature or product line.
• Experience with analytics tools such as Looker, Tableau or Power BI.
• Experience improving data instrumentation or building reliable transformations and pipelines.

***Please note we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this level***

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer II
jobs.description:
Wise helps banks, software companies, and large enterprises use Wise's infrastructure to offer their customers cross-border payment products through our API. We're a cross-functional team across sales, implementation, product, engineering, compliance, and analytics, based in New York, London, and Singapore.

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer II to join our Partner Experience team in London.

The Partner Experience team builds and runs the systems that let enterprise partners go live faster and manage their day-to-day operations in one place. 

We own the Partner Portal (used by many big banks to manage transfers, report fraud, handle compliance requests, and manage their teams) and the backend services behind partner onboarding, permissions, and communication. Most of what we build is new. There's no existing playbook for enterprise partner tooling at this scale, so you'll be designing systems from scratch more often than maintaining existing ones.

 

What will you be working on?:
• Backend microservices for partner-facing features: fraud reporting, case management, RFI handling, audit logging, and transaction visibility.
• The permissions and role-based access control system that governs what partners can do in the portal.
• SSO (SAML 2.0) integration for enterprise partners, including solving identity mapping between partner systems and Wise.
• The communication layer services between Wise and partners, extending them to handle new case types and workflows.
• API design for partner-facing endpoints. We care about consistency, documentation, and making them usable without hand-holding.
• Work with FinCrime, Compliance, and KYC teams to bring sanctions RFI workflows and fraud reporting into the portal.
• Technical discovery: mapping existing systems, evaluating dependencies, producing design documents that become the team's source of truth.
• Production support and debugging when live partner issues come up.

jobs.title: FinCrime Operations Team Lead - Screening
jobs.description:
Role & Job purpose

As a FinCrime Operations Team Lead - Sanctions you will develop and oversee the daily operations of a team of FinCrime Operations Analysts or Specialists. Your primary purpose is to ensure the effective mitigation of financial crime risks associated with Wise's customers, while maintaining a strong focus on operational efficiency, regulatory compliance and a customer-centric approach. You will foster a high-performing team, drive operational excellence, and act as a subject matter expert in KYC/AML/Fraud/Screening and financial crime prevention. You will be responsible for ensuring your team meets performance targets, maintains or elevates quality standards, and contributes to a culture of continuous improvement within the FinCrime Operations organization.

The FinCrime Operations Team Lead is a dual-focused leader, combining strong people leadership with domain and operational expertise. You will be instrumental in building and refining processes that prioritise customer impact while maintaining focus on the evolving risks within the financial services industry, specific product vulnerabilities, and the requirements set by regulations and partners. This includes supporting the development of compliant and scalable processes and possessing an understanding of financial crime risks associated with our customers, products, and tooling.

 

Job Responsibilities

 

Team Leadership

You will lead by example, driving a customer-focused mindset across your team and the wider fincrime organization. You are instrumental in fostering a high-performance, results-driven culture defined by strong ownership and accountability. This involves building and nurturing high-performing teams that value knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and adaptability in our change-oriented environment. Fincrime Operations Team Lead demonstrates strong capabilities in timely conflict resolution and fosters open communication and guides effective mediation to ensure a positive working environment. You should be visible and actively engaged in team management. Your focus is on unifying the team behind shared goals (and wider FinCrime/servicing strategies) and driving collective actions.

 

People management

Coach and develop a strong team of FinCrime Operations Analysts or Specialists with varying levels of experience, providing tailored guidance, and taking swift, decisive action to manage performance issues effectively, ensuring sustained excellence and growth. Provide regular, constructive, and actionable feedback to your direct reports. Coach and mentor team members to support their growth, develop their skills, and help them reach their full potential. Design and manage performance or development plans in identified areas. Conduct career map check-ins and make recommendations for demotions, promotions, salary raises, and other role related decisions.

 

Operational management

You will oversee the daily operations of the team, ensuring adherence to relevant regulations and internal policies and processes. Identify and propose opportunities for process and tooling improvements. Collaborate with central functions and other operational teams as needed to increase operational efficiency or to ensure effective cross-team collaboration on joint initiatives. Provide guidance and support on complex, high-risk cases and escalations. Be on top of timely admin related tasks including but not limited to scheduling, training, hiring, interviewing, organising team activities, and others.

 

Performance management

Measure team and individual KPIs and ensure performance targets and quality standards are consistently met while maintaining focus on customer experience and adherence to internal guidelines. Drive high-quality results for both the team and individuals, continuously enhancing overall quality outcomes. Conduct timely quality reviews, ensuring high decision accuracy and effectively communicate the importance of quality assurance. Conduct regular and impactful one on one coaching sessions (usually on a weekly or biweekly basis), provide clear and actionable feedback. Ensure tasks are managed timely and aligned with the team’s goals. Run team meetings to ensure that your team is kept up to date with the latest information, share best practices and enhance overall team spirit. Addresses underperformance promptly through coaching and setting SMART goals, and ensures all interventions are well-documented. Understand and be able to articulate how to move key metrics at team and individual level through efficient performance and task management.

 

Expertise sharing

Be a subject matter expert in financial crime areas with the ability to obtain and maintain sufficient subject matter expertise required to train, develop and coach your team. Maintain a comprehensive understanding of our regulatory obligations, internal policies, domain-specific processes and best practices. Apply a risk-based approach to deterring and preventing money laundering and financial crime. Perform and support deep dives, understand root causes of problematic cases and propose solutions to senior leadership. Assist senior leadership with reviews and developing our processes, task management and in other operational areas as requested to ensure compliant and effective servicing function

 

Issue Management and Escalation 

Escalate tooling or processing incidents, high-risk customer issues, control weaknesses, or other material problems to direct leadership in a timely and informative manner, following established protocols.

 

Planning and execution

Be accountable for driving your direct team's performance outcomes, ensuring key performance indicators (KPIs) are consistently met and enhanced. Possess strong knowledge of team processes and tooling, leveraging data to support initiative execution. This involves taking full ownership of your team's results, setting targets for improvement, and providing insights to stakeholders. Set and progress towards goals, adeptly identifying and resolving blockers or issues, whether performance or metric-related, to optimize output and results.

 

Stakeholder management and communication

Collaborate closely with stakeholders ensuring clear communication and coordination of actions. Your initiatives and reports are well documented and you choose the right platforms to communicate to a wider audience in a timely manner. The documentation has a clear scope and includes potential impact in different areas. You can communicate confidently with difficult stakeholders on varied operational or domain related topics. Proactively work on improving cross-team communication and collaboration, acting as the liaison between different layers of the organization and your own team. Employ impactful and inspiring communication skills, unifying individuals behind shared goals, and leverage strong presentation skills to convey vision and progress.

Other: Perform additional tasks as assigned by your lead, demonstrating adaptability and a proactive approach. This includes actively participating in meetings, trainings, workshops, and internal events to support broader team and company objectives.

jobs.title: Head of SOX Testing
jobs.description:
About the team (Finance Risk & Control)

Finance Risk & Control partners with Finance and the wider business to strengthen the control environment, support SOX compliance, and improve how risks and controls are designed, operated and evidenced. We’re a distributed team across the UK and Estonia, and we’re building a SOX testing hub in Hyderabad to increase consistency, quality and scalability of our testing programme.

What you’ll be doing (responsibilities)

Own the SOX business process controls testing programme (end-to-end)
• Build and run the annual and interim testing plan across all in-scope business process controls.
• Plan when testing occurs and ensure sequencing reflects process dependencies, change activity, and auditor timelines.
• Deliver both Design Effectiveness and Operating Effectiveness testing to a consistently high standard.

Methodology, quality, and audit readiness
• Own and continuously improve the testing methodology, templates, sampling guidance, and evidence standards.
• Perform QA reviews to ensure testing is complete, well-documented, and auditor-ready.
• Ensure consistent conclusions and a strong “why” behind pass/fail outcomes.

Auditor partnership and external reporting
• Be a key interface for the external auditor on business process testing: align approach, share results, coordinate walkthroughs/re-performance support, and respond to questions efficiently.
• Present testing outcomes clearly in governance packs and formal forums.

Manage external resources / co-sourcing
• Manage external testing resources: onboarding to Wise methodology, allocation, progress tracking, and quality/performance oversight.
• Ensure external capacity reduces bottlenecks without creating rework or inconsistencies.

Issue management and remediation governance
• Oversee how issues are agreed (severity, impact, root cause) and ensure remediation plans are practical, measurable, and owned.
• Track progress and coordinate re-testing / closure requirements.

Minimise burden on the business
• Build a low-friction evidence request process and smart scheduling to reduce disruption for process owners.
• Drive clarity and predictability: stakeholders know what’s needed, when, and why.

Build the Hyderabad testing capability
• This is the first testing hire in Hyderabad; you’ll help build the operating model and then hire/lead a team of 6+ testers.
• Coach and develop the team; embed standards, consistency, and stakeholder partnership.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

About the Team

OKX's Legal team provides legal advice and guidance to the company across all coverage areas and geographic locations, and supports business growth and development by working with all teams within the company to help them achieve their goals. We are a high-functioning, collaborative and fast-paced group of lawyers who enjoy the cutting-edge nature of our work and the digital assets industry.

 

Sitting in the Legal department, the Corporate Investigations team investigates fraud, misconduct and abuse committed against OKX. The team includes experienced investigators, among them former federal agents, and partners closely with the Compliance, Risk, Finance, and HR departments, colleagues in the Legal department, and business executives across OKX's global footprint.

About the Opportunity

This is a senior, high-impact role for a former federal prosecutor who wants to build and lead a global investigations function. The Head of Corporate Investigations will be the single accountable owner for investigating wrongdoing against OKX and developing these matters for appropriate recovery and civil or criminal enforcement as warranted.

 

As OKX's most senior investigations leader, you will set the standard for how the company uncovers and responds to wrongdoing, leading investigations that reflect the highest standards and best practices in the field. This is an opportunity to build a world-class investigations program, one whose rigor, independence and integrity protect OKX's people, assets and reputation

 

Where an investigation warrants it, you will be responsible for bringing matters to the appropriate authorities in the US, EMEA and APAC, ensuring each case is built to a prosecutorial standard and supported through to any civil or criminal resolution.

 

We offer a competitive base salary and bonus structure as well as excellent benefits and an opportunity to work in a cutting-edge industry that will be the future of financial services. Extensive international travel on short notice expected in this role.

 

What You'll Be Doing
• Lead the function and the team. Set the strategy, standards and methodology for internal investigations globally. Own intake, triage and prioritization. Manage and develop a team of investigators that includes former agents.
• Run investigations. Direct investigations from allegations through findings, including interview strategy, subject and witness interviews, digital forensics and financial tracing. Personally lead the most complex and sensitive matters.
• Build cases to a prosecutorial standard. Own OKX's framework for deciding which matters warrant escalation to authorities and in which jurisdiction. Build strong cases to the evidentiary and procedural standards of that jurisdiction, and partner with the Litigation team to pursue recovery of losses.
• Manage engagement with authorities. Where matters are brought to the attention of authorities, oversee OKX's engagement through to resolution, including providing evidence, making witnesses available and responding to legal process, as appropriate.
• Own law enforcement relationships. Build and maintain relationships and networks with law enforcement and prosecutors worldwide, including federal, state and local authorities in the US, EMEA and APAC.
• Partner across the company. Work with Compliance, Risk, Finance, HR, colleagues in the Legal department, and business executives to investigate and resolve matters effectively.
• Strengthen controls and report to leadership. Translate investigative findings into control improvements that prevent recurrence. Report significant matters and trends to senior leadership.

 

What We Look For In You
• Prior service as an Assistant United States Attorney is required. Experience as a trial attorney in the DOJ Criminal Division, such as the Fraud Section, will also be considered.
• A substantial record of investigating, charging and trying federal white-collar and fraud cases, including leading grand jury investigations and working closely with federal agents.
• A deep understanding of what makes a case prosecutable and what prosecutors and police need before they will accept one.
• In-house or law firm experience leading investigations required.
• A JD and membership in a US state bar.
• 15+ years of legal experience.
• Experience leading and developing investigative teams, including former law enforcement professionals.
• Sound, proportionate judgment, with a commitment to fairness and due process for the individuals under investigation.
• Exceptional written and oral communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear findings to senior leadership and credible presentations to law enforcement.
• Discretion, integrity and composure in sensitive, high-stakes matters.
• A self-starter who is comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, growth-stage, multicultural environment and across global time zones.
• Ability to collaborate effectively across functions and earn the trust of stakeholders at every level.

 

Nice to Haves
• Experience in financial services or digital assets.
• Exposure to cases involving cryptocurrency or blockchain tracing.
• Experience engaging with foreign law enforcement and prosecutors, or with international cooperation mechanisms such as MLATs, particularly in Asia-Pacific.
• Supervisory experience within a US Attorney's Office, such as a unit chief or deputy chief.

Lead Analyst - AML Prevention

We’re looking for a Lead Analyst who is passionate about our mission of Money Without Borders to partner with our financial crime product teams to help drive data-driven and innovative growth decisions while helping to combat financial crime. 

At Wise, we strike a critical balance between user experience and the stringent demands of risk prevention. Our mission within the AML team is to stay one step ahead of money laundering activities while ensuring that our customers enjoy a seamless experience. In this vital role, you will innovate and implement controls that enhance security without compromising user convenience.

Most importantly, you’ll collaborate closely with your product managers, designers, data scientists and engineers to bring your insights into real change for our customers and help drive our mission! 

This is an IC3 role. For more information on our Analytics Career Map and levelling structure, click here.

Your mission:

At Wise our mission is Money Without Borders - instant, convenient, transparent and eventually free. Whether our customers are sending money to another country, spending money abroad, or making and receiving international business payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Data at Brex

Our Scientists and Engineers work together to make data — and insights derived from data — a core asset across Brex. But it's more than just crunching numbers. The Data team at Brex develops infrastructure, statistical models, and products using data. Our work is ingrained in Brex's decision-making process, the efficiency of our operations, our risk management policies, and the unparalleled experience we provide our customers.

What you'll do

As a Data Engineer at Brex, you will be a core contributor in transforming raw data into actionable insights for various departments across the organization. You'll collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Software Engineers, and business units to create efficient data models, pipelines, and analytics frameworks that drive the business forward. You also play a leading role in the design, implementation, and maintenance of Core Data tables, our high-quality, curated data source for a wide range of analytic applications. 

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Design, build, and maintain data models and pipelines that scale with the growing number of services, products, and changes in the company.
• Collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Data Analysts, and Business teams to understand their data needs, translating them into robust, efficient, scalable data solutions that enable ease of predictive analytics, data analysis, and metrics formulation.
• Maintain data documentation and definitions, building and ensuring that source-of-truth tables remain high quality for data science and reporting applications.
• Develop and enable integration with various data sources, allowing for more data-driven initiatives across the company.
• Apply best practices in data management to ensure the reliability and robustness of data utilized across various analytics applications.
• Set and proliferate company-wide standards for data relating to structure, quality, and expectations.
• Act as a liaison between the technical and non-technical teams, bridging gaps and ensuring that data solutions align with business objectives.
• Use agentic AI where it speeds up pipeline and quality work, without skipping validation.

Requirements
• 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field such as Analytics Engineering.
• Advanced knowledge of databases and SQL with the ability to efficiently stage, process, and transform data.
• Experience integrating and orchestrating data workflows with various modern data tools and systems.
• Experience with data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, and data warehousing solutions.
• Experience working with a data warehouse such as Snowflake.
• Experience with a data workflow orchestrator tool such as Airflow.
• Experience with a programming language such as Python.
• Experience with agentic AI.
• Exceptional quantitative and analytical skills.
• Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with various stakeholders, both technical and non-technical.

Nice to have
• Familiarity with BI tools such as Looker, Tableau, or similar platforms.
• Solid dbt in production: models, tests, docs, and collaboration in a shared repo.
• AI-ready data: Metrics and dimensions are clear and reusable so AI-assisted analysis does not fork definitions.
• Experience with Salesforce data integration. 

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $120,800 - $151,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II - FX Markets
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer II with deep systems thinking, data engineering expertise, and a product-oriented mindset to join our Treasury FX function — spanning both the Market Data and Risk Engineering teams.

Our team builds the real-time infrastructure that powers Wise's FX pricing, risk management, and trade execution. We aggregate market data from Bloomberg and Reuters, compute live exposure and VaR, execute hedges worth tens to hundreds of millions of pounds daily, and protect the business from adverse currency movements. Our systems are tier- 1 and serve 50+ internal consumers with sub-second freshness across 50+ currency pairs.

You will be the technical anchor across both engineering teams, owning the architectural direction of 14+ production services, from rate ingestion and distribution, through real-time risk calculation, to automated hedge execution. The primary mission: build Wise's first semi-automated trade and hedge execution platform in close coordination with FX dealers, quantitative researchers, and treasury controllers.

We operate on a strong belief in automation, programmatic implementation, and reusable design. We're looking for people who can step back and think holistically about the ecosystem, but also follow through and help implement the design; drawing on the resources across the rest of the Finance & Treasury tribe.

Our stack is polyglot and modern: Java 21 + Spring Boot 4.x, Python 3.12, Apache Flink (streaming), Kafka, gRPC + Protobuf, and Bloomberg/Reuters real-time feeds. This isn't typical CRUD — it's real-time financial infrastructure where a 1bps improvement in hedging efficiency saves millions.

We need a seasoned engineer who can architect streaming data pipelines, collaborate with quants on model productionisation, drive reliability across mission-critical systems, and translate complex business requirements from traders and risk managers into elegant technical solutions.

What will you be working on?

You will own the technical direction and architectural evolution of Wise's FX engineering stack, with immediate focus on:
• Architecting a semi-automated hedge execution platform, from exposure decomposition through model-driven hedge proposals to programmatic trade execution on external partners
• Building real-time streaming pipelines with Apache Flink for portfolio-split exposure computation, tenor interpolation, and hedge lifecycle event processing
• Evolving our rate infrastructure for 10x throughput with FX Forwards, new corridors, NDFs and work on cross-provider deviation alerting
• Building production infrastructure for quant models for VaR, beta-adjusted exposure management, dynamic pricing and FRP cancellations.
• Owning Kafka topology design and schema evolution across the full pipeline: rate ingestion → risk calculation → trade execution → analytics
• Driving technical roadmap across both teams, mentoring IC2/IC3 engineers, and leading incident response for Tier-1 critical services

jobs.title: Senior Product Analytics Manager (AL2), SEND
jobs.description:
The role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Analytics Manager to set the strategic direction for analytics in our Global Send Experience Squad. You’ll help the squad decide where to focus, which customer problems to solve and how Wise can grow its global money transfer business, which today drives 5% of all cross-border transfers in the world for personal customers.

You’ll work closely with Product, Design and Engineering to lead discovery across the remittance space: building a deep understanding of customer needs, finding the biggest opportunities and turning them into a clear product strategy. You’ll influence decisions across the factors that shape whether customers choose to send money with Wise—including price, speed and convenience—throughout the whole customer lifecycle, from a customer’s first transfer to the choices they make as a returning customer.

You’ll lead a group of senior analysts. Your focus will be on setting the team’s direction and helping the squad make its most important strategic decisions. You’ll coach analysts to partner closely with teams on day-to-day product questions, while staying hands-on with the most complex and consequential opportunities yourself.

You’ll help us answer questions such as:
• Where are the biggest opportunities to grow money transfers around the world?
• What matters most to customers when they decide where, when and how to send money?
• How do price, speed and convenience shape customers’ choices and behaviour?
• How could an AI-powered concierge help customers find and complete the right transfer, while making the experience simpler and more personal?
• How can we make the experience work better for both new and returning customers?
• Which customer problems should we solve to make the biggest difference to growth and customer value?
• How should we focus our product strategy to grow our money transfer revenues 10x over the next few years?

What you’ll be doing
• Set the strategic direction for the squad. Partner with Product, Design and Engineering to build a clear view of customer needs, market opportunities and the choices Wise should make next.
• Lead discovery and opportunity finding. Explore customer behaviour and the end-to-end transfer journey to identify unmet needs, friction and growth opportunities. Help the squad understand not just what is happening, but where it has the greatest opportunity to act.
• Influence the whole customer decision. Bring an analytical perspective to how customers weigh price, speed and convenience when choosing how to send money, across both new and returning customer journeys.
• Turn opportunities into product priorities. Size customer and commercial opportunities, develop clear points of view and help teams make focused, evidence-based choices about what to build and why.
• Lead and develop a group of senior analysts. Set a high bar for analytical thinking and impact, coach analysts in their work and careers, and create the conditions for them to support their teams effectively.
• Enable strong day-to-day squad decisions. Coach analysts to work closely with their product teams, bring useful insights into planning and discovery, and help teams learn from product changes and customer behaviour.
• Stay hands-on with the most important problems. Work directly on high-impact or ambiguous questions, and guide the team through complex analysis when the strategic stakes are high.
• Bring people together around a shared view. Communicate complex evidence clearly, influence senior stakeholders and help cross-functional teams turn strategic choices into action.

Tools

Required

Preferred

jobs.title: Lead QA Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Lead QA Engineer, you'll own testing strategy and quality standards across our most important work; Deciding what should be automated, what needs a human eye, where the real risk is hiding, and acting on it. You'll work hands-on across both manual and automated testing, splitting your time based on what a given release actually needs, while mentoring other engineers and acting as the go-to voice on quality across projects. You've got the critical thinking skills to chase down a hard bug yourself, know when to ask for help and delegate, and the range to set direction for how the whole team approaches quality. You seek to help your coworkers and do so regularly.

Key Responsibilities
• Lead test strategy and quality standards across multiple projects, deciding what warrants automated coverage versus focused manual and exploratory testing.
• Build and maintain automated test suites in Playwright, and use BrowserStack to validate compatibility across browsers, devices, and platforms.
• Define and run deep manual and exploratory testing on new, ambiguous, or high-change-rate work where automation isn't the right investment yet.
• Translate requirements into concrete test plans and acceptance criteria, catching gaps in the requirements themselves before they become gaps in the product.
• Act as the technical point of contact for quality with stakeholders: communicate risk, resolve disagreements about scope, and negotiate realistic testing timelines.
• Write clear, actionable defect reports in Jira, drive them to resolution, and verify fixes actually hold up under retest rather than just passing a second glance.
• Use Jira's linking and epic structure to keep testing work traceable, and flag workflow friction in the board with the team before it slows down the SDLC.
• Mentor other QA engineers in both manual technique and automation practice, including how to write tickets clearly and so well that they need no follow-up clarification, raising the bar on testing across the team, not just on your own projects.
• Step into any project at any phase to assess its quality risk and recommend a concrete path forward.
• Stay ahead of testing tools and practices worth adopting, and bring the right ones into real workflows deliberately.
• Operate and champion the use of AI tooling with an understanding that its output is useful, but not infallible. You treat AI as a tool, not a coworker.

Craft Leadership Balance

Estimated 60% leadership, 40% craft.

Qualifications

Required
• 6-8 years of experience in software quality assurance or testing, ideally with exposure to consulting or multi-stakeholder environments.
• Strong, hands-on experience with Playwright for building and maintaining automated test suites and frameworks.
• Experience using BrowserStack (or a comparable cross-browser/device testing platform) to validate compatibility across platforms.
• Deep grounding in manual, exploratory, and regression testing, with the judgment to know when automation is and isn't the right investment.
• Proven ability to translate ambiguous requirements into concrete, actionable test plans and acceptance criteria.
• Strong Jira practice: writing tickets so well that no follow-up or clarification is needed, using issue-linking for traceability, and spotting workflow friction before it becomes a team-wide problem.
• Experience testing across a range of CMS or SaaS platforms rather than a single stack, since our client environments vary and this role needs to move between them.
• Exceedingly strong communication skills, including presenting technical risk and testing tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. It cannot be stressed enough how important this item is: communication is the whole ballgame.
• Prior experience as a technical or testing lead on large or multi-phase projects.

Preferred
• Familiarity with performance testing (e.g. Lighthouse) and accessibility testing (e.g. Axe, WCAG guidelines).
• Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
• Experience with structured test-case formats (e.g. Gherkin) and test case management tooling.
• A track record of debugging and performance investigation at scale.
• Creation and implementation of SDLC processes and norms at project and team scales.

Why Current

At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact.

We’re a remote-first agency with teams across the US, working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex technical challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates.

You’ll have the opportunity to work across a variety of clients and technologies, contribute to meaningful digital experiences, and help shape the future of engineering within a growing agency environment.

The target range of base compensation for this role is $85,000 - $110,000 annually. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, AI Trading
jobs.description:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Hong Kong, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

 

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 

 

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About The Opportunity

OKX's Trading Products team owns the core trading experience across Spot, Margin, and Perpetual/Futures — spanning the full user journey from pre-trade decision-making, through order execution, to post-trade settlement and risk management. As our trading volumes and product complexity continue to grow globally, we are looking for a Trading Product Manager who can own and evolve both the user-facing trading experience and the underlying trading mechanics that power it.

This role sits at the intersection of product design and trading logic. You will work on how users discover, price, place, and manage trades (pre-trade / trade / post-trade), while also owning the correctness and soundness of the core mechanisms beneath the surface — margin models, funding rate formulas, liquidation logic, risk parameter design, and order/matching behavior. You will work closely with engineering, risk, quant, and design teams to ship trading features that are intuitive for users and rigorous under the hood.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Start from users and the market to uncover real trading-experience needs — Continuously surface user pain points through user research, behavioral data, community feedback, and conversations with active traders, ensuring product direction is grounded in real signal rather than internal assumptions.
• Benchmark against industry best practices to build best-in-class trading product competitiveness — Continuously track developments in crypto and traditional finance markets and the latest moves from leading products, translating external insight into concrete product opportunities that keep our trading experience and competitiveness ahead of the industry.
• Build and continuously refine the end-to-end trading experience — Own the full journey across pre-trade (market data presentation, decision-support tools, leverage/margin setup, risk disclosures), trade (order flow, execution feedback, order book/depth interaction), and post-trade (position management, PnL display, settlement statements) — from defining requirements through to shipping the solution.
• Drive efficient cross-team collaboration with mature program-management execution — Bring a complete product methodology, independently write rigorous PRDs, and lead alignment and coordination across engineering, risk, quant, design, and compliance. Own the full project lifecycle — from requirements definition and solution design, through development scheduling, to launch validation and post-launch review — ensuring every stage closes the loop with a clear outcome, without relying on others to drive progress.
• Apply rigorous quantitative thinking to understand and reason about trading mechanics — Bring strong logical reasoning and quantitative analysis skills, with the ability to learn fast and quickly master core trading mechanisms such as margin, leverage, funding rates, and liquidation. Candidates with a deep understanding of trading systems are preferred.

What We Look For In You 

We are open to two types of candidates for this role:

(a) Experienced Trading Practitioners
• Prior hands-on experience in trading — either within crypto (exchange product, quant, trading desk) or in traditional finance (equities, futures, FX, derivatives) — with direct exposure to how trading products and mechanisms are designed and operated.
• Solid understanding of core trading concepts: margin/leverage, order types, market microstructure, risk management, and P L mechanics.
• Comfortable reading and reasoning through trading formulas (e.g. mark price, funding rate, liquidation price) and translating them into clear product logic.

(b) High-Potential Talent
• Strong quantitative/analytical foundation — a background in mathematics, physics, statistics, engineering, or a related quantitative discipline, with strong academic performance.
• High self-drive and fast learning ability — demonstrated track record of picking up complex, technical domains quickly and independently, even without prior trading experience.
• Genuine intellectual curiosity about financial markets and trading mechanics, with the rigor to work through formulas and edge cases rather than relying on surface-level understanding.

Common requirements for both profiles:
• 3+ years of product management experience (or equivalent hands-on experience in quant/trading roles for candidates from profile (a)).
• Strong technical intuition — comfortable discussing system architecture and data flows with engineers, and reasoning through quantitative models. You don't need to be a developer, but you think with the rigor of one.
• Excellent communication skills — able to write a precise, technically sound PRD, and to explain complex trading mechanics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• High agency and execution velocity — comfortable operating in ambiguity, moving from open question to shipped solution, and making decisions with incomplete information.
• Genuine passion for crypto and trading — actively uses trading products, understands order types and market microstructure, and can explain how margin, leverage, or liquidation mechanics work. Ideally, you have skin in the game.
• Proficiency in Mandarin is required to communicate effectively with internal engineering and product stakeholders in the China-based R D center.

Nice-To-Haves
• Experience with derivatives products (perpetual futures, options) either as a builder or an active trader.
• Familiarity with risk parameter design (margin tiers, liquidation engines, insurance funds) at an exchange or financial institution.
• Quantitative modeling experience (e.g. Python, SQL) sufficient to validate trading formulas or backtest mechanism changes.
• Prior work in a high-growth crypto exchange, trading firm, or fintech company.
• Fluency in English is preferred to better support communication with global product and business stakeholders.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

Please note that Hong Kong is a group-level service hub, and OKX does not carry on a business of operating a virtual asset trading platform in Hong Kong. 

Notice:

All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.

Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, TradingView (Growth & Trading Experience)
jobs.description:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

 

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 

 

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About The Opportunity

We are looking for a Product Manager with a deep understanding of TradingView users, strong commercial judgment, and experience driving product growth. You will grow OKX's business within the TradingView ecosystem by identifying the most promising customer segments, defining why traders should choose OKX, and finding effective ways to acquire, activate, and retain them, with accountability for measurable business outcomes.

Your first priority is to establish how the business can grow and which opportunities warrant investment. You will validate growth hypotheses through user research, data analysis, and focused experiments before committing substantial engineering resources. Those insights will shape the product roadmap, investment priorities, and the TradingView integrations and trading experience improvements you deliver with engineering and partners.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Define the Growth Strategy and Business Opportunity — 

Identify high-potential customer segments, trading use cases, and market opportunities within the TradingView ecosystem. Assess competitive positioning, platform selection drivers, and OKX's differentiated value proposition. Build growth hypotheses and business cases that consider audience size, revenue potential, acquisition cost, and expected return, then set business goals, priorities, and a phased growth plan.
• Understand Users and the Trading Conversion Journey — 

Use interviews, behavioral data, and community feedback to understand how traders discover platforms, use charts and indicators, set alerts, connect accounts, place orders, and manage positions. Identify what motivates or prevents users from choosing OKX, making their first trade, and returning. Develop customer segments and conversion funnels, and turn insights into clear product, positioning, and lifecycle opportunities.
• Validate Growth Hypotheses and Improve Conversion and Retention — 

Design measurable experiments across acquisition, account connection, first successful trade, repeat trading, and reactivation. Use existing capabilities, onboarding, trader education, value proposition testing, and targeted campaigns to validate opportunities. Define success metrics, experiment costs, and criteria to scale or stop; expand approaches that work and use the evidence to inform subsequent product investment.
• Drive Go-To-Market and Ecosystem Partnerships — 

Work with marketing, regional, lifecycle, and TradingView partner teams on acquisition and go-to-market plans. Evaluate ecosystem visibility, communities, creators, educational content, and joint campaigns as potential channels. Define the customer proposition, distribution approach, conversion journey, and partner objectives, and assess channels by the active traders, retention, and business contribution they generate.
• Translate Growth Evidence into Product Delivery and Integration — 

Translate validated user needs and growth opportunities into a product roadmap, PRDs, and acceptance criteria. Define the minimum scope and engineering priorities required to achieve the business objective. Work with OKX engineering and TradingView technical teams to assess API integration, account authorization, market data, and order and position synchronization, and drive the necessary adaptation, testing, and launch to address specific conversion, trust, or retention problems.
• Own Business Outcomes and Continuously Refine Investment — 

Own metrics for newly acquired trading users, first-trade conversion, active traders, retention, incremental trading volume, and revenue contribution, taking acquisition, incentive, and delivery costs into account. Separate the effects of market conditions, incentives, and product improvements. Review growth initiatives and feature investments, reallocate resources based on results, and track connection success and trading reliability as measures of experience quality.

What We Look For In You
• Relevant product management experience in trading, fintech, or digital assets, with a track record of measurable product growth. You can explain how you identified opportunities, developed a growth strategy, and improved acquisition, trading conversion, retention, or revenue, including your personal contribution and results.
• A deep understanding of TradingView users and their practical use of charts, indicators, watchlists, alerts, and trading workflows. You can explain why different traders choose a platform, switch terminals, abandon an order, or continue using a service, and validate those insights through research and data.
• Strong commercial judgment and growth strategy skills. You can segment customers, assess opportunities, define differentiated positioning, select distribution channels, and build business cases. You validate demand and a credible path to growth through research and focused experiments before substantial engineering investment.
• Strong analytical and experimentation skills. You can analyze funnels, cohorts, and retention, design and evaluate growth experiments, and assess incrementality, acquisition cost, customer value, and incentive cost. You can distinguish short-term trading volume changes from sustainable growth.
• An understanding of trading products and their commercial drivers. You are familiar with spot and derivatives fundamentals and how instrument coverage, fees, liquidity, execution quality, and account and position workflows influence customer choice, conversion, and retention. You can translate these factors into product decisions.
• Experience delivering products that involve technical integration. You have worked with engineers on API or third-party platform integrations and can read interface documentation, understand account authorization and market data, order, and position synchronization, define business rules and acceptance criteria, and drive testing and launch. You connect technical constraints and implementation scope to user value and growth objectives.
• Strong English communication and cross-functional execution skills. You can work with TradingView partners, marketing, regional, product, and engineering teams on business opportunities, product priorities, and technical feasibility, aligning resources around shared outcomes.

Nice-To-Haves
• Experience growing a business within TradingView or a comparable trading-tool ecosystem, with examples spanning opportunity discovery, growth validation, and scaling.
• Experience with trader communities, creators, educational content, partnerships, or channel growth, with the ability to evaluate initiatives by active traders, retention, and revenue contribution.
• Experience growing products across regions or trader segments, with an understanding of differences in user behavior, customer propositions, and acquisition approaches.
• Experience with TradingView Broker Integration, Advanced Charts, Trading Platform, or comparable integrations, with an ability to explain how the work improved the user experience or supported growth objectives.

What Success Looks Like
• An evidence-based growth plan that identifies priority customer segments, OKX's differentiated value, promising distribution channels, and the business opportunity.
• Validated, repeatable approaches to acquisition, trading conversion, and retention, supported by research and focused experiments that guide engineering investment and resource allocation.
• Measurable, sustainable growth in active traders, retention, and revenue contribution, with acquisition and incentive costs taken into account.
• Delivery of the product capabilities and TradingView integrations needed to capture validated opportunities, with improvements to critical user journeys and ongoing measurement of their growth impact.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!
