jobs.title: Finance Senior Manager, Japan
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Finance Senior Manager in Tokyo to lead finance, regulatory, and statutory operations for our Japan entities, with potential scope to support broader regional expansion (such as South Korea) as our footprint grows.

This role bridges local regulatory compliance (FSA, KLFB, BOJ, FIEA) with hands-on JGAAP and IFRS technical accounting and commercial business partnering.

Key Responsibilities
• Regulatory & Capital Compliance: Lead Capital Adequacy Requirements (CAR) monitoring and client fund segregation calculations for the entity. Prepare mandated regulatory reports and manage submissions with key regulatory bodies including FSA, KLFB, BOJ, and FIEA.
• Statutory Reporting & Audit: Manage the Preparation of JGAAP statutory financial statement and bridge from IFRS TB to JGAAP. Prepare annual financial statements and business reports. Lead the local audit process with an external auditor and prepare periodical reports to regulators.
• Tax & Operations: Coordinate with the internal tax team on local tax filings and preparation of supporting schedules. Oversee local banking portal administration, fixed asset registers, and local vendor management.
• Business Partnering & Financial Oversight: Act as the primary Finance partner for local Product, Compliance, Banking, and Expansion teams, leading financial reporting, performance analysis and forecast reviews. Collaborate with Regional and Group Finance to automate processes,ensure robust internal controls and report to the Board.

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Transaction Monitoring
jobs.description:
We Are:

YouTrip is at the forefront of Asia's financial revolution, defining the future of digital finance with its leading multi-currency payment platform. Launched in 2018, YouTrip has swiftly ascended as a powerhouse, orchestrating billions in transactions annually and securing the trust of millions. With innovative solutions like YouTrip for consumers and YouBiz for businesses, we offer unmatched financial ease and cost-effectiveness. Fresh off a successful US$50 million Series B funding round led by Lightspeed Venture, we're setting new benchmarks in the digital financial services sector.

At the heart of our mission is a commitment to eliminate financial borders across Asia, propelling us into the next wave of digital finance.

As the Compliance Senior Associate (Lead Role), you will be entrusted with a pivotal leadership role within the Transaction Monitoring (TM) team in Malaysia. You will act as the primary point of contact for all transaction monitoring activities, providing leadership, guidance, and strategic oversight of the team in Malaysia. This role involves driving the team’s performance, fostering a culture of compliance excellence, and ensuring that all transactions are thoroughly reviewed and flagged in accordance with regulatory requirements.

You will lead by example, promoting adherence to Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Counter-Terrorism Financing (CTF), and other financial crime compliance regulations, while guiding your team to effectively manage the risks associated with suspicious or unusual financial activities. The role demands both operational excellence and strong leadership skills to ensure the team is equipped to handle complex compliance challenges in an evolving regulatory landscape.

You Will:
• Manage overall Group level Quality as QC (“Quality Checker”). Assess alerts from junior staff who handled the first layer of review and ensure the quality of closures/escalations.
• Ensure the team follows strictly to the staff code of conduct.
• Manage the team’s KPI performance and ensure the SLAs of the company are met.
• Handle Group level Quality Assurance checks of the team’s reviewed alerts and ensure that the quality of reviews is maintained at high standard.
• Provide training to all New Employees to ensure a consistent level of quality.
• Collaborate with other key business functions to ensure a smooth end-to-end internal process to achieve customer satisfaction and safeguard the company’s and users’ interests.
• Act as the bridge between Level 1 team and Level 2 in Singapore.
• Perform any other ad-hoc compliance related duties.
• Ensure regular Management Reporting to the Transaction Monitoring team lead in Singapore.
• Act as the Subject Matter Expert for L1 Transaction Monitoring and Spearhead Alert Parameter Feedback/Tuning for L1 when applicable.
• Manage the Transaction Surveillance Function and act as the key contact person and subject matter expert.
• Review and assess alerts as required. 

You Are:
• Compliance & Risk enthusiast – you have racked up at least 4 - 6 years of relevant transaction monitoring work experience ideally within the financial services or payment industry. Relevant knowledge on payments related regulations in Singapore and Malaysia will be a plus.
• Analytical & detail-oriented thinker – you possess excellent problem-solving skills with demonstrated experience in solving complex business with analytical thinking. You have the natural tendency to always focus on details and hate to miss out on specifics.
• Travel enthusiast – you are a passionate traveler and understand the psychology of traveler, in particular when it comes to overseas spending behavior and its associated risks.
• Fearless self-starter – you are not afraid to suggest and implement new initiatives to tackle complex business issues, as long as the rationale are logical and sound. You do not mind getting your hands dirty in order to get things done on a tight timeline.
• Passion to lead – True leadership is not about being born into a role, but about embracing the responsibility to lead by example. With unwavering dedication and a clear vision, you will inspire and guide your team to reach new heights, demonstrating that the passion to lead is cultivated through action, not title.
• Reliable – you take pride and ownership in your work.
• Critical Thinking – you possess critical thinking to assess independently, objectively, and accurately, with no assumptions.
• Strong Communicator – you understand that this is the key in management of a team.
• Do-er, and a fixer – you let your actions do the talking.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager (Mobile & Backend)
jobs.description:
YouTrip is the leading and fastest-growing multi-currency payment platform in Asia Pacific. In 2018, we pioneered the region's first multi-currency digital wallet. Now, YouTrip is the #1 multi-currency digital wallet trusted by millions across the region, processing over US$15 billion in total payment value annually. 

Our consumer and business propositions – YouTrip and YouBiz – empower individuals and businesses with inclusive, accessible, and affordable financial solutions. YouTrip has raised over US$110 million to date, including its recent Series B round led by global venture capital firm Lightspeed Venture Partners—underscoring strong investor confidence in its mission to transform digital financial services across the Asia Pacific. 

Recognised as World Economic Forum’s Global Innovator 2025, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies (2025, 2024), and LinkedIn’s Top Startup (2024, 2023), YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses.

Valuing an entrepreneurial culture of diversity and inclusion, we are seeking driven individuals to join our fast-growing regional team as we push the boundaries of innovative fintech solutions.

Job Description:

Software Engineering Manager (Mobile & Backend)

We are looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager with strong technical depth across Android, iOS, and backend systems, and a proven record of leading large engineering teams. You'll lead a team of 10 or more engineers across one or two scrum teams, owning end-to-end products from backend services to the native mobile apps used by millions of customers across Asia Pacific. You'll play a key role in expanding our growing suite of services as we scale beyond digital fintech.

Responsibilities:
• Lead, mentor, and manage a cross-functional team of 10+ engineers spanning Android, iOS, and backend, setting clear goals, supporting career growth, and running regular performance evaluations.
• Own the technical direction for both mobile and backend: app architecture, API design, service scalability, and how the pieces fit together end to end.
• Stay hands-on by contributing to codebases, performing code reviews across mobile and backend, and keeping the technical depth needed to guide the team.
• Drive mobile engineering best practices, including app performance, stability, crash-free rates, release management, and App Store / Play Store delivery.
• Design and oversee secure, high-availability backend services and APIs that support payments at scale.
• Oversee project execution across squads, ensuring on-time delivery while meeting quality and security standards.
• Uphold engineering excellence by enforcing coding standards, building test automation (unit, integration, and UI) and CI/CD pipelines for mobile and backend, and continuously improving development processes.
• Bring in emerging technologies and industry best practices to improve innovation, scalability, and developer productivity.
• Build a clear and collaborative environment within the team and with Product, Design, QA, and other cross-functional partners.
• Regularly engage with stakeholders, sharing progress, technical insights, and delivery outcomes.
• Coach engineers technically and professionally, growing senior engineers and tech leads into autonomous contributors.
• Hire and grow a high-performing, agile, self-organizing team that delivers stable, scalable, and reliable features.
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
• 10+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 5 years in engineering management.
• Proven experience directly managing teams of 10 or more engineers, ideally across mobile and backend disciplines.
• Strong hands-on background in native mobile development, with working knowledge of any one Android and iOS. Experience with cross-platform frameworks (e.g. Flutter, React Native) is a plus.
• Expert-level proficiency in designing and building high-performance, concurrent backend applications. Experience with Golang is a strong plus.
• Solid background in distributed systems, microservices, API design, parallel processing, and highly complex software applications.
• Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or similar), CI/CD, and observability tooling.
• Experience in fintech, payments, or other highly regulated, high-security environments is a plus.
• Strong understanding of product and business metrics, and comfortable setting objectives with the OKR framework.
• A balanced approach to shipping features and engineering excellence, with a product-oriented mindset.
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to manage squad-level priorities, deadlines, and outcomes.
• Comfortable taking calculated risks and making strategic decisions under uncertainty.
• Experience collaborating with cross-functional and remote teams across the full development lifecycle.
• Curiosity, creative problem-solving, and an eye for detail.

To Apply

If you're interested in this role, click Apply Now and send us your CV. Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

jobs.title: Brex Rotational Program
jobs.location: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

The Brex Rotational Program

Throughout this 18-20 month program, you'll rotate through two of our G A teams, learning about areas such as risk management, finance, automation, and data analysis. You'll contribute to critical process improvements and developments, implementing our processes while leveraging AI to streamline workflows and enhance decision-making.

You'll challenge the status quo, bringing insights from each rotation to the next to improve cross-team communication and efficiency. We believe in a founder mindset — and this program is designed to show you how you can take ownership of your growth. During each rotation, you'll complete a core project focused on key data insights, process implementation, or process improvement—many of which will involve exploring and applying AI solutions. You'll then have the opportunity to share your findings with your program class and Brex Executives.

The program is supported by our leadership team, and you'll have frequent meetings with various Brex leaders. This provides a unique opportunity to work closely with and learn from executives who are at the forefront of building an AI-native company.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Salt Lake Office office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Handle day-to-day tasks efficiently.
• Analyze business inefficiencies and propose process improvements to leadership, leveraging AI to drive solutions.
• Work cross-functionally with various teams to streamline processes and create AI-powered workflows that improve automation and decision-making.
• Collaborate with EPD, G A, GTM, and Legal to translate business needs into practical automation solutions.
• Contribute to the long-term strategy for Brex's AI-native roadmap, exploring and integrating new tools and frameworks to enhance internal operations.

Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree.
• Demonstrated experience using AI tools and applying effective prompting skills.
• Strong problem-solving abilities and comfort working through ambiguity.
• Passion for business operations, internal tools, and the application of AI and automation to improve efficiency and enable scale.
• Proven ability to work both independently and in cross-functional teams.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex ideas clearly and effectively.
• Desire to contribute in a fast-paced environment with a founding team member mindset.

Bonus Points
• Major, minor, or coursework in a field relevant to AI and data, such as Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, Information Systems, or other Engineering.
• Basic knowledge or proficiency in programming languages such as but not limited to Python, JavaScript, or SQL.
• Experience with personal projects, a portfolio of work, or participation in competitions (e.g., Hackathons) focused on AI, machine learning, or data analysis.
• Leadership roles in university clubs or organizations related to data science, AI, computer science, or business analytics.
• Prior internships/full-time roles in an operational, data, or technical role, especially where you were involved in process improvement or automation.
• Familiarity with Retool, Salesforce, Hex, and Looker.

Compensations

The expected salary range for this role is $58,700 - 66,038. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

 

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? Coinbase is building the future of finance for people, institutions and their agents, with one place to trade crypto, equities, derivatives and prediction markets, use stablecoins, and connect AI agents with clear controls. The bar is high and the pace is intense, and we like it that way. This isn’t a place for complacency. It’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits and do the best work of your career. If you’re ready to build the future of finance with a championship team who refuse to settle for “good enough,” you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for in-person working sessions

Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Identity Verification

As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer on the Identity Verification team within the Platform group, you'll own the ML systems that determine whether a person, document, and capture session are legitimate. Every signup, account recovery, and high-risk action at Coinbase depends on these models. You'll lead the technical strategy for IDV ML end-to-end, from architecture through production enforcement, protecting the integrity of millions of accounts.

What you'll do:
• Own the full IDV ML stack, including document authenticity models, 1:1 and 1:N face-match, liveness detection, presentation-attack detection, and deepfake/injection detection from feature pipeline through threshold tuning and production enforcement.
• Build identity-graph systems using GNNs that cluster accounts sharing biometric, device, and document signals to detect synthetic-identity rings and coordinated fraud at onboarding.
• Develop behavioral and device-intelligence models for capture-session anomaly detection, bot-vs-human classification, and device-fingerprint-based risk scoring at real-time latency.
• Drive vendor ML strategy by benchmarking external models against a Coinbase-owned evaluation set, designing dynamic routing logic across providers and geographies, and building the in-house evaluation layer that catches regressions before they reach users.
• Lead and mentor senior and mid-level engineers in the pod while partnering with ML Platform and Risk ML teams to align cross-company ML system design.

Required Skills and

Experience:
• 8+ years deploying production ML systems at scale, with proven technical leadership owning cross-team ML architecture from design through production.
• Domain experience in identity verification, biometrics, or account integrity with deep applied ML in at least two of: computer vision/biometrics, GNNs, sequence models, or NLP/LLMs.
• Expert-level Python with production experience in TensorFlow or PyTorch, including model training, evaluation, and serving infrastructure.
• Track record translating KYC/AML requirements and fraud trends into ML roadmaps and communicating trade-offs to Product, Compliance, Risk, and Security stakeholders.
• Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

Staff Platform Engineer

You will provide technical leadership for the software and infrastructure that form Gemini’s internal engineering platform. You will build self-service systems, developer tools, and automation that improve the way teams create, deploy, scale, observe, and operate services.

You will partner with engineering, security, data, and product leaders to turn broad operational needs into reliable platform products, establish clear technical direction, and drive adoption across teams.

You will make infrastructure programmable, secure, observable, and resilient; use SLOs and error budgets to guide tradeoffs; and continuously replace manual operational work with well-designed software. The role spans software, systems, and infrastructure engineering, with an emphasis on solving cross-functional problems and delivering measurable improvements to developer productivity and production reliability.

in this role:

Engineers can safely self-serve common workflows through documented, well-supported platform products. Platform capabilities are adopted because they reduce complexity and improve outcomes. Reliability, deployment safety, developer experience, and infrastructure efficiency improve measurably over time. Operational load grows more slowly than the number and scale of services supported by the team. Platform engineers remain close to production while spending the majority of their time on durable software and systems improvements.

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

OKX runs a large peer-to-peer (P2P) crypto marketplace: an escrow-protected orderbook where users buy and sell crypto for local fiat through verified liquidity providers, with support for a wide range of local payment methods. The professional liquidity providers who post offers are what keep the marketplace deep and reliable.

You will own the relationship with these key liquidity providers in various markets: supporting partners' operational needs, maintaining marketplace depth and reliability, and improving partner experience. This is a builder's seat: high ownership, frontline, and fast-moving.

What you'll do
• Own the P2P liquidity provider programme: monitor marketplace depth and coverage, and improve partner satisfaction and retention
• Manage the liquidity-provider programme, tiering frameworks, account management and retention strategies.
• Lead the growth strategy and retention funnel with data: build and read funnels, produce recurring analysis, and turn it into decisions.
• Contribute to user quality and marketplace health, partnering with the user risk team on high-risk user profiling and dispute reduction. (Growth is the priority; risk exposure is a plus, not a requirement.)

• 7+ years in growth, account management or relationship management for high-value users or clients, including team leadership, with a track record of managing partner programmes at scale. Multi-market experience is strongly preferred.
• Proven experience managing high-volume client or partner relationships and improving partner engagement and service quality.
• Strong data and funnel fluency: owns metrics, runs analysis, steers decisions from data.
• High-energy and genuinely hungry: gets on the frontline, has built something 0 to 1, and pushes into harder markets rather than safer ones.
• Backgrounds in payments, remittance or fintech are especially relevant. Crypto or digital-currency experience is a plus, not a requirement. Strong operators from large internet and marketplace companies are also welcome.
• Working proficiency in English. At least one of the two roles also requires working proficiency in Mandarin (liquidity-provider and stakeholder coverage across Greater China markets).

jobs.title: VIP业务策略与中台运营专家
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

This is a core strategy and operations role within VIP business, serving as the strategic operating brain behind our VIP client franchise.

You will take an end-to-end business perspective across VIP clients, trading products, market dynamics, and RM operating models. Your responsibility is to identify the most important growth and efficiency opportunities, then design scalable, measurable, and repeatable strategies to address them.

Beyond developing recommendations, you will translate strategy into client segmentation, product and benefit propositions, operating journeys, decision frameworks, and actionable RM playbooks. You will also personally lead high-impact initiatives from problem definition through execution and performance evaluation.

This is not a traditional campaign operations or front-line execution role. We are looking for someone with strong business judgment and strategic thinking who is equally comfortable going deep into operational details and driving tangible results.

该岗位是 VIP 业务体系中的核心策略与运营角色，承担 VIP 业务“运营策略大脑”的职责。

你需要站在整体业务视角，理解 VIP 客户、交易产品、市场环境与 RM 作业模式，识别影响客户增长和业务效率的关键问题，并设计可规模化、可衡量、可持续迭代的运营策略与机制。

你不仅需要提出策略，更需要将策略转化为客户分层、产品组合、权益机制、运营路径和 RM 作战方案，并亲自推动关键项目落地。最终目标是让前端 RM 拥有更清晰的客户经营方向、更有效的策略工具和更高的业务产出。

这不是传统的一线活动运营岗位，也不是单纯的支持职能。我们希望你既具备较强的业务判断和战略思考能力，也愿意深入业务一线，解决复杂而具体的问题。

 

What You’ll Be Doing
• 制定VIP业务运营策略

Define the VIP Business Operations Strategy

基于业务目标、市场环境、客户需求及交易行为，识别VIP业务的核心问题与增长机会，制定阶段性运营策略、业务优先级及落地路径。

Identify critical business challenges and growth opportunities based on business objectives, market conditions, client needs, and trading behavior. Set strategic priorities and develop clear execution roadmaps.
• 搭建VIP客户经营体系

Build the VIP Client Management Model

围绕客户价值、资产规模、交易行为、产品偏好及生命周期建立客户分层与经营模型，设计产品组合、权益机制、触达策略及客户价值提升方案。

Develop client segmentation and management frameworks based on client value, assets, trading behavior, product preferences, and lifecycle stages. Design differentiated product, benefit, engagement, and value-growth strategies.
• 赋能前端RM开展客户经营
Enable RMs with Actionable Strategies

将中台策略转化为RM可直接使用的作战方案，包括目标客户筛选、机会识别、需求切入、产品及权益组合、沟通框架和跟进路径，持续为前端业务“造子弹”。

Translate central strategies into practical RM playbooks, including target-client selection, opportunity identification, client entry points, product and benefit propositions, communication frameworks, and follow-up journeys.
• 主导关键业务专项落地
Lead High-Impact Business Initiatives

针对重点客群增长、产品渗透、交易提升、资产留存、客户召回及RM产能优化等关键议题，完成问题定义、方案设计、资源协调和执行落地，并对业务结果负责。

Own strategic initiatives across priority-client growth, product penetration, trading growth, asset retention, client reactivation, and RM productivity—from problem definition and solution design through cross-functional execution and measurable outcomes.
• 建立数据分析与策略迭代机制
Drive Data-Informed Iteration and Capability Building

搭建VIP业务指标及分析框架，从客户、产品、交易和RM效率等维度评估策略效果、识别增长驱动因素，并将有效策略沉淀为可复用的运营机制、决策框架和标准化工具。

Establish analytical frameworks across clients, products, trading activity, and RM performance. Evaluate outcomes, identify growth drivers, and turn successful strategies into scalable operating mechanisms, decision frameworks, and reusable tools.

 

What We Look For In You
• 5年以上策略运营、商业运营、用户增长、客户经营或业务策略相关经验；具备金融、证券、财富管理、FinTech或加密货币行业经验者优先。5+ years of experience in strategy and operations, commercial operations, user growth, client management, or business strategy. Experience in financial services, securities, wealth management, FinTech, or cryptocurrency is preferred.
• 具备较强的业务敏感度，能够快速理解业务模式、识别核心问题，并判断不同策略对客户价值和业务结果的实际影响。Strong commercial judgment and the ability to quickly understand business models, identify critical issues, and assess how different strategies affect client value and business outcomes.
• 具备成熟的运营策略能力，能够从业务目标出发，完成问题定义、客户洞察、策略设计、机制搭建、项目落地及效果复盘。Proven ability to manage the full strategy cycle, including problem definition, client insight, strategy development, mechanism design, execution, and performance review.
• 具备客户经营思维，能够理解高净值客户、专业交易者或机构客户的决策逻辑，并据此设计差异化的产品、权益和运营方案。Strong client-management mindset and an understanding of how high-net-worth clients, professional traders, and institutional clients make decisions.
• 数据敏感，能够通过业务数据发现问题、验证假设和评估策略；不要求是专业数据分析师，但需要具备良好的分析框架和归因能力。Strong analytical thinking, with the ability to use data to identify issues, test hypotheses, evaluate outcomes, and conduct meaningful attribution analysis.
• 具备较强的结构化思维和复杂项目推动能力，能够协调多个团队，将相对模糊的业务问题转化为清晰、可执行的解决方案。Structured problem-solving and strong cross-functional leadership, with the ability to turn ambiguous business challenges into clear and executable solutions.
• 兼具战略高度和落地能力，既能搭建体系、制定方向，也愿意深入业务细节，亲自推动关键项目产生结果。A combination of strategic thinking and hands-on execution. You should be able to design the operating model while also driving critical initiatives personally.
• 对加密货币、交易产品及Web3行业有较强兴趣和理解，能够快速掌握现货、合约、结构化产品、借贷及资产管理等业务逻辑。Strong interest in and understanding of cryptocurrency, trading products, and Web3, with the ability to quickly develop knowledge across spot trading, derivatives, structured products, lending, and asset management.
• 具备良好的中英文沟通能力，能够在全球化、跨区域和快速变化的环境中工作。Strong written and verbal communication skills in both Chinese and English, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, global environment.

 

Nice to Haves
• 有加密货币交易平台、券商、私人银行、财富管理或高净值客户业务经验。Experience at a cryptocurrency exchange, brokerage, private bank, wealth management firm, or another business serving high-value clients.
• 曾负责客户分层、生命周期经营、会员体系、权益体系或客户价值增长策略。Experience building client segmentation, lifecycle management, membership, benefits, or client-value growth strategies.
• 有赋能RM、销售或客户经理团队的经验，能够将中台策略转化为前端业务产出。Experience enabling RM, sales, or client-facing teams and translating central strategies into front-line business results.
• 曾独立负责具有明确业务结果的增长或经营专项，而不只是参与活动执行。Ownership of strategic growth or commercial initiatives with measurable business outcomes.
• 熟悉交易平台的客户结构、产品体系、收入模式和市场周期。Familiarity with exchange client structures, product portfolios, revenue models, and market cycles.
• 能够使用SQL、BI工具或AI工具完成业务分析、策略研究及运营提效。Experience using SQL, BI platforms, or AI tools for business analysis, strategic research, and operational improvement.

 

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: Head of People Advisory and Employee Relations (12 Month Fixed Term Contract)
jobs.description:
Hello, we’re Starling.

Banking was broken – so we decided to fix it. The vision? Fast technology, fair service and honest values. All at the tap of a phone, all the time. We built Britain’s first digital bank. One hard-won banking licence later, we set about giving people a new way to spend, save and manage their money (and take better care of the planet, too). We’re changing banking for good. Back then, we were obsessed with unravelling the knotty world of finance and solving people’s problems rather than selling them stuff. We still are.

Since then, we’ve grown. A lot. Over four million accounts (and four account types!). A team of thousands. Headquartered in London with offices in Cardiff, Dublin, Manchester and Southampton. Five years voted Which? Recommended Provider and Britain's Best Banking Brand. Still zero branches. Our culture is open, inclusive and focused on solving real customer problems, with an emphasis on doing the right thing, even when it’s not always the easy thing. From our approach to working together and sustainability to how we build our products, our decisions need to make the world – and Starling – a better place to be. Everyone at Starling is essential to our mission, which is really quite simple: to solve our customer’s problems – and build the best bank in the world!

And now we're providing Starling to other banks, via a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) proposition through our subsidiary Engine, using the proprietary technology platform that it uses to power our own bank.

The Role:

At our core, we are dedicated to finding fantastic people and creating an environment where they can truly thrive. To support our continued growth, we are looking for a Head of People Advisory and Employee Relations (12 month FTC) to lead this critical function. Reporting to the Director of People Solutions, you will be the strategic architect of our Employee Relations framework across the Group. This isn't just about managing cases; it’s about setting the gold standard for how we support our people. You will provide expert leadership on complex ER matters, shape our people policies, and ensure we remain fully aligned with UK employment law and financial regulations (FCA/PRA and SMCR).

Your mission is to ensure our People Advisory team is seen as a trusted, proactive partner - one that balances commercial needs with a culture of inclusion, accountability, and psychological safety.

Knowledge
• In-depth knowledge of UK employment law, case law, and employee relations best practice.
• Strong understanding of financial services regulation, including FCA, PRA, and SMCR requirements as they relate to people management.
• Knowledge of people policies, procedures, and frameworks in a banking context.
• Awareness of HR strategy, organisational design, and cultural change within a regulated banking context.
• Familiar with HR systems and case management tools, ideally Workday.

Experience
• Proven experience of leading ER and People Advisory teams within financial services or a highly regulated environment.
• Proven track record of handling complex, high-risk ER cases, including tribunal preparation and negotiation with external stakeholders.
• Experience of building senior stakeholder relationships and influencing at executive/board level.
• Experience in developing and applying people policies and procedures.
• Experience of working collaboratively with legal, compliance, and risk teams.

Skills
• Excellent leadership, people management, influencing, and negotiation skills to constructively guide and challenge senior leaders.
• Advanced problem-solving and analytical skills, balancing legal, commercial, and cultural factors, and applying employment law practically.
• Highly organised with attention to detail, governance, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Agile, adaptable, resilient, and composed under pressure.
• Proficiency in HR systems and case management tools.
• CIPD qualification or working towards is desirable.
• 25 days holiday (plus take your public holiday allowance whenever works best for you)
• An extra day’s holiday for your birthday
• Annual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell up to five extra days off
• 16 hours paid volunteering time a year
• Salary sacrifice, company enhanced pension scheme
• Life insurance at 4x your salary
• Private Medical Insurance with VitalityHealth including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and Peloton
• Generous family-friendly policies
• Perkbox membership giving access to retail discounts, a wellness platform for physical and mental health, and weekly free and boosted perks
• Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work and Salary Sacrificed Gym partnerships

 About Us

You may be put off applying for a role because you don't tick every box. Forget that! While we can’t accommodate every flexible working request, we're always open to discussion. So, if you're excited about working with us, but aren’t sure if you're 100% there yet, get in touch anyway.

We’re on a mission to radically reshape banking – and that starts with our brilliant team. Whatever came before, we’re proud to bring together people of all backgrounds and experiences who love working together to solve problems.

Starling Bank is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster diversity & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment at Starling Bank are considered without regard to race, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

By submitting your application, you agree that Starling Bank may collect your personal data for recruiting and related purposes. Our Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over our use of your personal information.

jobs.title: People Partner
jobs.description:
We’re currently hiring a Global People Partner (Global HR Business Partner) to join our growing People Partners team and our mission. You’ll be supporting our Payment Operations teams and Global Product Operations teams in 7 locations globally (approx 650 Wisers in your direct stakeholder groups). You will be based in our London office.

We are looking for a commercially-minded, driven and goal-oriented HR Business Partner who will actively partner across our Servicing Operations teams and People team at Wise. This gives you an exciting opportunity to work internationally with very talented people, while also being part of a larger People Team. This role offers a lot of variety and scope, giving you access to make an impact at scale at Wise.

If you’re a curious, passionate and results-oriented HR professional, with an eye for detail and data, then this role is for you! You’ll thrive in creating great workplaces and working on a complete cycle of HR processes, including establishing trusted partnerships with business leaders and Wisers.

We’re looking for someone who is passionate about all things “people”. You enjoy partnering with senior stakeholder, getting to know the business, and providing pragmatic solutions to their everyday challenges.

Wise has already pioneered new ways for people to transfer money across borders and currencies. Our customers can also manage their hard-earned money with the world’s first platform to offer true multi-currency banking. We’re 9,500+ Wisers strong, with over 124 nationalities working in 11 key global locations! This is a unique opportunity to join Europe’s most valuable fintech company at a pivotal time in evolving our global People Team. 

What problems are we solving

We are building the People Partner capability at Wise as a way to empower leaders and ensure the service we offer is able to scale and keep up with growth. We help build our ways of working in a way that helps us grow sustainably and gives a great Wiser experience. Having customer-facing People Partners embedded in their business areas ensures that Wiser’s problems are being solved autonomously and at speed.

In your role as a Global People Partner, you will become the trusted partner to your stakeholders and spend time building and executing a people plan within your functions. 

The How
• Create close, effective relationships with senior leads and their teams, acting as a trusted People Partner to identify and achieve shared objectives, coaching, advising, and supporting them with their people plans and talent needs.
• Create and drive people strategy, along with metrics and OKRs, for your area of responsibility including performance management, talent identification and succession, org design, employee engagement & communications, skills gaps, workforce planning.
• Work with the Recruitment team and business leads to prioritise, plan and forecast roles for future growth.
• Accountability for driving the people strategy through high-quality talent planning, succession, assessment, and other processes, ensuring the seamless execution of approved plans.
• Drive organisational development, re-design, change & engagement in your areas, including project management & employee communications.
• Partner with leaders to develop our leadership capability and skills needed for our future success.
• Work closely with HR Centres of Expertise (CoE) to resolve complex and challenging problems through innovative and agile thinking.
• Actively drive our DEI strategy looking at how this can be improved for your business units across all touch points of the Wiser lifecycle. Support Wise initiatives and actively contribute to embed DEI nudges across our processes.
• Analyse people metrics and risks adding further insight into the overall health of our teams and to share trends or determine opportunities for focus.
• Lead the WiserPulse (our engagement survey) rollout into functional areas and drive action plans.
• Provide advice and consultation on complex Employee Relations issues.
• Help shape the global people team plan and priorities through the collation of global business trends, needs and anticipated future requirements.
• Champion our values and culture, being a role model for these and supporting the continual embedding of them in everything we do.

jobs.title: AI Engineer, Workbench
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

AI at Brex

AI Engineering at Brex is redefining how businesses run their finances by building intelligent, autonomous systems directly into the Brex platform. Our teams develop AI agents that don’t just surface insights—they take action, optimizing spend, managing workflows, and making real-time decisions on behalf of our customers. By deeply integrating proprietary financial data with product and platform infrastructure, we’re turning complex financial operations into simple, automated experiences and setting a new standard for how modern finance works.

What you’ll do

As an AI Engineer on our Finance Agents team, you’ll build Brex’s Agent Workbench: our singular conversational surface where finance professionals work with Brex’s agents through documents, charts, spreadsheets, and other interactive surfaces. You’ll help customers understand financial activity, investigate findings, revise policies, and steer agents doing consequential work.

Your first substantial project will be evolving the existing workbench into an extensible platform that can support multiple agent experiences, including bookkeeping and Brex Assistant. You’ll own the extension model, integration protocols, and application architecture that enable other teams to bring their agents and experiences into a coherent workspace.

You’ll establish the agentic design system with the technical depth to connect interaction design to platform decisions. Working closely with frontend engineers, agent teams, Product, and Design, you’ll build across application layers as needed and iterate with customers. The scope includes experiences such as policy editing, reporting, backtesting, and interactive data exploration, with priorities shaped by user needs.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We require three coordinated days in the office per week — Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Design and build a reusable agent workbench platform that supports multiple agent personas and enables other teams to integrate their agents and product experiences.
• Design and implement extension models, integration protocols, and application architecture that connect agent capabilities with rich, consistent user interactions.
• Build and ship customer-facing workflows that combine conversation with documents, charts, spreadsheets, and interactive artifacts, owning UI implementation and the supporting application behavior.
• Partner with frontend engineers, agent teams, Product, and Design to turn ambiguous user needs into cohesive experiences, making thoughtful tradeoffs across usability, extensibility, and reliability.
• Own features from design through production and iteration: talk directly with customers, investigate failures, and use feedback and observed outcomes to improve how users understand, configure, and steer agents.

Requirements
• 5+ years of software development experience delivering customer-facing applications
• Experience building or contributing to a production grade agent, agent harness, workbench, or agentic product.
• Experience in application architecture and integration design, with the ability to translate interaction needs into extensible interfaces, protocols, and clear boundaries between components.
• Deep familiarity with agent clients such as Claude, ChatGPT, and OpenCode, grounded in sustained use.
• Strong product judgment and ownership in ambiguous environments. You work effectively across engineering, Product, and Design, challenge decisions constructively, and take responsibility for production quality and customer outcomes.

Bonus points
• Full-stack experience spanning rich frontend interactions, backend services, APIs, and data modeling.
• Experience building IDEs, developer tools, real-time collaborative applications, or similarly sophisticated web products.
• Experience designing extension systems or reusable application platforms adopted by other teams.
• Professional experience shipping LLM or agentic products, including human-in-the-loop workflows, tracing, evaluation, or feedback mechanisms.
• Experience with financial software or other consequential workflows where transparency, traceability, and user control matter.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $216,000 - $240,000 USD. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

The Marketing team tells the Brex story, turning product innovation into customer obsession. Our team spans Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, and Brand Marketing, and works cross-functionally with Brand Design, Product, and Sales to drive growth and build trust.

What you’ll do

We are looking for a Brand Marketing Lead to set the creative standard and execute integrated campaigns that position Brex as the intelligent finance platform for ambitious companies. In this senior IC role, you will own major campaign launches end-to-end, combining sharp storytelling with strategic media distribution and measurement to elevate brand relevance, build market authority, and deliver commercial impact.

Where you'll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco or New York City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Lead Brex’s integrated brand campaign roadmap, owning large-scale brand moments from insights and briefing through creative execution, launch, and post-campaign analysis.
• Act as lead creative strategist and narrative architect, translating product capabilities and market trends into clear, distinctive, and memorable campaign themes.
• Drive integrated media and channel orchestration, partnering tightly with in-house media planners and external agency partners to build holistic media strategies across Paid Social, OOH, CTV, Digital Video, Sponsorships, and High-Impact Content Partnerships.
• Partner cross-functionally with Product Marketing (PMM), Growth Marketing, Comms, and Design to ensure brand campaigns align with product launches, build brand authority that accelerates deals, and directly feed down-funnel performance engines.

You might be a fit if you:
• Have 7–10+ years of experience leading multi-channel brand campaigns, creative strategy, or integrated marketing, ideally with a background in high-growth tech, SaaS, fintech, or top-tier brand agencies.
• Are a creative strategist at heart with exceptional narrative instincts and a proven portfolio of breakthrough campaign work that shifted market perception.
• Are deeply media-fluent, possessing a strong pulse on the evolving B2B and modern media landscape (OOH, CTV, podcasts, custom partnerships, paid social) and knowing where high-value audiences spend their time.
• Are an expert cross-functional operator who can align cross-departmental partners (PMM, Growth, Comms, Design) around a single creative vision and execution plan.

jobs.title: SDE 2 Infra
jobs.description:
About Fam (previously FamPay)

Fam is India’s first payments app for everyone above
11. FamApp helps make online and offline payments through UPI and FamCard. We are on a mission to raise a new, financially aware generation, and drive 250 million+ young users in India to kickstart their financial journey super early in their life.

We’re reimagining how the next generation experiences fintech—going beyond payments to build a lifestyle brand that blends money, identity, and everyday experiences into one seamless, intuitive journey.

Founded in 2019 by IIT Roorkee alumni, Fam is backed by some of the most respected investors around the world like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (Sequoia Capital) India, Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital and the likes of Kunal Shah, Amrish Rao as angel investors.

About the team
The Core Infrastructure team builds the platforms and systems that power everything at Fam, from real-time app experiences to high-volume payments. It operates as a small, high-leverage team with deep ownership. Every service at Fam runs on the platform this team builds, so it cares obsessively about system fundamentals, operational excellence, and mechanical sympathy.
What our systems process
1 Billion+ API requests per day powering ~10M daily transactions for 10M+ users at 20,000+ RPS.
470+ node Kubernetes cluster (~2,500 vCPUs and ~8 TiB RAM) under active orchestration.
Dynamic, multi-dimensional auto-scaling powered by 195+ HPAs paired with Karpenter.
12+ TB of active transactional data (and counting) across our high-throughput database clusters.
Event Streaming - 400+ topics, and 3,800+ partitions at ~46,700 messages/sec
Our Next Chapter
While our core systems already handle massive scale, our next vision as a team is to turn infrastructure into a frictionless platform discipline.
We are building towards a world where internal engineering teams consume platform primitives compute, storage, and event streams via self-serve contracts without waiting on us. We're also laying the groundwork for AI-native platform operations, developing agent plane and agent skills so agents can safely interact & operate infrastructure primitives alongside our team. We look to the CNCF landscape for best-in-class tools our systems, with a long-term commitment to contributing back to open source.

 
Perks That Go Beyond the Paycheck
• Relocation assistance to make your move seamless.
• Free office meals (lunch & dinner).
• Generous leave policy, including birthday leave, period leave, paternity and maternity support, and more.
• Salary advance and loan policies for any financial help.
• Quarterly rewards and recognition programs, and a referral program with great incentives.
• Access the latest gadgets and tools.
• Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family, mental health support.
• Tax benefits with options like food coupons, phone allowances, car/device leasing.
• Retirement perks like PF contribution, leave encashment and gratuity.
 
Here’s all the tea on FamApp ☕️
FamApp focuses on financial inclusion of the next generation by providing UPI & card payments to everyone above 11 years old. Our flagship Spending Account, FamX, seamlessly integrates UPI and card payments, enabling users to manage, save, and learn about their finances effortlessly.
 
Revolutionizing Payments and FinTech
FamApp has enabled 10 million+ users to make UPI and card payments across India, removing the inconvenience of carrying cash everywhere. Users get to customise their FamX card with doodles, which lets them add a personal touch to their payments.
 
Trusted by leading investors
We’re proud to be supported by renowned investors like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (formerly Sequoia Capital India), Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital, and esteemed angels Kunal Shah and Amrish Rao.
 
Join Our Dynamic Team
At Fam, our people-first approach is reflected in our generous leave policies, flexible work schedules, comprehensive health benefits, and free mental health sessions. We don’t mean to brag, but we promise you’ll be surrounded by some of the most fun, talented and passionate people in the startup space.
 
Want to see what makes life at Fam so awesome? Check out our shenanigans at @lifeatfam 😛
PS - We’re looking for someone with an AI-native mindset, who actively leverages AI in their day-to-day work, as we encourage and embed it across every level at Fam.

Greenlight is a family technology company on a mission to help families raise financially smart kids and navigate life together. Its suite of products — including the Greenlight app, debit card, Safe Family GPS trackers, and Family Hub — brings together financial tools, safety features, and everyday family management in one connected experience. Designed for busy families who want convenience without compromise, Greenlight continues to innovate alongside the evolving needs of modern life. Today, more than 6.5 million family members trust Greenlight to stay in sync.
At Greenlight, we're here to make the day-to-day easier and futures brighter, so families can spend less time managing life, and more time living it. That's why we get out of bed every morning.

It takes a talented team to aim for a mission like ours. We're looking for people who ask "is it bold enough?" jobs.title: Head of Compliance, LATAM
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity:

We are seeking a Senior Manager Compliance to join our dynamic Compliance Team within our LATAM region. We are a team of risk-minded problem solvers who advise regional business on the company's regulatory obligations and enterprise risk. The successful candidate will have extensive knowledge and experience in KYC/KYB, CDD/EDD, AML/FT and Sanctions' regulations, particularly within the LATAM crypto markets.

 

Key

Responsibilities:
• Serve as the senior compliance authority for the region, with direct accountability for regulatory relationships across all LatAm jurisdictions.
• Lead engagement with regulators at the regional level, including inspections, inquiries, and strategic regulatory positioning.
• Lead, develop, and coordinate a team of MLROs and compliance professionals across multiple markets.
• Partner with senior business, legal, and product leadership across LatAm to embed compliance requirements into strategic decisions, new product launches, and market expansions.
• Implement and maintain robust compliance policies, procedures, controls, and frameworks across LATAM in alignment with the Global Compliance Standard.
• Ensure policies and procedures are adapted appropriately for local markets.
• Identify compliance gaps and recommend remediation strategies.
• Collaborate cross-functionally (with groups such as Data, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Product and Risk) to operationalize compliance initiatives in line with local regulations, global standards and industry best practices.
• Monitor, and assess compliance with laws, regulations and policies from regional regulatory bodies (current and proposed regulatory frameworks).
• Supervise compliance reviews, investigations and suspicious activities in the region.
• Prepare and submit accurate and timely periodic compliance reports to local authorities.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager / Director, Trading Products
jobs.description:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Hong Kong, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

 

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 

 

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About The Opportunity

OKX is building out its equities and tokenized securities business. This is a post-trade and brokerage systems product role — you will own the layer that sits between our users and the securities markets: order management, execution, settlement, asset servicing and reconciliation.

We have strong crypto product and engineering talent. What this role brings is depth in brokerage architecture and securities market structure: how these systems are built, why they are built that way, and what breaks at scale. You will be the internal authority on that, and your judgment will shape decisions that are expensive to reverse.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Own the brokerage core — order management, execution and routing, instrument lifecycle and trading status, settlement and reconciliation.
• Shape account, custody and clearing architecture, along with the operating model required to run it.
• Own corporate actions and asset servicing end to end, in both conventional and on-chain form.
• Define how securities risk and margin frameworks coexist with those of a 24/7 digital asset market.
• Bring market structure, execution quality and regulatory requirements into product decisions early, before they become blockers.
• Set the standard for rigour — write PRDs precise enough to build from, and lead alignment across engineering, risk, legal, compliance and treasury.

What We Look For In You 

Domain Depth
• 5+ years in post-trade or brokerage systems product management. We strongly prefer candidates from internet and licensed brokerages — Futu, Tiger, Interactive Brokers, Robinhood, Webull, Longbridge — as well as clearing firms and brokerage infrastructure providers.
• Architectural perspective. You have a clear view of where responsibility belongs across the order, execution, clearing, settlement, asset servicing and ledger layers, and of what goes wrong downstream when a boundary is drawn in the wrong place.
• Depth across the order and execution path. Order types and parameters, state machine design, idempotency across an external execution boundary, cancel/replace and partial-fill semantics, timeout and exception recovery. This is the core craft of the role.
• End-to-end ownership of at least one area beyond the order path — clearing and settlement, corporate actions and asset servicing, margin and risk, securities lending, or position and cash reconciliation.
• Commercial and historical perspective. You understand how a brokerage actually earns, how each revenue line constrains the systems beneath it, and why the industry made the structural choices it did.

Ways of Working
• Strong technical intuition. You are comfortable discussing system architecture and data flows with engineers. You do not need to be a developer, but you think with the rigour of one.
• You design for the exceptions — the halted symbol, the timed-out counterparty, the partial fill, the corporate action mid-flight — not just the order that goes through.
• You run programs, not just write specs. You produce rigorous PRDs independently, drive alignment across engineering, risk, legal, compliance and treasury, and own the full lifecycle from requirements through post-launch review.
• You write precisely, and can make complex mechanics legible to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
• High agency. You are comfortable taking an open question all the way to a shipped, reconciled system, and making calls with incomplete information.
• Proficiency in Mandarin is required to communicate effectively with internal engineering and product stakeholders in the China-based R D center.

Nice-To-Haves
• Product experience with margin financing or securities lending.
• Exposure to tokenized securities, digital asset custody, or on-chain settlement.
• Experience integrating with broker-dealer or clearing APIs, as either the integrator or the provider.
• Hands-on experience with multi-jurisdiction regulatory frameworks — SEC/FINRA, MiFID II, or equivalent.
• A track record of launching a brokerage product in a new market from zero.
• Fluency in English to support communication with global product and business stakeholders.
• Genuine curiosity about what happens when securities markets meet 24/7 markets.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

Please note that Hong Kong is a group-level service hub, and OKX does not carry on a business of operating a virtual asset trading platform in Hong Kong.

About The Opportunity

We are looking for a Staff Mobile Security Engineer to join our Mobile Security team, where you will play a key role in identifying and mitigating security vulnerabilities across OKX's mobile applications and platforms. This is a high-ownership role at the intersection of offensive security, mobile engineering, and platform protection — you will work closely with development, operations, and compliance teams to ensure security is embedded at every layer of our mobile stack.

You bring deep expertise in mobile application security, offensive techniques, and secure coding practices. You are also fluent in AI-assisted development and bring the discipline to build, maintain, and continuously improve your own AI engineering workflows.

 

What You'll Be Doing
• Identify and address security vulnerabilities in mobile code, systems, and networks through manual review, automated tooling, and threat modelling.
• Manage and optimise application security tools, processes, and alerts to maintain a strong security posture.
• Validate and respond to Bug Bounty submissions, triaging findings and coordinating remediation with engineering teams.
• Produce detailed security findings reports and present them to both technical and management audiences, contributing to real-world attack prevention.
• Collaborate with development teams to implement and champion secure coding practices across iOS and Android platforms.
• Apply AI tools to accelerate security research, automate vulnerability detection workflows, and improve the efficiency of threat analysis.
• Work alongside operations and compliance teams to ensure security is a consistent priority across the organisation.
• Participate in incident response and management activities.
• Stay current on the latest offensive security techniques, application security threats, and industry best practices.

 

What We Look For In You
• 5+ years of experience in mobile application security or offensive security, with hands-on expertise in iOS and/or Android platforms.
• In-depth understanding of security risks, vulnerabilities, and concepts in mobile and web applications.
• Proficient in code review across Kotlin, Swift, TypeScript, or JavaScript, with a strong grasp of application security threats.
• Able to create proof-of-concepts (PoCs) to demonstrate vulnerabilities, review patch code for adherence to standards, and collaborate with repository owners on remediation.
• Actively uses AI tools in your security engineering workflow — including building AI-leveraged workflows and codifying repeatable agent skills so tools like Claude Code or Codex deliver reliably on real production work.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with excellent verbal and written communication skills.

 

Nice-To-Haves
• Prior experience developing mobile security SDKs at scale — products with a daily active user base of over ten million.
• Experience in large-scale business risk control projects, or practical experience in threat intelligence, business risk prevention, and countermeasures against black and grey industries.
• In-depth reverse engineering of major apps from first-tier vendors, or other projects that demonstrate strong reverse engineering capabilities.
• Proficiency in ARM assembly, with the ability to implement deep-level countermeasures at the native and application layers.
• Experience with device fingerprint recognition — including simulating new devices through methods such as flashing, modification, and application cloning.
• Ability to work across multiple mobile platforms simultaneously.

 

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

You will be responsible for continuously refining and scaling the Technology and Security oversight program, guiding first-line of defence (1LOD) execution, and providing independent risk challenge.

You will be a key member of OKX's Risk team, helping to shape and scale the firm’s 2LOD Security Data Risk programs. You’ll work closely with stakeholders including Engineering, Product, Risk, Compliance and Internal Audit.

You will play a key role in developing and implementing a comprehensive Technology and Security Risk Management program. This includes 2LOD oversight of technology defects, issues, and incidents, Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSA), key risk indicators (KRIs) and reporting.

The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of Technology Risk (including Technology Resilience, Change Management, SDLC, CI/CD pipeline, and software quality assurance) and Cybersecurity (covering internal and external threat vectors, control weaknesses, and organisational cyber hygiene). We are looking for a candidate with a strong drive for improvement and career growth.

What You’ll Be Doing 

Collaborate with internal stakeholders across the company to proactively identify, escalate, assess, and mitigate Technology and Security risks, ensuring adherence to the Technology Risk Policy.

Providing oversight of Technology and Security Risk incidents and issues, and partnering with 1LOD stakeholders to enhance related processes and ensure effective oversight

Lead the Technology Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) process from a 2LOD perspective, ensuring adherence to the ERM RCSA methodology, and providing effective challenge and oversight of 1LOD Security risks and controls.

Support the Security Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) definition, monitoring, and reporting.

Supporting the implementation and ongoing enhancement of Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) systems to enable effective risk oversight

Advocate and support the implementation of Risk Management frameworks for technology stakeholders, serving as a trusted advisor for the first line.

Stay up to date on emerging trends and regulations in the digital asset space, proactively identifying and addressing new risk considerations.

What We Look For In You
• 8+ years in information security, with a strong security architecture or technical security background; fintech, crypto or cloud-native experience preferred.
• Practical experience designing, implementing or reviewing cloud, IAM, cryptographic, network or application security controls.
• Experience in risk oversight, or readiness to transition, with the technical judgement to challenge controls and recommend proportionate improvements.
• Ability to threat-model systems and assess technical evidence, including architecture diagrams, IAM policies, logging configurations and dependencies.
• Working knowledge of cloud resilience, multi-region/AZ failover, RTO/RPO and disaster recovery testing.
• Familiarity with NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2 and relevant privacy requirements, including GDPR and PDPA, and their application to technical controls.
• Ability to independently assess and test controls, evaluate incidents and drive remediation with engineering and security teams; GRC platform experience desirable.
• Clear written and verbal communication, translating technical findings into prioritised actions for business stakeholders and governance committees.
• Strong stakeholder management skills, providing constructive challenge and collaborating across functions and geographies.
• A proactive, adaptable approach, with confidence taking ownership and improving practices in a fast-paced environment.
• A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience; CISSP, CCSP, cloud security/architecture, CISA or CISM qualifications desirable.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: Technology Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Hello, we’re Starling. We are proud to be the first British bank founded by a woman, Anne Boden. We built a new kind of bank because we knew technology had the power to help people save, spend and manage their money in a new and transformative way. We’re a fully licensed UK bank with the culture and spirit of a fast-moving, disruptive tech company. We’re a bank, but better: fairer, easier to use and designed to demystify money for everyone. We employ more than 3,000 people across our London, Southampton, Cardiff and Manchester offices.

Our technologists are at the very heart of Starling and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment that is all about building things, creating new stuff, and disruptive technology that keeps us on the cutting edge of fintech. We are deeply committed to closing the gender gap in technology; from our partnership with Code First Girls to our internal 'With Women' and 'Embrace' networks, we actively champion diverse women in tech. We operate a flat structure to empower you to make decisions regardless of what your primary responsibilities may be, innovation and collaboration will be at the core of everything you do. Help is never far away in our open culture, you will find support in your team and from across the business, we are in this together!

The way to thrive and shine within Starling is to be a self-driven individual and be able to take full ownership of everything around you: From building things, designing, discovering, to sharing knowledge with your colleagues and making sure all processes are efficient and productive to deliver the best possible results for our customers. Our purpose is underpinned by five Starling values: Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim For Greatness.

About the role

Our Technology Operations team is the first line of support for Starling, serving both our internal colleagues and our external technology partners. In this role, you will be responsible for leading a high-performing team that supports a primarily Apple Mac estate (with some Windows PCs) and critical infrastructure. You will manage team operations across two offices, ensuring a consistently high standard of support. This role blends hands-on technical support leadership with a drive for operational excellence, continual service improvement, and team performance.

What You’ll Do:
• Lead and manage the Technology Operations team across multiple offices, ensuring seamless support for internal users and external partners.
• Drive the best performance and behaviors from your team in line with our company values and performance management framework, coaching and up-skilling colleagues regularly.
• Provide day-to-day oversight for our Mac and Windows environments, ensuring our managed systems and network operate smoothly.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to understand operational requirements and integrate effective support processes.
• Assist with escalations to third-party suppliers, triaging and escalating issues as necessary to maintain high service standards.
• Assist in the development of data and metric-driven dashboards to identify opportunities for process improvements and to track team performance.
• Manage incident response and escalation processes to ensure timely and effective resolution of technical issues.
• Support the execution of IT projects related to office infrastructure and hardware lifecycle management.
• Proven experience managing a technical support or operations teams in a fast-paced, technically complex environment.
• Strong working knowledge of macOS and Windows support, along with experience using management tools such as Zentral, Intune, and Meraki.
• Demonstrated ability to manage multi-site operations, whilst driving a high-performance culture.
• Experience with incident management, ITSM tools, and continuous improvement processes.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with both internal stakeholders and external partners, whilst balancing multiple priorities.
• A passion for continuous improvement, with a metrics-driven mindset to develop dashboards and track key performance indicators.

We enable our customers to manage their money 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Whenever they need us, we will be there. As such, we are looking for people who can commit to 37.5 hours a week between 7am-10pm Monday to Sunday.
• 25 days holiday (plus take your public holiday allowance whenever works best for you)
• An extra day’s holiday for your birthday
• Annual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell up to five extra days off
• 16 hours paid volunteering time a year
• Salary sacrifice, company enhanced pension scheme
• Life insurance at 4x your salary & group income protection
• Private Medical Insurance with VitalityHealth including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and Peloton
• Generous family-friendly policies
• Incentives refer a friend scheme
• Perkbox membership giving access to retail discounts, a wellness platform for physical and mental health, and weekly free and boosted perks
• Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work, Salary Sacrificed Gym partnerships and Electric Vehicle (EV) leasing

So, if you're excited about working with us, but aren’t sure if you're 100% there yet, get in touch anyway. We’re on a mission to radically reshape banking – and that starts with our brilliant team.
