jobs.description:
YouTrip is the leading and fastest-growing multi-currency payment platform in Asia Pacific. In 2018, we pioneered the region's first multi-currency digital wallet. Now, YouTrip is the #1 multi-currency digital wallet trusted by millions across the region, processing over US$15 billion in total payment value annually. 

Our consumer and business propositions – YouTrip and YouBiz – empower individuals and businesses with inclusive, accessible, and affordable financial solutions. YouTrip has raised over US$110 million to date, including its recent Series B round led by global venture capital firm Lightspeed Venture Partners—underscoring strong investor confidence in its mission to transform digital financial services across the Asia Pacific. 

Recognised as World Economic Forum’s Global Innovator 2025, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies (2025, 2024), and LinkedIn’s Top Startup (2024, 2023), YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses.

Valuing an entrepreneurial culture of diversity and inclusion, we are seeking driven individuals to join our fast-growing regional team as we push the boundaries of innovative fintech solutions.

Job Description:

Principal Architect, Payments & Ledger

You'll own the architectural direction for money movement end to end: multi-currency wallets and balances, the core ledger, card issuing and authorisation, in-app FX, overseas transfers and payouts, treasury and pre-funding, settlement and reconciliation, and the shared platform services underneath them. Your remit covers both YouTrip (consumer) and YouBiz (business), across every market we operate in.

Responsibilities:
• The Ledger - Double-entry design, chart of accounts, sub-ledger boundaries, immutability and correction rules, multi-currency representation, precision and rounding policy, and how balances are derived or stored. You'll define how we handle authorisation holds, reversals, partial and incremental captures, refunds, FX revaluation and unreconciled positions, and you'll be able to explain and defend those choices to Finance, auditors and regulators.
• Money movement correctness - Idempotency, exactly-once outcomes on top of at-least-once messaging, clear state machines for every transaction type, and well-defined failure, retry, timeout and compensation paths. For every integration, the question "what happens if the partner succeeds and we fail?" should have a written answer that you own.
• Card issuing - Architecture for authorisation, clearing and settlement as a Mastercard Principal Member, including real-time authorisation on the scheme's critical path, stand-in processing, authorisation expiry, disputes and chargebacks, tokenisation for Apple Pay and Google Pay, virtual and physical card lifecycle, and the strict latency and availability targets that come with it.
• FX and multi-currency wallets - Rate sourcing, quoting and rate locking, spread and exposure management, in-app currency exchange across our wallet currencies, and pre-funding and liquidity models that keep customers' balances safe and available.
• Cross-border transfers - Corridor architecture, payout rail integrations (local real-time rails, bank transfers, SWIFT and partner networks), pre-funding and nostro design, and sanctions and AML screening built in as a core design constraint, not an afterthought.
• Reconciliation and settlement - We treat reconciliation as an architecture problem, not an operations task. You'll design systems where breaks are rare, spotted within minutes, and traceable to a clear cause, across multiple time zones, currencies and partners.
• Non-functional requirements - Latency, throughput, availability and cost as design targets with numbers attached. Clear, written decisions on where eventual consistency is acceptable and where it isn't. Recovery, replay and backfill as built-in capabilities.
• Standards and technical judgement - Engineering and coding standards, architecture reviews for significant changes, and architecture documentation that engineers actually build from. You'll write decision records that capture the reasoning and the options rejected, and keep them current.
• Partners and vendors - Technical evaluation and ongoing oversight of card processors, scheme connectivity, banking and settlement partners, FX liquidity providers, payout partners, KYC and screening vendors, and core infrastructure. You'll know their systems' failure modes as well as their own architects do.
• Growing technical leaders - You'll mentor tech leads and senior engineers from day one and lead mostly through influence. As the function matures, you'll build and lead a small architecture group.
• Deep payments and ledger experience (essential) - You've designed or substantially rebuilt a production financial ledger. You can speak from real experience about journal design, posting models, balance consistency and correction strategies, including what happens when they go wrong.
• Card issuing expertise - Hands-on experience with card scheme integrations (ideally Mastercard), issuer processing, authorisation flows, clearing files, and disputes.
• A builder, not just an advisor - You've written production code at scale, and your work sits behind systems that handled real traffic and real money. Your authority comes from having shipped.
• Range from system to field level - You're equally comfortable designing distributed settlement flows and deciding the type and precision of a single amount field, often in the same week.
• Regulated-environment fluency - Experience with safeguarding and customer fund segregation, payment and e-money licensing, data residency, auditability and technology risk requirements, ideally including MAS and other Asia Pacific regulators. You design ahead of regulatory and scheme changes instead of reacting to them.
• Multi-market experience - You've built systems that operate across several countries, currencies and regulators at once.
• Strong writing - Clear, structured, opinionated documents that remain useful long after the meeting ends. Documentation is part of the work, not a follow-up task.
• Opinions you can defend - Clear positions on design patterns, standards and trade-offs, explained just as well to a new graduate as to the board.
• Credibility with partners - You can tell when a vendor's recommendation serves them more than us, and you can make that case with evidence.
• Experience with Golang, event-driven architectures and cloud-native infrastructure is a plus.

What This Role Is Not

This isn't a diagramming role, and it isn't a review gate that approves other people's work without contributing to it. It's also not an engineering management role with large headcount or delivery ownership, though its influence is comparable. If you're looking to run a large organisation, we have other roles for that.

What You Can Expect From Us
• The chance to shape the core money platform of Asia Pacific's leading multi-currency wallet, used by millions of people and businesses.
• Some of the most interesting payments challenges in the region, across multiple markets, currencies, partners and regulators.
• A company that is committed to getting the architecture right, not just shipping fast.
• A culture that values technical craft, direct feedback and getting things done.

To Apply

If you're interested in this role, click Apply Now and send us your CV. Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

jobs.description:

YouTrip has raised over US$110 million to date, including its recent Series B round led by global venture capital firm Lightspeed Venture Partners—underscoring strong investor confidence in its mission to transform digital financial services across the Asia Pacific. 

Recognised as World Economic Forum’s Global Innovator 2025, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies (2025, 2024), and LinkedIn’s Top Startup (2024, 2023), YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses.

Valuing an entrepreneurial culture of diversity and inclusion, we are seeking driven individuals to join our fast-growing regional team as we push the boundaries of innovative fintech solutions.

Job Description:

Technical Program Manager

As a Technical Program Manager at YouTrip, you'll help our engineering organization deliver complex, cross-team programs that power payments for millions of customers and businesses across Asia Pacific. You'll bring structure to large initiatives that span mobile, backend, infrastructure, risk, and compliance. You'll turn ambiguous goals into clear roadmaps, keep teams across India and the region aligned, and make sure critical launches ship on time, safely, and at the quality our customers expect from a financial product.

You'll also help raise the bar for how engineering works at YouTrip by driving shared standards, better delivery processes, and the tools and practices that help teams move faster with confidence. This role needs a strong mix of technical understanding and people skills, so you can earn the trust of engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders alike.

Technical Program Management at YouTrip sits within our engineering organization and plays a key role in helping teams across India and the region deliver as one. TPMs are experienced technologists who create clarity, make sure we focus on the right priorities, drive execution, and manage risk on programs that depend on strong cross-team collaboration. You'll be joining a growing India team at an important stage, with real influence over how we build and scale.

Responsibilities:
• Lead the end-to-end delivery of multiple complex, technical programs at once, such as new market launches, card and payment network integrations, platform migrations, and regulatory or security initiatives.
• Work with engineering, product, design, QA, risk, compliance, and operations teams to define scope, requirements, milestones, and ownership.
• Build roadmaps that balance near-term deliverables with the longer-term technical direction of each program.
• Track progress, surface blockers early, and resolve cross-team dependencies across India and regional teams in Singapore and other markets.
• Anticipate risks across teams and systems, and put mitigation and contingency plans in place before they affect customers or deadlines.
• Use metrics throughout the program lifecycle (delivery health, quality, reliability, and business outcomes) so decisions are grounded in data.
• Communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels, from engineering teams to senior leadership, through status updates, reviews, and presentations.
• Coordinate release planning for mobile (Android and iOS) and backend services, including launch readiness, rollouts, and post-launch reviews.
• Drive improvements to engineering processes, such as planning cadences, incident follow-ups, documentation standards, and delivery tooling.
• Help teams work well together by building a collaborative, accountable, and enjoyable program culture.
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
• 8+ years of experience in technology, including at least 4 years as a Technical Program Manager, engineering manager, or in a similar delivery leadership role.
• A background as a software engineer or in a closely related technical role, with the ability to follow system design discussions and spot edge cases and risks in technical specs.
• Working knowledge of several technology areas, such as mobile development, backend and distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, data, or security, and the ability to pick up new ones quickly.
• Experience in fintech, payments, banking, or other regulated environments is a strong plus.
• Proven success delivering large programs across multiple teams, time zones, and locations.
• Comfort with ambiguity and a habit of creating clarity: you make sure goals, owners, dependencies, and risks are understood by everyone involved.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex topics simply to technical and non-technical audiences.
• Strong relationship-building

skills:

you know how to align people with different priorities, make sure every voice is heard, and gain commitment to a shared plan.
• A focus on outcomes over activity: you prioritize by impact, think strategically, and are still willing to dig into details to help the team deliver.
• Familiarity with Agile and Scrum practices, OKRs, and tools such as Jira and Confluence.
• Relevant certifications (e.g. PMP, CSM, SAFe) are a plus but not required.

To Apply

If you're interested in this role, click Apply Now and send us your CV. Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

jobs.description:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

 

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer - Wise Business
jobs.description:
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world's money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money. For everyone, everywhere.

Staff Product Designer:

We’re looking for a Staff Product Designer to join the Business Chapter and help shape the experience of the Wise Business product.

You’ll work closely with product managers, content designers, researchers, engineers and analysts to integrate Wise into our customer’s day-to-day financial workflows, helping them send and receive money globally while minimising financial admin and manual bookkeeping.

Our business customers are often not just one person. You’ll be designing experiences that need to work for different users across shared workflows; whether it’s Business Owners, Finance Managers, Employees, Accountants or a combination.

 

Here’s how you’ll contribute:

How can we make it easy for small businesses to manage the financial complexity of working globally? How can we integrate with their other financial tools to reduce manual bookkeeping so they spend less time on admin? How can we support a business owner to safely delegate financial tasks while maintaining control? These are some of the challenges you’ll get a chance to work on in this role.

You will work as the product designer within a team in the Business Account Management Squad, reporting into the Group Design Lead. As well as working closely with the other members of your team, you will collaborate with designers across Wise to deliver consistent, scalable experiences. You will also mentor other designers in your squad.

Your work will focus on deepening use of the product and building trust with our business customers so that Wise becomes their everyday account. 

 

Here's how you'll be contributing:
• Owning design problems in your team and working through the detail to create solutions that balance the need to design ahead with delivering incremental value.
• Building a deep understanding of the unmet needs of business users and how the Wise experience can solve for those.
• Shaping the now, next and future state of the experience, and holding the work to the outcomes we've committed to.
• Bringing systems thinking to your work and collaborating with other teams to ensure we create one coherent experience.
• Building vision with substance through evidence backed direction that shapes the roadmap.
• Raising the standard around you, through feedback, crits and skill shares, and lifting the quality of design across the squad.
• Using AI in your daily practice where it earns its place, and showing the team what that looks like.

 

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Ship work you’re proud of. Craft experiences that make complex concepts or workflows feel simple, innovative, and easy to use.
• Own your impact. choose what to work on, define what success looks like, and see your work directly improve the experience of thousands of businesses.
• Work on something genuinely difficult. Regulatory considerations, multi-user workflows, product integrations, dozens of payment methods and features all have to add up to one experience.
• Be part of a positive change in the world. We're fixing a broken, greedy system, and giving businesses control of their money.

About you:
• You've been the most senior designer on a complex product area, owning ambiguous problems end to end. The title matters less than the scope.
• You think in systems. You've designed something that had to work across many markets, formats or edge cases without fragmenting into special cases.
• You practise evidence-based design, using data and customer insights to rationalise your decisions clearly and credibly to senior stakeholders.
• You’ve got a portfolio of well-crafted, impactful work that solves real, complex problems for real people.
• You default to prototyping, explore multiple approaches, and articulate the tradeoffs clearly enough to build conviction with senior stakeholders.
• You have a high craft bar and strong visual skills, and you've worked with design systems to produce work that scales.
• You make the designers around you better. You design in the open, give direct feedback, and share credit.
• You're already using AI tools in your practice and have a point of view on where they help and where they don't.

This role runs the internal posture engine — the risk register, critical control monitoring, evidence, audit operations and GRC tooling. It keeps risk state current so the Lead and the Risk Committee decide from accurate data in the Risk Dashboard and reporting. Drata is the register of record. Named owners close gaps; this role keeps the register, evidence and audit operations current.

Responsibilities

Planning
• Operate the risk register from the Security Programme threat model: populate, track treatment, record acceptance decisions, follow up owners, and run the exceptions register.
• Keep the ISMS and security policy library current as part of audit readiness. Draft security standards when commissioned by the Lead.
• Run Drata as the control and evidence system — Statement of Applicability, framework crosswalk and automation.

Execution
• Run critical control monitoring: health check-ins, drift flags and Drata automation. Route drift to the SOC. Maintain the evidence file for Lead assessments and independent internal audit.
• Feed threat-assessment findings into the register and confidence ratings. Track which required assessments are current.
• Lead audit coordination and preparation: ISO 27001 and SOC 2 logistics, ISMS readiness, team prep, management-review pack, and customer due-diligence questionnaires.
• Coordinate the control register for external testing (red team, tabletop, pentest). Run security awareness and weekly alerts.

Tracking and evaluating performance
• Track residual risk, exceptions and gap-closure against appetite. Exceptions expire and are reported; the underlying requirement stays in force.
• Report register state and evidence health so the Lead and Risk Committee work from one view.

jobs.title: Head, Group FP&A
jobs.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint is Africa's all-in-one financial ecosystem, empowering businesses and their customers with seamless payment, banking, credit, and management tools. In 2023, we processed $182 billion and are Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer.

Job Purpose

Builds and owns the Group's FP A framework, methodology, and reporting standards, giving Group leadership a single, reliable view of financial performance and outlook across the Group's subsidiaries and business units: Moniepoint Nigeria, Moniepoint Kenya, MonieWorld and Moniepoint Technologies.
This is a framework and consolidation role, not a day to day business unit finance role. Some subsidiaries and markets run their own standalone FP A team that owns local budgeting, forecasting, and reporting for that business; this role sets the Group standard those teams work within and consolidates their output. Wherever a subsidiary or shared function doesn't yet have a dedicated FP A resource, this role covers it directly. The intent is one Group framework, executed locally wherever a local team exists, with no duplicated effort.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

Responsibilities:
• Design and own the Group's FP A framework: forecasting architecture, budget process, and management-reporting standards that every entity works to, including markets that maintain their own standalone FP A team
• Consolidate entity and BU-level forecasts, including those submitted by markets with their own standalone FP A team, into a single Group P L, balance sheet, and cash flow, with a working currency toggle and intercompany eliminations
• Own the annual Group budget calendar and process: templates, timelines, challenge sessions, and Board approval, without taking over the local budget-building work each entity's own finance team already does
• Produce the consolidated Group forecast (2026-28 and beyond), reconciled monthly to actuals, with a clear bridge explaining variances
• Work closely with the Group Financial Controller so actuals, the consolidation, and the forecast reconcile cleanly month to month, and closing timelines support the reporting calendar
• Run the monthly and quarterly reporting cycles at Group level: consolidated management accounts, Board packs, and investor-grade reporting
• Build and maintain the Group's KPI and unit-economics framework, and ensure it is applied consistently across every entity's finance team, whether that entity has its own dedicated resource or is covered directly by this role
• Partner with BU CFOs / finance leads (Moniepoint Nigeria, Moniepoint Kenya, Moniepoint Technologies, MonieWorld) as the standard-setter and consolidator, leaving day-to-day local execution with them
• Lead scenario and sensitivity modelling for Group-level strategic decisions: new market entry, capital raises, new market expansion, licence applications etc.
• Set and enforce FP A style and modelling standards across the Group (structure, formatting, sign-off, version control)
• Manage and develop the Group FP A Analysts covering the subsidiaries and markets without a dedicated resource, plus central shared services

Candidate

requirements:
• 10+ years in FP A, corporate finance, or investment banking, including experience building forecasting frameworks from scratch
• Proven experience consolidating multi-entity, multi-currency forecasts and management accounts
• Background in banking, fintech, or another regulated, fast-growth environment
• Advanced financial modelling skills (Excel at architect level); comfortable owning a model spanning multiple entities and currencies
ACA / ACCA / CFA or equivalent
• Proven ability to operate effectively as a remote, senior finance leader across time zones and geographies

Preffered Qualifications
• Experience in a high-growth African or emerging-markets fintech or bank
• Prior exposure to Board and investor reporting at Group level
• Familiarity with planning/consolidation tooling (NetSuite, Aleph, Pigment or similar) beyond Excel
• Experience standing up FP A functions or frameworks during a scale-up phase, including defining where a Group function ends and in-country teams begin

About you
• You think in frameworks. You build the system once, properly, rather than patching it every quarter
• You're comfortable holding a multi-entity, multi-currency picture in your head and explaining it simply to the CFO and Board
• You know the difference between setting the standard and doing the work. You'd rather make each market's FP A team excellent within a shared framework than take their work off them
• You push back on numbers that don't reconcile, and you don't sign off until they do
• You're a strong people manager. You can direct analysts and get consistent, house-standard output from a small team
• You communicate in writing the way you model: structured, precise, no padding
• You operate well remotely: proactive, well-organised, comfortable driving a Group-wide process without being in the room

What success looks like
• Group forecast is reconciled to actuals monthly, with variances explained within an agreed tolerance
• Management, board and investor reporting are delivered on time, every cycle, without late-stage rework
• Budget process runs to a fixed calendar with BU sign-off, with no material off-cycle changes
• BU finance leads use the Group model and house standards as their working framework, not a parallel one
• CFO and Group CEO treat the FP A output as the single source of truth for decision-making

What to expect in the hiring process
• A preliminary phone call with one of our recruiters.
• Hiring Manager Interview
• A Panel interview with existing Finance Leads
• A behavioural and technical interview with a member of the Executive team.

jobs.title: Deputy General Counsel, Head of Americas Legal
jobs.location: New York, United States; San Jose, California, United States; United States (US)
jobs.description:
About the Team

OKX’s Legal team provides legal advice and guidance to the company across all coverage areas and geographic locations, and supports business growth and development by working with all teams within the company to help them achieve their goals. We are a high-functioning, collaborative and fast-paced group of lawyers who enjoy the cutting-edge nature of our work and our industry.

 

Our Americas Legal team is the primary legal partner to OKX's regulated businesses across the Americas region, advising on a broad range of topics including regulatory strategy, regulatory licensing, product launches, strategic partnerships and corporate matters. The Americas Legal team works cross-functionally with leaders across the company to help build and scale an innovative and compliant OKX platform.

About the Opportunity

This is an essential, high-profile role at one of the fastest-growing global cryptocurrency exchanges based in San Jose, CA. The Deputy General Counsel will play a central role in proactively shaping OKX's regulatory and legal strategy in the US and across the Americas. The Deputy General Counsel will act as a key partner and provide day-to-day counsel to senior business leadership of OKX's US business, including the coordination of efforts with Compliance, Risk, Operations, Finance and other functions. The Deputy General Counsel will stay abreast of all regulatory changes applicable to the digital asset space in the US, promptly communicate developments to OKX's senior business leadership, and help guide the business in identifying growth opportunities in the US. The position will coordinate the efforts of the legal function serving OKX's business in the US as well as the Americas more broadly, and will report to OKX's VP, Legal.

 

You'll work at the intersection of law, regulations, and product innovation - driving complex licensing initiatives, advising senior stakeholders on questions without clear precedent, and helping the business move quickly through an evolving regulatory landscape. We are looking for a hands-on legal leader with sharp judgment, strong interpersonal skills, and the desire to work with a top-notch legal team. The right candidate is not afraid to jump into novel and complex matters, and is willing to roll up their sleeves and work effectively under time pressure. We offer a competitive base salary and bonus structure as well as excellent benefits and an opportunity to work in a cutting-edge industry that will be the future of financial services.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Develop and advance a best-in-class regulatory strategy in the US and across the Americas, including the development and maintenance of strong relationships with regulators.
• Engage directly with regulators and business counterparties as a key point of contact for OKX, as well as interacting on a daily basis with senior executives at OKX.
• Identify growth opportunities and strategic initiatives based on proactive, timely, actionable analysis of US regulatory developments.
• Lead and manage attorneys covering various Americas regions so that legal efforts are coordinated and consistently achieve successful outcomes.
• Manage a wide range of legal requests and advise on legal risk with an eye toward achieving the strategic goals of the company's regional business leaders.

What We Look For In You
• Strong communication and leadership skills, and excellent judgment
• Self-starter who can contribute as both an individual and a team member, with limited reliance upon external counsel.
• Membership with a US state bar or equivalent.
• 12+ years of regulatory experience dealing with financial services laws and regulations in a highly-regulated environment.
• Prior experience can be in-house at a regulated financial firm or in the crypto industry (preferable), at a top-tier law firm, and/or at a regulator.
• Experience driving projects to completion on expedited timelines.
• Must be highly-driven, proactive, responsive and precise.
• Experience making strategic recommendations to senior management and senior legal team members.
• Comfortable navigating legal ambiguity.
• Experience advising on cross-jurisdictional legal and regulatory matters.
• Supervisory experience, and in particular, experience managing other attorneys.
• Enthusiastic about blockchain technology with experience advising on laws and regulations applicable in the crypto context.
• Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, growth-stage and multi-cultural environment and across global time zones.
• Ability to effectively advise and build trust with business teams.
• Superior organizational skills.

Nice to Haves
• Expertise in the US securities laws and regulations.
• Prior in-house experience in a financial services or crypto firm.

In addition to the salary, a performance bonus and long-term incentives may be provided as part of the compensation package, as well as a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered. jobs.title: Principal / Staff Engineer - Compliance
jobs.location: Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR; Singapore, Singapore
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

 

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 

 

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About The Opportunity

The Compliance team's primary objective is to ensure that OKX operates in accordance with regulatory requirements while maintaining the highest ethical and moral standards. The team owns the full compliance engineering stack: KYC onboarding and refresh, sanctions / PEP / adverse-media screening, transaction monitoring (TM) and travel-rule enforcement, case management, and regulatory reporting. We achieve this by developing compliance service solutions, integrating with KYC AML vendors, and enabling robust business growth, which ultimately strengthens user trust in our platform. Our ultimate goal is to create a culture of compliance excellence, where innovation and responsible business practices are seamlessly integrated. In compliance, a system that is mostly right is wrong — so every control we build must be deterministic in its enforcement, complete in its coverage, and explainable in its outcome.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Formulate, select, and develop technical schemes for platform projects across the compliance domain — KYC onboarding flows, identity verification and refresh, sanctions / PEP / adverse-media screening, transaction monitoring, travel-rule, case management, and regulatory reporting — including AI/ML-powered features such as intelligent screening disambiguation, document verification, anomaly detection, automated risk scoring, and analyst-assist agents.
• Organize and coordinate resources, leading project research and development, troubleshoot problems, and ensure quality and timely completion — including delivery of AI model integration work within KYC, screening, and monitoring workflows.
• Facilitate cross-team communication and promote teamwork efficiency through code quality control and collaboration, including partnering with Data Science, Risk, and Legal to productionize models and ensure reliable, auditable inference infrastructure.
• Define where probabilistic AI is appropriate versus where deterministic logic is mandatory — and design the boundary cleanly so models assist without compromising auditability or enforcement integrity.
• Undertake team tasks and cultivate technical talents in the industry, with a focus on building AI engineering best practices across the compliance engineering team — patterns for agentic coding, prompt libraries, eval suites, and human-in-the-loop review of AI-generated work in a regulated environment.

 

What We Look For In You
• A compliance-first systems mindset — you instinctively reach for state machines, idempotency keys, exactly-once semantics, reconciliation jobs and immutable audit logs. You understand that in compliance, false negatives cost millions and false positives cost trust, and you design accordingly. Prior experience in KYC, AML, sanctions, fraud, or payments is a strong plus; experience surviving a regulatory audit is an even stronger plus.
• Daily, fluent use of modern AI coding tools — Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex CLI, or equivalents. You can describe the specific workflows you run, the failure modes you have hit, and the guardrails you have built around AI-generated code. AI fluency is required, not nice-to-have.
• Production experience integrating AI/ML model inference into Java services — REST/gRPC-based model serving, feature engineering pipelines, latency-sensitive inference optimization, graceful degradation, and drift / rollback playbooks.
• Hands-on experience with LLM application patterns — at least one of: RAG pipelines (vector store + retrieval + grounding) for policy / KYC / case lookup, agentic workflows (tool use, multi-step reasoning, validation loops) for analyst assistance, or LLM-based classification / extraction shipped to production.
• Discipline around AI output — you do not ship LLM features without evals, hallucination tests, prompt regression suites, and human-in-the-loop review for high-stakes decisions. You have an opinion on when to reach for a frontier model vs. a fine-tuned small model vs. a deterministic rule, and can defend that trade-off to a regulator.
• Exposure to LLM integration or AI agent frameworks is a strong plus — e.g. prompt engineering at the system level, RAG pipelines, or orchestrating AI workflows within a regulated environment.
• Good understanding of software engineering basics, distributed system principles, including CAP, consistency, idempotency, and exactly-once vs at-least-once semantics.
• Clear logic, quick thinking, and good communication skills — including the ability to write clearly for non-engineers (compliance officers, auditors, regulators).

 

AI Proficiency Expectations Interview Process

AI fluency is a required engineering competency for this role, on the same level as ‘can write good Java’. We will assess it explicitly during the interview, and a strong showing here is a meaningful plus:
• AI-augmented workflow demo — walk us through how you use AI tools day-to-day. The prompts, the tasks you delegate to an agent vs. write yourself, how you review AI-generated diffs, and how you measure the impact (commit velocity, defect rate, test coverage). Concrete examples beat slogans.
• Live agentic exercise — a working session using the AI coding agent of your choice on a realistic compliance-flavoured problem. We look at how you scope, prompt, validate, and integrate AI output, not whether the agent gets it right first try.
• Design discussion with a probabilistic twist — expect at least one system-design question where the right answer involves deciding when not to use an LLM, and how to design the deterministic fallback. We hire engineers who can defend that boundary.
• Evaluation guardrails — be ready to discuss an eval suite or guardrail you have built for an AI feature in production (e.g. an LLM-assisted SAR narrative drafting tool, an AI-assisted KYC document review step, or screening-hit disambiguation). If you have not shipped one, tell us how you would design it.

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

 

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About The Opportunity

OKX is building local exchange businesses from the ground up across multiple emerging and high-growth markets. We are looking for a product leader who has driven a complete 0-to-1 cycle in a priority overseas market — someone who will own the product strategy and local growth playbook for a specific region or country, and be directly accountable for product competitiveness and business growth outcomes in that market.

This role sits at the intersection of the Local business team and Global product and engineering. You'll go deep into the local market — translating user profiles, regulatory landscapes, and competitive dynamics into product and growth strategies — while driving Global product and engineering resources to deliver locally, ensuring the product experience and competitiveness actually take off on the ground.

We are not prescriptive about which specific region you've built in previously — LatAm, Southeast Asia, Turkey, MENA, or others are all relevant. What matters is that you have personally built a business in an emerging market, closed the growth loop, and can transfer that methodology to OKX's priority regions.

This is a product leadership role, not a country general manager role — but you need to operate with near business-owner accountability: responsible for the region's core growth metrics and product competitiveness, not just shipping features.

 

What You’ll Be Doing

Regional Product Strategy Local Growth Planning
• Own product strategy and local growth planning for a specific region or country, working across the Local business team and Global product and engineering to be directly accountable for local product competitiveness and business growth outcomes.
• Develop a deep understanding of local user profiles, legal and regulatory frameworks, competitive landscapes, and cultural nuances, and translate these into a comprehensive product competition strategy and channel growth strategy with clear prioritization.
• Continuously track the local crypto and fintech ecosystem — with a focus on global players and regional leaders across exchanges and fintech — as well as macro factors such as inflation, currency depreciation, and cross-border remittance demand that shape user trading behavior.

Local Product Experience Competitiveness
• Own the end-to-end local product experience and competitiveness, covering onboarding, fiat deposit, market analysis, trading, and earn — the core stages of the user journey.
• Build a comprehensive local product feedback loop — from user behavior data and funnel analysis, to local user feedback collection — to identify key bottlenecks and high-leverage opportunities in conversion, retention, and engagement, and drive iterative improvement.
• Adapt to local market characteristics (inflation-driven demand, competitor switching costs, payment method preferences, etc.) to reduce drop-off from registration to first trade and shorten time-to-first-trade.

Channel Growth Cross-team Collaboration
• Work with local teams to identify effective user acquisition channels; lead the discovery, introduction, integration, and scaling of high-impact channels.
• Leverage your local network — KOLs, fintech partners, payment providers, regulatory contacts — to accelerate market entry and growth.
• Collaborate closely with regional BD, Marketing, Operations, and Global product and engineering to ensure product initiatives align with local growth objectives.

What We Look For In You
• 0-to-1 business building and growth experience in an emerging market (e.g., LatAm, Southeast Asia, Turkey, MENA, or similar) — you can clearly articulate the regional metrics you owned and the business outcomes you delivered. You held a product, strategy, or growth role during the early stage of an international expansion at a tech company or at a high-growth local champion in the region.
• Comprehensive business growth and user growth methodology — you have fully owned a user funnel (acquisition → activation → retention) and can speak to results with data: CAC, activation rates, D7/D30 retention, LTV, reactivation. Your work was growth experimentation and product intervention, not just media buying.
• Strong product management capability — you can define product strategy and success metrics, prioritize a roadmap, drive A/B testing, and collaborate with product and engineering to deliver. This is a product leadership role, not a GM or pure growth marketing role.
• Proven cross-functional collaboration — able to drive alignment across teams (design, engineering, data, commercial), manage external partnerships, and navigate regulatory conversations. Effective at aligning resources between Local and Global organizations.
• Deep local market knowledge and an established local network — you understand local user behaviors, payment ecosystems (e.g., PIX, SPEI, Mercado Pago, UPI, GCash, DANA, M-Pesa, depending on region), regulatory environments, and competitive dynamics. You have partners, KOLs, and industry relationships in the region that you can activate.
• Consumer product management experience in fintech, crypto, or trading preferred. Candidates with experience managing or mentoring product teams will be considered for the Senior Product Director level.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Proficiency in Mandarin is a strong plus for effective collaboration with HQ teams.

Nice-To-Haves
• Proficiency in a local language relevant to the target region (Spanish, Portuguese, Bahasa Indonesia, Arabic, Turkish, etc.).
• Crypto exchange product experience — spot/derivatives trading, order types, fee structures, token listings, and fiat on/off-ramp flows.
• Familiarity with local payment rails and fiat-to-crypto conversion flows in emerging markets.
• Hands-on trading experience in FX, equities, or crypto.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

About

Engineering Experience looks after developer productivity at Wise. We work in two ways. We operate services that engineers rely on every day, and we are the pillar team responsible for improving engineering productivity across Wise.

We are looking for an experienced software engineer who wants to make life better for other engineers. You will build and run tools, help set our technical direction and work directly with teams so the things we create are useful in practice. This is a hands-on role for someone who writes strong production software and is comfortable teaching, advocating and leading change.

How we work:

Everything we build needs to work for more than 1,200 engineers. That scale matters. We are not looking for isolated wins. Saving every engineer an hour has a huge impact, so we focus on common problems and solutions that work across Wise.

We learn by talking to engineers, looking at usage data and seeing how our services behave in production. We use that evidence to design, build and operate improvements that are secure, reliable and easy to use. Adoption is part of the engineering work. What will you be working on?:

• Using research, feedback and data to find problems shared by many teams, then turning them into software and changes that save engineers time across Wise.

What do you need?:
• A senior engineer comfortable working in a polyglot environment. Our tools and services span languages including Java, Go, Python and TypeScript. You need to be an expert in either Java, Go or TypeScript, but not all of them.
• Strong experience building and operating production software, including taking services from design through to reliable operation.
• Excellent software design judgement. You can break down complex problems, define clear boundaries and interfaces, and build systems that are testable, maintainable and observable.
• Practical experience using agentic tools to deliver real user stories, not only prototypes. You know how to give agents the right context and constraints, review their output and take responsibility for the result.

jobs.title: Engineering Lead - Verification Platform
jobs.description:
We're looking for an Engineering Lead to manage the Platform team within the Business Onboarding Verification (BOV) organisation — based in London. This team owns the platform rails that Business verification is built on; the sister team (BOV Global) uses those rails to ship customer-facing journeys and agent tooling. There are three organisations in the wider squad — Business Onboarding Verification, Personal Onboarding Verification, and Wise Platform Verification.

 

The scale we operate at
• In FY2025, 15.6M people and businesses used Wise; we onboarded over 5.9M new customers (~500K/month) and moved £145B across borders (~£400M/day) across 160+ countries and 40+ currencies.
• Our onboarding decisions gate ~£25B/year in cross-currency volume.
• Verification is on the critical path for every new signup and for ~10 product teams across Wise that build on our rails today.

Our verification systems are not supporting tools — they are core production infrastructure that protects customers, enables growth, and must stay reliable under constant change in regulations, policies and evolving threat patterns.

 

The team you'll lead - Verification Platform

You will lead the Verification Platform (under BOV) team in London — a cross-functional engineering team whose mission is to provide the BOV platform (Onboarding Platform for business, requirement evaluation, collection, review, unified vendor integrations, repapering rails) that lets BoV Global and regional teams iterate safely and quickly on business verification without rebuilding plumbing. Concretely, this team owns three work-streams:
• Onboarding Platform (for business) — modelling Business requirements as configuration-as-a-service, per legal-entity type (Ltd, LLC, Sole Trader, Partnership, Corp), with versioned rules and repapering / refresh rails so a policy change is a config choice, not a multi-quarter project.
• Review tooling platform — the review surface on which Global (and regional teams) build their review flows; the foundation that makes AI-assisted review and review automation measurable and safe to roll out.
• Unified Vendor Integrations — one observable, retryable, swappable gateway for registry, adverse media, website signal, Acceptable Use Policy and Business Onboarding data vendors, replacing today's point-to-point integrations.

Your mission

As the Engineering Lead for BOV Platform, you will:
• Lead, coach and mentor a cross-functional team of engineers — supporting their growth, well-being and performance, and empowering them to do their best work.
• Own the technical roadmap for the BOV platform — make sure it addresses real reliability, security and scalability concerns of the Business verification stack.
• Partner deeply with BOV Global, Personal Onboarding, Wise Platform Verification and Mitigation Handling so the platform serves real product needs — not what the platform team thinks the platform should be.
• Be an active contributor to delivery. Support day-to-day execution, get hands-on when the team absolutely needs it, and stay in touch with the technology stack — leading by example.
• Own the health and productivity of the team, fostering a culture of ownership, transparency, bottom-up decision-making, collaboration and continuous improvement — the way Wise engineering works.
• Own operational excellence. Ensure appropriate on-call rotas, SLAs, documentation and observability for platform services; run incidents in your area of ownership and turn each into a durable fix.
• Collaborate globally with engineering leads across Global KYC and Onboarding (London, Tallinn, Budapest and Hyderabad) and the wider Wise engineering community.
• Run the engineering rituals of the team so we stay agile and predictable in product development.

Why this is an exciting problem

Picture a pharmaceutical company incorporated in Singapore, with one shareholder living in Dubai, trading in the UK and Singapore. In one signup, that business touches at least four regulatory perimeters — Singapore, UK, UAE for the shareholder, plus industry-specific controls for pharma (enhanced due diligence, sanctions, source-of-funds). Our job is to work out — in real time — exactly what each regulator needs, verify it against the right sources, and hand the customer a signup that feels effortless. Now scale that across 160+ countries and the millions of businesses we have. BOV Platform is building the framework that makes this possible without a new (or at most minimal) codebase per market, and the interesting problems stack up:
• Configuration-driven, versioned rules at scale. How do we express "what KYC do we need for entity type × country × industry × partner × risk tier?" as data — hot-reloadable, auditable, and safe to change weekly — while giving regulators a clean audit trail of which version passed which customer?
• Distributed decisioning under real-world latency. A single verification decision fans out to 10+ internal services and external vendors (registry lookups, sanctions, PEP, document verification, ML models). Sagas, idempotency, timeouts, and graceful degradation all matter — because "we couldn't reach the sanctions provider" isn't an acceptable customer experience.
• Consistency vs. availability on the KYC decision path. The same customer hits us from web, mobile and partner APIs concurrently. Where is strong consistency non-negotiable (a compliance-gated transfer) vs. eventual consistency fine (background re-screening)? How do we avoid decision drift across regions and entities?
• Event-driven re-evaluation and repapering. Rules change; a country updates its policy; a customer's risk profile shifts. How do we re-decide retroactively across millions of customers without stampeding downstream systems or ops queues?
• ML/AI in the loop — safely. Where does automation genuinely help (document classification, risk scoring, agent copilots), where does it not, and how do we ship it with safe fallbacks, clear observability and a human review path that doesn't become the bottleneck?

That's the problem your team will help solve — with real regulatory teeth, real customer impact, and enough platform surface area to keep senior engineers engaged for years.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

Join us at OKX, where we're shaping the future of decentralized finance (DeFi) to make it accessible to everyone. We're seeking Product Designers to define our DeFi products, strategize, and cultivate exceptional user experiences. 

As we expand our focus beyond CEX traders, we're building a world class Decentralised Platform tailored for our web3 users. Your role will involve owning transaction workflows, data display, and feature execution, crafting experiences that delight our global user base. This is your chance to have a significant impact on millions of users worldwide, collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver top-notch DeFi experiences. If you're passionate about revolutionizing decentralised finance, join us as we Buidl cutting edge web3 products with the latest blockchain technologies.

 

What You’ll Be Doing
• Synthesise needs from Product, Engineering, and Marketing into comprehensive design deliverables, ensuring design is front-of-mind throughout the product development process
• Work through design problems from beginning to end: translating research insights into ideas that form disruptive new products and features, then designing the workflows and detailed interactions to realize them
• Support the product development process with wireframes, user flows, journey maps, high-fidelity mockups, interactive prototypes, and evaluative research
• Partner with cross-functional peers within Product and Engineering in Asia and internationally to define initiatives and create thoughtful solutions—representing design and being the voice for the user throughout the product lifecycle
• Collaborate closely with UX Research, UX Writing, Brand, and Product leadership to shape the overall design vision of your area of ownership
• Consistently elevate the quality of the design by soliciting feedback from peers and stakeholders through formal Design Reviews, presentations and by facilitating design thinking workshops
• Mentor other designers throughout the organization on craft, quality, experience, and processes.
• Work with data, whether qualitative or quantitative to make informed design decisions

What We Look For In You
• At least 5 years of experience in Product Design, Interaction Design, UX Design, or related fields.
• Strong communication skills with a proven ability to articulate ideas and advocate for design decisions.
• Experience working with cross-functional teams, including Designers, Product Managers, Engineers, UX Writers, and Researchers.
• A deep understanding of design-critical thinking and user-centered design methodologies, ensuring products offer intuitive and trustworthy experiences.
• Results-oriented and adaptable to change.
• A thorough understanding of experimentation and research techniques, capable of validating designs independently.
• A good eye for design with a diverse portfolio of your design works throughout your career.

Nice to Haves
• Experience designing for Fintech, Investment platforms, or Crypto products
• Experience working with teams across offices and timezones
• Understanding of React framework for Front End development

jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. About the Opportunity

We are looking for a Product Designer to create intuitive, high-quality experiences for users discovering market opportunities, analysing assets, and trading across Web3 products.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Content, and other design teams to solve complex problems in a fast-moving environment. Crypto experience is a plus, but strong design thinking, product judgment, and the ability to learn quickly are more important.

Depending on team needs and your interests, your work may focus on:
• OKX Wallet — shaping a leading self-custody wallet experience and making asset management, dApp discovery, swaps, and cross-chain interactions seamless, intuitive, and trustworthy.
• OKX.AI — exploring the frontier of AI and Web3 by building an onchain Agent marketplace where Agents can discover work, collaborate, transact, and build reputation, with the ambition of enabling one person and one Agent to build a million-dollar company.
• X Layer — growing OKX’s Layer 2 ecosystem by designing DeFi products and new onchain experiences that attract users, builders, and liquidity.
• DEX Market — helping customers discover and understand opportunities across onchain markets, including emerging tokens, memes, and real-world assets.
• Onchain Trading — creating fast, intuitive, and trustworthy trading experiences across market discovery, execution, and position management.
• Growth — improving acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and cross-product discovery through growth campaigns and ecosystem features such as Boost and Outcomes.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Own the end-to-end design process, from problem definition and user flows to high-fidelity UI, prototypes, and final delivery.
• Turn complex product and business requirements into clear, intuitive user experiences.
• Work closely with Product and Engineering to evaluate trade-offs and make well-reasoned design decisions.
• Use research, data, user feedback, and product context to validate and improve solutions.
• Contribute to product discussions by identifying underlying user problems, challenging assumptions, and proposing better approaches.
• Maintain a high standard of design quality while working effectively under tight timelines and changing priorities.
• Design for a global user base across different markets, languages, and levels of Web3 experience.

What We Look For In You
• 5+ years of experience in Product Design
• Strong design thinking and problem-solving ability, with a portfolio that clearly demonstrates how you frame problems, explore options, make decisions, and measure outcomes.
• Ability to remain structured and make sound design decisions in complex, ambiguous, and high-pressure situations.
• Proficiency with AI tools and the ability to apply them effectively throughout the design process, from research and ideation to prototyping, validation, and delivery.
• Strong ownership, self-motivation, and the ability to adapt quickly in a fast-changing environment.
• Clear communication skills and the ability to explain and defend design decisions in both English and Chinese.
• Experience collaborating effectively with Product Managers, Engineers, and other designers.
• Curiosity, ambition, and a genuine interest in staying current with developments in crypto, AI, and the wider design industry.

Nice to Haves
• Experience designing crypto, fintech, investment, trading, wallet, or other data-intensive products.
• Familiarity with Web3 wallets, DApps, meme trading, token discovery, swaps, or on-chain products.
• Strong UI and visual design craft, with close attention to interaction details and overall product quality.
• Strong product sense and the ability to connect individual features with broader product goals and user journeys.
• Experience designing and shipping products for a global audience.
• Experience conducting user research, usability testing, or data-informed design validation.

Highlights of Perks and Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development

jobs.title: Principal Security Programme Manager & Technical Lead - Engine by Starling
jobs.description:
At Engine by Starling, we are on a mission to find and work with leading banks all around the world who have the ambition to build rapid growth businesses on our technology.

Engine is Starling's software-as-a-service (SaaS) business—the technology that was built to power Starling—and two years ago we split out as a separate business.

Starling has seen exceptional growth and success, and a large part of that is down to the fact that we have built our own modern technology from the ground up. This SaaS technology platform is now available to banks and financial institutions all around the world, enabling them to benefit from the innovative digital features and efficient back-office processes that have helped achieve Starling's success.

As a company, everyone is expected to roll up their sleeves to help deliver great outcomes for our clients. We are an engineering-led company and we’re looking for people who will be excited by the potential for Engine’s technology to transform banking in different markets around the world. Our purpose is underpinned by five values: Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim For Greatness.

Hybrid Working

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Engine - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of one of our offices so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person.

About the role

We are seeking a senior, highly adaptable Principal Security Programme Manager & Technical Lead to serve as a key technical partner to our Business Information Security Officer (BISO). In this high-visibility role, you will help shape, refine, and execute our strategic security roadmap as we rapidly scale our global fintech ecosystem.

You will bridge executive security vision with practical technical delivery—guiding core security initiatives that intersect with the CTO Office while collaborating daily with engineering, SecOps, threat and vulnerability management, and broader group functions. You will also champion secure innovation, ensuring our security posture keeps pace with emerging technologies like AI while embedding technical compliance across key financial standards.

This is a balanced role for a collaborative builder and strategist: you will be equally comfortable influencing engineering peers and designing future-state security controls as you are taking direct ownership to deliver technical milestones.

Responsibilities
• Roadmap Architecture & Scaling: Partner directly with the BISO to evaluate, refine, and drive the security roadmap, proactively proposing strategic updates to support rapid business growth.
• Cross-Functional Execution: Lead core security projects, aligning initiatives across the CTO Office, engineering leads, SecOps, and threat/vulnerability management.
• AI Security Readiness: Define and roll out practical security guardrails, risk assessments, and safe-use practices for AI/LLM adoption across engineering and business units.
• Compliance & Governance Alignment: Ensure technical security controls natively satisfy key regulatory frameworks—including ISO 27001, ISO42001, SOC 1/2, PCI DSS & 3DS, CSA C-STAR, and DORA.
• Pragmatic Technical Advisory: Translate high-level security requirements into actionable, practical guidance for engineering teams without creating delivery bottlenecks.
• Hands-on Delivery: Drive critical technical work streams directly when needed, taking full ownership of project milestones from inception through to operational handover.

Knowledge & Technical Expertise
• Fintech or Scale-Up: Deep background in fintech security principles, regulatory demands, and scaling controls within fast-paced environments.
• AI Security & Innovation: Practical understanding of security considerations surrounding AI integration, data privacy, and model risk management.
• Frameworks & Compliance: Hands-on experience mapping technical controls to ISO 27001, ISO42001, SOC 1/2, PCI DSS & 3DS, CSA C-STAR, and DORA.
• Programme Delivery: Strong project and programme management skills, with a proven track record of bringing complex security initiatives to completion.
• Technical Breadth: Strong technical foundation across SecOps, threat & vulnerability management, and secure engineering.

Behaviours & Competencies
• Influence & Autonomy: Exceptional interpersonal and stakeholder management skills; highly self-directed and capable of building cross-functional consensus collaboratively.
• Strategic & Operational Flexibility: Ability to shift seamlessly between strategic planning and hands-on technical execution.
• Pragmatic Problem-Solving: A clear focus on enabling business growth and engineering velocity through balanced, practical security controls.

Preferred Qualifications
• Prior experience operating autonomously as a TPM or Technical Lead in a fast paced environment
• Experience with cloud security architectures.
• Industry certifications in security, privacy, or compliance (e.g., CISSP).

Interview Process

Interviewing is a two-way process and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you! Our interviews are conversational and we want to get the best from you, so come with questions and be curious. In general, following an initial chat with one of our Talent Team, you can expect:
• Technical Interview with BISO ~ 45 minutes
• Live Tech Test with Deputy CTO ~ 90 minutes
• Final Interview with CTO ~ 60 minutes
• 33 days holiday (including public holidays, which you can take when it works best for you)
• An extra day’s holiday for your birthday
• Annual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell up to five extra days off
• 16 hours paid volunteering time a year
• Salary sacrifice, company enhanced pension scheme
• Life insurance at 4x your salary & group income protection
• Private Medical Insurance with VitalityHealth including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr & Mrs Smith and Peloton
• Generous family-friendly policies
• Work from Abroad policy
• Incentives refer a friend scheme
• Perkbox membership giving access to retail discounts, a wellness platform for physical and mental health, and weekly free and boosted perks
• Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work, Salary Sacrificed Gym partnerships and Electric Vehicle (EV) leasing

About Us

You may be put off applying for a role because you don't tick every box. Forget that! While we can’t accommodate every flexible working request, we're always open to discussion. So, if you're excited about working with us, but aren’t sure if you're 100% there yet, get in touch anyway. We’re on a mission to radically reshape banking – and that starts with our brilliant team. Whatever came before, we’re proud to bring together people of all backgrounds and experiences who love working together to solve problems.

Engine by Starling is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster diversity & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment at Engine by Starling are considered without regard to race, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

When you provide us with this information, you are doing so at your own consent, with full knowledge that we will process this personal data in accordance with our Privacy Notice. By submitting your application, you agree that Engine by Starling and Starling will collect your personal data for recruiting and related purposes. Our Privacy Notice explains what personal information we will process, where we will process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, its retention period, and the rights you can exercise over our use of your personal information.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II - Backend (Java) - Account Sharing
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Account Sharing team within Wise’s Consumer Squad. The team is focused on building entirely new products in the shared finances space for consumers — including international joint accounts and kid accounts.

Our mission is to make it easy for families, couples, friends, and flatmates across different countries to manage money together seamlessly through Wise. Unlike most existing solutions that are limited to domestic markets, we are building shared financial experiences that work globally.

This is a highly product-oriented engineering role where you’ll help shape products from the ground up. You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Data Analysts, and User Researchers to deeply understand customer problems and turn ambiguous ideas into scalable financial products used by millions of customers worldwide.

How we work

For everything we build, we keep our customers at the center of decision-making. We prioritize work based on customer research, behavioral data, and direct feedback, and we iterate quickly based on what we learn.

The Account Sharing team operates as a highly collaborative, cross-functional product team. Engineers are not expected to simply implement tickets — they are expected to contribute to product direction, challenge assumptions, influence technical strategy, and help shape the customer experience.

The environment is greenfield and fast-moving. Requirements evolve quickly, and engineers are encouraged to take ownership, drive discussions, and work closely with stakeholders across engineering, product, design, and research.

At Wise, we believe in autonomous teams where everyone contributes ideas, takes ownership, and helps define priorities together.

Impact

Your work will directly shape the future of shared finances at Wise.

You’ll help build products that allow families, couples, flatmates, and friends across different countries to manage money together in ways that existing financial products often cannot support today.

The systems and experiences you build will need to scale globally, support millions of customers, and navigate the complexities of international compliance, regulation, and financial infrastructure.

This role offers the opportunity to influence both technical architecture and product direction while helping Wise expand into a strategically important area of consumer finance.

What will you be working on?

Key focus areas for the team are:
• Building international joint accounts for globally distributed users
• Expanding Wise kid accounts into additional markets
• Creating shared finance experiences that work across borders
• Designing scalable backend systems for high-growth consumer products
• Developing features around shared spending, sending/receiving money, and account customization
• Collaborating on customer discovery and product iteration
• Scaling infrastructure and improving reliability across multiple markets
• Building greenfield financial products from concept to production

You’ll also have opportunities to work across multiple areas of the Wise ecosystem, including:
• Send/receive money flows
• Spend experiences
• Authorization systems
• FinCrime-related systems
• Shared account infrastructure

What do you need?
• You know how to build scalable distributed systems and deliver customer-facing products used by millions of users.
• You are proficient in backend programming languages such as Java, Kotlin, Python, or Go.
• You have strong experience designing asynchronous, reliable, and scalable systems within microservice architectures.
• You are comfortable working in greenfield environments where requirements evolve rapidly and ambiguity is part of the process.
• You have a strong product mindset and enjoy collaborating closely with Product Managers, Designers, Analysts, and Researchers to shape solutions — not just implement them.
• You care deeply about customer experience and understand how technical decisions impact end users.
• You are comfortable contributing to architectural discussions, challenging assumptions, and influencing technical and product direction.
• You write clean, maintainable, well-tested code and care about long-term scalability and reliability.
• You are a strong communicator who can explain complex technical concepts clearly and collaborate effectively across teams.
• You are comfortable operating independently while also contributing to a collaborative team culture.

Nice to have
• Experience building greenfield products from scratch
• Experience working on international consumer products
• Experience with payments, financial systems, or compliance-heavy environments
• Experience building systems at global scale
• Familiarity with event-driven architecture and messaging systems such as Kafka
• Experience with customer-facing financial products
• API-first development experience

Interested? Find out more:
• How we work – a practical guide
• DEI @ Wise
• Wise Tech Stack (2025 update)
• See what it's like to work at Wise London!
• Our Engineering career map

Wise Engineering – https://medium.com/wise-engineering

jobs.title: Group Compliance Lead - Regional Platform
jobs.description:
This is a first-line product compliance role. You will work directly alongside engineers and product managers to translate regulatory obligations into product decisions that are scalable, defensible and globally consistent. 

Your mission

Keeping pace with how money moves. As Wise expands into new markets, corridors, and payment schemes, the rules governing how transfers are processed, and who can send them, become increasingly complex. You will own the compliance strategy for core product flows that determine customer eligibility: how we verify where customers live, how we handle customers who move between countries, and how we allocate customers to the right licensed entity. These aren't abstract compliance questions, they manifest directly in product screens, data models, and engineering decisions. You will need to go deep quickly, surface the "so what," and drive alignment between legal, product, and engineering teams across multiple markets.

Strengthening the infrastructure for regulatory accountability. Wise is continuously evolving the regulatory infrastructure that helps us demonstrate compliance across our licences, markets, and products. This platform connects our regulatory obligations to the policies, controls, … You'll help shape and strengthen this capability by partnering with engineers, product teams, and compliance specialists to ensure regulatory obligations are accurately reflected in our systems and translated into appropriate controls. You’ll also help make this scalable.

Staying ahead of global payment standards. Wise operates across dozens of payment schemes and licensed entities worldwide. As international standards for payment messaging and data requirements evolve, you will own the compliance thread for how Wise's product and data infrastructure keeps pace, working closely with data engineering, scheme specialists, and regional legal counsel to ensure our payment flows are accurate, complete, and consistently applied across every market we operate in.

As Group Product Compliance Lead, you will:
• Own compliance strategy and delivery across all of Wise for core domains such as payment processing, obligations to control mapping and verification standards
• Translate complex, multi-jurisdictional obligations into actionable product and engineering decisions
• Represent Wise's compliance position to regional regulators, internal forums, and external auditors where required
• Build relationships with product, policy, and compliance teams globally to maintain a consistent and current view of obligations across markets
• Help define and scale the assurance frameworks that give Wise confidence its controls are working

We are looking for someone who:
• Has deep fintech compliance experience, with a track record of working directly in product teams, not alongside them
• Is comfortable in codebases, engineering discussions, and architecture reviews; not intimidated by technical complexity
• Can move between regulatory text and product specifications without losing either thread
• Is a strong communicator who can synthesise regulatory complexity into a clear position for non-specialists
• Is comfortable operating in ambiguity; capable of defining structure where none exists yet
• Has a track record of influencing decisions across legal, engineering, and product at senior levels
• Has familiarity with payment scheme rules (SEPA, SWIFT, domestic real-time rails)
• Has experience with multi-entity or multi-licence compliance structures
• Has working knowledge of KYC and identity verification frameworks and the product decisions that flow from them

In return, this role offers:
• Real ownership: you ship things, you don't just advise
• No regional or domain siloing; genuine cross-functional ownership spanning product, engineering, and compliance
• The chance to shape infrastructure and frameworks that will operate at company scale, affecting every Wise customer and licensed entity
• An exceptional cross-functional team across product, engineering, compliance, risk, and banking
