jobs.title: Finance Associate
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Finance at Brex

The Finance team is a strategic engine at Brex. We lead planning, forecasting, capital allocation, and ROI analysis — partnering across the business to drive clarity and unlock opportunity. We partner across teams at Brex to ensure our business is building and planning with the same dream big goals throughout our entire organization. We’re not here to report on outcomes; we shape them. If you want to influence company direction and think long-term about value creation, this is where your ownership starts.
• Cross-functional alignment: We work on complex problems that cut across Engineering, Product, Design, Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, CX, and more. This requires the ability to generate buy-in from a wide set of stakeholders on key initiatives.
• Business intelligence: We are a data-driven organization that always provides data to support our decision-making. When data is not available, we find it in market and competitive research. We convey complex financial information to varied stakeholders in order to influence decisions.
• Problem solving: We lead with solutions by defining an ambiguous problem, processing information, applying judgment and creativity, and generating buy-in around the answer. This requires the ability to not only track and improve key metrics, but to define what those key metrics should be.
• Building, not just advising: We ship the models, tooling, and automation that the frameworks depend on, and we own their accuracy.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our New York office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

What You’ll Do

We are building out the Strategic Finance team and looking for someone to join the function and partner with leadership to maximize ROI from our investments.

In this role, you will own the frameworks Brex uses to underwrite and measure return on investment across the business. You will translate roadmap proposals, GTM investments, headcount requests, and pricing changes into expected return, payback, and opportunity cost, so that business partners and Finance underwrite decisions off the same set of numbers. You will work with leaders across the company, and you will close the loop after the fact, measuring realized return against what was originally underwritten.

You will bring both the financial and the commercial point of view, and need to embrace challenges and structure complex problems. This role carries high exposure to Executive Leadership, as you will regularly deliver analysis and recommendations directly to the Leadership team.

Responsibilities
• Build and own the frameworks used to evaluate investment decisions across the business, spanning R D, GTM, headcount, and pricing
• Partner with business leaders on capital allocation: sizing the cost of a given bet, pricing the tradeoffs between competing uses of the next dollar, and framing opportunity cost in terms leadership can act on
• Develop the unit economics and ROI measurement standards applied to new product launches, pricing changes, GTM programs, and platform investments
• Run post-investment measurement on major bets, comparing realized return to what was underwritten and feeding those learnings back into the framework
• Quantify the downstream commercial impact of product and GTM decisions on revenue, margin, and customer lifetime value
• Translate operating and capacity inputs into financial impact, and financial constraints into terms business partners can plan against
• Build shared definitions and a single source of truth across Finance, EPD, GTM, and Revenue Operations so all organizations plan off the same numbers
• Ship the models, dashboards, and automation the frameworks depend on, and own their accuracy
• Provide ad hoc analytical support to GTM Finance and Revenue Operations on pipeline, conversion, retention, expansion, and go-to-market efficiency questions

Requirements
• Bachelor’s Degree in Economics, Finance, Business, or related field
• 2+ years of Strategic Finance, FP A, or Investment Banking experience
• An AI-first mindset: you default to asking how AI can improve every workflow, you actively experiment with new tools, and you have used AI to accelerate analysis or automate a task
• Mastery of Excel and PowerPoint with proven experience in building financial models and managing complex data
• Strong communication, team-working, quantitative and analytical skills
• Intellectual curiosity, a collaborative work style, and the drive to take ownership in a fast-moving environment
• Comfort managing multiple workstreams simultaneously and proactively driving work forward without being asked
• A bias toward proactive insight over reactive reporting
• Ability to operate independently, build structure in ambiguous environments, and prioritize effectively
• Comfort working directly in data: SQL or BI tooling experience is a strong plus (Snowflake, Hex, Looker, or Salesforce)

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $117,520 USD - $146,900 USD. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package

jobs.title: Product Director, Localisation & AI Evals
jobs.location: Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR; Singapore, Singapore
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

OKX is going all-in on AI-native localisation. The field has long been stuck on one trade-off: you can have translation quality, or you can have scale, but not both. And the real question was never "is this translation accurate?" — it's "can the user actually understand it and get through the flow?"

Web3 is the hardest place to solve this. The vocabulary reinvents itself constantly, with new tech jargon, protocol names and memes appearing every week. It sits next to dense, high-stakes trading terminology, where a single mistranslated word can mislead a user or move money. And every market has its own fast-moving regulations, so the "right" translation is a moving target that must stay compliant across jurisdictions in real time. If you want a localisation problem that is genuinely unsolved — high ambiguity, high stakes, high velocity — this is it.

We're going to break the trade-off with agents. You will own the 0-1 build and launch of two things:
• A frontier agentic translation system that localises every market (20+ languages) with a human-in-the-loop mechanism.
• A self-improving agentic QA product that autonomously evaluates translation and end-to-end localisation quality, flags its own failures, and closes the loop.

This is a build-the-frontier role, not a manage-the-vendor role.

 

This role does not require a linguistics or translation background, multilingual ability, or algorithm engineering skills. We're looking for a PM leader who can build a frontier agentic translation and QA system from 0 to 1 — and make the whole organisation share responsibility for localisation quality.

What You’ll Be Doing 

You will lead a squad of product managers and developers, and work hand-in-hand with language managers, to ship the translation and QA systems into production. You set the product direction and quality bar; your PMs and engineers build the agents, harness and evals; and the language managers ground the system in what "good" actually means in each market. Your job is to make these three groups operate as one team — and to make localisation quality something the whole organisation owns, not just the language team.

 

Own the agentic translation system

Architect and ship it end to end, from 0 to 1, across all markets and 20+ languages — where models carry the work and humans set the standard and make the final call. Break the cost curve: hold quality flat while coverage scales across languages, content and release velocity, so cost stops growing linearly with the business. Make the system interoperate cleanly with OKX's existing localisation stack and content pipelines, rather than living as an island.

Build the agentic QA and quality automation

Stand up an autonomous QA agent that evaluates translation and localisation quality at scale — catching regressions before release, monitoring in production, and self-verifying every fix, using LLM-as-a-judge and eval harnesses rather than manual review. Evaluate not just accuracy and fluency but cultural fit, bias and safety — especially on regulated and financial content, where a wrong or non-compliant phrasing is a real risk. Make quality measurable: define and drive a hard quality signal — human-acceptance rate, or the edit effort needed to reach shippable quality (e.g. Translation Time-to-Edit) — so quality is a metric the system optimises against, not a subjective call. And protect the funnel: conversion on key user journeys should never be adversely affected by language or localisation issues.

Make it self-improving

Drive a sustained reduction in severe and recurring production issues — every escape becomes a new guardrail, and the system gets smarter with every release.

 

What We Look For In You
• PM leader who has taken a frontier agentic product from 0 to 1, beyond translation.
• Proven ability to ship genuinely novel products at the edge of LLM capabilities—and repeat that success here.
• Accountable for business outcomes and measured on business metrics, not delivery volume.
• Deep hands-on experience building large-scale, frontier-LLM agentic systems from 0 to 1.
• Experience with harness/orchestration layers, multi-agent workflows, and LLM-as-a-judge or automated evaluation pipelines.
• Has built quality systems, automated evaluations, or release gates that enable confident autonomous-system launches.
• International product experience serving users across multiple languages and regions.

Nice to Haves
• Built an agentic system from scratch
• Shipped agentic / LLM applications in production
• Finance, payments or another highly regulated industry.

Perks Benefits

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own institutional partner products such as Custody, Brokerage, and Fees Incentive Programs (including MM/MT structures, VIP tiering, and rebate frameworks). Final scope will weigh your background, but the mandate is consistent: build institutional-grade products that compete on infrastructure, economic design, and reliability — and translate that into measurable growth in client adoption, trading volume, and revenue. • Own the fee schedule and incentive programs (MM/MT, VIP tiers, rebates), balancing market dynamics, competitor moves, and institutional needs against company strategy, revenue, and competitive position. Build and continuously evolve AI agents for competitor intel, liquidity analysis, fee and rebate simulation, and program operations.
• Own the commercial logic of your product lines. Build ROI-grounded business cases for product and partnership investments; quantify revenue and AUM impact to drive prioritisation;
• Articulate strategy, progress, and trade-offs to internal leadership and external institutional clients.
• Partner cross-functionally with engineering, design, compliance, and legal to ship complex changes. Navigate multi-jurisdictional regulatory constraints (HK, SG, EU, US) and balance trade-offs between speed, scalability, and compliance.

• PM experience at a crypto exchange on Custody OES, or at a custody, or background from traditional finance on Collateral / Tri-party / CCP solutions. Deep market knowledge and an end-to-end grasp of how counterparties, custody, execution, and settlement connect.
• Solid understanding of liquidity dynamics and how institutional crypto markets actually work. Prior hands-on experience managing fee schedules or designing incentive programs (MM/MT, VIP tiers, rebates) is a strong plus.
• Proven experience of leading strategic business reviews, facilitating on-site requirement discovery, and converting client feedback into prioritized product initiatives. Strong track record of partnering with Sales, BD, and Relationship Management teams in a B2B institutional setting.
• Proven ability to bring structure and clarity to complex problems, align senior stakeholders across functions, and drive decisions and execution. Able to communicate complex strategies and trade-offs with clarity and influence, producing high-quality strategy documents, product plans, roadmaps, and executive-level presentations. Demonstrated effectiveness leading and influencing globally distributed teams across time zones and diverse cultural contexts.
• Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools for market research and product operations. Building automated workflows, using AI for data analysis, or prototyping AI-powered features.
• Candidates with more experience will be considered as Product Director (P7-1). Experience building a zero-to-one product is a strong plus.

• Design and evolve OKDS core components and reusable business components with clear naming, variants, states, metadata, composition rules, and architecture suitable for designers, engineers, and AI-assisted workflows.
• Build reusable template systems and AI-readable guidance, and contribute to tooling infrastructure and validation workflows that improve AI pipeline readiness and production-quality output.
• Partner closely with engineers to ensure design intent, platform behavior, component APIs, and accessibility requirements remain aligned across Web, iOS, and Android.

• Apply quality acceptance criteria covering interaction states, responsive behavior, accessibility, compliance, and implementation-ready handoff.
• Plan and deliver work transparently, manage dependencies, and track outcomes such as reuse, adoption, reduced rework, and faster implementation.

• Strong Figma capability, including component properties, variables, modes, libraries, and scalable file organization.

• Design-engineering fluency and comfort discussing implementation constraints, states, APIs, and platform differences.
• An adoption mindset: you investigate user needs, make standards practical, and follow through until teams can use them successfully.

• Experience working with teams across offices and timezones
• Understanding of React framework for Front End development

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer, Core
jobs.description:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

 

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About the Opportunity

Core owns the foundational journeys that define a user's relationship with OKX: account management, identity verification, moving and securing funds, and the risk, compliance, and customer support experiences that sit alongside them. It also covers the internal enterprise tools our support agents, PMs, and operations teams rely on every day to serve customers and run the business. These are among the most consequential surfaces in the product. They determine whether users feel confident enough to trade, whether they trust us with their assets and their data, and whether the teams behind the scenes can resolve issues quickly and well.

AI is central to how Core works and what Core builds. On the product side, we design AI-powered support and assistant experiences that help millions of users get answers and resolve issues in real time. Internally, we are an AI-native team: we use AI to move faster, sharpen our thinking, and raise the quality of what we ship, and we design the AI-native tools our internal teams depend on. If you are excited to design with AI and to shape how AI shows up for both customers and colleagues, this is a place to do it at scale.

As a designer on Core, you'll take ownership of these high-stakes experiences end to end. The problems are genuinely hard. You'll design across markets with fundamentally different regulatory requirements, from newly regulated regions to our established global user base, and your work will need to satisfy strict compliance and security standards while still feeling fast, clear, and reassuring. You'll partner closely with product, engineering, legal, and compliance, shaping requirements early rather than executing them late. This is work where the details carry real weight. If you want to influence how millions of users experience crypto at its most critical moments, and how the teams supporting them get their work done, Core is one of the most impactful places to do it at OKX.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Own complex, high-stakes journeys end to end across account, assets, compliance, or support, taking them from problem definition to shipped, polished execution.
• Design AI-powered experiences, from customer-facing assistant and support flows to AI-native internal tools, thinking through how people and AI work together, and where trust, transparency, and control matter most.
• Partner with product, engineering, legal, compliance, and risk to define the real problem, then design solutions that balance regulatory and security requirements with a genuinely good user experience.
• Produce the full range of design artifacts as needed: user flows, journey maps, wireframes, high-fidelity designs, and interactive prototypes, backed by evaluative research.
• Work in an AI-native way, using AI to accelerate exploration, prototyping, and decision-making, and helping raise the bar for how the team designs.
• Shape the design vision for your area alongside UX Research, UX Writing, and product leadership, and influence the roadmap early rather than delivering to it.
• Raise the quality bar through design reviews, critique, and workshops, and bring rigor to ambiguous, high-consequence problems.

What We Look For In You

We hire against a shared set of competencies. Beyond craft, we look for how you think, decide, collaborate, and drive work forward.
• Craft and expertise. Deep design craft with a sharp eye for detail, and up-to-date knowledge of your field. You analyze problems methodically and turn them into simple, effective solutions you can execute end to end.
• Judgment in ambiguity. You cut to the root of a problem, make sound calls even with incomplete information, and find the optimal path rather than the obvious one. Core problems are rarely clean, and good judgment is what keeps users safe.
• Business and product sense. You understand how the business works and where it's heading, and you connect design decisions to strategy, metrics, and real outcomes, not just the screen in front of you.
• Collaboration and communication. You communicate with clarity and precision, build genuine trust with product, engineering, legal, and compliance, and give and seek feedback that raises the whole team's work. Partners see you as a collaborator, not a service function.
• Drive and curiosity. You ask why before you design, stay resilient when problems are hard or ambiguous, and keep pushing your craft and ideas forward. You question the brief rather than just building it.
• AI fluency. Genuine fluency and enthusiasm for AI. You already use AI tools in your own work, and you're excited to design AI-driven experiences, not just adopt the buzzword.
• Experience designing complex, multi-step flows, ideally in fintech, crypto, or another regulated or high-trust domain.
• 3+ years of experience shipping end-to-end design solutions in cross-functional teams at a tech company.

Nice to Haves
• Experience designing AI or conversational interfaces, or a track record of using AI to change how you work as a designer.
• Interest in designing complex internal tools and operational workflows, not just customer-facing surfaces.
• Exposure to data-informed design. You're comfortable interpreting user insights, behavioral data, or A/B test results.
• Familiarity with design systems and the ability to scale consistency across platforms.
• Prototyping skills to bring ideas to life and communicate transitions or microinteractions.
• Experience working across time zones with distributed teams. You know how to stay aligned and communicate with clarity.
• A degree in design, HCI, or a related field.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer, Global Exchange
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe the future will be reshaped by technology. Founded in 2017, we are revolutionising world systems through our cutting-edge digital asset exchange, Web3 portal and blockchain ecosystems. We reshape the financial ecosystem by offering some of the most diverse and sophisticated products, solutions, and trading tools on the market. Trusted by more than 50 million users in over 180 countries globally, OKX empowers every individual to explore the world of Web3. With our extensive range of products and services, and unwavering commitment to innovation, OKX envisions a world of financial access backed by blockchain and the power of decentralized finance.

 

We are innovative in the way we think, work, and in the products we create. We are also socially responsible by actively participating and encouraging employees to take part in various public welfare activities. With more than 3,000 employees around the world, we believe embracing diversity and inclusion will spark the creation of long-term value for the industry. Come Build the Future with Us now!

 

About the Opportunity 

We’re continuously meeting product design talent interested in shaping the future of centralized exchange products at OKX.

Our CEX Product Design team works across Manual Trading, Trading Strategy, Social VIP, Growth, and Institutional products. Depending on your experience, interests, and our current hiring needs, we’ll explore relevant opportunities across different teams and levels.

We design products for complex, fast-moving financial environments. Our work spans high-frequency and high-consideration user journeys, data-dense interfaces, trading and investment decisions, social experiences, and products serving both individual and institutional customers. Designers partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Content Design, Data, and other functions from early exploration through delivery and iteration. We care about interaction quality and visual craft, but also expect designers to understand the product deeply, navigate constraints, and influence the decisions that shape the customer experience.

Depending on team needs and your interests, your work may focus on:
• Manual Trading — helping customers discover markets, analyze information, place and manage trades, and understand their positions.
• Trading Strategy — designing tools and workflows that help customers create, discover, evaluate, and manage trading strategies.
• Social VIP — building differentiated experiences for social trading, communities, creators, and high-value customers.
• Growth — improving acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and cross-product discovery across the customer journey.
• Institutional — designing sophisticated, efficient, and trustworthy products for professional and institutional customers.

What You’ll Be Doing

The scope of the role will vary according to your experience and area of ownership. You may:
• Design clear, intuitive, and trustworthy experiences for complex and data-intensive products.
• Turn customer insights, product strategy, business goals, and technical constraints into coherent user journeys and detailed interactions.
• Work across the end-to-end design process, from problem framing and early exploration to prototyping, delivery, validation, and iteration.
• Create user flows, information architecture, wireframes, prototypes, and production-ready designs with a high level of interaction and visual craft.
• Partner closely with Product and Engineering to evaluate trade-offs, resolve ambiguity, and take work from concept through implementation.
• Use qualitative research, product analytics, experimentation, and market understanding to inform and evaluate design decisions.
• Present your work clearly, explain the reasoning behind your decisions, and use feedback to improve the outcome.
• Contribute to consistent, scalable experiences across platforms, markets, and product areas.
• Help strengthen design quality, collaboration, and customer-centered decision-making across the organization.

At more senior levels, you’ll be expected to define product and design direction, lead ambiguous cross-functional initiatives, influence decisions across teams, and raise the quality of design practice.

What We Look For In You
• Experience designing and delivering digital products. We hire across multiple levels, and assess experience according to the scope, complexity, autonomy, and impact demonstrated in your work.
• A portfolio that shows how you frame problems, explore alternatives, make decisions, craft interactions, and measure or evaluate outcomes—not only final screens.
• Strong product thinking and the ability to connect customer needs with business goals and technical realities.
• Strong interaction design and information architecture skills, especially for complex workflows or data-rich interfaces.
• A high standard of visual craft and attention to detail.
• Experience collaborating closely with Product and Engineering throughout the product development lifecycle.
• The ability to communicate clearly, explain your reasoning, and build alignment with cross-functional partners.
• Comfort working through ambiguity, changing priorities, and incomplete information.
• The ability to take ownership, follow through on details, and help teams turn ideas into shipped experiences.
• Genuine interest in learning about centralized exchange products and the customers who use them.

Nice to Haves
• Experience designing products in trading, investment, fintech, crypto, or other complex financial domains.
• Experience with data-intensive products, professional tools, marketplaces, or high-stakes customer journeys.
• Experience using research, experimentation, and product analytics to guide design decisions.
• Experience designing for customers across multiple markets, cultures, languages, or regulatory environments.
• Experience contributing to or working with a mature design system across platforms.
• At senior or staff level, experience mentoring designers, leading cross-team initiatives, or raising design quality beyond your immediate product area.

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer (GCP) - Engine by Starling
jobs.description:
At Engine by Starling, we are on a mission to find and work with leading banks all around the world who have the ambition to build rapid growth businesses, on our technology. 

Engine is Starling's software-as-a-service (SaaS) business, the technology that was built to power Starling Bank, and a year ago we split out as a separate business. 

Starling has seen exceptional growth and success, and a large part of that is down to the fact that we have built our own modern technology from the ground up. The Engine technology platform is now available to banks and financial institutions all around the world, enabling them to benefit from the innovative digital features, and efficient back-office processes that has helped achieve Starling's success.

Our technologists are at the very heart of Engine and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment that is all about building things, creating new stuff, and disruptive technology that keeps us on the cutting edge of fintech. We operate a flat structure to empower you to make decisions regardless of what your primary responsibilities may be, innovation and collaboration will be at the core of everything you do. Help is never far away in our open culture, you will find support in your team and from across the business, we are in this together!

The way to thrive and shine within Engine is to be a self-driven individual and be able to take full ownership of everything around you: From building things, designing, and discovering to sharing knowledge with your colleagues and making sure all processes are efficient and productive to deliver the best possible results for our customers. Our purpose is underpinned by five values: Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim For Greatness.

Hybrid Working

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Engine – our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of one of our offices so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person. 

About Engineering at Engine by Starling — https://enginebystarling.com/careers/engineering/

As a Security Engineer at Engine, you'll be working on helping to keep our infrastructure secure and compliant and our staff safe and productive. You'll be working on projects covering identity and access management, cloud and network security, vulnerability management, security monitoring, security hardening, compliance reviews, and more. It's a very varied role with lots of close interaction with the infrastructure, security engineering, cross-cutting and compliance teams.

We are looking for an experienced Senior level GCP Security Engineer to join our established Security Engineering team, working closely with Information Security, Infrastructure and the various Engine Technology teams to make sure security is at the heart of all our technical processes. As our subject matter expert, you will take ownership of engineering the security foundations of our Google Cloud Platform environment. This is a hands-on role for a specialist with a proven track record of designing, building, and automating security controls specifically for GCP, including hardened GKE clusters.

Engine by Starling engineers are excited about helping us deliver new features, regardless of what their primary tech stack may be. Hear from the team in our latest Blog or our case studies with Women in Tech.

As a GCP Security Engineer, you will:
• Collaborate with stakeholders to define our Google Cloud security architecture (cloud identity, runtime security, security posture)
• Design, document, build and maintain a secure and scalable infrastructure on GCP using Infrastructure as Code
• Be part of the team responsible for safeguarding our systems, applications and data by ensuring secure user access, authentication and authorisation mechanisms are in place
• Engineer and automate technical controls within GCP to ensure and demonstrate continuous compliance with stringent standards such as PCI DSS and 3DS
• Drive security infrastructure deployments across our growing environments
• Perform regular security assessments, audits, threat modelling and architecture design reviews to identify risks and vulnerabilities, triage found risks, identify improvements appropriately and design controls to implement as corrective actions
• Lead incident response efforts, including investigation and remediation of security breaches
• Support our internal security awareness and training programs, advocating the DevSecOps mindset that we have created across our technology teams

We're open-minded when it comes to hiring and we care more about aptitude and attitude than specific experience or qualifications. If you have an innate passion for security and care enough to find elegant solutions to difficult problems, we'd love to hear from you.

What skills are essential:
• Mature understanding of cloud security architecture, with deep expertise in GCP and a proven track record
• Experience creating a GCP landing zone, configuring services such as organisation policies and VPC Service Controls
• A deep understanding of GCP IAM and its limitations
• Experience with service-oriented architecture using containers, distributed systems and immutable infrastructure on GCP (including GKE, Compute Engine, Shared VPC and Cloud SQL)
• Expertise in Kubernetes, securing clusters (GKE) and meshes (Cilium is preferable), networking best practices and RBAC implementation (CKA, CKS qualifications are a plus)
• Experience with Infrastructure as Code and infrastructure provisioning tools, particularly Terraform
• Experience configuring GCP-native security posture and threat management with Security Command Center
• Experience securing the software supply chain with Binary Authorization, Artifact Registry and Artifact Analysis
• Experience with key and secret management on GCP — Cloud KMS, Cloud External Key Manager (EKM) and Secret Manager — including cryptographic key ceremonies
• Experience with Workload Identity and Workload Identity Federation for keyless authentication of workloads and CI/CD
• Experience configuring and utilising cloud-native security logging, monitoring and detection services
• Strong programming skills — in security we write our own scripts for automation in Python, Go and other languages while contributing to open-source tools so we can utilise them
• In-depth knowledge of security principles, technologies, best practices, and threat detection and mitigation strategies
• Knowledge of common attack vectors and methodologies (OWASP Top 10, MITRE ATT&CK Framework and social engineering tactics)
• The ability to identify potential threats, attack vectors and vulnerabilities in systems and applications
• The ability to document security requirements from various stakeholders
• Excellent problem-solving, communication and active listening skills with an innate passion for security
• The ability to identify security gaps and create solutions to minimise risk and impact to us
• A proactive approach to staying updated with the latest security threats, vulnerabilities and mitigation techniques
• Thorough understanding of the incident response process (preparation, identification, containment, eradication, recovery, lessons learned)

What skills are desirable:
• In-depth knowledge of network security, including core routing and switching concepts (TCP/IP, BGP, VPNs), security controls (firewalls, WAFs, IDS/IPS), and practical experience designing hybrid connectivity between GCP and on-premise environments
• Experience with data-residency and regulated-workload controls such as Assured Workloads and Access Transparency, relevant to deploying per-market for different banks' regulators
• Hands-on experience taking a company through security and compliance frameworks like NIST, SOC 2, ISO 27001 and PCI DSS
• Experience automating security controls and compliance checks against standards and frameworks including SOC 2, ISO 27001 and PCI DSS / 3DS
• Container security knowledge including container image provenance (e.g. Sigstore, Notary) with an in-depth knowledge of container runtimes, and an understanding of integrating security into the software development lifecycle
• Experience performing secure code reviews and security approvals, including the use of static and dynamic application security testing (SAST / DAST) tools
• Experience in cryptography management and enhancements
• Relevant security certifications such as ISC2 CC, CISSP, CCSP, CISM, AWS Security Specialty or GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer

The main part of our tech stack is listed below. We don't ask that you have experience in all of it, but if you do, that's great!
• Java, which makes up the majority of our backend codebase
• GCP and AWS — we're cloud-native
• Microservice-based architecture
• Kubernetes (GKE on GCP, EKS on AWS)
• TeamCity for CI/CD (with multiple production releases per day)
• Terraform and Grafana
• RDS and CloudSQL for PostgreSQL

Our Interview Process:

Interviewing is a two-way process and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you! Our interviews are conversational and we want to get the best from you, so come with questions and be curious. In general you can expect the below, following a chat with one of our Talent Team:
• Initial interview with an Engineer — ~45 minutes
• Take-home technical test, to be discussed in the next interview
• Technical interview with some Engineers — ~1.5 hours
• Final interview with our CTO / deputy CTO — ~45 minutes
• 33 days holiday (including public holidays, which you can take when it works best for you)
• An extra day’s holiday for your birthday
• Annual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell up to five extra days off
• 16 hours paid volunteering time a year
• Salary sacrifice, company enhanced pension scheme
• Life insurance at 4x your salary & group income protection
• Private Medical Insurance with VitalityHealth including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and Peloton
• Generous family-friendly policies
• Incentives refer a friend scheme
• Perkbox membership giving access to retail discounts, a wellness platform for physical and mental health, and weekly free and boosted perks
• Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work, Salary Sacrificed Gym partnerships and Electric Vehicle (EV) leasing

About Us

You may be put off applying for a role because you don't tick every box. Forget that! While we can’t accommodate every flexible working request, we're always open to discussion. So, if you're excited about working with us, but aren’t sure if you're 100% there yet, get in touch anyway. We’re on a mission to radically reshape banking – and that starts with our brilliant team. Whatever came before, we’re proud to bring together people of all backgrounds and experiences who love working together to solve problems.

Engine by Starling is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster diversity & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment at Engine by Starling are considered without regard to race, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. 

When you provide us with this information, you are doing so at your own consent, with full knowledge that we will process this personal data in accordance with our Privacy Notice. By submitting your application, you agree that Engine by Starling and Starling Bank will collect your personal data for recruiting and related purposes. Our Privacy Notice explains what personal information we will process, where we will process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over our use of your personal information.

We use AI tools to support various parts of our recruitment process, helping our team manage applications and assessments more efficiently. These tools are strictly used for support and do not replace human judgment with all final hiring decisions being made by our team. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please reach out to us.

• Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services including GKE, Compute Engine, Network Connectivity Center, Cloud SQL, Identity and Access Management (IAM) and VPC Service Controls
• Experience writing clean, modular Terraform code
• Experience with service-oriented architecture using containers, distributed systems and immutable infrastructure
• Experience with key and secret management on GCP — Cloud KMS, Cloud External Key Manager (EKM) and Secret Manager — including cryptographic key ceremonies
• Experience designing hybrid connectivity from GCP to co-located Payment HSMs using Network Connectivity Center (NCC), Cloud VPN and Dedicated / Partner Interconnect
• Experience with Workload Identity and Workload Identity Federation for keyless authentication of workloads and CI/CD
• Experience with observability tooling — Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Cloud Trace, Managed Service for Prometheus and OpenTelemetry (we also use Grafana)
• Experience setting up Google Workspace / Google Cloud Identity
• Experience with automation using a scripting language like Python or Go
• Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines
• An understanding of RESTful API and event-driven concepts
• Comfortable writing RFCs and ADRs which can be taken from design to implementation and into Production with documented runbooks and operating models

We are looking for an experienced Senior / Staff level GCP Security Engineer to join our established Security Engineering team, working closely with Information Security, Infrastructure and the various Engine Technology teams to make sure security is at the heart of all our technical processes. As our subject matter expert, you will take ownership of engineering the security foundations of our Google Cloud Platform environment. This is a hands-on role for a specialist with a proven track record of designing, building, and automating security controls specifically for GCP, including hardened GKE clusters.

Engine by Starling engineers are excited about helping us deliver new features, regardless of what their primary tech stack may be. Hear from the team in our latest Blog or our case studies with Women in Tech.

As a GCP Security Engineer, you will:
• Collaborate with stakeholders to define our Google Cloud security architecture (cloud identity, runtime security, security posture)
• Design, document, build and maintain a secure and scalable infrastructure on GCP using Infrastructure as Code
• Be part of the team responsible for safeguarding our systems, applications and data by ensuring secure user access, authentication and authorisation mechanisms are in place
• Engineer and automate technical controls within GCP to ensure and demonstrate continuous compliance with stringent standards such as PCI DSS and 3DS
• Drive security infrastructure deployments across our growing environments
• Perform regular security assessments, audits, threat modelling and architecture design reviews to identify risks and vulnerabilities, triage found risks, identify improvements appropriately and design controls to implement as corrective actions
• Lead incident response efforts, including investigation and remediation of security breaches
• Support our internal security awareness and training programs, advocating the DevSecOps mindset that we have created across our technology teams

• Mature understanding of cloud security architecture, with deep expertise in GCP and a proven track record
• Experience creating a GCP landing zone, configuring services such as organisation policies and VPC Service Controls
• A deep understanding of GCP IAM and its limitations
• Experience with service-oriented architecture using containers, distributed systems and immutable infrastructure on GCP (including GKE, Compute Engine, Shared VPC and Cloud SQL)
• Expertise in Kubernetes, securing clusters (GKE) and meshes (Cilium is preferable), networking best practices and RBAC implementation (CKA, CKS qualifications are a plus)
• Experience with Infrastructure as Code and infrastructure provisioning tools, particularly Terraform
• Experience configuring GCP-native security posture and threat management with Security Command Center
• Experience securing the software supply chain with Binary Authorization, Artifact Registry and Artifact Analysis
• Experience with key and secret management on GCP — Cloud KMS, Cloud External Key Manager (EKM) and Secret Manager — including cryptographic key ceremonies
• Experience with Workload Identity and Workload Identity Federation for keyless authentication of workloads and CI/CD
• Experience configuring and utilising cloud-native security logging, monitoring and detection services
• Strong programming skills — in security we write our own scripts for automation in Python, Go and other languages while contributing to open-source tools so we can utilise them
• In-depth knowledge of security principles, technologies, best practices, and threat detection and mitigation strategies
• Knowledge of common attack vectors and methodologies (OWASP Top 10, MITRE ATT&CK Framework and social engineering tactics)
• The ability to identify potential threats, attack vectors and vulnerabilities in systems and applications
• The ability to document security requirements from various stakeholders
• Excellent problem-solving, communication and active listening skills with an innate passion for security
• The ability to identify security gaps and create solutions to minimise risk and impact to us
• A proactive approach to staying updated with the latest security threats, vulnerabilities and mitigation techniques
• Thorough understanding of the incident response process (preparation, identification, containment, eradication, recovery, lessons learned)

What skills are desirable:
• In-depth knowledge of network security, including core routing and switching concepts (TCP/IP, BGP, VPNs), security controls (firewalls, WAFs, IDS/IPS), and practical experience designing hybrid connectivity between GCP and on-premise environments
• Experience with data-residency and regulated-workload controls such as Assured Workloads and Access Transparency, relevant to deploying per-market for different banks' regulators
• Hands-on experience taking a company through security and compliance frameworks like NIST, SOC 2, ISO 27001 and PCI DSS
• Experience automating security controls and compliance checks against standards and frameworks including SOC 2, ISO 27001 and PCI DSS / 3DS
• Container security knowledge including container image provenance (e.g. Sigstore, Notary) with an in-depth knowledge of container runtimes, and an understanding of integrating security into the software development lifecycle
• Experience performing secure code reviews and security approvals, including the use of static and dynamic application security testing (SAST / DAST) tools
• Experience in cryptography management and enhancements
• Relevant security certifications such as ISC2 CC, CISSP, CCSP, CISM, AWS Security Specialty or GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer

jobs.description:
As a Senior Product Manager for SMBs at Wise North America, you will be the dedicated owner of our North American business / SMB strategy. jobs.title: WFM Operations Partner Senior Lead
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Workforce Management Operations Partner Senior Lead to join our Operational team in our London office!

 

The WFM Operations Partner Senior Lead is accountable for the WFM–Operations partnering model, ensuring Workforce Management disciplines are consistently embedded into operational decision-making across the business.

This role owns the quality, consistency, and effectiveness of WFM partnership with Operations, ensuring that intraday, scheduling, and capacity principles are applied correctly, escalations are handled with discipline, and short-term decisions do not undermine medium- and long-term workforce plans.

The role does not execute tactical WFM activities or own forecasting, scheduling, or intraday delivery. Instead, it leads the Ops Partner function, sets standards, manages people, and acts as the senior WFM representative in complex operational trade-offs.

Your mission is to institutionalise WFM decision-making inside Operations, moving the organisation from reactive firefighting to predictable, data-driven execution at scale.

Your Mission
• The WFM Operations Partner Senior Lead is accountable for the people, standards, and decision quality of the WFM Operations Partner function. This includes direct line management of Ops Partner Leads and dotted-line functional leadership over Intraday and Scheduling Specialists.
• Act as the direct people manager for WFM Operations Partner Leads, with accountability for:
• hiring, onboarding, and role clarity
• performance management, GrowWise cycles, and calibration
• ongoing coaching, feedback, and development.
• Set and reinforce clear expectations for:
• decision quality
• stakeholder behaviour
• adherence to WFM principles and frameworks.
• Develop Ops Partner Leads from:
• metric interpretation
• structured decision support
• confident, evidence-based challenge of Operations leadership.
• Ensure consistent capability, judgement, and behavioural standards across the Ops Partner team through calibration and peer review.
• Act as the senior WFM representative to Operations Heads and senior Ops leaders.
• Own the quality and consistency of workforce decisions taken by Operations.
• Serve as the final escalation point for workforce-related decisions that materially impact service, cost, or workforce sustainability.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Bill Pay
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Engineering at Brex

Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams span Software, Data, Security, and IT, and operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration. We tackle hard technical problems, own our outcomes, and push for excellence at every level — from architecture to deployment. It's an environment where engineering is a craft, and builders become leaders.

What you'll do

The Bill Pay team is a high-functioning, product led team supported by product and design, building and leading the next generation of Accounts Payable (AP) software. We’re looking for an engineering leader to have strong opinions on technical design and the willingness and eagerness to jump on customer calls. This is one of the most important roles in Brex engineering as it perfectly sits between our Expense Management and Banking products. 

This is a founder-shaped problem: the domain is established, but the roadmap and how we get there is unwritten. If you're an ex-founder, this is your kind of opportunity.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Vancouver office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Build and lead a full-stack team (7-10 engineers) owning a defined part of Brex's next-generation Accounts Payable software, growing it through hiring and onboarding new engineers.
• Help define and continually sharpen the team's mandate within the broader Payments group — what it owns, where to invest and how to continuously win customers.
• Set the team's technical and product direction, making thoughtful tradeoffs about what to build, in what order, and why.
• Ship a high-quality, reliable, competitive Accounts Payable product, balancing customer-facing feature velocity with a durable technical foundation.
• Foster a people-centered culture, one built on enablement, trust, and context-sharing.
• Partner cross-functionally across Design and Product to align on scope and delivery.
• Provide strong coaching, mentorship, and career development for engineers at all levels.
• Bring an AI-forward mindset to how the team builds and operates. We expect you to be a continuous bar-raiser on AI for the team.
• Translate customer feedback into engineering priorities. Drive product discovery and champion the user’s voice in technical trade-off discussions to ensure the team is building the right features for the right reasons.

Requirements
• Track record of engineering leadership building and scaling customer-facing products, including hiring and growing teams.
• Strong product sense the ability to make and defend product and UX tradeoffs, not just technical ones.
• A staff-engineer-level technical bar; able to operate at all levels and earn the technical respect of a strong engineering team.
• Strong customer empathy and advocacy.
• Excellent written and verbal communication.
• Demonstrated coaching and mentorship of engineers across levels.
• Minimum 2+ years in an engineering management role

Bonus points
• Accounts Payable / Bill Pay domain experience
• Experience in a Payments domain (accounting, bill pay, credit card processing, banking integrations, ERPs, etc).

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $240,000 - $285,000 CAD. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Team

The Compliance function at OKX is responsible for promoting a strong compliance culture and supporting the business in meeting its regulatory obligations and managing enterprise risk.

The Product Compliance team is responsible for embedding compliance into the product lifecycle and supporting the compliant development, launch and ongoing operation of OKX products and features globally across all markets in which our products and services are offered. We work closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, Central Compliance and local Compliance teams to identify regulatory and compliance requirements, assess product risks and develop practical solutions that support responsible commercial growth.

About the Opportunity

 We are seeking an experienced, hands-on and commercially minded Senior Compliance Manager to join our Product Compliance team.
This is a senior individual-contributor role focused primarily on the day-to-day review of new products, material product changes and existing product enhancements. The emphasis is on delivering timely, well-reasoned product compliance assessments using a risk-based approach, ensuring that material compliance risks are sufficiently mitigated and the firm’s regulatory positioning protected.

You will act as a trusted compliance partner throughout the product development lifecycle, helping Product and Engineering teams navigate complex regulatory requirements while enabling commercially viable outcomes. You will be expected to distinguish between legal or regulatory constraints that cannot be crossed, risks that can be addressed through proportionate controls, and residual risks that require documented escalation or risk acceptance.

 

What You’ll Be Doing
• • Own and deliver day-to-day compliance reviews of new products, features, market expansions and material changes to existing products across OKX's global business and product suite.
• Review product requirements, technical documentation, user journeys, onboarding flows, trading or transaction mechanics, reward structures, disclosures and operational processes.
• Apply a risk-based waterfall that distinguishes hard legal or regulatory blockers from risks that may be addressed through controls, product conditions, jurisdictional restrictions, monitoring or escalation.
• Conduct and document product compliance risk assessments covering areas such as regulatory perimeter and licensing, AML/CFT, sanctions, KYC, consumer protection, financial promotions, trading and market conduct, asset safeguarding, data privacy and third-party risk.
• Produce clear, concise and evidence-based and solutions-based compliance recommendations setting out identified risks, required mitigants, residual exposure and the proposed approval or escalation route.
• Work directly with Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, Central Compliance and local Compliance teams to develop practical and scalable solutions to identified compliance requirements.
• Maintain complete and accurate documentation and audit trails for product reviews, decisions, conditions, exceptions, approvals and subsequent changes.
• Support post-launch monitoring, control testing and assurance in partnership with Audit, Product and other Compliance teams, and drive remediation of identified issues.
• Promote a compliance-by-design culture within the product lifecycle; communicate the Product Compliance framework and program requirements to relevant stakeholders and deliver targeted training or guidance to Product, Engineering and business teams as required.
• Support special projects and priority product launches in a fast-paced and continually evolving environment.

 

What We Look For In You
• • At least 8 years of relevant experience in Compliance, Legal or Risk within financial services, fintech, payments or the cryptocurrency industry.
• Bachelor's degree in law, finance, business, economics, engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• Significant hands-on experience in product compliance, regulatory advisory or product risk assessment, including advising on new products and material product changes.
• Strong understanding of the digital-asset industry and the products offered by crypto platforms, including trading, custody, payments, staking or earn products, lending, structured products, wallets or DeFi.
• Strong working knowledge of relevant regulatory and compliance requirements, including licensing and regulatory-perimeter considerations, AML/CFT, sanctions, KYC, consumer protection, financial promotions and trading or market-conduct requirements.
• Demonstrated ability to analyze products or initiatives involving significant complexity and risk and translate regulatory requirements into practical product requirements and controls.
• Experience in and demonstrated success in leveraging AI-enabled technology to maintain risk assessment standards, including ongoing tuning of agentic skills aligned with the Company’s risk appetite.
• Excellent risk judgment and the ability to balance compliance rigor with a pragmatic, risk-based approach that supports responsible commercial outcomes.
• Proven ability to develop and deliver repeatable product compliance solutions, controls and review processes aligned with broader group requirements.
• Strong project-management and execution skills, including the ability to manage multiple concurrent reviews, maintain accurate documentation and meet product-launch deadlines.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present clear recommendations and lead discussions with Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, senior management and other Compliance stakeholders.
• Strong stakeholder-management skills and the ability to influence product decisions and constructively challenge proposals without compromising Compliance rigor.
• Self-motivated, proactive and comfortable operating independently within a fast-paced, globally dispersed team.
• High personal integrity and sound professional judgment, including the ability to identify when an issue requires escalation.

 

Nice to Haves
• • Direct product compliance or regulatory advisory experience at a crypto exchange, fintech or technology-led financial-services company.
• Experience supporting multi-jurisdictional product launches and applying regulatory requirements across the United States, European Union, Middle East or Asia-Pacific.
• Practical knowledge of CeFi trading products, including spot, derivatives, leverage, custody, institutional products and OTC flows.
• Familiarity with Web3 products, blockchain technology, smart contracts, DeFi protocols and digital-asset transaction flows.
• Experience developing compliance risk-assessment frameworks, controls, and key risk indicators.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Cards

YouTrip is the leading and fastest-growing multi-currency payment platform in Asia Pacific. In 2018, we pioneered the region's first multi-currency digital wallet. Now, YouTrip is the #1 multi-currency digital wallet trusted by millions across the region, processing over US$15 billion in total payment value annually. 

Our consumer and business propositions – YouTrip and YouBiz – empower individuals and businesses with inclusive, accessible, and affordable financial solutions. YouTrip has raised over US$110 million to date, including its recent Series B round led by global venture capital firm Lightspeed Venture Partners—underscoring strong investor confidence in its mission to transform digital financial services across the Asia Pacific. 

Recognised as World Economic Forum’s Global Innovator 2025, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies (2025, 2024), and LinkedIn’s Top Startup (2024, 2023), YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses.

Valuing an entrepreneurial culture of diversity and inclusion, we are seeking driven individuals to join our fast-growing regional team as we push the boundaries of innovative fintech solutions.

Job Description:

Product Manager

As Product Manager, you will work on our core technology powering our multi-currency card processing and collections flow. You will have the opportunity to work directly on card payments, scheme integrations, tokenized payment flows, clearing/settlement logic, and the core ledgers that guarantee the accuracy and reliability of our customers’ balances.

You should have some prior card-program experience and you must be technically strong, curious, and comfortable learning fast. Expect to work on complex integrations and high-stakes logic around authorization flows, ledger postings, reconciliation risks, and more. We’re looking for someone who is unintimidated by complexity and willing to roll up their sleeves and dive into the details.

You should be prepared to understand and shape systems that must be correct, auditable, and reliable, while still building quickly and iterating fast.

 

You will:
• Work on and enhance our card processing capabilities, tokenization (Apple Pay/Google Pay) flows, scheme-driven requirements, and top ups.
• Support system enhancements that ensure accuracy of postings, settlement logic, reversals, refunds, and reconciliation processes.
• Co-own integrations with issuers, processors, and payment processors, helping ensure our systems meet scheme and regulatory expectations.
• Collaborate closely with engineering to design scalable, reliable technical functionalities across cards, top ups and ledger.
• Partner with Finance on reconciliation flows and accounting mapping; partner with Risk/Compliance on scheme/issuer obligations and controls.
• Develop, maintain, and prioritize a technical product backlog with clarity around risks, dependencies, and sequencing.
• Produce clear, structured technical documentation, including workflows, data flows, and requirements.
• Define success metrics for system performance (e.g., auth accuracy, ledger integrity, settlement timeliness).
• Collaborate across marketing, operations, and other functions to support go-to-market needs when launching card-related or ledger-related enhancements

You have:
• 4–6 years of product management experience working on technically complex systems.
• Strong ability to understand backend systems, workflows, and architectural decisions.
• High learning agility, especially in areas such as card processing, top ups, clearing & settlement, or ledger accounting.
• Comfortable working directly with engineers on API flows, data models, and integration behaviour.
• Comfortable articulating technical risks and trade-offs clearly, especially for flows where accuracy and compliance matter.
• An instinct to dive deep into workflows and processes across engineering, finance, operations, and compliance to ensure nothing is missed.
• A habit of writing clear technical documentation and requirements.
• Strong stakeholder management, especially with external partners/vendors (issuers, processors, fintech providers).
• Leadership presence — people naturally look to you for clarity, judgment, and direction.

jobs.title: iOS Engineer - Engine by Starling
jobs.description:
At Engine by Starling, we are on a mission to find and work with leading banks all around the world who have the ambition to build rapid growth businesses, on our technology. 

Engine is Starling's software-as-a-service (SaaS) business, the technology that was built to power Starling, and a year ago we split out as a separate business. 

Starling has seen exceptional growth and success, and a large part of that is down to the fact that we have built our own modern technology from the ground up. This SaaS technology platform is now available to banks and financial institutions all around the world, enabling them to benefit from the innovative digital features, and efficient back-office processes that has helped achieve Starling's success.

Our technologists are at the very heart of Engine and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment that is all about building things, creating new stuff, and disruptive technology that keeps us on the cutting edge of fintech. We operate a flat structure to empower you to make decisions regardless of what your primary responsibilities may be, innovation and collaboration will be at the core of everything you do. Help is never far away in our open culture, you will find support in your team and from across the business, we are in this together!

The way to thrive and shine within Engine is to be a self-driven individual and be able to take full ownership of everything around you: From building things, designing, and discovering to sharing knowledge with your colleagues and making sure all processes are efficient and productive to deliver the best possible results for our customers. Our purpose is underpinned by five values: Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim For Greatness.

Hybrid Working

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Engine - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of our offices so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person.

About Engineering at Engine by Starling - https://www.enginebystarling.com/

We’re looking for iOS Engineers to work on the Engine Platform and make our existing features work for banks all over the world as well as building new features from scratch that Starling hasn’t released in the UK market.

Engine by Starling engineers are excited about helping us deliver new features, regardless of what their primary tech stack may be. Hear more from the team in some case studies below, and our work with Women In Tech.
• Day in the Life of a Mobile Engineer
• Working as a Mobile QA
• Leading the Android Team
• Engine by Starling Careers Page

We are looking for engineers at all levels to join the team. We value people being engaged and caring about customers, caring about the code they write and the contribution they can make to banking around the world. People with a broad ability to apply themselves to a multitude of problems and challenges, who can work across teams do great things here at Engine, to continue changing banking for good.

As an Engineer you will:
• Contribute to our award winning platform and internal tooling
• Build new features and products from scratch in a configurable way
• Share your knowledge with those around you, contributing to our learning culture
• Own your projects, working in small teams across the bank to collaboratively deliver
• Aim for greatness in everything you do, staying curious and inquisitive
• Be part of a scaling team and organisation as we change banking for good

Our iOS application is entirely written in Swift. It is highly modular and we use MVVM-C architecture to maximise code reusability and testing. We also value simplicity over complexity, fewer moving parts means fewer faults and easier comprehension.

Some of the well known frameworks and tools we use:
• RxSwift - as our reactive programming framework;
• SnapKit - as our auto layout DSL, though we have an in-house framework built on top of SnapKit which allows us to write declarative, SwiftUI like layout code for UIKit.
• Realm - as the application main persistence layer;
• Sourcery and SwiftGen - for various code generation tasks.
• SwiftFormat, SwiftLint and Danger - to enforce high code quality standards.
• Etc.

We also built in-house tools and frameworks as developer productivity and automation is paramount to us.

We are looking for iOS engineers to work on these apps who:
• Want to work on a feature rich mobile app with millions of customers;
• Can produce robust, well tested code that will give our customers the reliability that they need;
• Care about the product, the user experience and the design;
• Think (like us) that a small number of empowered developers is the right way to deliver software;
• Our application is built with UIKit, knowing its concepts and components is a must.
• We use RxSwift in our project, experience with reactive programming will be a plus but is not required.

Interview process

Interviewing is a two way process and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you! Our interviews are conversational and we want to get the best from you, so come with questions and be curious. In general you can expect the below, following a chat with one of our Talent Team:
• First interview: ~45 minutes
• Take home technical test (no time limit)
• Technical face to face: ~1.5 hours
• Final Interview: ~45 minutes
• 33 days holiday (including public holidays, which you can take when it works best for you)
• An extra day’s holiday for your birthday
• Annual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell up to five extra days off
• 16 hours paid volunteering time a year
• Salary sacrifice, company enhanced pension scheme
• Life insurance at 4x your salary & group income protection
• Private Medical Insurance with VitalityHealth including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and Peloton
• Generous family-friendly policies
• Incentives refer a friend scheme
• Perkbox membership giving access to retail discounts, a wellness platform for physical and mental health, and weekly free and boosted perks
• Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work, Salary Sacrificed Gym partnerships and Electric Vehicle (EV) leasing

About Us

You may be put off applying for a role because you don't tick every box. Forget that! While we can’t accommodate every flexible working request, we're always open to discussion. So, if you're excited about working with us, but aren’t sure if you're 100% there yet, get in touch anyway. We’re on a mission to radically reshape banking – and that starts with our brilliant team. Whatever came before, we’re proud to bring together people of all backgrounds and experiences who love working together to solve problems.

Engine by Starling is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster diversity & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment at Engine by Starling are considered without regard to race, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. 

When you provide us with this information, you are doing so at your own consent, with full knowledge that we will process this personal data in accordance with our Privacy Notice. By submitting your application, you agree that Engine by Starling and Starling will collect your personal data for recruiting and related purposes. Our Privacy Notice explains what personal information we will process, where we will process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over our use of your personal information.

jobs.description:
Hello, we’re Starling.

Banking was broken – so we decided to fix it. The vision? Fast technology, fair service and honest values. All at the tap of a phone, all the time. We built Britain’s first digital bank. One hard-won banking licence later, we set about giving people a new way to spend, save and manage their money (and take better care of the planet, too). We’re changing banking for good. Back then, we were obsessed with unravelling the knotty world of finance and solving people’s problems rather than selling them stuff. We still are.

Since then, we’ve grown. A lot. Over four million accounts (and four account types!). A team of thousands. Headquartered in London with offices in Cardiff, Dublin, Manchester and Southampton. Seven years voted Which? Recommended Provider and Britain's Best Banking Brand. Still zero branches. Our culture is open, inclusive and focused on solving real customer problems, with an emphasis on doing the right thing, even when it’s not always the easy thing. From our approach to working together and sustainability to how we build our products, our decisions need to make the world – and Starling – a better place to be. Everyone at Starling is essential to our mission, which is really quite simple: to solve our customer’s problems – and build the best bank in the world!

And now we're providing Starling to other banks, via a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) proposition through our subsidiary Engine, using the proprietary technology platform that it uses to power our own bank.
