jobs.title: Sr Product Manager - Virality, Referrals & KOL
jobs.description:
BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Consumer Growth builds mobile and web experiences that help people become Kraken customers, fund their accounts, invest, earn, access new products, build wealth and stay lifelong clients. Product, engineering, design, data, and lifecycle marketing build together.

THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Own growth in viral, KOL- and creator-referred new transacting users (NTUs). Set aggressive NTU targets backed by a credible growth model, then beat them. Build and scale sharing, referral, and creator systems that drive 10x, then 50x growth while hitting payback targets.

 - Build sharing people find useful. Create natural reasons to pass on product value, and referral programs with modeled payback incentives, and without relying on aggressive incentives to hit targets. Make both work for the sender, recipient, and business.

 - Own the audience-to-customer journey. Build and test paths from recommendations and creator audiences to product value and a first transaction. Partner with the teams that own onboarding and core product experiences on shared journeys.

 - Own Consumer features and updates for the KOL Platform. Set the Consumer roadmap, ship features and ongoing improvements, and make measurement and commercial tools trustworthy and easy to use. Work with the teams that own KOL and affiliate relationships.

 - Build creator tools across Kraken’s app and web. Help creators, key opinion leaders (KOLs), and power referrers invite their followers and turn their audiences into valuable new transacting customers. Understand their different motivations and build with core product teams.

 - Make acquisition economics work. Own acquisition cost and gross-margin payback against clear targets, including fully loaded incentive, partner, operating, and fraud costs. Use downstream retention and revenue to judge what deserves more investment.

 - Increase virality per new transacting user and per returning user. Test ways to improve send conversion, invites per sender, and invite-to-first-transaction conversion. Improve repeat sharing and loop speed, and prove the gains create incremental valuable new transacting customers.

 - Build measurement you can trust. Validate instrumentation, define hypotheses and guardrails, and run tests that can detect meaningful effects. Separate attributed activity from incremental growth, interpret uncertainty honestly, and check that gains persist as you scale.

WHAT YOU BRING

 - You’ve personally built a product, tool, feature, or experience that spread beyond its initial audience. You can explain why it spread, your contribution, and how it acquired valuable customers.

 - Repeated success beating acquisition targets through referrals, product virality, or creator-led growth. Show the baseline, target, result, timeframe, component rates you improved, and your personal contribution. Bring evidence the gains lasted.

 - Strong growth product sense. You understand sharing psychology and the different motivations of customers, creators, KOLs, and power referrers. You combine customer research, creative product instincts, and strong UX and copy to give people a reason to participate.

 - Analytical independence. You independently investigate behavior with SQL and product analytics, validate instrumentation, and build funnel, cohort, and growth models.

 - Experimentation and commercial judgment. You design reliable tests, interpret uncertainty honestly, and distinguish attribution from incremental growth. You understand acquisition cost and payback, including downstream retention, revenue, and fully loaded incentive and fraud costs.

 - Senior ownership and hands-on execution. You set strategy, make hard priority calls, align teams without relying on reporting lines, and deliver autonomously. You use AI and working prototypes to turn original ideas into experiences people can try.

NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience building self-service creator or affiliate tools, revenue-share systems, or reliable partner payouts.

 - Consumer fintech, crypto, payments, or experience designing financial promotions and fraud controls.

 - Experience adapting growth journeys across markets, cultures, and regulatory environments.

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

THE TEAM

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Sr. MarTech Specialist for Attribution and Performance, you will support attribution and performance measurement at Payward by owning the data and processes that keep it accurate, and by acting as the bridge between our engineers and our performance marketing team. You will form part of a wider MarTech team and partner closely with finance and compliance so that measurement stays accurate and follows our safety and compliance practices. You will also use AI as a core part of how you work, moving quickly and sharing what you learn with the team. Key responsibilities include:

 - Attribution:
 
 - Drive attribution across web and app, covering conversion definitions, touchpoint credit and journeys stitched together across 3rd party vendors and our inhouse data platforms.
 
 - Reconcile ad platform, MMP, analytics and internal numbers, and explain the gaps in plain language.
 
 - Investigate discrepancies caused by vendor configuration, attribution methodology, fraud or bugs in our own apps.
 
 - Use AI as part of your everyday workflow to speed up investigation, SQL, specs and reporting, share what works with the team and contribute to team Agent.
 
 - Contribute to the roadmap for the next level of attribution, such as incrementality testing, LTV-based optimisation and marketing mix modelling.
 
 Engineering partnership:
 
 - Turn performance marketing needs into clear specs and tickets for engineering, covering event design, deep links, SDK changes and server-side tracking, and review what ships.
 
 - Work with engineers and data owners to keep the signals ad platforms optimise on (Meta, Google and TikTok conversion APIs and postbacks) complete, deduplicated and consent-compliant.
 
 - Audit and standardise event naming, properties and volume, with monitoring in place to catch breakages early.
 
 Performance and cross-functional support:
 
 - Run a regular rhythm with performance marketing on attribution health, discrepancies and test readouts.
 
 - Put a measurement plan in place before spend goes live on new channels, launches and tests, and own the readout afterwards.
 
 - Support weekly and monthly reporting cycles, maintain the attribution dashboards the performance team relies on, and support spend and invoice reconciliation with finance.
 
 - Work directly with MMP and ad platform reps and vendor support, escalating with evidence.
 
 - Work with compliance to keep tracking, conversion signals and reporting aligned with Payward's safety and compliance practices, including consent, privacy (GDPR, CCPA) and financial promotion rules.
 
 - Set up monitoring and alerts for tracking breakages, fraud and volatility-driven spikes in traffic and conversions, such as sharp market moves, and escalate per policy.
 
 - Participate in cross-functional discussions with product, compliance, finance, design, data and performance marketing, and prioritise requests openly.

WHAT YOU BRING

 - 5+ years of experience in MarTech, performance marketing technology, growth analytics or a related digital marketing field.

 - Hands-on experience with web and mobile attribution, including MMPs (such as AppsFlyer or Branch), SKAN, deep linking and web-to-app journeys.

 - Understanding of why ad platforms credit conversions differently, and experience with conversion APIs and server-side tracking for Meta, Google Ads and TikTok.

 - Comfortable working with data: SQL and a data warehouse, able to read an event schema and trace a discrepancy back to its source.

 - An AI-native way of working: you already use AI assistants and agents day to day for analysis, SQL, scripting, documentation and automation, move fast with them, check their output before relying on it, and follow our data privacy and security rules when doing so.

 - Experience working within safety and compliance practices in a regulated environment, such as consent and financial promotion rules, and monitoring data and alerts through volatile periods when traffic and conversions swing quickly.

 - Strong stakeholder management and written communication skills, with experience aligning performance marketers, engineers, data, finance and compliance around a number they might not align on.

 - Able to write a clear spec, work with engineers to deliver it and review the result.

 - Detail-oriented and process-driven, able to manage multiple workstreams and prioritise the problems that move spend decisions.

 - Genuine interest in the crypto or fintech industry.

NICE TO HAVES

 - Exposure to incrementality testing or marketing mix modelling.

 - Experience building AI-assisted workflows or lightweight automations, for example with LLM APIs, scripts or agents, for reporting, QA or monitoring.

 - Familiarity with affiliate platforms (Impact.com http://Impact.com or similar), CRM platforms, tag management and consent tooling.

 - Fintech or crypto experience.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

OUR COMMITMENT

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Sr Product Manager - Retention
jobs.description:
BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Consumer Growth builds mobile and web experiences that help people become Kraken customers, fund their accounts, invest, earn, access new products, build wealth and stay lifelong clients. Product, engineering, design, data, and lifecycle marketing build together.

THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Choose the right bets. Identify the client segments and problems worth solving. Own the roadmap and allocate effort against expected client value, commercial impact, and engineering cost. Set the baseline, target, and threshold for scaling; stop weak bets.

 - Build NTU retention. Help newly transacting users build on their first transaction, discover further value, and form repeat investing and financial habits through their first weeks and months. Find where they stall and improve the steps that lead to lasting use.

 - Retain and bring back established clients. Keep active clients engaged, address signs of lapsing, and reactivate clients who have stopped. Understand how needs change with tenure, holdings, and financial goals, then deepen the client’s relationship with Kraken.

 - Make the next financial move useful. Test ways to support client intent: recurring deposits and buys, useful portfolio context, timely opportunities, or relevant Earn products. Choose from the evidence. Successful automated investing and Earn can create lasting value without frequent manual activity. Make rewards, access, and risks clear.

 - Prove the commercial impact. Track retention by cohort and segment, linking behavior to retained balances, net inflows, product adoption, and revenue. Measure active engagement through useful actions, such as reviewing a portfolio or investing, and track successful automated habits separately. Distinguish inflows from asset-price gains, establish incremental impact, account for incentives and costs, and check that gains last after promotions end.

 - Connect product and lifecycle. Partner with lifecycle marketing on push, email, web, and app journeys, from a relevant message to a useful financial action. Adapt to local payment habits and market requirements.

 - Build and ship with the team. Turn the chosen problem into prototypes, requirements, and experiments with engineering, design, and data. Bring risk, compliance, and legal partners into design decisions. Balance client impact, reliability, maintainability, and delivery speed; scale what works.

WHAT YOU BRING

 - Evidence that you’ve personally led consumer product changes that beat retention or expansion targets. Be ready to explain the baseline, target, result, timeframe, and your contribution, including the impact on revenue, assets, or retained balances.

 - A clear account of what changed underneath the result: component behaviors or funnel rates such as repeat deposits, return-to-transaction conversion, successful recurring investments, or reactivation. Show how you established incremental impact and whether it lasted.

 - Strong client and product judgment. You can choose a segment and problem worth pursuing, understand why clients return, hold, withdraw, or disengage, and turn that insight into a useful experience.

 - Hands-on analytical depth. You query and validate your own data, diagnose cohorts and funnels, size opportunities, and design experiments that can detect a commercially meaningful effect.

 - Commercial discipline. You can explain how market conditions, incentives, costs, and client trust affected your results, and use that evidence to decide whether an improvement is worth scaling.

 - Senior ownership from decision through delivery. You’ve owned a roadmap, made product and technical trade-offs, allocated effort, stopped weak bets, and worked effectively with engineering, design, data, lifecycle marketing, and risk/compliance partners.

NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience with consumer investing, wealth, savings, fintech, or crypto products. Freemium gaming is nice-to-have as well.

 - Experience building recurring investment, deposit, Earn, portfolio, or goal-based experiences.

 - Experience adapting client journeys across markets and local financial behaviors.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

OUR COMMITMENT

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. jobs.title: Clinical Workflow Informaticist
jobs.description:
About Us:

Lunar is a stealth technology company building a new type of software platform for health systems. We are on a mission to revolutionize healthcare with cutting-edge, AI-powered software designed to help every hospital deliver world-class care for their patients. Our platform is already the core backbone of health systems today, transforming clinical and operational workflows at scale with the world’s first AI-native hospital information system.

This next-generation platform is a fundamental rebuild of the information infrastructure that runs health systems. All of it – from doctors, nurses, pharmacists, lab technicians, coders, billers, supply chain, and even patients – Lunar’s software powers everything, soup-to-nuts. We believe that this mission is the moon landing of healthcare – something so consequential and ambitious that most people believe it to be impossible.

Backed by Silicon Valley’s preeminent venture capital firms, we believe in the power of a high performance team of seasoned professionals operating at the peak of their abilities. We value people who are driven, curious, have sound judgement, and care about doing the best work of their careers.

We are looking for a Clinical Workflow Informaticist on the Clinical Applications team to bridge the gap between our clinical users (such as doctors, nurses, pharmacists, physiotherapists, lab technicians) and our technology, ensuring a seamless experience with the Lunar platform. This role will provide expert guidance, training, and support to healthcare professionals, helping them optimize workflows, troubleshoot issues, and maximize the value of our platform in delivering patient care. If that sounds meaningful to you, join us and make an impact on how healthcare is delivered.

Over the next 6 months, here are some ways you can make an impact:

 - Support Clinical Users: Lead onboarding and ongoing support for new clinical users, ensuring they can effectively navigate and utilize Lunar.

 - Streamline Support Processes: Develop support workflows and documentation to improve response times and provide scalable solutions for common clinical user challenges.

 - Gather Product Feedback: Gather feedback from frontline healthcare professionals to identify pain points and collaborate with product and engineering teams to drive usability improvements.

 - Facilitate Feature Adoption: Assist in the implementation of new clinical features by providing real-world insights, testing workflows, and ensuring seamless rollout to users.

 - Hands-on Clinical Insight: Leverage your clinical experience to create solutions that support clinicians in providing better patient care while easing the documentation burden.

Your

Experience:

- Clinical Background: Ideally, you are a Nurse Practitioner (NP), Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN), Registered Nurse (RN) or Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist (CRNA) with nursing experience, preferably in internal medicine or a hospital setting.

 - Hospital

Experience:

Strong experience in hospital environments, with a focus on internal medicine.

 - Experience Level: A minimum of 1 year of nursing experience, with 2-3 years total experience in clinical settings.

 - Communication

Skills:

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to describe clinical workflows, train users, and collaborate across teams.

 - End-user support

experience:

Prior experience supporting clinicians or end-users with clinical technology, troubleshooting issues, and guiding best practices in a healthcare environment.

 - Attention to Detail: Proven ability to work with precision, especially when configuring clinical templates and order sets that require accuracy and compliance.

At Lunar, we know our greatest strength is the diverse blend of backgrounds, experiences, and ideas that our team members contribute. We’re passionate about healthcare, but we are also passionate about creating an inclusive workplace where every unique talent and perspective is not just respected, but celebrated. We thrive on embracing differences and are fully committed to fostering a fair, supportive, and dynamic environment where everyone has the opportunity to shine. All applicants will be considered for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

 - Develop a radically better access control system for clinical data: Create a modern access control system with fine-grained permissions that respects clinical data structure and patient data ownership, while enabling population-level insights for better public health.

 - Keep hospitals online 24/7 - no matter what: Design and ship infrastructure that can handle rolling deployments, failover, and real-time data sync in environments where downtime isn’t an inconvenience - it’s a risk to patient care.

 - Bridge the gap between software and hardware: Architect a next-generation integration engine to connect ventilators, bedside monitors, imaging equipment, lab equipment, and more - reliably and in real time.

 - Push hospital workflows into the modern age: Rethink and rewire how data moves between nurses, doctors, and administrators - and turn confusing, click-heavy workflows into fast, intuitive experiences.

Your

Experience:

- Minimum of 10 years of professional software engineering experience.

 - Proficiency with object oriented and functional programming, with the ability and willingness to use and adopt new technologies. We use tools such as Phoenix, Elixir, Python, Erlang, Javascript, Node.js and more.

 - Strong ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and innovative team environment.

 - Exceptional problem-solving skills, with a track record of tackling challenging engineering problems. 

 - Intellectually curious with a growth mindset - able to tackle entirely novel challenges that lack prior precedent through applying strong fundamentals and first principles thinking.

 - Familiarity with open-source technology and a desire to explore and experiment with new solutions.

 - Experience building 0-1 with a strong product sense.

 - Excellent communication skills and the ability to articulate technical decisions, trade-offs, and best practices.

 - A passion for making a meaningful impact in the healthcare industry through software innovation is a plus.

 - Build a clinical design system from scratch: Design and ship a component library and design system that brings consistency, speed, and polish to every screen a clinician touches.

 - Push hospital workflows into the modern age: Rethink and rewire how clinicians move through the software - and turn confusing, click-heavy workflows into fast, keyboard-driven, intuitive experiences that clinicians love, not tolerate.

 - Render real-time clinical data, instantly: Build interfaces that reflect live patient data - vitals, orders, labs, alerts - the moment it changes, with no lag, in environments like the ED, ICU, and OR where a half-second matters. Architect the data layer, caching, and subscription patterns over GraphQL that make that possible.

 - Make interfaces that never fail under pressure: Engineer for accessibility, resilience, and performance so the UI holds up in high-stakes, high-stress settings - including degraded networks and edge cases that would break an ordinary web app.

 - Turn complexity into clarity: Take dense clinical and operational data and shape it into clear, glanceable, decision-ready interfaces for doctors, nurses, pharmacists, and administrators.

 - Define the frontend from first principles: Set the patterns, state management, and rendering architecture - balancing developer velocity against the reliability bar of mission-critical software.

Your

Experience:

- Minimum of 10 years of professional software engineering experience, with deep focus on frontend.

 - Expertise across the frontend stack including TypeScript, JavaScript, React, HTML, CSS, browser internals, rendering performance, state management and building real-time, reactive UIs against GraphQL APIs

 - Comfortable adopting new tools as needed (we use Elixir/Erlang, Phoenix, Postgres and AWS in the backend).

 - Experience with client-side data loading and management: caching, freshness, ownership, and how to optimize push updates

 - Understanding of the browser rendering cycle, how and when the DOM decides what to repaint, and the instinct to profile and optimize for a responsive, data-dense interface.

 - Well-versed in modern React patterns and functional programming principles, including advanced use of custom hooks to build performant, maintainable, and reusable component architectures at scale.

 - Deep fluency with async control flow in JavaScript (Promises, async/await) and a track record of diagnosing race conditions, ordering issues, and unhandled rejections in real-time systems.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
ABOUT MEOW

Meow is business banking built for global crypto companies. FDIC-insured accounts through our banking partners, real yield on idle cash, and support for US and offshore entities. You can also send and receive crypto straight from your fiat checking balance and it converts automatically, so you never have to hold crypto on your balance sheet.

Companies like Solana, Optimism, QuickNode, Starknet, and DoubleZero already run on Meow. More social proof at meow.com/for-crypto.

Everyone on the team is exceeding quota, it's time to pour gas on the fire with new tactics across lead generation, closing, and account management. 

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a quota-carrying Account Executive role based in our Soho, NYC office. You'll own deals end to end, from meeting booked to close, selling Meow to founders, CFOs, and treasurers at crypto companies. You'll work outbound, warm intros, and the NYC event circuit, with the product, the customer logos, and the team behind you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build a pipeline of crypto companies from first touch to funded account

 - Run sharp discovery and pitch Meow to skeptical, technical buyers who care about trust and social proof, not feature lists

 - Work warm paths through people who trust you instead of blasting cold

 - Show up at the dinners and events, follow up, and turn handshakes into accounts

 - Feed what you learn back to the team so the pitch keeps getting sharper

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 2 to 5 years in sales or BD with quota you actually carried and hit

 - You get finance and crypto. You can explain stablecoins, yield, and why FDIC insurance matters without reading off a sheet

 - Hungry. You'd rather figure it out than wait to be told

 - Well connected, or able to build a network fast and thoughtfully

 - Comfortable owning a number and closing sharp, skeptical buyers

 - Someone who can balance following a working playbook with enough creativity to test new strategies and bring them to the team. 

COMPENSATION

$110K to $150K base depending on experience, with $250K OTE all-in. Commission is uncapped and revenue-based, so the more you close, the more you make, with no ceiling. You'd be the 7th hire on the sales team. 

WHY NOW

The next wave of crypto companies is being built right now, and almost none of them have a long term banking partner with crypto rails. The product works, the logos are real, and the seat is open. If that sounds like your kind of problem, let's talk.

Our customers are complex and global, from crypto protocols to multi-entity international businesses. We combine financial infrastructure with hands-on support so founders can operate efficiently and scale with confidence.

We’re hiring a Software Engineer who wants real ownership in a fast-moving startup environment.

 - Build full-stack web features (front-end, back-end) from zero to one.

 - Comfortable with building against 3rd-party APIs and have a good mind for state machines. The financial system is one giant state machine.

 - Hold yourself accountable to high standards of quality.

 - 1-4 years of experience in full-stack web development, preferably with exposure to smaller companies where flexibility and versatility are key

 - Full-stack

experience:

 - Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship. U.S. citizenship or permanent residency is required.

Compensation

Total compensation may vary and could include equity and additional benefits depending on the position offered and location.

This is a high-autonomy role where you’ll work directly with innovative, early-stage startups, gaining exposure to complex business models and global operations.

jobs.title: Controller
jobs.description:
About Meow

Meow is a business banking platform that brings checking, corporate cards, global payments, treasury, invoicing, and accounting integrations into a single dashboard. Startups, small and mid-sized businesses, investment funds, and international companies use Meow to run their finances in one place. Banking services are provided by FDIC-insured partner banks; Meow Technologies is a financial technology company, not a bank.

About the role

Meow is hiring a Controller to own finance and financial operations across the company. You'll be accountable for the accuracy of our books, our control environment, our financial audit and SOC 1, payroll and benefits, tax, and the reporting our board and leadership use to run the business.

Today we run lean: outsourced bookkeepers handle day-to-day accounting and the monthly close, and outside CPAs handle tax. You'll direct these partners, decide what to bring in-house, and build the processes, policies, and systems our finance function needs as we grow. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants full ownership of finance at a fast-moving fintech.

What you'll do

Accounting and close

 - Manage our outsourced bookkeepers: set the close calendar, review each monthly close, and sign off on the financial statements

 - Review revenue recognition and other key accounting judgments for accuracy and GAAP compliance

 - Make sure every balance sheet account is reconciled and supported each month

 - Evaluate over time which accounting work should move in-house

Audit and SOC 1

 - Serve as the primary contact for our external financial auditors, preparing PBC lists and schedules and supporting fieldwork

 - Own SOC 1 readiness and the annual examination: document controls, coordinate testing, and remediate findings

 - Design and maintain internal controls, including approval limits, segregation of duties, and finance policies

Payroll and benefits

 - Administer payroll, including approvals, employee records, and accurate tax withholdings and filings

 - Administer health insurance and benefits, including open enrollment, broker and carrier relationships, and employee questions

 - Ensure payroll and benefits are recorded correctly in the books

Tax and corporate compliance

 - Manage outside CPAs on federal and state income tax, R&D credits, Delaware franchise tax, and state registrations

 - Own 1099 filings and keep entities in good standing, including annual reports and registered agents

Reporting and planning

 - Produce monthly management reports and the financials for board meetings and investor updates

 - Own budgeting and forecasting, and track profitability, margins, and cash flow

 - Lead finance diligence for fundraising and strategic partnerships

Finance operations

 - Oversee accounts payable, vendor payments, corporate cards, and expense management

 - Maintain stock compensation accounting, coordinate 409A valuations, and keep the cap table tied to the books

 - Manage corporate insurance renewals, including D&O, E&O, and cyber

 - Own the finance tool stack and automate manual processes

What you'll bring

 - 6+ years of accounting experience, including public accounting and time as a controller or assistant controller at a startup or growth-stage company

 - Strong command of US GAAP, including revenue recognition (ASC 606) and stock compensation (ASC 718)

 - Experience leading a financial statement audit and SOC 1 or SOX controls work

 - Hands-on experience administering payroll and benefits platforms such as Gusto, Rippling, or Justworks

 - Experience managing outsourced bookkeepers or accounting firms

 - Advanced proficiency with QuickBooks Online

 - Comfort working autonomously on a fast-moving team

Nice to have

 - CPA license

 - Experience in fintech, banking, or payments

 - Experience with treasury or cash management

 - A track record of building finance processes from scratch

 - Curiosity about AI systems and hands-on interest in using them to automate and improve Meow's financial processes

Compensation

$180K to $220K base depending on experience plus equity and benefits.

At Neo, we’re on a mission to build a more rewarding financial future for all Canadians. Life at a rapidly scaling tech startup isn’t for everyone. It’s complex, fast-paced, high-pressure, but also incredibly fulfilling. Since its founding in 2019, Neo has gained incredible traction and is one of the fastest-growing fintech companies in Canada.

 - #1 on Deloitte’s Technology Fast 50 for 2023, 2024, and 2025 https://www.newswire.ca/news-releases/neo-financial-achieves-first-ever-three-peat-win-as-number-one-on-deloitte-s-technology-fast-50-list-889692540.html — the first company ever to achieve a three-peat at the top!

 - #1 Fastest Growing Company in Canada for 2024 by Globe & Mail https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20240927952651/en/Neo-Financial-Ranks-No.-1-on-The-Globe-and-Mail%E2%80%99s-2024-List-of-Canada%E2%80%99s-Top-Growing-Companies

 - Top-ranked mobile apps and credit cards

 - Team of 500+ people

 - 1M+ customers

 - 10K+ retail partners
 
 

Average On-Target Earnings: $36.00/hour CAD ($74,880/year equivalent) 

 

Compensation: $20.00/hour CAD base wage + uncapped instant commission 

 

Job Type: (Contract) Full-time hours or Part-time hours

The Role

We are seeking motivated Sales Representatives to act as the face of Neo Financial. You will be directly responsible for customer acquisition by signing people up for Neo Credit card, Neo Money account, and other Neo products!

Key Perks

 - Instant Commission: Track your performance in real-time and get paid into your Neo App the moment a customer signs up using your link.

 - Flexible Scheduling: We offer customizable full-time and part-time schedules tailored to high-performing, sales-driven individuals.

What We Are Looking For

 - A strong motivation to earn money and hit performance targets.

 - Enthusiasm for sharing financial products and technology within your local community.

 - Ability to travel to various event locations across your city.

 - Previous experience in direct sales, door-to-door sales, retail, telemarketing, or marketing is an asset.

WORKING AT NEO:

The people who thrive at Neo are resourceful, growth-oriented, and driven to win. We hold ourselves to high standards because we’re on a mission that matters: to build a more rewarding financial future for all Canadians. As individuals and as a team, we constantly challenge ourselves and each other to raise the bar and deliver exceptional experiences for our customers. Our commitment to customer success drives everything we do, from building world-class products to providing exceptional support at every step of their journey. If this resonates with you, keep reading. 

We trust, respect, and support each other. This means honest conversations, constructive input, and empowering each other to move fast and think big. You’ll be surrounded by people who push you to be your best. We primarily collaborate in person across our Calgary, Winnipeg, and Toronto offices, where ideas move quickly and teams build momentum together. As we continue to scale and evolve, we’re looking for builders, innovators, and problem solvers who thrive on challenge–people who would rather blaze a trail through uncertainty than follow a well-paved path. 

At Neo, ownership is part of how we think and operate. For select roles, equity participation reinforces that mindset by giving employees a direct stake in the company’s long-term success. Regardless of role, every team member is expected to think like an owner and make decisions that move the business forward.

APPLY WITH US:

We believe in equal opportunity and are committed to creating an inclusive climate where everyone can thrive. Customers trust us with their finances, so successful candidates for this position will be required to undergo a security screening, including a criminal records check and a credit check. 

By continuing with your application, you agree to the Candidate Privacy Notice https://www.neofinancial.com/candidate-privacy-policy.pdf, which guides how we process your personal information for the purpose of your application. 

Neo Financial leverages artificial intelligence (AI) to reinforce our candidate evaluation process, including the initial assessment of applications and screening of candidates. These tools support our recruitment team; however, all final hiring decisions are made by humans and are not based exclusively on automated processing. If you require further information regarding our data processing practices, please contact us.

We are hiring for an open, vacant position.

This posting is intentionally ongoing. It is not a single open role with a start date attached. As Neo's data science organization grows, we keep a pipeline of people we'd want on the team and reach out when a current or emerging opportunity fits.

The Role

Neo's data science org sits inside products millions of Canadians already use. Data scientists, analytics leaders, and ML platform engineers work as one embedded function: production models, insight that shapes decisions, and the path from prototype to a monitored service. Not a reporting desk. Not a lab on the side.

There's a version of this work that stops at a notebook, a dashboard, or a handoff. Future roles here don't. They run from an ambiguous business question to something that actually runs — through the data, the constraints, and the commercial trade-offs.

At this level you frame the problem, ship the work, and stand behind the result. The people in this pipeline have taken models from working to reliable to material. They know a clever fit from a system the business can trust.

THE WORK

Neo is rebuilding financial services from scratch. We've shipped a full-stack banking platform (credit cards, savings, mortgages, personal loans, cash back) at a pace most financial institutions can't match in a decade. Data science is inside that loop, not adjacent to it.

The problems span credit risk, fraud, marketing and loyalty, executive decisioning, and the ML platform that keeps models alive in production. They run against real financial outcomes for millions of Canadians. Correctness isn't optional. Neither is commercial impact. The work doesn't get easier as we scale.

We don't have a handoff culture. You partner with Product, Engineering, Risk, Marketing, Finance, and operations. Models ship. Insights change decisions. You own the path from prototype to something the company can run on.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - A meaningful surface area with real business impact : risk, fraud, growth, analytics strategy, or the platform that productizes the work

 - The full loop: problem framing, method, delivery, and the validation and monitoring that keep it honest after launch

 - Standards that compound: reproducibility, metric consistency, model governance, and documentation , not one-off heroics

 - Mentorship that raises the bar: code review, experimental design, and developing the people around you

 - Cross-functional alignment. You translate. You don't throw work over the wall.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

If you're a Senior, Staff, or Principal Data Scientist, you own models end to end — design, training, validation, and production. You can defend a validation strategy to a peer who will try to break it, and explain the result to an executive without hiding behind metrics. You mentor. You don't wait for someone else to make the work real.

If you lead analytics, you are not running a service desk. You set the strategy, build the team, and move the company from reactive reporting to insight that changes decisions. You zoom out to company strategy and zoom in to the pipeline and the spreadsheet. You hold the line on metric definitions, experimentation, and quality when the business wants the number yesterday.

If you build ML platforms, you own the path from experiment to production — pipelines, observability, drift, registries, infrastructure-as-code. You make data scientists faster without lowering the bar. You've run production ML on cloud infrastructure, and you treat reliability as part of the model, not a follow-up project.

At every level:

 - Deep technical fluency in Python and SQL, and enough cloud and data-platform literacy to ship, not just present

 - Experience in fintech, lending, payments, or another regulated environment where a wrong number has consequences

 - A track record of taking things from working to reliable to growing — through ambiguity, not around it

 - Low ego, high standards: you do the unglamorous work and hold others to the same

HOW WE HIRE FOR THIS ROLE

We're looking for a rare combination and we won't compromise on fit to move fast. Applying here puts your profile in front of our team and keeps you in consideration as our data science organization grows. It doesn't guarantee an immediate interview, and it won't lock you to a single role. If your background matches a current or emerging opportunity, we'll reach out directly.

We aim to respond to every application, but given the selective nature of this search, timelines may vary.

 - Top-ranked mobile apps and credit cards

 - Team of 500+ people

 - 1M+ customers

 - 10K+ retail partners
 
 

This is a remote-friendly position but candidates must be located within Canada.

THE ROLE

Financial software runs underneath the biggest decisions people make. When it's good, it saves real money over years but when it's not, those losses compound just as quietly. Most of it was built to capture value, not create it. Neo is building the alternative.

Neo has been Canada's fastest-growing company for three years running. The platform behind that growth is built entirely in-house: 150 services in production, hundreds of pull requests merged every week, tens of millions of transactions processed every month. Engineers own their services from architecture through production. There is no QA team to hand work off to and no DevOps team to manage your deployments.

Neo if looking for a Staff engineer who remains hands-on. You write code, not just docs. You shape architecture and raise the technical ceiling across teams in a program, not only inside one squad. You are a sparring partner for Engineering Managers and Directors on hard technical calls, and you drive multi-team work that would otherwise stall or fragment. Our stack is GraphQL, Mongo, Node.js, TypeScript, React, and React Native on AWS. If you have spent time at a company where good ideas died in committee and you know you could be going faster, this is the environment those engineers tend to thrive in.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Own and ship critical services and shared libraries end to end: design, implementation, production delivery, and long-term health.

 - Set the architectural bar across multiple teams in your program: review designs, catch cross-team dependency risk early, and drive the target state when current systems will not scale.

 - Lead scoping and planning for large, complex projects that span teams; keep product and engineering goals aligned without waiting for perfect requirements.

 - Build and evolve tools, templates, and patterns that many teams use, so the whole program moves faster.

 - Raise and own the technical debt that blocks reliability, security, or scale; get the work onto the roadmap and see it through.

 - Keep production honest: observability, alerting, incident response, and blameless follow-through with actionable fixes.

 - Mentor Senior engineers and coach teams through pairing, design reviews, and deliberate knowledge sharing.

 - Advise Engineering Directors and Managers on tech debt, delivery risk, and when to ship an MVP versus invest in a durable system.

 - Treat AI as a force multiplier for yourself and the teams you support: standards, guardrails, and review expectations, not one-off prompting.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - You have roughly 10+ years building production systems, including serious time as a senior or lead IC, with impact that holds up at scale.

 - You have been the technical owner of systems that mattered: you shaped the architecture, not only implemented against someone else's plan.

 - You still write high-quality code and take pride in being a major contributor and code owner, not only a reviewer of others' work.

 - You think in systems: coupling, contracts, failure modes, cost, and second-order effects across services and teams.

jobs.title: Director of Sales
jobs.description:
ABOUT NOVO

Small businesses are the backbone of the US economy, comprising almost half of the GDP and the private workforce. Yet, big banks don’t provide the access, assistance and modern tools that owners need to successfully grow their business.

We started Novo to challenge the status quo. We’re on a mission to increase the GDP of the modern entrepreneur by creating the go-to banking platform for small businesses (SMBs). Our modern bank accounts and tools help owners save time, increase cash flow and manage their business in one place.

WHY NOVO?

 - 250,000+ business customers using the platform

 - $30B+ in transactions processed

 - Profitable, with $170M raised to date

 - Backed by firms including Valar Ventures, Crosslink Capital, Stripes, BoxGroup, RRE Ventures, and Notable Capital

 - Recently launched AI Agent Infrastructure throughout the product

 - Global workforce with offices in New York, LatAm, and India

THE ROLE

Until now, businesses have found Novo on their own. We haven’t had a sales function, and you’ll be the one who builds it.

We’re starting now for two reasons. We want to bring on larger businesses, and a business that size switches after a real conversation with someone who knows the product. We’ve also built a lot more than a checking account, so there’s far more to sell than there used to be.

This is a player-coach role, and it starts with the player part. In your first few months you’re the one prospecting, calling and closing, so you learn firsthand which businesses to go after and what gets them to switch. Then you hire and lead a team built around what you learned.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Sell

 - Develop the sales strategy to target and reach Novo’s ideal customer.

 - Prospect, call and close businesses that keep their money somewhere else today.

 - Show owners in plain terms why Novo is the better choice, and lay out the easiest way to move over.

 - Get hands-on with the switch when a customer needs it, so moving payments, payroll and everything tied to their old account doesn’t stall the deal.

 - Learn which businesses, offers and messages convert, and keep a clear record of it.

Work with AI

 - Use AI as your main tool for prospect research, list building, outreach and pipeline tracking.

 - Build your own workflows with it, and keep improving them as you learn what works.

 - Set how the sales team uses AI as it grows.

Build the team

 - Turn what worked into a playbook other sellers can follow.

 - Hire, train and coach the first sales team, using what you learned selling yourself.

 - Keep carrying your own deals while you lead.

 - Tell product and engineering what customers need in order to buy, backed by what you hear on calls.

WHY THIS ROLE

 - You build it your way. There’s no inherited process or structure. You design the sales function the way you think it should run.

 - You report to the Co-CEO. You have a direct say in the decisions that affect what you sell.

 - Product and engineering respond. When you can show that something will help you sell, it gets built.

 - The upside is uncapped. Commission has no ceiling, and with very strong results this can be the best-paid role at Novo.

 - The team is yours to build. As sales grows, you hire and lead the people who scale it.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

MUST HAVE

 - A record of beating quota on deals you found and closed yourself, cold outreach included.

 - Experience moving customers off a complicated financial product (banking, payments, payroll, lending or similar) and onto a competing one.

 - You can explain in plain words why one product beats another, to a business owner who is short on time.

 - AI is already part of how you work every day, and you can show us something you built with it for research, outreach or tracking.

 - You do well without structure: no playbook and no sales ops team to start.

 - Some experience coaching or leading other sellers, and the drive to build a team of your own.

 - You’re ready for a bigger job than the one you have now, and willing to bet on yourself to get it.

 - Able to work in person from our New York office.

NICE TO HAVE

 - Time on the sales team at a sales-led fintech.

 - Experience selling to business owners or finance leads.

 - You were an early sales hire somewhere, or built a new channel from scratch.

 - A network of business owners you can call in your first week.

PROBABLY NOT THE RIGHT FIT IF

 - You’ve moved fully into management and no longer sell yourself.

 - Your numbers have mostly come from inbound leads or cross-selling to existing customers.

 - You need an established process, tooling and a support team around you to do your best work.

Novo values diversity as a core tenant of the work we do and the businesses we serve. We are an equal opportunity employer, indiscriminate of race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, role-specific, or any other protected characteristic.

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

Product Marketing Manager for Nu Global

ABOUT THE ROLE

Launched in 2026, Nu Global is a global account that people can use to earn, send, and move money worldwide: a daily-yield balance held in digital dollars and digital euros, fee-free transfers to 35+ countries across both regions, a card for spending abroad, and access to curated digital assets. The Product Marketing Manager for Nu Global owns go-to-market to the existing customer base, lifecycle communications (CLM), the Nu Global website experience, the App Store and Google Play listing, and product-led content across channels.

CLM is the heaviest of these work streams and a core part of the role. You will reach customers through email, push notifications, in-app messages and marketing screens, using Nu's proprietary CRM platform, so the quality of this work directly drives adoption and engagement of Nu Global products.

The role is execution-heavy and sits in a small team: a lead PMM, a growth marketer and a partnership activation marketer. You own the delivery and results of your work streams, with direction on priorities from the lead PMM.

YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

Your week is split between running lifecycle programs and keeping the other owned surfaces (website, store listing, content) aligned with what the product is launching. The main challenge is delivering a high volume of work with quality while keeping customer touchpoints prioritized and not overloaded.

experience:

 - Uses behavioral and CX signals to refine audiences, messages and timing.

 - Applies AI and automation to scale content production and CRM operations, evaluating initiatives on ROI, effort and risk.

Nice to have

jobs.description:

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

ABOUT THE ROLE

Nubank is creating its first dedicated Insider Threat Defense team, and you will be the leader who builds it from scratch. Sitting within Information Security, this first-line-of-defense team detects and responds to risks coming from inside the company, such as privileged access misuse, sensitive data exfiltration, credential sale and collusion, sabotage, and remote worker and hiring fraud.

Protecting the trust of more than 127 million customers starts with protecting our own access and data. This is a structural, high-visibility role with M-team sponsorship, and you will own the strategy, the roadmap, and the results: detection coverage, speed of detection, and quality of response.

You will hire and lead the squad, define the scenarios that matter most, and work closely with Conduct Risk (2LOD), Legal, People, Risk, and Privacy. The team detects and qualifies; those areas decide on consequences, keeping a clear separation of roles and independent challenge.

YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Building the team: hire, lead, and develop a specialized squad of detection experts, analysts, and engineers, starting with a small team and growing across Brazil and our international locations, in a high-performance, inclusive, and AI-first culture.

 - Defining strategy and roadmap: set the Insider Threat Defense strategy, scenario taxonomy, and priorities, focusing on the highest residual-risk scenarios (e.g., product abuse, data leakage, privileged access misuse, queue manipulation, code of conduct breaches).

 - Creating the foundations: define policies, scope, documentation, and operating model for a capability that doesn't exist yet at Nubank.

 - Owning governance and key interfaces: work with People, Legal, Risk, Privacy, and Conduct Risk on sensitive cases, preserving line separation and formal model-risk governance.

 - Operating through shared services: ensure effective handoffs and clear SLAs with GSOC (24/7 triage), CSIRT (response and containment), and Threat Detection.

 - Driving automation and AI: use AI and automation to correlate identity, access, and data movement signals and reduce manual analyst effort, without losing detection quality.

 - Reporting to leadership: give executives, regulators, and Internal Audit enterprise-wide visibility of insider risk, including a monthly governance forum and an annual review.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR A PERSON WHO HAS

 - Led security detection, response, or investigation teams, ideally standing up a new capability in a high-scale environment.

 - Hands-on knowledge of insider threat or internal fraud scenarios in technology or financial companies, including UEBA, privileged access misuse, and data exfiltration patterns.

 - Solid technical grounding in SIEM, SOAR, detection engineering, and incident response, enough to guide technical decisions and challenge the team.

 - Worked with People, Legal, Privacy, and Risk on sensitive topics, with strong judgment and discretion.

 - Hired, coached, and grown senior individual contributors, and managed performance.

 - Translated complex technical risks into clear, actionable messages for executives and regulators.

 - Proficiency in English (understanding and speaking) for global collaboration.

NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in financial services or other regulated environments, including regulatory expectations on non-financial risk and three-lines-of-defense models.

 - Experience in insider threat programs, internal fraud, or hybrid cyber/physical investigations.

 - Experience in cloud environments (AWS/GCP) and modern data platforms for security analytics.

 - Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF, or CERT Insider Threat guidance.

 - Experience leading teams across multiple locations and time zones.

LOCATION FOR THIS OPPORTUNITY (CITY, COUNTRY)

 - São Paulo, Brazil

 - Campinas, Brazil

 - Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

 - Belo Horizonte, Brazil

OUR BENEFITS

 - Chance of earning equity at Nubank

 - Food/Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

 - Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

 - NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

 - Life Insurance

 - Medical Plan

 - Dental Plan

 - Nucleo – Our learning platform of courses

 - Daycare Allowance

 - Parental Consultancy

 - Work-from-home Allowance

ABOUT NU

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Global Risk function at Nu is structured around two dimensions: country risk officers (horizontal) and global functional heads by risk discipline (vertical). This matrix creates a "risk surface" that allows the organization to scale efficiently without duplicating senior expertise across geographies.

The Head of Risk US will lead the US risk surface, owning all risk disciplines locally while maintaining close coordination with global functional heads: Global Credit Risk, the Global Market and Liquidity Head, and other risk domain leads.

The US risk team is in its early stages, with existing members covering Compliance, Financial Crime/AML, Regulatory, and is expected to grow in line with the business. This is a build-from-scratch opportunity for a senior executive who thrives in dynamic, high-growth environments.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Head of Risk US is a senior executive responsible for the effective and independent oversight of all risk disciplines within Nu's US operation. 

The role requires a leader who understands the US regulatory landscape deeply, can engage independently with regulators and senior governance bodies, and is capable of building a high-performing risk function in a fast-moving fintech environment. 

This is a high-visibility, high-impact position that will interact frequently with the US Board/Risk Committee, senior regulators, and Nu's executive leadership team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND EXPECTATIONS

Risk Framework & Governance

 - Build and lead a comprehensive risk management framework for the US operation, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, financial crime, and compliance risk.

 - Develop a risk appetite framework and limit structure aligned with the US Board's stated risk tolerance, ensuring all business lines operate within defined parameters.

 - Establish robust risk metrics, reporting dashboards, and early warning indicators to monitor exposures and escalate material issues in a timely manner.

 - Serve as Secretary to the US Board Risk Management Committee; prepare and circulate agendas and minutes.

 - Participate as a permanent member of key senior management committees including the Risk Committee, ALCO, Compliance Committee, and New Product Approval Committee.

Regulatory Engagement

 - Serve as the primary independent risk voice in all interactions with US regulators, engaging with confidence and autonomy.

 - Ensure Nu's control environment consistently meets and anticipates regulatory expectations in a rapidly evolving US regulatory landscape.

 - Develop and maintain relationships with regulators, demonstrating transparency, preparedness, and a mature risk culture.

Risk Surface Management

 - Oversee the day-to-day management of the US risk surface, coordinating with global functional heads on credit, market/liquidity, operational, and financial crime risk.

 - Apply Nu's "target friction" philosophy: prioritize controls based on materiality, avoiding uniform friction in favor of risk-proportionate management that enables business growth.

 - Monitor operational loss events, cyber incidents, and key risk indicators, ensuring mitigation strategies are in place and effective.

Team & Stakeholder Leadership

 - Lead and develop the US risk team, fostering a culture of high standards, intellectual rigor, and ownership.

 - Build a strong working relationship with engineering and technology teams to ensure risk infrastructure is prioritized and developed appropriately.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with the US Country Manager, Legal, Compliance, and Finance to embed risk awareness across the organization.

 - Act as a business partner to the US leadership team — risk as an enabler, not a blocker.

QUALIFICATIONS

Professional Experience & Education

 - Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree (MBA, MSc Finance, JD) or professional certification (CFA, FRM) preferred.

 - 15+ years of experience in risk management within financial services, with a significant portion of that in the US market.

 - Deep expertise in the US regulatory environment (OCC, Fed, FDIC); experience engaging directly with regulators at a senior level is essential.

 - Background in financial institutions, fintechs, or challenger banks strongly preferred. Candidates with exclusive experience at large traditional banks (without demonstrated adaptability) may not be the right fit for this stage of growth.

 - Experience building or significantly transforming a risk function from an early/mid-stage into a mature framework.

 - Solid understanding of all risk disciplines: credit, market, liquidity, operational, financial crime, and compliance — with particular depth in the control environment (AML/BSA, operational risk, cyber).

 - Credit risk expertise is valued but not the primary focus; Nu's global credit function provides strong support in this area.

Competencies & Attributes

 - Comfort with ambiguity and a proven ability to build structure from scratch in fast-moving environments — "generating balance based on chaos."

 - Hands-on leader who is present on the ground and willing to be deeply involved in operational realities, not just strategic oversight.

 - Independent thought leader capable of engaging directly with boards and regulators without relying on hierarchical support for every interaction.

 - Strong stakeholder management skills, particularly with engineering/technology teams — able to translate risk requirements into development priorities and negotiate trade-offs effectively.

 - Risk philosophy aligned with Nu's approach: sees friction as a tool to be applied proportionally to materiality, not a default stance. Views risk as a business partner.

 - Highly adaptive: able to respond quickly to changes in the regulatory landscape and reprioritize accordingly.

 - Intellectually curious, data-driven, and committed to continuous learning.

While we value experience with our tech stack, we are confident that engineers who are eager to learn will be successful here — and we will teach you Clojure as our main backend language.

 - Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, using Finagle and leveraging functional programming techniques and hexagonal architecture

 - Continuous Integration and Deployment pipelines on AWS

 - Data storage solutions using Datomic and DynamoDB

 - Monitoring and observability with Prometheus

 - Services running as much as possible in Kubernetes

We work in small, independent teams that feel like startups within the company and avoid unnecessary coupling and centralization whenever realistic. We understand that execution is key to success and continuously optimize our processes to remove bottlenecks.

 - Pairing and participating in code reviews to support the growth of others in and around your team

 - Collaborating closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leaders to build new end-to-end experiences

 - Ensuring comprehensive observability, performance monitoring, and robust error handling across your team’s services

 - Participating in on-call rotations for your team and responding to incidents as necessary

 - Focusing primarily on backend applications

WE ARE LOOKING FOR A PERSON WHO HAS

 - At least 6 years of experience developing digital products in complex environments

 - Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices architecture, and cloud technologies

 - A proven track record of designing and delivering large-scale systems that serve thousands or millions of users

 - A strong background in object-oriented or functional programming languages, with the ability to work across multiple languages

 - Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives end-to-end within a team and in collaboration with partner teams

 - Experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar in their teams

 - Practical knowledge of agile software development methodologies and prior experience with CI/CD

 - Strong communication skills to identify and prevent risks, and explain trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

 - Experience with data-intensive systems (pipelines, transactional vs. analytical design) is a plus.

Even if you feel you don't meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply — your unique skills and experiences may be just what we're looking for, and we're excited to learn more about what you can bring to our team.

Business Analysts at Nubank

As a company at the forefront of the financial revolution in Brazil, Nubank has experienced exponential growth since its inception. To keep your growth path healthy, numerous critical decisions constantly need to be made. Business Analysts are fundamental in the decision process because they must not only be able to deal with large amounts of information and data, but also always think of ways to improve our clients' experience.

It is BA's responsibility to structure the data, analyze it and use the results to test different solutions with the aim of improving Nubank's efficiency.

We are looking for people who are independent and who are not afraid to take the initiative to identify and solve problems that are not necessarily obvious.

You can read more about it in our blog https://building.nubank.com.br and get some insights into how we work.

 

As a Business Analyst, you’re expected to:

 - Do a lot of investigative work, focused on deciding which data makes the most sense to use in which situation. If you don't have the data, it's your job to think about what tests can be done or how to extract the information you need to answer your questions;

 - Support your team in making data-based decisions by monitoring analysis and decisions, ensuring the flow of projects and making the process of taking risks comfortable despite the uncertainties;

 - Learning how to work with a large volume of data to build a solid foundation for decision making with calculated risks - even knowing that not all the answers are in the data and/or that not all the data you would like is available; Use tools like SQL, Python, Databricks and Scala - taught during your first weeks with us - for data extraction;

 - Understand our products and interactions with other areas;

 - Take advantage of opportunities to grow and learn from a well-prepared and highly qualified team;

 - Opportunity to work in a complex, dynamic and diverse environment, participating in projects that will impact a large number of clients.

 What are we looking for?

 - Analytical capacity: ease with numbers and calculations, having the ability to solve problems mathematically;

 - Business basics: dynamics between risks and opportunities, as well as interaction between business areas and technical areas (products/engineering);

 - Problem solving: ease and creativity to seek solutions to day-to-day challenges and achieve the best results;

 - Ability to understand how your decisions and work impact our customers' experience, seeking results that align with our purpose;

 - Willingness and ease of learning, especially for tools;

 - Openness to receive feedback and incorporate it into your daily life and development;

 - Adaptability to the multifunctional environment;

 - Profiles that add value to Nubank's culture.

 - Food card

 - Work-from-home Allowance

 - Parental Consultancy

 - Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Principal Product Designer, you are the senior-most design authority on the team. You are a visionary with the ability to execute swiftly, articulating solutions that don't just improve the status quo but redefine it. This is an IC9-level role, meaning you operate with exceptional autonomy to drive strategic change across multiple countries and functions.

You will be the guardian of our "purple" identity, responsible for defining 0-1 experiences and elevating the level of craftsmanship across our entire global product. From leading the next generation of our illustration system to architecting the core interaction patterns of our homepage, your work will set the technical and aesthetic foundations that millions of people interact with daily. You are a consultant to leadership, a mentor to the guild, and a pioneer of design excellence.

RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Define the Vision: Lead the creation of 0-1 product experiences, setting a high bar for concept and quality that inspires the entire design organization.

 - Evolve the Visual Identity: Spearhead the global transition to our new illustration system. Define scalable guidelines that move us from current standards to a unified, global language.

 - Architect Core Interactions: Define the structural patterns and widgets for the Nu homepage. Deliver production-ready specifications that bridge the gap between high-level design and engineering execution.

 - Unify Global Design: Eliminate fragmentation across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. You will create a cohesive design language that feels like "one Nu" while intelligently allowing for local market flexibility.

 - Drive Strategic Roadmap: Act as an advisor to business leadership, translating organizational strategy into a tangible design roadmap and removing blocks to ensure a world-class user experience.

 - Mentor and Influence: Act as an ambassador for design craft. You will coach senior design leaders and foster a culture of open communication, empathy, and continuous improvement.

 - Master AI & Innovation: Identify breakthrough opportunities to integrate AI into the design workflow and product experience, ensuring ethical standards and user trust are always prioritized.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required:

 - Deep Design Mastery: Extensive experience leading design at a global scale, with a portfolio that demonstrates world-class visual craft, UI excellence, and systems thinking.

 - Proven Strategic Leadership: Ability to drive large-scale organizational transformations and influence enterprise-level strategy through design.

 - Architectural Thinking: Deep expertise in design systems, interaction patterns, and creating scalable frameworks for complex digital products.

 - Swift Execution: A "visionary who does"—the ability to quickly prototype and articulate high-fidelity solutions that solve complex, ambiguous business problems.

 - Exceptional Communication: Mastery in communicating complex design logic to executive stakeholders and mentoring other designers to improve their persuasive storytelling.

 - Global Perspective: Experience working across diverse markets and cultures, with the ability to balance global consistency and local relevance.

Nice to Have:

- Experience in pioneering AI-driven design tools or features.

OUR BENEFITS

 - A high leverage compensation package benchmarked against global tech leaders, combining a competitive base salary ($312,000) with significant equity (RSUs) to ensure your success is directly tied to the long-term growth of the purple future we are building together.

 - Top Tier Medical Insurance

 - Top Tier Dental and Vision Insurance

About the Role

Nubank is seeking a Staff Security Engineer to contribute in the Identity and Access Management security function across a financial technology organization serving over 100 million customers in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. 
This is a senior individual-contributor role with organizational-level technical influence, responsible for supporting a multi-year IAM security strategy, directing its execution across multiple engineering teams, and ensuring that identity and access controls meet the security, regulatory, and operational requirements of a globally operating financial institution.

The Staff Security Engineer is expected to bring a demonstrated history of delivering consequential security programs — including programs that encountered setbacks — and the technical judgment that only sustained, hands-on experience in the domain produces. 
Critically, this role requires a security engineering philosophy grounded in business enablement: the conviction that security done well accelerates what the organization can do, not merely protects it. This means rigorously distinguishing between controls that reduce real risk and those that create the appearance of compliance without reducing exposure, taking genuine ownership of outcomes rather than delegating accountability through policy, and continuously questioning inherited assumptions about what security measures are necessary, sufficient, or proportionate.

WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Defining, communicating, and executing a multi-year security strategy (especially in the IAM field) aligned with the organization's risk posture, regulatory obligations, and business objectives across multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions.

 - Lead organization-wide authentication migrations that span heterogeneous surfaces — browser, operating system login, CLI tooling, and API-level integrations — across thousands of employees, multiple device ecosystems, and distributed work environments, producing measurable outcomes: authentication success rates above 99%, material reductions in per-authentication time, support exception rates below 1%, and return on investment within weeks of enforcement.

 - Designing and maintaining the core identity infrastructure with the durability and operational discipline required at organizational scale: enterprise Identity Provider, PKI and X.509 certificate lifecycle automation, mutual TLS for service-to-service authentication, and credential management systems engineered to remain sound as the organization grows.

 - Translating least-privilege access from a principle into a measurable, organization-wide program — with defined metrics, visible adoption curves, and accountability structures that allow Security and Engineering leadership to track and act on the organization's access risk posture over time.

 - Designing and maintaining a security engineering framework — comprising technical mechanisms, policies, incentives, and assurance processes — that ensures security properties are durable, verifiable, and operationally sound, rather than dependent on individual vigilance or periodic audits.

 - Leading technical incident response for identity and access security events, including critical vulnerabilities in remote access infrastructure, ensuring thorough investigation, documented root cause analysis, and structural improvements that reduce the likelihood and impact of recurrence.

 - Designing and facilitating large-scale preparedness exercises grounded in realistic attack paths — involving engineering, operations, and executive functions — to identify genuine gaps in IAM controls, not merely satisfy a compliance requirement.

 - Providing technical mentorship and coaching to senior engineers; lead innovative projects with universities and actively collaborate in hiring and career decisions in order to maintain a high technical standard throughout the safety organization.

 - Serving as the technical authority in engagements with Legal, Compliance, internal audit, and external regulators on matters related to identity, authentication, and access control.

 

WE ARE LOOKING FOR A PERSON WHO HAS

 Must-have

 - Solid professional experience in security engineering, with a concentration in identity, authentication, or access management.

 - Demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi-year security programs from conception through measurable outcome — including programs that required navigating organizational obstacles, technical constraints, or material mid-course corrections.

 - Expert-level knowledge of IAM and authentication protocols: OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, FIDO2/WebAuthn, mTLS, and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI).

 - Proficiency in software engineering: ability to produce, review, and reason about production-quality code in at least one general-purpose programming language.

 - Demonstrated ability to model identity-related threat scenarios, assess attacker techniques relevant to the IAM surface, and design controls that remain effective under adversarial conditions.

 - A demonstrable commitment to security as an organizational capability that enables business outcomes: a track record of solving real security problems, a disposition to challenge inherited security assumptions, and a clear pattern of distinguishing genuine risk reduction from security theater or responsibility transfer.

 - Experience communicating technical risk assessments and strategic recommendations to senior non-technical stakeholders, including executives and regulators.

Nice-to-have

 - Experience operating within a financial services institution or similarly regulated environment subject to multiple concurrent regulatory frameworks.

 - Hands-on experience administering or integrating with an enterprise Identity Provider at scale, particularly Okta, or Keycloak.

 - Experience designing and enforcing security controls for third-party, BPO, or partner environments without direct operational control of the partner's infrastructure.
